local local_class = newclass('RockClimb')

local function to_vector3(pos)
	return vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
end

function local_class:init()
	--region Game
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'RockClimb'

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	self.fx_time_passed = 0
	-- fx


	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.is_game_clear = false

	-- 튜토리얼을 봤는지
	self.is_tutorial = true
	self.touch_delay_timer = 0
	self.jump_key_press = false
	--endregion Game

	--region UI
	-- 좌우 버튼
	self.right_button = nil
	self.right_button_touch_handler = nil

	self.left_button = nil
	self.left_button_touch_handler = nil

	-- 게임패드 대응
	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

	self.is_ignore_touch_event = false
	--endregion

	--region Background
	self.background = {
		pooled = {},
		scale = 4,
		count = 3,
		pivot = vector(-7.5, 0, 1),
		size = vector(0, 24, 0),
		scrolling_end = false,
		end_update_routine = false,
		pool_destroy = false
	}

	--endregion Background

	--region fx
	self.fx = {
		hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,

		jump_smoke = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_common_jump_small_local')
		end,

		shockwave = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_shockwave')
		end,

		shockwave = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_shockwave')
		end,

		falling_rock = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_pw_cliff_falling_rock')
		end,

		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}

	self.ui = {
		num_counter = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
	--endregion

	--시어값 조절하기 위해 비쥬얼 컨트롤러 접근
	--TODO TilemapVisualConstants 수정 방식으로 수정해야한다면 대응해야함.
	self.get_visual_controller = function()
		return get_field_object('[gimmick]visualController')
	end

	--목표 프레임
	self.target_fps = 30

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	local constants_data = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/RockClimb/RockClimbConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[self.constants_data_key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end
function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self.fx:load_all()
	self.ui:load_all()
	self:load_all()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	self:unload_all()

	if self.rock_slide ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.rock_slide)
		self.rock_slide = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_all()
	self:dispose_resource_holder()

	if next(self.background.pooled) == nil then
		self:load_bg()
	end

	self:load_ui()
end

function local_class:unload_all()
	self:dispose_button()
	self:destroy_button()
	self:dispose_resource_holder()
	self:dispose_pooled_platform()
	self:dispose_bg()
	self:dispose_dynamic_goat()
	self:dispose_num_counter()

	self:reset_camera()
	self:reset_shear()
end

function local_class:load_bg()
	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

	local bg_pivot = self.background.pivot
	local bg_pos = pivot_pos - self.background.size + bg_pivot

	self.res_holder_bg = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	--3개 이어 붙임.
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		local bg_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder_bg,
				'ondemand/v3_00_pixyworld/tilesets', 'pw_cliff_minigame_bg')

		bg_prefab.transform.position = bg_pos
		bg_pos = bg_pos + self.background.size
		self.background.pooled[i] = bg_prefab
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_bg()
	for i = 1, self.background.count do
		if self.background.pooled[i] ~= nil then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.background.pooled[i])
		end
		self.background.pooled[i] = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_ui()
	self.res_holder_ui = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 화살표 UI 로드
	if self.right_button == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder_ui, 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/theatres/rungame', 'RunGameRightArrow', function(prefab)
					self.right_button = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.right_button:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end

	if self.left_button == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder_ui, 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/theatres/rungame', 'RunGameLeftArrow', function(prefab)
					self.left_button = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.left_button:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_resource_holder()
	if self.res_holder_bg ~= nil then
		self.res_holder_bg:Dispose()
		self.res_holder_bg = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder_ui ~= nil then
		self.res_holder_ui:Dispose()
		self.res_holder_ui = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder_platform ~= nil then
		self.res_holder_platform:Dispose()
		self.res_holder_platform = nil
	end
end

function local_class:load_num_counter()
	-- 카운트 ui
	self.ui_num_counter_object = self.ui.num_counter():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
	self.ui_num_counter = self.ui_num_counter_object.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))
	self.ui_num_counter:Reposition()
	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(0)
	local max_height_count = self.constants_data.game_info.max_height - self.constants_data.game_info.min_height
	self.ui_num_counter:SetMaxCount(max_height_count)
end

function local_class:dispose_num_counter()
	-- 카운터 ui 제거
	self.ui_num_counter = nil

	if self.ui_num_counter_object ~= nil then
		self.ui_num_counter_object:Dispose()
		self.ui_num_counter_object = nil
	end
end

-- 터치 이벤트 로직
function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
			-- 오른쪽으로 가는 버튼 누르고 있을 때
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonUp
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonUp then
			-- 오른쪽으로 가는 버튼을 놓았을 때
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then
			-- 왼쪽으로 가는 버튼 누르고 있을 때
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
			return true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonUp
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonUp then
			-- 왼쪽으로 가는 버튼을 놓았을 때
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.game_start_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self:load_pooled_platform()
	self:init_cur_game_info()
	self:init_platform()
	self:init_character()
	self:init_camera()
	self:setting_shear()

	self:init_dynamic_goat()

	self:set_custom_shader()
	self:hide_common_ui()

	-- 게임패드 이벤트 활성화
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

	self.left_pressed = false
	self.right_pressed = false

	start_coroutine(self.game_update, self)
end

function local_class:game_update()
	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info

	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		count_down = 3,
		play = 4,
		stun = 5,
		defeat = 6,
		restart = 7,
		victory = 8,
	}
	sp_util.enter_scene(nil)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.start

	--게임패드 연결시 스피치 버블 및 QTE 진행 안되는 것 방지 용


	if game_info.is_tutorial and
			self.is_tutorial then
		self.is_tutorial = false
		self:tutorial_scene()
	end

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

	--액티비티 시작에 BGM 볼륨 1로 전환, 믹스 4초
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'event', name = 'bgm_chasing', volume = 1 })

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.count_down

	self:load_num_counter()
	self:set_up_ui_button()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.play

	local time_passed = 0
	local target_dt = 1 / self.target_fps

	-- 캐릭터 및 플랫폼 업데이트
	local move_update = function(dt)
		local surplus = self:update_character_and_return_surplus(time_passed, dt)

		if surplus >= 0 then
			self:update_height(surplus)
		end

		self:update_num_count()

		self:update_platform(surplus)

		self:update_dynamic_goat(time_passed, surplus, dt)
		self:update_falling_rock(surplus, dt)

		if surplus >= 0 then
			self:update_background(surplus)
		end

		self:update_effect(surplus)

		self:caching_character_position()

		self:control_character(time_passed, dt)
	end

	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play or
			self.current_game_state == self.game_state.stun do

		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		-- 저프레임 대응
		if dt > target_dt then
			while dt >= target_dt do
				move_update(target_dt)
				dt = dt - target_dt
			end
			if not float_util.is_almost_zero(dt) then
				move_update(dt)
			end
		else
			move_update(dt)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.defeat then

		--카메라 그리드 아래로 떨어졌을 경우

		--추락하면서 실패 판정 시 1회 재생
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--카메라는 고정된 상태에서 1초 뒤 ‘실패’ 텍스트 등장
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("pw_doodle_jump_failed"))
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')

		--1초 뒤 fade out
		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		local character_data = self.character_data
		local character = get_character(character_data.name)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
		character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)

		self:unload_all()

		camera_util.move_async(vector(999, 0, 555), 0.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.1, 'linear')

		--이후 선택지 등장
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			--재시도(mercy)
			{ 'pw_doodle_jump_3', 'mercy' },
			--나가기(brutal)
			{ 'pw_doodle_jump_4', 'brutal' }
		})

		screen_util.fade_out_async(0.1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		if player_choice == 1 then
			--재시도(mercy)
			--출발 발판에서 다시 게임 진행

			self:load_all()
			self:game_start()
		else
			--나가기(brutal)
			--재시도 연출 진행
			self.is_tutorial = true
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))

			self:show_common_ui()
		end

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.victory then
		self:dispose_button()
		self:dispose_num_counter()

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

		if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'boomerang' then
			self:victory_scene_boomerang()
		elseif self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'goat' then
			self:victory_scene()
		end
	end

end

function local_class:init_character()
	self.character_data = self.constants_data.character
	self.character_data.character = get_character(self.character_data.name)
	local start_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.character_data.pivot.name) + to_vector3(self.character_data.pivot.offset)

	--캐릭터 위치 설정
	local character = self.character_data.character
	character.Position = start_pos
	field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	character_util.stop_shake(character)

	--점프 시 마다 초기 속도 설정
	local move_info = self.character_data.move_info
	local peak_height = move_info.peak_height
	local peak_time = move_info.peak_time
	self.character_data.init_speed = 2 * peak_height / peak_time
	--self.character_data.anim_change_speed = self.character_data.init_speed - peak_time / 2 * gravity
	--self.character_data.cur_speed = self.character_data.init_speed
	self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
	self.character_data.is_stop = true

	self.character_data.cached_pos = self.character_data.character.Position

	self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0

	character_util.set_direction(self.character_data.character, 'right')
end

function local_class:init_camera()
	local camera_info = self.constants_data.camera_info
	local cam_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(camera_info.pivot.name) + to_vector3(camera_info.pivot.offset)
	local ratio = camera_info.ratio

	camera_util.move_async(cam_pos, 0)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(ratio, 0)

	stage_camera.transform.parent.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:setting_shear()
	local visual_controller = self.get_visual_controller()
	self.shear_original = visual_controller.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear
	visual_controller.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = 0
end

function local_class:reset_shear()
	local visual_controller = self.get_visual_controller()
	self.shear_original = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.shear_original, 0.02)
	visual_controller.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController)).Shear = self.shear_original
end

function local_class:set_custom_shader()
	do
		local shader_asset = {
			path = 'ondemand/v2_39_demonshire/theatres/rungame',
			name = 'rungame_shader_container'
		}

		self.shader_container = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder_bg, shader_asset.path, shader_asset.name)

		-- Spine이 카메라를 바라보고 있지 않는 현상 수정
		local no_bend_shader = self.shader_container:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShaderContainer)).ShaderList[0]
		local character_data = self.character_data
		local character = get_character(character_data.name)

		character.SpineController.CustomShader = no_bend_shader
	end
end

function local_class:reset_camera()
	stage_camera.transform.parent.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:init_platform()
	local platform_list = self.constants_data.platform_list

	local height_limit = self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit

	self.cur_platform_list = {}
	self.wait_platform_list = {}

	-- height_limit 초과하는 데이터의 첫 번째 인덱스 찾기
	local split_index = 1
	for i, platform in ipairs(platform_list) do
		if platform.pos.y > height_limit then
			split_index = i
			break
		else
			-- height_limit 이하의 데이터는 lower_z_data, cur_platform_list에 추가
			table.insert(self.cur_platform_list, platform)
			platform.pooled_platform_idx = self:spawn_platform(platform)
		end
	end

	-- higher_z_data, wait_platform_list 초기화 및 데이터 추가
	for i = split_index, #platform_list do
		table.insert(self.wait_platform_list, platform_list[i])
	end
end


function local_class:init_cur_game_info()
	self.cur_game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	self.cur_game_info.height = 0
	self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll = 0

	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false
end

function local_class:hide_common_ui()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CustomButton1)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
end

function local_class:show_common_ui()
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton)
end

-- UI 셋업
function local_class:set_up_ui_button()
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	local target_size = vector(CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight * aspect, CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight)

	--버튼 벌어지는 정도 (원래는 300이였습니다. 지금은 150)
	local button_spread_pos = self.constants_data.game_info.button_spread_pos

	--self.left_button_pos = vector(-target_size.x / 2.0 + 300, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
	--self.right_button_pos = vector(target_size.x / 2.0 - 300, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
	self.left_button_pos = vector(-target_size.x / 2.0 + button_spread_pos, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
	self.right_button_pos = vector(target_size.x / 2.0 - button_spread_pos, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
	local button_scale = vector(1, 1, 1)

	if game_string.IsRTL then
		--self.left_button_pos = vector(target_size.x / 2.0 - 300, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
		--self.right_button_pos = vector(-target_size.x / 2.0 + 300, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
		self.left_button_pos = vector(target_size.x / 2.0 - button_spread_pos, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
		self.right_button_pos = vector(-target_size.x / 2.0 + button_spread_pos, -target_size.y / 2.0 + 114, 0)
		button_scale = vector(-1, 1, 1)
	end

	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.left_button.transform, 'FieldUI')
	self.left_button.transform.localPosition = self.left_button_pos
	self.left_button.transform.localScale = button_scale
	self.left_button:SetActive(true)

	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.right_button.transform, 'FieldUI')
	self.right_button.transform.localPosition = self.right_button_pos
	self.right_button.transform.localScale = button_scale
	self.right_button:SetActive(true)

	self.left_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	self.left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = self.left_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	self.left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
	self.left_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(200, 200)

	self.right_button_touch_handler = CS.Oak.FieldUIButtonTouchHandler()
	self.right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider = self.right_button:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider2D))
	self.right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.offset = vector(0, 0)
	self.right_button_touch_handler.buttonCollider.size = vector(200, 200)

function local_class:load_pooled_platform()
	self.platform_info_list = self.constants_data.platform_info_list
	self.pooled_platform_list = {
		normal = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		fragile = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		jump = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
		victory = {
			cur_idx = 1,
			table = {}
		},
	}

	self.res_holder_platform = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	for type_name, type_info in pairs(self.platform_info_list) do
		for idx = 1, type_info.max_num do

			local pooled_platform = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder_platform,
					type_info.asset_path, type_info.asset_name)
			pooled_platform.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			pooled_platform.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
			local pooled_platform_info = {
				index = idx,
				object = pooled_platform,
				type = type_name,
				is_active = false,
			}
			table.insert(self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table, pooled_platform_info)
		end
	end

	if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'boomerang' then
		local boomerang_data = self.constants_data.game_info.boomerang

		self.boomerang = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
			itemid = boomerang_data.item_id, notforinven = true,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = boomerang_data.sprscale, skip_text = true
		})

		self.boomerang:SetSortingLayerAndOrder('Default', 1, 'Default', 0)

		self.boomerang.SpriteTransform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, 0)

		self.boomerang.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	elseif self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'goat' then
		self.goat_scene = get_character(self.constants_data.game_info.goat_scene.name)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.goat_scene, active_state_type.enabled)

		scene_util.set_direction(self.goat_scene, 'right', false)

		self.goat_scene.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

		local goat_data = self.constants_data.goat_list.data
		character_util.set_scale_factor(self.goat_scene, self.goat_scene.Name, goat_data.size_scale)
	end

end

function local_class:dispose_pooled_platform()
	if self.pooled_platform_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for type_name, type_info in pairs(self.platform_info_list) do
		for i = 1, #self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table do
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table[i].object)
			self.pooled_platform_list[type_name].table[i].object = nil
		end
	end
	self.pooled_platform_list = nil

	if self.boomerang ~= nil then
		self.boomerang:ConsumeComplete()
		self.boomerang = nil
	end

	if self.fragile_platform_for_anim ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.fragile_platform_for_anim)
		self.fragile_platform_for_anim = nil
	end
end


--현재 플랫폼 리스트 값에 풀링된 플랫폼 아이템 오브젝트를 할당해 주고 위치를 옮김.
function local_class:spawn_platform(platform)
	local platform_type = platform.type
	local platform_pos_raw = platform.pos
	local platform_pos = vector(platform_pos_raw.x, platform_pos_raw.y, platform_pos_raw.z)

	local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name) + to_vector3(game_info.pivot.offset)

	local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list[platform_type]
	local item_table = pooled_platform_list.table
	local cur_item_table_idx = pooled_platform_list.cur_idx
	local max_item_table_idx = table_util.get_size(pooled_platform_list.table)

	local is_spawn_successfully = false
	local pooled_platform_idx = -1

	for idx = cur_item_table_idx, max_item_table_idx do
		local item = item_table[idx]
		local platform_object = item.object
		local platform_transform = platform_object.transform
		local type = item.type
		local is_active = item.is_active

		local type_info = self.platform_info_list[type]
		local type_pos_offset = lua_helper.get_or_default(type_info.pos_offset,
				{ x = 0, y = 0, z = 0 })
		local platform_pos_offset = to_vector3(type_pos_offset)

		if not is_active then
			is_spawn_successfully = true
			platform_transform.position = pivot_pos + platform_pos + platform_pos_offset + vector(0, -cur_height, 0)

			if platform_type == 'fragile' then
				local platform_animator = platform_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
				self:reset_animator(platform_animator)
				item.is_broken = false
			end

			--인덱스 바꿔줌
			self.pooled_platform_list[platform_type].cur_idx = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(
					cur_item_table_idx == max_item_table_idx,
					1,
					idx + 1)

			--활성화 상태로 바꿔줌
			self.pooled_platform_list[platform_type].table[idx].is_active = true

			pooled_platform_idx = idx
			break
		end

		-- 테이블전체를 순회 할 수 있도록 설정.
		if idx == max_item_table_idx then
			max_item_table_idx = cur_item_table_idx - 1
			cur_item_table_idx = 1
		end

	end

	if is_spawn_successfully then
		return pooled_platform_idx
	else
		-- 플랫폼(바닥)을 스폰하지 못했다면, 오류 출력.
		exception_stage_exit('The [' .. platform_type .. '] platform spawn failed : insufficient number of pooled objects available.')
		return pooled_platform_idx
	end
end

function local_class:despawn_platform(cur_platform)
	local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list
	local pooled_platform = self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]
	local platform_object = pooled_platform.object
	local platform_transform = platform_object.transform

	platform_transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx].is_active = false

end

function local_class:animate_platform(cur_platform, anim_name, reset_animator)
	local pooled_platform = self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]
	local platform_object = pooled_platform.object

	local platform_animator = platform_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	reset_animator = lua_helper.get_or_default(reset_animator, false)

	if reset_animator then
		self:reset_animator(platform_animator)
	end

	platform_animator.speed = 1
	platform_animator:Play(anim_name)
end

function local_class:reset_animator(animator)
	animator.enabled = false
	animator:Rebind()
	animator:Update(0)
	animator.enabled = true
end

function local_class:update_platform(surplus)
	if self:is_max_height_reached(surplus) then
		return
	end

	-- 플랫폼 움직임
	local despawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.cur_game_info.despawn_pos.name) + to_vector3(self.cur_game_info.despawn_pos.offset)
	local cur_platform_list = self.cur_platform_list

	local despawn_idx_list = {}

	for cur_platform_idx, cur_platform in pairs(cur_platform_list) do
		local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list
		local pooled_platform = self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]

		local platform_object = pooled_platform.object
		local platform_transform = platform_object.transform
		local platform_cur_pos = platform_transform.position

		platform_transform.position = vector(
				platform_cur_pos.x,
				platform_cur_pos.y - surplus,
				platform_cur_pos.z)

		-- 일정 높이 이하 디스폰 시키는 곳
		if platform_transform.position.y < despawn_pos.y then
			self:despawn_platform(cur_platform)
			table.insert(despawn_idx_list, cur_platform_idx)
		end

		if cur_platform.type == 'victory' then
			if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'boomerang' then
				local boomerang_offset = to_vector3(self.constants_data.game_info.boomerang.offset)
				self.boomerang.Position = platform_transform.position + boomerang_offset
			elseif self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'goat' then
				local goat_scene_offset = to_vector3(self.constants_data.game_info.goat_scene.offset)
				self.goat_scene.Position = platform_transform.position + goat_scene_offset
			end

		end
	end

	-- 순회가 끝난 이후 리스트에서 제거
	for i = 1, #despawn_idx_list do
		table.remove(self.cur_platform_list, 1)
	end

	-- 일정 높이 이상 스폰 시키는 곳
	local height_limit = self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit + self.cur_game_info.height

	-- height_limit 초과하는 데이터의 첫 번째 인덱스 찾기
	local remove_index = -1
	for idx, platform in ipairs(self.wait_platform_list) do
		if platform.pos.y > height_limit then
			break
		else
			-- height_limit 이하의 데이터는 lower_z_data, cur_platform_list에 추가
			table.insert(self.cur_platform_list, platform)
			platform.pooled_platform_idx = self:spawn_platform(platform)
			remove_index = idx
		end
	end

	-- self.wait_platform_list가 큐 자료구조 면 이따구로 할 필요 없을 텐데…
	if remove_index ~= -1 then
		for i = 1, remove_index do
			table.remove(self.wait_platform_list, 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:control_character(time_passed, dt)
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = character_data.character
	local move_info = self.character_data.move_info
	--region 좌우 이동 관련 (X 축)

	-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 체크

	local current_left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
			or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
			or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

	local current_right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
			or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
			or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

	-- 터치 체크 (버튼에서 손 땔 때 애니메이션 처리도 해야 되서 ignore_touch_event 상태여도 실행함)
	-- 버튼 누르거나 떼는 Animation 처리 (down : 누른 상태, up : 뗀 상태)
	local left_down = false
	local left_up = false
	local right_down = false
	local right_up = false

	self.left_button_touch_handler:Update()
	self.right_button_touch_handler:Update()

	-- 눌렀는지 떼었는지 확인
	if current_left_pressed ~= self.left_pressed then
		if current_left_pressed then
			left_down = true
		else
			left_up = true
		end

		self.left_pressed = current_left_pressed
	elseif current_left_pressed == self.left_pressed then
		if current_left_pressed then
			left_down = true
		else
			left_down = false
		end
		self.left_pressed = current_left_pressed

	end
	if current_right_pressed ~= self.right_pressed then
		if current_right_pressed then
			right_down = true
		else
			right_up = true
		end

		self.right_pressed = current_right_pressed

	elseif current_right_pressed == self.right_pressed then
		if current_right_pressed then
			right_down = true
		else
			right_down = false
		end
		self.right_pressed = current_right_pressed

	end

	local charge_state = {
		none = 1,
		charge_1 = 2,
		charge_2 = 3,
		charge_3 = 4,
		stun = 5,
	}
	local charge_info = move_info.charge
	local charge_time = charge_info.time

	self.cur_charge_state = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.cur_charge_state, charge_state.none)

	local x_speed = charge_info.x_speed[1]
	local z_speed = charge_info.z_speed[1]
	if self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_1 then
		x_speed = charge_info.x_speed[2]
		z_speed = charge_info.z_speed[2]
	elseif self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_2 then
		x_speed = charge_info.x_speed[3]
		z_speed = charge_info.z_speed[3]
	elseif self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_3 then
		x_speed = charge_info.x_speed[4]
		z_speed = charge_info.z_speed[4]
	end

	-- 힘 모을 때 공통 연출
	local charge_character = function(emotion, anim, shake_magnitude)
		scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, emotion)

		scene_util.set_anim(character, self, anim)

		character_util.stop_shake(character)

		shake_magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(shake_magnitude, 0)

		if shake_magnitude > 0 then
			character_util.shake(character, shake_magnitude, 999)
		end
	end

	self.left_down_time_passed = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.left_down_time_passed, 0)
	self.right_down_time_passed = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.right_down_time_passed, 0)

	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.stun and
			self.character_data.is_stop then
		if left_down and
				self.right_down_time_passed <= 0 then
			--UI 동작
			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = self.left_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({ 0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1 }),
					unity_color({ 1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1 }), unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.5 }))

			--게임 동작
			character_util.set_direction(character, 'left')
			self.left_down_time_passed = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.left_down_time_passed, 0) + dt
			if self.left_down_time_passed > charge_time[4] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_3 then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.stun

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')

				charge_character('damaged', 'prostrate')

			elseif self.left_down_time_passed > charge_time[3] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_2 then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.charge_3

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

				charge_character('mad', 'boong_attack_ready_loop', 0.09)

			elseif self.left_down_time_passed > charge_time[2] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_1 then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.charge_2

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

				charge_character('attack', 'bow_idle', 0.06)

			elseif self.left_down_time_passed > charge_time[1] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.none then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.charge_1

				charge_character('idle', 'cast2')

			end
		elseif right_down and
				self.left_down_time_passed <= 0 then
			--UI 동작
			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = self.right_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({ 0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1 }),
					unity_color({ 1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1 }), unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.5 }))

			--게임 동작
			character_util.set_direction(character, 'right')
			self.right_down_time_passed = lua_helper.get_or_default(self.right_down_time_passed, 0) + dt
			if self.right_down_time_passed > charge_time[4] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_3 then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.stun

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')

				charge_character('damaged', 'prostrate')

			elseif self.right_down_time_passed > charge_time[3] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_2 then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.charge_3

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

				charge_character('mad', 'boong_attack_ready_loop', 0.09)

			elseif self.right_down_time_passed > charge_time[2] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.charge_1 then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.charge_2

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

				charge_character('attack', 'bow_idle', 0.06)

			elseif self.right_down_time_passed > charge_time[1] and
					self.cur_charge_state == charge_state.none then

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.charge_1

				charge_character('idle', 'cast2')

			end
		elseif left_up and
				self.left_down_time_passed > 0 then
			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = self.left_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }),
					unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 0.8 }), unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.5 }))

			if self.cur_charge_state ~= charge_state.stun then
				self.character_data.is_stop = false

				scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'idle')
				scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'get')
				character_util.stop_shake(character)

				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = -x_speed

				self.left_down_time_passed = 0

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.none

				self:jump_character(z_speed, 0, time_passed)

				if self.wait_broken_platform ~= nil then
					self:break_platform(self.wait_broken_platform)
					self.wait_broken_platform = nil
				end
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'idle')
				scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'idle')
				character_util.stop_shake(character)

				self.left_down_time_passed = 0

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.none
			end
		elseif right_up and
				self.right_down_time_passed > 0 then
			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = self.right_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 1 }),
					unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 0.8 }), unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, 0.5 }))

			if self.cur_charge_state ~= charge_state.stun then
				self.character_data.is_stop = false

				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = x_speed

				scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'idle')
				scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'get')
				character_util.stop_shake(character)

				self.right_down_time_passed = 0

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.none

				self:jump_character(z_speed, 0, time_passed)

				if self.wait_broken_platform ~= nil then
					self:break_platform(self.wait_broken_platform)
					self.wait_broken_platform = nil
				end
			else
				scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'idle')
				scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'idle')
				character_util.stop_shake(character)

				self.right_down_time_passed = 0

				self.cur_charge_state = charge_state.none
			end
		end
	end


	--endregion
end

function local_class:update_character_and_return_surplus(time_passed, dt)
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = character_data.character
	local move_info = self.character_data.move_info

	--region 좌우 움직임 관련(x 축)
	local character_new_pos_x = character.Position.x +
			self.character_data.cur_x_speed * dt
	--endregion


	--region 점프 관련(z 축)
	local peak_height = move_info.peak_height
	local peak_time = move_info.peak_time - move_info.peak_consistent_time / 2
	local gravity = peak_height * 2 / (peak_time * peak_time)

	local cal_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed
	if self.character_data.is_stop then
		self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
		cal_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed
	else
		if not self.is_force_jump then
			if self.jump_start_time + move_info.peak_time < time_passed and
					time_passed < self.jump_start_time + move_info.peak_time + move_info.peak_consistent_time then
				self.character_data.cur_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed - gravity * dt
				cal_speed = 0
			else
				self.character_data.cur_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed - gravity * dt
				cal_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed
			end
		else
			self.character_data.cur_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed - gravity * dt
			cal_speed = self.character_data.cur_speed
		end
	end

	local jump_height_limit = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.character_data.pivot.name).y
	local character_new_pos_y = character.Position.y +
			cal_speed * dt
	--endregion

	local surplus = character_new_pos_y - jump_height_limit

	local character_new_pos = character.Position
	local surplus_rate = 0

	if character_new_pos_y > jump_height_limit and not self:is_max_height_reached(surplus) then
		character_new_pos = vector(character_new_pos_x, jump_height_limit, character.Position.z)
		surplus_rate = surplus
	else
		local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
		local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
		local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name) + to_vector3(game_info.pivot.offset)

		if pivot_pos.y > character_new_pos_y then
			self.current_game_state = self.game_state.defeat
			character_new_pos = character.Position
			surplus_rate = 0
		else
			character_new_pos = vector(character_new_pos_x, character_new_pos_y, character.Position.z)
			surplus_rate = 0
		end
	end

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.play then
		self:check_obstacle_hit()
		--내려갈 때 만 체크.
		if self.character_data.cur_speed < 0 then
			character_new_pos = self:check_platform_hit(character_new_pos, time_passed)
		end
	end

	character.Position = character_new_pos

	return surplus_rate
end

function local_class:jump_character(height_multiplier, jump_offset, time_passed, is_force_jump)

	height_multiplier = lua_helper.get_or_default(height_multiplier, 1)
	local move_info = self.character_data.move_info


	--플랫폼 밟은 위치 만큼 점프 정도를 보정해 줌
	jump_offset = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(jump_offset < 0, 0, jump_offset)
	local peak_height = move_info.peak_height * height_multiplier + jump_offset

	local peak_time = (move_info.peak_time - move_info.peak_consistent_time / 2) * math.sqrt(height_multiplier)

	local speed = 2 * peak_height / peak_time

	self.jump_start_time = time_passed

	--버섯 밟으면 체공 유지 시간 X
	is_force_jump = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_force_jump, false)
	self.is_force_jump = is_force_jump

	if is_force_jump then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
	end

	--이펙트
	self.character_data.cur_speed = speed
	local character_pos = self.character_data.character.Position

	self.shockwave = self.fx:shockwave():Instantiate(character_pos + vector(0, 0, 0))
	self.shockwave.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(20, 0, 0)
	self.shockwave.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
end

function local_class:update_effect(surplus)
	if self.shockwave ~= nil then
		local cur_pos = self.shockwave.transform.localPosition
		local new_pos = cur_pos + vector(0, -surplus, 0)
		self.shockwave.transform.localPosition = new_pos
	end

	if self.jump_smoke ~= nil then
		local cur_pos = self.jump_smoke.transform.localPosition
		local new_pos = cur_pos + vector(0, -surplus, 0)
		self.jump_smoke.transform.localPosition = new_pos
	end
end

function local_class:update_falling_rock(surplus, dt)
	for dust, _ in pairs(self.falling_rock_hashset) do
		dust.time_passed = dust.time_passed + dt
		dust.fx.transform.position = dust.fx.transform.position + vector(0, -surplus, 0)
	end

	for dust, _ in pairs(self.falling_rock_hashset) do
		if dust.time_passed > 2 then
			dust.fx:Dispose()
			self.falling_rock_hashset:remove(dust)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:stun_character(speed_value)
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = character_data.character

	speed_value = lua_helper.get_or_default(speed_value, 0)

	self.character_data.cur_x_speed = speed_value
	self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
	self.character_data.is_stop = false
	self.is_force_jump = true
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.stun

	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	local last_hit_fx = self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	last_hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local hit_fx = self.fx:hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	local angle = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(speed_value > 0, 720, -720)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, angle, 2)
end

function local_class:update_background(move_rate)
	if self:is_max_height_reached(move_rate) then
		return
	end

	local game_info = self.constants_data.game_info
	local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name) + self.background.pivot

	local up_limit_pos = pivot_pos + self.background.size * 2
	local under_limit_pos = pivot_pos - self.background.size

	for i = 1, #self.background.pooled do
		local cur_pos = self.background.pooled[i].transform.position
		local new_pos = cur_pos + vector(0, -move_rate, 0)
		self.background.pooled[i].transform.position = new_pos
	end

	for i = 1, #self.background.pooled do
		local cur_pos = self.background.pooled[i].transform.position
		if cur_pos.y < under_limit_pos.y then
			local max_y_index = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(i - 1 < 1, #self.background.pooled, i - 1)
			self.background.pooled[i].transform.position = self.background.pooled[max_y_index].transform.position + self.background.size
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_height(soar_rate)
	self.cur_game_info.height = self.cur_game_info.height + soar_rate
end

function local_class:update_num_count()
	local game_info = self.cur_game_info
	local half_height_limit = game_info.height_limit / 2
	local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height
	local num_count = 0

	local min_height = game_info.min_height

	if cur_height <= 0 then
		local pivot_name = game_info.pivot.name
		local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

		local character_data = self.character_data
		local character = get_character(character_data.name)
		local character_pos = character.Position

		self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll = math.max(half_height_limit + character_pos.y,
				self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll)

		num_count = math.ceil(self.cur_game_info.max_height_before_scroll) - min_height
	else
		num_count = math.ceil((cur_height + half_height_limit)) - min_height
	end

	self.ui_num_counter:SetCount(num_count)
end

function local_class:caching_character_position()
	-- 충돌 체크 용 : 과거 위치 기억 해 두기
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local character_pos = character.Position

	self.character_data.cached_pos = character_pos
end

function local_class:check_platform_hit(character_new_pos, time_passed)
	local cur_platform_list = self.cur_platform_list

	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local character_cur_pos = character_new_pos
	local character_hitbox_pos = character_cur_pos + to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.offset)
	local character_hitbox_size = to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.size)

	--체크 후 보정 값
	local character_fixed_pos = character_cur_pos

	for cur_platform_idx, cur_platform in pairs(cur_platform_list) do
		local pooled_platform_list = self.pooled_platform_list
		local pooled_platform = pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx]

		local platform_object = pooled_platform.object
		local platform_type = pooled_platform.type
		local type_info = self.platform_info_list[platform_type]
		local is_broken = pooled_platform.is_broken

		local platform_cur_pos = platform_object.transform.position
		local platform_hitbox_offset = to_vector3(type_info.hitbox.offset)
		local platform_hitbox_pos = platform_cur_pos + platform_hitbox_offset

		local platform_hitbox_size = to_vector3(type_info.hitbox.size)
		local height_scale = type_info.height_scale

		--점프 오프셋, 플레이어가 플랫폼 히트박스를 밟은 위치가 낮으면 낮을 수록 그만큼 더 뛰게 만든다.
		--추가된 이유 : 플랫폼을 상대적으로 아래를 밟았을 때와 위를 밟았을 때랑 도달할 수 있는 높이가 달랐음.
		--이에 따라 잘못 밟으면(아래를 밟으면) 거리가 간신히 닿는 플랫폼 까지 뛰지 못하는 경우가 발생
		local jump_offset = platform_cur_pos.y + platform_hitbox_offset.y + platform_hitbox_size.y * 0.5 - character_cur_pos.y

		if self:platform_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox_size, platform_hitbox_pos, platform_hitbox_size) and
				self:is_in_camera(platform_cur_pos) then
			if platform_type == 'fragile' and
					not self.character_data.is_stop and
					not is_broken then

				self.wait_broken_platform = cur_platform

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_01')
				self:stop_character()

				character_fixed_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(character_cur_pos,
						platform_cur_pos.y + platform_hitbox_offset.y + platform_hitbox_size.y * 0.5)
			elseif platform_type == 'jump' then

				self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0

				self:jump_character(height_scale, jump_offset, time_passed, true)

				self:animate_platform(cur_platform, 'swell', false)

			elseif platform_type == 'victory' then

				self:stop_character()

				self:win_game()

			elseif platform_type == 'normal' and
					not self.character_data.is_stop then

				self:stop_character()

				character_fixed_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(character_cur_pos,
						platform_cur_pos.y + platform_hitbox_offset.y + platform_hitbox_size.y * 0.5)
			end
			return character_fixed_pos
		end
	end

	return character_fixed_pos
end

function local_class:break_platform(cur_platform)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_break_wood_01')
	self:animate_platform(cur_platform, 'break', true)
	self.pooled_platform_list[cur_platform.type].table[cur_platform.pooled_platform_idx].is_broken = true
end

function local_class:stop_character()
	self.character_data.cur_x_speed = 0
	self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
	self.character_data.is_stop = true
	local character = get_character(self.character_data.name)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_projectile_01')

	self.jump_smoke = self.fx:jump_smoke():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.1))
	self.jump_smoke.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, 'idle')
end

function local_class:platform_collision_check(c_pos, c_hitbox, p_pos, p_hitbox)
	return p_pos.x - (p_hitbox.x / 2) - (c_hitbox.x / 2) < c_pos.x and
			c_pos.x < p_pos.x + (p_hitbox.x / 2) + (c_hitbox.x / 2) and
			p_pos.y - (p_hitbox.y / 2) + (c_hitbox.y / 2) < c_pos.y and
			c_pos.y < p_pos.y + (p_hitbox.y / 2) + (c_hitbox.y / 2)
end

function local_class:is_in_camera(platform_cur_pos)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	local cur_y = platform_cur_pos.y
	local up_pos_y = camera_pos.y + cam_half_height
	local down_pos_y = camera_pos.y - cam_half_height

	return down_pos_y < cur_y and cur_y < up_pos_y
end

function local_class:check_obstacle_hit()
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)
	local character_pos = character.Position
	local character_hitbox_pos = character_pos + to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.offset)
	local character_hitbox = to_vector3(character_data.hitbox.size)

	local goat_list = self.constants_data.goat_list
	local goat_data = goat_list.data
	local goat_count = goat_list.count

	for i = 1, goat_count do
		local goat = self:get_dynamic_goat_by_idx(i)
		local goat_pos = goat.Position
		local goat_hitbox_info = goat_data.hitbox
		local goat_hitbox_pos = goat_pos + to_vector3(goat_hitbox_info.offset)
		local goat_hitbox = to_vector3(goat_hitbox_info.size)

		if (goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state == self.goat_state.moving or
				goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state == self.goat_state.pause) and
				self:obstacle_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox, goat_hitbox_pos, goat_hitbox) then
			local speed_value = goat_list.pattern_list[i].dir_value * goat_data.speed

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			self:stun_character(speed_value)
		end
	end

	if self.constants_data.game_info.victory_scene_name == 'goat' then
		local goat = self.goat_scene
		local goat_pos = goat.Position
		local goat_hitbox_info = goat_data.hitbox
		local goat_hitbox_pos = goat_pos + to_vector3(goat_hitbox_info.offset)
		local goat_hitbox = to_vector3(goat_hitbox_info.size)

		if self:obstacle_collision_check(character_hitbox_pos, character_hitbox, goat_hitbox_pos, goat_hitbox) then
			local speed_value = 0

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
			self:stun_character(speed_value)
		end
	end

end

function local_class:obstacle_collision_check(c_pos, c_hitbox, o_pos, o_hitbox)
	return o_pos.x - (o_hitbox.x / 2) - (c_hitbox.x / 2) < c_pos.x and
			c_pos.x < o_pos.x + (o_hitbox.x / 2) + (c_hitbox.x / 2) and
			o_pos.y - (o_hitbox.y / 2) - (c_hitbox.y / 2) < c_pos.y and
			c_pos.y < o_pos.y + (o_hitbox.y / 2) + (c_hitbox.y / 2)
end

function local_class:init_dynamic_goat()
	local goat_list = self.constants_data.goat_list
	local goat_data = goat_list.data
	local goat_spec = goat_list.spec
	local goat_count = goat_list.count

	self.goat_state = {
		none = 1,
		wait_spawn = 2,
		spawn = 3,
		moving = 4,
		pause = 5,
		stop = 6,
	}

	self.constants_data.goat_list.container = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async(goat_spec)

	for i = 1, goat_count do
		local goat = self:get_dynamic_goat_by_idx(i)
		goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.disabled)
		goat.SpineController.TimeScale = goat_data.anim_scale
		character_util.set_scale_factor(goat, goat.Name, goat_data.size_scale)
	end

	for i = 1, goat_count do
		self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state = self.goat_state.wait_spawn
	end

	self.falling_rock_hashset = create_lua_hashset()

end

function local_class:get_dynamic_goat_by_idx(idx)
	local goat_key = self.constants_data.goat_list.key
	local goat_count = self.constants_data.goat_list.count
	local goat_container = self.constants_data.goat_list.container

	if idx > goat_count then
		return nil
	else
		return goat_container[goat_key .. idx]
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_dynamic_goat()
	if self.constants_data.goat_list.container ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.constants_data.goat_list.container)
	end
	self.constants_data.goat_list.container = nil

	local goat_count = self.constants_data.goat_list.count

	if self.falling_rock_hashset ~= nil then
		self.falling_rock_hashset:clear()
	end
end

function local_class:update_dynamic_goat(time_passed, surplus, dt)
	local goat_list = self.constants_data.goat_list
	local goat_data = goat_list.data
	local goat_spec = goat_list.spec
	local goat_count = goat_list.count

	local pattern_list = goat_list.pattern_list

	local cur_height = self.cur_game_info.height
	local height_limit = self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit

	-- 스폰 위치 관련
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.game_info.pivot.name)
	local goat_offset = to_vector3(goat_data.offset)
	local game_offset = to_vector3(self.constants_data.game_info.pivot.offset)
	local spawn_pivot_pos = pivot_pos + goat_offset

	-- 계산에 필요한 실질적 높이. 해당 값을 비교해 염소를 스폰/디스폰 해도 되는지 판단.
	local cur_height_sub = cur_height + height_limit

	for i = 1, goat_count do
		local cur_state = self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state
		if cur_state == self.goat_state.wait_spawn then
			local spawn_height = pattern_list[i].height

			if cur_height_sub > spawn_height then
				self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].state_change_time = time_passed
				self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state = self.goat_state.spawn
			end

		elseif cur_state == self.goat_state.spawn then
			local goat = self:get_dynamic_goat_by_idx(i)
			local x_min = pattern_list[i].x_min
			local x_max = pattern_list[i].x_max
			local spawn_pos_x = random_util.get_random_int(x_min, x_max)

			local spawn_height = pattern_list[i].height
			goat.Position = vector(spawn_pivot_pos.x + spawn_pos_x,
					pivot_pos.y + game_offset.y + goat_offset.y + spawn_height - cur_height,
					spawn_pivot_pos.x + goat_offset.z)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat)
			field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.enabled)

			--초기 방향(랜덤)
			local random_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, 2)
			local random_dir_num = -2 * random_num + 3
			local random_dir_string = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(random_dir_num == 1, 'right', 'left')
			self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].dir_value = random_dir_num

			character_util.set_direction(goat, random_dir_string)

			scene_util.set_anim(goat, self, { name = 'walk' })

			self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].move_start_time = time_passed
			self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].pause_start_time = 0
			self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state = self.goat_state.moving

			self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect_start_time = time_passed


		elseif cur_state == self.goat_state.moving or
				cur_state == self.goat_state.pause then
			local goat = self:get_dynamic_goat_by_idx(i)

			--region 상하 움직임 관련
			surplus = lua_helper.get_or_default(surplus, 0)
			local goat_new_pos_y = goat.Position.y - surplus
			--endregion

			--region 좌우 움직임 관련
			local x_min = pattern_list[i].x_min
			local x_max = pattern_list[i].x_max

			local move_time = pattern_list[i].move_time
			local pause_time = pattern_list[i].pause_time

			local goat_pos_x = goat.Position.x
			local goat_new_pos_x = goat_pos_x

			if cur_state == self.goat_state.moving then
				local moving_range_min_x = goat_offset.x + x_min + pivot_pos.x
				local moving_range_max_x = goat_offset.x + x_max + pivot_pos.x

				--좌우 범위 벗어나면
				if goat_pos_x < moving_range_min_x then
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].dir_value = 1
					character_util.set_direction(goat, 'right')
				elseif goat_pos_x > moving_range_max_x then
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].dir_value = -1
					character_util.set_direction(goat, 'left')
				end

				goat_new_pos_x = goat_pos_x +
						self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].dir_value * goat_data.speed * dt

				local move_start_time = pattern_list[i].move_start_time

				if time_passed > self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect_start_time + 0.2 then
					local fx_falling_rock = self.fx.falling_rock():Instantiate(goat.Position)

					local falling_rock_data = {
						fx = fx_falling_rock,
						time_passed = 0
					}

					self.falling_rock_hashset:add(falling_rock_data)
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect_start_time = time_passed
				end

				if time_passed > move_start_time + move_time then
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].pause_start_time = time_passed
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state = self.goat_state.pause

					scene_util.set_anim(goat, self, { name = 'idle' })

				end
			elseif cur_state == self.goat_state.pause then
				local pause_start_time = pattern_list[i].pause_start_time

				if time_passed > pause_start_time + pause_time then
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].move_start_time = time_passed
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state = self.goat_state.moving
					scene_util.set_anim(goat, self, { name = 'walk' })

					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect_start_time = time_passed
				end
			end
			--endregion

			--region 디스폰 관련
			local despawn_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.cur_game_info.despawn_pos.name)
					+ to_vector3(self.cur_game_info.despawn_pos.offset)
			local goat_effect = self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect
			if goat_new_pos_y > despawn_pos.y then
				goat.Position = vector(goat_new_pos_x, goat_new_pos_y, pivot_pos.z + goat_offset.z)
				if goat_effect ~= nil then
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect.transform.position = self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect.transform.position +
							vector(0, -surplus, 0)
				end
			else
				goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat)
				field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.disabled)

				if self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect ~= nil then
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect:Dispose()
					self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].effect = nil
				end

				self.constants_data.goat_list.pattern_list[i].cur_state = self.goat_state.stop
			end
			--endregion
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_effect_loop(effect, is_loop)
	local particle_systems = effect:GetComponentsInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.ParticleSystem))

	for i = 0, particle_systems.Length - 1 do

		local effect_particle_system = particle_systems[i]

		local main = effect_particle_system.main

		main.loop = is_loop

	end
end

function local_class:win_game()
	self.character_data.cur_speed = 0
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.victory
end

function local_class:is_max_height_reached(surplus)
	surplus = lua_helper.get_or_default(surplus, 0)
	return self.cur_game_info.height + surplus > self.cur_game_info.max_height - self.constants_data.game_info.height_limit / 2
end

function local_class:victory_scene()
	local character_data = self.character_data
	local character = get_character(character_data.name)

	local pivot_name = character_data.pivot.name
	local pivot_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(pivot_name)

	local character_pos = character.Position
	local is_qte_success = false

	local goat = self.goat_scene
	local goat_start_pos = goat.Position

	-- 카메라 줌인 (5, 1)
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	camera_util.move(vector_util.get_0yz(character_pos, pivot_pos.x), 1)
	wp_util.move(character, vector(pivot_pos.x, character_pos.y, character_pos.z), 1, nil)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 1)

	-- 마지막 발판 오르면 코르네 (right, idle, idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
	character_util.hide_weapon(character, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)

	character_pos = character.Position

	local euler_angle = vector(0, 0, 0)

	while not is_qte_success do

		-- 이후 대사 출력

		-- 코르네 (right, idle, idle): 이제… 거의 다 온 것 같은데…
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_doodle_jump_1', skip = true, euler_angle = euler_angle })

		-- 코르네 (right, idle, idle): 남은 부분은 단숨에 올라가자!
		scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(character, self,
				{ dir = 'right', sfx = false },
				nil,
				nil,
				{ key = 'pw_doodle_jump_2', skip = true, euler_angle = euler_angle })

		-- 코르네 (right, attack, boong_attack_ready_loop) 출력 시작되며 QTE 진행
		scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'boong_attack_ready_loop' })

		-- 터치 QTE 진행
		--qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap()
		local is_camera_resized = false

		--터치 횟수 10회
		is_qte_success = qte_play_util.tap(10, {
			-- 제한 시간 3초
			duration = 3,
			-- 1회 터치 시
			tap_count_callback = function()
				-- 카메라 줌인 (4.5, 0.3)
				if not is_camera_resized then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')
					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4.5, 0.3)
					is_camera_resized = true
				end
				-- 카메라 shake (0.05)
				camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.1)
			end
		})

		screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()
		self:hide_common_ui()

		if not is_qte_success then
			-- 실패 연출
			-- 왼쪽 상단에서 황색 산양이 등장하며 충돌
			scene_util.set_direction(goat, 'right', false)

			local goat_speed = 4
			goat.SpineController.TimeScale = 2
			field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.enabled)

			local falling_rock_routine = true
			start_coroutine(function()
				local time_passed = 0
				local falling_rock_period = 0.2
				while falling_rock_routine do
					time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					while time_passed > falling_rock_period do
						local fx_falling_rock = self.fx.falling_rock():Instantiate(goat.Position)

						local falling_rock_data = {
							fx = fx_falling_rock,
							time_passed = 0
						}

						self.falling_rock_hashset:add(falling_rock_data)
						time_passed = 0
					end

					self:update_falling_rock(0, unity_class.time.deltaTime)

					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end)

			scene_util.set_anim(goat, self, { name = 'walk' })
			wp_util.move_async(goat,
					vector_util.get_x0z(character_pos + vector(-0.75, 0, 0), goat_start_pos.y),
					goat_speed)

			-- 충돌과 동시에 fx_hit와 fx_lasthit가 출력
			-- 코르네는 (down, damaged, embarrassed) 출력되며 아래로 떨어지며 사라짐
			scene_util.set_direction(character, 'down', false)
			scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'damaged')
			scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'embarrassed' })

			--실패 시 염소에 부딪히는 Fx에
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')

			local last_hit_fx = self.fx:last_hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.1))
			last_hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

			local hit_fx = self.fx:hit():Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.1))
			hit_fx.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

			start_coroutine(function()
				wp_util.move_async(goat,
						{ vector_util.get_x0z(character_pos + vector(3, 0, 0), goat_start_pos.y) },
						goat_speed,
						nil,
						{ last_direction = 'left' })
				scene_util.set_anim(goat, self, { name = 'idle' })
				falling_rock_routine = false
			end)

			local character_speed = 0
			local time_passed = 0
			local max_time = 2
			local gravity = 9.8
			local x_speed = 2

			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 720, max_time)
			while time_passed < max_time do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				character_speed = character_speed - gravity * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local new_x = x_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local new_y = character_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
				character.Position = character.Position + vector(new_x, new_y, 0)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

			-- 마지막 발판 올라와서 진행하는 대사부터 진행
			scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
			character.Position = character_pos
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
			character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
			character_util.stop(character)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat)
			scene_util.set_direction(goat, 'right', false)

			character_util.stop(goat)
			goat.Position = goat_start_pos

			field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.enabled)

			falling_rock_routine = false

			camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0)

			wait_for_sec(1)

			screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
		end
	end

	-- 성공 연출

	-- 카메라 줌아웃 (5, 0.3)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(5, 0.3)

	-- 코르네 (right, attack, jump) 상태에서 현재 위치에서 0.5초에 걸쳐 Z축 +20 만큼 이동
	scene_util.set_direction(character, 'right', false)
	scene_util.set_emotion(character, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_anim(character, self, { name = 'jump' })

	--코르네 점프 시
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rush_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	--점프 시 FX_shockwave 원래 크기로 출력
	self.shockwave = self.fx:shockwave():Instantiate(character_pos + vector(0, 0, 0))
	self.shockwave.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(20, 0, 0)

	wp_util.move_async(character, character.Position + vector(5, 20, 0), nil, 0.5)

	-- 1초 후 ‘액티비티 완료’ 텍스트 출력
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--액티비티 완료 발현 시 BGM 종료, 믹스 디폴트
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	-- 이후 1초에 걸쳐 fade out
	wait_for_sec(2)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	field_object_util.set_active_state(goat, active_state_type.disabled)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(goat)
	scene_util.set_direction(goat, 'right', false)
	character_util.stop(goat)
	goat.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self:unload_all()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))

	self:show_common_ui()
end

local player_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/RunningGamePlayerController')
local background_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/RunningGameBgController')
local sequence_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/Sequence/RunningGameSequenceController')
local monster_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/Monster/RunningGameMonsterController')
local obstacle_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/Obstacle/RunningGameObstacleController')
local road_block_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/Obstacle/RunningGameRoadBlockController')

local local_class = newclass('RunningGameController')

function local_class:init(_)
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.center_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

	self.is_stage_end = false
	self.is_game_playing = false
	self.is_mini_game_end = false
	self.is_active_control = true
	self.is_scrolling = true

	self.mini_game_name = 'RunningGame'

	self.get_fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder_player = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder_player_elec')
	end

	self.fx = {
		cloud_thunder = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_gimmick_cloud_thunder_player_elec')
		end,
		onigirl_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_cw_onigirl_trail')
		end,
		load_all = function(this)
			for name, load_func in pairs(this) do
				if name ~= 'load_all' then
					load_func()
				end
			end
		end
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	-- constants_data 세팅
	self.constants_data = require('minigame/RunningGame/RunningGameConstants')[key]

	-- config
	self.config = self.constants_data['config']
	self.center_pos = vector(self.config.pos.x, self.config.pos.y, self.config.pos.z)
	self.line_pos_z_list = {
		self.center_pos.z + self.config.line_interval,
		self.center_pos.z,
		self.center_pos.z - self.config.line_interval
	}
	self.bgm_name = self.config.bgm_name

	self.effect_name_list = {}
	for effect_key, effect_name in pairs(self.config.effect_list) do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name)
		self.effect_name_list[effect_key] = effect_name
	end

	self.game_over_pos = self.center_pos + vector(self.config.game_over_interval, 0, 0)

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	-- 카메라는 게임 플레이 하는 부분으로
	camera_util.move_async(self.center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(self.config.camera_size, 0)

	player_controller:setting_player(self)
	monster_controller:setting_monster(self)
	sequence_controller:setting(self)
	background_controller:setting_background(self)
	obstacle_controller:setting_obstacle(self)
	road_block_controller:setting_road_block(self)

	self.fx:load_all()
	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 배경 루핑 시작
	start_coroutine(self.looping_background, self)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))

	self.is_stage_end = true
	self.is_game_playing = false
	self.is_mini_game_end = true

	self.effect_name_list = nil
	self:dispose_controller()
end

function local_class:dispose_controller()
	player_controller:dispose()
	monster_controller:dispose()
	sequence_controller:dispose()
	background_controller:dispose()
	obstacle_controller:dispose()
	road_block_controller:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(_)
	self.is_stage_end = true
end

function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.update_routine, self)
end

function local_class:update_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 미니맵 네비게이션바 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	-- 리더 컨트롤 뺏음
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local manual_touch_state = leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState
	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RequestDisableControl(leader, CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)
	end

	-- Dpad와 Action 버튼은 활성화
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	-- Action 버튼은 점프로 변경
	local action_button = field_ui_manager:GetUIByKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton, leader)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Jump

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.bgm_name, state = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	self.is_game_playing = true
	while not self.is_stage_end and self.is_game_playing do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self:get_distance_from_monster() <= self.config.game_over_interval and
				player_controller:is_idle_state() then
			self:game_over()
		end

		-- 특수 게임오버라면 게임오버 연출
		if self.is_special_game_over then
			self:special_game_over()
		end

		-- 캐릭터 조작 업데이트
		player_controller:update_frame(dt)

		-- 몬스터 패턴 업데이트
		monster_controller:update_frame(dt)

		-- 장애물 패턴 업데이트
		obstacle_controller:update_frame(dt)

		-- 갈림길 (길막) 패턴 업데이트
		road_block_controller:update_frame(dt)

		-- 시퀀스가 다 돌아 갔으면서, 장애물 패턴이 끝났을 때 게임 종료
		if sequence_controller:sequence_update(dt) and
				obstacle_controller:is_not_active_obstacle() then
			self.is_game_playing = false
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	monster_controller:set_idle_state()

	-- 미니게임 성공 연출
	self:mini_game_success_event()

	self.is_mini_game_end = true
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 컨트롤러들 dispose
	self:dispose_controller()

	if manual_touch_state ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(manual_touch_state, CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState) then
		manual_touch_state:RemoveDisableControl(leader)
	end

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	action_button.OverridenButtonAction = nil

	-- 미니게임 성공 쏨
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.mini_game_name, true))
end

function local_class:looping_background()
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	while self.is_mini_game_end == false do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		background_controller:scrolling(dt)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_game_playing or not self.is_active_control then
		return false
	end

	return player_controller:action_input_processing(e)
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if not self.is_game_playing or not self.is_active_control then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		return player_controller:joy_stick_input_processing(e)
	end

	return false
end

-- 현재 플레이어 라인
function local_class:cur_player_line()
	return player_controller:get_cur_line()
end

-- 현재 몬스터 라인
function local_class:cur_monster_line()
	return monster_controller:get_cur_line()
end

-- 플레이어 데미지 체크
function local_class:check_player_damage(line_index, target_pos, interval, is_monster_accel, is_car_attack)
	local is_damaged = self:is_crash(self:cur_player_line(), line_index, self.center_pos, target_pos, interval)

	if is_damaged == false then
		return false
	end

	-- 데미지를 받을 수 있는 상태인지 확인 (점프 상태거나 무적 상태인지 확인)
	is_damaged = player_controller:damaged_event(is_car_attack)

	-- 데미지를 받을 수 있는 상태면서, 몬스터 속도가 빨라져야 한다면 속도 올림
	if is_damaged and is_monster_accel then
		monster_controller:set_accel()
	end

	return is_damaged
end

function local_class:immediately_check_player_damage()
	if self:cur_monster_line() ~= self:cur_player_line() then
		return false
	end

	return player_controller:damaged_event(true)
end

-- 특수 게임오버 체크
function local_class:check_special_game_over(line_index, target_pos, interval)
	local is_crash = self:is_crash(self:cur_player_line(), line_index, self.center_pos, target_pos, interval)

	if is_crash == false then
		return false
	end

	if player_controller.current_state:get_type() == 'line_move' then
		return false
	end

	self.is_special_game_over = true
	return is_crash
end

-- 몬스터가 데미지를 받았는지 체크
function local_class:check_monster_damage(line_index, target_pos, interval)
	local monster = monster_controller.monster
	local is_crash = self:is_crash(self:cur_monster_line(), line_index, monster.Position, target_pos, interval)

	if is_crash == false then
		return false
	end

	-- 몬스터가 데미지를 받을 수 있는 상태인지 확인
	return monster_controller:damaged_event()
end

-- 몬스터와의 거리
function local_class:get_distance_from_monster()
	return math.abs(self.center_pos.x - monster_controller.cur_x)
end

-- 같은 라인에서 충돌 하였는지 체크
function local_class:is_crash(line, target_line, pos, target_pos, interval)
	local is_equal_line = line == target_line
	if is_equal_line == false then
		return false
	end

	local diff = math.abs(pos.x - target_pos.x)
	return diff <= interval
end

-- 일반적인 게임 오버 - 괴물에게 공격 당했을 때
function local_class:game_over()
	-- 플레이어와 괴물의 간격이 1이 되었을 시 게임오버 연출 진행.
	-- 화면 스크롤 정지.
	self.is_active_control = false
	background_controller:set_speed(0)
	monster_controller:set_idle_state()

	local character = player_controller.character
	local monster = monster_controller.monster

	-- 1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 3.5만큼 줌인.
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3.5, 1)
	camera_util.move(character.Position, 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 동시에 라나 scared 표정 전환.
	character_util.set_emotion(character, { name = 'scared' })
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 동시에 괴물 pounce 자세로 라나 캐릭터를 향해 돌진.
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_jump_01', volume = 0.7, loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'pounce', loop = false, scale = 0.25 })
	wp_util.move(monster, character.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	, nil, 1.25, { locked_dir = 'left' })

	-- 동시에 게임 오버 서큘러 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(self.center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(self.config.camera_size, 0)

	player_controller:reset_player()
	monster_controller:reset_monster()
	sequence_controller:reset_sequence()
	obstacle_controller:reset_obstacle()
	background_controller:set_speed(10)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

-- 차에 치였을 때의 게임 오버
function local_class:special_game_over()
	self.is_active_control = false
	background_controller:set_speed(0)
	monster_controller:set_idle_state()

	local character = player_controller.character

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(character)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(character)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_car_damaged_01')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_list['hit']):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_list['extreme_hit']):Instantiate(character.Position + vector(0, 0.05, 0))
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(character, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'damaged' })

	local duration = 1
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 720, duration + 0.2)
	character_util.spine_scale(character, unity_class.vector3.one * 7, duration)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(character, false)

	local start_pos = character.Position
	local end_pos = character.Position + vector(3, 10, -12)
	local is_fade_start = false

	character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 1000)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		if not is_fade_start and time_passed >= (duration * 0.5) then
			is_fade_start = true
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular(1, 'linear')
		end

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
		local y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * end_pos.y

		character.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, y)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	character_util.spine_scale(character, unity_class.vector3.one, 0)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(character, true)

	player_controller:reset_player()
	monster_controller:reset_monster()
	sequence_controller:reset_sequence()
	obstacle_controller:reset_obstacle()
	background_controller:set_speed(10)
	road_block_controller:all_stop_road_block()
	wait_for_sec(1)
	self.is_special_game_over = false

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	self.is_active_control = true
end

	qte_play_util.tap(8, { time_mod = time_mod_value, anim_unscaled_time = true, darken = false })

			unity_class.quaternion.identity, character.Transform)
	-- 대기 1초
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 해당 대사는 스킵 불가 처리.
	-- [화면 0.3값으로 1초 shake 하며] [왼쪽 말풍선] 라나 (left, attack, run) : 이야아아아아압!!!!!
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(character, { key = 'lw_sub_lana_s4_11', skip = false, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 해당 대사 출력돠 동시에 1초에 걸쳐 Stage Camera 값 5로 줌 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lana_01')
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 1)

	-- 3초에 걸쳐 라나 캐릭터의 이동속도가 현재의 1.5배로 증가하기 시작하며 화면 왼쪽으로 사라진다.
	local end_pos = character.Position - vector(20, 0, 0)
	local speed = 0.5

	local is_run_end = false
	start_coroutine(function()
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		while character.Position.x > end_pos.x do
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			speed = speed + dt * 4
			character.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(character.Position, character.Position.x - (speed * dt))
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		is_run_end = true
	end)

	-- 2초 때, 화면이 1초에 걸쳐 화이트 페이드 아웃 된다.
	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(character)
	while is_run_end == false do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	thunder_effect:Dispose()
	trail_effect:Dispose()
end
