local background_controller = newclass('RunningGameBgController')

function background_controller:init(_)
	self.controller = nil
	self.bg_center = nil
	self.res_holder = nil

	-- 배경 프리팹 담음 테이블
	self.bg_pools = {}

	self.bg_scroll_dir = 'right'
	self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = nil
	self.cur_speed = 10
	self.mid_idx = 0
end

function background_controller:setting_background(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	local bg_data = self.controller.constants_data['background_data']

	local bg_offset = vector(0, 0, -1)

	self.bg_center = self.controller.center_pos + bg_offset
	self.bg_pool_size = bg_data.prefab_size
	self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(self.bg_scroll_dir)
	self.cur_speed = bg_data.speed

	local mid_idx = math.floor(bg_data.prefab_num * 0.5)
	if bg_data.prefab_num % 2 ~= 0 then
		mid_idx = mid_idx + 1
	end

	local gap = self.bg_scroll_dir_vec * self.bg_pool_size

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	for i = 1, bg_data.prefab_num do
		local idx_from_mid = mid_idx - i
		local pos = self.bg_center + (gap * idx_from_mid)

		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.res_holder, bg_data.asset_bundle, bg_data.prefab_name, function(prefab)
					local bg_pool = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					bg_pool.transform.localPosition = pos

					table.insert(self.bg_pools, bg_pool)
				end)
	end

	self.bg_reset_pos = self.controller.center_pos.x + (self.bg_pool_size * 2)
end

function background_controller:scrolling(dt)
	background_scroller_util.update_by_frame(self.bg_pools, self.bg_pool_size,
			self.bg_reset_pos, self.cur_speed, 'right', dt)
end

function background_controller:set_speed(speed)
	self.cur_speed = speed
end

function background_controller:dispose()
	self:dispose_bg_pool()

	self.bg_scroll_dir_vec = nil
	self.res_holder = nil
end

function background_controller:dispose_bg_pool()

end

--region BaseState

local base_state = newclass('RunningGamePlayerBaseState')

function base_state:init(player_controller)
	self.player_controller = player_controller
	self.controller = player_controller.controller
	self.is_complete_acting = false
end

function base_state:update_frame()
end

function base_state:is_acting_complete()
	return true
end

function base_state:dispose()
	self.is_complete_acting = true
	self.player_controller = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function base_state:get_type()
	return 'base'
end

--endregion BaseState

--region RunningState

local running_state = newclass('RunningGamePlayerRunningState', base_state)

function running_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	-- 뛰는 애니메이션으로 변경
	character_util.set_anim(controller.character, { name = controller.player_spec.move_anim })
end

function running_state:get_type()
	return 'running'
end

--endregion RunningState

--region JumpingState
local jumping_state = newclass('RunningGamePlayerJumpState', base_state)

function jumping_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 점프 상태로 변경
	local character = controller.character
	local player_spec = self.player_controller.player_spec
	character_util.set_anim(character, { name = player_spec.jump_anim })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(character, player_spec.jump_height, player_spec.jump_duration)
end

function jumping_state:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_complete_acting then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.player_controller.player_spec.jump_duration then
		self.is_complete_acting = true
		character_util.set_anim(self.player_controller.character, { name = 'run' })
	end
end

function jumping_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function jumping_state:get_type()
	return 'jumping'
end

function jumping_state:is_acting_complete()
	return self.is_complete_acting
end

--endregion JumpingState

--region 라인 이동 하는 State

local line_move_state = newclass('RunningGamePlayerLineMoveState', base_state)

function line_move_state:init(controller, is_up)
	self.super:init(controller)

	local cur_line = controller.cur_line
	cur_line = is_up and (cur_line - 1) or (cur_line + 1)

	-- 이동할 수 없는 라인이라면 return
	if cur_line <= 0 or (cur_line > controller.controller.config.max_line) then
		self.is_complete_acting = true
		return
	end

	self.player_controller.cur_line = cur_line
	self.is_complete_acting = false
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.start_pos = controller.character.Position
	self.end_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.start_pos, self.controller.line_pos_z_list[cur_line])
end

function line_move_state:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_complete_acting then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local move_duration = self.player_controller.player_spec.move_duration
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / move_duration)
	local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
	self.player_controller.character.Position = lerp_pos

	if self.time_passed > move_duration then
		self.is_complete_acting = true
	end
end

function line_move_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.time_passed = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
end

function line_move_state:get_type()
	return 'line_move'
end

function line_move_state:is_acting_complete()
	return self.is_complete_acting
end

--endregion 라인 이동 하는 State

local player_controller = newclass('RunningGamePlayerController')

function player_controller:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.current_state = nil

	self.character = nil
	self.player_spec = nil

	self.cur_move_cool_time = 0
	self.cur_jump_cool_time = 0
	self.cur_line = 2

	-- 무적 상태 관련
	self.immortal_state = {
		hurt = 1,
		recovery = 2,
	}
	self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.hurt

	self.cur_immortal_time = 0
	self.is_immortal = false
	self.is_active_line_move = true
end

function player_controller:setting_player(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	self.player_spec = self.controller.constants_data['player_spec']
	self.player_spec.movement_amount = vector(0, 0, self.controller.config.line_interval)

	-- 캐릭터
	self.character = get_character(self.player_spec.npc_name)
	self.immortal_state_change_time = self.player_spec.immortal_time * 0.4

	self.effect_name_list = {}
	for key, effect_name in pairs(self.player_spec.effect_list) do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name)
		self.effect_name_list[key] = effect_name
	end

	self:reset_player()
end

function player_controller:reset_player()
	self.cur_line = 2

	self.cur_immortal_time = 0

	character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.character)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 1, 0)
	self.is_immortal = false

	character_util.set_position(self.character, self.controller.center_pos)
	self:change_state(running_state(self))
end

function player_controller:joy_stick_input_processing(e)
	if self.cur_move_cool_time > 0 or not self.is_active_line_move then
		return false
	end

	-- 달리는 중(기본 상태)이 아닐 때는 return
	if self.current_state:get_type() ~= 'running' then
		return false
	end

	if e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		self.cur_move_cool_time = self.player_spec.move_cool_time
		local next_state = line_move_state(self, true)
		self:change_state(next_state)

		return true
	elseif e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		-- 아래
		self.cur_move_cool_time = self.player_spec.move_cool_time
		local next_state = line_move_state(self, false)
		self:change_state(next_state)

		return true
	end
	-- 위 

	return false
end

function player_controller:action_input_processing(e)
	if self.cur_jump_cool_time > 0 then
		return false
	end

	-- 달리는 중이 아니라면 점프 못함
	if self.current_state:get_type() ~= 'running' then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		-- 액션 버튼 누를 시 점프 상태로 변경
		self.cur_jump_cool_time = self.player_spec.jump_cool_time

		local next_state = jumping_state(self)
		self:change_state(next_state)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function player_controller:update_frame(dt)
	self.cur_move_cool_time = math.max(self.cur_move_cool_time - dt, 0)
	self.cur_jump_cool_time = math.max(self.cur_jump_cool_time - dt, 0)

	self:check_immortal_state(dt)
	self.current_state:update_frame(dt)

	-- 모든 상태는 끝나면 뛰는 상태로 돌아감
	if self.current_state:is_acting_complete() then
		self:change_state(running_state(self))
	end
end

function player_controller:check_immortal_state(dt)
	if self.is_immortal == false then
		return
	end

	self.cur_immortal_time = self.cur_immortal_time + dt

	if self.cur_immortal_time >= self.immortal_state_change_time and
			self.cur_immortal_state == self.immortal_state.hurt then
		self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.recovery
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.character)
	end

	if self.cur_immortal_time >= self.player_spec.immortal_time then
		self.is_immortal = false
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 1, 0)
	end
end

function player_controller:damaged_event(is_car_attack)
	if self.is_immortal then
		return false
	end

	if self.current_state:get_type() == 'line_move' then
		return false
	end

	-- 건물 공격이면서 점프 상태면 그냥 return
	is_car_attack = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_car_attack, false)
	if is_car_attack and self.current_state:get_type() == 'jumping' then
		return false
	end

	self.is_immortal = true
	self.cur_immortal_time = 0
	self.cur_immortal_state = self.immortal_state.hurt

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
	local effect_pos = self.character.Position + vector(0, 0.1, 0)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_list['hit']):Instantiate(effect_pos)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_name_list['last_hit']):Instantiate(effect_pos)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.character)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.character)
	character_util.shake(self.character, 0.03, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.character, 0.5, 0)

	return true
end

function player_controller:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

function player_controller:dispose()
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	self.effect_name_list = nil
end

function player_controller:set_active_line_move(is_active)
	self.is_active_line_move = is_active
end

function player_controller:get_cur_line()
	return self.cur_line
end

function player_controller:is_idle_state()
	return self.current_state:get_type() == 'running'
end

return {
	create = function()
		return player_controller()
	end
}

--- 사우나 관리 (sauna_magement_game) 미니 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass('SaunaManagementGameController')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 미니게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'sauna_management_game'

	-- Constants Data
	self.constants = nil

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- 사우나 레버 가져오기
	self.get_sauna_lever = function(index) return get_field_object('sauna_lever_' .. index) end

	-- 사우나 좌표 마커
	self.get_sauna_marker = function(index) return field:GetMarker('sauna_marker_' .. index) end

	-- 게임시작시 위치할 좌표
	self.get_game_start_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('sauna_game_start') end

	-- 사우나 퇴장 좌표
	self.get_leave_sauna_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('sauna_leave_marker') end

	-- 사우나 작동 이팩트
	self.get_sauna_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Trap_LavaLiquid') end

	-- 사우나 불타는 이팩트
	self.get_fire_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_field_fire') end

	-- 커스텀 스프라이트
	self.get_custom_sprite = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite') end

	-- 사우나 실패 카운트 UI
	self.get_ui_fail_counter = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter') end

	-- 게임중인지?
	self.is_playing_game = false

	-- 실패 횟수
	self.fail_count = 0

	-- 사우나 상태
	self.sauna_states = nil

	-- 미니게임 성공했는지?
	self.is_success = false

	-- 커스텀 아틀라스
	self.custom_atlas = nil

	-- 불꽃 이팩트 딜레이 시간
	self.showing_fire_effect_time = 2
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_mini_game_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent), 'on_mini_game_load_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.constants = nil
	self.sauna_states = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil

	-- 실패 카운트 dispose 체크
	self:dispose_fail_counter()

	self:dispose_res_holder()

	self.is_playing_game = false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	-- 미니게임 스타트 이름이 해당 미니게임 이름과 동일하다면 시작
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_load_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		self.constants_data_key = e.DataKey
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_init, self, e.LoadEndCallback))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.constants == nil or not self.is_playing_game or self.sauna_states == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 조작한 사우나 레버에 해당하는 사우나를 작동시킨다.
	for i = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local sauna_lever = self.get_sauna_lever(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sauna_lever) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.active_sauna, self, sauna_lever, i))
			return true
		end
	end
end

-- 미니게임 초기화
function local_class:game_init(load_end_callback)
	if self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	-- Constants 세팅
	self.constants = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data('minigame/SaunaManagementGame/SaunaManagementGameConstants', self.constants_data_key)

	-- 값 초기화
	self.is_success = false
	self.fail_count = 0
	self.sauna_states = {}
	for i = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local sauna_state = {
			is_active = false,
			remain_active_time = 0,
			showing_effect_time = 0,
			handle_name = 'sauna_tile_' .. i,
		}
		table.insert(self.sauna_states, sauna_state)
	end

	-- 리더 좌표 이동
	local start_pos = self.get_game_start_marker().position
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	-- 카메라를 고정할 것인가?
	if self.constants.is_fix_camera_pos ~= nil and self.constants.is_fix_camera_pos then
		camera_util.move(start_pos, 0)
	end

	-- 카메라 크기 조정
	local camera_size = CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize > 4 and self.constants.camera_scale_size_pad or self.constants.camera_scale_size
	camera_util.resize_to(camera_size, 0)

	-- 이팩트 PreLoad
	self:set_arrow_custom_atlas()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	self.get_custom_sprite()
	self.get_sauna_effect()
	self.get_ui_fail_counter()
	self.get_fire_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 화살표 커스텀 아틀라스 가져오기
function local_class:set_arrow_custom_atlas()
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
	                  self.res_holder, 'spritesheets/battle', 'battle_custom', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 사우나 레버 활성화
	for i = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local sauna_lever = self.get_sauna_lever(i)
		sauna_lever.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	-- 영업 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bell_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('nightmare_futurecastle_sauna_game_1'), 2)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 미니게임 배경음악 재생
	--TODO: 미니게임 end 받는 곳에서 원래 배경음악으로 변경해주어야함.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_trickery_theme', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	-- 사우나 실패 카운트 UI 세팅
	self:dispose_fail_counter()

	local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_ui_fail_counter():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

	local layout_positioner = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
	layout_positioner.AnchorPosition = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	layout_positioner.Position = vector(0, 40)

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
	self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 손님 상태
	local customer_states = {}
	for _ = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local customer_state = {
			name = '',
			satisfied_time = 0,
			unsatisfied_time = 0,
			is_animating = true,
			is_active = false,
		}
		table.insert(customer_states, customer_state)
	end

	-- 게임 루프 시작
	self.is_playing_game = true
	yield_return_func(self.game_loop, self, customer_states)
	self.is_playing_game = false

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 사우나 레버 비활성화
	for i = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local sauna_lever = self.get_sauna_lever(i)
		sauna_lever.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	-- 성공 실패 연출
	if self.is_success then
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
	end
	wait_for_sec(self.is_success and 1 or 2)

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 목숨 UI dispose
	self:dispose_fail_counter()

	-- 사우나 레버 push 애니메이션으로 변경
	for i = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local sauna_lever = self.get_sauna_lever(i)
		local animator = sauna_lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('push')
	end

	-- 활성화된 손님 다 disable
	for i = 1, #customer_states do
		if customer_states[i].is_active then
			local customer = get_character(customer_states[i].name)
			if customer ~= nil then
				character_util.stop(customer)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(customer)
				character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'disabled')
			end
		end
	end

	-- 리소스 홀더 dispose
	self:dispose_res_holder()

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	-- Constants Data 제거
	self.constants = nil

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- MiniGameEndEvent로 성공 여부를 Publish 한다
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.is_success))
end

function local_class:game_loop(customer_states)
	-- 다음 웨이브 체크하기 위한 변수
	local time_passed = 0

	-- 손님들어온 카운트 수
	local update_customer_count = 1
	local current_update_time = self.constants.customer_update_times[update_customer_count]

	while self.is_playing_game do
		-- 미니게임 실패 확인
		if self.fail_count >= self.constants.life then
			self.is_playing_game = false
			break
		else
			-- 미니게임 성공 확인
			if update_customer_count >= #self.constants.customer_show_patten then
				-- 패턴이 끝났으며 손님이 다 비활성화 됐을 때 게임 끝
				if self:is_all_customer_deactive(customer_states) then
					self.is_playing_game = false
					self.is_success = true
					break
				end
			else
				-- 만약 진행 중이라면 일정 시간 마다 신규 손님 추가
				time_passed = time_passed + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
				if time_passed >= current_update_time then
					-- 손님 추가
					local customer_index = self:get_random_deactive_sauna(customer_states)
					if customer_index > 0 then
						time_passed = 0
						self:add_new_customer(customer_states, customer_index, update_customer_count)
						update_customer_count = update_customer_count + 1
						if #self.constants.customer_update_times >= update_customer_count then
							current_update_time = self.constants.customer_update_times[update_customer_count]
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- 사우나 상태 업데이트
		self:update_sauna_state()
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:update_sauna_state()
	for i = 1, #self.sauna_states do
		-- 사우나가 작동중 일 때
		if self.sauna_states[i].is_active then
			-- 작동시간 다 됐으면 비활성화
			if self.sauna_states[i].remain_active_time <= 0 then
				self.sauna_states[i].is_active = false
				self.sauna_states[i].showing_effect_time = 0

				-- push 애니메이션 재생
				local sauna_lever = self.get_sauna_lever(i)
				local animator = sauna_lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
				animator:Play('push')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_greenland_01')
			else
				-- 시간 계속해서 업데이트
				self.sauna_states[i].remain_active_time = self.sauna_states[i].remain_active_time - CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
				self.sauna_states[i].showing_effect_time = self.sauna_states[i].showing_effect_time - CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime

				-- 이팩트 재생시간이 됐다면 이팩트 재생
				if self.sauna_states[i].showing_effect_time <= 0 then
					self.sauna_states[i].showing_effect_time = self.showing_fire_effect_time
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
					for j = 1, self.constants.sauna_tile_count do
						local sauna_tile = get_field_object(self.sauna_states[i].handle_name .. '_' .. j)
						self.get_sauna_effect():Instantiate(sauna_tile.Position)
					end
				end
			end
		else
			if self.sauna_states[i].remain_active_time > 0 then
				-- 레버 pull 애니메이팅 연출
				local sauna_lever = self.get_sauna_lever(i)
				if not self.sauna_states[i].is_active then
					self.sauna_states[i].is_active = true
					local animator = sauna_lever:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
					animator:Play('pull')
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gear_01')
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_random_deactive_sauna(customer_states)
	-- 10번동안 랜덤으로 비활성화 된 손님을 확인해준다.
	for _ = 1, 10 do
		local random_value = random_util.get_random_int(1, self.constants.sauna_count)
		if not customer_states[random_value].is_active then
			return random_value
		end
	end

	-- 위에서 만약 랜덤으로 착출 되지 않았다면 인덱스 앞부터 제일 빠른 비활성화 된 손님 인덱스를 리턴한다.
	for i = 1, #customer_states do
		if not customer_states[i].is_active then
			return i
		end
	end

	return -1
end

-- 새로운 손님 등장하게하고 로직 시작
function local_class:add_new_customer(customer_states, customer_index, patten_index)
	local customer_info = self.constants.customer_type[self.constants.customer_show_patten[patten_index]]

	-- 빈 손님 가져오도록 해야함
	customer_states[customer_index].name = self:get_customer_name(customer_info.name)
	customer_states[customer_index].satisfied_time = customer_info.satisfied_time
	customer_states[customer_index].unsatisfied_time = customer_info.unsatisfied_time
	customer_states[customer_index].is_animating = customer_info.is_animating
	customer_states[customer_index].is_active = true

	-- 손님 로직 시작
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.customer_routine, self, customer_index, customer_states[customer_index]))
end

function local_class:get_customer_name(first_name)
	for i = 1, self.constants.sauna_count do
		local customer_name = first_name .. i
		local customer = get_character(customer_name)
		if customer ~= nil and customer.ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
			return customer_name
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 손님 로직
function local_class:customer_routine(index, customer_state)
	local customer = get_character(customer_state.name)

	-- UI가 안사라졌을수 도 있으니 호출
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(customer))

	-- 초반 등장 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(customer, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(customer, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(customer, self.get_sauna_marker(index).position)
	character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(customer, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 불만족 시간
	local unsatisfied_time = 0

	-- 만족 시간
	local satisfied_time = 0

	-- 만족중인가?
	local is_satisfied = 0

	-- 제한시간 UI가 보이고 있는가?
	local is_show_attack_queue = false

	-- 화살표 UI 세팅
	local pos = self.get_sauna_marker(index).position + vector(0, 1.7, 0)
	local arrow_object_pool = self.get_custom_sprite():Instantiate(vector(999, 0, 999))
	local custom_sprite = arrow_object_pool:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 180, 0)
	custom_sprite.transform.localScale = vector(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = unity_class.vector2.one
	custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'arrow_quest_sub.png'
	custom_sprite:SetSortingLayer("UI")
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()

	while self.is_playing_game do
		-- 시간이 다 되었을 때
		if unsatisfied_time >= customer_state.unsatisfied_time then
			-- 손님 화내며 나감 목숨 -1
			arrow_object_pool.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			yield_return_func(self.unsatisfied_customer, self, customer, customer_state.is_animating)
			break
		elseif satisfied_time >= customer_state.satisfied_time then
			-- 손님 불타면서 만족하며 퇴장
			arrow_object_pool.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			local fire_effect = self.get_fire_effect():Instantiate(customer.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, customer.transform)
			yield_return_func(self.satisfied_customer, self, customer, customer_state.is_animating)
			fire_effect:Dispose()
			break
		end

		if not self.sauna_states[index].is_active then
			unsatisfied_time = unsatisfied_time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			if is_satisfied ~= 1 then
				is_satisfied = 1
				if customer_state.is_animating then
					character_util.remove_emotion(customer)
					character_util.set_emotion(customer, { name = 'attack' })
				end
				arrow_object_pool.transform.position = pos
				is_show_attack_queue = true
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(customer, customer_state.unsatisfied_time))
			end
		else
			satisfied_time = satisfied_time + CS.UnityEngine.Time.deltaTime
			if is_satisfied ~= 2 then
				is_satisfied = 2
				unsatisfied_time = 0
				if customer_state.is_animating then
					character_util.remove_emotion(customer)
					character_util.set_emotion(customer, { name = 'blush' })
				end
				arrow_object_pool.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
				is_show_attack_queue = false
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(customer))
			end

		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 화살표 UI Dispose
	arrow_object_pool:Dispose()

	-- 게임중이라면 손님 비활성화
	if self.is_playing_game then
		self:deacive_customer(customer, customer_state)
	end

	-- attack_queue가 보이고 있다면 AttackQueueEndEvent 발행
	if is_show_attack_queue then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(customer))
	end
end

-- 손님 만족 연출
function local_class:satisfied_customer(customer, is_animating)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(customer))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')

	-- 애니메이팅 연출이 필요하다면 애니메이션 연출
	if is_animating then
		character_util.set_direction(customer, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(customer, { name = 'victory_extra' }, { name = 'smile' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(customer, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 손님 불만족 연출
function local_class:unsatisfied_customer(customer, is_animating)
	-- faile Count UI 업데이트
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.fail_count = self.fail_count + 1
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(self.fail_count)
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(customer))

	-- 손님이 점프 두번 후 입구쪽으로 이동 후 fade
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(customer, { name = 'mad' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(customer, true)

	if is_animating then
		character_util.set_direction(customer, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(customer, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(customer, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

-- 손님 비활성화
function local_class:deacive_customer(customer, customer_state)
	customer_state.name = ''
	customer_state.satisfied_time = 0
	customer_state.unsatisfied_time = 0
	customer_state.is_active = false

	character_util.set_active_state(customer, 'disabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(customer)
	character_util.set_position(customer, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 모든 손님가 비활성화 되었는지?
function local_class:is_all_customer_deactive(customer_states)
	for i = 1, #customer_states do
		if customer_states[i].is_active then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 인덱스에 해당하는 사우나 작동
function local_class:active_sauna(lever, index)
	if self.sauna_states == nil or #self.sauna_states < index then
		return
	end

	self.sauna_states[index].remain_active_time = self.constants.sauna_active_time

	-- 레버를 치는 애니메이션 연출
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, 'attack') * 0.5
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')
	wait_for_sec(anim_duration)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_fail_counter()
	-- 실패 카운트 dispose 체크
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_res_holder()
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

function local_class:start_game()
	local shells = {
		self:get_shell(1),
		self:get_shell(2),
		self:get_shell(3),
		self:get_shell(4),
	}

	local shell_pos_list = {
		self:get_shell_pos(1),
		self:get_shell_pos(2),
		self:get_shell_pos(3),
		self:get_shell_pos(4),
	}

	local answer_shell = shells[2]

	local gambler = self:get_gambler()
	local gambler_pos = self:get_gambler_pos()

	local leader_pos = self:get_player_pos()
	local party_pos = {
		leader_pos,
		leader_pos + vector(0, 0, -1),
		leader_pos + vector(-1, 0, -1),
		leader_pos + vector(1, 0, -1),
	}

	local camera_pos = (shell_pos_list[2] + shell_pos_list[3] ) / 2

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

	for i = 1, self.shell_count do
		local shell = shells[i]
		shell.Position = shell_pos_list[i]
		shell.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(shell)
		shell.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	end

	gambler.Position = gambler_pos
	gambler.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gambler)
	character_util.set_direction(gambler, 'right')

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		member.Position = party_pos[i + 1]
		member.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	self:setting_before_game()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:scene_before_shuffle()

	local count = 0
	while count <= self.shuffle_count do
		local r_info = self.behave_table[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.behave_table)]

		shells = self:shuffle_shells(shells, shell_pos_list, r_info,
				self.start_speed + count * (self.end_speed - self.start_speed) / self.shuffle_count)
		count = count + 1

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
	end

	self:scene_after_shuffle()

	local answer_index = 1

	for i = 1, self.shell_count do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(shells[i], answer_shell) then
			answer_index = i
			break
		end
	end

	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		{'minigame_shell_game_choice_1', 'forced'},
		{'minigame_shell_game_choice_2', 'intellect'},
		{'minigame_shell_game_choice_3', 'brutal'},
		{'minigame_shell_game_choice_4', 'mercy'},
	})

	if answer_index == result then
		self:show_win(answer_index)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'shell_game', 'end', 'win' }))
	else
		self:show_lose(answer_index)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party.Leader, { 'shell_game', 'end', 'lose' }))
	end
end

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler,

function local_class:show_lose(answer_index)
	if stage.Name == self.stage_names.halloween then

		-- 정답은..!
		local gatcha_drum_roll_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_gatcha_drum_roll_01' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gambler, {key = 'halloween_shell_game_21', skip = true})

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gambler)
			end)
		})
	end

function local_class:show_answer()
	local answer_shell = self:get_shell(2)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	local candy = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid =  self:get_int().bead_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', skip_text = true,
		pos = answer_shell.Position, target = answer_shell.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	candy.ConsumeTarget = answer_shell

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

function local_class:shuffle_shells(shells, shell_pos_list, behave_info, time_scale)
	local dur = 0.5 / time_scale
	local jump_height = 1

	local wait_list = {}
	local order_list = {}

	for i = 1, #shells do
		local info = behave_info[i]
		if info < 0 then
			-- behave_info의 value를 직접 바꾸면 원본 테이블이 변경되기 때문에 테이블을 따로 만들어서 처리
			table.insert(order_list, -info)
			local angle = -info > i and 360 or -360
			table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(self.spin_jump_async, self,
					shells[i], jump_height, dur, angle, shell_pos_list[-info]))
		else
			table.insert(order_list, info)
			table.insert(wait_list, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_to_async,
					shells[i], shell_pos_list[info], dur, nil, true, true, true))
		end
	end

	wait_all(wait_list)

	for _, v in pairs(shells) do
		character_util.set_direction(v, 'down')
	end

	return self:reorder_table(shells, order_list)
end

function local_class:spin_jump_async(character, height, duration, spin_angle, move_pos)
	character_util.jump(character, height, duration)
	character_util.spine_rotate(character, spin_angle, duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_throw_01')

	if move_pos ~= nil then
		character_util.move_to_async(character, move_pos, duration, nil, true, false, false)
	else
		wait_for_sec(duration)
	end

	character_util.spine_rotate(character, 0, 0)
end

function local_class:reorder_table(list, index_list)
	local new_list = {}

	for i = 1, #list do
		new_list[index_list[i]] = list[i]
	end

	return new_list
end

return {
	create = function(quest_id, cs_controller)
		return local_class(quest_id, cs_controller)
	end
}

--스네이크 게임
local local_class = newclass('SnakeGame')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'SnakeGame'

	-- 게임의 데이터 키
	self.constants_data_key = ''
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 플레이 캐릭터
	self.character_list = nil

	-- 게임 루프
	self.game_loop = false

	-- 마지막 점수
	self.last_score = 0

	-- 현재 라운드
	self.round = 1

	-- 라운드 클리어 옵션
	self.round_clear = false

	-- 이동 속도
	self.player_speed = 4

	-- 대상 타겟
	self.next_target = nil

	-- 몇번 째 붙었는지
	self.follow_count = 0

	-- 꼬리 NPC
	self.tail_npcs = nil

	-- NPC 위치 리스트
	self.move_pos_list = nil

	-- 벽 관리
	self.wall_list = nil

	-- 획득한 npc 수
	self.get_npc_count = 0
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	local constants_data = require('minigame/SnakeGame/SnakeGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- pool load
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadStageTitle()

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			'fx_guildarcade_dead',
			'fx_guildarcade_rabbit_hit'
	)

	-- Subscribe
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')

	-- 기존 파티 제외
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]
		character_util.set_active_state(party_member, 'disabled')
		character_util.convert_to_npc(party_member)
	end

	-- 플레이 파티 세팅
	self.character_list = self.constants_data.play_character_list
	local leader = get_character(self.character_list[1])
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		leader = get_character(self.character_list[2])
	end
	character_util.set_active_state(leader, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(leader, param)

	--꼬리 NPC 세팅
	self.tail_npcs = {}
	for i = 1, self.constants_data.npc_count[#self.constants_data.npc_count] do
		local npc = get_character(self.constants_data.npc_name..i)
		npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		table.insert(self.tail_npcs, npc)
	end

	--게임 위치로 이동
	local game_start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).position
	local game_start_dir = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).direction
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, game_start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, game_start_dir)

	-- 카메라 설정
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.constants_data.mini_game_camera_size, 0.01)

	-- npc 리셋 위치 생성
	self.move_pos_list = {}
	local lt = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_size_marker.lt).position
	local rb = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_size_marker.rb).position
	for x = lt.x, rb.x, 2 do
		for z = rb.z, lt.z, 2 do
			local pos = vector(x, 0, z)
			table.insert(self.move_pos_list, pos)
		end
	end

	-- 플레이어 스피드 설정
	self.player_speed = self.constants_data.user_speed[1].init_speed

	-- 벽 세팅
	self.wall_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.constants_data.wall_count do
		local wall = get_field_object(self.constants_data.wall_name .. i)
		wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		table.insert(self.wall_list, wall)
	end

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	while true do
		self:game_ui_show()

		-- BGM 재생
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/arcade/audio:bgm_arcade_fox', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

		-- 게임 시작
		self.game_loop = true

		-- 다음 타겟 지정
		self.next_target = self.tail_npcs[1]
		-- NPC 등장
		self:appear_npc()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_rabbit, self, self.next_target))


		-- 플레이어 달리기 연출
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'run' })

		while self.game_loop do
			-- 충돌 검사
			self:check_collision_object()

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.round_clear then
			-- 클리어 시 다음 라운드로
			self:next_round()
		else
			-- 게임 오버 시 종료
			break
		end
	end

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
end

-- 게임 종료 처리
function local_class:game_end()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	if self.game_loop then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_ui_show, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:moving_rabbit(rabbit)
	local req_cnt = self.follow_count
	while self.follow_count == req_cnt do
		local move_pos = self.move_pos_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.move_pos_list)]
		local move_x = vector(move_pos.x, 0, rabbit.Position.z)
		local move_z = vector(rabbit.Position.x, 0 , move_pos.z)

		local rand_move = {
			{ move_x, move_pos },
			{ move_z, move_pos },
			{ move_x },
			{ move_z }}

		character_util.move_waypoint_async(rabbit, rand_move[random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)], 4, true)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision_object()
	local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5)

	for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.IsOverlappingXZ(user_party.Leader.Bounds, fo.Bounds) then
			-- 벽충돌
			if (fo.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle and
					not CS.Oak.ICrashBehaviourExtensions.IsEthereal(fo.CrashBehaviour) then
				self:collision_fail()
				return
			elseif self:is_character(fo) and fo.Name ~= user_party.Leader.Name then
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo, self.next_target) then
					-- 타겟과 충돌
					self:collision_success(self.next_target)
				else
					-- 몸통과 충돌
					self:collision_fail()
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 대상이 캐릭터인지 검사
function local_class:is_character(fo)
	local type = fo:GetType()
	local result = false

	cast(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character))

	if lua_helper.type_compare(fo, typeof(CS.Oak.Character)) then
		result = true
	end

	cast(fo, type)

	return result
end

-- 다음 타겟 등장 함수
function local_class:appear_npc()
	character_util.set_active_state(self.next_target, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(self.next_target,
			self.move_pos_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.move_pos_list)])
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_guildarcade_dead'):Instantiate(self.next_target.Position + vector(0,0.35,0))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_explosion_01')
end

function local_class:collision_success(target)
	-- 달리고 있는 상태 정지
	self.follow_count = self.follow_count + 1
	self.get_npc_count = self.get_npc_count + 1
	character_util.stop(target)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_guildarcade_rabbit_hit'):Instantiate(target.Position + vector(0,0.35,0))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_get_01')

	-- 위치 변경
	local dir_vector = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party.Leader.Direction)
	target.Position = user_party.Leader.Position - dir_vector
	target.Direction = user_party.Leader.Direction
	target.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.2, 0.8, 0.2))

	-- 상태 변경
	local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowerNPCState.Create(target, user_party, self.follow_count - 1, 0, 0.3, false)
	target:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
	target.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	-- 플레이어 스피드 갱신
	local index = math.min(self.round, #self.constants_data.user_speed)
	local speed = self.constants_data.user_speed[index].init_speed + self.follow_count * self.constants_data.user_speed[index].add_speed
	self.player_speed = math.min(speed, self.constants_data.user_speed[index].max_speed)

	user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState.speed = self.player_speed

	-- 점수 갱신
	-- 500 + 100*(총 획득한 토끼 숫자 - 1) 점 씩 추가
	local score = 500 + 100 * (self.get_npc_count - 1)
	self.last_score = math.min(self.last_score + score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('SnakeGame', self.last_score))

	-- NPC가 아직 남아있다면
	if self.follow_count < self.constants_data.npc_count[math.min(self.round, #self.constants_data.npc_count)] then
		self.next_target = self.tail_npcs[self.follow_count + 1]
		self:appear_npc()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_rabbit, self, self.next_target))
	else
		self:game_end()
		self.round_clear = true
		self.game_loop = false
		-- 성공 동작
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_clear_01')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		-- BGM 종료
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end
end

function local_class:collision_fail()
	self:game_end()
	self.game_loop = false
	self.follow_count = -1
	character_util.stop(self.next_target)

	local knock_back_info = CS.Oak.KnockBackInfo()
	knock_back_info.type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics
	knock_back_info.stun = true
	knock_back_info.direction = direction_util.to_vector3(direction_util.get_opposite(user_party.Leader.Direction))
	knock_back_info.impactForce = 5000
	knock_back_info.impactTime = 0.05
	knock_back_info.muCoefficient = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party.Leader, knock_back_info)
	user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_arcade_hit_wall_01')
	-- 실패 동작
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead1' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 아날로그 조작 State
	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerWormGameMoveState.Create(user_party.Leader, self.player_speed, user_party.Leader.Direction, false)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

	-- DPad 추가
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)

	-- Level UI 제거
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- 보물상자, 환경설정, 대화창, 미니맵 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end
end

function local_class:next_round()
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 꼬리 NPC 리셋
	for _, npc in ipairs(self.tail_npcs) do
		message_system:SendSync(npc.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		npc.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.8, 1.1))
		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
	end

	-- 라운드 재설정
	self.round_clear = false
	self.round = self.round + 1
	self.follow_count = 0

	-- 플레이어 스피드 갱신
	local index = math.min(self.round, #self.constants_data.user_speed)
	self.player_speed = self.constants_data.user_speed[index].init_speed

	-- 리더 anim emotion 리셋
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	--게임 위치로 이동
	local game_start_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).position
	local game_start_dir = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.game_start_marker_name).direction
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, game_start_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, game_start_dir)

	-- 벽 추가 루틴
	local wall_count = math.max(self.round - self.constants_data.wall_appear_round, 0)
	wall_count = math.min(self.constants_data.wall_count / self.constants_data.wall_appear_count, wall_count)

	for i = 1, wall_count do
		for j = 1, self.constants_data.wall_appear_count do
			local wall = self.wall_list[(i - 1) * self.constants_data.wall_appear_count + j]
			wall.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--Unsubscribe
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	-- 게임 루프 종료
	self.round_clear = false
	self.game_loop = false

	-- 꼬리 NPC 비활성화
	if self.tail_npcs ~= nil then
		for _, npc in ipairs(self.tail_npcs) do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
			npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
			character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
		end
		self.tail_npcs = nil
	end

	-- 파티 표정, 애니메이션, 상태 클리어
	if self.character_list ~= nil then
		for i = 2, #self.character_list do
			message_system:SendSync(get_character(self.character_list[i]).FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
		end
		self.character_list = nil
	end

	-- 아케이드 미니게임의 경우 파티 복원 필요 없음

	self.wall_list = nil
	self.next_target = nil
	self.move_pos_list = nil
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local player_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/SpicyFoodRace/SpicyFoodRaceCharacterPlayerController')
local npc_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/SpicyFoodRace/SpicyFoodRaceCharacterNpcController')
local item_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/SpicyFoodRace/SpicyFoodRaceItemController')

local local_class = newclass('SpicyFoodRace')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'SpicyFoodRace'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		loaded = 2,
		playing = 3,
		paused = 4,
		game_end = 5,
	}

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- 충돌 판정 범위
	self.collision_distance = nil

	-- 게임 시간
	self.game_play_time = 100
	self.cur_game_play_time = 0
	-- 목표 획득 갯수
	self.mission_item_count = 30
	self.cur_mission_item_count = 0

	-- fx
	self.fx = metatable_helper.create_fx_accessor({
		-- 카운팅 UI
		field_ui_num_counter = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUINumCounter')
		end,
		get = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
		end,
		plitvice_buff_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_plitvice_buff')
		end,
		screen_fx = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_fw_hot_food_screen')
		end,
		last_hit = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
		end,
		flamethrower_mask_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_qc_flamethrower_mask_loop')
		end,
		dragon_boy_flame = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_dragonboy_flame')
		end
	})

	-- 무적 처리
	self.cur_invincible_time = 0
	self.invincible_time = 0

	-- screen fx
	self.screen_fx = nil
	self.screen_fx_active_item_count = 0

	-- count ui
	self.num_counter_ui = {
		max = 10,
		count = 0,
		counter_obj = nil,
		counter = nil,
		is_end = function(this)
			return this.count >= this.max
		end,
		load = function(this)
			this.counter_obj = self.fx:field_ui_num_counter():Instantiate(vector(0, 0, 1))
			this.counter = this.counter_obj.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUINumCounter))
			this:hide()
		end,
		-- numCounter 초기화
		init = function(this, max_count)
			this.count = 0
			this.max = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_count, 10)

			this:set_count(this.counter)
			this.counter:SetMaxCount(this.max)
			this.counter:Reposition()
		end,
		-- numCounter show
		show = function(this)
			if this.counter == nil then
				return
			end

			this.counter.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end,
		hide = function(this)
			if this.counter == nil then
				return
			end

			this.counter.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end,
		set_count = function(this, num)
			if this.counter == nil then
				return
			end

			this.count = num
			this.counter:SetCount(this.count)
		end,
		add_count = function(this, num)
			this.count = this.count + num
			this:set_count(this.count)
		end,
		-- numCounter dispose
		dispose = function(this)
			if this.counter_obj ~= nil then
				this.counter_obj:Dispose()
			end

			this.counter_obj = nil
			this.counter = nil
		end,
	}
end

function local_class:load_resource(key)
	self.constants_data = require('minigame/SpicyFoodRace/SpicyFoodRaceConstants')[key]
	self.collision_distance = self.constants_data['collision_distance']
	self.game_play_time = self.constants_data['game_play_time']
	self.mission_item_count = self.constants_data['mission_item_count']
	self.screen_fx_active_item_count = self.constants_data['screen_fx_active_item_count']
	self.cur_game_play_time = 0
	self.cur_mission_item_count = 0
	self.invincible_time = self.constants_data['invincible_time']
	self.cur_invincible_time = self.invincible_time

	npc_controller:setting_controller(self)
	player_controller:setting_controller(self)
	item_controller:setting_controller(self)
	player_controller:setting_player()
	item_controller:setting_item_npc()
	self.fx:load_async()
	self.num_counter_ui:load()
	self.num_counter_ui:init(self.mission_item_count)

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.loaded
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	self:hide_game_ui()
	self.num_counter_ui:dispose()
	item_controller.drop_item:dispose_all()
	player_controller:dispose()
	npc_controller:dispose()
	item_controller:dispose()

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

	return true
end

function local_class:use_late_update_frame()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		local input_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection

		if player_controller.character_base.cur_direction == input_direction then
			return false
		end

		player_controller.character_base.cur_direction = input_direction
		character_util.set_direction(player_controller.player, input_direction)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.paused
	self:hide_game_ui()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	self:show_game_ui()
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state.playing

	return false
end
--endregion event

function local_class:update_frame_priority()
	return CS.Oak.UpdatePriorities.StageEvent
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.cur_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return
	end

	player_controller:update_frame(dt)
	npc_controller:update_frame(dt)
	item_controller:update_frame(dt)
	self:check_collision(dt)

	-- 미션 개수만큼 아이템 획득 시 클리어
	if self.cur_mission_item_count >= self.mission_item_count then
		mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, true)
	end
end

function local_class:check_collision(dt)
	local player = player_controller.player
	local npc_list = npc_controller.npc_list
	local item_list = item_controller.drop_item.item_list

	self.cur_invincible_time = self.cur_invincible_time + dt

	-- Player Npc 충돌
	for i = 1, #npc_list do
		local diff = (npc_list[i].character.Position - player.Position).magnitude

		if self.cur_invincible_time >= self.invincible_time and diff < self.collision_distance then
			self.cur_invincible_time = 0
			character_util.look_at(player, npc_list[i].character)
			npc_list[i]:character_collision_action()
			player_controller:character_collision_action()
		end
	end

	if item_list == nil then
		return
	end

	-- Player Item 충돌
	for i = 1, #item_list do
		local diff = (item_list[i].item.Position - player.Position).magnitude

		if item_list[i].can_consume and diff < self.collision_distance then
			self.cur_mission_item_count = self.cur_mission_item_count + 1
			self.num_counter_ui:set_count(self.cur_mission_item_count)
			self:set_screen_fx()
			self.fx.get():Instantiate(item_list[i].item.Position)
			item_controller.drop_item:consume(i)
			player_controller:get_item()
			break
		end
	end

	-- Npc Item 충돌
	for i = 1, #item_list do
		if item_list[i].can_consume then
			for j = 1, #npc_list do
				local diff = (item_list[i].item.Position - npc_list[j].character.Position).magnitude

				if diff < self.collision_distance then
					self.fx.get():Instantiate(item_list[i].item.Position)
					item_controller.drop_item:consume(i)
					npc_list[j]:get_item()
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')

	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

	self:show_game_ui()

function local_class:show_game_ui()

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
end

function local_class:set_screen_fx()
	if self.screen_fx == nil and self.cur_mission_item_count >= self.screen_fx_active_item_count then
		self.screen_fx = self.fx.screen_fx():Instantiate(stage_camera.LookAtPosition,
				unity_class.quaternion.identity, stage_camera.transform)
	end
end

function local_class:timer_finished()
	mini_game_util.game_end(self.game_name, false)
end

function local_class:hide_game_ui()
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
	self.num_counter_ui:hide()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
end

function local_class:reset()
	self.game_play_time = self.constants_data['game_play_time']
	self.mission_item_count = self.constants_data['mission_item_count']
	self.screen_fx_active_item_count = self.constants_data['screen_fx_active_item_count']
	self.cur_game_play_time = 0
	self.cur_mission_item_count = 0

	if self.screen_fx ~= nil then
		self.screen_fx:Dispose()
		self.screen_fx = nil
	end

	npc_controller:reset()
	player_controller:reset_party()
	item_controller:reset()
	item_controller.drop_item:dispose_all()
end

return local_class

function base_state:update_frame(dt)
end

function base_state:is_next_state()
	return true
end

function base_state:get_type()
	return 'base'
end

function base_state:dispose()
	self.is_complete_state = true
	self.controller = nil
end

--region Move State
local move_state = newclass('SpicyFoodRaceCharacterMoveState', base_state)

function move_state:init(character_controller)
	self.super:init(character_controller)
end

function move_state:late_init()
	scene_util.set_emotion(self.controller.character, self, 'attack')

	if not self.controller.is_player then
		local speed = self.controller.normal_speed + self.controller.cur_add_speed_value

		wp_util.move(self.controller.character, self.controller.target_pos, speed, nil, {
			run = true,
			end_callback = function()
				self.is_complete_state = true
			end })
	else
		scene_util.set_anim(self.controller.character, self, 'run')
	end
end

function move_state:update_frame(dt)
	if self.controller.is_player then
		local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(self.controller.cur_direction)
		local speed = self.controller.normal_speed + self.controller.cur_add_speed_value

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = dir_vec
		move_info.magnitude = speed * dt

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, self.controller.cur_direction, false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.controller.character, move_event)
	end
end

function move_state:is_next_state()
	return self.is_complete_state
end

function move_state:get_type()
	return 'move'
end

function move_state:dispose()
	if not self.controller.is_player then
		character_util.stop(self.controller.character)
	else
		local dir_vec = direction_util.to_vector3(self.controller.cur_direction)
		self.controller.cur_direction = vector_util.to_direction(-dir_vec)
	end

	self.super:dispose()
end
--endregion Move State

--region Damage State
local damage_state = newclass('SpicyFoodRaceCharacterDamageState', base_state)

function damage_state:init(character_controller)
	self.super:init(character_controller)

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function damage_state:late_init()
	scene_util.set_emotion(self.controller.character, self, 'damaged')
	scene_util.set_anim(self.controller.character, self, 'damaged')

	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.controller.character.Direction)
	local move_pos = self.controller.character.Position + (self.controller.stun_distance * -dir)
	character_util.move_to(self.controller.character, move_pos, self.controller.stun_move_time)
end

function damage_state:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.time_passed >= self.controller.stun_time then
		self.is_complete_state = true
	end
end

function damage_state:is_next_state()
	return self.is_complete_state
end

function damage_state:get_type()
	return 'damage'
end

function damage_state:dispose()
	character_util.remove_anim(self.controller.character)

	self.super:dispose()

	self.time_passed = nil
end
--endregion Damage State

--region Idle State
local idle_state = newclass('SpicyFoodRaceCharacterIdleState', base_state)

function idle_state:init(character_controller)
	self.super:init(character_controller)
end

function idle_state:get_type()
	return 'idle'
end

function idle_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end
--endregion Idle State

--region Character Base
local character_base = newclass('SpicyFoodRaceCharacterBase')

function character_base:init()
	self.controller = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	-- 캐릭터
	self.character = nil
	-- 기본 스피드
	self.normal_speed = 4
	-- 현재 이동속도 증가량
	self.cur_add_speed_value = 0
	-- 아이템 획득 이동속도 증가량
	self.plus_item_speed = 0.4
	-- 이동속도 증가 시간
	self.plus_speed_time = 5
	-- 현재 이동속도 증가된 시간
	self.plus_speed_time_passed = 0
	-- 충돌 시 이동 거리
	self.stun_distance = 1
	-- 기절 시 이동 시간
	self.stun_move_time = 0.3
	-- 기절 지속 시간
	self.stun_time = 0.3
	-- 현재 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	-- 스프라이트 컬러 가중치 증가량
	self.add_color_magnitude_value = 0
	-- 현재 스프라이트 컬러 가중치
	self.color_magnitude = 0
	-- 현재 캐릭터가 Player인지
	self.is_player = false
	-- 현재 캐릭터가 바라보는 방향
	self.cur_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	-- 부착 fx
	self.attach_fx = nil
	-- 획득한 아이템 수
	self.get_item_count = 0
	-- 이펙트 발현되는 아이템 수
	self.attach_fx_item_count = 5
end

function character_base:setting_character(controller, constant_data)
	self.controller = controller
	self.character = get_character(constant_data.name)
	self.normal_speed = constant_data.normal_speed
	self.cur_add_speed_value = 0
	self.plus_item_speed = constant_data.plus_item_speed
	self.plus_speed_time = constant_data.plus_speed_time
	self.plus_speed_time_passed = 0
	self.stun_distance = constant_data.stun_distance
	self.stun_move_time = constant_data.stun_move_time
	self.stun_time = constant_data.stun_time
	self.add_color_magnitude_value = constant_data.add_color_magnitude_value
	self.color_magnitude = 0
	self.attach_fx = nil
	self.get_item_count = 0
	self.attach_fx_item_count = 5

	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.character, active_state_type.enabled)

	self:change_state(idle_state(self))
end

function character_base:update_frame(dt)
	self:check_plus_speed(dt)
	self:update_state(dt)
end

function character_base:check_plus_speed(dt)
	if self.cur_add_speed_value == 0 then
		return
	end

	self.plus_speed_time_passed = self.plus_speed_time_passed + dt

	if self.plus_speed_time_passed >= self.plus_speed_time then
		self.cur_add_speed_value = 0

		if self.current_state:get_type() ~= 'damage' then
			scene_util.set_emotion(self.character, self, 'attack')
		end
	end
end

function character_base:get_item()
	self.plus_speed_time_passed = 0
	self.cur_add_speed_value = self.plus_item_speed
	self.color_magnitude = math.min(self.color_magnitude + self.add_color_magnitude_value, 1)
	scene_util.set_emotion(self.character, self, 'burning')
	character_util.add_color(self.character, self.character.Name, unity_class.color.red, self.color_magnitude, 0)

	self.get_item_count = self.get_item_count + 1

	if self.attach_fx == nil and self.get_item_count >= self.attach_fx_item_count then
		if self.is_player then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_01')
		end

		self.attach_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_plitvice_buff'):Instantiate(
				self.character.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.character.Transform)
	end
end

function character_base:update_state(dt)
	self.current_state:update_frame(dt)

	if self.current_state:get_type() == 'move' and self.current_state:is_next_state() then
		self:change_state(idle_state(self))
	end

	if self.current_state:get_type() == 'damage' and self.current_state:is_next_state() then
		self:change_state(idle_state(self))
	end
end

function character_base:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	next_state:late_init()
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function character_base:get_state_type()
	return self.current_state:get_type()
end

function character_base:set_state(key)
	if key == 'move' then
		self:change_state(move_state(self))
	elseif key == 'idle' then
		self:change_state(idle_state(self))
	elseif key == 'damage' then
		self:change_state(damage_state(self))
	end
end

function character_base:reset()
	self:set_state('idle')
	character_util.remove_color(self.character, self.character.Name, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.character)

	self:dispose_fx()
end

function character_base:dispose_fx()
	if self.attach_fx ~= nil then
		self.attach_fx:Dispose()
		self.attach_fx = nil
	end
end

function character_base:dispose()
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	self:dispose_fx()

	self.current_state = nil
	self.controller = nil
end
--endregion Character Base

return {
	create = function()
		return character_base()
	end
}

			scale = 1.3 })
end

	if self.is_move_right then
		self.cur_marker_index = self.cur_marker_index == self.marker_count and 1 or self.cur_marker_index + 1
	else
		self.cur_marker_index = self.cur_marker_index == 1 and self.marker_count or self.cur_marker_index - 1
	end
end

function local_class:update_target_pos()
	if self.character_base:get_state_type() == 'idle' then
		self:update_marker_index()
		self.character_base.target_pos = self.move_marker_list[self.cur_marker_index]
	end

function local_class:move()
	if self.character_base:get_state_type() == 'idle' then
		self.character_base:set_state('move')
	end
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self:update_target_pos()
	self:move()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cur_marker_index = 1
	self.move_marker_list = nil
	self.character_base = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil
	self.character_base = nil

	-- constant data로 받아온 스펙
	self.player_spec = nil
	-- 플레이 캐릭터
	self.player = nil
	-- 현재 파티 저장용
	self.current_party = nil
end

function local_class:setting_controller(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	if self.character_base == nil then
		self.character_base = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/SpicyFoodRace/SpicyFoodRaceCharacterBase')
	end

	self.player_spec = self.controller.constants_data['player_info']
	self.character_base:setting_character(self, self.player_spec)
	self.player = self.character_base.character
	self.character_base.is_player = true
end

function local_class:setting_player()
	self.current_party = {}

	-- 모든 파티원 제외
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		local character = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(character)
		character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))
		field_object_util.set_active_state(character, active_state_type.disabled)

		table.insert(self.current_party, character)
	end

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.player, active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.player, param)

	-- 벽에 부딪치고 NPC는 통과해야 되는 Crash Behaviour 사용
	self.player.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.TrapCrashEtherealCharacterBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_position(self.player, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.player_spec.start_marker))
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.controller.constants_data['game_camera_size'], 0)
	character_util.set_direction(self.player, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.player)
end

function local_class:reset_party()
	self:dispose_fx()
	self.player.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.player)

	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	field_object_util.set_active_state(self.current_party[#self.current_party], active_state_type.enabled)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character_v2(self.current_party[#self.current_party], param, true)
	character_util.set_immortal(self.current_party[#self.current_party], false)

	for i = #self.current_party - 1, 1, -1 do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(self.current_party[i], active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.remove_color(self.current_party[i], self.current_party[i].Name, 0)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member_v2(self.current_party[i], user_party, true)
	end

	self.current_party = nil
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.character_base:update_frame(dt)
	self:move()
end

function local_class:move()
	if self.character_base:get_state_type() == 'idle' then

	end
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self:move()
end

function local_class:get_item()
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_eat_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_catch_fire_01')
	self.character_base:get_item()
end

function local_class:character_collision_action()
	if self.character_base:get_state_type() == 'damage' then
		return
	end

	self.character_base:set_state('damage')
end

function local_class:dispose_fx()
	self.character_base:dispose_fx()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.player = nil
	self.player_spec = nil
	self.character_base = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('SpicyFoodRaceItemController')

function local_class:init()
	self.controller = nil

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version + 1

	self.item_info = nil
	self.throw_npc_list = nil
	self.move_npc_list = nil

	self.cur_throw_delay = 0
	self.throw_delay = 100

	self.drop_item = setmetatable({
		-- 던져지는 시간
		drop_duration = 0.5,
		-- 던져질 때 회전하는 각도
		rotate_angle = 720,
		--담길 리스트
		item_list = {},
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_item = function(this, item_id, start_pos, target_pos)
				if this.item_list == nil then
					this.item_list = {}
				end

				local item = quest_drop_item_util.create_item({
					item_id = item_id,
					pos = start_pos,
					loot_state = quest_drop_item_loot_state.dont_find_looter,
					skip_text = true
				})

				local thrown_item = { item = item, can_consume = false }

				table.insert(this.item_list, thrown_item)

				quest_drop_item_util.rotate(item, this.rotate_angle, this.drop_duration)
				quest_drop_item_util.move(item, target_pos, {
					duration = this.drop_duration,
					y_move = function(progress)
						return math.sin(math.pi * progress) * 4
					end,
					callback = function()
						thrown_item.can_consume = true
						music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_food_01', play_pos = target_pos })
					end
				})
			end,
			consume = function(this, index)
				quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.item_list[index].item)
				table.remove(this.item_list, index)
			end,
			dispose_all = function(this)
				if this.item_list ~= nil then
					for i = 1, #this.item_list do
						this.item_list[i].item:Stop()
						quest_drop_item_util.dispose_item(this.item_list[i].item)
					end

					this.item_list = nil
				end
			end
		}
	})
end

function local_class:setting_controller(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.throw_npc_list = {}
	self.move_npc_list = {}

	self.item_info = controller.constants_data['item_info']

	for i = 1, self.item_info.npc_count do
		table.insert(self.throw_npc_list, get_character(self.item_info.npc_name_pri_pix .. i))
	end

	local npc_info = controller.constants_data['move_npc_info']

	for i = 1, #npc_info do
		table.insert(self.move_npc_list, get_character(npc_info[i].name))
	end

	self.cur_throw_delay = 0
	self.throw_delay = controller.constants_data['throw_item_delay']
end

function local_class:setting_item_npc()
	for i, npc in ipairs(self.throw_npc_list) do
		field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(npc, field_util.get_marker_pos(self.item_info.marker_name .. i))
		character_util.set_direction(npc, field_util.get_marker_dir(self.item_info.marker_name .. i))
		scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'smile')
		character_util.remove_anim(npc)
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:throw_item(dt)
end

--- 일정 시간마다 랜덤한 npc가 아이템을 던져줌
function local_class:throw_item(dt)
	self.cur_throw_delay = self.cur_throw_delay + dt

	if self.cur_throw_delay < self.throw_delay or self.drop_item == nil then
		return
	end

	self.cur_throw_delay = 0

	local throw_npc = self.throw_npc_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.throw_npc_list)]
	local target_pos = self.move_npc_list[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.move_npc_list)].Position
	local item_id = self.item_info.item_ids[random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.item_info.item_ids)]

	scene_util.set_anim(throw_npc, self, { name = 'attack', scale = 2, count = 1 })
	self.drop_item:create_item(item_id, throw_npc.Position, target_pos)
end

function local_class:game_start()
end

function local_class:reset()
	for i, npc in ipairs(self.throw_npc_list) do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.remove_color(npc, npc.Name, 0)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.throw_npc_list = nil
	self.move_npc_list = nil
	self.item_info = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

require('base/class')

local cafe_class = newclass('SuccubusCafe')

function cafe_class:init(status)
	self.constants = require('minigame/SuccubusCafe/SuccubusConstants')
	self.assets = status.Assets
	self.extra_potion_count = status.ExtraPotionCount
	self.extra_slot_count = status.ExtraSlotCount
	self.highest_sales = status.HighestSales
	self.total_sales = status.TotalSales
	local employee_count = status.Employees.Count

	self.employees = {}
	local generator = require('minigame/SuccubusCafe/Employee')
	for i = 0, employee_count - 1 do
		local employee_data = status.Employees[i]
		local e = generator.create(employee_data)
		self.employees[i + 1] = e
	end

end

function cafe_class:level()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	return c:GetCafeLevel(self.total_sales)
end

function cafe_class:table_count()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	return c:GetTableCount(self.total_sales)
end

function cafe_class:mana_portion_count()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	return c.BasePotionCount + self.extra_potion_count
end

function cafe_class:employee_slot_count()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	return c.BaseSlotCount + self.extra_slot_count
end

function cafe_class:game_time()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	return c:GetGameTime(self.total_sales)
end

function cafe_class:customer_period()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	return c:GetCustomerPeriod(self.total_sales)
end

function cafe_class:add_sales(sales)
	self.assets = self.assets + sales
	self.total_sales = self.total_sales + sales
end

function cafe_class:add_employee()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	if self.assets < c.SummonPrice then
		return "succubus_cafe_not_enough_assets"
	end

	local specs = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeList()
	local remaining_ids = {}
	local entries = 0
	local prob_sum = 0

	for i = 0, specs.Count -1 do
		if specs[i].CanSummon then
			local found = false
			for j = 1, #self.employees do
				if self.employees[j].id == specs[i].Id then
					found = true
					break
				end
			end

			prob_sum = prob_sum + specs[i].Probability

			if not found then
				entries = entries + 1
				local entry = {}
				entry.id = specs[i].Id
				entry.probability = specs[i].Probability
				remaining_ids[entries] = entry
			end
		end
	end

	if entries == 0 then
		return "succubus_cafe_out_of_employees"
	end

	self.assets = self.assets - c.SummonPrice

	local roll = math.random() * prob_sum
	local prob_walker = 0
	local hit_id = -1
	for i = 1, #remaining_ids do
		prob_walker = prob_walker + remaining_ids[i].probability
		if roll <= prob_walker then
			hit_id = remaining_ids[i].id
			break
		end
	end

	if hit_id < 0 then
		return "succubus_cafe_no_hit"
	end

	local generator = require('minigame/SuccubusCafe/Employee')
	local employee_data = {}
	employee_data.Id = hit_id
	employee_data.Condition = c:MaxCondition()
	employee_data.Sales = c.EmployeeLevels[3] + 1

	local new_e = generator.create(employee_data)

	self.employees[#self.employees + 1] = new_e
	return new_e
end

function cafe_class:add_potion()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	local price = c:GetExtraPotionPrice(self.extra_potion_count)
	if price < 0 then
		return "succubus_cafe_full_potions"
	end

	if self.assets < price then
		return "succubus_cafe_not_enough_assets"
	end

	self.extra_potion_count = self.extra_potion_count + 1
	self.assets = self.assets - price
	return self.extra_potion_count
end

function cafe_class:add_slot()
	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	local price = c:GetExtraSlotPrice(self.extra_slot_count)
	if price < 0 then
		return "succubus_cafe_full_slots"
	end

	if self.assets < price then
		return "succubus_cafe_not_enough_assets"
	end

	self.extra_slot_count = self.extra_slot_count + 1
	self.assets = self.assets - price
	return self.extra_slot_count
end

function cafe_class:add_member_if_not_there(cid, level)
	local found = false
	for i = 1, #self.employees do
		if self.employees[i].id == cid then
			found = true
			break
		end
	end

	if found then
		return false
	end

	local c = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	local generator = require('minigame/SuccubusCafe/Employee')
	local employee_data = {}
	employee_data.Id = cid
	employee_data.Condition = c:MaxCondition()
	employee_data.Sales = c.EmployeeLevels[level - 2] + 1

	local new_e = generator.create(employee_data)

	self.employees[#self.employees + 1] = new_e
	return true
end

-- Cafe Generator
return {
	create = function(init_data)
		return cafe_class(init_data)
	end
}
