--- Succubus MiniGame Controller
--- 해당 퀘스트를 시작 하면 데이터를 로드 한다. Bridge를 통해 Deserialize 된 데이터를 로드
--- 해당 퀘스트 종료, 혹은 갱신시 Bridge 의 Save 를 통해 데이터를 저장.
--- 해당 컨트롤러에 있는 값들을 Bridge 에서 읽어서 사용 하는 구조가 될 예정
--- 따라서 모든 데이터는 여기서 관리 되서 미니 게임이 돌아 가면 된다.
--- 로직을 분리 하고 싶다면 종속성, 상태 제거한 함수들을 모아서 다른 파일로 넣고
--- require 로 읽어와서 사용 하면 해당 파일의 복잡도가 줄어 들것.
local local_class = newclass("SuccubusCafeController")

function local_class:init(cs_controller, scene)
	-- Constants 를 여기서 로드 한다.
	self.constants = require('minigame/SuccubusCafe/SuccubusConstants')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeStartEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_dream_good")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_dream_normal")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_dream_bad")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_sales_normal")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_sales_strong")
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_heal_a")

	return util.cs_generator(self.stage_load_resource, self)
end

--- Load Resources Here.
function local_class:stage_load_resource()
	coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeDataBridge.LoadGame(self))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeStartEvent) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_cafe, self, e.TargetSales))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeStartEvent), 'on_event')

	self.menu_state = nil
	self.cafe_open = nil
	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end
end

--- SuccubusCafeDataBridge 의 클래스 확인
function local_class:load(status)

	self.cafe = cafe_class.create(status)
end

--- 카페 미니게임 로딩
function local_class:load_cafe(target_sales)
	-- 상수
	self.poor_customer_id_max = 3
	self.normal_customer_id_max = 6
	self.epic_customer_id_max = 9

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local cafe_center = field:GetMarker("cafe_customer_entry").position
	camera_util.move(cafe_center, 0, { end_target = nil })

	local constants = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()

	self.target_sales = target_sales

	-- 주인공 / 유즈 셋업
	if self.cafe_yuze == nil then
		self.cafe_yuze = get_character("cafe_yuze")
		self.cafe_knight = get_character("cafe_knight")
	end

	self.cafe_yuze.Position = cafe_center + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	self.cafe_yuze.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_yuze, { name = "success", loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.cafe_yuze, { name = "smile"})

	self.cafe_knight.Position = cafe_center + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)
	self.cafe_knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_knight, { name = "idle", loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.cafe_knight, { name = "smile"})

	-- NGUI / FieldUI 어셋 로드
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		-- NGUI
		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "CafeMainMenu"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))

		self.cafe_open = nil
		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "CafeOpen"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			self.cafe_open = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.CafeOpen))
		end))

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "CafeSelectPopup"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "CafeRecovery"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "CafeResult"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))


		-- FieldUI
		local num_tables = constants:GetMaxTableCount()

		self.place_states = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.UI.FieldUICafePlaceState)
		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "PlaceState"), function(p)
			for i = 0, num_tables - 1 do
				local f = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(p)
				local place = f:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.FieldUICafePlaceState))
				self.place_states:Add(place)
				f:SetActive(false)
			end
		end))

		self.mana_bars = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.UI.FieldUICafeProgressBar)
		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/cafe/ui", "PlaceProgressBar"), function(p)
			for i = 0, num_tables - 1 do
				local f = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(p)
				local bar = f:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.FieldUICafeProgressBar))
				self.mana_bars:Add(bar)
				f:SetActive(false)
			end
		end))

	end

	self.cafe_open.gameObject:SetActive(false)


	-- 메인 메뉴 오픈 준비
	local need_to_add_employees = false
	local is_first_time = false;

	if #self.cafe.employees == 1 then
		-- C# 코드로 generate 된 raw 데이터. 2번, 3 번 멤버를 넣고 저장 플래그를 킨다.
		if self.cafe.employees[1].id == 1 then
			local generator = require('minigame/SuccubusCafe/Employee')
			local employee_data2 = {}
			employee_data2.Id = 2
			employee_data2.Condition = constants:MaxCondition()
			employee_data2.Sales = 0
			local new_e2 = generator.create(employee_data2)
			self.cafe.employees[2] = new_e2

			local employee_data3 = {}
			employee_data3.Id = 3
			employee_data3.Condition = constants:MaxCondition()
			employee_data3.Sales = 0
			local new_e3 = generator.create(employee_data3)
			self.cafe.employees[3] = new_e3

			need_to_add_employees = true
			is_first_time = true
		end
	end

	if self:got_bianca() then
		if self.cafe:add_member_if_not_there(7, 3) then
			need_to_add_employees = true
		end
	end

	if self:got_lupina() then
		if self.cafe:add_member_if_not_there(8, 5) then
			need_to_add_employees = true
		end
	end

	if self:got_tinia() then
		if self.cafe:add_member_if_not_there(9, 7) then
			need_to_add_employees = true
		end
	end

	if self:got_lana() then
		if self.cafe:add_member_if_not_there(10, 3) then
			need_to_add_employees = true
		end
	end

	local all_members = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.UI.CafeCharacterInfo)

	local sorted_employees = {}
	for i = 1, #self.cafe.employees do
		sorted_employees[i] = self.cafe.employees[i]
	end

	local member_sort = function (a, b)
		if a.sales > b.sales then
			return true
		elseif a.sales < b.sales then
			return false
		end

		local a_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(a.id)
		local b_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(b.id)

		if a_spec.Rarity > b_spec.Rarity then
			return true
		elseif a_spec.Rarity < b_spec.Rarity then
			return false
		end

		if a.id < b.id then
			return true
		else
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	table.sort(sorted_employees, member_sort)


	for i = 1, #sorted_employees do
		local m = CS.Oak.UI.CafeCharacterInfo()
		m.Id = sorted_employees[i].id
		m.Sales = sorted_employees[i].sales
		m.Condition = sorted_employees[i].condition
		m.AssignedTable = -1
		m.CurrentSessionSales = 0
		all_members:Add(m)
	end

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	wait_for_sec(0.5)


	-- 메인 메뉴 오픈
	local menu_state = CS.Oak.UI.CafeMainMenuState()
	menu_state.Members = all_members
	menu_state.CafeSales = self.cafe.total_sales
	menu_state.ExtraSlotCount = self.cafe.extra_slot_count
	menu_state.ExtraPotionCount = self.cafe.extra_potion_count
	menu_state.Assets = self.cafe.assets

	local cancelled = false
	local oked = false

	local on_cancel = function ()
		cancelled = true
	end

	local running_members = nil
	local on_ok = function (members)
		oked = true
		running_members = members
	end

	local on_summon = function ()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.summon, self))
	end

	local on_potion_purchase = function ()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.purchase_potion, self))
	end

	local on_slot_purchase = function ()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.purchase_slot, self))
	end

	menu_state.OnCancel = on_cancel
	menu_state.OnStartBusiness = on_ok
	menu_state.OnSummon = on_summon
	menu_state.OnPotionPurchase = on_potion_purchase
	menu_state.OnSlotPurchase = on_slot_purchase

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CafeMainMenu.Instance, menu_state)
	self.menu_state = menu_state

	local time_passed = 0
	local tutorial_point = 0.5
	while true do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		local old_time_passed = time_passed
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		if cancelled or oked then
			break
		end

		if is_first_time and old_time_passed < tutorial_point and time_passed >= tutorial_point then
			CS.Oak.UI.CafeMainMenu.Instance:OnHelpButtonClick()
		end
	end

	if cancelled then
		self:clear_cafe()
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent.Create(0, true))
		return
	end

	-- 카페 시작 누른 순간
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_no_del_stage_entry_01')

	-- 신규 캐릭터를 획득했다면 여기서 저장을 해야 한다.
	if need_to_add_employees then
		ui_scene_manager:ShowWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject, true)
		coroutine.yield(self:save())
	end

	-- 로딩을 위해 페이드 아웃
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1.0 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, "linear")

	ui_scene_manager:HideWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject)
	ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()

	-- 캐릭터 로딩 / 배치
	if self.employees == nil then
		self.employees = {}
	end

	local chars_to_generate = ni;
	local name_to_ids = nil

	for i = 0, running_members.Count -1 do
		if self.employees[running_members[i].Id] == nil then
			if chars_to_generate == nil then
				chars_to_generate = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateParam)
				name_to_ids = {}
			end

			local e_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(running_members[i].Id)
			local characters_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("Characters")
			local c_spec = characters_data:GetSpec(e_spec.Name)

			local c = CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateParam.GetDefault()
			c.Name = string.format("generated_employee_%d", running_members[i].Id)
			c.SpineName = c_spec.SpineAssetName
			c.SpriteName = c_spec.SpriteAssetName
			c.SkinName = c_spec.SpineSkinName
			c.StartPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)

			name_to_ids[c.Name] = running_members[i].Id
			chars_to_generate:Add(c)
		end
	end

	if chars_to_generate ~= nil then
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateNpcCharacter(chars_to_generate))
		for i = 0, chars_to_generate.Count - 1 do
			local cid = name_to_ids[chars_to_generate[i].Name]
			self.employees[cid] = get_character(chars_to_generate[i].Name)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, running_members.Count - 1 do
		self.employees[running_members[i].Id].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end

	-- 손님 로딩
	if self.customers_poor == nil then
		self.customers_poor = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.used_customers_poor = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.customers_normal = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.used_customers_normal = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
		self.customers_epic = {}

		local num_tables = constants:GetMaxTableCount()
		local pool_size = num_tables + 1

		-- 가난한 손님

		local characters_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData("Characters")
		local poor_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetCustomerSpec(1)
		local c_poor_spec = characters_data:GetSpec(poor_spec.Name)

		local normal_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetCustomerSpec(4)
		local c_normal_spec = characters_data:GetSpec(normal_spec.Name)

		local chars_to_generate = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateParam)

		for i = 0, pool_size -1 do
			local c = CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateParam.GetDefault()
			c.Name = string.format("generated_poor_customer_%d", i)
			c.SpineName = c_poor_spec.SpineAssetName
			c.SpriteName = c_poor_spec.SpriteAssetName
			c.SkinName = c_poor_spec.SpineSkinName
			c.StartPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
			chars_to_generate:Add(c)
		end

		for i = 0, pool_size -1 do
			local c = CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateParam.GetDefault()
			c.Name = string.format("generated_normal_customer_%d", i)
			c.SpineName = c_normal_spec.SpineAssetName
			c.SpriteName = c_normal_spec.SpriteAssetName
			c.SkinName = c_normal_spec.SpineSkinName
			c.StartPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
			chars_to_generate:Add(c)
		end

		-- 에픽 손님 로드. 시작 끝 아이디를 C# 에서 가져올 방법이 없어서 hack
		local epic_start = self.normal_customer_id_max + 1
		local epic_end = self.epic_customer_id_max

		for i = epic_start, epic_end do
			local epic_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetCustomerSpec(i)
			local c_epic_spec = characters_data:GetSpec(epic_spec.Name)

			local c = CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateParam.GetDefault()
			c.Name = string.format("generated_epic_customer_%d", i)
			c.SpineName = c_epic_spec.SpineAssetName
			c.SpriteName = c_epic_spec.SpriteAssetName
			c.SkinName = c_epic_spec.SpineSkinName
			c.StartPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
			chars_to_generate:Add(c)
		end


		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.NpcCharacterGenerator.GenerateNpcCharacter(chars_to_generate))

		for i = 0, chars_to_generate.Count - 1 do
			if i < pool_size then
				self.customers_poor:Add(get_character(chars_to_generate[i].Name))
			elseif i < pool_size * 2 then
				self.customers_normal:Add(get_character(chars_to_generate[i].Name))
			else
				self.customers_epic[i - pool_size * 2 + epic_start] = get_character(chars_to_generate[i].Name)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 실제 게임 루틴으로
	coroutine.yield(self:run_cafe(running_members))
end

-- 실제 게임
function local_class:run_cafe(running_members)
	local constants = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()

	-- Cafe table state enums and constants
	self.table_state_empty = 0
	self.table_state_approaching = 1
	self.table_state_waiting = 2
	self.table_state_therapy = 3
	self.table_state_payment = 4
	self.table_state_ending = 5

	self.table_ending_happy = 0
	self.table_ending_bad = 1
	self.table_ending_ugly = 2

	self.member_table_offset = vector(0.4, 0.75, 0)
	self.customer_table_offset = vector(-0.4, 0.75, 0)

	self.employee_good_stat = 70
	self.employee_normal_stat = 20

	-- CafeOpen 처리
	self.game_time = self.cafe:game_time()
	self.potion_count = self.cafe:mana_portion_count()
	self.cafe_open.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	self.cafe_open:Init()
	self.cafe_open:SetPotion(self.potion_count)
	self.cafe_open:SetTimer(self.game_time)

	self.total_sales_this_session = 0
	local num_tables = self.cafe:table_count()
	local cafe_center = field:GetMarker("cafe_center").position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
	self.open_select_table = -1
	self.is_recovery_open = false
	self.running_members = running_members

	self.cafe_yuze.Position = field:GetMarker("cafe_center").position + vector(6.5, 0, 1.0)
	self.cafe_yuze.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_yuze, { name = "sing", loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.cafe_yuze, { name = "smile"})

	self.cafe_knight.Position = field:GetMarker("cafe_center").position + vector(6.5, 0, -1.0)
	self.cafe_knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_knight, { name = "sing", loop = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.cafe_knight, { name = "smile"})

	-- 마나 초기화
	for i = 0, self.running_members.Count -1 do
		local spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(self.running_members[i].Id)
		self.running_members[i].CurrentMana = spec:GetMana(self.running_members[i].Sales)
	end

	local on_help_open = function ()
		self.paused = true
		for i = 0, num_tables -1 do
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	local on_help_close = function ()
		self.paused = false
		self:restore_place_states_and_mana_bar()
	end

	self.cafe_open.OnHelpOpenAction = on_help_open
	self.cafe_open.OnHelpCloseAction = on_help_close

	-- 미리 생성해놓은 recovery_state

	local on_recovery = function (member_index)
		local spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(self.running_members[member_index].Id)
		self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana = spec:GetMana(self.running_members[member_index].Sales)
		self.potion_count = self.potion_count - 1
		self.cafe_open:SetPotion(self.potion_count)
		CS.Oak.UI.CafeRecovery.Instance:UpdateAfterRecovery(member_index, self.potion_count)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_drinking_01')

		if self.running_members[member_index].AssignedTable > 0 then
			self:update_mana_bar(self.running_members[member_index].AssignedTable)
			self:set_table_response(self.running_members[member_index].AssignedTable)

			local heal_pos = self.table_states[self.running_members[member_index].AssignedTable].position + self.member_table_offset
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_heal_a"):Instantiate(heal_pos)
		end
	end

	local on_recovery_close = function ()
		self.is_recovery_open = false
		self.paused = false
		self:restore_place_states_and_mana_bar()
	end

	local recovery_state = CS.Oak.UI.CafeRecoveryState()
	recovery_state.Members = self.running_members
	recovery_state.OnRecoveryAction = on_recovery
	recovery_state.OnCloseAction = on_recovery_close

	local on_potion_click = function ()
		if self.open_select_table > 0 or self.is_recovery_open then
			return
		end

		if self.game_time <= 0 then
			return
		end

		for i = 0, num_tables -1 do
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)
		end

		self.is_recovery_open = true
		self.paused = true

		recovery_state.PotionCount = self.potion_count

		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CafeRecovery.Instance, recovery_state)
	end
	self.cafe_open.OnPotionClick = on_potion_click


	-- table state 생성
	self.table_states = {}
	for i = 1, num_tables do
		self.table_states[i] = {}
		self.table_states[i].state = self.table_state_empty
		self.table_states[i].approach_time = 0
		self.table_states[i].guest_id = -1
		self.table_states[i].guest_therapy_time = 0
		self.table_states[i].member_index = -1
		self.table_states[i].member_struggling = false
		self.table_states[i].wait_time = 0
		self.table_states[i].ending = -1
		self.table_states[i].ending_time = 0
		self.table_states[i].ending_member_index = -1
		self.table_states[i].good_dream_effect = nil
		self.table_states[i].normal_dream_effect = nil
		self.table_states[i].bad_dream_effect = nil
		self.table_states[i].guest_character = nil
		self.table_states[i].guest_rank_icon1 = nil
		self.table_states[i].guest_rank_icon2 = nil
		self.table_states[i].guest_rank_icon3 = nil
	end

	-- 미리 생성해놓은 select_state

	local select_state = CS.Oak.UI.CafeSelectState()
	select_state.Members = self.running_members

	local on_cancel_select = function ()
		self.open_select_table = -1
		self.is_recovery_open = false
		camera_util.move(cafe_center, 0.2)
		self:restore_place_states_and_mana_bar()
		self.paused = false
	end

	local on_confirm_select = function (selected_member_index)
		local table_index = self.open_select_table
		if selected_member_index >= 0 then
			local prev_table = self.running_members[selected_member_index].AssignedTable
			if prev_table > 0 then
				CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Trying to assign already working member")
			else
				self:waiting_to_therapy(table_index, selected_member_index)
			end
		end

		on_cancel_select()
	end

	select_state.OnConfirmAction = on_confirm_select
	select_state.OnCancelAction = on_cancel_select

	-- PlaceState 처리
	local on_state_click = function (index)
		if self.open_select_table > 0 or self.is_recovery_open then
			return
		end

		if self.game_time <= 0 then
			return
		end

		if self.table_states[index].state == self.table_state_waiting then
			-- Select 오픈
			self.open_select_table = index
			self.paused = true

			for i = 0, num_tables -1 do
				if i + 1 ~= index then
					self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
					self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)
				end
			end

			select_state.GuestId = self.table_states[index].guest_id

			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
			ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CafeSelect.Instance, select_state)

			camera_util.move(self.table_states[index].position + vector(2, 0, 0), 0.2)
		elseif self.table_states[index].state == self.table_state_therapy then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
			self:therapy_to_ending(index)
		elseif self.table_states[index].state == self.table_state_payment then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_button_06')
			self:payment_to_ending(index)
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.place_states.Count -1 do
		if i < num_tables then
			local marker_name = string.format("cafe_table_%d", (i + 1))
			local marker_pos = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position
			self.table_states[i + 1].position = marker_pos
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.place_states[i]:Init(i + 1, marker_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5), on_state_click)
			self.mana_bars[i].AnchorPoint = marker_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.25)
			self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)
		else
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.place_states[i]:Clear()
			self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	camera_util.resize_to(5.0, 0)
	camera_util.move(cafe_center, 0)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, "linear")


	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("succubus_cafe_run_start"), 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.35)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bell_02')
	wait_for_sec(1.65)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/cafe/preload:bgm_cafe_game', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	self.paused = false

	local guests_up_to_now = 0
	local epic_guests_up_to_now = 0
	local game_time_passed = 0

	-- 게임 MAIN LOOP
	while self.game_time >= 0 do
		if self.paused then
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		else
			local dt = unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime

			-- 손님 생성
			local random_free_table = self:get_random_free_table_index()
			if random_free_table > 0 then
				local new_guest_id = self:get_new_guest(game_time_passed, guests_up_to_now, epic_guests_up_to_now)
				if new_guest_id >= 0 then
					local added = self:empty_to_approaching(random_free_table, new_guest_id)
					if added then
						guests_up_to_now = guests_up_to_now + 1
						if new_guest_id > self.normal_customer_id_max then
							epic_guests_up_to_now = epic_guests_up_to_now + 1
						end
					end
				end
			end

			for i = 1, num_tables do
				self:table_loop(i, dt)
			end

			self.cafe_open:SetSales(self.total_sales_this_session, self.target_sales)
			self.cafe_open:SetTimer(self.game_time)

			self.game_time = self.game_time - dt
			game_time_passed = game_time_passed + dt
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	self.cafe_open:SetTimer(0)
	self.cafe_open.OnPotionClick = nil
	self.cafe_open.OnHelpOpenAction = nil
	self.cafe_open.OnHelpCloseAction = nil

	for i = 0, self.place_states.Count - 1 do
		self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)

		if self.table_states[i + 1].good_dream_effect ~= nil then
			self.table_states[i + 1].good_dream_effect:Dispose()
			self.table_states[i + 1].good_dream_effect = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[i + 1].normal_dream_effect ~= nil then
			self.table_states[i + 1].normal_dream_effect:Dispose()
			self.table_states[i + 1].normal_dream_effect = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[i + 1].bad_dream_effect ~= nil then
			self.table_states[i + 1].bad_dream_effect:Dispose()
			self.table_states[i + 1].bad_dream_effect = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon1 ~= nil then
			self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon1:Dispose()
			self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon1 = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon2 ~= nil then
			self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon2:Dispose()
			self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon2 = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon3 ~= nil then
			self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon3:Dispose()
			self.table_states[i + 1].guest_rank_icon3 = nil
		end
	end

	self.table_states = nil

	for key, value in pairs(self.employees) do
		value:CancelShake()
	end

	-- 종료 연출
	for i = 0, self.running_members.Count -1 do
		if self.running_members[i].AssignedTable > 0 then
			local char = self.employees[self.running_members[i].Id]
			char.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
			character_util.set_emotion(char, { name = "smile" })
			character_util.set_anim(char, { name = "success", loop = true })
		end
	end

	self.cafe_yuze.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_yuze, { name = "success", loop = true })
	self.cafe_knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_knight, { name = "success", loop = true })

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString("succubus_cafe_run_end"), 1.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bell_02')
	wait_for_sec(2.0)

	-- 종료 처리
	local cafe_level_before = self.cafe:level()
	self.cafe.total_sales = self.cafe.total_sales + self.total_sales_this_session
	local cafe_level_after = self.cafe:level()
	local cafe_levelup = cafe_level_after > cafe_level_before

	self.cafe.assets = self.cafe.assets + self.total_sales_this_session
	if self.total_sales_this_session > self.cafe.highest_sales then
		self.cafe.highest_sales = self.total_sales_this_session
	end

	local employee_levelup = false

	-- 참여한 멤버 매출 업데이트
	for i = 0, self.running_members.Count -1 do
		local found = false
		self.running_members[i].Sales = self.running_members[i].Sales + self.running_members[i].CurrentSessionSales

		for j = 1, #self.cafe.employees do
			if self.running_members[i].Id == self.cafe.employees[j].id then
				found = true;
				local employee_level_before = constants:GetEmployeeLevel(self.cafe.employees[j].sales)
				self.cafe.employees[j].sales = self.cafe.employees[j].sales + self.running_members[i].CurrentSessionSales
				local employee_level_after = constants:GetEmployeeLevel(self.cafe.employees[j].sales)
				if not employee_levelup then
					employee_levelup = employee_level_after > employee_level_before
				end

				local condition = self.cafe.employees[j].condition
				if condition > 0 then
					condition = condition - 1
				end
				self.cafe.employees[j].condition = condition
				break
			end
		end

		if not found then
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("SuccubusCafe : Couldn't find member to update")
		end
	end

	-- 비참여 멤버 건강 회복
	for i = 1, #self.cafe.employees do
		local ran = false
		for j = 0, self.running_members.Count - 1 do
			if self.running_members[j].Id == self.cafe.employees[i].id then
				ran = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not ran then
			self.cafe.employees[i].condition = constants:MaxCondition()
		end
	end

	ui_scene_manager:ShowWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject, true)
	coroutine.yield(self:save())
	ui_scene_manager:HideWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 정산 루틴으로.
	coroutine.yield(self:end_cafe(self.total_sales_this_session, cafe_levelup, employee_levelup))
end

-- 각 테이블의 메인 루프
function local_class:table_loop(table_index, dt)
	local constants = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()

	if self.table_states[table_index].state == self.table_state_approaching then
		local approach_duration = 1.0
		self.table_states[table_index].approach_time = self.table_states[table_index].approach_time + dt
		local char = self.table_states[table_index].guest_character
		local time_passed = self.table_states[table_index].approach_time
		if time_passed >= approach_duration then
			char.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1, 0)
			self:approaching_to_waiting(table_index)
		else
			local progress = time_passed / approach_duration
			char.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(progress, 0)
		end
	elseif self.table_states[table_index].state == self.table_state_waiting then
		local break_point = constants.CustomerWaitDuration * 0.5
		local old_time = self.table_states[table_index].wait_time
		self.table_states[table_index].wait_time = self.table_states[table_index].wait_time + dt

		local guest_character = self.table_states[table_index].guest_character
		if old_time < break_point and self.table_states[table_index].wait_time >= break_point then
			guest_character:Shake(0.02, 10000)
			character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "attack" })
			character_util.show_emoticon(guest_character, nil, CS.Oak.EmoticonType.Angry)
		end

		if self.table_states[table_index].wait_time >= constants.CustomerWaitDuration then
			guest_character:CancelShake()
			self:waiting_to_ending(table_index)
		end
	elseif self.table_states[table_index].state == self.table_state_therapy then
		local consumption = self:calculate_consumption(table_index)
		local consume_speed = consumption / constants.TherapyDuration
		local time_before = self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time
		self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time = self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time + dt
		local time_after = self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time

		if self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time >= constants.TherapyDuration then
			self:therapy_to_payment(table_index)
		else
			local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index

			local tick_before = math.floor(time_before / constants.TherapyTick)
			local tick_after = math.floor(time_after / constants.TherapyTick)

			if tick_before + 0.5 < tick_after then
				-- 중간 정산
				local payment = self:calculate_payment(table_index)
				local paymentThisTick = payment * (constants.TherapyTick / constants.TherapyDuration)
				local amount = math.floor(paymentThisTick)
				self.running_members[member_index].CurrentSessionSales = self.running_members[member_index].CurrentSessionSales + amount
				self.total_sales_this_session = self.total_sales_this_session + amount

				if amount > 0 then
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_heart_01')
				else
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_cry_01')
				end

				self:show_payment(table_index, amount)
			end

			self.place_states[table_index - 1]:SetTimer(constants.TherapyDuration - self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time)
			local mana_diff = consume_speed * dt
			if self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana <= mana_diff then
				self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana = 0
			else
				self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana = self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana - mana_diff
			end

			self:set_table_response(table_index, true)
		end
	elseif self.table_states[table_index].state == self.table_state_ending then
		local ending_duration = 1.5
		local fade_duration = 0.25
		local member_character = nil
		if self.table_states[table_index].ending_member_index >= 0 then
			local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].ending_member_index
			member_character = self.employees[self.running_members[member_index].Id]
		end
		local guest_character = self.table_states[table_index].guest_character

		if self.table_states[table_index].ending_time == 0 then
			-- 엔딩 연출 셋업
			if self.table_states[table_index].ending == self.table_ending_happy then
				if member_character ~= nil then
					character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "awesome"})
					character_util.set_anim(member_character, { name = "clap", loop = true, upper = true })
				end

				character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "awesome"})
				character_util.set_anim(guest_character, { name = "success", loop = true} )
			elseif self.table_states[table_index].ending == self.table_ending_bad then
				if member_character ~= nil then
					character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "idle"})
					character_util.set_anim(member_character, { name = "nod", loop = true, upper = true })
				end

				character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "idle"})
				character_util.set_anim(guest_character, { name = "nod", loop = true, upper = true } )
			else
				if member_character ~= nil then
					character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "damaged"})
				end

				character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "mad"})
				character_util.set_anim(guest_character, { name = "release", loop = true} )
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon1 ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon1:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon1 = nil
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon2 ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon2:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon2 = nil
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon3 ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon3:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon3 = nil
			end
		end

		self.table_states[table_index].ending_time = self.table_states[table_index].ending_time + dt
		if self.table_states[table_index].ending_time >= ending_duration then
			self:ending_to_empty(table_index)
		else
			local fade_prog = (self.table_states[table_index].ending_time - (ending_duration - fade_duration)) / fade_duration
			if fade_prog >= 0 then
				if member_character ~= nil then
					member_character.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1 - fade_prog, 0)
				end
				guest_character.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(1 - fade_prog, 0)
			end

		end
	end

	self:update_mana_bar(table_index)
end


-- UI 편의 함수
function local_class:update_mana_bar(table_index)
	if self.table_states[table_index].member_index < 0 then
		return
	end
	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index
	local spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(self.running_members[member_index].Id)
	self.mana_bars[table_index - 1]:SetProgress(self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana, spec:GetMana(self.running_members[member_index].Sales))
end

function local_class:restore_place_states_and_mana_bar()
	for i = 0, #self.table_states -1 do
		local state = self.table_states[i + 1].state
		if state ~= self.table_state_empty and state ~= self.table_state_ending and state ~= self.table_state_approaching then
			self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(true)
		end
		if state == self.table_state_therapy or state == self.table_state_payment then
			self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(true)
		end
	end
end

-- 손님 생성 관련
function local_class:get_new_guest(game_time_passed, num_guests, num_epic_guests)
	local constants = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	local guests_to_have = (game_time_passed - 1.0) / self.cafe:customer_period()

	if guests_to_have >= num_guests then
		local info = constants:GetCafeInfo(self.cafe.total_sales)
		local total_weight = info.NormalWeight + info.RareWeight + info.EpicWeight
		local roll = math.random() * total_weight

		-- 시간 반이 지날 동안 에픽 게스트가 한번도 안나왔다면 강제로 에픽 게스트가 나오도록.
		if game_time_passed >= self.game_time / 2.0 and num_epic_guests == 0 then
			if self.cafe:level() == 1 then
				return 9
			else
				return math.random(self.normal_customer_id_max + 1, self.epic_customer_id_max)
			end
		end

		if roll <= info.NormalWeight then
			return math.random(1, self.poor_customer_id_max)
		elseif roll <= info.NormalWeight + info.RareWeight then
			return math.random(self.poor_customer_id_max + 1, self.normal_customer_id_max)
		end
		return math.random(self.normal_customer_id_max + 1, self.epic_customer_id_max)
	end

	return -1
end

function local_class:get_random_free_table_index()
	local num_free_tables = 0
	for i = 1, #self.table_states do
		if self.table_states[i].state == self.table_state_empty then
			num_free_tables = num_free_tables + 1
		end
	end

	if num_free_tables == 0 then
		return -1
	end

	local rand_walker = math.random(0, num_free_tables -1)
	for i = 1, #self.table_states do
		if self.table_states[i].state == self.table_state_empty then
			if rand_walker == 0 then
				return i
			else
				rand_walker = rand_walker - 1
			end
		end
	end

	return -1
end


-- 계산 함수
function local_class:calculate_consumption(table_index)
	local customer_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetCustomerSpec(self.table_states[table_index].guest_id)
	return customer_spec:GetConsumeFactor(self.cafe.total_sales)
end

function local_class:calculate_payment(table_index)
	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index

	if self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana <= 0 then
		return 0
	end

	local employee_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(self.running_members[member_index].Id)
	local customer_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetCustomerSpec(self.table_states[table_index].guest_id)

	local payment_factor = customer_spec:GetPaymentFactor(self.cafe.total_sales)
	local stat = 0
	if customer_spec.RequiredStatType == CS.Oak.UI.CafeCharacterStatType.Visual then
		stat = employee_spec:GetVisual(self.running_members[member_index].Sales)
	elseif customer_spec.RequiredStatType == CS.Oak.UI.CafeCharacterStatType.Kindness then
		stat = employee_spec:GetKindness(self.running_members[member_index].Sales)
	else
		stat = employee_spec:GetHumor(self.running_members[member_index].Sales)
	end

	local condition_factor = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate():GetConditionFactor(self.running_members[member_index].Condition)
	local res = stat * payment_factor * condition_factor
	return res
end

function local_class:show_payment(table_index, amount)
	local pos = self.table_states[table_index].position + self.member_table_offset + vector(0, 0.5, 0)
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(nil, amount, unity_class.color.white, pos)

	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index
	local match_level = self:get_match_level(table_index)

	if self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana <= 0 then
		match_level = 0
	end

	if match_level == 2 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_sales_strong"):Instantiate(pos)
	elseif match_level == 1 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_sales_normal"):Instantiate(pos)
	end
end

function local_class:get_match_level(table_index)
	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index
	local employee_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetEmployeeSpec(self.running_members[member_index].Id)
	local customer_spec = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeData.GetCustomerSpec(self.table_states[table_index].guest_id)

	local relevant_stat = 0
	if customer_spec.RequiredStatType == CS.Oak.UI.CafeCharacterStatType.Visual then
		relevant_stat = employee_spec:GetVisual(0)
	elseif customer_spec.RequiredStatType == CS.Oak.UI.CafeCharacterStatType.Kindness then
		relevant_stat = employee_spec:GetKindness(0)
	else
		relevant_stat = employee_spec:GetHumor(0)
	end

	if relevant_stat >= self.employee_good_stat then
		return 2
	elseif relevant_stat >= self.employee_normal_stat then
		return 1
	end

	return 0
end


-- 스테이트 전환
function local_class:payment_to_ending(table_index)
	-- 결제 처리 (한 틱 분량)
	local constants = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index
	local payment = self:calculate_payment(table_index)
	local paymentThisTick = payment * (constants.TherapyTick / constants.TherapyDuration)
	local amount = math.floor(paymentThisTick)
	local match_level = self:get_match_level(table_index)
	self.running_members[member_index].CurrentSessionSales = self.running_members[member_index].CurrentSessionSales + amount
	self.total_sales_this_session = self.total_sales_this_session + amount


	self:show_payment(table_index, amount)

	self.running_members[member_index].AssignedTable = -1
	self.table_states[table_index].state = self.table_state_ending
	if self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana > 0 then
		if match_level > 0 then
			self.table_states[table_index].ending = self.table_ending_happy
		else
			self.table_states[table_index].ending = self.table_ending_bad
		end

		if amount > 0 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_heart_02')
		else
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_heart_02')
		end
	else
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_get_heart_02')
		self.table_states[table_index].ending = self.table_ending_ugly
	end
	self.table_states[table_index].ending_time = 0
	self.table_states[table_index].ending_member_index = member_index
	self.table_states[table_index].member_index = -1
	self.table_states[table_index].member_struggling = false
	self.place_states[table_index - 1].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.mana_bars[table_index - 1]:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:waiting_to_ending(table_index)
	self.table_states[table_index].state = self.table_state_ending
	self.table_states[table_index].ending = self.table_ending_ugly
	self.table_states[table_index].ending_time = 0
	self.table_states[table_index].ending_member_index = -1
	self.place_states[table_index - 1].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
end

function local_class:empty_to_approaching(table_index, guest_id)
	local char = nil
	local rank = 0
	if guest_id <= self.poor_customer_id_max then
		if self.customers_poor.Count == 0 then
			CS.UnityEngien.Debug.LogError("Poor customers pool is empty")
		else
			char = self.customers_poor[0]
			self.customers_poor:RemoveAt(0)
			self.used_customers_poor:Add(char)
		end
	elseif guest_id <= self.normal_customer_id_max then
		rank = 1
		if self.customers_normal.Count == 0 then
			CS.UnityEngien.Debug.LogError("Normal customers pool is empty")
		else
			char = self.customers_normal[0]
			self.customers_normal:RemoveAt(0)
			self.used_customers_normal:Add(char)
		end
	else
		rank = 2
		local redundant = false
		for i = 1, #self.table_states do
			if self.table_states[i].guest_id == guest_id then
				redundant = true
				break
			end
		end

		if not redundant then
			char = self.customers_epic[guest_id]
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(string.format("Redundant epic customer %d", guest_id))
		end
	end

	-- 어떤 이유로든 캐릭터 리소스를 받아오지 못했다면 전환 실패
	if char == nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(string.format("Customer approach failed %d", guest_id))
		return false
	end

	self.table_states[table_index].state = self.table_state_approaching
	self.table_states[table_index].guest_id = guest_id
	self.table_states[table_index].approach_time = 0
	self.table_states[table_index].guest_character = char

	-- 손님 세팅
	char.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.remove_anim(char, true)
	character_util.set_anim(char, { name = "seat", loop = true })
	character_util.set_emotion(char, { name = "idle", loop = true })
	char.SpineController:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
	char.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.001)
	char.Position = self.table_states[table_index].position + self.customer_table_offset
	char:CancelShake()

	-- 손님 별 아이콘 세팅
	if rank == 0 then
		local pos = self.table_states[table_index].position + self.customer_table_offset
		local icon1 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(pos + vector(0.0, 1.5, 0))
		local item1 = icon1:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
		item1.ShadowActive = false
		item1.Item.localPosition = vector(0, 0.02, 0)
		item1:ResetTransforms()
		item1:SetItem("mall_silvercoin", 0.0125)
		item1.Item.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		item1.Item.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon1 = icon1
	elseif rank == 1 then
		local pos = self.table_states[table_index].position + self.customer_table_offset
		--local icon1 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(pos + vector(-0.132, 1.5, 0))
		local icon1 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(pos + vector(-0.15, 1.5, 0))
		local item1 = icon1:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
		item1.ShadowActive = false
		--item1:SetItem("coin", 0.011)
		item1.Item.localPosition = vector(0, 0.02, 0)
		item1:ResetTransforms()
		item1:SetItem("coin", 0.0125)
		item1.Item.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		item1.Item.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon1 = icon1

		--local icon2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(pos + vector(0.082, 1.5, 0))
		local icon2 = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(pos + vector(0.095, 1.5, 0))
		local item2 = icon2:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
		item2.ShadowActive = false
		--item2:SetItem("coin", 0.011)
		item2.Item.localPosition = vector(0, 0.02, 0)
		item2:ResetTransforms()
		item2:SetItem("coin", 0.012)
		item2.Item.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)
		item2.Item.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon2 = icon2
	else
		local pos = self.table_states[table_index].position + self.customer_table_offset

		return
	end

			self.table_states[i].ending_member_index = -1
		end

	self.table_states[table_index].state = self.table_state_therapy
	self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time = 0
	self.table_states[table_index].member_index = member_index
	self.table_states[table_index].member_struggling = false

	self.place_states[table_index - 1]:SetTherapyMode(constants.TherapyDuration - self.table_states[table_index].guest_therapy_time)

	character.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0.0001)

	if self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana <= 0 then
	else

		else

		self.table_states[table_index].guest_rank_icon2 = nil

function local_class:ending_to_empty(table_index)
	self.table_states[table_index].state = self.table_state_empty

	if self.table_states[table_index].guest_character ~= nil then
		local guest_id = self.table_states[table_index].guest_id
		if guest_id <= self.poor_customer_id_max then
			self.used_customers_poor:Remove(self.table_states[table_index].guest_character)
			self.customers_poor:Add(self.table_states[table_index].guest_character)
		elseif guest_id <= self.normal_customer_id_max then
			self.used_customers_normal:Remove(self.table_states[table_index].guest_character)
			self.customers_normal:Add(self.table_states[table_index].guest_character)
		end

		self.table_states[table_index].guest_character.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Table does not have a guest")
	end

	self.table_states[table_index].guest_id = -1
	self.table_states[table_index].guest_character = nil

	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].ending_member_index
	if member_index >= 0 then
		self.employees[self.running_members[member_index].Id].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	end
	self.table_states[table_index].ending_member_index = -1
end

-- 테이블 분위기 처리
-- 꿈 이펙트, 종업원 struggle 처리, 종업원 표정
function local_class:set_table_response(table_index, in_loop)
	local state = self.table_states[table_index].state
	local member_index = self.table_states[table_index].member_index
	local member_character = self.employees[self.running_members[member_index].Id]
	local guest_character = self.table_states[table_index].guest_character

	local match_level = self:get_match_level(table_index)
	if state == self.table_state_therapy then
		local exhausted = self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana <= 0
		local pos = self.table_states[table_index].position + self.customer_table_offset + vector(0, 0.85, 0)

		-- 이펙트 처리
		if match_level == 2 and not exhausted then
			if self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect == nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_dream_good"):Instantiate(pos)
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect = nil
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect = nil
			end
		elseif match_level == 1 and not exhausted then
			if self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect == nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_dream_normal"):Instantiate(pos)
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect = nil
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect = nil
			end
		else
			if self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect == nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("fx_succubus_cafe_dream_bad"):Instantiate(pos)
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect = nil
			end

			if self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect ~= nil then
				self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect:Dispose()
				self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect = nil
			end
		end


		local struggle_changed = false

		-- struggle 처리
		if self.table_states[table_index].member_struggling ~= exhausted then
			self.table_states[table_index].member_struggling = exhausted
			struggle_changed = true

			if exhausted then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_victim_scream_01')
				member_character:Shake(0.03, 10000)
			else
				member_character:CancelShake()
			end
		end

		-- 표정 처리
		if not in_loop or struggle_changed then
			if not exhausted then
				if match_level > 0 then
					character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "smile"})
					character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name ="smile" })
				else
					character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "tired"})
					character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "idle" })
				end
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "damaged"})
				character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "tired" })
			end
		end
	else
		-- 이펙트 처리
		if self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect ~= nil then
			self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect:Dispose()
			self.table_states[table_index].good_dream_effect = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect ~= nil then
			self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect:Dispose()
			self.table_states[table_index].normal_dream_effect = nil
		end

		if self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect ~= nil then
			self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect:Dispose()
			self.table_states[table_index].bad_dream_effect = nil
		end

		-- struggle 처리
		self.table_states[table_index].member_struggling = false
		member_character:CancelShake()

		-- 표정 처리
		if self.running_members[member_index].CurrentMana > 0 then
			if match_level > 0 then
				character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "smile"})
				character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name ="smile" })
			else
				character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "tired"})
				character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "idle" })
			end
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(member_character, { name = "damaged"})
			character_util.set_emotion(guest_character, { name = "tired" })
		end
	end
end



-- 정산 처리
function local_class:end_cafe(total_sales, cafe_levelup, employee_levelup)
	local result_state = CS.Oak.UI.CafeResultState()
	result_state.CafeTotalSales = self.cafe.total_sales
	result_state.Assets = self.cafe.assets
	result_state.SalesThisTime = total_sales
	result_state.Members = self.running_members
	result_state.CafeLevelUp = cafe_levelup
	result_state.EmployeeLevelUp = employee_levelup

	local wait_for_exit = true
	result_state.OnExit = function ()
		wait_for_exit = false
	end

	-- 정산창 내려오는 순간
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_ui_transition_02')
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CafeResult.Instance, result_state)

	while wait_for_exit do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0.5 })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	for i = 0, self.place_states.Count -1 do
		self.place_states[i].cachedGameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.place_states[i]:Clear()
		self.mana_bars[i]:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.running_members = nil

	self.cafe_open.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeEndEvent.Create(total_sales, false))

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	self:clear_cafe()
end

-- 저장 처리
function local_class:save(keep_waiting)
	local save_success = true
	local on_error = function (ex)
		save_success = false
	end

	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		save_success = true
		local r = CS.Oak.SuccubusCafeDataBridge.SaveGameAsync(self.cafe, nil, on_error)
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("SuccubusCafe : Save Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
end

-- 카페에 사용된 캐릭터들 제거
function local_class:clear_cafe()

	self.cafe_yuze.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.cafe_knight.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if self.customers_poor ~= nil then
		while self.used_customers_poor.Count > 0 do
			self.customers_poor:Add(self.used_customers_poor[0])
			self.used_customers_poor:RemoveAt(0)
		end

		while self.used_customers_normal.Count > 0 do
			self.customers_normal:Add(self.used_customers_normal[0])
			self.used_customers_normal:RemoveAt(0)
		end

		local constants = CS.Oak.SuccubusConstants.GetOrCreate()
		local pool_size = constants:GetMaxTableCount() + 1

		if self.customers_poor.Count ~= pool_size then
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(string.format("Wrong poor count %d", self.customers_poor.Count))
		end

		if self.customers_normal.Count ~= pool_size then
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError(string.format("Wrong normal count %d", self.customers_normal.Count))
		end

		for i = 0, self.customers_poor.Count -1 do
			self.customers_poor[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self.customers_normal[i].Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			self.customers_poor[i]:CancelShake()
			self.customers_normal[i]:CancelShake()
		end
	end

	if self.employees ~= nil then
		for key, value in pairs(self.employees) do
			value.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			value:CancelShake()
		end
	end

	if self.customers_epic ~= nil then
		for key, value in pairs(self.customers_epic) do
			value.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
			value:CancelShake()
		end
	end
end


function local_class:summon()
	ui_scene_manager:ShowWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject, true)

	local res = self.cafe:add_employee()
	if res == "succubus_cafe_not_enough_assets" then
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
		popup_state.NoticePopUp = true
		popup_state.Title = game_string:GetString("succubus_cafe_summon_title")
		popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString("succubus_cafe_not_enough_fund")
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, popup_state)
		ui_scene_manager:HideWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject)
		return
	elseif res == "succubus_cafe_out_of_employees" then
		wait_for_sec(0.25)
		local popup_state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
		popup_state.NoticePopUp = true
		popup_state.Title = game_string:GetString("succubus_cafe_summon_title")
		popup_state.Text = game_string:GetString("succubus_cafe_out_of_employees")

	self.cafe_knight.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right

	character_util.set_anim(self.cafe_knight, {name = 'question', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

		m.Condition = res.condition
		m.AssignedTable = -1
		m.CurrentSessionSales = 0
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	if need_pop then
		ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
	end

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.CafeMainMenu.Instance, self.menu_state)
	CS.Oak.UI.CafeMainMenu.Instance:UpdateAfterSummon(self.cafe.assets, m)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.3, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
end

function local_class:custom_show_emoticon_async(fo, type, duration)
	local emoticon_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('emoticon'):Instantiate(fo.Position)
	local emoticon = emoticon_pool.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.Emoticon))
	type = character_util.get_emoticon_type(type)

	emoticon:Init()
	emoticon:ShowOn(fo, unity_class.vector3.one, type)

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	emoticon:Hide()

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	emoticon:Dispose()
end

local local_class = newclass('SummerWaterShootingGame')

local enemy_base_state = newclass('SummerWaterShootingEnemyBaseState')

local enemy_state = {
	create = newclass('SummerWaterShootingEnemyCreateState', enemy_base_state),
	move = newclass('SummerWaterShootingEnemyMoveState', enemy_base_state),
	finish = newclass('SummerWaterShootingEnemyFinishState', enemy_base_state),
	dead = newclass('SummerWaterShootingEnemyDeadState', enemy_base_state),
}
function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

	-- game name
	self.game_name = 'SummerWaterShootingGame'

	-- data key
	self.constants_data_key = ''
	self.constants_data = nil

	-- 게임 진행도
	self.game_state = {
		none = 1,
		ready = 2,
		playing = 3,
		game_fail = 4,
		game_success = 5,
		game_end = 6,
		disposed = 7
	}

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none

	-- game 진행시간
	self.game_play_time = 0

	-- player 관련
	self.empty_battle_action_name = 'short_story_mm_mermaid_manual'

	self.player_info = nil

	self.player_state = {
		idle = 1,
		hold = 2,
		idle_damaged = 3,
		hold_damaged = 4,
	}

	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle

	-- 총알 관리용
	self.bullets = nil

	self.collision_type = {
		player = 1,
		enemy = 2
	}

	-- 물폭탄 관리용
	self.bombs = nil

	self.bomb_state = {
		idle = 1,
		hold = 2,
		reset = 4
	}

	-- wave 관리용
	self.waves = nil
	self.wave_index = 1

	-- enemy 관리용
	self.enemies_data = nil

	-- 적 도착 존 bound
	self.finish_zone_bound = nil

	-- 경계선
	self.out_line = nil

	-- 파티 저장용
	self.cached_party = nil

	-- fx
	self.fire_fx_name = nil
	self.proj_fx_name = nil
	self.hit_fx_name = nil

	self.get_fail_counter_ui = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIEventFailCounter')
	end

	-- 게임이 일시 정지중인지
	self.is_game_paused = false
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	self.constants_data = require('minigame/SummerWaterShootingGame/SummerWaterShootingGameConstants')[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	-- 웨이브 정보 세팅
	self.waves = {}

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.wave_info do
		local wave = self.constants_data.wave_info[i]
		local cur_wave = {
			time = wave.time,
			marker_number = wave.marker_number,
			enemy_type = wave.enemy_type,
		}

		table.insert(self.waves, cur_wave)
	end

	-- 적 목표 zone 세팅
	self.finish_zone_bound = field:GetZone(self.constants_data.finish_zone_name).Bounds

	-- fx 세팅
	self.fire_fx_name = self.constants_data.fire_fx_name
	self.proj_fx_name = self.constants_data.proj_fx_name
	self.hit_fx_name = self.constants_data.hit_fx_name

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
			self.fire_fx_name,
			self.proj_fx_name,
			self.hit_fx_name,
			'FieldUIEventFailCounter'
	)

	-- 실패 카운트 ui 세팅
	self:load_fail_count()

	-- 경계선 세팅
	local out_line_size = self.constants_data.outline.size
	self.out_line = get_field_object(self.constants_data.outline.name)
	self.out_line.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(out_line_size.x, out_line_size.y, out_line_size.z))

	-- 플레이어 기본 정보 세팅
	self.player_info = {
		shot_cool_time = 1,
		shot_cool_time_passed = 0,
		bullet_speed = 8,
		can_player_shot = true,
		life = 3,
		confused_time = 1,
		confused_time_passed = 0
	}

	-- 폭탄 세팅
	self:setting_bomb()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent), 'on_stage_end_event')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	self:remove_ui_fail_count()
	self:dispose_enemies_data()
	self:dispose_bullet()
	self:dispose_bomb()

	self.cached_party = nil
	self.player_info = nil
	self.wave_index = 1
	self.game_play_time = 0
	self.waves = nil
	self.finish_zone_bound = nil
	self.out_line = nil

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.none
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.disposed
end

--region on_event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	if self.player_info.can_player_shot and
			self.current_player_state == self.player_state.idle and
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action3TouchDown then
		self.player_info.can_player_shot = false
		self:player_shot()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.bombs do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.bombs[i].object) then
			self:bomb_explosion(i)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.bombs do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Holder, user_party.Leader) and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.bombs[i].object) then
			self.bombs[i].state = self.bomb_state.hold
			self.bombs[i].object.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotDamagedBehaviour()
			self.bombs[i].object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PotCrashBehaviour.Instance
			self.current_player_state = self.player_state.hold

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.IsComplete then
		-- 시간이 지나면 게임 클리어
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_success
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_end

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	self:remove_ui_fail_count()
	self:dispose_enemies_data()
	self:dispose_bullet()
	self:dispose_bomb()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	if self.bombs == nil then
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, #self.bombs do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bombs[i].object) then
			self.bombs[i].item.Position = self.bombs[i].object.Position + self.bombs[i].offset
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.playing then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		if e.Stick4WayDirection == character_util.get_direction('right') then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		elseif e.Stick4WayDirection == character_util.get_direction('left') then
			character_util.set_locked_dir(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(e)
	self.is_game_paused = true
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(e)
	self.is_game_paused = false
	self:show_game_ui()
	return true
end
--endregion

--- 게임 진입 세팅
function local_class:game_ready_setting()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 파티원 제외
	self.cached_party = {}
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local party_member = user_party[i]

		table.insert(self.cached_party, party_member)
		character_util.set_direction(party_member, 'down')
		character_util.convert_to_npc(party_member)
	end

	-- 리더 세팅
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.player_start_pos_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(leader, start_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, start_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, start_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(leader, leader.Direction)
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', self.constants_data.weapon_name)
	leader.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
	leader.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'rifle_walk'
	leader.CustomRunAnimationName = 'rifle_run'

	scene_util.set_anim(leader, self, 'rifle_idle')

	self.current_player_state = self.player_state.idle
	self.player_info.shot_cool_time_passed = 0
	self.player_info.shot_cool_time = self.constants_data.player_info.shot_cool_time
	self.player_info.bullet_speed = self.constants_data.player_info.bullet_speed
	self.player_info.can_player_shot = true
	self.player_info.life = self.constants_data.player_info.life
	self.player_info.confused_time_passed = 0

	-- 실패 UI 초기화
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)

	self.bullets = {}

	-- 폭탄 재배치
	self:reset_bomb()

	-- 적 npc 풀 세팅
	self:setting_enemy()

	-- 카메라 세팅
	local camera_size = self.constants_data.camera_size
	local camera_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.constants_data.camera_center_marker_name)

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(camera_size, 0)
	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0)

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.ready

	yield_return_func(leader.CharacterBehaviour.RefreshBattleActionsWithClass,
			leader.CharacterBehaviour, self.empty_battle_action_name)

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

--- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.playing

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({
		state = 'event', name = 'ondemand/short_story_mermaid/audio:bgm_mermaid_game' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({
		duration = self.constants_data.mini_game_time, handler = self, callback = 'on_timer_alarm_event' })

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)

	self:show_game_ui()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent), 'on_hold_up_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent), 'on_throw_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_move_field_object_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')

	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

--- 게임 종료 시 세팅
function local_class:game_end_setting()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))

	-- 파티 복원
	for i = #self.cached_party, 1, -1 do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.cached_party[i], user_party, true)
	end

	self.cached_party = nil

	-- 배틀 스타일 원복
	yield_return_func(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.RefreshBattleActions, user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour)

	--디폴트 무기 설정
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id > -1 then
		character_util.set_equipment(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
				user_party.Leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour.CharacterSpec.DefaultWeapon1Id)
	end

	character_util.reset_locked_dir(user_party.Leader)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self:dispose_enemies_data()

	-- 폭탄 재배치
	self:reset_bomb()

	self.shot_cool_time = 0
	self.wave_index = 1
	self.game_play_time = 0
end

--- 조작 UI Show
function local_class:show_game_ui()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton,
			user_party.Leader)

	self:show_fail_count()
end

--- 게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	while self.current_game_state == self.game_state.playing do
		local dt = self.is_game_paused and 0 or unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self.game_play_time = self.game_play_time + dt

		self:enemy_spawn_check()
		self:enemies_data_update(dt)
		self:check_cool_time(dt)
		self:bullet_update(dt)
		self:bomb_update(dt)
		self:player_state_update(dt)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.game_success or
			self.current_game_state == self.game_state.game_fail then
		self:game_end()
	end
end

--- 게임 종료
function local_class:game_end()
	self:dispose_bullet()
	self:hide_fail_count()
	self:enemies_all_stop()

	timer_util.end_timer(self)
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.game_fail then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, false))
	else
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
	end
end

--- 적 스폰 체크
function local_class:enemy_spawn_check()
	if self.wave_index > #self.waves then
		return
	end

	if self.waves[self.wave_index].time <= self.game_play_time then
		self:spawn_enemy(self.waves[self.wave_index].enemy_type, self.waves[self.wave_index].marker_number)
		self.wave_index = self.wave_index + 1
	end
end

--- states 업데이트
function local_class:enemies_data_update(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
		for j = 1, #self.enemies_data[i] do
			if self.enemies_data[i][j].state ~= nil then
				self.enemies_data[i][j].state:update(dt)
			end
		end
	end
end

--region Fail Count
function local_class:load_fail_count()
	local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_fail_counter_ui():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetCounter(3)
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)

	self:hide_fail_count()
end

--- 목숨 차감
function local_class:update_life_ui()
	if self.player_info.life <= 0 then
		return
	end

	self.player_info.life = self.player_info.life - 1

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(self.constants_data.player_info.life - self.player_info.life)

	if self.player_info.life <= 0 then
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.game_fail
	end
end

function local_class:hide_fail_count()
	self.ui_fail_counter.gameObject:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:show_fail_count()
	self.ui_fail_counter.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	-- 프리팹에 있는 ui offset y 값
	local fail_ui_y_pos = -210

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetCenterPosOfActiveCount(vector(0, fail_ui_y_pos),  CS.Oak.Direction.Up)
end

function local_class:remove_ui_fail_count()
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
end
