--region Player
function local_class:check_cool_time(dt)
	self.player_info.shot_cool_time_passed = self.player_info.shot_cool_time_passed + dt
	self.player_info.can_player_shot = self.player_info.shot_cool_time_passed >= self.player_info.shot_cool_time
end

function local_class:player_shot()
	scene_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', upper = true, count = 1 })
	self.player_info.shot_cool_time_passed = 0
	self:shot_bullet(user_party.Leader, self.collision_type.player, character_util.get_look_direction(user_party.Leader))
end

function local_class:player_state_update(dt)
	if self:check_bullet(user_party.Leader, self.collision_type.player) then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		self.current_player_state = self.current_player_state == self.player_state.idle and
				self.player_state.idle_damaged or self.player_state.hold_damaged

		scene_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, self, 'confused')
	end

	if self.current_player_state == self.player_state.idle_damaged or
			self.current_player_state == self.player_state.hold_damaged then
		self.player_info.confused_time_passed = self.player_info.confused_time_passed + dt

		if self.player_info.confused_time_passed >= self.player_info.confused_time then
			self.player_info.confused_time_passed = 0
			self.current_player_state = self.current_player_state == self.player_state.idle_damaged and
					self.player_state.idle or self.player_state.hold

			character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

			self:show_game_ui()
		end
	end
end
--endregion Player

--region Bullet
--- 총알 발사
function local_class:shot_bullet(target, collision_type, direction)
	local target_dir = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, target.Direction)
	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(target_dir)
	local fire_pos = target.Position + dir * 0.5 + vector(0, 0.4, 0)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fire_fx_name):Instantiate(fire_pos)

	--- 총알 정보
	---@param effect any 총알 pooled object
	---@param dir vector3 총알이 나가는 방향
	---@param speed number 총알 속도
	---@param life_time number 총알 유지 시간
	---@param hp number 총알 체력 (기본 총알은 관통을 하지 않기 위해 1로 설정)
	---@param bound any 총알 판정 범위
	---@param collision_type number 총알 타입(타입에 따라서 판정할 대상이 바뀜)
	local shot_info = {
		effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.proj_fx_name):Instantiate(fire_pos),
		dir = dir,
		speed = self.constants_data.player_info.bullet_speed,
		life_time = 2,
		hp = 1,
		bound =  CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(fire_pos, unity_class.vector3.one * 0.3),
		collision_type = collision_type
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stella_shoot_01')
	self:add_bullet(shot_info)
end

--- 총알 추가
function local_class:add_bullet(shot_info)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.playing then
		table.insert(self.bullets, shot_info)
	end
end

--- 총알 테이블 전체 제거
function local_class:dispose_bullet()
	if self.bullets == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.bullets do
		if self.bullets[i].effect ~= nil then
			self.bullets[i].effect:Dispose()
			self.bullets[i].effect = nil
		end

		self.bullets[i].bound = nil
		self.bullets[i] = nil
	end

	self.bullets = nil
end

--- 총알 업데이트
function local_class:bullet_update(dt)
	for i, bullet in ipairs(self.bullets) do
		-- 판정되어 hp가 0 이하이거나 life_time이 다 되었을 경우 제거
		if bullet.life_time <= 0 or bullet.hp <= 0 then
			if bullet.effect ~= nil then
				-- effect가 없는 경우는 총알에 피격된 경우
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stella_hit_01')

				bullet.effect:Dispose()
				bullet.effect = nil
			end

			bullet.bound = nil
			bullet = nil
			table.remove(self.bullets, i)
			break
		end

		-- 물폭탄일 경우 effect가 time limit 으로 동작하기 때문에 제외
		if bullet.effect ~= nil then
			local move_dir = bullet.dir * bullet.speed * dt
			local next_pos = bullet.effect.transform.localPosition + move_dir
			local rot = unity_class.quaternion.FromToRotation(unity_class.vector3.right, move_dir)

			bullet.effect.transform.localPosition = next_pos
			bullet.effect.transform.localRotation = rot
			bullet.bound.center = next_pos
		end

		bullet.life_time = bullet.life_time - dt
	end
end

--- 총알 충돌 체크
--- 판정되었을 경우 hp 1 차감
function local_class:check_bullet(target, collision_type)
	local bounds = target.Bounds

	for i, bullet in ipairs(self.bullets) do
		if collision_type ~= bullet.collision_type and
			bounds_util.is_overlapping_xz(bounds, bullet.bound) then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_fx_name):Instantiate(bullet.bound.center)
			bullet.hp = bullet.hp - 1
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion Bullet

--region Bomb
--- 폭탄 세팅
function local_class:setting_bomb()
	self.bombs = {}
	local bomb_info = self.constants_data.water_bomb_info

	for i = 1, #bomb_info do
		local object = get_field_object(bomb_info[i].handle_name)

		object.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
		object.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

		-- 폭탄과 경계선끼리 충돌 제외
		local field_object_pair = CS.Oak.FieldObjectPair(object, self.out_line)
		field:AddIgnoreCrash(field_object_pair)

		--- bomb 생성
		---@param object any wall object
		---@param state number 폭탄 상태
		---@param item any 물풍선 아이템 스프라이트
		---@param bomb_fx_name string 물풍선 폭발 pool 이름
		---@param bomb_cool_time number 폭탄 쿨타임
		---@param bomb_cool_time_passed number 폭탄 쿨타임 체크용
		---@param reset_pos vector3 폭탄 리셋 위치
		---@param explosion_offsets table vector3 fx가 발생할 위치 오프셋 해당 개수만큼 fx 생성
		---@param explosion_delays table number fx간격 딜레이
		---@param hit_box table vector3 판정 박스
		local bomb = {
			object = object,
			bomb_npc = get_character(bomb_info[i].npc_name),
			state = self.bomb_state.idle,
			item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = object.Position,
				itemid = bomb_info[i].item_id,
				notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'
			}),
			offset = vector(bomb_info[i].offset.x, bomb_info[i].offset.y, bomb_info[i].offset.z),
			bomb_fx_name = bomb_info[i].bomb_fx_name,
			bomb_cool_time = bomb_info[i].bomb_cool_time,
			bomb_cool_time_passed = 0,
			reset_pos = object.Position,
			explosions_info = {},
			explosion_delays = {},
			explosion_offsets = {},
			hit_box = {},
		}

		for j = 1, #bomb_info[i].explosion_info do
			local explosion_offset = bomb_info[i].explosion_info[j].offset
			local explosion_info = {
				delay = bomb_info[i].explosion_info[j].delay,
				offset = vector(explosion_offset.x, explosion_offset.y, explosion_offset.z),
				sfx = bomb_info[i].explosion_info[j].sfx
			}

			table.insert(bomb.explosions_info, explosion_info)
		end

		for j = 1, #bomb_info[i].hit_box do
			local hit_box_size = bomb_info[i].hit_box[j]
			table.insert(bomb.hit_box, vector(hit_box_size.x, hit_box_size.y, hit_box_size.z))
		end

		-- 파괴 시에 회복 구슬 DropOrb가 떨어지지 않도록 추가
		stage.DropManager:AddToNoDrop(bomb.object)

		bomb.item:SetSortingLayer(true)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(bomb.bomb_fx_name)

		table.insert(self.bombs, bomb)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_bomb()
	for i = 1, #self.bombs do
		self.bombs[i].object.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		self.bombs[i].object.Position = self.bombs[i].reset_pos
		self.bombs[i].item.Position = self.bombs[i].reset_pos
		self.bombs[i].item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		self.bombs[i].item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time_passed = 0
		self.bombs[i].state = self.bomb_state.idle
		self.bombs[i].object.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
		self.bombs[i].object.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		scene_util.set_anim(self.bombs[i].bomb_npc, self, 'idle')
	end
end

--- 폭탄 업데이트
function local_class:bomb_update(dt)
	for i = 1, #self.bombs do
		--- 폭탄이 리셋중이라면
		if self.bombs[i].state == self.bomb_state.reset then
			self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time_passed = self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time_passed + dt

			if self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time_passed >= self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time then
				self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time_passed = 0
				self.bombs[i].state = self.bomb_state.idle
				self.bombs[i].object.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.HoldableObjectBehaviour()
				self.bombs[i].object.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
				scene_util.set_anim(self.bombs[i].bomb_npc, self, 'idle')
			else
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time_passed / self.bombs[i].bomb_cool_time)

				self.bombs[i].item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
				self.bombs[i].item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * progress
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:bomb_explosion(index)
	local bomb = self.bombs[index]

	bomb.state = self.bomb_state.reset
	scene_util.set_anim(bomb.bomb_npc, self, 'eat')

	bomb.object.FieldObjectBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullFieldObjectBehaviour.Instance
	bomb.object.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	bomb.object.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullCrashBehaviour.Instance
	bomb.object.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	-- 폭탄 생성
	-- hp를 수치를 높게 설정하여 life_time 시간 동안 적을 계속 판정할 수 있도록 처리
	local add_hit_box = function(size, position)
		local shot_info = {
			effect = nil,
			dir = vector(0, 0, 0),
			speed = 0,
			life_time = 0.4,
			hp = 100,
			bound =  CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(position, size),
			collision_type = self.collision_type.player
		}

		self:add_bullet(shot_info)
	end

	-- 물폭탄 연쇄 폭발 처리
	start_coroutine(function()
		local start_pos = bomb.object.Position

		for i = 1, #bomb.explosions_info do
			local bomb_pos = start_pos + bomb.explosions_info[i].offset

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(bomb.bomb_fx_name):Instantiate(bomb_pos)

			for j = 1, #bomb.hit_box do
				add_hit_box(bomb.hit_box[j], bomb_pos)
			end

			if bomb.explosions_info[i].sfx ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(bomb.explosions_info[i].sfx)
			end

			wait_for_sec(bomb.explosions_info[i].delay)
		end
	end)

	bomb.object.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	bomb.object.Position = bomb.reset_pos

	bomb.item.SpriteTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	bomb.item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
end

function local_class:dispose_bomb()
	if self.bombs == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.bombs do
		self.bombs[i].item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.bombs[i].explosions_info = nil
		self.bombs[i].explosion_delays = nil
		self.bombs[i].explosion_offsets = nil
		self.bombs[i].hit_box = nil
		self.bombs[i] = nil
	end

	self.bombs = nil
end
--endregion Bomb

--region Enemy
--- enemy 풀 세팅
function local_class:setting_enemy()
	self.enemies_data = {}
	local enemy_info = self.constants_data.enemy_info
	local npcs = character_manager:GetAllNpcs()

	for i = 0, npcs.Count - 1 do
		local npc = npcs[i]

		for j = 1, #enemy_info do
			if self.enemies_data[j] == nil then
				self.enemies_data[j] = {}
			end

			if string.match(npc.Name, enemy_info[j].enemy_name) then
				-- 적 정보 세팅
				-- npc 적 npc
				-- active 활성화 상태
				-- state 담을 state
				-- enemy_type 적 타입 index
				-- move speed 적 이동 속도
				-- can attack 적 공격 가능 여부
				-- marker name 적 시작 마커 이름
				-- hit_sfx 피격 사운드
				-- appear_sfx 등장 사운드
				local cur_enemy_info = {
					npc = npc,
					active = false,
					state = nil,
					enemy_type = j,
					move_speed = enemy_info[j].move_speed,
					can_attack = enemy_info[j].can_attack,
					shot_time = enemy_info[j].shot_time,
					marker_name = nil,
					hit_sfx = enemy_info[j].hit_sfx,
					appear_sfx = enemy_info[j].appear_sfx
				}

				-- 총알 발사 가능 npc 세팅
				if cur_enemy_info.can_attack then
					character_util.spine_set_attachment(npc, '[base]weapon1', self.constants_data.weapon_name)
					npc.CustomIdleAnimationName = 'rifle_idle'
					npc.CustomWalkAnimationName = 'rifle_walk'
					npc.CustomRunAnimationName = 'rifle_run'
				end

				field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(cur_enemy_info.npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

				table.insert(self.enemies_data[j], cur_enemy_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 적 생성
---@param enemy_type number 적 타입 index
---@param marker_number number 적이 위치할 마커 번호
function local_class:spawn_enemy(enemy_type, marker_number)
	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data[enemy_type] do
		if self.enemies_data[enemy_type][i].active then
			goto continue
		end

		self.enemies_data[enemy_type][i].active = true
		self.enemies_data[enemy_type][i].marker_name = self.constants_data.spawn_marker_info.marker_name .. marker_number

		self:change_enemy_state(enemy_state.create(self, enemy_type, i))
		break

		:: continue ::
	end
end

--- 적 npc 전체 멈춤
function local_class:enemies_all_stop()
	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
		for j = 1, #self.enemies_data[i] do
			if self.enemies_data[i][j].active then
				character_util.stop(self.enemies_data[i][j].npc)
			end
		end
	end
end
--endregion Enemy

--region State
--- state 변경
function local_class:change_enemy_state(change_state)
	local enemy_type = change_state.type
	local state_index = change_state.index
	local current_state = self.enemies_data[enemy_type][state_index].state

	if current_state ~= nil then
		current_state:exit()
		current_state:dispose()
	end

	self.enemies_data[enemy_type][state_index].state = change_state
	self.enemies_data[enemy_type][state_index].state:enter()
end

--- 적 state 비 활성화
function local_class:dispose_enemy_state(type, index)
	self.enemies_data[type][index].active = false
	self.enemies_data[type][index].state:exit()
	self.enemies_data[type][index].state:dispose()
	self.enemies_data[type][index].state = nil
end

--- 게임 종료 시 enemies_data dispose용
function local_class:dispose_enemies_data()
	if self.enemies_data == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.enemies_data do
		for j = 1, #self.enemies_data[i] do
			if self.enemies_data[i][j].state ~= nil then
				character_util.set_position(self.enemies_data[i][j].npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
				self.enemies_data[i][j].state:exit()
				self.enemies_data[i][j].state:dispose()
				self.enemies_data[i][j].state = nil
			end
		end
	end

	self.enemies_data = nil
end
--endregion State

--region Base State
function enemy_base_state:init(controller, type, index)
	self.controller = controller
	self.type = type
	self.index = index
	self.enemy_info = controller.enemies_data[type][index]
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function enemy_base_state:dispose()
	self.type = nil
	self.index = nil
	self.enemy_info = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function enemy_base_state:enter()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function enemy_base_state:exit()
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function enemy_base_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion Base State

--region Create State
function enemy_state.create:init(controller, type, index)
	self.super:init(controller, type, index)
	self.alpha_fade_time = 0.5
end

function enemy_state.create:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()
end

function enemy_state.create:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	-- 이펙트 없는 부활 처리
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.isRevive = true
	heal_info.skipEffect = true
	heal_info.sender = self.enemy_info.npc
	heal_info.target = self.enemy_info.npc

	command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.enemy_info.npc, 0, 0)
	self.enemy_info.npc.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)

	-- 위치 설정
	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.enemy_info.marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(self.enemy_info.npc, marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.enemy_info.npc, marker.direction)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.enemy_info.npc, 'enabled')

	-- 알파 페이드 아웃 처리
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.enemy_info.npc, 1, self.alpha_fade_time)

	if self.enemy_info.appear_sfx ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.enemy_info.appear_sfx)
	end
end

function enemy_state.create:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function enemy_state.create:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed >= self.alpha_fade_time then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(enemy_state.move(self.controller, self.type, self.index))
	end
end
--endregion Create State

--region Move State
function enemy_state.move:init(controller, type, index)
	self.super:init(controller, type, index)

	self.finish_zone_bound = controller.finish_zone_bound
	self.can_shot = self.enemy_info.can_attack

	self.shot_time_passed = 0
end

function enemy_state.move:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.can_shot = nil
	self.shot_time_passed = nil
	self.finish_zone_bound = nil
end

function enemy_state.move:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	local enemy_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.enemy_info.npc.Direction)
	local move_distance = 20
	local move_pos = self.enemy_info.npc.Position + enemy_dir * move_distance

	wp_util.move(self.enemy_info.npc, move_pos, self.enemy_info.move_speed)
end

function enemy_state.move:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	character_util.stop(self.enemy_info.npc)
end

function enemy_state.move:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.controller:check_bullet(self.enemy_info.npc, self.controller.collision_type.enemy) then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(enemy_state.dead(self.controller, self.type, self.index))
		return
	end

	self:check_shot(dt)

	if self:check_zone_bound() then
		self.controller:change_enemy_state(enemy_state.finish(self.controller, self.type, self.index))
		return
	end
end

--- 적이 도착 지점에 도달했는지 체크 (x값으로만 비교로 간소화)
function enemy_state.move:check_zone_bound()
	return self.finish_zone_bound.max.x > self.enemy_info.npc.Position.x
end

--- 총알 발사가 가능한 적 체크 및 발사 함수
function enemy_state.move:check_shot(dt)
	if not self.can_shot then
		return
	end

	self.shot_time_passed = self.shot_time_passed + dt

	if self.shot_time_passed >= self.enemy_info.shot_time then
		self.can_shot = false

		scene_util.set_anim(self.enemy_info.npc, self, { name = 'rifle_shoot', upper = true, count = 1 })
		self.controller:shot_bullet(self.enemy_info.npc, self.controller.collision_type.enemy)
	end
end
--endregion Move State

--endregion Finish State
function enemy_state.finish:init(controller, type, index)
	self.super:init(controller, type, index)

	self.alpha_fade_time = 0.5
end

function enemy_state.finish:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.alpha_fade_time = nil
end

function enemy_state.finish:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	local enemy_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(self.enemy_info.npc.Direction)
	local move_distance = 5
	local move_pos = self.enemy_info.npc.Position + enemy_dir * move_distance

	wp_util.move(self.enemy_info.npc, move_pos, self.enemy_info.move_speed)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.enemy_info.npc, 0, self.alpha_fade_time)

	self.controller:update_life_ui()
end

function enemy_state.finish:exit()
	self.super:exit()

	character_util.stop(self.enemy_info.npc)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.enemy_info.npc, 'disabled')
end

function enemy_state.finish:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed >= self.alpha_fade_time then
		self.controller:dispose_enemy_state(self.type, self.index)
	end
end
--region Finish State

--region Dead State
function enemy_state.dead:init(controller, type, index)
	self.super:init(controller, type, index)

	self.air_spin_time = 2
end

function enemy_state.dead:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.air_spin_time = nil
end

function enemy_state.dead:enter()
	self.super:enter()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.enemy_info.hit_sfx)
	character_util.air_spin(self.enemy_info.npc, { offset = vector(1, 0, 1), speed = 1.5, stay_time = 0.3 })
end

function enemy_state.dead:exit()
	self.super:exit()
end

function enemy_state.dead:update(dt)
	self.super:update(dt)

	if self.time_passed >= self.air_spin_time then
		self.controller:dispose_enemy_state(self.type, self.index)
	end
end
--endregion Dead State

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

sgw_constants_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsConstantsManager')
sgw_tile_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsTileManager')
sgw_skill_direct = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsSkillDirect')

local local_class = newclass('SuperGuardianWars')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'super_guardian_wars'

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	-- 추후 다른 입장 케이스가 필요한 경우 처리용
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 타일 갯수
	self.tile_x_count = 0
	self.tile_z_count = 0

	-- 타일 한 칸당 사이즈
	self.tile_x_size = 0
	self.tile_z_size = 0

	-- 현재 선택된 타일의 Index
	self.select_tile_index = -1

	-- 이전 타일의 Index
	self.pre_tile_index = -1

	self.selected_character = nil

	-- waiting : 아무 것도 안하는 상태
	-- show_action : 액션 팝업창 떠 있을 때
	-- move : 이동 선택 중인 상태
	-- show_skill_menu : 스킬 팝업창 떠 있을 때
	-- target_select : 스킬 타겟 확인 세팅할 때
	-- attack : 공격 중 일 때
	-- show_status : 상태 팝업창 떠 있을 때
	-- turn_end : 턴 종료 일 때
	self.game_state = { waiting = 0, show_action = 1, move = 2, show_skill_menu = 3, target_select = 4,
	                    attack = 5, show_status = 6, turn_end = 7,
	                    enemy_state_start = 21, enemy_move = 22, enemy_attack = 23, enemy_turn = 24 }
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.waiting
	self.camera = nil
	self.ally = {}
	self.enemy = {}
	self.star_piece = {}
	self.object_name_map = {}
	self.selected_skill_id = -1
	self.selected_target = nil

	-- 미니게임 진행 중에 있는지?
	self.is_play_mini_game = false

	-- 조작(터치 or 패드 조작)을 막을 것인가?
	self.is_control_block = false

	-- 카메라 이동 스피드
	self.camera_speed = 4

	-- 카메라 최소 줌 사이즈
	self.camera_zoom_min = 3

	-- 터치 딜레이
	self.is_touch_delay = false

	-- 활성화 유닛 표시용
	self.active_frame = nil

	-- 커스텀 아틀라스
	self.custom_atlas = nil

	-- 전투 종료 타입
	self.battle_end_type = 'all_kill'

	-- 캐릭터 로드할 때 표시되는 이펙트 리스트
	self.character_load_effect_list = {}

	-- 터치 Block 시간 체크용 코루틴 Index
	self.current_touch_coroutine_index = 0

	-- 터치 Block 시간(더블 탭 방지)
	self.touch_block_time = 0.5

	-- 터치 다운 좌표
	self.touch_down_pos = vector(0, 0)

	-- UI를 닫았는지
	self.ui_close = false

	-- 패드용) 마커 아이콘
	self.pad_marker_icon = nil

	-- 퇴각 다이얼로그가 나오고 있는가?
	self.is_show_retreat_dialog = false

	-- 패드용) 현재 위치 index
	self.current_marker_index = -1

	-- 이펙트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_dead_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead') end
	self.get_blink_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blink') end
	self.get_star_piece_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character') end

	-- 적의 스킬 데이터용
	self.enemy_target_data = nil

	-- 현재 재생중인 Bgm 이름
	self.current_play_bgm_name = nil

	self:set_game_direct_fine_tuning_value()
	self:set_enemy_routine_fine_tuning_value()

	-- 아군 턴 시작 UI
	self.player_phase_ui = nil
	-- 적군 턴 시작 UI
	self.enemy_phase_ui = nil

	-- 타겟 에임 스프라이트
	self.aim_sprite = nil
end

-- 게임 연출 세부 조정 값 세팅
function local_class:set_game_direct_fine_tuning_value()
	-- 페이드 시간
	self.skill_direct_fade_time = 0.4

	-- 에임 이동하는 속도
	self.aim_speed = 12
end

-- 적 행동 세부 조정 값 세팅
function local_class:set_enemy_routine_fine_tuning_value()
	-- 적이 선택된 후 행동을 하기 전 딜레이 시간
	self.enemy_move_delay_time = 0.1

	-- 적의 위치로 카메라가 이동 후에 활성화 UI가 켜지는 딜레이 시간
	self.enemy_show_active_ui_delay_time = 0.1

	-- 적의 활성화 UI가 표시된 후 이동 or 공격하기 전 딜레이 시간
	self.enemy_active_delay_time = 0.05

	-- 적의 이동 범위가 표시 되는 시간, 해당 시간 만큼 이동 범위를 보여준 뒤 이동 한다.
	self.enemy_move_range_active_time = 0.3

	-- 적이 이동 완료 후에 딜레이 시간
	self.enemy_move_end_delay_time = 0.3
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	sgw_constants_manager.set_constants_data_key(self.constants_data_key)

	local constants_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_constants_data()
	self.camera_speed = constants_data.camera_speed
	self.camera_zoom_min = constants_data.camera_zoom_min
	self.is_using_pad = false

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_mini_game_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOnEvent), 'on_chat_mode_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOffEvent), 'on_chat_mode_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.OptionOnEvent), 'on_option_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.OptionOffEvent), 'on_option_off_event')

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	yield_return_func(sgw_tile_manager.create_tile, self)
	yield_return_func(sgw_skill_direct.load_resource, self)

	if is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	-- FIXME: SuperGuardianWarsDialog 쪽에 ignoreLanguages랑 맞춰야 할 것 같은데...
	-- Phase UI 에서 레트로 풍 폰트가 사용 불가능한 언어권 리스트
	-- 중국어, 일본어, 태국어, 러시아어
	local retro_font_ignore_languages = { 'jaJP', 'zhCN', 'thTH', 'ruRU' }

	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'SuperGuardianWarsOurPhase'), function(p)
		self.player_phase_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		self.player_phase_ui:SetActive(false)

		local is_retro_font_ignore_language = false
		for i = 1, #retro_font_ignore_languages do
			local ignore_language = retro_font_ignore_languages[i]

			if CS.GameStrings.Instance.MainLanguage == ignore_language then
				is_retro_font_ignore_language = true
				break
			end
		end

		local label = self.player_phase_ui.transform:Find('PhaseLabel')
		local label_retro = self.player_phase_ui.transform:Find('PhaseLabelRetro')

		label.gameObject:SetActive(is_retro_font_ignore_language)
		label_retro.gameObject:SetActive(not is_retro_font_ignore_language)
	end))

	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'SuperGuardianWarsEnemyPhase'), function(p)
		self.enemy_phase_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		self.enemy_phase_ui:SetActive(false)

		local is_retro_font_ignore_language = false
		for i = 1, #retro_font_ignore_languages do
			local ignore_language = retro_font_ignore_languages[i]

			if CS.GameStrings.Instance.MainLanguage == ignore_language then
				is_retro_font_ignore_language = true
				break
			end
		end

		local label = self.enemy_phase_ui.transform:Find('PhaseLabel')
		local label_retro = self.enemy_phase_ui.transform:Find('PhaseLabelRetro')

		label.gameObject:SetActive(is_retro_font_ignore_language)
		label_retro.gameObject:SetActive(not is_retro_font_ignore_language)
	end))

	self.camera = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(sgw_tile_manager.get_background().transform, 'Camera'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	self.camera_offset = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(sgw_tile_manager.get_background().transform, 'offset')

	self.get_dead_effect()
	self.get_blink_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self:load_custom_atlas()

	--self:change_current_bgm(sgw_constants_manager.get_bgm_name(), 0)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.OptionOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.OptionOffEvent))

	-- 패드 사용중이라면 GamepadEvent을 아니라면 TouchEvent를 구독 해지
	if self.is_using_pad then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	else
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	self:clear_all_characters()
	self:clear_star_piece()

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.waiting
	self.selected_skill_id = -1
	self.selected_target = nil
	self.camera = nil
	self.camera_offset = nil
	self.selected_character = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
	self.select_tile_index = -1
	self.is_play_mini_game = false
	self.arrow_directions = nil
	self.enemy_target_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	self:dispose_res_holder()
	self:dispose_active_frame()
	self:dispose_marker_icon()

	if not is_unity_null(self.player_phase_ui) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.player_phase_ui)
		self.player_phase_ui = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.enemy_phase_ui) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.enemy_phase_ui)
		self.enemy_phase_ui = nil
	end

	sgw_tile_manager.dispose()

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- Resource Holder Dispose
function local_class:dispose_res_holder()
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		return
	end

	self.res_holder:Dispose()
	self.res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_active_frame()
	if self.active_frame == nil then
		return
	end

	self.active_frame:Dispose()
	self.active_frame = nil
end

function local_class:dispose_marker_icon()
	if self.pad_marker_icon == nil then
		return
	end

	self.pad_marker_icon:Dispose()
	self.pad_marker_icon = nil
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 게임 끝날 때 받아오는 이벤트
function local_class:on_mini_game_end_event(_)
	self.is_play_mini_game = false
	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(_)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return
	end

	self:set_control_block(true)
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(_)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	if self:is_ally_turn() == false then
		return
	end

	self:set_control_block(false)
end

function local_class:on_chat_mode_on_event(e)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return false
	end

	self:set_control_block(true)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_chat_mode_off_event(e)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	if self:is_ally_turn() == false then
		return false
	end

	self:set_control_block(false)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_option_on_event(e)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return false
	end

	self:set_control_block(true)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_option_off_event(e)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return false
	end

	if self:is_ally_turn() == false then
		return false
	end

	self:set_control_block(false)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if not self.is_play_mini_game then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		self.touch_down_pos = e.TouchPos
		if self.is_show_retreat_dialog then
			if sgw_skill_direct.get_is_typing() then
				sgw_skill_direct.skip_retreat_dialog()
				return true
			end
			self.is_show_retreat_dialog = false
			sgw_skill_direct.hide_retreat_dialog()
		end
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchUp then
		if self.is_control_block or self.is_touch_delay then
			return false
		end

		if self.ui_close then
			self.ui_close = false
			self.touch_down_pos = unity_class.vector2.zero
			return false
		end

		local swipeDistPixel = 30
		local swipeDistInch = 0.04
		local swipeDist = swipeDistPixel
		if CS.UnityEngine.Screen.dpi > 50 and CS.UnityEngine.Screen.dpi < 1000 then
			swipeDist = swipeDistInch * CS.UnityEngine.Screen.dpi
		end

		local diff = e.TouchPos - self.touch_down_pos
		local diff_x = math.abs(diff.x)
		local diff_y = math.abs(diff.y)
		if diff_x < swipeDist and diff_y < swipeDist then
			self.current_touch_coroutine_index = self.current_touch_coroutine_index + 1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.set_touch_delay, self))
			self:run_state(e.TouchPos)
		end

		self.touch_down_pos = unity_class.vector2.zero
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:set_touch_delay()
	self.is_touch_delay = true

	local current_time = 0
	local touch_coroutine_index = self.current_touch_coroutine_index
	while current_time >= self.touch_block_time do
		if touch_coroutine_index ~= self.current_touch_coroutine_index then
			return
		end

		current_time = current_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_touch_delay = false
end

function local_class:run_state(pos)
	local convert_pos = self.camera.Cam:ScreenToWorldPoint(vector(pos.x, pos.y, 0))
	local correction_z = -0.6
	local touch_pos = vector(convert_pos.x, 0, convert_pos.z + convert_pos.y + correction_z)
	-- 터치영역 보정 테스트용 코드. 카메라가 수정되면 보정 값 수정해서 이거 키고 테스트 해보면 됨
	--print('[SGW] TouchPos[' .. touch_pos:ToString() .. ']. TileIndex[' .. sgw_tile_manager.get_collide_tile_index(touch_pos) .. '], TileCenter[' .. sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_pos(touch_pos).center:ToString() .. ']')

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.waiting then
		local select_tile_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_collide_tile_index(touch_pos)
		local select_character = sgw_tile_manager.get_character(select_tile_index)
		if select_character == nil then
			ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
			self:clear_selected_character()
			return false
		end

		-- 다른캐릭터 선택중에 해당 상태를 탄다면 선택을 초기화 시켜준다.
		if self.selected_character ~= nil and select_character ~= self.selected_character then
			self.pre_tile_index = -1
			self:clear_selected_character()
			self:clear_select_target_data()
			return false
		end

		self:wait_state_logic(select_tile_index, select_character)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.show_action or self.current_game_state == self.game_state.show_status then
		if CS.UICamera.Raycast(vector(pos.x, pos.y, 0)) then
			return false
		end
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.move then
		local select_tile_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_collide_tile_index(touch_pos)

		self:move_state_logic(select_tile_index)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.attack then
		local selected_target = sgw_tile_manager.get_character_by_pos(touch_pos)
		local select_tile_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_collide_tile_index(touch_pos)

		self:attack_state_logic(selected_target, select_tile_index)
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if self.is_control_block or not self.is_using_pad then
		return false
	end

	-- 1. 4방향 터치 체크
	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadUpButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickUpButtonDown then
		self:set_next_index_and_move_marker(self.arrow_directions.up)
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadDownButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickDownButtonDown then
		self:set_next_index_and_move_marker(self.arrow_directions.down)
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
		self:set_next_index_and_move_marker(self.arrow_directions.right)
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then
		self:set_next_index_and_move_marker(self.arrow_directions.left)
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.AButtonDown then
		self:select_tile_pad()
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.BButtonDown then
		self:cancel_action_pad()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 패드 사용 시 이동할 위치에 따라 다음 이동할 인덱스를 구해주고 이동 함수를 호출
function local_class:set_next_index_and_move_marker(direction)
	if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.waiting
			and self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.move
			and self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.attack then
		return
	end

	local move_grid_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().move_grid_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(move_grid_sfx_name)

	local next_index
	if direction == self.arrow_directions.up then
		next_index = self.current_marker_index + 1
		if not sgw_tile_manager.is_equal_floor_tile(self.current_marker_index, next_index) then
			return
		end

		self:move_marker_logic(next_index)
	elseif direction == self.arrow_directions.down then
		next_index = self.current_marker_index - 1
		if not sgw_tile_manager.is_equal_floor_tile(self.current_marker_index, next_index) then
			return
		end

		self:move_marker_logic(next_index)
	elseif direction == self.arrow_directions.right then
		next_index = self.current_marker_index - sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_x_count()
		self:move_marker_logic(next_index)
	elseif direction == self.arrow_directions.left then
		next_index = self.current_marker_index + sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_x_count()
		self:move_marker_logic(next_index)
	end
end

-- 패드 사용 시 이동 시켜주는 함수
function local_class:move_marker_logic(index)
	local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info(index)
	if tile_info == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 위치 화살표 이동
	self.current_marker_index = index
	self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(tile_info.center)
	self:set_pos_or_create_marker_icon(tile_info.center)

	-- 카메라 이동
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_move_end_target_tile,
			self, tile_info.center, self.camera_zoom_min, self.camera_speed, false, false))
end

-- 현재 화살표 좌표에 캐릭터가 있다면 action_popup 호출해준다.
function local_class:select_tile_pad()
	local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info(self.current_marker_index)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.waiting then
		-- waiting 상태일 때 캐릭터가 없다면 리턴
		if tile_info.object == nil then
			return
		end
		self:wait_state_logic(self.current_marker_index, tile_info.object)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.move then
		self:move_state_logic(self.current_marker_index)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.attack then
		self:attack_state_logic(tile_info.object, self.current_marker_index)
	end
end

-- 패드에서 취소 버튼을 눌렀을 때 현재 상태에서 뒤로 돌아가는 형태로 개발필요
function local_class:cancel_action_pad()
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.move or
			self.current_game_state == self.game_state.attack then
		sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'Move' then
		self:enable_touch_block_when_ally_turn()
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.move)
		ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
		self.ui_close = true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'TurnEnd' then
		self.pre_tile_index = -1
		local is_ally = self:is_ally_turn()

		if is_ally then
			-- 아군 턴종료 로직
			self:ally_turn_end()
		else
			-- 적군 턴종료 루틴
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enemy_turn_end_routine, self))
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'ShowSkillPop' then
		local state = CS.Oak.UI.SGWSkillPopupState()
		local skill_ids = self.selected_character:get_skill_ids()
		state.CurrentCost = self.selected_character.energy
		for i = 1, #skill_ids do
			local skill_id = skill_ids[i]
			local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(skill_id)
			--TODO: 일단 아직은 타입이 두개라 굳이 enum값으로 보내기 애매해서 bool 값으로 확인 중, 스킬 타입 늘어날 경우 수정 필요.
			local is_heal_type_skill = skill_data.type == 'heal'
			local skill_popup_data = CS.Oak.UI.SGWSkillPopupState.MakeData(skill_id, skill_data.skill_name, skill_data.attack, skill_data.energy,
					skill_data.range, self:available_skill(self.selected_character, skill_id), is_heal_type_skill)
			state.SkillPopupDatas:Add(skill_popup_data)
		end
		ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
		CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsSkillPopup.Instance, state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsSkillPopup))
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'Attack' then
		self:enable_touch_block_when_ally_turn()
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.attack)
		self.selected_skill_id = tonumber(e:GetParamAt(1))

		local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(self.selected_skill_id)
		if skill_data.type == 'attack' then
			sgw_tile_manager.show_attack_tile(self.selected_character, skill_data.range)
		elseif skill_data.type == 'heal' then
			sgw_tile_manager.show_heal_tile(self.selected_character, skill_data.range)
		end

		self.ui_close = true
		ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'move_end' then
		if self:is_ally_turn() then
			self:change_game_state(self.game_state.show_action)
		else
			sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()
			-- 적 타겟 데이터가 없으면 block 있으면 공격
			if self.enemy_target_data == nil then
				self:play_block()
			else
				self.selected_target = self.enemy_target_data.target
				self.selected_skill_id = self.enemy_target_data.skill_data.id
				self.enemy_target_data = nil
				self:change_game_state(self.game_state.enemy_attack)
			end
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'Cancel' then
		self:aim_dispose()
		self:set_active_field_ui(true)
		ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
		if self.is_using_pad then
			self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
			return
		end

		self:set_control_block(false)
		if (self.selected_character ~= nil and self.pre_tile_index > 0) then
			self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
		else
			self:dispose_active_frame()
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'Block' then
		self:play_block()
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'BattleStart' then
		self:play_skill()
	end
end

function local_class:ally_turn_end()
	local current_pos
	if self.selected_target ~= nil or self.selected_character ~= nil then
		current_pos = self.selected_target ~= nil
				and self.selected_target:get_position() or self.selected_character:get_position()
	end
	self:enable_touch_block_when_ally_turn()

	-- 타겟 사망확인
	if self.selected_target ~= nil and self.selected_target:is_dead() then
		self:selected_target_dead(true)
	end

	-- 선택된 캐릭터 턴 종료
	self.selected_character:turn_end()

	-- 스타피스 체크
	self:check_star_piece()

	-- 턴 종료 상태로 변경 및 selected 정보 clear
	self:clear_select_target_data()
	self:clear_selected_character()

	-- 게임 종료 체크
	if self:check_game_end() then
		-- 전투가 끝난 뒤, 아군 캐릭터 활성화
		-- FIXME: 적군을 잡고 이겼을 때만 활성화 해야 하나? 패배 했을 땐 어떻게 되지?
		-- 추후 확인 필요함
		for i = #self.ally, 1, -1 do
			local character = self.ally[i]
			character:reset_state()
		end

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self:is_ally_turn()))
		return
	end

	-- 아군일 경우 턴종료 상태로 바꿔준다. (아군 턴 판단을 game_state로 하기에)
	self:change_game_state(self.game_state.turn_end)
	ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
	if self:check_turn_end() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_turn_end_direct, self, true))
	else
		if self.is_play_mini_game then
			-- 패드일 때는 current_pos쪽에 다시 마커를 띄워준다.
			if self.is_using_pad and current_pos then
				self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(current_pos)
				self:set_pos_or_create_marker_icon(current_pos)
			end
			self:set_active_field_ui(true)
			self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
		end
	end
end

-- 적군 턴 종료 루틴
function local_class:enemy_turn_end_routine()
	-- 적군턴에서 타겟이 죽었을 경우 퇴각 다이얼로그를 보여준다.
	if self.selected_target ~= nil and self.selected_target:is_dead() then
		self.is_show_retreat_dialog = true
		sgw_skill_direct.show_retreat_dialog(self.selected_target)
		self.is_show_retreat_dialog = false
		self:selected_target_dead(false)
	end

	-- 선택된 캐릭터 턴 종료
	self.selected_character:turn_end()

	-- 턴 종료 상태로 변경 및 selected 정보 clear
	self:clear_select_target_data()
	self:clear_selected_character()

	-- 게임 종료
	if self:check_game_end() then
		-- 전투가 끝난 뒤, 아군 캐릭터 활성화
		-- FIXME: 적군을 잡고 이겼을 때만 활성화 해야 하나? 패배 했을 땐 어떻게 되지?
		-- 추후 확인 필요함
		for i = #self.ally, 1, -1 do
			local character = self.ally[i]
			character:reset_state()
		end

		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self:is_ally_turn()))
		return
	end

	if self:check_turn_end() then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_turn_end_direct, self, false))
	else
		self:set_active_field_ui(true)
		self:start_enemy_ai()
	end
end

-- 스타피스 획득 여부 확인
function local_class:check_star_piece()
	local index = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_index_by_character(self.selected_character)
	for i = #self.star_piece, 1, -1 do
		-- 선택된 캐릭터와 같은 index에 스타피스가 있다면 획득 연출 후 table에서 삭제
		local star_piece_index = self.star_piece[i].spawn_tile_index
		if star_piece_index ~= nil and index == star_piece_index then
			self.star_piece[i]:drop_star_piece()
			table.remove(self.star_piece, i)
			return
		end
	end
end

-- 선택된 타겟의 사망 처리
function local_class:selected_target_dead(is_ally)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local character_dead_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().character_dead_sfx_name
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(character_dead_sfx_name)

		local character = self.selected_target:get_character()
		local fx_dead
		if is_ally then
			fx_dead = self.get_dead_effect():Instantiate(character.transform.localPosition)
		else
			fx_dead = self.get_blink_effect():Instantiate(character.transform.localPosition)
		end
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(fx_dead.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

		-- 이펙트 수명이 다 될 때 까지 대기
		while fx_dead.gameObject.activeSelf do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		-- Layer를 다시 원상복구
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(fx_dead.transform, 'Default')
	end))

	-- 적군 캐릭터가 죽을 때에만 퍼플 코인을 떨어뜨리게 한다.
	if self.selected_target:get_type() == 'enemy' then
		self.selected_target:drop_item()
	end
	self.selected_target:dead()
	self:remove_character()

	local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_character(self.selected_target)
	if tile_info == nil then
		return
	end
	tile_info.object = nil
end

-- 캐싱해둔 캐릭터 컨테이너에서 selected_target을 제거한다.
function local_class:remove_character()
	if self.selected_target == nil then
		return
	end

	local character_container = self.selected_target:is_ally() and self.ally or self.enemy
	for i = #character_container, 1, -1 do
		if character_container[i] == self.selected_target then
			local object_name = character_container[i]:get_object_name()
			self.object_name_map[object_name] = nil

			table.remove(character_container, i)
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:show_turn_end_direct(is_ally)
	self:set_control_block(true)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	self:set_active_field_ui(false)

	local turn_end_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().turn_end_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(turn_end_sfx_name)

	local phase_ui = nil
	if is_ally then
		phase_ui = self.enemy_phase_ui
	else
		phase_ui = self.player_phase_ui
	end

	phase_ui:SetActive(true)

	-- 페이즈 전환 UI 출력과 동시에 BGM 교체
	local bgm_name = is_ally and sgw_constants_manager.get_enemy_turn_bgm_name() or sgw_constants_manager.get_ally_turn_bgm_name()
	self:change_current_bgm(bgm_name)

	self.pre_tile_index = -1
	self.select_tile_index = -1
	self.selected_character = nil
	self.selected_target = nil

	self:turn_over(is_ally)
	local first_target_character = self:get_first_target(is_ally)

	local animator = phase_ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	while animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < 1 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:set_active_field_ui(true)

	phase_ui:SetActive(false)

	-- 패드 사용중 일때는 첫번째 유닛 위치에 마커 표시
	if not is_ally and self.is_using_pad then
		-- 마커 인덱스 세팅
		local start_frame_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_index_by_character(first_target_character)
		self.current_marker_index = start_frame_index

		-- 첫번째 유닛에 마커 세팅
		self:get_tile_info_and_set_marker(start_frame_index)
	end

	-- 아군 턴이 끝났을 때에 적 공격 시작
	if is_ally then
		self:start_enemy_ai()
	else
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
	end

	self:enable_touch_block_when_ally_turn()
end

function local_class:clear_select_target_data()
	self.selected_target = nil
	self.selected_skill_id = -1
end

function local_class:clear_selected_character()
	self.selected_character = nil
	self.select_tile_index = -1
end

-- bgm 변경 해주는 함수
function local_class:change_current_bgm(bgm_name, mix_value)
	if self.current_play_bgm_name ~= nil and self.current_play_bgm_name == bgm_name then
		return
	end

	self.current_play_bgm_name = bgm_name
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = mix_value })
end

--region State

-- wait 상태 처리 함수
function local_class:wait_state_logic(select_tile_index, select_character)
	local grid_select_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().grid_select_sfx_name

	-- 선택된 캐릭터가 아군일 경우에는 선택 / 적군을 경우에는 status_popup 출력 (적군 정보만 보이는)
	self.select_tile_index = select_tile_index
	self.selected_character = select_character
	if self.selected_character ~= nil and self.selected_character:is_available_character() and self.selected_character:is_ally() then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(grid_select_sfx_name)
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.show_action)
	elseif self.selected_character ~= nil and not self.selected_character:is_ally() then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(grid_select_sfx_name)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_enemy_only_status_popup_routine, self))
	end
end

-- move 상태 처리 함수
function local_class:move_state_logic(select_tile_index)
	-- 움직이는 상태일 때 타일을 눌러서 이동 가능한 타일일 경우에는 해당 타일로 캐릭터를 이동 시킨다.
	if sgw_tile_manager.is_movable_tile(self.selected_character, select_tile_index, self.selected_character:get_move_range()) then
		self:set_control_block(true)
		self.pre_tile_index = self.select_tile_index
		self.select_tile_index = select_tile_index
		self:move_select_character(self.select_tile_index)
	else
		self:set_active_field_ui(true)
		self.selected_character:set_position(sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(self.select_tile_index))
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
	end
	sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()
end

-- attack 상태 처리 함수
function local_class:attack_state_logic(selected_target, select_tile_index)
	self.selected_target = selected_target
	local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(self.selected_skill_id)

	if not sgw_tile_manager.is_attack_able_tile(self.selected_character, select_tile_index, skill_data.range) then
		self:set_active_field_ui(true)
		self:change_game_state(self.game_state.waiting)
		return
	end

	if skill_data.type == 'attack' then
		if self.selected_target ~= nil and self.selected_target:get_type() ~= self.selected_character:get_type() then
			self:aim_to_target(self.selected_character, self.selected_target, self.show_status_popup, self)
		else
			return
		end
	elseif skill_data.type == 'heal' then
		if self.selected_target ~= nil and (self.selected_target:get_type() == self.selected_character:get_type() and self.selected_target ~= self.selected_character) then
			self:play_heal()
		else
			return
		end
	end

	sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()
end

--endregion

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- 초기화
	self.select_tile_index = -1
	self.pre_tile_index = -1
	self.selected_character = nil
	self.selected_target = nil
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.waiting

	self:dispose_active_frame()
	self:dispose_marker_icon()

	local is_using_pad = CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled
	self:set_control_block(is_using_pad)

	-- 상태 리셋
	for i = 1, #self.ally do
		self.ally[i]:reset_state()
	end
	for i = 1, #self.enemy do
		self.enemy[i]:reset_state()
	end

	-- 패드로 게임이 시작 됐을 경우에는 인덱스에서 첫번째 유닛으로 카메라를 옮겨준다.
	if is_using_pad then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
		self.arrow_directions = { up = 0, down = 1, left = 2, right = 3 }

		-- 마커 인덱스 세팅
		local start_frame_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_index_by_character(self.ally[1])
		self.current_marker_index = start_frame_index

		-- 첫번째 유닛에 tile_info를 가져오며 마커를 세팅한다.
		local first_character_tile_info = self:get_tile_info_and_set_marker(start_frame_index)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_move_end_target_tile,
				self, first_character_tile_info.center, self.camera_zoom_min, self.camera_speed, false))
	else
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	end

	self.is_using_pad = is_using_pad
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)

	self:set_active_field_ui_part(false)
	self:set_active_field_ui(true)
	self.is_play_mini_game = true

	-- 게임 시작할 때는 아군턴 이므로 아군 턴 BGM 재생
	self:change_current_bgm(sgw_constants_manager.get_ally_turn_bgm_name())
	-- 아군 턴 UI
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_phase_ui, self, true))
end

function local_class:show_phase_ui(is_ally)
	self:set_control_block(true)

	local turn_end_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().turn_end_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(turn_end_sfx_name)

	local phase_ui = nil
	if is_ally then
		phase_ui = self.player_phase_ui
	else
		phase_ui = self.enemy_phase_ui
	end

	phase_ui:SetActive(true)

	local animator = phase_ui.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	while animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < 1 do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	phase_ui:SetActive(false)

	self:set_control_block(false)
end

function local_class:get_tile_info_and_set_marker(index)
	local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info(index)
	self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(tile_info.center)
	self:set_pos_or_create_marker_icon(tile_info.center)
	return tile_info
end

function local_class:available_skill(character, skill_id)
	local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(skill_id)
	if skill_data.energy > character:get_energy() then
		return false
	end

	if skill_data.type == 'attack' then
		local available_tiles = sgw_tile_manager.get_available_attack_skill_tile_index(self.select_tile_index, skill_data.range, character)
		for _, tile_index in ipairs(available_tiles) do
			local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info(tile_index)
			if tile_info.object ~= nil and tile_info.object:get_type() ~= character:get_type() then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif skill_data.type == 'heal' then
		local available_tiles = sgw_tile_manager.get_available_heal_skill_tile_index(self.select_tile_index, skill_data.range, character)
		for _, tile_index in ipairs(available_tiles) do
			local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info(tile_index)
			if tile_info.object ~= nil and (tile_info.object:get_type() == character:get_type() and tile_info.object ~= character) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:change_game_state(state)
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.waiting and state == self.game_state.show_action then
		local buttons
		local available_skill = false
		local skill_ids = self.selected_character:get_skill_ids()
		for i = 1, #skill_ids do
			local skill_id = skill_ids[i]
			if self:available_skill(self.selected_character, skill_id) then
				available_skill = true
			end
		end
		if available_skill == false then
			buttons = CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.Move |
					CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.ActionEnd
		else
			buttons = CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.Move |
					CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.Attack |
					CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.ActionEnd
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_action_popup_routine, self, self.select_tile_index, false, buttons))
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.move and state == self.game_state.show_action then
		local buttons
		local available_skill = false
		local skill_ids = self.selected_character:get_skill_ids()
		for i = 1, #skill_ids do
			local skill_id = skill_ids[i]
			if self:available_skill(self.selected_character, skill_id) then
				available_skill = true
			end
		end
		if available_skill == false then
			buttons = CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.ActionEnd
		else
			buttons = CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.Attack |
					CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.UISGWActionPopButtonType.ActionEnd
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_action_popup_routine, self, self.select_tile_index, true, buttons))
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.attack and state == self.game_state.waiting then
		sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()
		ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
		self.selected_character:set_position(sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(self.select_tile_index))
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.show_action and state == self.game_state.waiting then
		sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()
		ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()
		self.selected_character:set_position(sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(self.select_tile_index))
	end

	self.current_game_state = state

	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.move then
		sgw_tile_manager.show_move_tile(self.selected_character, self.selected_character:get_move_range(), true)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.enemy_move then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enemy_move_routine, self))
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.enemy_attack then
		self:aim_to_target(self.selected_character, self.selected_target, self.play_skill, self)
	elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.waiting then
		local grid_select_cancel_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().grid_select_cancel_sfx_name
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(grid_select_cancel_sfx_name)

		if self.selected_character ~= nil then
			if self.is_using_pad then
				local before_pos
				-- 이전 타일이 있다면 그쪽 좌표로
				if self.pre_tile_index > 0 then
					before_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(self.pre_tile_index)
					self.selected_character:return_before_pos(before_pos)
					self.current_marker_index = self.pre_tile_index
				else
					before_pos = self.selected_character:get_position()
					self.current_marker_index = self.select_tile_index
				end

				self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(vector(before_pos.x, 0, before_pos.z))
				self:set_pos_or_create_marker_icon(vector(before_pos.x, 0, before_pos.z))

				self:set_control_block(true)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_move_end_target_tile,
						self, before_pos, self.camera_zoom_min, self.camera_speed, false))
			else
				-- 이전 타일의 index가 있다면 이전 타일로 돌아감
				if self.pre_tile_index > 0 then
					local before_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(self.pre_tile_index)
					self.selected_character:return_before_pos(before_pos)
					--coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.camera_move_end_target_tile,
					--		self, before_pos, nil, self.camera_speed, false))
				end
				self:dispose_active_frame()
			end
		end
		self.pre_tile_index = -1
		self:clear_selected_character()
	end
end

--region aim_to_target
function local_class:aim_to_target(character, target, end_callback, ...)
	local args = { ... }

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.aim_to_target_routine, self, character, target, end_callback, table.unpack(args)))
end

function local_class:aim_to_target_pos(start_pos, end_pos, end_callback, ...)
	local args = { ... }

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.aim_to_target_pos_routine, self, start_pos, end_pos, end_callback, table.unpack(args)))
end

function local_class:aim_to_target_routine(character, target, end_callback, ...)
	self:set_control_block(true)
	self:dispose_active_frame()
	self:dispose_marker_icon()

	-- 시작과 목표 좌표 세팅
	local start_pos = character:get_position()
	local end_pos = target:get_position()

	-- 캐릭터가 에임 날라가는 방향으로 회전
	character:lock_target_pos(end_pos)

	-- 혹시나 에임 스프라이트가 잔재되어 있을 경우, Dispose
	self:aim_dispose()

	-- 에임 custom sprite 세팅
	local pos_y = sgw_constants_manager.get_corrected_character_pos_y()
	self.aim_sprite = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(start_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.aim_sprite.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	local custom_sprite = self.aim_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(1, 1)
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'srw_ui_ic_aim.png'
	custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
	custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 6
	custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local target_select_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().target_select_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(target_select_sfx_name)

	-- 목표 지점까지 에임 이동
	local time_passed = 0.0
	local move_time = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / self.aim_speed
	while time_passed <= move_time do
		local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, move_time)
		local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, move_time)
		self.aim_sprite.transform.position = vector(x, pos_y, z)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 도착 후 0.25초뒤 스킬 시전
	self.aim_sprite.transform.position = end_pos
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	if end_callback then
		local args = { ... }
		end_callback(table.unpack(args))
	end
end

function local_class:aim_to_target_pos_routine(start_pos, end_pos, end_callback, ...)
	self:set_control_block(true)
	self:dispose_active_frame()
	self:dispose_marker_icon()

	-- 혹시나 에임 스프라이트가 잔재되어 있을 경우, Dispose
	self:aim_dispose()

	-- 에임 custom sprite 세팅
	self.aim_sprite = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(start_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.aim_sprite.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	local custom_sprite = self.aim_sprite.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(1, 1)
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'srw_ui_ic_aim.png'
	custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
	custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 6
	custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	local target_select_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().target_select_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(target_select_sfx_name)

	-- 목표 지점까지 에임 이동
	local time_passed = 0.0
	local move_time = (end_pos - start_pos).magnitude / self.aim_speed
	while time_passed <= move_time do
		local position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, time_passed / move_time)
		self.aim_sprite.transform.position = position
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	-- 도착 후 0.25초뒤 스킬 시전
	self.aim_sprite.transform.position = end_pos
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	if end_callback then
		local args = { ... }
		end_callback(table.unpack(args))
	end
end
function local_class:aim_dispose()
	if self.aim_sprite then
		self.aim_sprite:Dispose()
		self.aim_sprite = nil
	end
end

function local_class:show_status_popup()
	self:set_control_block(true)
	self:set_active_field_ui(false)

	self:change_game_state(self.game_state.show_status)
	local my_info_data = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState.MakeData(self.selected_character:get_hp(), self.selected_character:get_max_hp(),
			self.selected_character:get_energy(), self.selected_character:get_max_energy(), true, self.selected_character:get_status_icon_name())
	local enemy_info_data = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState.MakeData(self.selected_target:get_hp(), self.selected_target:get_max_hp(),
			self.selected_target:get_energy(), self.selected_target:get_max_energy(), true, self.selected_target:get_status_icon_name())
	local state = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState()
	state.myInfo = my_info_data
	state.enemyInfo = enemy_info_data
	state.isVisibleEnemyInfoOnly = false
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsStatusPopup.Instance, state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsStatusPopup))
end

function local_class:show_enemy_only_status_popup()
	self:change_game_state(self.game_state.show_status)
	local my_info_data = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState.MakeData(0, 0, 0, 0)
	local enemy_info_data = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState.MakeData(self.selected_character:get_hp(), self.selected_character:get_max_hp(),
			self.selected_character:get_energy(), self.selected_character:get_max_energy(), true, self.selected_character:get_status_icon_name())
	local state = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState()
	state.myInfo = my_info_data
	state.enemyInfo = enemy_info_data
	state.isVisibleEnemyInfoOnly = true
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsStatusPopup.Instance, state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsStatusPopup))
end

function local_class:show_enemy_only_status_popup_routine()
	self:set_control_block(true)
	self:set_active_field_ui(false)

	-- 카메라를 index에 해당하는 좌표로 이동시켜준다.
	local target_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(self.select_tile_index)
	self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(target_pos)
	--	self:camera_move_end_target_tile(target_pos, nil, self.camera_speed, true)
	self:show_enemy_only_status_popup()
end

function local_class:load_custom_atlas()
	if self.custom_atlas ~= nil then
		return
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'srw_ui_custom'), function(prefab)
		self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
		self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end))
end
