--region skill_direct
-- 스킬 시전 함수
function local_class:play_skill(attacker, target, skill_id, is_controlled_event)
	attacker = lua_helper.get_or_default(attacker, self.selected_character)
	target = lua_helper.get_or_default(target, self.selected_target)
	skill_id = lua_helper.get_or_default(skill_id, self.selected_skill_id)

	ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()

	self:set_active_field_ui(false)
	self:set_control_block(true)

	local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(skill_id)
	local bgm_name = lua_helper.get_or_default(skill_data.bgm, self.current_play_bgm_name)

	local is_change_bgm = self.current_play_bgm_name ~= bgm_name
	self.current_play_bgm_name = bgm_name

	sgw_skill_direct.play_skill(attacker, target, skill_data, is_controlled_event, is_change_bgm, self.skill_direct_fade_time)

	-- fade out 시간에 맞춰서 에임 스프라이트 Dispose
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(self.skill_direct_fade_time)

		self:aim_dispose()
	end))
end

-- 방어 시전 함수
function local_class:play_block(blocker, is_controlled_event)
	blocker = lua_helper.get_or_default(blocker, self.selected_character)

	ui_scene_manager:ClearAllOverlayList()

	self:dispose_active_frame()
	self:dispose_marker_icon()

	local block_type = self.selected_character:get_block_type()
	if block_type == 'heal' then
		self:set_control_block(true)
		sgw_skill_direct.play_block(blocker, is_controlled_event)
	else
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'TurnEnd' }))
	end
end

-- 회복 시전 함수
function local_class:play_heal(healer, target, skill_id, is_controlled_event)
	healer = lua_helper.get_or_default(healer, self.selected_character)
	target = lua_helper.get_or_default(target, self.selected_target)
	skill_id = lua_helper.get_or_default(skill_id, self.selected_skill_id)

	self:dispose_active_frame()
	self:dispose_marker_icon()
	self:set_control_block(true)
	sgw_skill_direct.play_heal(healer, target, skill_id, is_controlled_event)
end
--endregion

function local_class:turn_over(is_ally)
	local reset_characters
	if is_ally then
		reset_characters = self.ally
	else
		reset_characters = self.enemy
	end

	for i = 1, #reset_characters do
		reset_characters[i]:reset_state()
	end
end

function local_class:get_first_target(is_ally)
	local first_target_character

	if is_ally then
		if self.enemy ~= nil and #self.enemy > 0 then
			first_target_character = self.enemy[1]
		end
	else
		if self.ally ~= nil and #self.ally > 0 then
			first_target_character = self.ally[1]
		end
	end

	if first_target_character == nil then
		return nil
	end

	local target_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_character(first_target_character).center
	self:camera_move_end_target_tile(target_pos, nil, self.camera_speed, false, false)
	return first_target_character
end

function local_class:start_enemy_ai()
	for i = 1, #self.enemy do
		local enemy = self.enemy[i]
		if enemy:is_available_character() then
			self.selected_character = enemy
			break
		end
	end

	self:change_game_state(self.game_state.enemy_move)
end

-- 적이 행동하는 루틴
function local_class:enemy_move_routine()
	self:set_control_block(true)

	-- N초만큼 기다렸다가 움직인다.
	wait_for_sec(self.enemy_move_delay_time)

	-- 카메라를 선택된 적의 타일로 이동 및 활성화 UI ON
	local target_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_character(self.selected_character).center
	self:camera_move_end_target_tile(target_pos, nil, self.camera_speed)

	-- N초만큼 기다렸다가 활성화 UI를 켜준다.
	wait_for_sec(self.enemy_show_active_ui_delay_time)

	local move_grid_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().move_grid_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(move_grid_sfx_name)
	self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(target_pos)

	-- N초뒤에 이동 진행
	wait_for_sec(self.enemy_active_delay_time)

	self:enemy_move()
end

-- 적 움직임 계산 함수
function local_class:enemy_move()
	-- 사용할 수 있는 스킬들 가져오기
	local available_skill_ids = {}
	local skill_ids = self.selected_character:get_skill_ids()
	for i = 1, #skill_ids do
		if self.selected_character:available_skill(skill_ids[i]) then
			table.insert(available_skill_ids, skill_ids[i])
		end
	end

	-- 원킬 가능한 적 리스트 / 공격 가능한 적 리스트
	local one_shot_list = {}
	local attack_able_list = {}

	-- enemy_skill_data 초기화
	self.enemy_target_data = nil

	-- 한방에 죽일 수 있는지 체크하는 로컬 함수
	local is_one_shot_kill = function(skill_data, target)
		return target:get_hp() <= skill_data.attack
	end

	-- 공격 범위 안에 들어가는지 확인하는 함수
	local check_available_skill = function(move_tile_index, skill_data, skill_tile_index)
		-- 해당 타일에 캐릭터가 있으면서 적군(적에게는 'ally'가 적군)이면 원킬이 가능한지 확인 후 원킬 리스트에 넣을지
		-- 공격 가능한 적에 넣을지 판단하여 각각의 테이블에 넣어준다.
		local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info(skill_tile_index)
		if tile_info.object ~= nil and tile_info.object:is_ally() then
			local one_shot = is_one_shot_kill(skill_data, tile_info.object)

			local target_info = {}
			target_info.move_tile_index = move_tile_index
			target_info.skill_data = skill_data
			target_info.target_tile_index = skill_tile_index
			target_info.target = tile_info.object

			if one_shot then
				table.insert(one_shot_list, target_info)
			else
				table.insert(attack_able_list, target_info)
			end
		end
	end

	-- 타일과 타일의 거리를 비교하는 함수
	local get_tile_distance = function(target_tile_index, tile_index)
		local current_tile_floor = math.floor((tile_index - 1) / sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_x_count())
		local target_tile_floor = math.floor((target_tile_index - 1) / sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_x_count())
		local is_equal_floor_tile = current_tile_floor == target_tile_floor

		if is_equal_floor_tile then
			return math.abs(target_tile_index - tile_index)
		end

		local range = current_tile_floor - target_tile_floor
		local tile_range_x = target_tile_index + (range * sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_x_count())
		return math.abs(tile_range_x - tile_index) + math.abs(range)
	end

	-- 보내준 tile_index에서의 아군들과의 거리 값 구하는 함수
	local get_allys_distance_value = function(tile_index)
		local allys_distance = 0
		for i = 1, #self.ally do
			local ally_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_index_by_character(self.ally[i])
			allys_distance = allys_distance + get_tile_distance(ally_index, tile_index)
		end

		return allys_distance
	end

	-- 움직일 수 있는 타일들을 가져와서 돌아본다.
	local movable_tile_index_list = sgw_tile_manager.get_movable_tile_index(self.selected_character, self.selected_character:get_move_range(), self.selected_character)
	for i = 1, #movable_tile_index_list do
		local movable_tile_index = movable_tile_index_list[i]
		for j = 1, #available_skill_ids do
			local available_skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(available_skill_ids[j])
			local available_skill_tile_index_list = sgw_tile_manager.get_available_attack_skill_tile_index(movable_tile_index, available_skill_data.range, self.selected_character)

			-- 적이 movable_tile_index에 와서 스킬을 사용할 수 있는 범위를 모두 체크
			for k = 1, #available_skill_tile_index_list do
				check_available_skill(movable_tile_index, available_skill_data, available_skill_tile_index_list[k])
			end
		end
	end

	if #one_shot_list > 0 then
		-- 원킬을 낼 수 있는 스킬이 있다면 적과 제일 가까운 거리에서 에너지 소모량이 제일 적은 스킬을 사용한다.
		local current_distance_value = -1
		local energy_value = -1
		for i = 1, #one_shot_list do
			local one_shot_data = one_shot_list[i]

			-- 에너지 소모량이 더 적다면 current_distance_value를 초기화 해준다.
			if one_shot_data.skill_data.energy < energy_value then
				current_distance_value = -1
				energy_value = one_shot_data.skill_data.energy
			end

			local distance = get_allys_distance_value(one_shot_data.move_tile_index)
			if current_distance_value < 0 or
					(current_distance_value > distance and one_shot_data.skill_data.energy <= energy_value) then
				current_distance_value = distance
				self.enemy_target_data = one_shot_data
			end
		end
	elseif #one_shot_list <= 0 or #attack_able_list > 0 then
		-- 원킬은 낼 수 없지만 공격이 가능한 스킬이 있다면 적들과 제일 먼 곳에서 가장 강한 스킬을 사용한다.
		local attack_value = -1
		local current_distance_value = -1
		for i = 1, #attack_able_list do
			local attack_data = attack_able_list[i]

			-- 공격력이 더 높다면 current_distance_value를 초기화 해준다.
			if attack_data.skill_data.attack > attack_value then
				current_distance_value = -1
				attack_value = attack_data.skill_data.attack
			end

			local distance = get_allys_distance_value(attack_data.move_tile_index)
			if current_distance_value < 0 or
					(current_distance_value < distance and attack_data.skill_data.attack >= attack_value) then
				current_distance_value = distance
				self.enemy_target_data = attack_data
			end
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 선택된 스킬이 있을 때는 이동 후 스킬 사용, 없을 때는 제일 가까운 적을 추적
	local moving_target_tile_index = 0
	if self.enemy_target_data == nil then
		-- 적들과 제일 가까운 위치로 이동
		local current_distance = -1
		for i = 1, #movable_tile_index_list do
			local movable_tile_index = movable_tile_index_list[i]
			-- 적들과 평균적으로 가까운 위치를 찾음
			--local distance = get_allys_distance_value(movable_tile_index)
			--if current_distance < 0 or current_distance > distance then
			--	current_distance = distance
			--	moving_target_tile_index = movable_tile_index
			--end

			-- 제일 가까운 적을 찾음
			for j = 1, #self.ally do
				local ally_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_index_by_character(self.ally[j])
				local distance = get_tile_distance(ally_index, movable_tile_index)
				if current_distance < 0 or current_distance > distance then
					current_distance = distance
					moving_target_tile_index = movable_tile_index
				end
			end
		end
	else
		-- 적군의 타겟 정보가 있을 경우에는 move_tile_index를 넣어준다.
		moving_target_tile_index = self.enemy_target_data.move_tile_index
	end

	-- N초간 타일을 보여주고 난 뒤
	sgw_tile_manager.show_move_tile(self.selected_character, self.selected_character:get_move_range(), false)
	wait_for_sec(self.enemy_move_range_active_time)
	sgw_tile_manager.hide_active_tile()

	-- enemy를 moving_target_tile_index로 움직여 준다.
	self:move_select_character(moving_target_tile_index, self.enemy_move_end_delay_time)
end

function local_class:show_action_popup_routine(index, is_camera_move, enabled_buttons)
	self:set_control_block(true)
	self:set_active_field_ui(false)

	-- 카메라를 index에 해당하는 좌표로 이동시켜준다.
	local target_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(index)
	self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(target_pos)
	self:camera_move_screen(target_pos)

	-- SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup 오버레이
	local state = CS.Oak.UI.SGWActionPopupState()
	local my_info_data = CS.Oak.UI.SGWStatusPopupState.MakeData(self.selected_character:get_hp(), self.selected_character:get_max_hp(),
			self.selected_character:get_energy(), self.selected_character:get_max_energy(), true, self.selected_character:get_status_icon_name())
	local wts = self.camera.Cam:WorldToScreenPoint(target_pos)
	state.WidgetPosition = vector_util.get_xy0(CS.UICamera.mainCamera:ScreenToWorldPoint(wts))
	state.SGWActionPopupButtonType = enabled_buttons
	state.MyInfo = my_info_data
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup.Instance, state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsActionPopup))
end

-- 선택한 캐릭터를 특정 인덱스의 타일로 이동시켜주는 함수 호출
function local_class:move_select_character(index, end_delay)
	if self.selected_character == nil then
		return
	end

	local grid_select_cancel_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().grid_select_cancel_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(grid_select_cancel_sfx_name)

	local target_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(index)
	self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(target_pos)
	self.selected_character:move(target_pos, end_delay)
end

--region action_character_target_tile
--- 캐릭터를 특정 지점까지 이동
--- @param object_name string 해당 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
--- @param target_index number 이동할 지점의 타일 index
--- @param move_speed number 이동할 때의 속도
function local_class:move_character_target_tile(object_name, target_index, move_speed)
	local character = self:get_character_from_object_name(object_name)
	if character == nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'directing_move' }))
		return
	end

	local current_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_index_by_character(character)
	target_index = sgw_tile_manager.get_move_able_tile(current_index, target_index)

	local target_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(target_index)
	character:directing_move(target_pos, move_speed)
end

--- 캐릭터로 특정 타겟에게 공격
--- @param attacker_object_name string 공격하는 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
--- @param target_object_name string 공격할 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
--- @param skill_id number 공격에 사용할 스킬의 id
function local_class:attack_character_target_tile(attacker_object_name, target_object_name, skill_id)
	local attacker = self:get_character_from_object_name(attacker_object_name)
	local defender = self:get_character_from_object_name(target_object_name)
	if attacker == nil or defender == nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'directing_attack' }))
		return
	end

	self.selected_character = attacker
	self.selected_target = defender
	self:aim_to_target(attacker, defender, self.play_skill, self, attacker, defender, skill_id, true)
end

--- 캐릭터로 방어
--- @param blocker_object_name string 방어하는 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
function local_class:block_character_target_tile(blocker_object_name)
	local blocker = self:get_character_from_object_name(blocker_object_name)
	if blocker == nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'directing_block' }))
		return
	end

	self:play_block(blocker, true)
end

--- 캐릭터로 특정 타겟에게 회복
--- @param healer_object_name string 회복하는 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
--- @param target_object_name string 회복할 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
--- @param skill_id string 회복에 사용할 스킬의 id
function local_class:heal_character_target_tile(healer_object_name, target_object_name, skill_id)
	local healer = self:get_character_from_object_name(healer_object_name)
	local target = self:get_character_from_object_name(target_object_name)
	if healer == nil or target == nil then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'directing_heal' }))
		return
	end

	self:play_heal(healer, target, skill_id, true)
end

--- 캐릭터의 틴트색 변경
--- @param object_name string 틴트를 변경할 캐릭터의 고유한 오브젝트 이름
--- @param target_alpha number 변경할 틴트 alpha 값
--- @param duration number target_alpha 수치로 변경 되기까지 걸리는 시간
function local_class:change_tint_color_target_character(object_name, target_alpha, duration)
	local character = self:get_character_from_object_name(object_name)
	if character then
		character:change_tint_color(target_alpha, duration)
	end
end

-- 오브젝트 이름으로 캐릭터 가져오기

	if self.object_name_map[object_name] then
		return self.object_name_map[object_name]
	end

	return nil
end

-- 오브젝트 이름 기준으로 활성화 프레임 띄우기
function local_class:show_active_frame_from_object_name(object_name)
	local character = self:get_character_from_object_name(object_name)

	if character then
		local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_character(character)
		self:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(tile_info.center)
	end

function local_class:set_pos_or_create_active_frame(target_pos)
	target_pos = vector(target_pos.x, 0.3, target_pos.z)
	if self.active_frame ~= nil then
		self.active_frame.transform.position = target_pos
		return
	end

	-- 활성화 UI Show
	self.active_frame = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(target_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.active_frame.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	local custom_sprite = self.active_frame.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(3.1225, 2.21)
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'srw_ui_tile_line_00.png'
	custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
	custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 2
	custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)
end

function local_class:set_pos_or_create_marker_icon(target_pos)
	target_pos = vector(target_pos.x, 1.2, target_pos.z)
	if self.pad_marker_icon ~= nil then
		self.pad_marker_icon.transform.position = target_pos
		return
	end

	self.pad_marker_icon = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(target_pos)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.pad_marker_icon.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	local custom_sprite = self.pad_marker_icon.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(1.4, 1.4)
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = 'srw_ui_ic_marker_00.png'
	custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
	custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 11
	custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)
end

-- 카메라를 target_pos로 duration에 맞는 시간 동안 이동시킨다.
function local_class:camera_move_end_target_tile(target_pos, target_ortho_size, duration, block, is_checking_block)
	self.camera.ZoomCoroutine = nil
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 만약 날라온 값보다 작다면 거리에 맞게 카메라 속도 이동
	local start_pos = vector(self.camera.Transform.localPosition.x, 0, self.camera.Transform.localPosition.y)
	local range_duration = (target_pos - start_pos).magnitude / self.camera_speed
	local final_duration = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(range_duration, 0, duration)

	local y = target_pos.z / (math.cos(math.rad(45.2)) * 2)
	target_ortho_size = lua_helper.get_or_default(target_ortho_size, self.camera.Cam.orthographicSize)
	self.camera:ZoomTo(vector(target_pos.x, y, -50 + y), target_ortho_size, false, final_duration)

	local is_checking = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_checking_block, true)
	if is_checking then
		wait_for_sec(final_duration + 0.1)
		local current_block = lua_helper.get_or_default(block, true)
		self:set_control_block(current_block)
	end
end

function local_class:camera_move_screen(target_pos)
	-- 카메라 비율에 맞춰 x,y 거리 비교해서 카메라 움직여야 한다면 움직인다.
	local is_camera_move = self:is_camera_area(target_pos)
	if is_camera_move then
		return
	end

	self.camera.ZoomCoroutine = nil
	local y = target_pos.z / (math.cos(math.rad(45.2)) * 2)
	self.camera.Cam.transform.localPosition = vector(target_pos.x, y, -50 + y)
	self:set_control_block(false)
end

function local_class:is_camera_area(target_pos)
	local camera = self.camera.Cam
	local screen_point = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(target_pos)

	if screen_point.z < 0 then
		return false
	end

	local x1 = sgw_constants_manager.get_camera_move_rate_x()
	local y1 = sgw_constants_manager.get_camera_move_rate_y()
	local x2 = 1 - x1
	local y2 = 1 - y1
	return screen_point.x > x1 and screen_point.x < x2 and screen_point.y > y1 and screen_point.y < y2
end

function local_class:camera_move_end_target_tile_in_game(target_pos, block)
	self.camera.ZoomCoroutine = nil
	local y = target_pos.z / (math.cos(math.rad(45.2)) * 2)
	self.camera.Cam.transform.localPosition = vector(target_pos.x, y, -50 + y)
	local current_block = lua_helper.get_or_default(block, true)
	self:set_control_block(current_block)
end

function local_class:directing_camera_shake(magnitude, duration)
	if self.camera == nil then
		return
	end

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if shake_calculator.IsActive then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			self.camera_offset.localPosition = shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:load_characters(key, delay, spawn_sfx)
	local constants_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_constants_data()
	local character_deploy = constants_data.character_deploy[key]
	delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(delay, 0.1)

	-- 캐릭터를 넣어둘 커스텀 아틀라스 가져오기
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	for _, pair in ipairs(character_deploy) do
		local tile_index = pair[1]
		local character_id = pair[2]
		local object_name = pair[3]
		local direction = pair[4]
		local drop_item_type = pair[5]
		local drop_item_name = pair[6]

		local character_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_character_data(character_id)
		local character_object = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)

		-- 캐릭터 데이터 세팅
		local game_character = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsCharacter')
		game_character:set_data(character_data.id, character_object, object_name, direction, drop_item_type, drop_item_name)

		-- 스프라이트 세팅
		local custom_sprite = character_object.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
		custom_sprite.SpriteName = game_character:get_sprite_name_by_direction(direction)
		custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(game_character:is_flip(direction) and -1.8 or 1.8, 1.8)
		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.white
		custom_sprite.Atlas = self.custom_atlas
		custom_sprite.IgnoreOriginalSize = false
		custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 3
		custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

		game_character:set_position(sgw_tile_manager.get_spawn_tile_position(tile_index))
		if game_character:is_ally() then
			table.insert(self.ally, game_character)
		else
			table.insert(self.enemy, game_character)
		end
		self.object_name_map[object_name] = game_character

		sgw_tile_manager.add_object(game_character, sgw_tile_manager.get_collide_tile_index(game_character:get_position()))

		if spawn_sfx then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(spawn_sfx)
		end
		self:show_character_load_effect(game_character:get_character())

		if delay > 0 then
			wait_for_sec(delay)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:load_star_piece(key)
	local constants_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_constants_data()
	local character_deploy = constants_data.character_deploy[key]

	-- 스타피스 이팩트 Create
	self.get_star_piece_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	for _, pair in ipairs(character_deploy) do
		local tile_index = pair[1]
		local star_piece_id = pair[2]

		-- 타입이 스타피스 이면서 해당 스타피스를 먹지 않았을 때만 그려준다.
		local star_piece_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_character_data(star_piece_id)
		if star_piece_data.type == 'star_piece' and not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(star_piece_data.name) then
			-- 스타피스 생성 후 self.star_piece에 넣어둔다.
			local star_piece_pos = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_position(tile_index)
			local star_piece_effect = self.get_star_piece_effect():Instantiate(star_piece_pos)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(star_piece_effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

			local star_piece_character = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsCharacter')
			star_piece_character:set_star_piece(star_piece_data.id, tile_index, star_piece_effect)
			table.insert(self.star_piece, star_piece_character)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:reset_game_data()
	self:clear_all_characters()
	self:clear_star_piece()
end

function local_class:clear_all_characters()
	for i = #self.ally, 1, -1 do
		local character = self.ally[i]
		local object_name = character:get_object_name()
		self.object_name_map[object_name] = nil
		character:dispose()

		local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_character(character)
		if tile_info ~= nil then
			tile_info.object = nil
		end
	end
	self.ally = {}

	for i = #self.enemy, 1, -1 do
		local character = self.enemy[i]
		local object_name = character:get_object_name()
		self.object_name_map[object_name] = nil
		character:dispose()

		local tile_info = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_character(character)
		if tile_info ~= nil then
			tile_info.object = nil
		end
	end
	self.enemy = {}
end

function local_class:clear_star_piece()
	for i = #self.star_piece, 1, -1 do
		local star_piece = self.star_piece[i]
		star_piece:dispose()
	end
	self.star_piece = {}
end

function local_class:show_character_load_effect(character)
	local blink_effect = self.get_blink_effect():Instantiate(character.transform.localPosition + vector(0, 0, -1))
	blink_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1.75, 1.75, 1.75)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(blink_effect.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	local is_character_load_effect_list_empty = #self.character_load_effect_list <= 0
	table.insert(self.character_load_effect_list, blink_effect)

	-- 기존에 self.character_load_effect_list에 아무것도 등록되어있지 않았다면, 코루틴을 작동시킴
	if is_character_load_effect_list_empty then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_character_load_effect_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:show_character_load_effect_routine()
	while #self.character_load_effect_list > 0 do
		for i = #self.character_load_effect_list, 1, -1 do
			character_load_effect = self.character_load_effect_list[i]

			-- 이펙트 수명이 다 될 때 까지 대기
			if not character_load_effect.gameObject.activeSelf then
				-- Layer를 다시 원상복구
				CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(character_load_effect.transform, 'Default')
				table.remove(self.character_load_effect_list, i)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:check_turn_end()
	local check_characters
	if self:is_ally_turn() == false then
		check_characters = self.enemy
	else
		check_characters = self.ally
	end

	for _, character in pairs(check_characters) do
		if character:is_action_end() == false and character:is_dead() == false then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:check_game_end()
	local check_characters
	local is_ally_turn = self:is_ally_turn()

	if is_ally_turn then
		check_characters = self.enemy
	else
		check_characters = self.ally
	end

	--TODO: 현재로썬 아군 보스가 죽었을 때 게임오버 되는 연출은 없으므로 아군 턴일때만 boss_kill을 확인한다.
	if is_ally_turn and self.battle_end_type == 'boss_kill' then
		return self:is_boss_kill(check_characters)
	else
		return self:is_all_kill(check_characters)
	end

	return false
end

-- 체크해야하는 유닛이 전부 죽었는지 체크하는 함수
function local_class:is_all_kill(check_characters)
	for i = 1, #check_characters do
		local character = check_characters[i]
		if not character:is_dead() then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 체크해야하는 유닛 중 보스가 죽었는지 체크하는 함수
function local_class:is_boss_kill(check_characters)
	for i = 1, #check_characters do
		local character = check_characters[i]
		-- 리스트에 보스가 있다면 아직 보스가 죽은 것이 아니기에 false
		if character:is_equal_sub_type('boss') then
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- 배틀 타입 세팅
function local_class:set_battle_end_type(end_type)
	-- 스트링이 아닌 값이 날라오면 all_kill로 세팅
	self.battle_end_type = type_util.is_string(end_type) and end_type or 'all_kill'
end

-- 아군의 턴일 때만 터치 잠금을 풀어주는 함수
function local_class:enable_touch_block_when_ally_turn()
	if not self:is_ally_turn() then
		return
	end

	if self.is_play_mini_game then
		self:set_control_block(false)
	end
end

function local_class:set_control_block(is_block)
	if self.is_control_block == is_block then
		return
	end

	self.is_control_block = is_block
	if self.is_using_pad then
		return
	end
	self.camera.Block = is_block
end

function local_class:is_ally_turn()
	if self.current_game_state < self.game_state.enemy_state_start then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:game_end()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.TouchControllerBlockAreaResetEvent.Create(true))
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller);
	end
}

sgw_constants_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsConstantsManager')
sgw_tile_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsTileManager')

local local_class = newclass('SuperGuardianWarsCharacter')

function local_class:init()
	self.character_id = -1
	self.character = nil
	self.object_name = nil
	self.character_data = nil
	self.character_state = { waiting = 0, move = 1, attack = 2, action_end = 3 }
	self.current_state = self.character_state.waiting

	self.drop_item_type = nil
	self.cached_drop_item = nil

	self.skills = {}

	self.hp = 0
	self.max_hp = 0
	self.energy = 0
	self.max_energy = 0
	self.move_speed = 4

	self.current_direction = nil
	self.moving_direction = nil

	-- 캐릭터 색 변경 중복 실행 방지용 coroutine request id
	self.change_tint_color_req_id = 0
end

-- 캐릭터 데이터 세팅
function local_class:set_data(character_id, character, object_name, start_direction, drop_item_type, drop_item_name)

	self.character = character
	self.object_name = object_name
	self.character_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_character_data(self.character_id)

	-- 드롭 아이템 세팅
	self.drop_item_type = drop_item_type
	if self.drop_item_type ~= nil then
		self.cached_drop_item = get_field_object(drop_item_name)
	end

	local character_skill_ids = sgw_constants_manager.get_character_skill_ids(self.character_id)
	for i = 1, #character_skill_ids do
		table.insert(self.skills, sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(character_skill_ids[i]))
	end

	self.max_hp = self.character_data.hp
	self.energy = self.character_data.energy
	self.max_energy = self.character_data.energy
	self.move_speed = self.character_data.move_speed

	self.moving_direction = start_direction

	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.character.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
end

function local_class:set_star_piece(id, index, effect_object)
	self.character_id = id
	self.character_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_character_data(self.character_id)
	self.spawn_tile_index = index

	self.character = nil
	self.effect_object = effect_object
	self.object_type = 'star_piece'
end

-- 턴종료 시 status를 action_end로 변경 및 틴트 값 변경
function local_class:turn_end()
	local duration = sgw_constants_manager.get_turn_end_alpha_duration()
	self:change_tint_color(0.3, duration)
	self:change_state(self.character_state.action_end)
	self.current_direction = self.moving_direction
end

function local_class:change_tint_color(target_alpha, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.change_tint_color_routine, self, target_alpha, duration))
end

-- 캐릭터 색 변경
function local_class:change_tint_color_routine(target_alpha, duration)
	if self.character == nil then
		return
	end

	local custom_sprite = self.character.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	local start_color = custom_sprite.TintColor
	local time_passed = 0

	self.change_tint_color_req_id = self.change_tint_color_req_id + 1
	local req_id = self.change_tint_color_req_id

	while time_passed < duration and req_id == self.change_tint_color_req_id do
		if custom_sprite == nil then
			return
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		local value = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_color.r, target_alpha, progress)
		custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ value, value, value, 1 })
		custom_sprite:Rebuild()

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if custom_sprite == nil then
		return
	end

	custom_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ target_alpha, target_alpha, target_alpha, 1 })
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 사망시 캐릭터 poolObject dispose
function local_class:dead()
	if self.character ~= nil then
		self.character:Dispose()
		self.character = nil
	end
end

function local_class:drop_item()
	if self.drop_item_type == nil or self.cached_drop_item == nil then
		return
	end

	-- 퍼플코인일 때
	if self.drop_item_type == 'purple_coin' then
		local offset = vector(0, 0, -0.5)
		self.cached_drop_item.transform.position = self:get_position() + offset

		local shadow = self.cached_drop_item.transform:Find('shadow')
		shadow.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		local custom_sprite = self.cached_drop_item.transform:Find('item'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		local vps = CS.ViewportScaler.Instance

		-- 슈가대 미니게임에서 사용하는 카메라에는 ViewportScaler가 붙어있지 않아서, 퍼플 코인 크기가 약간 찌그러져서 나옴.
		-- CustomSprite의 Scale에 ViewPortScaleY만큼을 곱해줘, 정상적인 크기로 보이게끔 수정
		custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(0.9, vps.ViewportScaleY * 0.9)
		custom_sprite.SortingOrder = 20
		custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.cached_drop_item.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		message_system:Send(self.cached_drop_item.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))
	elseif self.drop_item_type == 'star_piece' then
		-- 스타피스 일 때
		if not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.cached_drop_item.Name) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_star_piece_routine, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_star_piece_routine()
	-- 스타피스 획득 연출
	local star_piece_get = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_get'):Instantiate(self.character.transform.position)
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(star_piece_get.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	-- 획득 처리
	message_system:Send(self.cached_drop_item.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	wait_for_sec(1.35)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(star_piece_get.transform, 'Default')
end

function local_class:drop_star_piece()
	if self.object_type == nil or self.object_type ~= 'star_piece' then
		return
	end
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.drop_star_piece_routine, self))
end

function local_class:drop_star_piece_routine()
	-- 스타피스 이팩트 제거
	local effect_pos = self.effect_object.transform.position
	self.effect_object:Dispose()
	self.effect_object = nil

	-- 스타피스 획득 연출
	local star_piece_get = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_get'):Instantiate(effect_pos)
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(star_piece_get.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	-- 획득 처리
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.character_data.name)
	message_system:Send(star_piece.FieldObjectBehaviour, CS.Oak.GotCrashedEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	wait_for_sec(1.35)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(star_piece_get.transform, 'Default')
end

function local_class:directing_move(pos, move_speed)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_routine, self, pos, move_speed, 'directing_move'))
end

function local_class:move_routine(pos, move_speed, move_end_param, end_delay)
	local start_pos = self.character.transform.position
	local start_tile = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_pos(start_pos)
	local target_y = sgw_constants_manager.get_corrected_character_pos_y()
	local end_pos = vector(pos.x, target_y, pos.z)
	local end_tile = sgw_tile_manager.get_tile_info_by_pos(end_pos)

	local start1 = start_tile.center + ((vector(start_tile.right.x, 0, start_tile.top.z) - start_tile.center) * 100)
	local start2 = start_tile.center + ((vector(start_tile.left.x, 0, start_tile.bottom.z) - start_tile.center) * 100)
	local end1 = end_tile.center + ((vector(end_tile.right.x, 0, end_tile.bottom.z) - end_tile.center) * 100)
	local end2 = end_tile.center + ((vector(end_tile.left.x, 0, end_tile.top.z) - end_tile.center) * 100)

	local a = start2.z - start1.z
	local b = start1.x - start2.x
	local e = (a * start1.x) + (b * start1.z)

	local c = end2.z - end1.z
	local d = end1.x - end2.x
	local f = (c * end1.x) + (d * end1.z)

	local de = (a * d) - (b * c)
	local explaining_x = ((e * d) - (b * f)) / de
	local explaining_z = ((a * f) - (e * c)) / de
	local explaining_pos = vector(explaining_x, target_y, explaining_z)

	local explaining = true
	if explaining_pos == start_pos or explaining_pos == end_pos then
		explaining_pos = start_pos
		explaining = false
	end

	local custom_sprite = self.character.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	if explaining then
		self.moving_direction = self:get_direction(start_pos, explaining_pos)
		self:rebuild_sprite(custom_sprite, self.moving_direction)
	end

	local move_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().move_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(move_sfx_name)

	local time_passed = 0.0
	local move_time = (explaining_pos - start_pos).magnitude / move_speed
	if explaining then
		while time_passed <= move_time do
			local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.x, explaining_pos.x - start_pos.x, move_time)
			local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, start_pos.z, explaining_pos.z - start_pos.z, move_time)
			self.character.transform.position = vector(x, target_y, z)
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end

	self.moving_direction = self:get_direction(explaining_pos, end_pos)
	self:rebuild_sprite(custom_sprite, self.moving_direction)
	time_passed = 0.0
	move_time = (end_pos - explaining_pos).magnitude / move_speed
	while time_passed <= move_time do
		local x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, explaining_pos.x, end_pos.x - explaining_pos.x, move_time)
		local z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(time_passed, explaining_pos.z, end_pos.z - explaining_pos.z, move_time)
		self.character.transform.position = vector(x, target_y, z)
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	custom_sprite:Rebuild()
	self.character.transform.position = end_pos
	sgw_tile_manager.move_object(self, sgw_tile_manager.get_collide_tile_index(end_pos))

	end_delay = lua_helper.get_or_default(end_delay, 0)
	wait_for_sec(end_delay)

	move_end_param = lua_helper.get_or_default(move_end_param, 'move_end')
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { move_end_param }))
end

	custom_sprite.SpriteName = self:get_sprite_name_by_direction(direction)

	custom_sprite.IgnoreOriginalSize = false
	custom_sprite:Rebuild()
end

function local_class:get_direction(start_pos, target_pos)
	if start_pos.x < target_pos.x and start_pos.z >= target_pos.z then
		return 'front_right'
	elseif start_pos.x < target_pos.x and start_pos.z < target_pos.z then
		return 'back_right'
	elseif start_pos.x >= target_pos.x and start_pos.z >= target_pos.z then
		return 'front_left'
	elseif start_pos.x >= target_pos.x and start_pos.z < target_pos.z then
		return 'back_left'
	end

	return 'front_right'
end

function local_class:get_sprite_name_by_direction(direction)
	if direction == 'front_left' or direction == 'front_right' then
		return self:get_sprite_name() .. '_f.png'

sgw_constants_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsConstantsManager')

local battle_ui_object
local battle_ui
local recovery_ui_object
local recovery_ui

local heal_animation

local get_heal_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_heal_a') end

-- 바 등장 이후 회복 연출 까지 대기 시간
local recovery_wait_time = 0.2

-- 회복 연출 시간
local recovery_direct_time = 0.4

-- 회복 연출 후 대기하는 시간
local recovery_end_delay_time = 0.2

-- 퇴각 대사 보여주고 있는가?
local is_show_retreat_dialog = false

local res_holder

local global_dialogue_holder

-- 스킬 연출에 필요한 리소스 로드
local function load_resource()
	if is_unity_null(res_holder) then
		res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	-- 적, 아군 HP / EN Bar, 다이얼로그 UI
	coroutine.yield(res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI'), function(p)
		battle_ui_object = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
		battle_ui_object:SetActive(false)

		battle_ui = battle_ui_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI))
	end))

	-- 회복 게이지 / 수치 UI
	coroutine.yield(res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName('ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'SuperGuardianWarsRecovery'), function(p)
		recovery_ui_object = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)

		recovery_ui = recovery_ui_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsRecovery))
	end))

	coroutine.yield()
	recovery_ui_object:SetActive(false)

	-- 이펙트
	get_heal_effect()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

local function dispose()
	if not is_unity_null(res_holder) then
		res_holder:Dispose()
		res_holder = nil
	end

	if battle_ui_object then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(battle_ui_object)
		battle_ui_object = nil
	end

	if recovery_ui_object then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(recovery_ui_object)
		recovery_ui_object = nil
	end

	if global_dialogue_holder then
		global_dialogue_holder:Stop()
		global_dialogue_holder = nil
	end
end

--region skill_damage
local play_skill_damage_routine

local function play_skill_damage(damage)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(play_skill_damage_routine, damage))
end

function play_skill_damage_routine(damage)
	local widget = recovery_ui_object.transform:Find('Recovery')
	widget.transform.localPosition = vector(0, -180, 0)

	local hp_label = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(recovery_ui_object.transform, 'Hp Label')
	local en_label = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(recovery_ui_object.transform, 'En Label')
	local hp_damage_label = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(recovery_ui_object.transform, 'Hp Damage Label')
	hp_label.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	en_label.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	hp_damage_label.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local hp_ui = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(recovery_ui_object.transform, 'Hp Box')
	hp_ui.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	recovery_ui:DisableEnUI(true)
	recovery_ui_object:SetActive(true)

	-- 데미지 수치 애니메이션
	hp_damage_label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	hp_damage_label.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5
	hp_damage_label:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UILabel)).text = tostring(damage)

	local label_offset = vector(0, 16, 0)
	local hp_label_start_position = vector(0, 60, 0)
	local hp_label_end_position = hp_label_start_position + label_offset

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 2

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local hp_label_position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(hp_label_start_position, hp_label_end_position, progress)

		hp_damage_label.localPosition = hp_label_position

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	hp_damage_label.localPosition = hp_label_end_position

	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 종료
	hp_damage_label.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	hp_ui.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	hp_label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	en_label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	hp_damage_label.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	recovery_ui_object:SetActive(false)
end
--endregion

--region skill
local play_skill_routine
local change_invader_sprite
local play_skill_voice_routine

local function get_skill_voice_name(skill_data)
	local is_language_base = skill_data.voice_sfx.is_language_base

	if is_language_base then
		local current_voice_language = music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage
		return skill_data.voice_sfx[current_voice_language]
	end

	return skill_data.voice_sfx['ko']
end

local function play_skill_voice(voice_id, voice_type)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(play_skill_voice_routine, voice_id, voice_type))
end

function play_skill_voice_routine(voice_id, voiceType)
	-- 실제 voice play로 구현 변경
	xlua.private_accessible(CS.Oak.MusicPlayer)

	-- 소리 강제로 키워줌
	local success, org_volume = CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance.masterMixer:GetFloat('VoiceVolume')
	if not success then
		-- db 이므로 0 이 우리 볼륨 100% 임.
		org_volume = 0
	end

	-- 볼륨 조정 [-80, 20]
	local changed_volume = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(org_volume + sgw_constants_manager.get_add_voice_volume(), -80, 20)
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance.masterMixer:SetFloat('VoiceVolume', changed_volume)

	-- 보이스 재생
	local audio_source_holder = music_player:PlayVoice(voice_id, 0, voiceType)

	-- 재생 완료 기다림
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	while audio_source_holder.IsUsing do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 볼륨 원래대로 돌려줌
	CS.Oak.MusicPlayer.Instance.masterMixer:SetFloat('VoiceVolume', org_volume)
end

local function play_skill(attacker, defender, skill_data, is_controlled_event, is_change_bgm, fade_time)
	-- AnimationEvent를 처리하는 함수
	local event_listener = {}
	event_listener.on_event = function(_, e)
		if e.EventName == 'waiting' then
			local portrait_name = attacker:get_portrait_name()

			battle_ui.dialog:SetNameLabel(game_string:GetString(attacker:get_name()))
			battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait(portrait_name.idle)
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel('')
		elseif e.EventName == 'attack_dialog' then
			local portrait_name = attacker:get_portrait_name()

			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString(skill_data.attack_string))
			if portrait_name.attack then
				battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait(portrait_name.attack)
			end

			global_dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(skill_data.attack_string)
			-- FIXME : 기본 보이스 처리하던 방식 남겨둠, 추후 다이얼로그 방식으로 일원화 하는게 좋을 듯..
			if global_dialogue_holder == nil then
				local skill_voice_name = get_skill_voice_name(skill_data)
				local is_play_voice_channel = skill_data.voice_sfx.is_play_voice_channel
				if skill_voice_name then
					if is_play_voice_channel then
						-- FIXME: 보이스 채널 사용하면 무조건 보이스id 및 타입 데이터 제대로 넣었다고 가정함.
						play_skill_voice(skill_data.voice_sfx.voice_id, skill_data.voice_sfx.voice_type)
					else
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(skill_voice_name)
					end
				end
			end
		elseif e.EventName == 'attack' then
			if attacker:is_ally() then
				battle_ui.myInfo:DecreaseEn(skill_data.energy)
			else
				battle_ui.enemyInfo:DecreaseEn(skill_data.energy)
			end
		elseif e.EventName == 'hit' then
			if defender:is_ally() then
				battle_ui.myInfo:DecreaseHp(skill_data.attack)
			else
				battle_ui.enemyInfo:DecreaseHp(skill_data.attack)
			end
			play_skill_damage(skill_data.attack)
		elseif e.EventName == 'hit_dialog' then
			local portrait_name = defender:get_portrait_name()

			battle_ui.dialog:SetNameLabel(game_string:GetString(defender:get_name()))
			if portrait_name.damaged then
				battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait(portrait_name.damaged)
			else
				battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait(portrait_name.idle)
			end

			local hit_string = defender:get_hit_string()
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString(hit_string))

			global_dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(hit_string)
			-- FIXME : 기본 보이스 처리하던 방식 남겨둠, 추후 다이얼로그 방식으로 일원화 하는게 좋을 듯..
			if global_dialogue_holder == nil then
				local hit_sfx_name = defender:get_hit_sfx_name()
				if hit_sfx_name then
					if defender:is_hit_sfx_play_voice_channel() then
						-- FIXME: 보이스 채널 재생의 경우 voice id, type 데이터 있다고 가정
						play_skill_voice(defender:get_hit_voice_data())
					else
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(hit_sfx_name)
					end
				end
			end
		elseif e.EventName == 'destroy' then
			battle_ui.dialog:SetNoiseActive(true)
			local destroy_string = defender:get_destroy_string()
			battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabel(game_string:GetString(destroy_string))

			global_dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(destroy_string)
			-- FIXME : 기본 보이스 처리하던 방식 남겨둠, 추후 다이얼로그 방식으로 일원화 하는게 좋을 듯..
			if global_dialogue_holder == nil then
				local die_sfx_name = defender:get_die_sfx_name()
				if die_sfx_name then
					if defender:is_die_sfx_play_voice_channel() then
						-- FIXME: 보이스 채널 재생의 경우 voice id, type 데이터 있다고 가정
						play_skill_voice(defender:get_die_voice_data())
					else
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(die_sfx_name)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- generate cs enumerator
	local cs_enumerator = util.cs_generator(play_skill_routine, event_listener, attacker, defender, skill_data, is_controlled_event, is_change_bgm, fade_time)
	-- convert to custom coroutine class
	local c = coroutine_class.coroutine(stage.StageGameObject, cs_enumerator)
	-- attach finally method
	c:Finally(function()
		-- unsubscribe AnimationEvent one more (defend exception occured in coroutine)
		message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_event')
		event_listener.on_event = nil
		global_dialogue_holder = nil
	end)
	-- start coroutine
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(c)
end

function play_skill_routine(event_listener, attacker, defender, skill_data, is_controlled_event, is_change_bgm, fade_time)
	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_async(fade_time, unity_class.color.black)

	message_system:Subscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_event')

	-- SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI를 활성화
	battle_ui_object:SetActive(true)

	-- HP, EN 수치 세팅
	if attacker:is_ally() then
		battle_ui.myInfo:InitHpBar(attacker:get_hp(), attacker:get_max_hp(), attacker:get_energy(), attacker:get_max_energy())
		battle_ui.enemyInfo:InitHpBar(defender:get_hp(), defender:get_max_hp(), defender:get_energy(), defender:get_max_energy())
	else
		battle_ui.myInfo:InitHpBar(defender:get_hp(), defender:get_max_hp(), defender:get_energy(), defender:get_max_energy())
		battle_ui.enemyInfo:InitHpBar(attacker:get_hp(), attacker:get_max_hp(), attacker:get_energy(), attacker:get_max_energy())
	end

	-- 실제 공격하는 캐릭터와, 공격 받는 캐릭터의 HP/EN 수치 감소
	attacker:decrease_energy(skill_data.energy)
	defender:decrease_hp(skill_data.attack)

	-- 스킬 애니메이션 프리팹을 로드
	local res_holder_skill = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local go = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder_skill, skill_data.bundle_name, skill_data.asset_name)
	go.transform.position = vector(500, 0, 500)

	local skill_sfx_name = skill_data.sfx
	if skill_sfx_name then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(skill_sfx_name)
	end

	-- 페이드 인
	wait_for_sec(fade_time)
	if is_change_bgm then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = skill_data.bgm, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	end
	screen_util.fade_in_async(fade_time, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 스킬 애니메이션 공격 캐릭터와 방어 캐릭터 스프라이트 변경
	local scene_hit = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(go.transform, 'scene_hit')
	local hit_defender_sprite = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(scene_hit.transform, 'battle_character'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsBattleCharacter))
	change_invader_sprite(hit_defender_sprite, defender:get_sprite_name())

	-- 스킬 애니메이션이 끝날 때 까지 대기
	local animator = go.transform.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	-- 피격 캐릭터 체력이 0 이하가 되면, 터지는 연출이 작동하도록 파라미터 변경
	if defender:get_hp() <= 0 then
		animator:SetBool('IsDead', true)

		local scene_shutdown = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(go.transform, 'shutdown')
		local shutdown_defender_sprite = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(scene_shutdown.transform, 'battle_character'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.SuperGuardianWarsBattleCharacter))
		change_invader_sprite(shutdown_defender_sprite, defender:get_sprite_name())
	end

	local is_play_destroy_sfx = false
	while animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0).normalizedTime < 1 do
		if not is_play_destroy_sfx and animator:GetCurrentAnimatorStateInfo(0):IsName('shutdown') then
			is_play_destroy_sfx = true

			local destroy_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().destroy_sfx_name
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(destroy_sfx_name)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	-- 다이얼로그 보이스가 출력되는 동안 대기
	if global_dialogue_holder then
		while global_dialogue_holder.IsUsing do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black)

	-- 애니메이션이 모두 끝나면, 오브젝트를 파괴함
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(go)
	res_holder_skill:Dispose()

	-- 전투가 끝났으므로, SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI를 비활성화
	battle_ui.dialog:SetNoiseActive(false)
	battle_ui_object:SetActive(false)

	message_system:Unsubscribe(event_listener, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_event')

	screen_util.fade_in_async(fade_time, unity_class.color.black)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'TurnEnd' }))
	if is_controlled_event then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'directing_skill' }))
	end
end

function change_invader_sprite(sprite, name)
	if name == 'builder' then
		sprite:SetSprite(0)
	elseif name == 'invader_fighter' then
		sprite:SetSprite(1)
	elseif name == 'invader_fighter_leader' then
		sprite:SetSprite(2)
	elseif name == 'invader_mothership' then
		sprite:SetSprite(3)
	elseif name == 'iron_teatan' then
		sprite:SetSprite(4)
	elseif name == 'sweeper' then
		sprite:SetSprite(5)
	elseif name == 'heavenhold' then
		sprite:SetSprite(6)
	end
end

local play_block_routine

local function play_block(blocker, is_controlled_event)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(play_block_routine, blocker, is_controlled_event))
end

function play_block_routine(blocker, is_controlled_event)
	-- 방어 했을 때, 회복하는 HP, Energy 수치
	local increase_hp = blocker:get_block_recovery_hp()
	local increase_energy = blocker:get_block_recovery_energy()

	local end_event_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_controlled_event, 'directing_block', nil)
	yield_return_func(heal_animation, blocker, increase_hp, increase_energy, end_event_name)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(play_heal_routine, healer, target, skill_id, is_controlled_event))

function play_heal_routine(healer, target, skill_id, is_controlled_event)
	local skill_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_skill_data(skill_id)

	-- 방어 했을 때, 회복하는 HP, Energy 수치
	local increase_hp = skill_data.hp

	healer:decrease_energy(skill_data.energy)

	local end_event_name = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(is_controlled_event, 'directing_heal', nil)
	yield_return_func(heal_animation, target, increase_hp, nil, end_event_name)
end

--region heal_animation
function heal_animation(character, increase_hp, increase_energy, event_name)
	-- HP, EN 수치 세팅
	local hp = character:get_hp()
	local max_hp = character:get_max_hp()
	recovery_ui.HpBarProgress = hp / max_hp

	if increase_energy then
		local en = character:get_energy()
		local max_en = character:get_max_energy()
		recovery_ui.EnBarProgress = en / max_en
	end

	-- 실제 회복하는 캐릭터의 HP/EN 수치 증가
	if increase_energy then
		character:increase_energy(increase_energy)
	end
	character:increase_hp(increase_hp)

	-- 회복 이펙트 표시
	local heal_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().heal_sfx_name
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(heal_sfx_name)

	local target_character = character:get_character()
	local fx_heal = get_heal_effect():Instantiate(target_character.transform.localPosition, unity_class.quaternion.identity, target_character.transform)
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(fx_heal.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- UI를 캐릭터 위치로 이동
	local wts = character:get_world_to_screen_position()
	local widget = recovery_ui_object.transform:Find('Recovery')
	widget.transform.position = vector_util.get_xy0(CS.UICamera.mainCamera:ScreenToWorldPoint(wts))
	widget.transform.localPosition = widget.transform.localPosition + vector(0, -125, 0)

	local hp_label = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(recovery_ui_object.transform, 'Hp Label')
	local en_label = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(recovery_ui_object.transform, 'En Label')
	hp_label.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	en_label.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	if increase_energy then
		recovery_ui:DisableEnUI(false)
	else
		recovery_ui:DisableEnUI(true)
	end
	recovery_ui_object:SetActive(true)

	-- HP/EN 바만 키고 recovery_wait_time 시간 만큼 대기한다
	wait_for_sec(recovery_wait_time)

	-- HP/EN Bar 애니메이션 재생
	local prev_hp_progress = recovery_ui.HpBarProgress
	local prev_en_progress = recovery_ui.EnBarProgress
	local next_hp_progress = character:get_hp() / character:get_max_hp()
	local next_en_progress = character:get_energy() / character:get_max_energy()

	-- HP / EN 라벨 오브젝트 활성화
	local en_default_pos = vector(84, 65, 0)
	if increase_energy then
		en_label.localPosition = en_default_pos
		en_label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	end
	hp_label.gameObject:SetActive(true)
	hp_label.localPosition = increase_energy ~= nil and vector(84, 95, 0) or en_default_pos

	local heal_animation_sfx_name = sgw_constants_manager.get_sfx_name_list().heal_animation_sfx_name
	local count_number_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = heal_animation_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = recovery_direct_time

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		local now_hp_progress = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(prev_hp_progress, next_hp_progress, progress)
		local now_recovery_hp = increase_hp * progress
		recovery_ui.HpBarProgress = now_hp_progress
		recovery_ui.HpLabel = '+' .. tostring(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(now_recovery_hp))

		if increase_energy then
			local now_en_progress = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(prev_en_progress, next_en_progress, progress)
			local now_recovery_en = increase_energy * progress
			recovery_ui.EnBarProgress = now_en_progress
			recovery_ui.EnLabel = '+' .. tostring(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(now_recovery_en))
		end

		coroutine.yield()
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	count_number_sfx:Stop()

	recovery_ui.HpBarProgress = next_hp_progress
	recovery_ui.HpLabel = '+' .. tostring(increase_hp)
	if increase_energy then
		recovery_ui.EnBarProgress = next_en_progress
		recovery_ui.EnLabel = '+' .. tostring(increase_energy)
	end

	wait_for_sec(recovery_end_delay_time)

	-- 종료
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(fx_heal.transform, 'Default')
	recovery_ui:DisableEnUI(false)
	recovery_ui_object:SetActive(false)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'TurnEnd' }))
	if event_name then
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { event_name }))
	end
end

-- 퇴각 다이얼로그
local function show_retreat_dialog(character)
	battle_ui:SetActiveUnitInfo(false)

	-- SuperGuardianWarsBattleUI를 활성화
	local portrait_name = character:get_portrait_name()

	battle_ui_object:SetActive(true)
	battle_ui.dialog:SetNameLabel(game_string:GetString(character:get_name()))
	if portrait_name.damaged then
		battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait(portrait_name.damaged)
	else
		battle_ui.dialog:SetPortrait(portrait_name.idle)
	end

	-- 후퇴(퇴각) 보이스 or sfx
	local dialogue_key = character:get_retreat_string()
	local dialogue_holder = music_player:PlayDialogue(dialogue_key)
	if dialogue_holder == nil then
		local retreat_sfx_name = character:get_retreat_sfx_name()
		if retreat_sfx_name then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(retreat_sfx_name)
		end
	end

	local dialog_string = game_string:GetString(dialogue_key)
	local type_speed = sgw_constants_manager.get_dialog_typing_speed()
	local dialog_string_len = string.len(dialog_string)
	battle_ui.dialog:SetDialogLabelTyping(dialog_string, type_speed)

	local time_passed = 0
	local type_duration = dialog_string_len * type_speed + 2
	is_show_retreat_dialog = true
	while time_passed < type_duration or (dialogue_holder ~= nil and dialogue_holder.IsUsing) do
		if not is_show_retreat_dialog then
			if dialogue_holder ~= nil then
				dialogue_holder:Stop()
			end
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	battle_ui.dialog:SetNoiseActive(false)
	battle_ui_object:SetActive(false)
	battle_ui:SetActiveUnitInfo(true)
end

local function get_is_typing()
	return battle_ui.IsTyping
end

local function skip_retreat_dialog()
	battle_ui:SkipTyping()
end

local function hide_retreat_dialog()
	is_show_retreat_dialog = false
end

return {
	load_resource = load_resource,
	dispose = dispose,
	play_skill = play_skill,
	play_block = play_block,
	play_heal = play_heal,
	get_is_typing = get_is_typing,
	show_retreat_dialog = show_retreat_dialog,
	skip_retreat_dialog = skip_retreat_dialog,
	hide_retreat_dialog = hide_retreat_dialog,
}

sgw_constants_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.CreateGlobalVariable('minigame/SuperGuardianWars/SuperGuardianWarsConstantsManager')

local tile_x_size
local tile_z_size
local tile_x_count
local tile_z_count

local tile_line_color = unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 0.1 })
local tile_green_color = unity_color({ 0.04705882, 0.4901961, 0.2235294, 0.8 })
local tile_red_color = unity_color({ 0.7215686, 0.06666667, 0.06666667, 0.8 })

local background
local tiles = {}
local tile_line = {}
local active_tiles = {}
local ban_tile_index_list = {}
local custom_atlas

local res_holder

local function init_data()
	local constants_data = sgw_constants_manager.get_constants_data()
	tile_x_size = constants_data.tile_x_size
	tile_z_size = constants_data.tile_z_size
	tile_x_count = constants_data.tile_x_count
	tile_z_count = constants_data.tile_z_count
	ban_tile_index_list = constants_data.ban_tile_index_list
end

local function create_end_tile_object(tile_info, sprite_name, tint_color, sorting_order)
	local object_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(tile_info.center + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(object_pool.transform, 'SpecialEvents')

	local custom_sprite = object_pool.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	custom_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
	custom_sprite.LocalScale = vector(3.1225, 2.21)
	custom_sprite.SpriteName = sprite_name
	custom_sprite.TintColor = tint_color
	custom_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
	custom_sprite.SortingOrder = sorting_order
	custom_sprite:Rebuild(true)

	return object_pool
end

local function create_tile()
	init_data()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	if is_unity_null(res_holder) then
		res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync(res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/super_guardian_wars/theatre', 'super_guardian_wars', function(prefab)
		background = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
	end))

	-- 슈가대 background plane에 씌울 sprite 이미지 파일을 동적 로드(bytes)
	local asset_bundle_path = 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/super_guardian_wars/theatre'
	local info = {
		target_name = 'srw_map_sky_bg',
		asset_name = 'srw_map_sky_bg.jpg',
		layer_name = 'Under Effects',
		order = 0,
		need_loading = true
	}

	local asset_bundle
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance.LoadAssetBundleAsync,
		CS.Foundations.AssetBundleManager.Instance, asset_bundle_path, function(res)
			asset_bundle = res
		end)

	if info.need_loading then
		local target_obj = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(background.transform, 'Plane').gameObject

		yield_return_func(asset_bundle.LoadAssetAsync, asset_bundle, info.asset_name, function(texture_bytes)
			if texture_bytes then
				local texture = CS.UnityEngine.Texture2D(2, 2, CS.UnityEngine.TextureFormat.RGBA32, false)
				texture.wrapMode = CS.UnityEngine.TextureWrapMode.Clamp
				if CS.UnityEngine.ImageConversion.LoadImage(texture, texture_bytes.bytes, true) then
					local rect = CS.UnityEngine.Rect(0, 0, texture.width, texture.height)
					-- 텍스쳐를 스프라이트로 생성
					local sprite = CS.UnityEngine.Sprite.Create(texture,
						rect,
						vector(0.5, 0.5),
						100,
						0,
						CS.UnityEngine.SpriteMeshType.Tight,
						unity_class.vector4.zero,
						false)

					-- 새 오브젝트를 만들어서 SpriteRenderer를 붙여줌
					local sprite_renderer = CS.GameObjectExtensions.GetOrAddComponent(target_obj,
						typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))

					if sprite_renderer then
						sprite_renderer.sprite = sprite
						sprite_renderer.sortingLayerName = info.layer_name
						sprite_renderer.sortingOrder = info.order
					end

					CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(target_obj.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync(res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_15_demonworld/ui', 'srw_ui_custom', function(prefab)
		custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
		custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end))

	for i = 1, tile_z_count do
		for j = 1, tile_x_count do
			local tile_info = { center, top, bottom, left, right, object }
			local tile_x_half_size = tile_x_size * 0.5
			local tile_z_half_size = tile_z_size * 0.5

			tile_info.center = vector((j - i) * tile_x_half_size, 0, (j + i) * tile_z_half_size)
			tile_info.left = vector(tile_info.center.x - tile_x_half_size, 0, tile_info.center.z)
			tile_info.top = vector(tile_info.center.x, 0, tile_info.center.z - tile_z_half_size)
			tile_info.right = vector(tile_info.center.x + tile_x_half_size, 0, tile_info.center.z)
			tile_info.bottom = vector(tile_info.center.x, 0, tile_info.center.z + tile_z_half_size)
			table.insert(tiles, tile_info)

			-- 라인 타일 그리기
			local tile_object = create_end_tile_object(tile_info, 'srw_ui_tile_grid_00.png',
					tile_line_color, 1)
			table.insert(tile_line, tile_object)

			--TODO: 나중에 디버그 모드 필요할 때 주석 해제
			--if sgw_constants_manager.is_debug_mode() then
			--end
		end
	end
end

local function is_collide_triangle(a, b, c, p)
	local edge1 = b - a
	local edge2 = c - a
	local normal = unity_class.vector3.Cross(edge1, edge2).normalized

	local ev0 = b - a
	local ev1 = c - b
	local ev2 = c - a

	local n0 = unity_class.vector3.Cross(normal, ev0)
	local n1 = unity_class.vector3.Cross(normal, ev1)
	local n2 = unity_class.vector3.Cross(normal, ev2)

	local g = p - a
	local def = unity_class.vector3.Dot(n0, ev2) * unity_class.vector3.Dot(n0, g)
	if def < 0 then
		return false
	end

	g = p - b
	def = unity_class.vector3.Dot(n1, -ev0) * unity_class.vector3.Dot(n1, g)
	if def < 0 then
		return false
	end

	g = p - c
	def = unity_class.vector3.Dot(n2, ev0) * unity_class.vector3.Dot(n2, g)
	if def < 0 then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

local function is_equal_floor_tile(current_tile_index, target_tile_index)
	local current_tile_floor = math.floor((current_tile_index - 1) / tile_x_count)
	local target_tile_floor = math.floor((target_tile_index - 1) / tile_x_count)
	return current_tile_floor == target_tile_floor
end

local function get_collide_tile_index(pos)
	for i = 1, #tiles do
		local tile_info = tiles[i]
		if is_collide_triangle(tile_info.left, tile_info.top, tile_info.right, pos) then
			return i
		end

		if is_collide_triangle(tile_info.left, tile_info.right, tile_info.bottom, pos) then
			return i
		end
	end

	return -1
end

local function get_tile_index_range(index, range)
	if index == -1 or index > #tiles then
		return nil
	end

	local available_tiles = {}
	local current_range = range
	for _ = 1, range + 1 do
		local center_index = index - ((range - current_range) * tile_x_count)
		local current_index = center_index - current_range
		for _ = 1, current_range * 2 + 1 do
			local center_floor = math.floor((center_index - 1) / tile_x_count)
			local current_floor = math.floor((current_index - 1) / tile_x_count)
			if current_index > 0 and current_index <= #tiles and center_floor == current_floor then
				table.insert(available_tiles, current_index)
			end

			current_index = current_index + 1
		end

		current_range = current_range - 1
	end

	current_range = range - 1
	for _ = 1, range do
		local center_index = index + ((range - current_range) * tile_x_count)
		local current_index = center_index - current_range
		for _ = 1, current_range * 2 + 1 do
			local center_floor = math.floor((center_index - 1) / tile_x_count)
			local current_floor = math.floor((current_index - 1) / tile_x_count)
			if current_index > 0 and current_index <= #tiles and center_floor == current_floor then
				table.insert(available_tiles, current_index)
			end

			current_index = current_index + 1
		end

		current_range = current_range - 1
	end

	return available_tiles
end

local function get_tile_position(index)
	if index == -1 then
		return vector(0, 0, 0)
	end

local get_move_able_tile
function get_move_able_tile(current_index, target_index)
	-- 이동 하려는 타일과, 현재 타일의 index가 같다면(제자리 라면) 그대로 반환 시켜준다
	if current_index == target_index then
		return target_index
	end

	-- 이동 하려는 타일의 위치에 캐릭터가 있는지 검사
	-- 캐릭터가 있다면, 이동할 수 없는 타일 이므로 그 이전 타일을 탐색한다.
	local tile_info = tiles[target_index]
	if tile_info.object == nil then
		return target_index
	end

	-- index를 x/y 좌표로 치환
	local index_to_pos = function(index) return vector(math.floor(index / tile_x_count), index % tile_x_count) end
	local current_pos = index_to_pos(current_index)
	local target_pos = index_to_pos(target_index)

	-- 이동 하려는 방향의 반대 방향의 타일 index를 찾아서, 해당 타일이 이동 가능한지 계속해서 탐색
	local direction = (target_pos - current_pos).normalized
	local index_offset = 0

	if math.abs(direction.x) > math.abs(direction.y) then
		if direction.x > 0 then
			index_offset = -tile_x_count
		else
			index_offset = tile_x_count
		end
	else
		if direction.y > 0 then
			index_offset = -1
		else
			index_offset = 1
		end
	end

	return get_move_able_tile(current_index, target_index + index_offset)
end

local function get_spawn_able_tile(current_index)
	-- 서치 순서 앞으로 한칸, 뒤로 한칸, 왼쪽 같은 라인 타일, 오른쪽 같은 라인 타일
	local search_index_list = { 1, -1, tile_x_count, -tile_x_count }

	local is_not_search_tile = false
	while not is_not_search_tile do
		for i = 1, #search_index_list do
			local search_index = current_index + search_index_list[i]

			-- 앞 뒤 타일을 검사할 때는 같은 라인에 있을 때만 검사한다.
			local is_valid = true
			if i < 2 then
				is_valid = is_equal_floor_tile(current_index, search_index)
			end

			if is_valid then
				-- 서치 인덱스가 타일 사이즈보다 작을때만 확인
				if search_index <= #tiles then
					local target_tile = tiles[search_index]
					if target_tile.object == nil then
						return target_tile
					end
				else
					is_not_search_tile = true
				end
			end
			search_index_list[i] = search_index_list[i] + (i % 2 == 0 and -1 or 1)
		end
	end

	-- 만약 못찾게 된다면 nil 리턴
	return nil
end

-- 스폰할 때 타일의 좌표를 가져오기위한 함수
local function get_spawn_tile_position(index)
	if index == -1 then
		return vector(0, 0, 0)
	end

	local tile = tiles[index]
	-- 타일에 오브젝트(캐릭터)가 존재하지 않을 때 해당 타일의 센터를 리턴한다.
	if tile.object == nil then
		return tile.center
	end

	local spawn_able_tile = get_spawn_able_tile(index)
	if spawn_able_tile == nil then
		return vector(0, 0, 0)
	end

	-- 주변 다른 타일에서 스폰이 가능한 위치를 찾아 리턴한다
	return spawn_able_tile.center
end

local function get_character(index)
	if index == -1 then
		return nil
	end

	return tiles[index].object
end

local function get_character_by_pos(pos)
	local index = get_collide_tile_index(pos)
	return get_character(index)
end

local function get_tile_info(index)
	if index > #tiles then
		return nil
	end

	return tiles[index]
end

local function get_tile_info_by_pos(pos)
	local index = get_collide_tile_index(pos)
	if index == -1 then
		return nil
	end

	return tiles[index]
end

local function get_tile_info_by_character(character)
	local index = get_tile_index_by_character(character)
	if index == -1 then
		return nil
	end

	return tiles[index]
end

local function get_character_by_tile_index(index)
	local tile_info = get_tile_info(index)
	if tile_info == nil or tile_info.object == nil then
		return nil
	end

	return tile_info.object
end

local function move_object(object, move_index)
	local tile_index = get_tile_index_by_character(object)
	tiles[tile_index].object = nil
	tiles[move_index].object = object
end

local function add_object(object, index)
	tiles[index].object = object
end

local function dispose()
	for i = #tiles, 1, -1 do
		table.remove(tiles, i)
	end

	for i = #active_tiles, 1, -1 do
		active_tiles[i]:Dispose()
		table.remove(active_tiles, i)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(background) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(background)
		background = nil
	end

	custom_atlas = nil

	if not is_unity_null(res_holder) then
		res_holder:Dispose()
		res_holder = nil
	end
end

local function get_background()
	return background
end

local function get_tile_x_count()
	return tile_x_count
end

return {
	get_background = get_background,
	get_tile_x_count = get_tile_x_count,
	create_tile = create_tile,
	get_collide_tile_index = get_collide_tile_index,
	is_equal_floor_tile = is_equal_floor_tile,
	get_tile_index_range = get_tile_index_range,
	get_tile_index_by_character = get_tile_index_by_character,
	get_movable_tile_index = get_movable_tile_index,
	show_move_tile = show_move_tile,
	get_available_attack_skill_tile_index = get_available_attack_skill_tile_index,
	get_available_heal_skill_tile_index = get_available_heal_skill_tile_index,
	show_attack_tile = show_attack_tile,
	show_heal_tile = show_heal_tile,
	hide_active_tile = hide_active_tile,
	get_tile_position = get_tile_position,
	get_move_able_tile = get_move_able_tile,
	get_spawn_tile_position = get_spawn_tile_position,
	get_character = get_character,

	get_tile_info = get_tile_info,
