-- 유저의 행동 처리
function local_class:player_action()
	if self.freeze_time > 0 then
		return
	end

	self:player_push_action()
	self:player_move_action()
end

-- 조작으로 인한 플레이어 이동
function local_class:player_move_action()
	--이전 위치
	local prev_position = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position)

	--방향키 조작값 받기
	local direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	if self.input_direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = self.input_direction
	end
	self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	-- 입력된 이동이 없거나, 플레이어가 이동중이거나, 상하 이동은 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_player_moving == true
	or direction == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		return
	end

	-- 다음 이동할 곳 찾기
	local direction_vector = self:direction_to_vector(direction)
	self.player_vector = direction_vector
	local next_position = prev_position + direction_vector
	if next_position.x < self.data.stage_x_min or next_position.x > self.data.stage_x_max
	or next_position.z < self.data.stage_z_min or next_position.z > self.data.stage_z_max - 2 then
		return
	end

	-- 이동 방향 쳐다 보기
	if direction_vector.x > 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
		self.push_vector = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif direction_vector.x < 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
		self.push_vector = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	end

	-- 이동할 수 있으면 이동 실행
	self:add_next_position(next_position)
end

-- 밀기 조작
function local_class:player_push_action()
	if self.is_player_moving == true then
		return
	end

	-- 밀기 키 입력
	local push_button_touched = false
	if self.push_button_touched then
		push_button_touched = true
		self.push_button_touched = false
	end

	if push_button_touched == true then
		local leader_position = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position)
		local target_pos = leader_position + self.push_vector
		local target_move_pos = leader_position + self.push_vector + self.push_vector
		local color = self:get_block_grid_color(target_pos.x, target_pos.z)
		if color >= self.data.block_color.color_start and color <= self.data.block_color.color_end
		and self:get_block_grid(target_move_pos.x, target_move_pos.z) == self.data.block_id.empty then
			self:block_move(target_pos.x, target_pos.z, self.push_vector)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.sfx_push_block)
		end

		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'kick'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.sfx_kick)
		self.freeze_time = self.data.freeze_time
	end
end

-- 플레이어가 실제로 이동하는 다음 좌표 구하기
function local_class:add_next_position(next_pos)
	local is_movable = false
	if self:get_block_grid(next_pos.x, next_pos.z) == self.data.block_id.empty then
		is_movable = true
	end

	if is_movable == false then
		return
	end

	self.move_waypoint = {}
	table.insert(self.move_waypoint, vector(next_pos.x, 0, next_pos.z))
	self.is_player_moving = true
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.sfx_player_move, 0.3)
end

--좌표를 정수로 조정
function local_class:round_position(pos)
	return vector(math.floor(pos.x + 0.5), 0, math.floor(pos.z + 0.5))
end

-- 플레이어 이동
function local_class:player_move(dt)
	if self.is_player_moving == false then
		return
	end

	-- 이동 가능 여부 확인
	local target_pos = self.move_waypoint[1]
	if self:get_block_grid(target_pos.x, target_pos.z) > 0 then
		local new_pos = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position)
		-- 좌우 이동 중 막힘
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z <= target_pos.z then
			if self:get_block_grid(new_pos.x, new_pos.z) > 0 then
				if self:get_block_grid(new_pos.x, new_pos.z - 1) == self.data.block_id.empty then
					new_pos = new_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
				else
					self:fail()
				end
			end
		end

		-- 막혀서 이동 취소
		user_party.Leader.Position = new_pos
		self.move_waypoint = {}
		self.is_player_moving = false
		return
	end

	-- 1프레임 이동
	local prev_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
	self:move_by_one_frame(user_party.Leader, target_pos, self.data.player_move_speed, dt)
	local pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	-- 목적지 도착 확인
	if self:IsPointOnLine(prev_pos.x, prev_pos.z, pos.x, pos.z, target_pos.x, target_pos.z) == true then
		table.remove(self.move_waypoint, 1)
	end

	-- 이동 종료
	if #self.move_waypoint == 0 then
		user_party.Leader.Position = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position)
		self.is_player_moving = false
	end
end

-- 프레임당 움직임
function local_class:move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_to, speed, dt)
	local dir = (pos_to - fo.Position).normalized
	if dir == unity_class.vector3.zero then
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * dt)
end

-- 선이 점을 지나는지 확인(chat-gpt)
function local_class:IsPointOnLine(startX, startY, endX, endY, pointX, pointY)
	if startX == endX and endX == pointX
	and startY == endY and endY == pointY then
		return true
	end

	local lineVectorX = endX - startX
	local lineVectorY = endY - startY
	local pointVectorX = pointX - startX
	local pointVectorY = pointY - startY

	local dotProduct = pointVectorX * lineVectorX + pointVectorY * lineVectorY
	local lineLengthSquared = lineVectorX * lineVectorX + lineVectorY * lineVectorY

	-- dot product이 0에서 lineLengthSquared 사이에 있는지 확인
	local epsilon = 1e-6 -- 부동 소수점 정밀도를 고려하여 작은 오차 범위를 설정
	return dotProduct >= 0 and dotProduct <= lineLengthSquared + epsilon
end

-- 방향을 벡터로 변환
function local_class:direction_to_vector(direction)
	local v = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
		v = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) then
		v = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
		v = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
		v = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	return v
end

-- 정해진 시간마다 블럭 처리
function local_class:block_update()
	-- 블럭 낙하
	if self.current_block_progress == self.data.block_progess.fall then
		self.is_block_fall = self:block_fall()
		self:check_erase()
	-- 블럭 지우기
	elseif self.current_block_progress == self.data.block_progess.erase then
		for _, data in ipairs(self.erase_block_list) do
			local x = data.fo.Position.x
			local z = data.fo.Position.z
			self.fo_wrappers:set_active(data.fo, false)
			self:set_block_grid(x, z, self.data.block_id.empty)
		end
		self.erase_block_list = {}
		self.current_block_progress = self.data.block_progess.fall
	end
end

-- 블럭 낙하
function local_class:block_fall()
	local is_move = false

	-- 라인별로 낙하 할 게 있는지 확인
	for x = self.data.stage_x_min, self.data.stage_x_max do
		local is_col_move = false
		for z = self.data.stage_z_min + 1, self.data.stage_z_max do
			if self:get_block_grid(x, z) > 0 and self:get_block_grid(x, z - 1) == self.data.block_id.empty then
				local color = self:get_block_grid_color(x, z)
				self:block_move(x, z, vector(0, 0, -1))
				is_col_move = true

				-- 게임 오버 체크
				local new_pos = vector(x, 0, z - 1)
				if z > user_party.Leader.Position.z and vector_util.distance(user_party.Leader.Position, new_pos) <= 0.2 then
					if self:get_block_grid(new_pos.x, new_pos.z - 1) == self.data.block_id.empty then
						user_party.Leader.Position = new_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)
					else
						self:fail()
					end
				end

				-- 검은 블럭 착지음
				if color == self.data.block_color.black
				and self.black_block_fall_list[x] == nil
				and self:get_block_grid(x, z - 2) ~= self.data.block_id.empty then
					music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.data.sfx_black_block_stop)
					self.black_block_fall_list[x] = true
				end
			end
		end

		-- 이동한 경우 이동한 것 기억, 아닌 경우 그 열은 더 이상 검사하지 않음
		if is_col_move == true then
			is_move = true
		end
	end

	return is_move
end

-- 블럭 이동
function local_class:block_move(x, z, force)
	local id = self:get_block_grid(x, z)
	local new_pos = self.block_data_list[id].fo.Position + force
	self.block_data_list[id].fo.Position = new_pos
	self:set_block_grid(new_pos.x, new_pos.z, id)
	self:set_block_grid(x, z, self.data.block_id.empty)
end

-- 사라질 블럭 있는지 확인
function local_class:check_erase()
	self.visited = {}  -- 방문 여부를 저장하는 테이블
	self:init_visited()
	local erase_block_list = {}

	-- 연결된 블럭 검사
	for z = self.data.stage_z_min, self.data.stage_z_max do
		for x = self.data.stage_x_min, self.data.stage_x_max do
			if self.visited[z][x] == false then
				local block_id = self:get_block_grid(x, z)
				if block_id > 0 and self.block_data_list[block_id].color ~= self.data.block_color.black then
					local count, b_list = self:CountConnectedBlocks(x, z, self.block_data_list[block_id].color)
					if count >= self.data.block_connect_count then
						table.insert(erase_block_list, b_list)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if #erase_block_list > 0 then
		self.combo_count = self.combo_count + 1
		self.combo_delay = self.data.combo_delay
		local score = 0

		-- 연결된 블럭 지우기
		for _, list in ipairs(erase_block_list) do
			for _, pos in ipairs(list) do
				local data = self.block_data_list[self:get_block_grid(pos.x, pos.z)]
				character_util.set_anim(data.fo, { name = 'erase' })
				table.insert(self.erase_block_list, data)

				local combo_count = math.min(self.combo_count, 16)
				score = score + ((2 ^ combo_count) * 100)
				if self.combo_count >= 1 then
					self:show_combo(self.combo_count)
				end
			end
		end
		if self.combo_count == 1 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.data.sfx_combo1)
			music_player:PlayVoice(self.data.scintilla_voice_id, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack1)
		elseif self.combo_count == 2 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.data.sfx_combo2)
			music_player:PlayVoice(self.data.scintilla_voice_id, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack2)
		elseif self.combo_count == 3 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.data.sfx_combo3)
			music_player:PlayVoice(self.data.scintilla_voice_id, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Attack3)
		elseif self.combo_count == 4 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.data.sfx_combo4)
			music_player:PlayVoice(self.data.scintilla_voice_id, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Skill1)
		elseif self.combo_count >= 5 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.data.sfx_combo5)
			music_player:PlayVoice(self.data.scintilla_voice_id, 0, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.LevelUp)
		end
		self:add_score(score)

		-- 모든 블럭 낙하
		self.current_block_progress = self.data.block_progess.erase
	end
end

-- 블럭 그리드 값(그리드에 있는 블럭ID) 얻기
function local_class:get_block_grid(x, z)
	-- 범위 밖
	if z < self.data.stage_z_min or z > self.data.stage_z_max
	or x < self.data.stage_x_min or x > self.data.stage_x_max then
		return self.data.block_id.disable
	end

	return self.block_grid[z][x]
end

-- 블럭 그리드 색 얻기
function local_class:get_block_grid_color(x, z)
	-- 화면 위쪽은 무조건 빈 걸로 취급
	if z > self.data.stage_z_max then
		return self.data.block_color.empty
	end

	-- 해당 그리드에 놓인 블럭 ID 얻기
	local block_id = self:get_block_grid(x, z)

	-- 불가능한 영역 또는 빈 곳
	if block_id == self.data.block_id.disable then
		return self.data.block_color.disable
	elseif block_id == self.data.block_id.empty then
		return self.data.block_color.empty
	end

	-- 블럭 색 리턴
	return self.block_data_list[block_id].color
end

-- 블럭 그리드 값 설정
function local_class:set_block_grid(x, z, block_id)
	-- 범위 밖
	if z < self.data.stage_z_min or z > self.data.stage_z_max
	or x < self.data.stage_x_min or x > self.data.stage_x_max then
		return
	end

	self.block_grid[z][x] = block_id
end

-- DFS(Depth-First Search) 함수
function local_class:DFS(x, z, targetColor, connect_block_list)
	-- 범위 밖
	if z < self.data.stage_z_min or z > self.data.stage_z_max
	or x < self.data.stage_x_min or x > self.data.stage_x_max then
		return 0
	end

	-- 이미 방문했거나 다른 색인 경우
	if self.visited[z][x] == true or self:get_block_grid_color(x, z) ~= targetColor then
		return 0
	end

	table.insert(connect_block_list, vector(x, 0, z))
	self.visited[z][x] = true
	local connectedCount = 1

	-- 상하좌우 방향으로 DFS 호출
	connectedCount = connectedCount + self:DFS(x - 1, z, targetColor, connect_block_list)  -- 위로 이동
	connectedCount = connectedCount + self:DFS(x + 1, z, targetColor, connect_block_list)  -- 아래로 이동
	connectedCount = connectedCount + self:DFS(x, z - 1, targetColor, connect_block_list)  -- 왼쪽으로 이동
	connectedCount = connectedCount + self:DFS(x, z + 1, targetColor, connect_block_list)  -- 오른쪽으로 이동

	return connectedCount
end

-- chat gpt
function local_class:CountConnectedBlocks(x, z)
	-- 변수 초기화
	local targetColor = self:get_block_grid_color(x, z)
	local connect_block_list = {}

	-- DFS 호출
	return self:DFS(x, z, targetColor, connect_block_list), connect_block_list
end

-- 방문 초기화
function local_class:init_visited()
	-- 방문 여부 초기화
	for z = self.data.stage_z_min, self.data.stage_z_max do
		self.visited[z] = {}
		for x = self.data.stage_x_min, self.data.stage_x_max do
			self.visited[z][x] = true
		end
	end

	-- 방문 필요 없는 부분(바닥에 닿지 않은 블럭)은 방문하지 않게 세팅
	for x = self.data.stage_x_min, self.data.stage_x_max do
		for z = self.data.stage_z_min, self.data.stage_z_max do
			if self:get_block_grid(x, z) > 0 then
				self.visited[z][x] = false
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 점수 증가
function local_class:add_score(score)
	self:set_score(self.current_score + score)
end

-- 점수 설정
function local_class:set_score(score)
	self.current_score = math.min(score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create('TetrisGame', self.current_score))
end

-- 색상 박스 만들기
function local_class:create_color_box_list()
	for i = 1, self.data.color_max do
		for j = 1, self.data.color_max do
			local color1 = self.data.block_color.color_start + (i - 1)
			local color2 = self.data.block_color.color_start + (j - 1)
			local box = {}
			table.insert(box, color1)
			table.insert(box, color2)
			table.insert(self.color_box_list, box)
		end
	end

	self:random_shuffle(self.color_box_list)
end

-- 배열을 랜덤하게 섞음
function local_class:random_shuffle(list)
	for i = #list, 2, -1 do
		local j = math.random(i)
		list[i], list[j] = list[j], list[i]
	end
end

-- 다음 블럭 생성
function local_class:create_next_blocK()
	if #self.color_box_list == 0 then
		self:create_color_box_list()
	end

	-- 컬러 박스 꺼내기
	local color_box = {}
	local box = self.color_box_list[1]
	for i = 1, #box do
		table.insert(color_box, box[i])
	end
	table.remove(self.color_box_list, 1)

	-- 블럭 좌표
	local pos_list = {}
	for z = 1, #box do
		local pos = vector(0, 0, z - 1)
		table.insert(pos_list, pos)
	end

	-- 다음 블럭 정보 초기화
	self.next_block_info = {
		pos_list = pos_list,
		block_list = {},
	}

	-- 블럭 데이터에서 사용할 블럭을 가져옴
	for i = 1, #pos_list do
		local pos = self.priestess_init_pos + pos_list[i] + vector(0, 0, 1)
		local data = self:create_block(pos, color_box[i])
		table.insert(self.next_block_info.block_list, data)
	end
end

-- 블럭 초기화
function local_class:init_block(data)
	local fo = data.fo
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(fo, true)
	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 9)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'victory' })

	if data.color == self.data.block_color.red then
		fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'vermilion'
	elseif data.color == self.data.block_color.black then
		fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'black'
	elseif data.color == self.data.block_color.yellow then
		fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'yellow'
	elseif data.color == self.data.block_color.blue then
		fo.SpineController.SkinName = 'blue'
	end
	fo.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
end

-- 떨어질 곳을 보여줌
function local_class:chase()
	local pos_list = self.next_block_info.pos_list

	-- 생성 위치
	local spawn_x = math.max(math.floor(user_party.Leader.Position.x + 0.5), self.data.stage_x_min)
	local spawn_z = self.data.stage_z_max - 1

	-- 오라 보이기
	if self.extra_time > 0 then
		for i = 1, #pos_list do
			local spawn_point = vector(spawn_x, 0, spawn_z) + pos_list[i]
			self.fo_wrappers:set_active(self.aura_list[i], true)
			self.aura_list[i].Position = spawn_point
		end
	-- 오라 숨기기
	else
		for i = 1, #pos_list do
			self.fo_wrappers:set_active(self.aura_list[i], false)
		end
	end
end

-- 해당 위치에 블럭 생성
function local_class:create_block(pos, color)
	for _, data in ipairs(self.block_data_list) do
		if self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(data.fo) == false then
			data.fo.Position = pos
			character_util.set_anim(data.fo, { name = 'idle' })
			data.color = color
			self:init_block(data)

			return data
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 블럭 생성
function local_class:spawn_block()
	-- 생성 위치가 막혀 있는지 확인
	for i = 1, #self.aura_list do
		if self:get_block_grid(self.aura_list[i].Position.x, self.aura_list[i].Position.z) > 0 then
			return false
		end
	end

	-- 오라 부분에 블럭 생성
	local block_list = self.next_block_info.block_list
	for i = 1, #self.aura_list do
		local data = block_list[i]
		local pos = self.aura_list[i].Position
		data.fo.Position = pos
		self:set_block_grid(pos.x, pos.z, data.id)

		-- 오라 지우기
		self.fo_wrappers:set_active(self.aura_list[i], false)
	end

	-- 예고 블럭 새로 만들기
	self:create_next_blocK()

	return true
end

-- 검은 블럭 생성
function local_class:spawn_black_block()
	-- 생성 정보
	local color = self.data.block_color.black
	local block_count = self.data.stage_x_max - self.data.stage_x_min + 1
	local spawn_x = self.data.stage_x_min
	local spawn_z = self.data.stage_z_max

	-- 블럭 생성
	for i = 1, block_count do
		local spawn_point = vector(spawn_x + (i - 1), 0, spawn_z)
		local grid_value = self:get_block_grid(spawn_point.x, spawn_point.z)
		if grid_value == self.data.block_id.empty then
			local block_data = self:create_block(spawn_point, color)
			self:set_block_grid(spawn_point.x, spawn_point.z, block_data.id)
		end
	end
end

-- 블럭 그리드 초기화
function local_class:init_block_grid()
	self.block_grid = {}
	for z = self.data.stage_z_min, self.data.stage_z_max do
		self.block_grid[z] = {}
		for x = self.data.stage_x_min, self.data.stage_x_max do
			self.block_grid[z][x] = self.data.block_id.empty
		end
	end
end

-- 블럭 초기화
function local_class:init_block_data_list()
	self.block_data_list = {}
	local npc_list = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
	for i = 0, npc_list.Count - 1 do
		local npc = npc_list[i]
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(npc)
		npc.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
		npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		if string.match(npc.Name, self.data.block_npc_name) then
			self:add_block_data(npc)
			self.fo_wrappers:set_active(npc, false)
			npc.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2.5
		elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.aura_npc_name) then
			table.insert(self.aura_list, npc)
			npc.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
		end
	end

	-- ID 부여
	for i, data in ipairs(self.block_data_list) do
		data.id = i
	end
end

-- 블럭 데이터 추가
function local_class:add_block_data(fo)
	local npc_data = {
		fo = fo,	-- 필드 오브젝트
		color = self.data.block_color.empty,	-- 색
	}
	table.insert(self.block_data_list, npc_data)
end

-- fail 상태가 됨
function local_class:fail()
	if self.cheat_immortal == true then
		return
	end

	self.current_game_progress = self.data.game_progress.fail
	self:hide_combo()
end

-- 게임 오버
function local_class:game_over()
	-- 검은 블럭 마지막까지 낙하기 시키기
	if self.clear_bonus == true then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.last_block_fall, self))
	end

	-- BGM 종료
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.sfx_gameover)

	-- 실패 동작
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'dead' })
	wait_for_sec(2)
	self:hide_combo()

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
end

-- 마지막까지 블럭 떨어뜨리기
function local_class:last_block_fall()
	while true do
		wait_for_sec(0.15)
		local is_block_fall = self:block_fall()
		if is_block_fall == false then
			break
		end
	end
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경
function local_class:change_manual_character(new_manual_character_name)
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party_leader
	local manual_character = get_character(new_manual_character_name)

	-- 파티 리더 변경
	party_util.switch_leader(manual_character)

	character_util.set_direction(manual_character, self.saved_party_leader.Direction)

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 콤보 표시
function local_class:show_combo(combo_count)
	if self.clear_bonus == true then
		return
	end

	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.data.game_progress.playing then
		return
	end

	self.combo_effect.ComboNumber = combo_count
	self.combo_effect:SetActive(true)
end

-- 콤보 숨기기
function local_class:hide_combo()
	self.combo_effect:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:set_timer_text(t)
	t = math.floor(math.max(t, 0))
	self.timer_number:Show(t)
end

-- 게임패드 UI 표시
function local_class:show_gamepad_label()
	self.gamepad_label = gamepad_util.show_joypad_label({
		string_key = 'joypad_tetris_push_label'
	})
end

-- 게임 패드 UI 숨기기
function local_class:hide_gamepad_label()
	gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label)

	self.gamepad_label = nil
end
--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	self:event_unsubscribe()

	-- 보이스 원복
	music_player.VoiceVolume = self.pre_voice_volume

	self.game_loop = false

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.data = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.player_pos_marker = nil
	self.saved_party_leader = nil
	self.sprites_data = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil

	self.game_progress = nil
	self.block_data_list = nil
	self.erase_block_list = nil
	self.aura_list = nil
	self.block_grid = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('ThrowingWaterBalloons')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'ThrowingWaterBalloons'

	-- Constants Data
	self.game_data = nil

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_fx_water_ball = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_wateballoon_explosion')
	end

	self.get_fx_smoke = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Common_SmokeScreen')
	end

	-- 미니게임 상태
	self.game_state = {
		loading = 1,
		in_game = 2,
		end_game = 3
	}

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loading

	-- 각 턴의 상태
	self.turn_state = {
		none = 1,
		angle_setting = 2,
		power_setting = 3,
		shoot = 4,
		ending = 5
	}

	self.current_turn_state = self.turn_state.none

	-- 현재 턴 정보
	self.current_turn_data = {
		shooter = nil,
		water_balloon = nil,
		action = nil,
		target = nil,
		target_tower = nil,
		target_fallen_tower = nil,
		target_tower_bounds = nil,
		ui_data = nil,
		is_player_turn = nil
	}

	self.player_data = nil
	self.enemy_data = nil

	self.optimized_npc_player_name = 'player_npc_'
	self.optimized_npc_enemy_name = 'enemy_npc_'

	-- 튜토리얼을 봤는지
	self.is_show_tutorial = false

	-- 물풍선 이동의 목표 프레임
	self.target_fps = 30

	self.res_holder = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/ThrowingWaterBalloons/ThrowingWaterBalloonsConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	self.get_fx_water_ball()
	self.get_fx_smoke()

	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 각도, 파워 설정 ui 생성
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
		self.res_holder, 'ondemand/short_story_summer/ui', 'AttackGageBar', function(prefab)
			self.attack_gage_ui = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
			self.attack_gage_ui:SetActive(false)

			local player_gage_ui = self.attack_gage_ui.transform:Find('Content/leftbar')

			-- 플레이어 ui
			self.player_gage_ui_data = {
				ui = player_gage_ui,
				gage = player_gage_ui:Find('gage'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite)),
				arrow = player_gage_ui:Find('arrow'),
				set_active = function(is_active)
					player_gage_ui.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
				end
			}

			self.player_gage_ui_data.set_active(false)

			-- 적 ui
			local enemy_gage_ui = self.attack_gage_ui.transform:Find('Content/rightbar')

			self.enemy_gage_ui_data = {
				ui = enemy_gage_ui,
				gage = enemy_gage_ui:Find('gage'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite)),
				arrow = enemy_gage_ui:Find('arrow'),
				set_active = function(is_active)
					enemy_gage_ui.gameObject:SetActive(is_active)
				end
			}

			self.enemy_gage_ui_data.set_active(false)
		end)

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 플레이어 데이터
	self.player_data = self.constants_data.player_data
	self.player_tower_bounds = {
		min = self:change_to_vector(self.player_data.tower_bounds.min),
		max = self:change_to_vector(self.player_data.tower_bounds.max)
	}

	-- 적 데이터
	self.enemy_data = self.constants_data.enemy_data
	self.enemy_tower_bounds = {
		min = self:change_to_vector(self.enemy_data.tower_bounds.min),
		max = self:change_to_vector(self.enemy_data.tower_bounds.max)
	}

	-- 물풍선 데이터
	self.water_balloon_bounds = {
		min = self:change_to_vector(self.constants_data.water_balloon_data.bounds.min),
		max = self:change_to_vector(self.constants_data.water_balloon_data.bounds.max)
	}

	-- 벽 데이터
	self.wall_item_id = self.constants_data.wall_data.item_id
	self.wall_bounds = {
		min = self:change_to_vector(self.constants_data.wall_data.bounds.min),
		max = self:change_to_vector(self.constants_data.wall_data.bounds.max)
	}

	self.is_show_tutorial = false

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self:exit_game()

	if self.attack_gage_ui then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_gage_ui)
		self.attack_gage_ui = nil
	end

	if self.res_holder ~= nil then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
	end

	self.player_gage_ui_data = nil
	self.enemy_gage_ui_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 플레이어가 슈터일 때만 동작
	if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.in_game and self.current_turn_state > self.turn_state.none and
		self.current_turn_data.is_player_turn and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then

		self.current_turn_state = self.current_turn_state + 1
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

--- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

--- 미니게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	self:game_setting()

	for phase = 1, #self.constants_data.phase do
		self:phase_setting(phase)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		self:play_tutorial()

		self:phase_opening()

		if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
			self.is_show_pc_narration = true
			field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_touch')
		end

		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.in_game

		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

		-- 승자가 생길 때까지 반복
		while self.winner == nil do
			self.current_turn_data.action(self)

			self:next_turn()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self:exit_phase(phase)

		if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.end_game then
			self.success_mini_game = false
			break
		end
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.end_game

	self:exit_game()

	self.attack_gage_ui:SetActive(false)

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.success_mini_game))
end

--- 게임 시작 시 세팅

--- 페이즈 시작 시 세팅
function local_class:phase_setting(phase)
	-- 현재 페이즈의 정보
	self.current_phase_data = self.constants_data.phase[phase]

	for key, data in pairs(self.player_npc_data) do
		local npc = self.npc_list[self.player_shooter][key]
		character_util.set_direction(npc, data.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, data.emotion)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, data.animation)
		npc.Position = self.player_tower.Position + self:change_to_vector(data.dist_to_tower)
	end

	-- 적 세팅
	local enemy_tower_pos = field:GetMarker(self.enemy_data.tower_pos_marker_name).position
	self.enemy_tower.Position = enemy_tower_pos

	-- 적 npc 동적 생성
	local optimized_enemy_npc_list = {}
	local npc_data = {}

	for i = 1, #self.current_phase_data.enemy_character_data do
		local key_string = self.optimized_npc_enemy_name .. i
		optimized_enemy_npc_list[key_string] = self.current_phase_data.enemy_character_data[i].spec_name
		npc_data[key_string] = self.current_phase_data.enemy_character_data[i]
	end

	local optimized_npc = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(optimized_enemy_npc_list)
	table.insert(self.optimized_npc_list, optimized_npc)

	for key, data in pairs(npc_data) do
		local npc = optimized_npc[key]
		character_util.set_direction(npc, data.direction)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, data.emotion)
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(npc, data.animation)
		npc.Position = self.enemy_tower.Position + self:change_to_vector(data.dist_to_tower)
	end

	self.enemy_shooter = optimized_npc.enemy_npc_1

	self.npc_list[self.enemy_shooter] = optimized_npc

	-- 플레이어 턴부터 시작
	self:current_turn_data_setting(true)

	self.current_turn_state = self.turn_state.none

	self.current_enemy_pattern = 1

	-- 벽 생성
	self.wall_data_list = {}
	local wall_xz_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.wall_data.wall_pos_marker_name).position
	local height = self.wall_bounds.max.y

	-- 벽 설치 위치 왼쪽부터 1라인
	for line = 1, #self.current_phase_data.wall_count do
		self.wall_data_list[line] = {}
		for index = self.current_phase_data.wall_count[line], 1, -1 do
			local wall = drop_item_util.create_item(
				{ pos = vector(999, 0, 999),
				  itemid = self.wall_item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				  sprscale = self.constants_data.wall_data.sprite_scale, showoncharacter = true })

			wall.Position = wall_xz_pos + vector(0, (index - 1) * height, height / 2)

			local wall_data = {
				-- 벽 아이템 오브젝트
				obj = wall,
				-- 인게임에서 활성화 되어 있는지
				is_active = true
			}

			table.insert(self.wall_data_list[line], wall_data)
		end

		wall_xz_pos = wall_xz_pos + vector(self.wall_bounds.max.x - self.wall_bounds.min.x, 0, 0)
	end

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.3)
end

--- 튜토리얼 실행
function local_class:play_tutorial()
	local tutorial_data = self.constants_data.tutorial_data

	if not tutorial_data or self.is_show_tutorial then
		return
	end

	self.is_show_tutorial = true

	local talker = get_character(tutorial_data.talker_name)

	for i = 1, #tutorial_data.speech_key do
		if tutorial_data.speech_sfx and tutorial_data.speech_sfx[i] then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(tutorial_data.speech_sfx[i])
		end

		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(talker, tutorial_data.speech_key[i])
	end
end

--- 페이즈 시작 전 연출
function local_class:phase_opening()
	local opening_data = self.current_phase_data.opening_data
	if opening_data == nil then
		wait_for_sec(2)
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #opening_data.talker_index do
		if opening_data.sfx and opening_data.sfx[i] then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(opening_data.sfx[i])
		end

		local talker_index = opening_data.talker_index[i]
		local talker = self.npc_list[self.enemy_shooter][self.optimized_npc_enemy_name .. talker_index]
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(talker, opening_data.speech_key[i])
	end
end

--- 플레이어의 턴
function local_class:start_player_turn()
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.player_shooter, { name = 'boong_attack_ready' })

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.player_shooter, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')

	self.current_turn_state = self.current_turn_state + 1

	-- 발사 세팅 ui 켜주기
	self:set_ui()

	-- 각도 설정
	local shoot_angle = self:set_angle()

	-- 파워 설정
	local shoot_power = self:set_power()

	self.current_turn_data.ui_data.set_active(false)

	-- 물풍선 발사
	local shoot_pos = self.player_shooter.Position + vector(0.3, 0.3, 0)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.player_shooter, { name = 'boong_attack' })
	self:shoot_water_balloons(shoot_pos, shoot_angle, shoot_power)
end

--- 적의 턴
function local_class:start_enemy_turn()
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.enemy_shooter, { name = 'boong_attack_ready' })

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(self.enemy_shooter, 'boong_attack_ready_loop')

	-- 발사 세팅 ui 켜주기
	self:set_ui()

	-- 현재 페이즈의 적 패턴
	local enemy_pattern = self.current_phase_data.enemy_pattern[self.current_enemy_pattern]
	self.current_enemy_pattern = self.current_enemy_pattern + 1

	-- 저장된 패턴을 다 사용했다면 처음부터 반복
	if self.current_enemy_pattern > #self.current_phase_data.enemy_pattern then
		self.current_enemy_pattern = 1
	end

	-- 각도 설정
	local shoot_angle = 180 - self:set_angle(enemy_pattern.shoot_angle)

	-- 파워 설정
	local shoot_power = self:set_power(enemy_pattern.shoot_power)

	self.current_turn_data.ui_data.set_active(false)

	-- 물풍선 발사
	local shoot_pos = self.enemy_shooter.Position + vector(-0.3, 0.3, 0)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.enemy_shooter, { name = 'boong_attack' })
	self:shoot_water_balloons(shoot_pos, shoot_angle, shoot_power)
end

--- 다음 턴
function local_class:next_turn()
	if self.winner ~= nil then
		return
	end

	if self.current_turn_data.is_player_turn then
		self:current_turn_data_setting(false)
	else
		self:current_turn_data_setting(true)
	end

	self.current_turn_state = self.turn_state.none

	wait_for_sec(1)
end

--- 페이즈 또는 게임이 끝났을 때
function local_class:exit_phase(phase)
	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.loading

	local player_lose = lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, self.enemy_shooter)

	local loser = self.current_turn_data.target
	for _, npc in pairs(self.npc_list[loser]) do
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_embarrassed_anim(npc)
	end

	local target_tower = self.current_turn_data.target_tower
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 2)
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.Shake, target_tower.SpriteTransform, 0.2, 2)

	if player_lose then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
	local fx_smoke = self.get_fx_smoke():Instantiate(target_tower.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	self.current_turn_data.target_fallen_tower.Position = target_tower.Position
	target_tower.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	for _, npc in pairs(self.npc_list[loser]) do
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'confused')
		scene_util.set_prostrate_anim(npc)
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	if not self.constants_data.win_event_func_name then
		-- 이겼을 때 정해진 연출이 없을 때

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

		for _, npc in pairs(self.npc_list[self.winner]) do
			scene_util.set_emotion_loop(npc, 'smile')
			scene_util.set_anim_non_loop(npc, 'victory_get')
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

	else
		-- 이겼을 때 정해진 연출이 있을 때
		yield_return(self, self.constants_data.win_event_func_name, phase)
	end

	if player_lose then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		self.current_game_state = self.game_state.end_game

	elseif phase == #self.constants_data.phase then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for _, list in pairs(self.optimized_npc_list) do
		for _, npc in pairs(list) do
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
		end
	end

	fx_smoke:Dispose()

	-- 벽 제거
	for line = 1, #self.wall_data_list do
		for index = 1, #self.wall_data_list[line] do
			self.wall_data_list[line][index].obj:ConsumeComplete()
		end
	end

	self.current_turn_data.target_fallen_tower.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	self.winner = nil

	load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(self.optimized_npc_list[2])
	table.remove(self.optimized_npc_list)

function local_class:set_angle(target_angle)
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_coop_matching_02', loop = true })

	local max_angle = 90

	local start_angle = 0
	local end_angle = max_angle

	local duration = self.constants_data.angle_move_duration
	local time_passed = 0

	if target_angle then
		end_angle = target_angle
		duration = duration * target_angle / max_angle
	end

	local angle = start_angle

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		angle = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_angle, end_angle, progress)
		self.current_turn_data.ui_data.arrow.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, angle)

		if time_passed > duration then
			time_passed = 0
			start_angle = end_angle
			end_angle = max_angle - end_angle

			if target_angle then
				break
			end
		end

		if self.current_turn_state > self.turn_state.angle_setting then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.loop_sfx)

	return angle
end

function local_class:set_power(target_power)
	self.loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_laser_build_up_03', loop = true })

	local max_power = self.constants_data.max_power

	local start_power = 0
	local end_power = max_power

	local duration = self.constants_data.power_move_duration
	local time_passed = 0

	local power = start_power

	if target_power then
		end_power = target_power
		duration = duration * target_power / max_power
	end

	while true do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
		power = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_power, end_power, progress)

		local power_gage = power / max_power
		self.current_turn_data.ui_data.gage.fillAmount = power_gage

		if time_passed > duration then
			time_passed = 0
			start_power = end_power
			end_power = max_power - end_power

			if target_power then
				break
			end
		end

		if self.current_turn_state > self.turn_state.power_setting then

		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.stop_sfx(self.loop_sfx)

	return power
end

--- 물풍선 발사
function local_class:shoot_water_balloons(shoot_pos, shoot_angle, shoot_power)
	if shoot_power < self.constants_data.max_power / 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
	end

	local target_dt = 1 / self.target_fps

	local gravity = constants.jump_gravity
	local shoot_radian = shoot_angle * unity_class.mathf.PI / 180

	local water_balloon = self.current_turn_data.water_balloon

	local shoot_speed = self.constants_data.shoot_speed

	-- 도착 거리까지 걸리는 시간 계산
	local duration = shoot_power * unity_class.mathf.Sin(shoot_radian) * 2 / gravity
	local time_passed = 0

	-- 물풍선 이동 업데이트 및 이동 시 충돌 체크
	local move_update = function(dt)
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local cur_x = shoot_power * math.cos(shoot_radian) * time_passed
		local cur_y = shoot_power * math.sin(shoot_radian) * time_passed - (gravity * time_passed * time_passed / 2)

		water_balloon.Position = shoot_pos + vector(cur_x, cur_y, 0)

		-- 물풍선 충돌 체크
		if self:check_water_balloon_crash(water_balloon.Position) then
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	-- 물풍선이 움직일 상태인지
	local is_move_state = true

	while is_move_state and time_passed < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime * shoot_speed

		-- 저프레임 대응
		if dt > target_dt then
			while is_move_state and dt >= target_dt do
				is_move_state = move_update(target_dt)
				dt = dt - target_dt
			end

			if is_move_state and not float_util.is_almost_zero(dt) then
				is_move_state = move_update(dt)
			end
		else
			is_move_state = move_update(dt)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local end_y = math.max(0, water_balloon.Position.y)
	self.get_fx_water_ball():Instantiate(vector_util.get_x0z(water_balloon.Position, end_y))
	water_balloon.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	if shoot_power < self.constants_data.max_power / 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_02')
	end

	local wall_height = self.wall_bounds.max.y

	-- 떨어질 벽이 있을 때 떨어지는 연출
	if self.falling_wall then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		-- 벽 낙하 시간
		local falling_duration = 0.3

		for i = 1, #self.falling_wall do
			local wall = self.falling_wall[i]
			drop_item_util.move_item(wall, wall.Position + vector(0, -1 * wall_height, 0),
				{ duration = falling_duration })
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')

		self.falling_wall = nil

		wait_for_sec(falling_duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_02')
	end
end

--- 물풍선 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_water_balloon_crash(water_balloon_pos)
	-- 물풍선 바운드
	local water_balloon_bounds = {
		min = water_balloon_pos + self.water_balloon_bounds.min,
		max = water_balloon_pos + self.water_balloon_bounds.max
	}

	-- 벽과 충돌 했는지
	local is_wall_hit = false

	-- 충돌된 벽의 라인
	local wall_hit_line

	-- 체크할 라인의 시작과 끝 지점
	local start_line
	local end_line
	local search_order

	if self.current_turn_data.is_player_turn then
		start_line = 1
		end_line = #self.wall_data_list
		search_order = 1
	else
		start_line = #self.wall_data_list
		end_line = 1
		search_order = -1
	end

	for line = start_line, end_line, search_order do
		for i = #self.wall_data_list[line], 1, -1 do
			local wall_data = self.wall_data_list[line][i]

			if wall_data.is_active then
				-- 벽 바운드
				local wall_bounds = {
					min = wall_data.obj.Position + self.wall_bounds.min,
					max = wall_data.obj.Position + self.wall_bounds.max
				}

				-- 물풍선과 벽 충돌 체크
				if not is_wall_hit and
					not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xy_area(water_balloon_bounds, wall_bounds)) < constants.epsilon) then

					-- 벽 파괴
					wall_data.obj.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

					is_wall_hit = true
					wall_hit_line = line
					wall_data.is_active = false

				elseif is_wall_hit and wall_hit_line ~= line then
					-- 같은 라인의 벽이 아니면 탈출
					-- 벽은 순서대로 저장 되어 있기 때문에 라인가 달라지면 그 뒤로도 쭉 다르기 때문에 탈출
					break
				elseif is_wall_hit then
					-- 충돌된 벽보다 위의 벽들은 떨어질 벽으로 저장
					if not self.falling_wall then
						self.falling_wall = {}
					end

					table.insert(self.falling_wall, wall_data.obj)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if is_wall_hit then
		camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.3)
		return true
	end

	-- 타워 바운드
	local tower_bounds = {
		min = self.current_turn_data.target_tower.Position + self.current_turn_data.target_tower_bounds.min,
		max = self.current_turn_data.target_tower.Position + self.current_turn_data.target_tower_bounds.max
	}

	-- 물풍선과 타워 충돌 체크
	if not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xy_area(water_balloon_bounds, tower_bounds)) < constants.epsilon) then
		self.winner = self.current_turn_data.shooter
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_earthquake_01')
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 현재 턴의 정보 세팅
function local_class:current_turn_data_setting(is_player_turn)
	if is_player_turn then
		-- 플레이어 턴으로 세팅
		self.current_turn_data.shooter = self.player_shooter
		self.current_turn_data.water_balloon = self.player_water_balloon
		self.current_turn_data.action = self.start_player_turn
		self.current_turn_data.target = self.enemy_shooter
		self.current_turn_data.target_tower = self.enemy_tower
		self.current_turn_data.target_fallen_tower = self.enemy_fallen_tower
		self.current_turn_data.target_tower_bounds = self.enemy_tower_bounds
		self.current_turn_data.ui_data = self.player_gage_ui_data
		self.current_turn_data.is_player_turn = true

	else
		-- 적 턴으로 세팅
		self.current_turn_data.shooter = self.enemy_shooter
		self.current_turn_data.water_balloon = self.enemy_water_balloon
		self.current_turn_data.action = self.start_enemy_turn
		self.current_turn_data.target = self.player_shooter
		self.current_turn_data.target_tower = self.player_tower
		self.current_turn_data.target_fallen_tower = self.player_fallen_tower
		self.current_turn_data.target_tower_bounds = self.player_tower_bounds
		self.current_turn_data.ui_data = self.enemy_gage_ui_data
		self.current_turn_data.is_player_turn = false
	end
end

--- 내부 바운드 충돌 체크
function local_class:get_overlapped_xy_area(bounds1, bounds2)
	local min_x = math.max(bounds1.min.x, bounds2.min.x)
	local min_y = math.max(bounds1.min.y, bounds2.min.y)
	local max_x = math.min(bounds1.max.x, bounds2.max.x)
	local max_y = math.min(bounds1.max.y, bounds2.max.y)

	return math.max(0, max_x - min_x) * math.max(0, max_y - min_y)
end

	return vector(value[1], value[2], value[3])

			state:set(value)
		end,
		is_enabled = function(this, fo)
			if this.container[fo] == nil then
				this:add(fo)
			end

		end,
