function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require(
			'minigame/TigerJumpGame/TigerJumpGameConstants')
	self.data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- 점프 계산기
	local gravity_factor = 5
	self.jump_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(15, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * gravity_factor, 0, 0)
	self.free_fall_calculator = CS.CalculatorFreeFall.Create(0, CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity * gravity_factor, 0, 0)

	-- 플레이어 시작 위치 마커
	self.player_pos_marker = field:GetMarker(self.data.player_start_stand_name)

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 조이스틱 표시
	gamepad_util.preload_joypad_label()

	-- 오브젝트 풀 로드
	local pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')
	while not CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.IsLoaded(pool) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- UI를 위한 스프라이트 생성
	local pooled_object = {}
	for i = 1, self.data.sprite_id.max do
		pooled_object[i] = pool:Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.one * 999)
	end

	-- Atlas 프리로드
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadeBuffUI', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
			end)

	if self.custom_atlas ~= nil then
		self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
	end

	self.custom_sprite = {}
	for i = 1, self.data.sprite_id.max do
		self.custom_sprite[i] = pooled_object[i]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		if not is_unity_null(self.custom_sprite[i]) then
			self.custom_sprite[i].Atlas = self.custom_atlas
			self.custom_sprite[i].SortingLayer = 'UI'
		end
	end

	-- 커스텀 스프라이트
	for i = self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_begin, self.data.sprite_id.score_effect_end do
		self:init_sprites_data(i, 'tigerjump_home.png', 0, 2)
	end

	-- 점수 이펙트
	self.score_effect_list = {}
	for i = 1, self.data.score_effect_max do
		local score_effect = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/ui', 'GuildArcadeScoreSprite'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.GuildArcadeScoreSprite))
		score_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
		table.insert(self.score_effect_list, score_effect)
	end

	self:game_pre_init()

	-- 플레이어 캐릭터 세팅
	self.jump_player = get_character(self.data.player_npc_name1)
	self.jump_player.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
	self.jump_player.Position = vector(self.player_pos_marker.position.x, 0, 4.8)
	self.prev_position = self.jump_player.Position
	self.jump_player.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_player)
	self.jump_player.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(self.jump_player, true)
	self.jump_player.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0), vector(1.6, self.hitbox_y_size, 1))
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.jump_player, 'right')

	-- 배경 세팅
	self:init_bg(res_holder)

	-- 화면 크기(25 : 9 대응)
	self.half_screen_size = unity_class.vector2(15.27, 5.5)

	-- 점프 버튼 표시
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.CustomAttack

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 스프라이트 초기화
function local_class:init_sprites_data(sprite_id, file_name, background_order, scale)
	self.sprites_data[sprite_id] = {
		sprite = self.custom_sprite[sprite_id],
		sprite_name = file_name,
		local_scale = unity_class.vector2.one * scale,
		init_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)
	}

	local data = self.sprites_data[sprite_id]
	data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	data.sprite.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(90, 0, 0))
	data.sprite.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
	data.sprite.SpriteName = data.sprite_name
	data.sprite.LocalScale = data.local_scale
	data.sprite:SetSortingOrder(background_order)
	data.sprite:Rebuild()
end

-- 스프라이트 보이기, 숨기기
function local_class:show_sprites_data(data, is_show)
	if is_show then
		data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = data.init_pos
	else
		data.sprite.Transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	end
end

-- 현재 스프라이트가 보이고 있는지 확인
function local_class:is_show_sprites_data(data)
	local invisible_position = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
	if data.sprite.Transform.localPosition == invisible_position then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 점수 이펙트 표시
function local_class:show_score_effect(position, score)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_score_effect_core, self, position, score))
end

function local_class:show_score_effect_core(position, score)
	local score_effect
	for i = 1, self.data.score_effect_max do
		if self.score_effect_list[i].IsShow == false then
			score_effect = self.score_effect_list[i]
			score_effect:Show(score)
			score_effect.transform.position = position
			break
		end
	end

	-- 이펙트 숨기기
	if score_effect ~= nil then
		wait_for_sec(1)
		score_effect:Hide()
	end
end

-- npc 데이터 리스트 초기화
function local_class:init_npc_data_list()
	self.npc_data_list = {}
	self.baby_max = 0
	local npc_list = stage.CharacterManager:GetAllNpcs()
	for i = 0, npc_list.Count - 1 do
		local npc = npc_list[i]
		if npc ~= self.jump_player then
			self.fo_wrappers:set_active(npc, false)

			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(npc, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
			npc.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
			npc.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			if string.match(npc.Name, self.data.player_npc_name) then
				-- 주인공 캐릭터(Skip)
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.baby_npc_name) then	-- 따라붙는 아기 호랑이(충돌 영역 없음)
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.baby)
				data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = self:get_baby_skin_name(self.baby_max)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
				data.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0, 0, 0))
				self.baby_max = self.baby_max + 1
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.foothold_npc_name) then	-- 발판
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.foothold)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.02
				data.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, -1.6), vector(2, self.hitbox_y_size, 0.3))
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.wall_npc_name) then	-- 벽
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.wall)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3(1.02, 1.02, 1)
				data.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0), vector(2, self.hitbox_y_size, 10.7))
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.bonus_npc_name) then	-- 보너스 아이템
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.bonus)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
				data.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, self.hitbox_y_size, 1))
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.item_baby_npc_name) then	-- 아기 호랑이
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.item_baby)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
				data.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0), vector(1, self.hitbox_y_size, 1))
			elseif string.match(npc.Name, self.data.enemy_npc_name) then	-- 적
				local data = self:add_npc_data(npc, self.data.npc_type.enemy)
				data.fo.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 2
				data.fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0, 0, 0))
			end
		end
	end

	self.sub_pos_max = self.baby_max * 5 + 5
end

-- 아기 호랑이 스킨 이름 얻기
function local_class:get_baby_skin_name(count)
	local skin_name
	if count == 0 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_a'
	elseif count == 1 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_b'
	elseif count == 2 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_c'
	elseif count == 3 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_d'
	elseif count == 4 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_e'
	elseif count == 5 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_f'
	elseif count == 6 then
		skin_name = 'arcade_whitetiger_baby_g'
	end

	return skin_name
end

-- npc 데이터 초기화, 리스트 추가
function local_class:add_npc_data(fo, type)
	local npc_data = {
		fo = fo,		-- 필드 오브젝트
		type = type,	-- 타입
	}

	fo.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	table.insert(self.npc_data_list, npc_data)
	return npc_data
end

-- 비활성화 된 NPC 찾기
function local_class:get_disable_npc(type)
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if not self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(data.fo) and data.type == type then
			return data
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 점프 버튼
function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then
		return true
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown then
		self.jump_button_touch_down = true
	end

	return false
end

-- 치트키 받기
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'acg_cheat:level' then
		local value = e:GetParamAt(1)
		if value == nil then
			self.stage = self.stage + 1
		else
			self.stage = math.max(tonumber(value), 1)
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'acg_cheat:immortal' then
		local value = e:GetParamAt(1)
		if value == nil then
			if self.cheat_immortal == true then
				self.cheat_immortal = false
			else
				self.cheat_immortal = true
			end
		else
			local param = tonumber(value)
			if param == 0 then
				self.cheat_immortal = false
			else
				self.cheat_immortal = true
			end
		end

		if self.cheat_immortal == true then
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.jump_player, 0.5)
		else
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.jump_player, 1)
		end
	end
end

-- 게임 패드
function local_class:on_gamepad_connected(_)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	self:show_gamepad_label()

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_disconnected(_)
	if self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.playing then return true end

	self:hide_gamepad_label()

	return false
end

--endregion

--region Game Logic
function local_class:game_start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start_routine, self))
end

-- 게임 시작
function local_class:game_start_routine()
	self:game_init()
	self:game_ui_show()

	-- 이미 게임패드가 활성화되있는 상태라면 게임패드 라벨을 보여준다.
	if CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled then
		self:show_gamepad_label()
	end

	self.game_loop = true
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.main_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	self:game_routine()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.jump_player, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:HideAndBackup()

	self.game_loop = false

	self:game_over()
end

function local_class:game_pre_init()
	self:change_manual_character(self.data.player_npc_name1)

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent), 'on_gamepad_connected')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent), 'on_gamepad_disconnected')

	-- NPC 초기화
	self:init_npc_data_list()

	-- 발판, 벽 세팅
	self.foothold_data_list = {}
	self.wall_data_list = {}
	for _, npc_data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.foothold then
			local data = {
				fo = npc_data.fo,
			}
			table.insert(self.foothold_data_list, data)
		elseif npc_data.type == self.data.npc_type.wall then
			local data = {
				fo = npc_data.fo,
			}
			table.insert(self.wall_data_list, data)
		end
	end
	self:make_start_pattern()

	-- 파티 숨기기
	for i = user_party.Count - 1, 1, -1 do
		local member = user_party[i]
		character_util.convert_to_npc(member)
		self.fo_wrappers:set_active(member, false)
	end

	-- 카메라 초기화
	local center_x = 8.5
	self.center_pos = unity_class.vector3(center_x, 0, 7)
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.center_pos
	user_party.Leader.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	camera_util.resize_to(5.5, 0)

	-- 서브 위치 초기화
	for i = 1, self.sub_pos_max do
		table.insert(self.sub_pos_list, self.player_pos_marker.position)
	end

	-- 점수 초기화
	self:set_score(0)
end

function local_class:game_init()
	-- 프레임 레이트에 따라 아기 호랑이 위치 수정
	local frame_rate_option = CS.UnityEngine.Application.targetFrameRate
	frame_rate_option = math.min(frame_rate_option, 60)	-- 최대 60프레임으로 제한
	self.sub_pos_scale = math.max(math.floor(5 / (60 / frame_rate_option)), 1)
end

function local_class:game_ui_show()
	-- 인터랙트, 공격, 들기, 스킬 전부 막아놓음
	local manual_touch_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	manual_touch_state:DisableControls(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Interact |
			CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Attack | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Super | CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Hold)

	local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterAnalogueState.Create(user_party.Leader)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	-- 보물상자, 환경설정, 대화창, 미니맵 제거
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad)
	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	-- 점프 버튼 표시
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton).OverridenButtonAction =
	CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Button1Action.Run
	self.show_jump_button = true
end

-- 배경 초기화
function local_class:init_bg(res_holder)
	self.background_data_list = {}

	-- 맵 셋팅
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back1', 0, 0.1)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back1', self.data.bg_width, 0.1)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back2', 0, 0.2)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back2', self.data.bg_width, 0.2)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back3', 0, 0.4)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back3', self.data.bg_width, 0.4)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back4', 0, 0.8)
	self:init_bg_one(res_holder, 'guild_arcade_tigerjump_game_back4', self.data.bg_width, 0.8)
end

-- 배경 하나 초기화
function local_class:init_bg_one(res_holder, asset_name, init_x, speed)
	local background = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/arcade/theatres/arcade_tigerjump', asset_name)
	background.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5

	local background_data = {
		prefab = background,
		init_x = init_x,
		speed = speed,
	}
	table.insert(self.background_data_list, background_data)

	self:reset_bg(background_data)
end

function local_class:reset_bg(data)
	data.prefab.transform.position = vector(data.init_x, -1, 2)
end

-- 메인 게임 루틴
function local_class:game_routine()
	while self.game_loop == true do
		-- 스테이지 초기화
		self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.playing
		self.goal_x = self.data.goal_not_set
		self.baby_item_progress = 0
		self.item_baby_set_count = 0
		self.baby_list = {}
		self.baby_update = true

		-- 스테이지 클리어시 초기화
		if self.is_goal_in == true then
			self.is_goal_in = false
			self:next_stage()
		end

		-- 달리기 시작
		character_util.set_anim(self.jump_player, { name = 'run' })

		-- 게임 루프 메인
		while self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.playing and self.game_loop == true do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)	-- 프레임 드랍에 의한 오작동 방지
			self:player_action()
			self:game_update(dt)
			self:check_collision()
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	-- 서브 포지션 계속 업데이트(게임오버 처리)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.update_baby_routine, self))
end

-- 다음 스테이지
function local_class:next_stage()
	self.stage = self.stage + 1

	-- 페이드 아웃
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- 모든 npc 숨기기
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		self.fo_wrappers:set_active(data.fo, false)
	end

	-- 플레이어 초기화
	self.jump_player.Position = vector(self.player_pos_marker.position.x, 0, 4.8)
	self.prev_position = self.jump_player.Position

	-- 시작 패턴 생성
	self:make_start_pattern()

	-- 카메라 초기화
	local center_x = 8.5
	self.center_pos = unity_class.vector3(center_x, 0, 7)
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.center_pos
	camera_util.resize_to(5.5, 0)

	-- UI 초기화
	self:game_ui_show()
	coroutine.yield()
	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(true)

	-- 배경 초기화
	for _, data in ipairs(self.background_data_list) do
		self:reset_bg(data)
	end

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	-- BGM 재생
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.data.main_bgm_name, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
end

-- 서브 포지션 계속 업데이트 루틴
function local_class:update_baby_routine()
	while self.baby_update == true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		self:update_baby(dt)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 유저의 행동 처리
function local_class:player_action()
	-- 점프 입력 받기
	local jump_button_touch_down = false
	if self.jump_button_touch_down == true then
		jump_button_touch_down = true
		self.jump_button_touch_down = false
	end

	-- 점프 실행
	if jump_button_touch_down and self.jump_count < self.data.jump_max then
		self:jump_start()
	end
end

-- 스테이지 종료 연출
function local_class:stage_ending()
	character_util.move_to_async(self.jump_player, vector(self.goal_x + 16, self.jump_player.Position.y, self.jump_player.Position.z), nil, 6)
	self.baby_update = false
	character_util.set_anim(self.jump_player, { name = 'idle' })
	for _, data in ipairs(self.baby_list) do
		character_util.set_anim(data.fo, { name = 'idle' })
	end

	-- BGM 종료
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.stage_clear_sfx_name)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 아기 호랑이 보너스
	local bonus_score = 1000
	for _, data in ipairs(self.baby_list) do
		character_util.set_direction(data.fo, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim(data.fo, { name = 'victory' })
		data.fo.Position = data.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, -0.2)
		self:show_score_effect(data.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, 2), bonus_score)
		self:add_score(bonus_score)
		bonus_score = bonus_score + 1000
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.goal_bonus_sfx_name)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
	end

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.clear
end

-- 아기 호랑이 위치 업데이트
function local_class:update_baby(dt)
	for i = self.sub_pos_max, 2, -1 do
		self.sub_pos_list[i] = self.sub_pos_list[i - 1]
	end
	self.sub_pos_list[1] = self.jump_player.Position
	local scale = self.sub_pos_scale

	-- 서브 플레이어 위치 갱신
	for i = 1, #self.baby_list do
		self.baby_list[i].fo.Position = vector(self.jump_player.Position.x - 0.5 - (i * 0.5), 0, self.sub_pos_list[scale + i * scale].z)
	end
end

-- 점프 시작
function local_class:jump_start()
	self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.jump
	self.jump_count = self.jump_count + 1
	self.prev_position = self.jump_player.Position
	self.jump_progress = 0
	self.jump_start_position = self.jump_player.Position

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.jump_sfx_name)
end

-- 주인공 궤적에 걸리는 발판 데이터 찾기
function local_class:get_foothold_data(prev_pos, current_pos)
	local distance_max = 2	-- 플레이어 크기와 발판 크기를 고려해서 충돌 가능한 최대 거리로 설정
	for _, data in ipairs(self.foothold_data_list) do
		local foothold = data.fo
		if self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(foothold) and
				math.abs(foothold.Position.x - self.jump_player.Position.x) <= distance_max then
			local bounds = self:get_foothold_bounds(foothold)
			-- 밟았는지 확인
			if self:check_foot_cross(self.jump_player.Bounds, bounds, prev_pos, current_pos) == true then
				return data
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 플레이어 낙하 궤적과 발판 교차여부 판단
function local_class:check_foot_cross(bounds1, bounds2, prev_pos, current_pos)
	local line_z = bounds2.max.z
	if bounds1.min.x <= bounds2.max.x and bounds1.max.x >= bounds2.min.x then
		if prev_pos.z >= line_z and current_pos.z <= line_z then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 주인공 충돌하는 벽 찾기
function local_class:get_wall_data()
	local distance_max = 2	-- 플레이어 크기와 발판 크기를 고려해서 충돌 가능한 최대 거리로 설정
	for _, data in ipairs(self.wall_data_list) do
		local wall = data.fo
		if self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(wall) and math.abs(wall.Position.x - self.jump_player.Position.x) <= distance_max then
			local bounds = self:get_wall_bounds(wall)
			if bounds:Intersects(self.jump_player.Bounds) then
				return data
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 수정된 벽 바운더리 얻기
function local_class:get_wall_bounds(wall)
	return wall.Bounds
end

-- 게임 업데이트
function local_class:game_update(dt)
	-- 달리기
	if self.jump_player.Position.x < self.goal_x or self.current_jump_state ~= self.jump_state.none then
		self.jump_player.Position = self.jump_player.Position + vector(dt * self.data.run_speed, 0, 0)
	elseif self.is_goal_in == false then
		self.is_goal_in = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.stage_ending, self))
	end

	-- 골인 지점 지나면 UI 숨김
	if self.show_jump_button == true and self.jump_player.Position.x >= self.goal_x then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:SetUIEventReceive(false)
		self.show_jump_button = false
	end

	-- 주인공 상태에 따른 처리
	if self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.jump then
		self:jump_update(dt)
	elseif self.current_jump_state == self.jump_state.free_fall then
		self:free_fall_update(dt)
	else
		local data = self:get_foothold_data(self.jump_player.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.01), self.jump_player.Position - vector(0, 0, 0.01))
		-- 발 아래 발판이 없음
		if data == nil then
			self.jump_start_position = self.jump_player.Position
			self.prev_position = self.jump_player.Position
			self.jump_progress = 0
			self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.free_fall
		end
	end

	-- 아기 호랑이 위치 갱신
	if self.baby_update == true then
		self:update_baby(dt)
	end

	-- 카메라 이동
	local prev_camera_x = self.center_pos.x
	local camera_offset = 3
	if self.jump_player.Position.x >= self.goal_x then
		camera_offset = 0
	end

	if self.center_pos.x < self.jump_player.Position.x + camera_offset then
		self.center_pos = unity_class.vector3(self.jump_player.Position.x + camera_offset, 0, self.center_pos.z)
	end
	--camera_util.move(self.center_pos, 0)
	user_party.Leader.Position = self.center_pos
	local camera_diff = self.center_pos.x - prev_camera_x

	-- 배경 무한 루프
	local center_pos = self.center_pos
	local size_x = self.half_screen_size.x

	for _, data in ipairs(self.background_data_list) do
		self:move_bg(data, center_pos, size_x, camera_diff)
	end

	-- 다음 발판 생성
	local diff_x = self.next_foothold_x - self.jump_player.Position.x
	if diff_x < 30 then
		self:make_new_pattern()
	end

	-- 스크롤 넘어간 NPC 숨기기
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(data.fo)
		and data.type ~= self.data.npc_type.baby
		and self:is_fo_in_screen(data.fo.Position, 1) == false then
			character_util.stop(data.fo)
			self.fo_wrappers:set_active(data.fo, false)
		end
	end

	-- 화면하단 아래로 낙하 체크
	if self.jump_player.Position.z <= -2 then
		if self.cheat_immortal == false then
			self:fail()
		else	-- 치트 모드일 때는 하늘에서 나옴
			self.jump_player.Position = vector(self.jump_player.Position.x, 0, 10)
			self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.none
			self.jump_count = 0
		end
	end
end

-- 벽에 부딪침
function local_class:on_crash_wall()
	if self.cheat_immortal == false and self.current_game_progress ~= self.game_progress.fail then
		self:fail()
		character_util.set_anim(self.jump_player, { name = 'damaged' })
		local target_pos = vector(self.jump_player.Position.x - 2, 0, -2)
		character_util.jump_move(self.jump_player, target_pos, 8, 4, false)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.hit_sfx_name)
	end
end

-- 배경 이동
function local_class:move_bg(data, center_pos, size_x, camera_diff)
	local bg = data.prefab
	local next_pos = bg.transform.position + vector(camera_diff * data.speed, 0, 0)
	if next_pos.x + (self.data.bg_width * 0.75) < center_pos.x - size_x then
		next_pos = next_pos + vector(self.data.bg_width * 2, 0, 0)
	end
	bg.transform.position = next_pos
end

-- 점프 상태 업데이트
function local_class:jump_update(dt)
	self.prev_position = self.jump_player.Position

	-- 점프 z 값 얻어 좌표 수정
	self.jump_progress = self.jump_progress + dt
	local z = self.jump_calculator:GetDistance(self.jump_progress)
	self.jump_player.Position = vector(self.jump_player.Position.x, 0, self.jump_start_position.z + z)

	-- 낙하 중 플레이어 발 아래에 발판이 있으면 점프 종료
	local prev_z = self.prev_position.z
	if prev_z > z then
		self:check_fall_end()
	end
end

-- 자유 낙하 상태 업데이트
function local_class:free_fall_update(dt)
	self.prev_position = self.jump_player.Position

	-- 낙하 z 값 적용
	self.jump_progress = self.jump_progress + dt
	local z = self.free_fall_calculator:GetDistance(self.jump_progress)
	self.jump_player.Position = vector(self.jump_player.Position.x, 0, self.jump_start_position.z + z)

	self:check_fall_end()
end

-- 낙하 종료 체크
function local_class:check_fall_end()
	-- 밟았는지 확인
	local foothold_data = self:get_foothold_data(self.prev_position, self.jump_player.Position)

	if foothold_data == nil then
		-- 벽 충돌 체크
		if self:get_wall_data() then
			self:on_crash_wall()
			return
		end

		-- 발판에 걸친 거 인정해 줌
		local distance_max = 2	-- 플레이어 크기와 발판 크기를 고려해서 충돌 가능한 최대 거리로 설정
		for _, data in ipairs(self.foothold_data_list) do
			local foothold = data.fo
			if self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(foothold)
					and math.abs(foothold.Position.x - self.jump_player.Position.x) <= distance_max then
				local bounds = self:get_foothold_bounds(foothold)
				if bounds:Intersects(self.jump_player.Bounds) then
					foothold_data = data
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- 착지 성공
	if foothold_data ~= nil then
		local bounds = self:get_foothold_bounds(foothold_data.fo)
		self.current_jump_state = self.jump_state.none
		self.jump_count = 0

		-- 발판 바운더리로 z 좌표 보정
		self.jump_player.Position = vector(self.jump_player.Position.x, 0, bounds.max.z)
	end
end

-- 수정된 발판 바운더리 얻기
function local_class:get_foothold_bounds(foothold)
	return foothold.Bounds
end

-- 처음 발판 배치
function local_class:make_start_pattern()
	self.next_foothold_z = 4	--	다음 발판 Z 좌표

	local x = -6
	for _ = 1, 13 do
		self:spawn_foothold(x, self.next_foothold_z)
		self:spawn_wall(x, self.next_foothold_z - 10)
		x = x + 2
	end

	self.next_foothold_x = x	-- 다음 발판 X 좌표
end

-- 다음 발판 X 좌표 구하기
function local_class:get_next_foothold_x()
	local max = math.min(4 + self.stage, 7)
	local width = self:get_random_int(4, max)
	return self.next_foothold_x + width
end

-- 다음 발판 Z 좌표 구하기
function local_class:get_next_foothold_z()
	local diff = 4
	local z_max = math.min(self.next_foothold_z + diff, self.data.foothold_height_max)
	local rand_num = self:get_random_int(1, 100)
	local rand_z = 0
	if self.next_foothold_z <= 5 then
		if rand_num <= 50 then
			-- 50% 확률로 랜덤 패턴
			rand_z = self:get_random_int(1, z_max)
		else
			-- 50% 확률로 올라가는 패턴
			rand_z = self:get_random_int(self.next_foothold_z, z_max)
		end
	else
		if rand_num <= 50 then
			-- 50% 확률로 랜덤 패턴
			rand_z = self:get_random_int(1, z_max)
		else
			-- 50% 확률로 내려가는 패턴
			rand_z = self:get_random_int(1, self.next_foothold_z - 1)
		end
	end

	return rand_z
end

-- 평범한 발판 배치
function local_class:spawn_normal_foothold(set_up_wall)
	local foothold_width = self:get_random_int(1, 2)
	if self.stage == 1 then
		foothold_width = 2
	end

	local up_wall_height = math.max(7 - self.stage * 0.5, 3.5)
	local up_wall_z = self.next_foothold_z + up_wall_height
	if self.stage < 3 or foothold_width == 1 or up_wall_z > 12 then
		set_up_wall = false
	end

	for _ = 1, foothold_width do
		-- 윗벽
		if set_up_wall == true then
			self:spawn_wall(self.next_foothold_x, up_wall_z)
		end

		-- 아랫벽
		self:spawn_wall(self.next_foothold_x, self.next_foothold_z - 10)

		self:spawn_foothold(self.next_foothold_x, self.next_foothold_z)
		self:spawn_item(self.next_foothold_x, self.next_foothold_z + 0.8)
		self.next_foothold_x = self.next_foothold_x + 2
	end
end

-- 새로운 발판 배치
function local_class:make_new_pattern()
	-- 새끼 배치 발판
	if self.baby_item_progress >= self.data.baby_item_progress_max then
		if self.item_baby_set_count < self.baby_max and self.baby_item_progress >= self.data.baby_item_progress_max then
			self.next_foothold_x = self:get_next_foothold_x()
			self.next_foothold_z = self:get_next_foothold_z()

			self:spawn_enemy(self.next_foothold_x + 2, self.next_foothold_z + 3, self.item_baby_set_count)
			self.item_baby_set_count = self.item_baby_set_count + 1

			-- 발판 배치
			for i = 1, 3 do
				self:spawn_foothold(self.next_foothold_x, self.next_foothold_z)
				self:spawn_wall(self.next_foothold_x, self.next_foothold_z - 10)
				self.next_foothold_x = self.next_foothold_x + 2
			end

			-- 초기화
			self.baby_item_progress = self.baby_item_progress - self.data.baby_item_progress_max
		else
			if self.goal_x == self.data.goal_not_set then
				self.next_foothold_x = self:get_next_foothold_x()
				self.goal_x = self.next_foothold_x

				-- 집배치
				self:show_sprites_data(self.sprites_data[1], true)
				self.sprites_data[1].sprite.Transform.localPosition = vector(self.goal_x + 21, 0, 6.3)
			end

			self:spawn_foothold(self.next_foothold_x, 4)
			self:spawn_wall(self.next_foothold_x, -6)
			self.next_foothold_x = self.next_foothold_x + 2
		end
	else
		local prev_foothold_x = self.next_foothold_x
		local prev_foothold_z = self.next_foothold_z

		-- 다음 발판 위치 얻기
		self.next_foothold_x = self:get_next_foothold_x()
		self.next_foothold_z = self:get_next_foothold_z()

		local foothold_diff_x = self.next_foothold_x - prev_foothold_x
		local foothold_diff_z = self.next_foothold_z - prev_foothold_z

		-- 벽이 존재할 수 있는 간격 한계
		local height_diff_max = -99
		if foothold_diff_x == 4 then
			height_diff_max = -3
		elseif foothold_diff_x == 5 then
			height_diff_max = -4
		elseif foothold_diff_x == 6 then
			height_diff_max = -5
		end

		-- 불가능 패턴 막기
		local set_up_wall = true
		if foothold_diff_z < height_diff_max or foothold_diff_x <= 4 then
			set_up_wall = false
		end

		-- 평범한 발판 배치
		self:spawn_normal_foothold(set_up_wall)

		self.baby_item_progress = self.baby_item_progress + 1
	end
end

-- 발판 배치
function local_class:spawn_foothold(x, z)
	-- 비활성화된 발판 찾기
	local foothold_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.data.npc_type.foothold)

	-- 발판 찾을 수 없으면 nil 리턴(에러)
	if foothold_data == nil then
		print("tiger jump game error : foothold not found")
		return nil
	end

	local foothold = foothold_data.fo
	foothold.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(foothold, true)

	character_util.set_anim(foothold, { name = 'normal' })
	foothold.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	foothold.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_foothold)

	return foothold_data
end

-- 벽 배치
function local_class:spawn_wall(x, z)
	-- 비활성화된 벽 찾기
	local wall_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.data.npc_type.wall)

	-- 발판 찾을 수 없으면 nil 리턴(에러)
	if wall_data == nil then
		print("tiger jump game error : wall not found")
		return nil
	end

	local wall = wall_data.fo
	wall.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(wall, true)

	character_util.set_anim(wall, { name = 'idle' })
	wall.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(0)
	wall.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_wall)

	return wall_data
end

-- 랜덤 값 얻기(완전 랜덤으로 할지 정해진 랜덤으로 할지)
function local_class:get_random_int(min, max)
	return random_util.get_random_int(min, max)
end

-- 아이템 배치
function local_class:spawn_item(x, z)
	local item_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.data.npc_type.bonus)

	-- 아이템을 찾을 수 없으면 nil 리턴(에러)
	if item_data == nil then
		print("tiger jump game error : item not found")
		return nil
	end

	local item = item_data.fo
	item.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(item, true)

	item.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_item)
	local random_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, 3)
	if random_num == 1 then
		character_util.set_anim(item, { name = 'idle' })
	elseif random_num == 2 then
		character_util.set_anim(item, { name = 'idle2' })
	elseif random_num == 3 then
		character_util.set_anim(item, { name = 'idle3' })
	end

	return item_data
end

-- 적 배치
function local_class:spawn_enemy(x, z, baby_count)
	-- 비활성화된 발판 찾기
	local enemy_data = nil
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if data.type == self.data.npc_type.enemy and not self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(data.fo) then
			enemy_data = data
			break
		end
	end

	-- 적을 찾을 수 없으면 nil 리턴(에러)
	if enemy_data == nil then
		print("tiger jump game error : enemy not found")
		return nil
	end

	local enemy = enemy_data.fo
	enemy.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(enemy, true)
	character_util.set_direction(enemy, 'left')
	enemy.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_enemy)

	-- 아기 호랑이 배치
	self:spawn_item_baby(x, z - 0.6, baby_count)

	return enemy_data
end

-- 서브 플레이어 붙이기
function local_class:add_baby(id)
	local npc_data = self:get_disable_npc(self.data.npc_type.baby)
	if npc_data ~= nil then
		table.insert(self.baby_list, npc_data)
		self.fo_wrappers:set_active(npc_data.fo, true)
		character_util.set_direction(npc_data.fo, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim(npc_data.fo, { name = 'run' })
		npc_data.fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_player + 1)
		npc_data.fo.SpineController.SkinName = self:get_baby_skin_name(id)
	end
end

-- 새끼(아이템) 배치
function local_class:spawn_item_baby(x, z, baby_count)
	local data = self:get_disable_npc(self.data.npc_type.item_baby)

	-- 아이템을 찾을 수 없으면 nil 리턴(에러)
	if data == nil then
		print("tiger jump game error : item baby not found")
		return nil
	end

	local fo = data.fo
	fo.Position = vector(x, 0, z)
	self.fo_wrappers:set_active(fo, true)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(data.fo, { name = 'caught' })
	fo.SpineController.SkinName = self:get_baby_skin_name(baby_count)
	fo.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', self.data.priority_item)
	data.count = baby_count	-- 아기 호랑이 번호 기억

	return data
end

-- 점수 세팅
function local_class:set_score(score)
	self.current_score = math.min(score, CS.System.Double.MaxValue)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameScoreChangeEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.current_score))
end

-- 점수 증가
function local_class:add_score(score)
	self:set_score(self.current_score + score)
end

-- 아이템 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_collision()
	for _, data in ipairs(self.npc_data_list) do
		if not self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(data.fo) then
			goto continue
		end

		if data.type == self.data.npc_type.bonus then
			if data.fo.Bounds:Intersects(self.jump_player.Bounds) then
				self:show_score_effect(data.fo.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), self.data.bonus_item_score)
				self:add_score(self.data.bonus_item_score)
				self.fo_wrappers:set_active(data.fo, false)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.get_item_sfx_name)
			end
		elseif data.type == self.data.npc_type.item_baby then
			if data.fo.Bounds:Intersects(self.jump_player.Bounds) then
				if not self.fo_wrappers:is_enabled(data.fo) then
					goto continue
				end

				self:add_baby(data.count)
				self.fo_wrappers:set_active(data.fo, false)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.get_baby_sfx_name)
			end
		end
		::continue::
	end
end

-- 필드 오브젝트가 화면 안에 있는지 검사
function local_class:is_fo_in_screen(fo_position, bonus_dis)
	local center_pos = self.center_pos
	local size_x = self.half_screen_size.x + bonus_dis

	-- 왼쪽으로 벗어난 경우 체크
	if fo_position.x < center_pos.x - size_x then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 게임오버 이벤트 발생
function local_class:fail()
	if self.current_game_progress == self.game_progress.fail then
		return
	end

	self.current_game_progress = self.game_progress.fail
	self.game_loop = false
end

-- 게임오버
function local_class:game_over()
	-- BGM 종료
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 0})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.data.game_over_sfx_name)
	wait_for_sec(2)
	self.baby_update = false

	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, true))
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경
function local_class:change_manual_character()
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party_leader

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))
end

-- 게임패드 UI 표시
function local_class:show_gamepad_label()
	self.gamepad_label = gamepad_util.show_joypad_label()
end

-- 게임 패드 UI 숨기기
function local_class:hide_gamepad_label()
	gamepad_util.hide_joypad_label(self.gamepad_label)

	self.gamepad_label = nil
end

--endregion

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadConnectedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadDisconnectedEvent))

	self.game_loop = false

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.data = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil

	self.player_pos_marker = nil
	self.saved_party_leader = nil
	self.game_progress = nil
	self.sprites_data = nil
	self.custom_atlas = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local local_class = newclass('TimberGame')

function local_class:init()
	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'TimberGame'

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	-- 추후 다른 입장 케이스가 필요한 경우 처리용
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	-- 리소스 홀더
	self.resholder = nil

	--region UI
	-- 좌우 버튼
	self.right_button = nil
	self.right_button_touch_handler = nil

	self.left_button = nil
	self.left_button_touch_handler = nil

	-- 게임패드 대응
	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false
	--endregion

	-- 실패하여 터치 불가능 중인지
	self.fail_disadvantage_time = false

	-- 오브젝트 풀 프리셋
	self.ui_num_counter_preset = 'FieldUINumCounter'
	self.minigame_correct_effect_preset = 'steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_blue'
	self.minigame_fail_effect_preset = 'steampunk_rhythm_minigame_hit_blue'

	self.is_playing_game = false
	self.current_wood_index = 1
	self.total_wood_count = 1
	self.failed_count = 0
	self.wood_list = { }
	self.tree_pos = nil

	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end
	self.get_fail_counter_ui = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter') end

	self.game_attack_dir_type = { left = 0, right = 1 }
	self.is_playing_attack_scene = false
	self.is_playing_tree_down = false
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key

	local constants_data = require('minigame/TimberGame/TimberGameConstants')
	self.constants_data = constants_data[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	coroutine.yield(unity_object_pool.WaitAll())

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	-- 오브젝트 풀 로드
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.ui_num_counter_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.minigame_correct_effect_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.minigame_fail_effect_preset)
	self.get_fx_hit()
	self.get_fail_counter_ui()

	self:dispose_resource_holder()
	self.resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 화살표 UI 로드
	if self.right_button == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.resholder, 'ondemand/short_story_rosetta/ui', 'MiniGameRightArrow', function(prefab)
					self.right_button = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.right_button:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end

	if self.left_button == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				self.resholder, 'ondemand/short_story_rosetta/ui', 'MiniGameLeftArrow', function(prefab)
					self.left_button = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
					self.left_button:SetActive(false)
				end)
	end

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:load_fail_counter()
	local life = self.constants_data.system_data.game_failed_count
	local ui_fail_counter_obj = self.get_fail_counter_ui():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
	self.ui_fail_counter = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))

	for i = 0, ui_fail_counter_obj.transform.childCount - 1 do
		local child_obj = ui_fail_counter_obj.transform:GetChild(i).gameObject
		if i < life then
			child_obj:SetActive(true)
		else
			child_obj:SetActive(false)
		end
	end

	local layout_positioner = ui_fail_counter_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
	layout_positioner.AnchorPosition = CS.Oak.Direction.None
	layout_positioner.Position = vector(20, -200)

	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
	self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()
end

function local_class:unload_fail_counter()
	if self.ui_fail_counter then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
end


function local_class:dispose()
	self:unload_fail_counter()
	self:dispose_resource_holder()
	self:dispose_tree()
	self.wood_bounds = nil
	self.tree_pos = nil
	self.is_playing_attack_scene = false
	self.is_playing_tree_down = false
	self.pre_setting = nil
	self.success_scene = nil
	self.tree_pos = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.left_button) then
		local t = self.left_button
		self.left_button = nil
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(t)
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.right_button) then
		local t = self.right_button
		self.right_button = nil
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(t)
	end
end

function local_class:game_end()
	self:dispose_resource_holder()
	self:unload_fail_counter()
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	-- 게임패드 버튼 플래그 초기화
	self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
	self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Show()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	stage_camera:SetTarget(leader)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

	character_util.hide_weapon(leader, false)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(leader)

	self.wood_bounds = nil
	self.is_playing_attack_scene = false
	self.is_playing_tree_down = false
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self.tree_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.system_data.tree_pos_marker).position
	self.current_wood_index = 1
	self.is_playing_attack_scene = false
	self.is_playing_tree_down = false

	if self.pre_setting ~= nil then
		self:pre_setting()
	end

	start_coroutine(self.game_start_scene, self)
end

function local_class:game_update()
	if self.is_playing_game == false then
		return
	end

	-- 버튼 연속 누르기 방지
	local timer = 0
	local disadvantage_timer = 0
	local ignore_touch_delay = self.constants_data.system_data.ignore_touch_delay
	local disadvantage_time = 1

	-- 버튼 눌러진 상태 체크
	local left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
	local right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed

	local left_button_pos = self.left_button.transform.localPosition
	local right_button_pos = self.right_button.transform.localPosition

	local game_win = false
	local game_duration = self.constants_data.system_data.game_duration
	local game_failed_count = self.constants_data.system_data.game_failed_count

	self.fail_disadvantage_time = false
	self.failed_count = 0
	self.timer_is_alive = true
	self.scene_play_infos = { }

	timer_util.start_timer(
			{ duration = game_duration,
			  handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })

	timer_util.set_position_based_on_anchor(vector(0, -520))

	while self.is_playing_game do
		if self.failed_count >= game_failed_count then
			game_win = false
			self.is_playing_game = false
			break
		end

		if self.current_wood_index > self.total_wood_count then
			game_win = true
			self.is_playing_game = false
			break
		end

		-- 터치 상태면 일정 시간 대기 후 다시 터치 가능한 상태로 변경
		if self.is_ignore_touch_event then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if timer >= ignore_touch_delay then
				timer = 0
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = false
			end
		end

		-- 터치 체크 (버튼에서 손 땔 때 애니메이션 처리도 해야 되서 ignore_touch_event 상태여도 실행함)
		-- 버튼 누르거나 떼는 Animation 처리 (down : 누른 상태, up : 뗀 상태)
		local left_down = false
		local left_up = false
		local right_down = false
		local right_up = false

		-- 버튼이 눌러졌는지 체크 코드
		local current_left_pressed = self.left_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.A)
				or self.gamepad_left_button_pressed == true

		local current_right_pressed = self.right_button_touch_handler.Pressed
				or CS.UnityEngine.Input.GetKey(CS.UnityEngine.KeyCode.D)
				or self.gamepad_right_button_pressed == true

		self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = false
		self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = false

		self.left_button_touch_handler:Update()
		self.right_button_touch_handler:Update()

		-- 눌렀는지 떼었는지 확인
		if current_left_pressed ~= left_pressed then
			if current_left_pressed then
				left_down = true
			else
				left_up = true
			end

			left_pressed = current_left_pressed
		elseif current_right_pressed ~= right_pressed then
			if current_right_pressed then
				right_down = true
			else
				right_up = true
			end

			right_pressed = current_right_pressed
		end

		-- 왼쪽 버튼 눌렀을 때 애니메이션 처리
		if left_down then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')

			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

			-- 버튼 터치 가능한 상태면 입력 처리
			if not self.is_ignore_touch_event and not self.fail_disadvantage_time and not self.is_playing_attack_scene then
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = true

				self:touch_left_button()
			end
			-- 왼쪽 버튼 떼었을 때 애니메이션 처리
		elseif left_up then
			self.left_button.transform.localPosition = left_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 1, 1, 0.8}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
		end

		-- 오른쪽 버튼 눌렀을 때 애니메이션 처리
		if right_down then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_switch_button_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_snowball_throw_01')

			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos + vector(0, -10, 0)

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({0.2274, 0.1411, 0.1411, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 0.7921, 0.3647, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))

			-- 버튼 터치 가능한 상태면 입력 처리
			if not self.is_ignore_touch_event and not self.fail_disadvantage_time and not self.is_playing_attack_scene then
				self.is_ignore_touch_event = true

				self:touch_right_button()
			end
			-- 오른쪽 버튼 떼었을 때 애니메이션 처리
		elseif right_up then
			self.right_button.transform.localPosition = right_button_pos

			self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({0, 0, 0, 1}),
					unity_color({1, 1, 1, 0.8}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.bgm_name ~= nil then
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 0)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field'})
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0, 0)
	end

	self:dispose_button()

	if self.timer_is_alive then
		timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
		self.timer_is_alive = false
	end

	if game_win then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
		wait_for_sec(1.5)
	end

	while self.is_playing_attack_scene do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for key, value in pairs(self.scene_play_infos) do
		while self.scene_play_infos[key] do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local leader = get_party_leader()

	if game_win then
		if self.success_scene ~= nil then
			self:success_scene()
		else
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, {name = 'smile'})
			character_util.set_anim(leader, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false})
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
		end
	else
		-- 타임 오버에 의한 실패시 연출 추가
		if self.failed_count < game_failed_count then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'tired' })
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'frustration', loop = false })
			wait_for_sec(1.3)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	character_util.spine_remove_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1')

	self:game_end()

	if not game_win then
		self:create_tree()
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, game_win))
end

function local_class:dispose_button()

	if self.left_button then
		self.left_button:SetActive(false)
		self:set_button_tint(self.left_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
				unity_color({0.7255, 0.1059, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
	end

	if self.right_button then
		self.right_button:SetActive(false)
		self:set_button_tint(self.right_button, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 1}),
				unity_color({0.1059, 0.7255, 0.1059, 1}), unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0.5}))
	end
end

	if self.is_playing_game and not self.is_ignore_touch_event then
		if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftShoulderDown then
			self.gamepad_left_button_pressed = true
		elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightTriggerDown
				or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.RightShoulderDown then
			self.gamepad_right_button_pressed = true
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:touch_left_button()
	if not self.is_playing_game or self.current_wood_index > self.total_wood_count then
		return
	end

	start_coroutine(self.wood_attack, self, self.game_attack_dir_type.left)
end

function local_class:touch_right_button()
	if not self.is_playing_game or self.current_wood_index > self.total_wood_count then
		return
	end

	start_coroutine(self.wood_attack, self, self.game_attack_dir_type.right)
end

function local_class:wood_attack(attack_dir)
	local failed_count = self.failed_count
	local game_failed_count = self.constants_data.system_data.game_failed_count
	if not self.is_playing_game or self.current_wood_index > self.total_wood_count or self.failed_count >= game_failed_count then
		return
	end

	if self.is_playing_attack_scene then
		logger_util.error('error! wood_attack failed. can not attack')
		return
	end

	self.is_playing_attack_scene = true

	local leader = get_party_leader()
	local wood_type = self:get_wood_type_by_index(self.current_wood_index)
	local deny_wood_type = 2
	local increase_failed_count = false
	local can_play_game_over = false

	if attack_dir == self.game_attack_dir_type.right then
		deny_wood_type = 3
	end

	-- 해당 방향으로 움직인 뒤에 공격 모션
	local start_pos = self:get_position_by_attack_dir(attack_dir)

	leader.Position = start_pos
	character_util.set_direction(leader, self:get_direction_by_attack_dir(attack_dir))

	local target_dir = (self.tree_pos - leader.Position).normalized
	local distance_vector = target_dir * 0.3
	local can_down_tree = false

	-- 왼쪽에 가지가 뻗어있는 나무 기둥이 아니라면 피격 판정을 받지 않게 해주어야한다.
	if wood_type == deny_wood_type then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		failed_count = failed_count + 1

		-- 실패 카운트를 올려주자.
		local ui_fail_counter = self.ui_fail_counter

		if ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
			ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(failed_count)
			ui_fail_counter:Reposition()
		end

		if failed_count < game_failed_count then
			-- 히트 판정 일어나야 함
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

			local fx_hit_inst = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + (target_dir * 0.1))
			fx_hit_inst.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.8
			camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)


			-- 피격 애니메이션 재생 및 조작불능 시간
			character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(leader, -target_dir * 0.7, 0.4, 0.2)
			wait_for_sec(0.4)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_idle', loop = true })
			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		else
			can_play_game_over = true
		end
	else
		local hit_pos = self.tree_pos - (target_dir * 0.15) + vector(0, 0.4, 0)
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(hit_pos)

		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_attack', loop = false, scale = 3 })
		character_util.move_distance_async(leader, distance_vector, nil, 9)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_slash_loop_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_monster_01')

		start_coroutine(self.wood_crash, self, self.current_wood_index, attack_dir)
		start_coroutine(self.tree_down_scene, self)

		if failed_count >= game_failed_count then
			can_play_game_over = true
		else
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
			character_util.remove_anim(leader)
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_idle', loop = true })
			character_util.move_to_async(leader, start_pos, 0, 9)
		end

		-- 만약 트리가 내려가는 도중이면 기달리게 한다.
		while self.is_playing_tree_down do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.current_wood_index = self.current_wood_index + 1

		wood_type = self:get_wood_type_by_index(self.current_wood_index)

		-- 위에서 내려오는 가지가 유저와 충돌되는 상황.
		if wood_type == deny_wood_type then
			if can_play_game_over == false then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')

				failed_count = failed_count + 1

				local ui_fail_counter = self.ui_fail_counter

				if ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
					ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(failed_count)
					ui_fail_counter:Reposition()
				end

				-- 실패 카운트 체크
				if failed_count >= game_failed_count then
					can_play_game_over = true
				else
					character_util.spine_pulse_color(leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish(leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

					local fx_hit_inst = self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(leader.Position + (target_dir * 0.1))
					fx_hit_inst.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1) * 0.8
					camera_util.shake(0.03, 0.3)

					-- 피격 애니메이션 재생 및 조작불능 시간
					character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'damaged' })
					character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

					character_util.spine_deviate_local(leader, -target_dir * 0.7, 0.4, 0.2)
					wait_for_sec(0.4)
					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
					character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_idle', loop = true })
					wait_for_sec(0.2)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	self.failed_count = failed_count

	if can_play_game_over then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0, 0)

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, {name = 'dead', loop = false}, {name = 'confused'})
		character_util.move_distance(leader, target_dir * -0.5, nil, 3)

		self:unload_fail_counter()
		self:dispose_button()
		if self.timer_is_alive then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
			self.timer_is_alive = false
		end
		wait_for_sec(3)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	self.is_playing_attack_scene = false
end

function local_class:tree_down_scene()
	if self.is_playing_tree_down then
		logger_util.error('error! tree_down_scene failed.')
		return
	end

	local current_wood_index = self.current_wood_index + 1

	if current_wood_index > self.total_wood_count then
		return
	end

	self.is_playing_tree_down = true

	for i = current_wood_index, #self.wood_list do
		local prev_wood_item = self.wood_list[i-1]
		local prev_wood_type = self:get_wood_type_by_index(i-1)
		local prev_height = self:get_wood_height_by_type(prev_wood_type)

		local cur_wood_item = self.wood_list[i]
		local cur_wood_type = self:get_wood_type_by_index(i)

		local target_pos = cur_wood_item.Position - vector(0, prev_height, 0)

		drop_item_util.move_item(cur_wood_item, target_pos, { duration = 0.08 })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.083)

	self.is_playing_tree_down = false
end

function local_class:wood_crash(wood_index, attack_dir)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	local wood_key = 'wood_crash_' .. wood_index

	self.scene_play_infos[wood_key] = true

	local throw_dist = 3.5
	local throw_dir = vector(1, 0, 0)

	if attack_dir == self.game_attack_dir_type.right then
		throw_dir = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	end

	local wood_item = self.wood_list[wood_index]
	local goal_pos = self.tree_pos + (throw_dir * throw_dist)

	drop_item_util.throw_item(wood_item, goal_pos, { rotation_num = 1, initial_velocity = 8 })
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(wood_item, 0, 0.5)

	self.scene_play_infos[wood_key] = nil
end

function local_class:get_position_by_attack_dir(attack_dir)
	local result = self.tree_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0)

	if attack_dir == self.game_attack_dir_type.right then
		result = self.tree_pos + vector(1, 0, 0)
	end

	return result
end

function local_class:get_direction_by_attack_dir(attack_dir)
	local result = 'right'

	if attack_dir == self.game_attack_dir_type.right then
		result = 'left'
	end

	return result
end

-- 게임이 시작되는 씬
-- 페이드가 사용되어 환경이 백그라운드로 셋팅되는 씬이다.
-- 외부에서 페이드를 통해 진입해야 한다.
function local_class:game_start_scene()
	-- begin
	local leader = get_party_leader()
	--field_ui_manager:Hide()
	--party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	--screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create(self.game_name))

	local game_center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.constants_data.system_data.tree_pos_marker).position

	camera_util.move(game_center_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 0)
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0)

	leader.Position = self:get_position_by_attack_dir(self.game_attack_dir_type.left)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, self:get_direction_by_attack_dir(self.game_attack_dir_type.left))

	self.current_wood_index = 1
	self.total_wood_count = 1

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	-- process
	self:create_tree()
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'twohand_idle', loop = true })

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(leader, '[base]weapon1', 'axe')
	-- end
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	if self.pre_play_scene ~= nil then
		yield_return_func(self.pre_play_scene, self)
		self.pre_play_scene = nil
	end

	-- 게임패드 이벤트 활성화
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

	self:set_up_ui_button()

	-- 기존 UI 비활성화
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
			CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	if not self.is_show_pc_narration then
		self.is_show_pc_narration = true
		field_ui_util.show_pc_control_narration('tip_keyboard_two')
	end

	-- 경기 시작 카운트
	for i = 3, 1, -1 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(tostring(i), 2.1)

		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
	self:load_fail_counter()
	self.is_playing_game = true

	if self.bgm_name ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music( { name = self.bgm_name, state = 'event' })
		music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1, 0.3)
	end

	start_coroutine(self.game_update, self)
end

--- 데이터를 벡터로 변환
function local_class:change_to_vector(value)
	return vector(value[1], value[2], value[3])
end

--- 데이터를 칼라로 변환
function local_class:change_to_color(value)
	return unity_color(value)
end

function local_class:create_tree()
	if self.wood_list ~= nil then
		self:dispose_tree()
	end

	self.total_wood_count = table_util.get_size(self.constants_data.tree_data) + 1

	self.wood_bounds = { }

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.wood_type do
		local wood_type_data = self.constants_data.wood_type[i]
		table.insert(self.wood_bounds, {
			min = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_data.bounds.min),
			max = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_data.bounds.max)
		})
	end

	local last_wood_pos = self.tree_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	for i = 1, #self.constants_data.tree_data do
		local wood_type = self.constants_data.tree_data[i]
		local wood_type_info = self.constants_data.wood_type[wood_type]
		local wood_height = self:get_wood_height_by_type(wood_type)
		local item_id = wood_type_info.item_id
		local offset = vector(0, 0, 0)

		if wood_type_info.offset ~= nil then
			offset = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_info.offset)
		end

		local wood_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			pos = last_wood_pos + offset,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = false,
			skip_text = true
		})

		wood_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		last_wood_pos = last_wood_pos + vector(0.0, wood_height, 0.0)
		table.insert(self.wood_list, wood_item)
	end

	-- 마지막에 트리의 꼭대기를 만들어준다.

	local wood_type = 4
	local wood_type_info = self.constants_data.wood_type[wood_type]
	local item_id = wood_type_info.item_id
	local offset = vector(0, 0, 0)

	if wood_type_info.offset ~= nil then
		offset = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_info.offset)
	end

	local wood_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
		itemid = item_id,
		notforinven = true,
		pos = last_wood_pos + offset,
		lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		showoncharacter = false,
		skip_text = true
	})

	wood_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	table.insert(self.wood_list, wood_item)
end

-- tree에 대한 drop item 구성
function local_class:create_tree_items(key)
	local data = require('minigame/TimberGame/TimberGameConstants')
	local constants_data = data[key]
	local tree_pos = field:GetMarker(constants_data.system_data.tree_pos_marker).position

	local total_wood_count = table_util.get_size(constants_data.tree_data) + 1
	local wood_bounds = { }
	local wood_list = { }

	for i = 1, #constants_data.wood_type do
		local wood_type_data = constants_data.wood_type[i]
		table.insert(wood_bounds, {
			min = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_data.bounds.min),
			max = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_data.bounds.max)
		})
	end

	local last_wood_pos = tree_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	for i = 1, #constants_data.tree_data do
		local wood_type = constants_data.tree_data[i]
		local wood_type_info = constants_data.wood_type[wood_type]
		local wood_height = wood_bounds[wood_type].max.y
		local item_id = wood_type_info.item_id
		local offset = vector(0, 0, 0)

		if wood_type_info.offset ~= nil then
			offset = self:change_to_vector(wood_type_info.offset)
		end

		local wood_item = drop_item_util.create_item({
			itemid = item_id,
			notforinven = true,
			pos = last_wood_pos + offset,
			lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			showoncharacter = false,
			skip_text = true
		})

		wood_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		last_wood_pos = last_wood_pos + vector(0.0, wood_height, 0.0)
		table.insert(wood_list, wood_item)
	end

	-- 마지막에 트리의 꼭대기를 만들어준다.

	local wood_type = 4
	local wood_type_info = constants_data.wood_type[wood_type]
	local item_id = wood_type_info.item_id
	local offset = vector(0, 0, 0)

local resource_loader = newclass('TunnelRunResourceLoader')
local tile_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/TunnelRun/Controllers/TileController')

function resource_loader:init()
	self.res_holder = nil

	self.camera_pivot = nil
	self.camera = nil

	self.all_object_pool = {}

	self.fx_dash_loop = nil

	self.fx = setmetatable({
		impact = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_dreampower_impact')
		end,
		tile_nine = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_moneyshot_tile_nine')
		end,
		dash_start_loop = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_dreampower_dash_start_loop')
		end,
		dash_end = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_dreampower_dash_end')
		end,
		companion_trail = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_companion_trail')
		end,
		blink = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_blink')
		end,
		tile_break = function()
			return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_dv_moneyshot_tile_one_break')
		end
	}, {
		__index = {
			create_all = function(this)
				for _, creator in pairs(this) do
					creator()
				end
			end
		}
	})

	self.constants_data = nil
end

function resource_loader:load_resource(key)
	self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	screen_util.preload_tutorial_spine()

	self.fx:create_all()

	self.constants_data = require('minigame/TunnelRun/TunnelRunConstants')[key]

	local ring_object_pool_creator = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/TunnelRun/RingObjectPool')
	local spec = self.constants_data.coures_info

	local ring_prefab = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			self.res_holder, spec.asset_path, spec.asset_name,
			function(prefab)
				ring_prefab = prefab
			end)

	self.ring_object_pool = ring_object_pool_creator(ring_prefab,self.constants_data.preload_count, self.fx.tile_break())

	local qte_pool = self:create_qte_action_data(self.constants_data.qte_action_info)

	self.all_object_pool.qte_data = qte_pool

	self:create_camera(self.constants_data.camera_info)
	self.camera_pivot:SetActive(false)
end

function resource_loader:dispose()
	if not is_unity_null(self.camera_pivot) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.camera_pivot)
	end

	self.camera_pivot = nil
	self.camera = nil

	if self.ring_object_pool ~= nil then
		self.ring_object_pool:dispose()
		self.ring_object_pool = nil
	end

	local qte_data = self.all_object_pool.qte_data

	if qte_data ~= nil then
		for object_index = 1, #qte_data do
			local object = qte_data[object_index]
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(object)
		end
		qte_data = nil
	end

	local scene_data = self.all_object_pool.scene_data
	if scene_data ~= nil then
		for object_index = 1, #scene_data do
			local object = scene_data[object_index]
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(object)
		end
		scene_data = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.res_holder) then
		self.res_holder:Dispose()
		self.res_holder = nil
	end

	self.constants_data = nil

	if self.fx_dash_loop ~= nil then
		self.fx_dash_loop:Dispose()
		self.fx_dash_loop = nil
	end
end

function resource_loader:create_qte_action_data(spec)
	local original_action = load_util.load_prefab_async(
			self.res_holder, spec.asset_path, spec.asset_name
	)

	coroutine.yield()

	local data_pool = {
		object = original_action
	}

	return data_pool
end

function resource_loader:create_camera(spec)
	local camera_pivot = load_util.load_prefab_async(
			self.res_holder,
			spec.asset_path,
			spec.asset_name
	)

	--미니게임용 카메라
	local camera = camera_pivot.transform:GetChild(0).gameObject
	local stage_camera = stage_camera.Camera

	camera.transform.localPosition = stage_camera.transform.localPosition

	self.camera_pivot = camera_pivot
	self.camera = camera
end

function resource_loader:get_constants_data()
	return self.constants_data
end

function resource_loader:get_event_object_pool()
	return self.all_object_pool
end

function resource_loader:get_ring_object_pool()
	return self.ring_object_pool
end

function resource_loader:get_camera_pivot()
	return self.camera_pivot
end

function resource_loader:get_camera()
	return self.camera
end

function resource_loader:get_fx_data()
	return self.fx
end

function resource_loader:copy_camera_from(to, from)
	to.orthographic = from.orthographic
	to.orthographicSize = from.orthographicSize
	to.nearClipPlane = from.nearClipPlane
	to.farClipPlane = from.farClipPlane
	to.useOcclusionCulling = from.useOcclusionCulling
end

function resource_loader:set_dash_loop(is_active)
	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('minigame_start')

	if is_active then
		if self.fx_dash_loop == nil then
			self.fx_dash_loop = self.fx.dash_start_loop():Instantiate(pos)
		end
	else
		if self.fx_dash_loop ~= nil then
			self.fx.dash_end():Instantiate(pos)
			self.fx_dash_loop:Dispose()
			self.fx_dash_loop = nil
		end
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return resource_loader()
	end
}

local ring_object_pool = newclass('TunnelRunRingObjectPool')
local ring_object = newclass('TunnelRunRingObject')

do
	function ring_object:init(object, break_fx_pool)
		self.object = object
		self.tiles = {}

		self.current_pattern_info = nil

		self.break_fx_pool = break_fx_pool

		local tile_parent = self.object.transform:Find('dv_moneyshot_course')

		for i = 1, tile_parent.childCount do
			local tile_tf = tile_parent:GetChild(i - 1)
			local tile_name = tile_tf.name
			local tile_object = tile_tf.gameObject
			local visual_objects = {}
			local visual_parent = tile_tf:GetChild(0)

			for j = 1, 4 do
				visual_objects[j] = visual_parent:GetChild(j - 1).gameObject
			end

			self.tiles[tile_name] = {
				object = tile_object,
				visual_objects = visual_objects,
				visual_parent_object = visual_parent.gameObject,
			}
		end

		self.object:SetActive(false)

		self.is_looping_object = false
	end

	function ring_object:dispose()
		if not is_unity_null(self.object) then
			CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.object)
		end

		self.object = nil
		self.tiles = nil
		self.break_fx_pool = nil
	end

	function ring_object:on_init(pattern_info)
		for tile_name, tile_info in pairs(pattern_info) do
			local tile = self.tiles[tile_name]

			-- 선택된 비주얼을 제외하고 전부 비활성화
			for i = 1, 4 do
				tile.visual_objects[i]:SetActive(i == tile_info.type)
			end

			tile.visual_parent_object:SetActive(true)

			-- 타일은 일단 전부 켜줌
			tile.object:SetActive(true)
		end

		self.current_pattern_info = pattern_info

		self.object:SetActive(true)

		self.is_looping_object = false
	end

	function ring_object:on_return()
		self.object:SetActive(false)

		self.current_pattern_info = nil

		self.is_looping_object = false
	end

	function ring_object:play_break()
		local center_pos = self.object.transform.position

		for tile_name, tile_info in pairs(self.current_pattern_info) do
			if not tile_info.active then
				local tile = self.tiles[tile_name]

				tile.visual_parent_object:SetActive(false)

				local quaternion = tile.object.transform.rotation
				local fx_pos = center_pos + quaternion * vector(0, 0, -2.7)

				self.break_fx_pool:Instantiate(fx_pos, quaternion, tile.object.transform)
			end
		end
	end

	function ring_object:break_tile(tile_name)
		local center_pos = self.object.transform.position
		local tile = self.tiles[tile_name]

		tile.visual_parent_object:SetActive(false)

		local quaternion = tile.object.transform.rotation
		local fx_pos = center_pos + quaternion * vector(0, 0, -2.7)

		self.break_fx_pool:Instantiate(fx_pos, quaternion, tile.object.transform)
	end

	function ring_object:set_position(position)
		self.object.transform.position = position
	end

	function ring_object:move(diff)
		self.object.transform.position = self.object.transform.position + diff
	end

	function ring_object:rotate(rotation)
		self.object.transform.rotation = rotation
	end

	function ring_object:get_z_pos()
		return self.object.transform.position.z
	end

	function ring_object:get_pos()
		return self.object.transform.position
	end

	function ring_object:get_rotation()
		return self.object.transform.rotation
	end

	function ring_object:is_tile_enabled(tile_name)
		local tile = self.tiles[tile_name]

		return tile.visual_parent_object.activeSelf
	end
end

do
	function ring_object_pool:init(prefab, preload_count, break_fx_pool)
		self.prefab = prefab
		self.container = {}
		self.break_fx_pool = break_fx_pool

		self.created_count = 0

		for i = 1, preload_count do
			self.container[i] = self:create_new()
		end
	end

	function ring_object_pool:dispose()
		if self.container ~= nil then
			if #self.container < self.created_count then
				logger_util.error('Some ring objects didnt return to pool!!!')
			end

			for index, object in pairs(self.container) do
				object:dispose()
				self.container[index] = nil
			end

			self.container = nil
		end

		self.prefab = nil

		self.break_fx_pool = nil
	end

	function ring_object_pool:get_object(pattern_info)
		-- 없으면 새로 생성
		if self.container[1] == nil then
			self.container[1] = self:create_new()
		end

		local object = self.container[#self.container]

		self.container[#self.container] = nil

		object:on_init(pattern_info)

		return object
	end

	function ring_object_pool:return_object(object)
		object:on_return()

		self.container[#self.container + 1] = object
	end

	---@private
	function ring_object_pool:create_new()
		local ring_go = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(self.prefab)

		self.created_count = self.created_count + 1

		return ring_object(ring_go, self.break_fx_pool)
	end
end

return ring_object_pool
