local player_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/TunnelRun/Controllers/PlayerController')
local scroller_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/TunnelRun/Controllers/ScrollerController')
local camera_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/TunnelRun/Controllers/CameraController')
local resource_loader = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/TunnelRun/ResourceLoader')
local local_class = newclass('DVTunnelRun')

function local_class:init(cs_controller, cs_section)
	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	self.cs_section = cs_section

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'TunnelRun'

	self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version
	--Constants 데이터

	--region state
	self.game_state = {
		none = 0,
		loading = 1,
		starting = 2,
		playing = 3,
		ending = 4,
		clear = 5,
		done = 999
	}

	self.current_wave_number = 1

	self.constants_data = nil

	self.game_loop = true

	self.is_passed = false

	self.is_fade_in_start = false

	self.is_playing = false
	self.is_game_over = false

	self.is_qte_clear = false

	self.safe_easy_mode = false

	self.qte_turbo_start = false

	self.anim_event_handler = nil

	self.game_over_count = 0
	self.is_newbie_mode = 2

	self.hovering_data = {
		['twins_younger'] = false,
		['twins_older'] = false,
		['companion_boy'] = false,
	}

	self.get_minigame_start = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('minigame_start')
	end
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, key, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	resource_loader:load_resource(key)

	self.constants_data = resource_loader:get_constants_data()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')

	--카메라 생성
	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:on_joypad_event(e)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 여부
	if not self.is_playing or self.is_passed or self.is_game_over or
			not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) then
		return false
	end

	local rotate_axis = 1

	if e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_passed = true

		rotate_axis = -1

		if e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then

			rotate_axis = 1
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine.yield(self:pressed(rotate_axis))
			self.is_passed = false
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if (self.is_playing and not self.is_passed and not self.is_game_over) and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		local rotate_axis = 1

		-- 터치 위치 저장
		local screen_pos_x = e.TouchPos:GetXy0().x

		local center_x = resource_loader  :get_camera().transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera)):WorldToScreenPoint(
				self.get_minigame_start()).x

		self.is_passed = true

		-- right
		if center_x < screen_pos_x then
			rotate_axis = -1
		else
			rotate_axis = 1
		end

		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine.yield(self:pressed(rotate_axis))
			self.is_passed = false
		end)
	end

	if self.qte_turbo_start and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown or
			e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then

		self.is_tab = true

		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if not self.is_playing or self.is_passed or self.is_game_over then
		return false
	end

	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then

		self.is_passed = true

		local rotate_axis = 1

		rotate_axis = 1

		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine.yield(self:pressed(rotate_axis))
			self.is_passed = false
		end)

	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
		local rotate_axis = 1

		self.is_passed = true

		rotate_axis = -1

		start_coroutine(function()
			coroutine.yield(self:pressed(rotate_axis))
			self.is_passed = false
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:on_animation_event(e)
	if e.EventName == 'chain' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_chain_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_stomp_01')
		return true
	elseif e.EventName == 'chain_2' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_rock_break_05')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_chain_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_companion_stomp_01')
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:exit()
	self:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))

	camera_controller:dispose()
	player_controller:dispose()
	scroller_controller:dispose()

	resource_loader:dispose()
end

function local_class:game_start()
	start_coroutine(self.game_routine, self)
end

function local_class:game_init(start_game_number, is_hard_reset)
	local event_object_pool = resource_loader:get_event_object_pool()
	local ring_object_creator = resource_loader:get_ring_object_pool()
	local camera = resource_loader:get_camera_pivot()

	local game_count = start_game_number

	if self.game_over_count > 2 then
		game_count = start_game_number + self.is_newbie_mode
	end

	scroller_controller:game_init(game_count, self.constants_data, ring_object_creator, event_object_pool, is_hard_reset)

	player_controller:game_init(self.constants_data.player_info.name, self.constants_data.enemy_info)
	camera_controller:game_init(self.constants_data, camera)

	camera_controller:in_game_setting(0.1)

	resource_loader:set_dash_loop(true)
end

-- 미니게임 로직
function local_class:game_routine()
	self.game_loop = true

	local play_time = self.constants_data.play_time_sec

	local time_passed = 0

	local qte_dir = 'left'

	while self.game_loop do

		local sfx_tile_break_loop = nil

		if self.is_fade_in_start then
			self.is_fade_in_start = false

			self:game_init(self.current_wave_number, true)

			screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/v3_10_dreamvillage/audio:bgm_dreamvillage_event',
												 state = 'event' })

			wait_for_sec(0.8)
		else

			self:game_init(self.current_wave_number, false)
		end

		self.is_playing = true
		self.is_game_over = false
		self.is_clear = false
		self.is_qte_clear = false

		sfx_tile_break_loop = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = '01_earthquake_07', loop = true, volume = 0.3, mix = 2
		})

		while not self.is_game_over and not scroller_controller:get_complete_wave() do

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			self:game_update()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.is_game_over then
			scroller_controller:cancel_changed()
			sfx_tile_break_loop:Stop()
			self.game_over_count = self.game_over_count + 1
			self:game_over()
			break
		end

		if not (self.current_wave_number < self.constants_data.max_scene_count) then
			scroller_controller:changed_scene_wave_data(-8)

			while not self.is_game_over do
				if not scroller_controller:get_is_change_stage() then
					sfx_tile_break_loop:Stop()

					player_controller:set_game_play(false)

					self.is_playing = false

					resource_loader:set_dash_loop(false)

					player_controller:reset_companion_boy()

					camera_controller:in_game_setting(0.5)

					self.is_clear = true
					break
				end

				self:game_update()

				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			if self.is_game_over then
				scroller_controller:cancel_changed()
				sfx_tile_break_loop:Stop()

				self.game_over_count = self.game_over_count + 1

				self:game_over()
				break
			end

			break
		end

		scroller_controller:changed_scene_wave_data()

		time_passed = 0

		local first_qte_play = true

		while not self.is_game_over and not self.is_qte_clear do

			if not scroller_controller:get_is_change_stage() and first_qte_play then
				sfx_tile_break_loop:Stop()
				first_qte_play = false

				player_controller:set_game_play(false)

				resource_loader:set_dash_loop(false)

				self.is_playing = false

				start_coroutine(function()
					self:qte_scene(qte_dir)
				end)

			end

			self:game_update()

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.is_game_over then
			sfx_tile_break_loop:Stop()
			self.game_over_count = self.game_over_count + 1

			self:game_over()
			break
		end

		self.current_wave_number = self.current_wave_number + 1
	end

	if self.is_clear then
		self:minigame_end()
	end
end

function local_class:game_over()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	resource_loader:set_dash_loop(false)

	--이후 게임 오버 텍스트가 출력된 뒤, 머니샷 시작 지점으로 복귀한다.
	if self.is_playing then
		player_controller:player_dead()
	end

	--게임 오버 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(2, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	scroller_controller:clear_data()
	player_controller:reset_companion_boy()

	self.is_fade_in_start = true

	self:game_start()
end

function local_class:game_update()
	local is_tile_update_cycle = false

	is_tile_update_cycle = scroller_controller:update()

	if self.is_playing then
		self:keyboard_update()

		player_controller:update()
	end

	if is_tile_update_cycle then
		if not scroller_controller:get_is_current_tile_active() and not player_controller:get_is_player_jumping() then
			self.is_game_over = true
		end
	end

	return self.is_game_over
end

function local_class:pressed(rotate_axis)
	wait_all {
		util.cs_generator(function()
			player_controller:pressed(self.constants_data.ignore_touch_delay, rotate_axis)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			scroller_controller:pressed(rotate_axis)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			camera_controller:pressed(rotate_axis)
		end),
	}

	if not scroller_controller:get_is_current_tile_active() then
		self.is_game_over = true
	end
end

function local_class:qte_scene(dir)
	local older = player_controller:get_player_data()[1]
	local younger = player_controller:get_player_data()[2]
	local companion_boy = player_controller:get_companion_boy()

	while player_controller:get_is_player_jumping() do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	scroller_controller:set_scrolling(false)

	local camera_pivot = resource_loader:get_camera_pivot()
	local camera = resource_loader:get_camera().transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	--아래에 항목을 동시에 실행.
	--카메라 관련
	--카메라 최초 사슬 튀어나오는 지점을 향해 이동.
	--카메라 2까지 0.5초에 걸쳐 줌 인.
	--시온 관련
	--Fx_dv_blink를 실행하여 시온 (down, attack, idle)로 생성.
	--생성 위치는 QTE 연출에서 가장 먼저 부서질 타일과 동일한 위치에서, Y만 통로 중심위치에 오는 높이로 설정.
	--도화, 서화 (up, idle, idle, jump 1회) 실행.
	--화면 직진 이동 정지.
	--[fx_dv_dreampower_dash_end] 실행.

	coroutine.yield()

	player_controller:reset_companion_boy()

	local fx_loop_companion_boy = nil
	do
		--타일 16개 뒤에서 소환 16 * 2
		local pos = self.get_minigame_start() + vector(0, 1, 32)

		fx_loop_companion_boy = resource_loader.fx.companion_trail():Instantiate(pos + vector(0, -0.25, 0))

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_character_warp_01')
		resource_loader.fx.blink():Instantiate(pos)

		character_util.set_position(companion_boy, pos)

		field_object_util.set_active_state(companion_boy, active_state_type.enabled)

		fx_loop_companion_boy.transform.parent = companion_boy.transform

		scene_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'down', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion(companion_boy, self, 'attack')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(younger)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(older)

	scene_util.set_direction(older, 'up', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(younger, 'up', false)

	character_util.normal_jump(older, '01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(younger, '01_small_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local intro_cut_object_pos_z = self.get_minigame_start().z + 55
	scroller_controller:set_qte_intro(intro_cut_object_pos_z)

	do
		local duration = 0.3
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					camera_controller:in_game_setting(duration)
				end,
				function()
					camera_controller:resize_fov_camera(camera, 22.5, duration)
				end
		)
	end

	--QTE 공간 진입 후 진행.
	--아래 항목들 동시에 실행.
	--시온 : [shout] 그만 귀찮게 굴라고!!!
	--위치 : x 0.5 / y 0.8
	--크기 : 2배
	--대사 3초간 실행 완료 대기.
	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	--도화, 서화 (up, idle, idle, jump 1회) 실행.
	--화면 직진 이동 정지.
	--시온 (1회차 : x 0.8 , y 0.3)(2회차 : x 0.2, y 0.3) : [shout] 그만 귀찮게 굴라고!!!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			camera_controller:shake_camera_async(camera, 0.3, 0.3)
		end),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
			scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(
					get_character('companion_boy'),
					'dv_main_s21_33',
					true,
					{
						viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.3),
						scale = 2,
					}
			)
		end)
	})

	local time_mode_key = 'qte_start'
	local clear_qte = false

	start_coroutine(function()
		camera_controller:shake_camera_async(camera, 0.02, 999)
	end)

	local sfx_loop_quake = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_07', volume = 0.5, fade_in_time = 2, loop = true })

	scene_util.set_anim(companion_boy, self, 'cast2')

	start_coroutine(function()
		local close_patten_tile_data = { 'down', 'left_down', 'right_down' }
		local from = nil

		while from == nil or from > 0 do
			from = scroller_controller:proceed_qte_break(companion_boy.Position.z, from, close_patten_tile_data)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)
	--시온 부서지는 타일들과 같은 속도로 down, attack, idle 상태에서 플레이어 방향을 향해 다가옴.
	--카메라 현재 위치에서부터 1초간 서화, 도화가 카메라 중심 2칸 하단에 잡히는 위치까지 이동.

	do
		local duration = 1
		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					local set_pos = self.get_minigame_start() + vector(0, 1.5, 1.5)

					wp_util.move_async(companion_boy, set_pos, nil, duration)
				end,
				function()
					camera_controller:resize_fov_default_camera(camera, duration)
				end
		)
	end

	--공간 회전 QTE는 1초간 아래의 항목들이 동시에 실행됨.
	--슬로우모션 적용
	--0.5초를 0.5배로 실행하여 1초를 진행하는 것이 목적.
	--타일 삭제 그대로 진행.
	--이전 타일 삭제를 0.1초마다 그대로 실행하여, 0.5초간 5개의 타일에 tile_break_attack 를 실행하여 다가온다.
	--슬라이드 QTE 실행
	--슬라이드 (→) QTE를 1초간 실행.
	--서화 (right, attack, idle) : [shout] 도화야!!!
	--위치 : x0.2 / y 0.5
	--크기 : 1.5배
	do
		local duration = 1
		local viewport_pos = vector(0.4, 0.3)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(
				older,
				{ key = 'dv_main_s21_33_1',
				  skip = false,
				  bubble_type = 'shout',
				  viewport_pos = viewport_pos,
				  scale = 1.5,
				  type_speed = 0,
				  life_time = duration
				}
		)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
		clear_qte = qte_play_util.swipe(dir, { duration = duration, anim_unscaled_time = true })

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(older)
	end

	sfx_loop_quake:FadeOut(8)

	do
		local duration = 2
		local set_pos = self.get_minigame_start() + vector(0, 1.5, -30)

		wp_util.move(companion_boy, set_pos, nil, duration)
	end

	camera_controller:stop_camera_shake()

	if not clear_qte then
		--QTE 실패 시 아래 연출 순서대로 실행.
		--카메라 shake 0.02 지속 적용된 상태.
		--세 영역에 tile_break_attack[임시 : 삭제] 는 그대로 이어서 실행하여, 플레이어 카메라 너머까지 진행.
		--해당 과정에서 서화, 도화가 사슬에 피격될 시 아래에 사항 동시에 실행.
		--서화
		--(right, damaged, damaged)
		--일반 피격 연출 실행.
		--x -0.5 / y 1.5 의 공중으로 0.4초에 걸쳐 이동.
		--이후 x -1.5 / y-3 의 바닥으로 0.8초에 걸쳐 이동.
		--그대로 화면 이탈
		--도화
		--(left, damaged, damaged)
		--일반 피격 연출 실행.
		--x 0.5 / y 1.5 의 공중으로 0.4초에 걸쳐 이동.
		--이후 x 1.5 / y-3 의 바닥으로 0.8초에 걸쳐 이동.
		--그대로 화면 이탈
		--서화, 도화 피격 기준 0.5초 대기.
		--게임 오버 텍스트 출력 후 완료까지 대기.
		--카메라 1초간 페이드 아웃.
		--머니샷 시작 지점으로 복귀 세팅.
		--카메라 1초간 페이드 인을 실행하여 머니샷 재진입.
		local dir_data = {
			'right',
			'left'
		}

		local end_pos_offset = {
			vector(-1, -4, 0),
			vector(1, -4, 0)
		}

		local height_pos_offset = {
			vector(-0.5, 2, 0),
			vector(0.5, 2, 0)
		}

		player_controller:qte_fail_scene(dir_data, height_pos_offset, end_pos_offset, 1)

		fx_loop_companion_boy.transform.parent = nil
		fx_loop_companion_boy:Dispose()

		self:stop_hovering(companion_boy)

		--Y축으로 4의 속도로 떨어진 뒤 화면에서 이탈.
		self.is_game_over = true
		return false
	end

	--QTE 성공 시 아래 연출 순서대로 실행.
	--카메라 shake 0.02 지속 정지.

	--슬로우모션 적용 0.1배[서화, 도화 제외]
	scroller_controller:set_tile_between_time(0.5)

	do
		local angle = -135
		local axis = -1
		local duration = 1.5

		--1초[실제 0.1초]간 아래 사항 동시에 실행
		do
			local player_dir = 'left'
			local height = 1
			local emotion = 'attack'
			local anim = 'get'


			--도화, 서화 (left, attack, get, jump)상태로 0.5초간 y 0.5 상승, 0.5초간 y 0.5 하락을 실행.
			scene_util.set_direction(older, player_dir, false)
			character_util.set_emotion(older, { name = emotion })
			character_util.set_anim(older, { name = anim })

			scene_util.set_direction(younger, player_dir, false)
			character_util.set_emotion(younger, { name = emotion })
			character_util.set_anim(younger, { name = anim })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
			character_util.jump(
					older,
					height,
					duration
			)

			character_util.jump(
					younger,
					height,
					duration
			)
		end

		--1초간 통로 전체가 반시계방향으로 3타일 분량만큼 이동.
		--1초간 지정된 영역에 tile_break_attack[임시 : 삭제]  가 그대로 실행됨.

		scroller_controller:scene_rotate_object(angle, axis, duration)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_break_rock_earthquake_01')
		scroller_controller:set_tile_between_time(0.05)
	end

	--0.5초 대기
	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	--화면 0.1 / 0.3 shake 실행.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(older)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(younger)

	--도착한 위치에서 두 캐릭터 (left, attack, idle) 유지 상태.
	scene_util.set_direction(older, 'left', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(younger, 'left', false)

	scene_util.set_emotion(older, self, 'attack')
	scene_util.set_emotion(younger, self, 'attack')

	camera_controller:shake_camera_async(camera, 0.1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--도화 (down, attack, idle))
	--서화 (down, attack, idle)
	scene_util.set_direction(older, 'down', false)
	scene_util.set_direction(younger, 'down', false)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')

	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	--화면 0.1 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	--도화 (down, attack, idle)
	--서화 (down, attack, idle)
	local changed_dir = 'right'

	scroller_controller:changed_qte_object(changed_dir)

	camera_controller:shake_camera_async(camera, 0.1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	--1초 대기
	--아래 항목 동시에 실행.
	--화면 0.1 / 0.3 shake 실행.
	--도화 (down, surprise idle, jump 1회)
	--서화 (down, surprise, idle, jump 1회)

	character_util.normal_jump(older, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.normal_jump(younger, '01_player_jump_01')

	scene_util.set_emotion(older, self, 'surprise')
	scene_util.set_emotion(younger, self, 'surprise')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_break_rock_earthquake_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_stomp_fire_02')
	camera_controller:shake_camera_async(camera, 0.1, 0.3)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.AnimationEvent), 'on_animation_event')

	--1초 대기.
	wait_for_sec(1)

	start_coroutine(function()
		--시온 등장 후 이동.
		--시온 좌측 화면에서부터 지정된 위치까지 (right, attack, idle)[호버링] 상태로 회전하는 동안 이동.
		--회전 완료 후 시온은 현재 위치에서 (down, attack, idle)[호버링] 상태를 반복 후 유지.
		local pos = self.get_minigame_start() + vector(0, 3, -20)
		local fx_offset = vector(0, -0.25, 0)
		local duration = 4

		character_util.set_position(companion_boy, pos)
		companion_boy.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(15, 0, 0)

		scene_util.set_direction(companion_boy, 'right', false)

		scene_util.set_emotion(companion_boy, self, 'attack')
		scene_util.set_anim(companion_boy, self, 'staff_idle')

		self:start_hovering(companion_boy, 0.4, 0.1)

		local move_pos = vector(0, 0, 25)
		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			companion_boy.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(pos, pos + move_pos, progress)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)

	do
		local duration = 1

		scroller_controller:play_qte_animation('action1')

		player_controller:conversion_qte_scene(changed_dir, duration)
		camera_controller:conversion_qte_scene(changed_dir, unity_class.time.deltaTime, duration)
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		scroller_controller:start_qte_tab_setting(4.5)
	end)

	scroller_controller:set_is_check_tile(false)

	wait_for_sec(2)

	local game_pad_key = 'tap_gamepad'

	do
		local set_pos = vector(0.2, 0.8)
		local fail_pos = self.get_minigame_start() + vector(0, 0, 3.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

		gamepad_util.set_tap_game_pad_event(self, game_pad_key)
		qte_play_util.show_turbo_tap(false, set_pos)

		self.tap_count = 0

		self.qte_turbo_start = true

		local time_passed = 0
		local duration = 2.4
		local move_speed = 4
		local back_speed = 0.7
		local move_duration = 0.1
		local last_tab_time = 0

		clear_qte = true

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local target_pos = 0

			if self.is_tab then
				if time_passed - last_tab_time > move_duration then
					target_pos = target_pos + move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
					last_tab_time = time_passed
				end
			else
				target_pos = target_pos - back_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime
			end

			self.is_tab = false

			older.Position = older.Position + vector(0, 0, target_pos)
			younger.Position = younger.Position + vector(0, 0, target_pos)

			if older.Position.z < fail_pos.z then
				clear_qte = false
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	screen_util.close_tutorial_spine()

	self.qte_turbo_start = false

	scroller_controller:set_scrolling(false)

	if not clear_qte then
		--서화, 도화 게임오버 연출
		--0에서부터 0.75초 대기.
		--0.75초 시점에 낙하한 사슬에 피격당한 도하와 서화 아래에 사항 동시에 실행.
		--일반 피격 연출 실행.
		--(right, damaged, damaged)
		--X : 3 / Y : 2 가 도착치가 되도록 0.5초에 걸쳐 포물선으로 날아갑니다.
		--이후 X : 9 / Y : -4가 도착지가 되도록 1초에 걸쳐 화면 바깥으로 사라집니다.
		local dir_data = {
			'right',
			'right'
		}

		local end_pos_offset = {
			vector(4, -4, 0),
			vector(4, -4, 0)
		}

		local height_pos_offset = {
			vector(2.5, 3, 0),
			vector(2.5, 3, 0)
		}

		player_controller:qte_fail_scene(dir_data, height_pos_offset, end_pos_offset, 1)

		fx_loop_companion_boy.transform.parent = nil
		fx_loop_companion_boy:Dispose()

		self:stop_hovering(companion_boy)

		--Y축으로 4의 속도로 떨어진 뒤 화면에서 이탈.
		self.is_game_over = true
		return false
	end

	local object_move_pos = {
		vector(39, 2.25, 209.5),
		vector(39, 2.25, 207.5)
	}

	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				local duration = 1
				scroller_controller:set_definite_current_object_pos(object_move_pos[1], duration)
			end,
			function()
				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				scroller_controller:play_qte_animation('action3')
			end
	)
	--점프 QTE 진행
	--달리기 QTE가 종료되면 곧바로 점프 QTE로 진입.
	--이후 제한시간(인자값 / 임시 1초)을 가진 슬라이드 QTE를 진행.
	--[→] QTE가 서화, 도화 상단에 출력.
	--QTE 제한시간동안 모든 화면 정지.
	--실패 시 진행(달리기 QTE 실패와 동일)
	--도화 / 서화 right, damaged, embarrassed를 시작.
	--이후 시온의 사슬이 주황색 지점을 지나 그대로 다음 발판까지 이어서 실행.

function local_class:start_hovering(target, speed, height)
	self.hovering_data[target.Name] = true
	--sin 함수를 그리며 호버링
	--unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * time_passed * speed) * height + 현재 높이
	--speed = 0.4
	--height = 0.1

	start_coroutine(function()
		local currnet_boy_y = target.Position.y
		local time_passed = 0

		while self.hovering_data[target.Name] do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local value = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * time_passed * speed) * height

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end)

	if not self.is_passed and not self.is_game_over then

			rotate_axis = 1

				coroutine.yield(self:pressed(rotate_axis))

			end)

			local rotate_axis = 1

			self.is_passed = true

			rotate_axis = -1

				self.is_passed = false

		end
	end
end

	self.hovering_data[target.Name] = false

		for _, vent_info in ipairs(self.constants_data.vent_info_list) do
			local pos = vector(vent_info.vent_pos.x, 0, vent_info.vent_pos.z)
			if self:check_collision(pos, user_party.Leader.Position, 0.2) == true then
				self.game_loop = false
				crashed_vent = vent_info
				break
			end
		end

		-- 게임오버 처리
		if self.is_game_over then
			self:game_over()
			self.is_game_over = false
		elseif self.game_loop == true then
			--조작 처리
			if self.input_delay > 0 then
				self.input_delay = self.input_delay - unity_class.time.deltaTime --조작 불가능 시간 줄이기
				if self.input_delay <= 0 then
					self:user_move_end()
				end
			elseif self.input_direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
				self:user_action(self.input_direction)
			end
		end

		self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.current_game_map_info.racing_info == nil then
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0}) -- 이동 애니메이션 종료
		self:vent_out(crashed_vent)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil

	if self.racing_count_ui then
		self.racing_count_ui:Dispose()
		self.racing_count_ui = nil
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
end

-- 맵에 바닥이 있는지 확인
function local_class:is_floor(map, x, z)
	local map_info = self.current_game_map_info
	if x < map_info.start_x or x > map_info.end_x or z < map_info.start_z or z > map_info.end_z then
		return false
	end

	-- 방어 코드
	if map[z] == nil then
		return false
	end

	if map[z][x] == nil then
		return false
	end

	--결과값
	return (map[z][x] == 1)
end

function local_class:is_floor_v2(x, z)
	return field:IsThereFloorAt(unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z))
end

-- 바닥이 있는지 없는지 맵을 만들어 둠
function local_class:make_game_map(game_map_info)
	local start_x = game_map_info.start_x
	local start_z = game_map_info.start_z
	local end_x = game_map_info.end_x
	local end_z = game_map_info.end_z

	local game_map = {}

	-- 길 있으면 1, 없으면 0인 맵
	for z = start_z, end_z do
		game_map[z] = {}
		for x = start_x, end_x do
			if field:IsThereFloorAt(unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z)) then
				game_map[z][x] = 1
			else
				game_map[z][x] = 0
			end
		end
	end

	game_map_info.game_map = game_map

	--맵 데이터 확인용 테스트 코드

	for z = end_z, start_z, -1 do
		for x = start_x, end_x do
			if game_map[z][x] == 1 then
				test = test .. '□'
			else
				test = test .. '■'
			end
		end
		test = test .. '\n'
	end
	print(test)]]--

	self:init_enemy_list(game_map_info)
	self:init_racing(game_map_info)
end

--블록 초기화
function local_class:make_block_map(game_map_info)
	local block_list = {}
	local start_x = game_map_info.start_x
	local start_z = game_map_info.start_z
	local end_x = game_map_info.end_x
	local end_z = game_map_info.end_z

	for z = start_z, end_z do
		for x = start_x, end_x do
			local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(unity_class.vector3(x, 0, z), 0.1)
			for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
				local fo = fo_list[i]
				if fo.Pushable ~= nil and fo.Pushable.IsPushable == true then
					local block = {}
					block.fo = fo
					block.init_position = fo.Position
					table.insert(block_list, block)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	game_map_info.block_list = block_list
end

-- 적 초기화
function local_class:init_enemy_list(game_map_info)
	game_map_info.enemy_list = {}
	if game_map_info.enemy_id == nil then
		return
	end

	local idx = 1
	while true do
		local fo = get_character(game_map_info.enemy_id .. idx)
		if fo == nil then
			break
		else
			fo.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
			local enemy = {}
			enemy.fo = fo	--적 오브젝트
			enemy.init_pos = fo.Position	--적 초기 위치
			enemy.waypoints = {}	--적 웨이포인트
			table.insert(game_map_info.enemy_list, enemy)
			idx = idx + 1
		end
	end
end

-- 레이싱 초기화
function local_class:init_racing(game_map_info)
	if game_map_info.racing_info == nil then
		return
	end

	local onigirl = get_character(game_map_info.racing_info.npc_name)
	if onigirl == nil then
		game_map_info.racing_info = nil
		return
	end

	onigirl.ActiveState = active_state('visible')
	character_util.set_anim(onigirl, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0})
	game_map_info.racing_info.npc = onigirl
	game_map_info.racing_info.npc_init_position = onigirl.Position
end

-- 이동 노드 생성
function local_class:make_astar_node(remove_other_path)
	local map = {}	-- 적 하나가 쓸 전용 맵
	local map_info = self.current_game_map_info -- 적용되는 맵 정보(문자수 줄이기 용)

	--맵 복사
	for z = map_info.start_z, map_info.end_z do
		map[z] = {}
		for x = map_info.start_x, map_info.end_x do
			map[z][x] = self.current_game_map_info.game_map[z][x]
		end
	end

	if remove_other_path == true then
		-- 다른 적의 이동경로는 제외
		for _, enemy in ipairs(self.current_game_map_info.enemy_list) do
			for _, point in ipairs(enemy.waypoints) do
				map[point.z][point.x] = 0
			end
		end
	end

	-- 어디로 이동할 수 있는지 노드 생성
	graph = {}
	for z = map_info.start_z, map_info.end_z do
		for x = map_info.start_x, map_info.end_x do
			local graphId = x .. ',' .. z
			graph[graphId] = {}

			--상하좌우 확인
			if self:is_floor(map, x + 1, z) then
				table.insert(graph[graphId], x + 1 .. ',' .. z)
			end

			if self:is_floor(map, x - 1, z) then
				table.insert(graph[graphId], x - 1 .. ',' .. z)
			end

			if self:is_floor(map, x, z + 1) then
				table.insert(graph[graphId], x .. ',' .. z + 1)
			end

			if self:is_floor(map, x, z - 1) then
				table.insert(graph[graphId], x .. ',' .. z - 1)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:game_over()
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'confused' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.stop(user_party.Leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	-- 주인공 초기화
	self:reset_leader()

	-- 적 원래 위치로
	self:reset_enemys()

	-- 블럭 원래 위치로
	self:reset_blocks()

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
end

function local_class:position_to_string(pos)
	pos = math.floor(pos.x + 0.5) .. ',' .. math.floor(pos.z + 0.5)
	return pos
end

function local_class:path_to_waypoint(path)	--공백으로 나눠진 이동경로 문자열을 벡터 웨이포인트로 변환
	local waypoints = {}
	if path ~= nil then
		for _, str_pos in ipairs(path) do
			local nums = {}
			for word in string.gmatch(str_pos, '([^,]+)') do
				table.insert(nums, tonumber(word))
			end
			table.insert(waypoints, vector(nums[1], 0, nums[2]))
		end
	end

	if #waypoints > 0 then
		table.remove(waypoints, 1)	--첫번째 웨이포인트는 자신의 위치이기 때문에 삭제
	end

	return waypoints
end

function local_class:make_waypoint(enemy, target_pos, enemy_pos)	--AStar를 이용해서 이동 경로 생성
	enemy.waypoints = {}
	self:make_astar_node(true)	--다른 적의 이동경로를 지우고 검색

	local str_target_pos = self:position_to_string(target_pos)
	local str_enemy_pos = self:position_to_string(enemy_pos)
	local path = simpleAStar(goal({str_target_pos}))(str_enemy_pos)
	enemy.waypoints = self:path_to_waypoint(path)
	if #enemy.waypoints > 0 then
		table.remove(enemy.waypoints, #enemy.waypoints)	--주인공 위치 삭제(안 그러면 두번째 적부터 경로를 못 찾음)
	end

	if #enemy.waypoints == 0 then	-- 다른 적의 이동 경로를 제외하고 길이 없으면 다른 적의 이동경로를 무시하고 다시 검색
		self:make_astar_node(false)
		path = simpleAStar(goal({str_target_pos}))(str_enemy_pos)
		enemy.waypoints = self:path_to_waypoint(path)
	end
end

function local_class:enemy_action(user_next_position)
	local blocked_point = {}
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.current_game_map_info.enemy_list) do
		local enemy_pos = enemy.fo.Position
		if enemy_pos.x >= self.current_game_map_info.start_x
			and enemy_pos.x <= self.current_game_map_info.end_x
			and enemy_pos.z >= self.current_game_map_info.start_z
			and enemy_pos.z <= self.current_game_map_info.end_z then

			self:make_waypoint(enemy, user_party.Leader.Position, enemy.fo.Position)
			if #enemy.waypoints > 0 then
				local enemy_next_position = enemy.waypoints[1]

				-- 다른 적이 서 있는 곳 이동 불가능
				local isMovable = true
				for _, point in ipairs(blocked_point) do
					if enemy_next_position == point then
						isMovable = false
						break
					end
				end

				--블럭 부수기
				if isMovable == true then
					local block = self:get_block(enemy_next_position)
					if block ~= nil then
						isMovable = false
						self:face_to(enemy.fo, enemy.fo.Position, block.fo.Position)
						self:destroy_block(block.fo)
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enemy_attack, self, enemy))
					end
				end

				if isMovable == true then
					if user_next_position == enemy_next_position then
						self:enemy_blitz(enemy, user_next_position)
						break
					else
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enemy_move, self, enemy))
						table.insert(blocked_point, enemy_next_position)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:face_to(fo, fo_pos, target_pos)
	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(target_pos - fo_pos)
	if dir ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		fo.Direction = dir
	end
end

function local_class:enemy_move(enemy)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_walk_robot_01', play_pos = enemy.Position,
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local duration = self.move_duration - 0.05
	character_util.move_to(enemy.fo, enemy.waypoints[1], duration, nil, true)

	if(self.enemies_leg_walk) then
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 3})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'walk', scale = 5})
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)

	if(self.enemies_leg_walk) then
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'idle'})
	end
end

function local_class:enemy_attack(enemy)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_05', play_pos = enemy.Position,
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'attack', loop = false, scale = 3})
	wait_for_sec(self.move_duration - 0.05)
	if(self.enemies_leg_walk) then
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0})
	else
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'idle'})
	end
end

function local_class:enemy_blitz(enemy, user_next_position)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_game_die_02', play_pos = enemy.Position,
								 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local attack_duration = 0.3
	self:face_to(enemy.fo, enemy.fo.Position, user_next_position)
	self:face_to(user_party.Leader, user_next_position, enemy.fo.Position)
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'blood'})
	character_util.jump(user_party.Leader, 0.5, 0.2)
	character_util.jump(enemy.fo, 1.5, attack_duration)
	character_util.move_to(enemy.fo, user_next_position, attack_duration)
	character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(attack_duration)
	if(self.enemies_leg_walk) then
		character_util.set_anim(enemy.fo, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0})
	end
	self.is_game_over = true
end

--좌표를 정수로 조정

-- 방향을 벡터로 변환
function local_class:direction_to_vector(direction)
	local v = vector(0, 0, 0)
	if(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right) then
		v = vector(1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left) then
		v = vector(-1, 0, 0)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) then
		v = vector(0, 0, 1)
	elseif(direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down) then
		v = vector(0, 0, -1)
	end

	return v
end

-- 적 찾기
function local_class:get_enemy(pos)
	for _, enemy in ipairs(self.current_game_map_info.enemy_list) do
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(enemy.fo.Bounds, pos) then
			return enemy
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 블럭 찾기
function local_class:get_block(pos)
	for _, block in ipairs(self.current_game_map_info.block_list) do
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(block.fo.Bounds, pos) then
			return block
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 유저의 행동 처리
function local_class:user_action(direction)
	local direction_vector = self:direction_to_vector(direction)
	local prev_position = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position);	--이전 위치
	local next_position = prev_position + direction_vector
	local next_next_position = next_position + direction_vector
	local user_next_position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	local user_action_type = {
		none = 0,
		move = 1,
		push = 2
	}
	local final_user_action = user_action_type.none
	local block = self:get_block(next_position)

	-- 플레이어 행동 처리
	if self:is_floor(self.current_game_map_info.game_map, next_position.x, next_position.z) then
		if block == nil then
			local enemy = self:get_enemy(next_position)
			if enemy == nil then	-- 블럭, 적이 없으면 이동
				final_user_action = user_action_type.move
			else -- 적의 습격
				self:enemy_blitz(enemy, user_party.Leader.Position)
			end
		else	-- 블럭이 있으면 블럭 밀기 시도
			if self:is_floor(self.current_game_map_info.game_map, next_next_position.x, next_next_position.z) and self:get_block(next_next_position) == nil then
				final_user_action = user_action_type.push
			end
		end
	end

	if self.current_game_map_info.racing_info ~= nil
		and self.racing_count == self.current_game_map_info.racing_info.count_max - 1
		and CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.goal_bound, next_position) then

		final_user_action = user_action_type.none
		self:win()
	end

	-- 행동 개시
	if final_user_action == user_action_type.move then
		--character_util.move_to(user_party.Leader, next_position, self.move_duration, 4, true)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.user_move, self, next_position, self.move_duration))
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, {name = 'walk4legs', scale = 3})
		user_next_position = next_position
	elseif final_user_action == user_action_type.push then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_rock_unit_03')
		character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, direction_util.to_str(direction))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.user_attack, self))
		character_util.move_to(block.fo, next_next_position, self.move_duration)
		user_next_position = user_party.Leader.Position
	end

	-- 주인공 행동하면 적도 움직임
	if final_user_action ~= user_action_type.none then
		self.input_delay = self.move_duration + 0.1
		self:enemy_action(user_next_position)
		self:racing_action(user_next_position)
	else
		self.input_delay = 0.001	-- 연속 입력 방지
	end
end

function local_class:user_move(next_position, duration)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_game_move_01', volume = 0.6 })

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < duration do
		self:move_by_one_frame(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position, next_position, 4)
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local new_pos = self:round_position(user_party.Leader.Position)
	user_party.Leader.Position = new_pos
end

function local_class:move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized
	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)
end

end

	fo.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

function local_class:racing_action(user_next_position)
	if self.current_game_map_info.racing_info == nil then
		return
	end

	local racing_info = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info
	self.racing_count = self.racing_count + 1
	local dir =  character_util.get_direction(racing_info.move_pattern[self.racing_count])
	local target_pos = racing_info.npc.Position + self:direction_to_vector(dir)

	local block = self:get_block(target_pos)
	if block == nil then	-- 이동
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.onigirl_move, self, target_pos))
	else	-- 블럭 밀기
		local next_next_position = target_pos + self:direction_to_vector(dir)
		if self:is_floor_v2(next_next_position.x, next_next_position.z) and self:get_block(next_next_position) == nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_unit_04', volume = 0.6 })
			character_util.set_direction(racing_info.npc, direction_util.to_str(dir))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.onigirl_attack, self))
			character_util.move_to(block.fo, next_next_position, self.move_duration)
		end
	end

	if not self.count_ui_red and racing_info.count_max - self.racing_count < 5 then
		self.count_ui_red = true
		self.racing_count_ui:SetTextColorRed()
	end

	self.racing_count_ui:SetTextCount(racing_info.count_max - self.racing_count)

	if self.racing_count >= racing_info.count_max  then
		if CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.goal_prev_bound, user_next_position) then
			self:draw()
		elseif not CS.BoundsExtensions.ContainsXZ(self.goal_bound, user_next_position) then
			self:lose()
		end
	end
end

--- 레이싱 이겼을 때 연출
function local_class:win()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	self.racing_count_ui:Dispose()
	self.racing_count_ui = nil

	local racing_npc = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info.npc
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lana_05) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0.5)

	-- 결승선 도착 연출
	character_util.set_direction(racing_npc, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(racing_npc, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(racing_npc)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(leader, 'right', 1, 0.7)
	character_util.move_to_async(leader, self.goal_pos, 1, nil, true)

	-- 스위치 눌림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	local switch = get_field_object('oni_girl_switch')
	message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(user_party.Leader))

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self:racing_over('oni_girl_racing_win')
end

--- 레이싱 졌을 때 연출
function local_class:lose()
	local racing_npc = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info.npc
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self:lose_action(false)

	-- 결승선 도착 연출
	character_util.look_at(leader, racing_npc)
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	character_util.mario_jump_new(racing_npc, 'left', 1, 0.7)
	character_util.move_to_async(racing_npc, self.goal_pos, 1, nil, true)

	-- 스위치 눌림
	local switch = get_field_object('oni_girl_switch')
	message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(racing_npc))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(racing_npc)

	character_util.set_emotion(racing_npc, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(racing_npc, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lana_05) -> Field(bgm_lilith_tower)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

	self:racing_over('oni_girl_racing_lose')
end

--- 레이싱 비겼을 때 연출
function local_class:draw()
	local racing_npc = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info.npc
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	self:lose_action(true)

	-- 결승선 도착 연출
	character_util.set_direction(leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump(leader)

	character_util.set_emotion(racing_npc, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(racing_npc, { name = 'prostrate' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slowmotion_01')
	character_util.jump(racing_npc, 0.7, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(racing_npc, self.goal_pos, 1, nil, true)

	-- 스위치 눌림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_03')
	local switch = get_field_object('oni_girl_switch')
	message_system:SendSync(switch, CS.Oak.FloorSwitchStepOnEvent.Create(racing_npc))

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(racing_npc)

	character_util.set_emotion(racing_npc, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(racing_npc, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	self:racing_over('oni_girl_racing_draw')
end

--- 패배 공통 액션
function local_class:lose_action(draw)
	wait_for_sec(self.move_duration)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0 })

	local racing_npc = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info.npc

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	self.racing_count_ui:Hide()

	if draw then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

		-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lana_05) -> Muted
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	end

	-- 카메라 줌인
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 0.5)
	camera_util.move_async(racing_npc.Position, 0.5)

	character_util.set_active_state(racing_npc, 'enabled')
end

--- 레이싱 종료 세팅
function local_class:racing_over(racing_result)
	local racing_info = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info

	if racing_result ~= 'oni_girl_racing_win' then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')

	-- 레이싱 초기화
	character_util.set_active_state(racing_info.npc, 'visible')
	racing_info.npc.Position = racing_info.npc_init_position
	character_util.remove_anim(racing_info.npc)
	character_util.remove_emotion(racing_info.npc)
	character_util.set_direction(racing_info.npc, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(racing_info.npc, { name = 'walk4legs', scale = 0})

	if self.racing_count_ui then
		self.racing_count = 0
		self.racing_count_ui:SetTextCount(racing_info.count_max)
	end

	user_party.Leader.CrashBehaviour = self.user_crash_behavior
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	self:reset_blocks()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'end_vent_racing', racing_result }))

	self.game_loop = false
end

--- 레이싱 시작 연출
function local_class:start_racing()
	local racing_info = self.current_game_map_info.racing_info

	character_util.set_emotion(racing_info.npc, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 라나 (right, smile, idle) : 중앙에 버튼을 먼저 누르는 사람이 이기는 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(racing_info.npc,
		{ key = 'lilith_tower_oni_girl_racing_16', skip = true })

	-- 라나 (right, smile, idle) : 그럼… 출발!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(racing_info.npc,
		{ key = 'lilith_tower_oni_girl_racing_17', skip = true })

	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_lana_05), 0
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_lana_05', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	-- 플레이어 위에 카운트 UI 세팅
	if not self.racing_count_ui then
		local offset = vector(0, 3, -1)
		local count_ui_pool = self.get_count_ui():Instantiate(
			user_party.Leader.Position + offset, unity_class.quaternion.identity, user_party.Leader.Transform)

		self.racing_count_ui = count_ui_pool:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIControlCount))
	else
		self.racing_count_ui:SetTextColorWhite()
		self.count_ui_red = false
		self.racing_count_ui:Show()
	end

	self.racing_count_ui:SetTextCount(self.current_game_map_info.racing_info.count_max)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:set_enemies_leg_walk()
	self.enemies_leg_walk = true
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local builder = newclass('BehaviorTreeBuilder')

function builder:init()
	self.node_prototypes = {}
	self.behavior_prototypes = {}

	self.game_controller = nil

	self:load_node_prototype('minigame/VirtualCop/Nodes/Action')
	self:load_node_prototype('minigame/VirtualCop/Nodes/Sequence')
	self:load_node_prototype('minigame/VirtualCop/Nodes/EntityBehaviorNode')

	self:load_behavior_prototype('minigame/VirtualCop/Data/EntityBehavior')
end

function builder:resolve_dependencies(game_controller)
	self.game_controller = game_controller
end

function builder:dissolve_dependencies()
	self.game_controller = nil
end


function builder:load_node_prototype(path)
	local nodes = get_or_create_global_variable(path)

	for k, v in pairs(nodes) do
		self.node_prototypes[k] = v
	end
end

function builder:load_behavior_prototype(path)
	local nodes = require(path)

	for k, v in pairs(nodes) do
		self.behavior_prototypes[k] = v
	end
end

function builder:set_battle_sequence(sequence_data, key)
	local sequence = require(sequence_data)[key]
	return self:create_node(sequence.node_type, self, sequence.data)
end

function builder:create_node(node_type, bt_builder, data)
	local type = self.node_prototypes[node_type]
	local instance = type(bt_builder, data)

	return instance
end

function builder:create_entity_behavior(entity, behaviour_type, behavior_data)
	local behavior_type = self.behavior_prototypes[behaviour_type]
	if 	behavior_type.data == nil then
		behavior_type.data = {}
	end
	behavior_type.data.entity = entity
	behavior_type.data.behavior_data = behavior_data
	
	local instance = self:create_node(behavior_type.node_type, self, behavior_type.data)

	return instance
end

function builder:create_entity_node(entity, node_type, bt_builder, node_data, behavior_data)
	local type = self.node_prototypes[node_type]

	if node_data == nil then
		node_data = {}
	end
	
	node_data.entity = entity
	
	local instance = type(bt_builder, node_data, behavior_data)
	if behavior_data[node_type] ~= nil then
		instance:set_data(behavior_data[node_type])
	end

	return instance
end

return {
	create = function()
		return builder()
	end
}

local node_status = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/VirtualCop/Nodes/BTNode').node_status
local bt_builder = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/BehaviorTreeBuilder')
local camera_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/CameraController')
local shooting_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/ShootingController')
local effect_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/EffectController')
local entity_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/EntityManager')
local health_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/HealthController')
local loop_sound_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/VirtualCop/Controllers/LoopSoundController')

local local_class = newclass('VirtualCop')

function local_class:init(_)
	-- 게임 설정
	self.game_config = nil

	-- 카메라
	self.camera_comp = nil

	-- 게임 이름
	self.game_name = 'VirtualCop'

	-- 상수 데이터 키
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- 트리 구조의 시퀀스
	self.game_sequence = nil

	-- 리소스 로더
	self.resource_loader = nil

	self.is_game_end = false
	self.is_game_restarting = false

	self.original_shear = nil

	-- 버추얼캅 전용 UI
	self.virtual_cop_ui = nil

	-- 미니 게임 공용 내비게이션
	self.navigation_ui = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	self.constants_data_key = key
	self.game_config = require('minigame/VirtualCop/Data/Config')[key]

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	local resource_loader_path = 'minigame/VirtualCop/Resources/'
	local assetbundle_path = self.game_config.assetbundle_path
	local loader_type = get_or_create_global_variable(resource_loader_path .. self.game_config.resource_loader)
	
	self.resource_loader = loader_type(assetbundle_path, self.constants_data_key, self.game_config.effects)
	self.resource_loader:load_async()
	local result = self.resource_loader:get_resources()
	
	self.camera_comp = result.camera

	-- 기존 스테이지 카메라는 꺼버림
	stage_camera.transform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local shear_controller = get_field_object('shear'):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ShearController))
	self.original_shear = shear_controller.Shear
	shear_controller.Shear = 0

	-- 기사 no_bend_container적용
	get_party_leader().SpineController.CustomShader = result.no_bend_shader

	-- 리소스가 전부 로드 된 이후에는 의존성 해결.
	self:resolve_dependencies()

	-- 엔티티들 생성
	entity_manager:load_entities()

	-- 이펙트 프리로드
	effect_controller:pre_load_async()

	loop_sound_controller:add_loop_sound('01_blizzard_04', 0.4, 3)

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- Naughty Dog's Old Fashioned way of dealing dependencies
function local_class:resolve_dependencies()
	local result = self.resource_loader:get_resources()
	self.virtual_cop_ui = result.virtual_cop_ui
	self.navigation_ui = result.navigation_ui

	self.virtual_cop_ui:play_fps_hand_anim('idle', true)
	self.virtual_cop_ui:set_max_bullet_num(self.game_config.max_bullet)

	self.navigation_ui:set_pause_retry_call_back(function()
		self:restart_game(false)
	end)

	self:set_ui_active_state(false)

	-- 힘들다... 재활용 포기...
	bt_builder:resolve_dependencies(self)

	camera_controller:resolve_dependencies(self.camera_comp, result.camera_red_vignette, result.camera_hit_effect, self.virtual_cop_ui)
	shooting_controller:resolve_dependencies(self.game_config, self.camera_comp, self.virtual_cop_ui)
	entity_manager:resolve_dependencies(self, self.resource_loader, bt_builder)
	effect_controller:resolve_dependencies(self, self.game_config)
	health_controller:resolve_dependencies(self.game_config.max_hp, self.virtual_cop_ui)
end

function local_class:dissolve_all_depencencies()
	health_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	effect_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	shooting_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	camera_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	entity_manager:dissolve_dependencies()
	bt_builder:dissolve_dependencies()
end

function local_class:game_start()
	self:load_game_sequence()
	self:late_init()
end

function local_class:set_restart_transform_value(pos, rot, fov)
	camera_controller:set_restart_transform_value(pos, rot, fov)
end

function local_class:fade_out_screen(is_player_dead)
	if is_player_dead then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_vignette_01')
		loop_sound_controller:fade_out_loop_sound('01_blizzard_04', 3)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	else
		screen_util.fade_out(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	loop_sound_controller:stop_sfx('01_helicopter_03')
end

function local_class:fade_in_screen()
	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
end

function local_class:late_init()
	camera_controller:late_init()
	shooting_controller:late_init()
end

function local_class:game_end()
	shooting_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	camera_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	entity_manager:dissolve_dependencies()
	
	self.shear_controller.Shear = self.original_shear
end

function local_class:load_game_sequence()
	self.game_sequence = bt_builder:set_battle_sequence('minigame/VirtualCop/Data/SeqeunceData', self.constants_data_key)
end

function local_class:update(dt)
	-- 카메라는 무조건 업데이트 한다.
	camera_controller:update(dt)

	if self.is_game_end then
		self:dispose_game_sequence()
		entity_manager:dispose_child_effect()
		return false
	end

	if self.is_game_restarting then
		return true
	end
	
	shooting_controller:update(dt)

	-- 히트 처리
	local hit_entity = shooting_controller:get_hit_object()

	entity_manager:update_damaged_entity(hit_entity)
	if self.game_sequence ~= nil then
		local sequence_result = self.game_sequence:update(dt)
		if sequence_result == node_status.succeed then
			shooting_controller:disable()
			self.is_game_end = true
		end
	end

	entity_manager:update_entity_behaviors(dt)

	shooting_controller:late_update()
	shooting_controller:reset()

	if not health_controller:is_player_alive() then
		self:restart_game(true)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:restart_game(is_player_dead)
	self.is_game_restarting = true
	
	start_coroutine(function()
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
		if is_player_dead then
			wait_for_sec(0.3)
		end
		
		self:fade_out_screen(is_player_dead)
		
		get_field_object('default_light').ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

		effect_controller:reset()
		camera_controller:restart()
		shooting_controller:restore()
		health_controller:restore()
		entity_manager:restart()
		
		self.game_sequence:dispose()
		self:load_game_sequence()
		
		if is_player_dead then
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
		end

		if is_player_dead then
			loop_sound_controller:add_loop_sound('01_blizzard_04', 0.4, 3)
		end

		self:fade_in_screen()

		self.is_game_restarting = false
	end)
end

function local_class:set_ui_active_state(is_active)
	self.virtual_cop_ui:set_active(is_active)
	self.navigation_ui:set_active(is_active)
end

function local_class:draw_fps_hand_async(duration)
	self.virtual_cop_ui:draw_fps_hand_async(duration)
end

-- 구조 관리 개망~ 시간 없는데 될대로 대라지.
function local_class:reset_effect()
	effect_controller:reset()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dissolve_all_depencencies()

	self:dispose_game_sequence()
	
	camera_controller:dispose()
	shooting_controller:dispose()
	health_controller:dispose()
	entity_manager:dispose()
	effect_controller:dispose()
	
	self.resource_loader:dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose_game_sequence()
	if self.game_sequence ~= nil then
		self.game_sequence:dispose()
		self.game_sequence = nil
	end
end


return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	-- 미니게임 이름

	-- game state
	self.game_state_enum = {
		none = 1,
		start = 2,
		play = 3,
		trap = 4,
		ending = 5,
	}
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.none

	-- Constants Data
	self.game_data = nil

	-- 게임 진행중에 있는지?
	self.is_playing_game = false

	self.cs_controller = cs_controller

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = nil

	-- string key
	self.string_key = nil

	-- NPC
	-- 안대 장착한 아이
	self.get_blind_kid = function()
		return get_character('kid_android')
	end

	-- 유저 스폰 포인트
	self.user_spawn_pos = nil

	-- follow npc 스폰 포인트
	self.follower_spawn_pos = nil

	-- fo
	-- (field object name)
	self.water_balloon_name = 'water_balloon_'
	self.water_melon_name = 'water_melon'
	self.broken_water_melon_name = 'broken_water_melon'
	-- 물풍선 drop item 리스트d
	self.drop_item_water_balloon_list = {}
	self.drop_item_water_melon = nil
	self.drop_item_broken_water_melon = nil

	self.water_balloon_item_num = 20694
	self.water_melon_item_num = 20689
	self.broken_water_melon_item_num = 20693

	self.get_water_balloon = function(num)
		return get_field_object(self.water_balloon_name .. num)
	end
	self.get_water_melon = function()
		return get_field_object(self.water_melon_name)
	end

	-- 물풍선 관련
	self.water_balloon_obj_first_name_len = 14
	self.water_ballon_count = 0

	-- 게임 진행 시간
	self.game_play_time = 0

	self.input_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.None

	self.player_char_ment_on = false

	-- 유즈(플레이어 캐릭터)가 emotion smile에서 점프대 점프 이후 emotion이 기본으로 풀려 방지하기 위한 플래그
	self.player_char_jump_state = false

	-- item (물풍선, 수박)

	-- effect
	self.get_fx_water_melon_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('hammock_fx_cwp_eighttail_explosion')
	end
	self.get_fx_water_balloon_hit = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_waterball_explosion')
	end

	-- marker
	self.get_watermelon_center_pos = nil

	self.play_count = 0

	-- 해상도에 따른 camera size 저장
	self.minigame_camera_size = 0

	-- 챌린지 체크
	self.challenge_mode = false

	-- 사운드
	self.user_clap_sound_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 게임 데이터 및 키 세팅
	local before_data_key = self.constants_data_key
	self.constants_data_key = key
	if self.game_data == nil or before_data_key ~= self.constants_data_key then
		-- game_data 키가 세팅이 안되있거나 이전 데이터 키랑 다른 값이 세팅되어 있다면 game_data 다시 세팅
		self.game_data = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data(
				'minigame/WatermelonGame/WatermelonGameConstants', self.constants_data_key)
	end

	-- 챌린지 모드인지 체크
	if string.match(self.constants_data_key, 'challenge') then
		self.challenge_mode = true
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	local kid = self.get_blind_kid()

	self.water_ballon_count = self.game_data.water_ballon_count

	-- 물풍선 비활성화 체크 후 활성화로 변경
	for index = 1, self.water_ballon_count do
		if self.drop_item_water_balloon_list ~= nil and #self.drop_item_water_balloon_list > 0 then
			if self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] ~= nil then
				self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index].SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
				self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index].ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			end
		end

		local fo = get_field_object('water_balloon_' .. index)
		if fo ~= nil and fo.ActiveState == active_state('disabled') then
			stage_util.set_fo_active_state(fo.Name, 'enabled')
		elseif fo == nil then
			break
		end
	end

	self.string_key = self.game_data.string_key

	-- 캐릭터 게임 시작 위치로 이동
	self.user_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(self.game_data.user_spawn_point).position
	self.follower_spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(self.game_data.follower_spawn_point).position

	scene_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right', false)
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, self.user_spawn_pos)

	scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'down', false)
	character_util.set_position(kid, self.follower_spawn_pos)

	character_util.spine_set_attachment(kid, '[base]weapon1', 'stick')
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid, 'blind')

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(kid, 'twohand_idle')

	character_util.convert_to_npc(kid)

	-- 미니게임 로드 이후에 카메라 사이즈 변경
	local aspect = CS.UnityEngine.Screen.safeArea.width / CS.UnityEngine.Screen.height
	if aspect < 1.8 then
		self.minigame_camera_size = 6
	else
		self.minigame_camera_size = 5
	end

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.minigame_camera_size, 0)

	-- game data setting
	local camera_center_pos_name = self.game_data.camera_center_pos_name
	self.get_watermelon_center_pos = function()
		return field:GetMarker(camera_center_pos_name).position
	end

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	self.get_fx_water_melon_hit()
	self.get_fx_water_balloon_hit()

	self:item_obj_setting()

	-- 준비 끝났으면 콜백 보냄
	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.is_playing_game then
		self.is_playing_game = false
	end

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.play then
		self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.none
	end

	self:clear_minigame_drop_item()

	if self.user_clap_sound_sfx ~= nil then
		self.user_clap_sound_sfx:Stop()
		self.user_clap_sound_sfx = nil
	end

	self.constants_data_key = nil
	self.game_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	return true
end

-- 물풍선 리스트 셋팅
function local_class:item_obj_setting()
	if self.game_data.use_default_field_object_pos then
		if #self.drop_item_water_balloon_list == 0 then
			for index = 1, self.water_ballon_count do
				if self.get_water_balloon(index) ~= nil then
					self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] = drop_item_util.create_item({
						pos = self.get_water_balloon(index).Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
						itemid = self.water_balloon_item_num, notforinven = true
					})
				end
			end
		end

		if self.drop_item_water_melon == nil then
			self.drop_item_water_melon = drop_item_util.create_item({
				pos = self.get_water_melon().Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				itemid = self.water_melon_item_num, notforinven = true
			})
		end
	else
		self:clear_minigame_drop_item()

		self.drop_item_water_balloon_list = {}

		-- constants data에서 지정한 위치로 field object 위치 변경, 드랍 아이템 위치 지정
		if self.game_data.water_ballon_pos_list ~= nil then
			for index = 1, self.water_ballon_count do
				local water_balloon = self.get_water_balloon(index)
				if water_balloon ~= nil then
					local new_water_balloon_pos = self.game_data.water_ballon_pos_list[index]
					if new_water_balloon_pos ~= nil and new_water_balloon_pos[1] ~= nil and new_water_balloon_pos[2] ~= nil then
						water_balloon.Position = vector(new_water_balloon_pos[1], 0, new_water_balloon_pos[2])

						self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] = drop_item_util.create_item({
							pos = water_balloon.Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
							itemid = self.water_balloon_item_num, notforinven = true
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if self.game_data.water_melon_pos ~= nil then
			if self.drop_item_water_melon == nil then
				local water_melon = self.get_water_melon()
				local new_water_melon_pos = self.game_data.water_melon_pos
				water_melon.Position = vector(new_water_melon_pos[1], 0, new_water_melon_pos[2])

				stage_util.set_fo_active_state(water_melon.Name, 'enabled')

				self.drop_item_water_melon = drop_item_util.create_item({
					pos = self.get_water_melon().Position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					itemid = self.water_melon_item_num, notforinven = true
				})
			end
		end
	end

	if self.drop_item_broken_water_melon == nil then
		self.drop_item_broken_water_melon = drop_item_util.create_item({
			pos = vector(999, 0, 999), lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
			itemid = self.broken_water_melon_item_num, notforinven = true
		})
	end
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- 미니게임 로직
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	local center_pos = self.get_watermelon_center_pos()
	local kid = self.get_blind_kid()

	self.play_count = self.play_count + 1

	self.is_playing_game = true
	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.start

	local backup_hitbox = kid.Hitbox
	kid.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(0.45, 0.75, 0.45))

	scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'down', false)
	character_util.set_position(kid, self.follower_spawn_pos)

	camera_util.move(center_pos, 0)

	-- 페이드 인
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)

	self:explain_ment()

	self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.play

	-- bgm 정보가 있다면 해당 bgm 재생
	if self.game_data.play_bgm ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.game_data.play_bgm, state = 'event', mix = 0 })
	end

	-- 게임 루프 시작
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local cur_play_time = 0
	local is_success = false
	local hit_obj = nil

	local backup_camera_pos_z = 0

	scene_util.set_anim_loop(kid, 'twohand_walk', { upper = true })

	self.user_clap_sound_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_loop_01',
															loop = true, parent = kid })
	scene_util.set_emotion_loop(user_party.Leader, 'smile')
	scene_util.set_anim_loop(user_party.Leader, 'unique/clap_upper', { upper = true })

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
			| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	while self.is_playing_game and self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.play do
		-- 시간 계속 체크
		cur_play_time = cur_play_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local weight_z = 0
		if leader.Position.z > -31 then
			weight_z = leader.Position.z - -31
			if leader.Position.z > -28 then
				weight_z = 3
			end
		end

		if leader.Position.z < -37.5 then
			weight_z = leader.Position.z - -37.5
			if leader.Position.z < -39.5 then
				weight_z = -2
			end
		end

		-- check yuze jump state
		self:check_jump_state()

		backup_camera_pos_z = center_pos.z + weight_z

		camera_util.move(vector(center_pos.x, 0, center_pos.z + weight_z), 0)

		-- 아이 유즈를 보며 이동
		self:kid_move_by_one_frame(kid, kid.Position, leader.Position, 1.5)

		-- 플레이어블 캐릭터(유즈) 주기적으로 멘트 출력
		if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.play then
			self:check_character_ment(cur_play_time)
		end

		-- 물풍선, 수박 체크
		hit_obj = self:check_object_collision()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 게임 끝났으니 컨트롤 뺏는다.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 파티 스테이트 원복
	field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	character_util.remove_anim(leader, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

	if self.user_clap_sound_sfx ~= nil then
		self.user_clap_sound_sfx:Stop()
		self.user_clap_sound_sfx = nil
	end

	local anim_duration = 0
	local vec_dir = unity_class.vector3.zero

	character_util.remove_anim(kid, true)

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.ending then

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')

		-- 카메라 안드로이드 꼬마에게 이동 및 줌 인
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.5)
		camera_util.move_async(kid.Position, 0.5)

		-- 수박 공격 시 바라보는 방향으로 잠시 나옴
		anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(kid, 'twohand_attack4') / 1
		character_util.look_at(kid, hit_obj)
		vec_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(kid.Direction)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(kid, vector(vec_dir.x * 0.25, 0, vec_dir.z * 0.25), anim_duration * 0.5, anim_duration * 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_fire_harpy_jump_02')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(kid, { name = 'twohand_attack4', count = 1, scale = 2, keep_anim = true })

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.3, 'crash_watermelon')

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.35)

		CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('crash_watermelon')

		-- 02_lord_explosion_01 + 02_explosion_01
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lord_explosion_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')

		self.get_fx_water_melon_hit():Instantiate(hit_obj.Bounds.center)
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(hit_obj.Name, 'disabled')

		-- 수박 아이템, 오브젝트와 부서진 아이템 간의 위치 값 스왑
		if self.drop_item_broken_water_melon ~= nil then
			self.drop_item_broken_water_melon:SetPosition(hit_obj.Position)
		end
		if self.drop_item_water_melon ~= nil then
			self.drop_item_water_melon:SetPosition(vector(999, 0, 999))
			self.drop_item_water_melon.SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.drop_item_water_melon.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

	elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.trap then

		-- 물풍선 공격 시 바라보는 방향으로 잠시 나옴
		anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(kid, 'twohand_attack') / 2
		character_util.look_at(kid, hit_obj)
		vec_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(kid.Direction)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(kid, vector(vec_dir.x * 0.5, 0, vec_dir.z * 0.5), anim_duration * 0.5, anim_duration * 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(kid, { name = 'twohand_attack', count = 1, scale = 2, keep_anim = true })

		wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.3)

		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_water_01')
		self.get_fx_water_balloon_hit():Instantiate(hit_obj.Bounds.center)
		stage_util.set_fo_active_state(hit_obj.Name, 'disabled')
		local obj_name_len = string.len(hit_obj.Name)
		local obj_index_len = obj_name_len - self.water_balloon_obj_first_name_len
		local obj_index = string.sub(hit_obj.Name, self.water_balloon_obj_first_name_len + 1, obj_name_len)
		local drop_item_index = tonumber(obj_index)
		if drop_item_index ~= nil then
			self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[drop_item_index].SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[drop_item_index].ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		end

	end

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration * 0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(kid, true)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(leader)

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.ending then
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.minigame_camera_size, 0.5)
		camera_util.move_async(vector(center_pos.x, 0, backup_camera_pos_z), 0.5)

		-- 03_activity_clear_01 + 01_crowd_clap_02
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')

		-- 성공했다면 ...
		scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_direction(kid, 'right', false)
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'smile')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'victory_extra')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(kid, 'victory_extra')
		is_success = true
	elseif self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.trap then
		if leader.Position.x < kid.Position.x then
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'right', false)
		else
			scene_util.set_direction(leader, 'left', false)
		end

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(leader, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(leader, 'embarrassed')
		scene_util.set_emotion_loop(kid, 'surprise')
		scene_util.set_anim_loop(kid, 'embarrassed')
		is_success = false
	end

	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 실패했을 경우에만
	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.trap then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	-- Fade Out
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Show()

	-- 안드로이드 꼬마에 장착된 무기 제거
	character_util.spine_set_attachment(kid, '[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	if self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.ending then
		self:clear_minigame_drop_item()
	end

	kid.Hitbox = backup_hitbox
	local game_over_pos = field:GetMarker(self.game_data.game_over_position).position
	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, game_over_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(kid, game_over_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0))

	-- 성공 여부에 따라 재생
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
end

function local_class:explain_ment()
	if self.play_count == 1 and not self.challenge_mode then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')
		-- 화자(사회자) : 꼬마 참가자분이 끝에 있는 수박을 깨뜨리면 성공입니다!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 23, true,
				{ screen_pos = vector(-100, -50), bubble_direction = 'ct' })

		-- 화자(사회자)  : 단, 도중 물풍선에 닿으면 실패입니다!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 24, true,
				{ screen_pos = vector(-100, -50), bubble_direction = 'ct' })

		-- 화자(사회자)  : 라이프가드께서 박수소리로 꼬마 참가자분을 잘 이끌어주셔야 합니다!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 25, true,
				{ screen_pos = vector(-100, -50), bubble_direction = 'ct' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

		-- 화자(사회자)  : 그럼… 시작!!
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 26, true,
				{ screen_pos = vector(-100, -50), bubble_direction = 'ct' })
	else
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

	-- 유즈 : 내 박수 소리를 듣고 잘 따라와!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(user_party.Leader, self.string_key .. 27, true)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:check_jump_state()
	-- 캐릭터가 점프대로 날아오는 중이면 이벤트 발생하지 않게 넘어감
	if lua_helper.type_compare(
			user_party.Leader.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) then
		self.player_char_jump_state = true

		if self.user_clap_sound_sfx ~= nil then
			self.user_clap_sound_sfx:Stop()
			self.user_clap_sound_sfx = nil
		end
	else
		if self.player_char_jump_state then
			if self.is_playing_game and self.cur_game_state == self.game_state_enum.play then
				scene_util.set_emotion_loop(user_party.Leader, 'smile')
				scene_util.set_anim_loop(user_party.Leader, 'unique/clap_upper', { upper = true })
				self.player_char_jump_state = false


				self.user_clap_sound_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_loop_01',
																		loop = true, parent = self.get_blind_kid() })
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:kid_move_by_one_frame(fo, pos_from, pos_to, speed)
	local dir = (pos_to - pos_from).normalized
	fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(dir)
	local move_result = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
			fo,
			dir,
			speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

	if move_result.stopper ~= nil then
		local xComponent = vector(dir.x, 0, 0)
		local zComponent = vector(0, 0, dir.z)
		local rem = ((speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime) - move_result.distance)

		if rem > 0 and xComponent.magnitude > 0 and zComponent.magnitude > 0 then
			local xOverlap = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetXOverap(fo.Bounds, move_result.stopper.Bounds)
			local zOverlap = CS.BoundsExtensions.GetZOverap(fo.Bounds, move_result.stopper.Bounds)
			if xOverlap < zOverlap then
				CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
						fo,
						zComponent.normalized,
						rem * zComponent.magnitude)
			else
				CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(
						fo,
						xComponent.normalized,
						rem * xComponent.magnitude)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:check_character_ment(cur_play_time)
	local cur_time = math.ceil(cur_play_time)
	local remainder = cur_time % self.game_data.player_char_ment_time

	if remainder == 0 and self.player_char_ment_on == false then
		self.player_char_ment_on = true
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, { key = self.string_key .. 28, skip = false })
	elseif remainder > 0 then
		self.player_char_ment_on = false
	end
end

-- 물풍선, 수박 충돌 체크
function local_class:check_object_collision()
	local kid = self.get_blind_kid()

	local collide_fos = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(
			kid.Bounds.center, kid.Bounds)

	for i = 0, collide_fos.Count - 1 do
		local fo = collide_fos[i]
		if string.match(fo.Name, self.water_balloon_name) then
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.trap
			self.player_char_jump_state = false
			self.is_playing_game = false
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			return fo
		elseif string.match(fo.Name, self.water_melon_name) then
			self.cur_game_state = self.game_state_enum.ending
			self.player_char_jump_state = false
			self.is_playing_game = false
			collide_fos:Dispose()
			return fo
		end
	end

	collide_fos:Dispose()
	return nil
end

-- 타이머 종료 시 호출되는 함수
function local_class:clear_minigame_drop_item()
	if self.drop_item_water_melon ~= nil then
		self.drop_item_water_melon.SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.drop_item_water_melon.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_water_melon)
		self.drop_item_water_melon = nil
	end

	if self.drop_item_broken_water_melon ~= nil then
		drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_broken_water_melon)
		self.drop_item_broken_water_melon = nil
	end

	for index = 1, self.water_ballon_count do
		if self.drop_item_water_balloon_list ~= nil and self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] ~= nil then
			self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index].SpriteTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index].ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index])
			self.drop_item_water_balloon_list[index] = nil
		end
	end

	self.drop_item_water_balloon_list = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}
