--- 두더지 잡기(Whack-A-Mole) 미니 게임 컨트롤러
local local_class = newclass('WhackAMoleController')

function local_class:init(cs_controller)
	self.game_name = 'whack_a_mole'

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_mole = function(num) return get_field_object('whack_a_mole_mole_' .. num) end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_player_position = function() return field:GetMarker('whack_a_mole_player_position') end
	self.get_mole_position = function(num) return field:GetMarker('whack_a_mole_mole_position_' .. num) end

	-- UI 오브젝트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_ui_fail_counter = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FieldUIFailCounter') end

	-- Constants Data
	self.constants = nil

	-- 불러올 Constants Data의 Key
	self.constants_data_key = ''

	-- UI
	self.ui_fail_counter = nil

	-- Effect
	self.effect_list = nil

	-- 실패 횟수
	self.fail_count = 0
	self.max_fail_count = 4

	-- 미니게임이 진행 중인가
	self.is_playing_game = false
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	self.get_ui_fail_counter()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.constants = nil

	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end

	self:effect_list_clear()
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameLoadEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_load_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_load_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		self.constants_data_key = e.DataKey
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_init, self, e.LoadEndCallback))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.constants ~= nil then
		local mole_num = self.constants.mole_num
		for i = 1, mole_num do
			local mole = self.get_mole(i)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, mole) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.attack_mole, self, mole))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:effect_list_clear()
	if self.effect_list ~= nil then
		for k, v in pairs(self.effect_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Dispose()
				self.effect_list[k] = nil
			end
		end

		self.effect_list = nil
	end
end

-- 미니게임 초기화
function local_class:game_init(load_end_callback)
	-- Constants Data 로드
	self.constants = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data('minigame/WhackAMole/WhackAMoleConstants', self.constants_data_key)

	-- 플레이어 위치 세팅
	local player_position_marker = self.get_player_position()
	user_party.Leader.Position = player_position_marker.position
	user_party.Leader.Direction = player_position_marker.direction

	-- 두더지 위치 세팅
	local mole_num = self.constants.mole_num
	for i = 1, mole_num do
		local mole = self.get_mole(i)
		local mole_position_marker = self.get_mole_position(i)

		mole.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		mole.Position = mole_position_marker.position
	end

	-- 실패 횟수 초기화
	self.fail_count = 0

	-- 이펙트 리스트 초기화
	self:effect_list_clear()
	self.effect_list = {}

	-- 이펙트 로드
	if self.constants.mole_effect_name ~= nil then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.constants.mole_effect_name)

		yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
	end

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	-- BGM 재생
	if self.constants.bgm_name ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = self.constants.bgm_name, state = 'event' })
	end

	-- UI Fail Counter 세팅
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end
	self.ui_fail_counter = self.get_ui_fail_counter():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.FieldUIFailCounter))
	self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(0)
	self.ui_fail_counter:Reposition()

	-- 게임 진행
	yield_return_func(self.game_loop, self)

	-- 1초동안 UI Fail Counter에 실패 아이콘이 4개 쌓인걸 보여줌.
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 미니게임이 끝난 후, 두더지 오브젝트를 비활성화
	local is_finish_disabled = self.constants.is_finish_disabled
	if is_finish_disabled then
		for i = 1, mole_num do
			local mole = self.get_mole(i)

			mole.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
		end
	end

	-- Fail Counter UI 제거
	if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
		self.ui_fail_counter:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.PooledUnityObject)):Dispose()
		self.ui_fail_counter = nil
	end

	-- Constants Data 제거
	self.constants = nil

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local is_success = self.fail_count < self.max_fail_count
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))
end

-- 미니게임 진행
function local_class:game_loop()
	self.is_playing_game = true

	local pattern_list = self.constants.pattern

	for i = 1, #pattern_list do
		local pattern = pattern_list[i]
		local enabled_list = lua_helper.get_or_default(pattern.enabled, {})
		local disabled_list = lua_helper.get_or_default(pattern.disabled, {})
		local wait_num = lua_helper.get_or_default(pattern.wait, 3)

		-- 두더지 비활성화
		--region disabled
		local prev_fail_count = self.fail_count
		for j = 1, #disabled_list do
			local disabled_num = disabled_list[j]
			local mole = self.get_mole(disabled_num)

			-- Interact 가능한 오브젝트가 남아있으면, 1개당 실패 1회로 처리.
			if mole.Interactable ~= nil and lua_helper.type_compare(mole.Interactable, typeof(CS.Oak.PublishInteractable)) then
				self.fail_count = self.fail_count + 1

				if self.ui_fail_counter ~= nil then
					self.ui_fail_counter:SetFailCount(self.fail_count)
				end

				if self.fail_count >= self.max_fail_count then
					break
				end
			end

			mole.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
			if self.effect_list[mole] ~= nil then
				self.effect_list[mole]:Dispose()
				self.effect_list[mole] = nil
			end
		end

		-- 실패 Sfx 재생
		if prev_fail_count ~= self.fail_count then
			if self.constants.mole_miss_sfx_name ~= nil then
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.constants.mole_miss_sfx_name)
			end
		end

		if self.fail_count >= self.max_fail_count then
			break
		end
		--endregion

		-- 두더지 활성화
		--region enabled
		for j = 1, #enabled_list do
			local enabled_num = enabled_list[j]
			local mole = self.get_mole(enabled_num)

			mole.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
			if self.effect_list[mole] == nil and self.constants.mole_effect_name ~= nil then
				-- Effect Offset 지정
				local offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
				if self.constants.mole_effect_offset ~= nil then
					local constants_offset = self.constants.mole_effect_offset
					offset = vector(constants_offset.x, constants_offset.y, constants_offset.z)
				end

				-- Effect 생성
				self.effect_list[mole] = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.constants.mole_effect_name):Instantiate(mole.Position + offset)

				-- Effect Sfx 재생
				if self.constants.mole_effect_sfx_name ~= nil then
					music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.constants.mole_effect_sfx_name, parent = mole, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
				end
			end
		end
		--endregion

		-- 다음 패턴까지 대기
		wait_for_sec(wait_num)
	end

	local mole_num = self.constants.mole_num
	for i = 1, mole_num do
		local mole = self.get_mole(i)

		mole.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	self:effect_list_clear()

	-- 실패하지 않고 성공했을 경우 Sfx 재생
	if self.fail_count < self.max_fail_count then
		if self.constants.success_sfx_name ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(self.constants.success_sfx_name)
		end
	end

	self.is_playing_game = false
end

-- 타겟을 공격했을 때의 연출
function local_class:attack_mole(mole)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(user_party.Leader, 'attack')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'attack' })

	wait_for_sec(0.23)

	-- 두더지를 때렸을 때 Sfx 재생
	if self.constants.mole_hit_sfx_name ~= nil then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = self.constants.mole_hit_sfx_name, parent = mole, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	end

	mole:Shake(0.05, 0.25)
	mole.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	if self.effect_list ~= nil and self.effect_list[mole] ~= nil then
		self.effect_list[mole]:Dispose()
		self.effect_list[mole] = nil
	end

	wait_for_sec(anim_duration - 0.23)

	-- game_loop가 끝난 후, 1초동안 UI Fail Counter를 보여주는 동안에 컨트롤이 풀리지 않게 처리.
	if self.is_playing_game then
		party_util.reset_controllers()
	end
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

function local_class:load_resource()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_effect_preset)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

	self.ru = get_character(self.ru_name)

	self.minigame_check_elf = get_character(self.minigame_check_elf_name)

	-- 상단 매드 팬더 설정
	self.mad_panda_upper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	self.mad_panda_upper_state_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)

	for i = 1, self.mad_panda_num do
		local mad_panda = get_character(self.mad_panda_upper_name..i)
		mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_immortal(mad_panda, true)

		self.mad_panda_upper_list:Add(mad_panda)
		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list:Add(self.mad_panda_upper_state.none)

		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(mad_panda)

	end

	-- 하단 매드 팬더 설정
	self.mad_panda_lower_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	self.mad_panda_lower_state_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)
	self.mad_panda_evasion_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)

	for i = 1, self.mad_panda_num do
		local mad_panda = get_character(self.mad_panda_lower_name..i)
		mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.set_immortal(mad_panda, true)

		self.mad_panda_lower_list:Add(mad_panda)
		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list:Add(self.mad_panda_lower_state.none)
		self.mad_panda_evasion_list:Add(i - 1)

		stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(mad_panda)

	end

	-- 이동 불가 벽 비활성화
	self.block_wall = get_field_object(self.block_wall_name)
	self.block_wall.Position = self.block_wall.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	self.block_wall.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(42, 1, 1))
	stage_util.set_fo_active_state(self.block_wall_name, 'disabled')

	-- 마커 리스트 설정
	self.steal_marker_name_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
	for i = 1, self.steal_marker_num do
		self.steal_marker_name_list:Add(self.steal_marker_name..i)
	end

	self.sing_marker_name_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
	for i = 1, self.sing_marker_num do
		self.sing_marker_name_list:Add(self.sing_marker_name..i)
	end

	-- 프로젝타일 설정
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec(self.projectile_name)
	self.projectile_speed = 7.5 --proj_spec.Speed
	self.projectile_life_time = 1.5 --proj_spec.Lifetime

	self.projectile_virtual_obj_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject)

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource()
	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	local optimized_npc = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		gift_dropper = 'xm_elf_male'
	})

	self.optimized_gift_npc = optimized_npc['gift_dropper']
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_gift_npc, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_direction(self.optimized_gift_npc, 'down')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.optimized_gift_npc, 'disabled')

	self:game_init()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))

	self:dispose_gift_table()

	self:dispose_mad_panda()

	self.gift_table = nil

	self.gift_done = nil

	self.constants = nil

	self:effect_list_clear()

	self:dispose_bakery_timer_ui()

	if self.optimized_gift_npc ~= nil and self.experimental_destroy_character then
		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs({ self.optimized_gift_npc })
		self.optimized_gift_npc = nil
	end

end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		return self:on_stage_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent) then
		return self:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		return self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		return self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == self.game_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_start, self))
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if self.constants ~= nil then
	end

	for bench_id, bench in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
		if e.Target == bench.table then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bench_power_on, self, bench_id))
			break
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_move_field_object_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) and self.is_camera_move then
		self:set_camera()
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_upper_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.is_playing_game and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.mad_panda_upper_list[i]) then
			local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile

			if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
				self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.dead

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_lower_list.Count - 1 do
		if self.is_playing_game and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.mad_panda_lower_list[i]) then
			local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Projectile

			if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type and
					(self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion and
							self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.respawn and
							self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint and
							self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.dead) then
				self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.shoot_projectile_up_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.instantiate_virtual_obj, self, CS.Oak.Direction.Up))
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.shoot_projectile_down_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.instantiate_virtual_obj, self, CS.Oak.Direction.Down))
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.shoot_projectile_right_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.instantiate_virtual_obj, self, CS.Oak.Direction.Right))
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.shoot_projectile_left_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.instantiate_virtual_obj, self, CS.Oak.Direction.Left))
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'game_end_scene_finish' then
			self.external_end_event = false
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.enter_section_5 then
			for i = 1, self.constants.workbench_count + 1 do
				self:belt_power_on(i)
			end
		end
	elseif e.Params ~= nil and e.Params.Length == 2 then
		if e.Params[0] == 'load_mini_game' then
			self.constants_data_key = e.Params[1]
			self:game_init()
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:effect_list_clear()
	if self.effect_list ~= nil then
		for k, v in pairs(self.effect_list) do
			if v ~= nil then
				v:Dispose()
				self.effect_list[k] = nil
			end
		end

		self.effect_list = nil
	end
end

-- 미니게임 초기화
function local_class:game_init()
	-- Constants Data 로드
	--self.constants = load_util.load_lua_gimmick_data('minigame/XMasComicBakery/XMasComicBakeryConstants', self.constants_data_key)
	local constant_class = require('minigame/XMasComicBakery/XMasComicBakeryConstants')
	if constant_class == nil then
		-- 오류 뱉어냄
		return
	end

	self.constants = constant_class[self.constants_data_key]
	--CS.Debug.LogError('constants loaded as ' .. self.constants_data_key)

	-- 엘프 설정
	for i = 1, 3 do
		for j = 1, 4 do
			local cur_elf = get_character(self.constants.workbench_name .. i .. '_' .. j)
			cur_elf.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
	end

	local christmas_main_quest_id = 60045
	local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(christmas_main_quest_id)
	local is_belt_on = quest_progress ~= nil and quest_progress.InnerProgress > 3

	for i = 1, self.constants.workbench_count + 1 do
		self:generate_belt(i, vector(1, 0, 0), self.constants.convair_belt_lengths[i])

		if is_belt_on then
			self:belt_power_on(i)
		end
	end
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	party_util.align_party(vector(8, 0, 119), 'left', 0, 'linear')

	-- 벤치 및 벨트 테이블에 등록
	for i = 1, self.constants.workbench_count + 1 do
		self:generate_belt(i, vector(1, 0, 0), self.constants.convair_belt_lengths[i])
	end
	for i = 1, self.constants.workbench_count do
		self:generate_bench(i)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 플레이어 캐릭터 교체
	if user_util.has_knight_male() then
		self:change_manual_character(self.shooter_male_name)
	else
		self:change_manual_character(self.shooter_female_name)
	end

	-- 캐릭터 무적으로 설정
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, true)

	-- 캐릭터 HP 최대로 회복
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.sender = user_party_leader
	heal_info.target = user_party_leader
	heal_info.heal = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

	command_util.publish_cmd(heal_info.Owner, CS.Oak.HealCommand.Create(heal_info))

	-- 티니아 제거
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.tinia_name), 'disabled')

	-- 루돌프와 엘프 설정
	if self.constants.show_mini_game_ending then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.ru, 'enabled')
	else

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

-- 미니게임 진행
function local_class:game_loop()
	-- 매드 팬더 컨트롤
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.control_mad_panda, self))

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.control_player, self))

	local timer = 0
	local gift_regen_timer = 0
	self.lost_count = 0
	self.game_level = 0
	while not self.is_gameover and timer < self.constants.time_limit do
		if not self.is_pause then
			-- 타이머 UI 갱신
			self:update_bakery_timer(self.constants.time_limit - timer)
			for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
				-- 작업대 위에 놓인 선물 진행
				self:gift_progress_on_bench(bench_id)
				-- 기계에 들어간 선물 대기 끝났는지 체크
				self:check_head_of_bench(bench_id)
			end

			for belt_id, _ in ipairs(self.belt_table) do
				-- 벨트 위에 놓인 선물 진행
				self:gift_progress_on_belt(belt_id)
				-- 벨트 끝에서 기계에 선물 들어가야 하는지 체크
				self:check_head_of_belt(belt_id)
			end

			-- 주기적으로 선물 아이템 생성
			if timer > gift_regen_timer then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.generate_gift, self))
				gift_regen_timer = gift_regen_timer + self.constants.regen_delay
			end

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 미니게임 종료 후, 다시 플레이 할 수 있도록 설정 초기화
function local_class:game_reset()
	self.is_gameover = false

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	-- 플레이어 캐릭터 리셋

	self.damage_count = 0

		for gnome_id = 1, 4 do
			local cur_elf = self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[gnome_id]
			character_util.set_active_state(cur_elf, 'enabled')

	end

	-- 매드 팬더 NPC로 변경
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_upper_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.mad_panda_upper_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.mad_panda_upper_list[i])
	end

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_lower_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(self.mad_panda_lower_list[i], vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.convert_to_npc(self.mad_panda_lower_list[i])
	end

	-- 티니아 복구
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character(self.tinia_name), 'enabled')

	-- 엘프 UI 표시
	for i = 1, 3 do
		for j = 1, 4 do
			local cur_elf = get_character(self.constants.workbench_name .. i .. '_' .. j)
			field_ui_manager:SetUI(cur_elf, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

			character_util.remove_anim(cur_elf)
			character_util.remove_emotion(cur_elf)
		end
	end

	-- 선물 놓는 엘프 비활성화
	character_util.set_position(self.optimized_gift_npc, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 비밀길 염
	local blocker = get_field_object(self.blocker_name)
	blocker.Position = vector(42, 0, 120)

	-- 배틀게이트 염
	for i = 1, self.battlegate_num do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battlegate_name..i, false))
	end

	-- 선물 초기화
	self:dispose_gift_table()

	-- 작업대 및 벨트 리셋
	for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
		self:bench_power_init(bench_id)
	end

	-- 매드 팬더 관련 변수 초기화
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_upper_state_list.Count - 1 do
		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.none

-- 작업대 목록에 작업대 추가
function local_class:generate_bench(index)
	if self.bench_table[index] == nil then
		self.bench_table[index] = {
			gifts = {},
			gnomes = {},
			gnome_init_pos = nil,
			input = index,
			output = index + 1,
			duration = 3.5,
			power = true,
			table = get_field_object(self.bench_table_name..index)
		}

		-- 작업대에 할당된 노움들 목록에 추가
		for i = 1, 4 do
			table.insert(self.bench_table[index].gnomes, get_character(self.constants.workbench_name .. index .. '_' .. i))
			if i ~= 1 then
				character_util.set_active_state(self.bench_table[index].gnomes[i], 'disabled')
			else
				self.bench_table[index].gnome_init_pos = self.bench_table[index].gnomes[i].Position
				character_util.set_position(self.bench_table[index].gnomes[i],
						self.bench_table[index].gnome_init_pos)
			end
		end

	end
	self:bench_power_init(index)

	return self.bench_table[index]
end

-- 작업대에 배치된 선물들 순차적으로 진행
function local_class:gift_progress_on_bench(bench_id)
	local bench = self.bench_table[bench_id]
	if not bench.power then
		return
	end
	for _, gift_id in ipairs(bench.gifts) do

		local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

		if gift ~= nil then
			self:gift_add_progress(gift_id, unity_class.time.deltaTime / bench.duration)

			-- 작업대에서 다같이 선물 포장하는 연출 (가운데에서 처리)
			if gift.progress > 0 and gift.level == bench_id then
				gift.level = bench_id + 0.1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gift_move_to, self,
						gift_id, gift.gift.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3))
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gnomes_delayed_animation, self,
						bench_id, 0.3, 'dance', 'idle', 'left'))
			elseif gift.progress > 0.5 and gift.level == bench_id + 0.1 then
				gift.level = bench_id + 0.2
				self:gift_level_up(gift_id)
			elseif gift.progress > 0.85 and gift.level == bench_id + 0.2 then
				gift.level = bench_id + 1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gift_move_to, self,
						gift_id, self.belt_table[bench.output].start_pos, 0.5))
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gnomes_delayed_animation, self,
						bench_id, 0.1, 'idle', 'idle', 'down'))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 작업대에 선입한 선물이 벨트로 나갈 준비가 되었는지 체크
function local_class:check_head_of_bench(bench_id)
	local t = self.bench_table[bench_id].gifts
	if t == nil then
		return
	end
	if #t < 1 then
		return
	end

	local gift_id = t[1]
	local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

	-- 선물의 진행도가 완료상태인지 체크
	if gift.progress >= 1 then
		-- 선물을 현재 작업대에서 제거
		table.remove(t, 1)

		-- 선물을 작업대의 아웃풋 벨트로 옮김

		self:enter_convairbelt(gift_id, bench_id + 1)
		--self:enter_convairbelt(gift_id, self.bench_table[bench_id].ouput_belt)

	end
end

-- 작업대에 선물이 들어가는 연출
function local_class:enter_workbench(gift_id, bench_id)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_wait

	-- 벨트에서 작업대로 이동하는 짧은 이동 연출
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_bench
	self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, 0)
	table.insert(self.bench_table[bench_id].gifts, gift_id)

	-- 노움들 선물 작업하는 연출
	for _, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
		character_util.set_anim(gnome, {name = 'attack'})
	end
end

function local_class:gnomes_delayed_animation(bench_id, delay, anim, emo, dir)
	wait_for_sec(delay)
	if self.is_playing_game and self.bench_table[bench_id].power then
		-- 노움들 선물 작업하는 연출
		character_util.set_direction(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[1], dir)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[1], {name = anim}, {name = emo})

	end
end

-- 작업대의 노움이 도망침
function local_class:bench_power_off(bench_id)

	-- 너구리를 피해 테이블 아래로 도망치는 연출
	local gnome = self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[1]
	--
	--character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
	--wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--
	--character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'up')
	--character_util.jump_move(gnome, vector_util.get_x0z(gnome.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 1.3), 0),
	--		2, 0.4, true, 'right')

	character_util.shake(gnome, 0.03, 9999)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'cast'}, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_emotion(gnome, {name = 'scared'})

	ui_quest_marker:AddCustomMarkerToIFO('workbench_' .. bench_id, self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[1], 'xm_ic_marker_panic.png')

	self.bench_table[bench_id].power = false
	self:belt_power_off(bench_id + 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_game_enemy_attack_01')
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.bench_power_off_alert_async, self,
			bench_id))

	self.bench_table[bench_id].table.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:bench_power_off_alert_async(bench_id)
	local timer = 0
	while not self.bench_table[bench_id].power do
		local wave = -math.cos(timer * 4 * math.pi) + 0.5
		self:bench_color_tint(bench_id, unity_color({ 1, wave, wave, 1 }))
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	self:bench_color_tint(bench_id, unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }))
end

-- 작업대의 노움들이 잠에서 깸
function local_class:bench_power_on(bench_id)
	self.bench_table[bench_id].table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_dummy_02')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, {name = 'attack'})
	self.bench_table[bench_id].table:Shake(0.3, 0.2)

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('workbench_' .. bench_id)

	-- 정신차리고 다시 일로 복귀하는 연출
	local gnome = self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[1]

	character_util.stop_shake(gnome)
	character_util.normal_jump(gnome)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gnome)

	if #self.bench_table[bench_id].gifts > 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'dance'}, {name = 'idle'})
	else
		character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'down')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
	end

	self.bench_table[bench_id].power = true
	self:belt_power_on(bench_id + 1)
end

function local_class:bench_power_init(bench_id)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('workbench_' .. bench_id)
	local gnome = self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes[1]
	character_util.set_position(gnome, self.bench_table[bench_id].gnome_init_pos)
	character_util.stop_shake(gnome)
	character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
	self.bench_table[bench_id].table.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	self.bench_table[bench_id].power = true
	self:bench_color_tint(bench_id, unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }))
	self:belt_power_on(bench_id + 1)
end

function local_class:bench_color_tint(bench_id, color)
	local table = self.bench_table[bench_id].table
	local renderer = table:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.MeshRenderer))

	local mat = renderer.material
	mat.shader = CS.UnityEngine.Shader.Find('Unlit/Texture Tint')
	mat.color = color
end

-- 컨베이어 벨트 목록에 벨트 추가
-- TODO: 지금은 받는 인자가 오른쪽으로 고정인데, 벨트별로 방향 다른 경우가 있다면 유동적으로 바꿔야 함. 근데 그런 일이 없을 수도 있다.
function local_class:generate_belt(index, direction, length)
	if self.belt_table[index] == nil then
		self.belt_table[index] = {
			gifts = {},
			segments = {},
			start_pos = vector(0,0,0),
			direction = direction,
			duration = length / self.constants.belt_speed,
			power = true
		}

		-- 벨트 마디에 해당하는 핸들네임 찾아서 segments에 추가
		for i = 1, length do
			table.insert(self.belt_table[index].segments,
					get_field_object(self.constants.convair_belt_name .. index .. '_' .. i))
		end

		self.belt_table[index].start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.belt_table[index].segments[1].Position, 0.7)
	end
end

-- 벨트에 배치된 선물들 일괄적으로 진행
function local_class:gift_progress_on_belt(belt_id)
	local belt = self.belt_table[belt_id]
	if not belt.power then
		return
	end
	for index, gift_id in ipairs(belt.gifts) do
		local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

		if gift == nil then
			return
		end

		if belt_id <= self.constants.workbench_count then
			if not self.bench_table[belt_id].power or #self.bench_table[belt_id].gifts > 0 then
				if (1 - gift.progress) * belt.duration > index * 0.25 then
					self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, gift.progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime / belt.duration)
					self:gift_set_position(gift_id, belt.start_pos + self.constants.belt_speed * belt.direction * gift.progress * belt.duration)
				end
			else
				self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, gift.progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime / belt.duration)
				self:gift_set_position(gift_id, belt.start_pos + self.constants.belt_speed * belt.direction * gift.progress * belt.duration)
			end
		else
			self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, gift.progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime / belt.duration)
			self:gift_set_position(gift_id, belt.start_pos + self.constants.belt_speed * belt.direction * gift.progress * belt.duration)
		end
	end
end

-- 벨트에 선입한 선물이 작업대로 나갈 준비가 되었는지 체크
function local_class:check_head_of_belt(belt_id)
	local bt = self.belt_table[belt_id].gifts
	if bt == nil then
		return
	end
	if #bt < 1 then
		return
	end

	local gift_id = bt[1]

	-- 선물의 진행도가 완료상태인지 체크
	if self.gift_table[gift_id].progress >= 1 then
		-- 선물을 현재 벨트에서 제거
		table.remove(bt, 1)

		if belt_id > self.constants.workbench_count then
			-- 선물을 운송 카트로 옮김
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gift_finished, self,
					gift_id))
		else
			-- 선물을 작업대로 옮김
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_workbench, self,
					gift_id, belt_id))
		end
		--self:enter_workbench(gift_id, self.belt_table[belt_id].ouput_belt)
	end
end

-- 운송 카트에 담겨지는 선물
function local_class:gift_finished(gift_id)
	table.insert(self.gift_done, gift_id)
	self:gift_set_position(gift_id,
			vector(38.75 + math.floor((#self.gift_done - 1) / 4) / 2, 1, 121.25 - ((#self.gift_done - 1) % 4) / 2))

	self:update_bakery_gift_count()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_02')
end

-- 컨베이어 벨트에 선물 올라가는 연출
function local_class:enter_convairbelt(gift_id, belt_id)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_belt
	-- 선물의 진행도 초기화
	self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, 0)

	table.insert(self.belt_table[belt_id].gifts, gift_id)
end

-- 벨트의 전원이 차단됨
function local_class:belt_power_off(belt_id)
	self.belt_table[belt_id].power = false
	for _, seg in ipairs(self.belt_table[belt_id].segments) do
		local animator = seg:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator.speed = 0
	end
end

-- 벨트의 전원이 켜짐
function local_class:belt_power_on(belt_id)
	self.belt_table[belt_id].power = true
	for _, seg in ipairs(self.belt_table[belt_id].segments) do
		local animator = seg:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling')
		animator.speed = self.constants.belt_speed * 1.5
	end
end

-- 선물 아이템 템플릿 생성해서 목록에 추가
function local_class:generate_gift()
	local random = random_util.get_random_int(1, #self.constants.original_item_id)
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = self.optimized_gift_npc.Position,
											 target = self.belt_table[1].start_pos,
	                                         itemid = self.constants.original_item_id[random],
	                                         skip_item_text = true, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
	item:SetSortingLayer(true)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.optimized_gift_npc, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', loop = false, parent = self.optimized_gift_npc})

	self.gift_table[self.gift_count] = {
		-- 보여지는 드롭아이템
		gift = item,
		-- 현재 아이템의 상태
		-- 벨트 위/ 작업대 위/ 이동 연출중/ 도난당하는 중/ 카트에 담김
		state = self.gift_enum.on_wait,
		-- 현재 아이템의 단계
		level = 1,
		-- 현재 아이템 스텝의 진행도
		progress = 0
	}
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	while self.is_pause do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	self:enter_convairbelt(self.gift_count, 1)

	self.gift_count = self.gift_count + 1
end

function local_class:gift_move_to(gift_id, pos, duration)
	local timer = 0
	local init_pos = self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position
	while timer < duration and self.is_playing_game do
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(init_pos, pos, timer / duration)
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position = lerp_pos
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, 0.7)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 선물 아이템 위치 설정
function local_class:gift_set_position(gift_id, pos)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, 0.7)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, 0.6)
end

-- 선물 아이템 현재 진행도 설정 (0~1, 1이 되면 다음 위치로 이동할 준비가 끝남)
function local_class:gift_set_progress(gift_id, progress)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].progress = progress
end

function local_class:gift_add_progress(gift_id, addition)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].progress = self.gift_table[gift_id].progress + addition
end

-- 선물의 포장 단계를 한 단계 올리고 아이템을 변경한다.
function local_class:gift_level_up(gift_id)
	local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

	if gift.level < 4 then
		self:gift_item_change(gift_id, self.constants.gift_item_id[math.floor(gift.level)])
	else
		CS.Debug.LogError('Cannot Level up more! Something gone wrong!')
	end
end

-- 선물 아이템 변경
function local_class:gift_item_change(gift_id, item_id)
	local pos = vector(0,0,0)
	if self.gift_table[gift_id] ~= nil then
		if self.gift_table[gift_id].gift ~= nil then
			pos = self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:ConsumeComplete()
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = nil
		end
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = pos, itemid = item_id,
		                                                            skip_item_text = true, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:SetSortingLayer(true)
	end
end

-- 선물 id로 목록에서 제거(도난당해 게임 내에서 제거될 때 호출)
function local_class:dispose_gift_by_index(gift_id)
	if self.gift_table[gift_id] ~= nil then
		if self.gift_table[gift_id].gift ~= nil then
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:ConsumeComplete()
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = nil
		end

		self.gift_table[gift_id] = nil

		for belt_id, _ in ipairs(self.belt_table) do
			local belt = self.belt_table[belt_id]

			for belt_gift_id, gift_id_belt in ipairs(belt.gifts) do
				if gift_id_belt == gift_id then
					table.remove(belt.gifts, belt_gift_id)

					break
				end
			end
		end

		for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
			local bench = self.bench_table[bench_id]

			for bench_gift_id, gift_id_bench in ipairs(bench.gifts) do
				if gift_id_bench == gift_id then
					table.remove(bench.gifts, bench_gift_id)

					break
				end
			end
		end


	end
end

-- 게임 종료시 선물 목록 일괄 초기화
function local_class:dispose_gift_table()
	for gift_id, _ in pairs(self.gift_table) do
		if self.gift_table[gift_id] ~= nil then
			if self.gift_table[gift_id].gift ~= nil then
				self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:ConsumeComplete()
				self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = nil
			end
		end
		self.gift_table[gift_id] = nil
	end

	self.gift_table = {}

	self.gift_done = {}

	for _, bench in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
		bench.gifts = {}
	end

	for _, belt in ipairs(self.belt_table) do
		belt.gifts = {}
	end

end

-- 프로젝타일 체크를 위해 플레이어가 발사한 프로젝타일의 궤적을 따라가는 Virtual FieldObject 추가하고 충돌했는지 확인
function local_class:instantiate_virtual_obj(dir)
	if self.is_projectile_shoot then
		return
	end

	self.is_projectile_shoot = true

	local virtual_obj = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	virtual_obj.Position = user_party_leader.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction).normalized * 0.2
	virtual_obj.Direction = dir
	virtual_obj.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.projectile_virtual_obj_list:Add(virtual_obj)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = self.projectile_life_time

	local move_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(virtual_obj.Direction).normalized

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		local next_pos = virtual_obj.Position + move_dir * unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.projectile_speed
		virtual_obj.Position = next_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.projectile_virtual_obj_list:Remove(virtual_obj)

	self.is_projectile_shoot = false

	virtual_obj:Dispose()
end

-- 매드 팬더 전체 행동 제어
function local_class:control_mad_panda()
	local panda_timer = 0

	local cur_mad_panda_upper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local saved_mad_panda_upper_state_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)

	local cur_mad_panda_lower_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local saved_mad_panda_lower_state_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)

	-- TODO: 너구리 교체 플래그
	-- 미니게임이 방식이 변경되면 제거될 수 있음
	local remove_level_1_upper_mad_panda = false
	local remove_level_2_upper_mad_panda = false
	local remove_level_1_lower_mad_panda = false
	local remove_level_2_lower_mad_panda = false

	local start_mad_panda_upper_index = 0
	local start_mad_panda_lower_index = 0

	-- 매드 팬더 상태 설정
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_upper_list.Count -1 do
		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.respawn
		saved_mad_panda_upper_state_list:Add(self.mad_panda_upper_state.none)
	end

	cur_mad_panda_upper_list:Add(self.mad_panda_upper_list[self.game_level])

	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_lower_list.Count -1 do
		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.respawn
		saved_mad_panda_lower_state_list:Add(self.mad_panda_lower_state.none)
	end

	cur_mad_panda_lower_list:Add(self.mad_panda_lower_list[self.game_level])

	-- 매드 팬더 활동까지 잠시 대기
	wait_for_sec(self.constants.mad_panda_active_duration)

	while self.is_playing_game do
		for i = start_mad_panda_upper_index, cur_mad_panda_upper_list.Count - 1 do
			-- 기존 스테이트와 현재 스테이트가 다른 경우 신규 스테이트를 실행한다
			if saved_mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] then
				-- 기존 스테이트 정보 업데이트
				saved_mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i]

				if self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.respawn then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_respawn, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.enter_field then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_enter_field, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.idle then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_idle, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_random then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_move_random, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_belt then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_move_belt, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_steal, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal_finished then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_steal_finished, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.dead then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.upper_mad_panda_dead, self, i))

					-- TODO: 레벨이 오르고 기존 너구리가 죽은 경우, 너구리를 변경한다.
					--if self.game_level == 1 and not remove_level_1_upper_mad_panda then
					--	remove_level_1_upper_mad_panda = true
					--
					--	start_mad_panda_upper_index = start_mad_panda_upper_index + 1
					--
					--	cur_mad_panda_upper_list:Add(self.mad_panda_upper_list[self.game_level])
					--elseif self.game_level == 2 and not remove_level_2_upper_mad_panda then
					--	remove_level_2_upper_mad_panda = true
					--
					--	start_mad_panda_upper_index = start_mad_panda_upper_index + 1
					--
					--	cur_mad_panda_upper_list:Add(self.mad_panda_upper_list[self.game_level])
					--end
				end
			end
		end

		for i = start_mad_panda_lower_index, cur_mad_panda_lower_list.Count - 1 do
			-- 기존 스테이트와 현재 스테이트가 다른 경우 신규 스테이트를 실행한다
			if saved_mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] then
				-- 기존 스테이트 정보 업데이트
				saved_mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i]

				if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.respawn then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_respawn, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_idle, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_random then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_move_random, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_player then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_move_player, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_machine then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_move_machine, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_sing, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_faint, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.dead then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_dead, self, i))

					-- TODO: 레벨이 오르고 기존 너구리가 죽은 경우, 너구리를 변경한다.
					if self.game_level == 1 and not remove_level_1_lower_mad_panda then
						remove_level_1_lower_mad_panda = true

						start_mad_panda_lower_index = start_mad_panda_lower_index + 1

						cur_mad_panda_lower_list:Add(self.mad_panda_lower_list[self.game_level])
					elseif self.game_level == 2 and not remove_level_2_lower_mad_panda then
						remove_level_2_lower_mad_panda = true

						start_mad_panda_lower_index = start_mad_panda_lower_index + 1

						cur_mad_panda_lower_list:Add(self.mad_panda_lower_list[self.game_level])
					end
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.hit then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_hit, self, i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
							util.cs_generator(self.lower_mad_panda_evasion, self, i))
				end
			end
		end

		panda_timer = panda_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.game_level == 0 and panda_timer >= self.constants.level_up_duration_1 then
			self.game_level = 1
			-- TODO: 판다 수를 늘려야 되면 여기서 진행하면 됨
			--cur_mad_panda_upper_list:Add(self.mad_panda_upper_list[1])

			self.game_level = 2
			-- TODO: 판다 수를 늘려야 되면 여기서 진행하면 됨
			--cur_mad_panda_lower_list:Add(self.mad_panda_lower_list[1])
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 카메라 밖에서 생성되어 대기하는 연출
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_respawn(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Respawn')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]

	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	local x_limit_left = self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_left + cam_half_width
	local x_limit_right = self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_right - cam_half_width

	local cur_pos
	local cur_pos_x

	if camera_pos.x < x_limit_left then
		-- 카메라가 너무 왼쪽에 있어서 오른쪽에서만 너구리 생성해야 하는 경우
		cur_pos_x = camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + 1
	elseif camera_pos.x > x_limit_right then
		-- 카메라가 너무 오른쪽에 있어서 왼쪽에서만 너구리 생성해야 하는 경우
		cur_pos_x = camera_pos.x - cam_half_width - 1
	else
		local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))

		if rand == 0 then
			cur_pos_x = camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + 1
		else
			cur_pos_x = camera_pos.x - cam_half_width - 1
		end
	end

	cur_pos = vector(cur_pos_x, 0, self.constants.upper_mad_panda_pos_z)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_active_state(mad_panda, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

	if camera_pos.x - mad_panda.Position.x >= 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'left')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.enter_field
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 화면 안으로 걸어오는 연출
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_enter_field(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Enter Field')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]
	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	-- 너무 오랫동안 카메라에 들어오지 않으면 그냥 활동 개시
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	-- 카메라 안에 들어올 때까지 카메라 방향으로 이동한다.
	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < self.constants.upper_mad_panda_camera_move_limit_duration and
			not self:check_character_in_camera(mad_panda) and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.enter_field do
		local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition
		local dist = camera_pos.x - mad_panda.Position.x

		if dist >= 0 then
			character_util.set_position(mad_panda,
					mad_panda.Position + vector(speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0, 0))
		else
			character_util.set_position(mad_panda,
					mad_panda.Position + vector(-speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0, 0))
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.enter_field then
		mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.idle
	end
end

-- 카메라 화면에 해당 캐릭터가 잡혔는지 확인, y축은 무시함
function local_class:check_character_in_camera(character)
	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth

	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	if character.Position.x < camera_pos.x + cam_half_width and
			character.Position.x > camera_pos.x - cam_half_width and
			character.Position.z < camera_pos.z + cam_half_height and
			character.Position.z > camera_pos.z - cam_half_height then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 정지 상태, 잠시 대기 후 이동 상태로 변환됨
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_idle(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Idle')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]

	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'down')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local idle_duration = 0.3

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < idle_duration and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.idle do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.idle then
		local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))

		if rand == 0 then
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_random
		else
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_belt
		end
	end
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 랜덤 이동
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_move_random(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Move Random')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	local dir = {
		right = 0,
		left = 1,
	}

	local dir_move_vec = { vector(1, 0, 0), vector(-1, 0, 0) }

	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	-- 움직일 시간 랜덤 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = unity_class.random.Range(
			self.constants.mad_panda_random_move_duration_min, self.constants.mad_panda_random_move_duration_max)

	-- 매드 팬더 방향 랜덤 설정
	local cur_dir

	-- 이동 가능 범위 체크해서 이동 방향 설정
	if mad_panda.Position.x - speed * move_duration < self.constants.mad_panda_move_x_limit_left then
		cur_dir = 0
	elseif mad_panda.Position.x + speed * move_duration > self.constants.mad_panda_move_x_limit_right then
		cur_dir = 1
	else
		cur_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
	end

	if cur_dir == dir.left then
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'left')
	elseif cur_dir == dir.right then
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'right')
	end

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_random do
		local cur_pos = mad_panda.Position + dir_move_vec[cur_dir + 1] * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

		-- 이동 불가능 할 경우 경로 이동 중단
		if not field:IsThereFloorAt(cur_pos) then
			break
		else
			character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_random then
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.idle
	end
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 벨트 특정 위치로 이동
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_move_belt(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Belt')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	local cur_marker_name
	local shortest_dist = 999

	for i = 0, self.steal_marker_name_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.steal_marker_name_list[i])
		local cur_dist = (mad_panda.Position - cur_marker.position).magnitude

		if cur_dist < shortest_dist then
			cur_marker_name = self.steal_marker_name_list[i]
			shortest_dist = cur_dist
		end
	end

	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	-- 움직일 시간 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = shortest_dist / speed

	local end_pos = field:GetMarker(cur_marker_name).position

	-- 매드 팬더 방향 설정
	local cur_dir = ((field:GetMarker(cur_marker_name).position - mad_panda.Position).normalized):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, cur_dir)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_belt do
		local cur_pos = mad_panda.Position +
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(mad_panda.Direction) * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.move_belt then
		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal
	end
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 선물 훔치기 위해 아래로 점프해서 이동 후, 선물이 올 때까지 일정 시간 대기
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_steal(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Steal')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]

	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'down')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local wait_duration = self.constants.upper_mad_panda_wait_for_gift_duration
	local start_pos = mad_panda.Position
	local end_pos = start_pos + vector(0, 0.6, -1.5)
	local jump_duration = 0.5
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'get' })
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	-- 벨트에 올라타기 시도
	character_util.jump(mad_panda, 1, jump_duration)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < jump_duration and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / jump_duration)

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] ~= self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal then
		return
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local stealed_gift_id = -1

	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'angry' })
	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration and stealed_gift_id == -1 and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal do
		-- 선물 리스트가 근접했으면 훔치는 state로 이동함
		for belt_id, _ in ipairs(self.belt_table) do
			local belt = self.belt_table[belt_id]

			for _, gift_id in ipairs(belt.gifts) do
				local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]
				-- X축 좌표만 계산
				if math.abs(gift.gift.Position.x - mad_panda.Position.x) < self.constants.upper_mad_panda_gift_dist_limit then
					stealed_gift_id = gift_id

					break
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal then
		if stealed_gift_id ~= -1 then
			character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_emotion(mad_panda, { name = 'doyagao' })

			cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			wait_duration = 0.2

			while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_bomb_01', loop = false, parent = mad_panda})
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_explosion_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

			self:dispose_gift_by_index(stealed_gift_id)
			self.lost_count = self.lost_count + 1
			self:update_bakery_lost_count()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')

			cur_time = unity_class.time.time
			wait_duration = 1

			character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'eat' })
			while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < wait_duration do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
			character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)
		end

		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal_finished
	end
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 선물 훔치기 종료되어 원위치로 돌아감
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_steal_finished(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Steal Finished')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]


	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	local start_pos = mad_panda.Position
	local end_pos = mad_panda.Position + vector(0, -0.6, 1.5)
	local dist = (mad_panda.Position - end_pos).magnitude

	-- 움직일 시간 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local jump_duration = dist / speed

	-- 매드 팬더 방향 설정
	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'get' })
	character_util.jump(mad_panda, 1, jump_duration)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < jump_duration and
			self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal_finished do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / jump_duration)

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_upper_state.steal_finished then
		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.idle
	end
end

-- 상단 매드 팬더 프로젝타일 맞아서 데미지 입고 날아가는 연출
function local_class:upper_mad_panda_dead(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Upper Dead')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_upper_list[index]

	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(mad_panda, 10000, unity_class.color.red, mad_panda.Position)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.air_spin(mad_panda, { offset = vector(0, 0, 1), speed = 1.5, stay_time = 0.3 })
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_panda, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_duration)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		self.mad_panda_upper_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_upper_state.respawn
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 카메라 밖에서 생성되어 대기하는 연출
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_respawn(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Respawn')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	local x_limit_left = self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_left + cam_half_width
	local x_limit_right = self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_right - cam_half_width

	local cur_pos
	local cur_pos_x

	if camera_pos.x < x_limit_left then
		-- 카메라가 너무 왼쪽에 있어서 오른쪽에서만 너구리 생성해야 하는 경우
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(
				camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + 1, self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_right)

		cur_pos_x = rand_x
	elseif camera_pos.x > x_limit_right then
		-- 카메라가 너무 오른쪽에 있어서 왼쪽에서만 너구리 생성해야 하는 경우
		local rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(
				self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_left, camera_pos.x - cam_half_width - 1)

		cur_pos_x = rand_x
	else
		local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
		local rand_x

		if rand == 0 then
			rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(
					camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + 1, self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_right)
		else
			rand_x = unity_class.random.Range(
					self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_x_limit_left, camera_pos.x - cam_half_width - 1)
		end

		cur_pos_x = rand_x
	end

	cur_pos = vector(cur_pos_x, 0, self.constants.lower_mad_panda_pos_z)

	-- 회피 횟수 초기화
	self.mad_panda_evasion_list[index] = index

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_active_state(mad_panda, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

	if camera_pos.x - mad_panda.Position.x >= 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'right')
	else
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'left')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)
	character_util.spine_rotate(mad_panda, 0, 0)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 정지 상태, 잠시 대기 후 이동 상태로 변환됨
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_idle(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Idle')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	mad_panda.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)
	character_util.spine_rotate(mad_panda, 0, 0)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local idle_duration = 0.3

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < idle_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle do
		if self:check_evasion(mad_panda, index) then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 모든 벤치의 전원이 꺼져 있으면 move machine 상태로는 넘어가지 않는다.
	local rand_max = 3
	local all_off = true

	for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
		if self.bench_table[bench_id].power then
			all_off = false
		end
	end

	if all_off then
		rand_max = 2
	end

	if not self.is_playing_game or self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle then
		return
	end
	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)
	character_util.spine_rotate(mad_panda, 0, 0)

	mad_panda.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

	if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle then
		local rand = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, rand_max))

		if rand == 0 then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_random
		elseif rand == 1 then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_player
		else
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_machine
		end
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 랜덤 이동
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_move_random(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Move Random')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	local dir = {
		right = 0,
		left = 1,
	}

	local dir_move_vec = { vector(1, 0, 0), vector(-1, 0, 0) }

	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	-- 움직일 시간 랜덤 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = unity_class.random.Range(
			self.constants.mad_panda_random_move_duration_min, self.constants.mad_panda_random_move_duration_max)

	-- 매드 팬더 방향 랜덤 설정
	local cur_dir

	-- 이동 가능 범위 체크해서 이동 방향 설정
	if mad_panda.Position.x - speed * move_duration < self.constants.mad_panda_move_x_limit_left then
		cur_dir = 0
	elseif mad_panda.Position.x + speed * move_duration > self.constants.mad_panda_move_x_limit_right then
		cur_dir = 1
	else
		cur_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 2))
	end

	if cur_dir == dir.left then
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'left')
	elseif cur_dir == dir.right then
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'right')
	end

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_random do
		if self:check_evasion(mad_panda, index) then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion

			break
		else
			local cur_pos = mad_panda.Position + dir_move_vec[cur_dir + 1] * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

			-- 이동 불가능 할 경우 경로 이동 중단
			if not field:IsThereFloorAt(cur_pos) then
				break
			else
				character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_random then
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 플레이어 위치로 이동
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_move_player(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Move Player')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	local end_pos = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, mad_panda.Position.z)

	-- 움직일 시간 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = (mad_panda.Position - end_pos).magnitude / speed

	-- 매드 팬더 방향 설정
	local cur_dir = ((end_pos - mad_panda.Position).normalized):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, cur_dir)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_player do
		if self:check_evasion(mad_panda, index) then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion

			break
		else
			local cur_pos = mad_panda.Position +
					CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(mad_panda.Direction) * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

			character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_player then
		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 노래부르기 위해 엘프들 옆으로 이동
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_move_machine(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Move Machine')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	local cur_marker_name
	local shortest_dist = 999

	for i = 0, self.sing_marker_name_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.sing_marker_name_list[i])
		local cur_dist = (mad_panda.Position - cur_marker.position).magnitude

		local table_index = math.floor(i / 2)

		if self.bench_table[table_index + 1].power then
			if cur_dist < shortest_dist then
				cur_marker_name = self.sing_marker_name_list[i]
				shortest_dist = cur_dist
			end
		end
	end

	-- 이동 상태 진입했는데 1프레임 뒤 모든 전원이 꺼진 경우 에러 발생할 수 있어서 여기서 처리함
	if cur_marker_name == nil then
		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle

		return
	end

	local speed = self:get_mad_panda_speed()

	-- 움직일 시간 설정
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = shortest_dist / speed

	local end_pos = field:GetMarker(cur_marker_name).position

	-- 매드 팬더 방향 설정
	local cur_dir = ((field:GetMarker(cur_marker_name).position - mad_panda.Position).normalized):ToDirection()
	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, cur_dir)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_machine do
		if self:check_evasion(mad_panda, index) then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion

			break
		else
			local cur_pos = mad_panda.Position +
					CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(mad_panda.Direction) * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

			character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.move_machine then
		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, field:GetMarker(cur_marker_name).direction)
		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)

		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 노래부름
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_sing(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Sing')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local jump_duration = 0.5
	local jump_dist_x
	if mad_panda.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		jump_dist_x = 1
	else
		jump_dist_x = -1
	end
	local end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(mad_panda.Position + vector(jump_dist_x, 0, 1), 0.7)
	local start_pos = mad_panda.Position

	-- 작업대에 올라타기 시도
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, {name = 'get'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', loop = false, parent = mad_panda})
	character_util.jump(mad_panda, 1, jump_duration)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < jump_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / jump_duration)

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)

	local cur_table_index = -1
	-- 어떤 엘프들을 재울 지 알 수가 없어서 각 테이블 좌표를 가져온 뒤 가장 가까운 위치의 엘프들을 재우는 방식으로 처리
	local table_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	table_pos_list:Add(vector(10.5, 0, 119))
	table_pos_list:Add(vector(18.5, 0, 119))
	table_pos_list:Add(vector(28.5, 0, 119))

	local shortest_dist = 999

	for i = 0, table_pos_list.Count - 1 do
		local cur_dist = (mad_panda.Position - table_pos_list[i]).magnitude

		if cur_dist < shortest_dist then
			cur_table_index = i + 1
			shortest_dist = cur_dist
		end
	end

	if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing then

		if cur_table_index ~= -1 then
			self:bench_power_off(cur_table_index)
		end

	else
		return

	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local sing_duration = 1
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_panda, {name = 'mad'})
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, {name = 'attack2'})

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < sing_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing do

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing then
		return
	end

	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	jump_duration = 0.5

	end_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(mad_panda.Position + vector(-jump_dist_x, 0, -1), 0)
	start_pos = mad_panda.Position

	-- 작업대에서 뛰어내리기
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, {name = 'get'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', loop = false, parent = mad_panda})
	character_util.jump(mad_panda, 1, jump_duration)

	while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < jump_duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / jump_duration)

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing then
		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)

		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 프로젝타일 맞고 쓰러짐
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_faint(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Faint')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]
	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_trip_01')
	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(mad_panda.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_panda, { name = 'damaged' })

	-- TODO: 현재는 점프중인 상태를 전제로 y축 높이로 잡지만, 더 명확히 너구리가 작업대로 향하는지 판별할 수 있어야 함.
	if mad_panda.Position.y > 0.1 and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint then
		local shortest_marker
		local shortest_dist = 999

		for i = 0, self.sing_marker_name_list.Count - 1 do
			local cur_marker = field:GetMarker(self.sing_marker_name_list[i])
			local cur_dist = (mad_panda.Position - cur_marker.position).magnitude

			if cur_dist < shortest_dist then
				shortest_marker = cur_marker
				shortest_dist = cur_dist
			end
		end

		local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local start_pos = mad_panda.Position
		local end_pos = vector(start_pos.x, 0, shortest_marker.position.z)

		while self.is_playing_game and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < 0.2 do
			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / 0.2)

			character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, end_pos)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(mad_panda)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(mad_panda)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	end


	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = self.constants.mad_panda_revive_duration

	local air_spin = false

	local is_shake = false
	local shake_duration = duration * 2 / 3

	while not air_spin and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration and
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint do
		local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - mad_panda.Position).magnitude

		if dist < self.constants.mad_panda_air_spin_dist then
			air_spin = true
		end

		if not is_shake and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_duration then
			character_util.shake(mad_panda, 0.04, duration - shake_duration)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint then
		if air_spin then
			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.dead
		else
			mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_bubble_pop_01', loop = false, parent = mad_panda})
			character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
			character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)

			self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.idle
		end
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 쓰러진 상태에서 플레이어에게 맞고 날아감
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_dead(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Dead')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(mad_panda, 10000, unity_class.color.red, mad_panda.Position)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	local dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction)

	character_util.air_spin(mad_panda, { offset = dir, speed = 1.5, stay_time = 0.3 })
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_panda, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_duration)

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.dead then
		self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.respawn
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 플레이어와 충돌 후 폭발과 함께 사라짐
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_hit(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Hit')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]
	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')

	end
end

-- 하단 팬더 점프해서 projectile 피하는 이벤트
function local_class:lower_mad_panda_evasion(index)
	--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('Lower Evasion')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_lower_list[index]
	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', loop = false, parent = mad_panda})
	character_util.jump(mad_panda, 1.5, 0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion then
		mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	end
