-- 플레이어 위치 계산해서 매드 팬더와 부딪힌 경우 데미지 입고 잠시 정지
function local_class:control_player()
	while self.is_playing_game do
		for i = 0, self.mad_panda_lower_list.Count - 1 do
			local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - self.mad_panda_lower_list[i].Position).magnitude

			if dist < self.constants.player_game_over_dist and
					self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.respawn and
					self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_lower_state.sing and
					self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[i] < self.mad_panda_lower_state.faint then
				self.damage_count = self.damage_count + 1

				if self.damage_count >= self.damage_count_max then
					self.damage_count = 0

					coroutine.yield(self:player_respawn())

					break
				else
					coroutine.yield(self:player_damaged(i))
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 플레이어 데미지 입음
function local_class:player_damaged(mad_panda_index)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[mad_panda_index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.hit

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local damage_num = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.panda_damage_per

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = user_party_leader
	damage_info.target = user_party_leader
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(damage_num)
	damage_info.notMortal = true

	command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, mad_panda)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	local knockback_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(
			CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(user_party_leader.Direction))

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, knockback_dir,
			15000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, user_party_leader, knock_back_info, nil)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'prostrate' })
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.04, 1)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bubble_pop_01')
		character_util.mario_jump_new(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Direction)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	if self.is_playing_game then
		party_util.reset_controllers()

		-- 무적 시간 동안 깜박임
		for n = 0, 2 do
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party_leader, 0, 0.25)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party_leader, 1, 0.25)

			wait_for_sec(0.2)
		end
	end
end

-- 플레이어 리스폰
function local_class:player_respawn()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self.is_pause = true
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name .. '_gameover', false))

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(user_party_leader, 9999, unity_class.color.red, user_party_leader.Position)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	self:hide_bakery_timer_ui()

	self.is_gameover = true
	self.is_pause = false
end

-- 매드 팬더 속도 리턴
function local_class:get_mad_panda_speed()
	if self.game_level == 0 then
		return self.constants.mad_panda_speed_1
	elseif self.game_level == 1 then
		return self.constants.mad_panda_speed_2
	else
		return self.constants.mad_panda_speed_3
	end
end

-- 하단 매드 팬더 회피 확인 후 리턴
function local_class:check_evasion(mad_panda, index)
	local enter_evade = false

	-- 프로젝타일이 근접한 상황에서 evasion 횟수가 남아 있으면, 팬더는 Evasion State로 바뀜
	for i = 0, self.projectile_virtual_obj_list.Count - 1 do
		local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.projectile_virtual_obj_list[i].Position, self.projectile_hitbox)

		local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bounds,
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self.projectile_virtual_obj_list[i].Direction) * 1.5)

		for ii = 0, list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(list[ii], mad_panda) then
				--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('너구리 Projectile에 근접함 / 남은 회피 횟수 : '..self.mad_panda_evasion_list[index])

				-- 횟수 계산
				if self.mad_panda_evasion_list[index] > 0 then
					enter_evade = true

					self.mad_panda_lower_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_lower_state.evasion

					self.mad_panda_evasion_list[index] = self.mad_panda_evasion_list[index] - 1

					break
				end
			end
		end

		list:Dispose()

		if enter_evade then
			self.projectile_virtual_obj_list:RemoveAt(i)

			break
		end
	end

	return enter_evade
end

-- 카메라 세팅
function local_class:set_camera()
	camera_util.move(vector(user_party_leader.Position.x, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z + 1.5),
			0, { ignorecameragrids = true })
end

-- 시간이 다 되서 게임이 종료된 경우, screen fade 등 처리
function local_class:time_out(is_success)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 퀘스트 마커 제거
	for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
		self:bench_power_init(bench_id)
	end

	self:hide_bakery_timer_ui()

	if self.constants.show_mini_game_ending then
		camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)

		local dist = math.floor(user_party_leader.Position.x - 39.5)

		if dist >= 1 then
			camera_util.move_async(vector(39.5, 0, 121.5), dist / 6, { ignorecameragrids = true })
		else
			camera_util.move_async(vector(39.5, 0, 121.5), 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
		end

		-- 이펙트
		if is_success then
			character_util.set_anim(self.ru, { name = 'nod' })

			character_util.set_anim(self.minigame_check_elf, { name = 'clap' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.minigame_check_elf, { name = 'smile' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_15', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_anim(self.ru)

			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

			-- 승리시의 BGM 처리
			camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.1)
		else
			character_util.set_anim(self.ru, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.ru, { name = 'attack' })

			character_util.set_emotion(self.minigame_check_elf, { name = 'attack' })

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ru, { key = 'christmas_main_s5_16', skip = true })

			character_util.set_anim(self.minigame_check_elf, { name = 'unique/factory_fail', loop = false })
		end

		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(1, 'linear')

		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.ru)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.ru)

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
		character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

		character_util.remove_anim(self.minigame_check_elf)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.minigame_check_elf)
	end

end

-- 게임 종료 시 매드 팬더 관련 변수 일괄 초기화
function local_class:dispose_mad_panda()
	self.sing_marker_name_list = nil
	self.steal_marker_name_list = nil

	self.mad_panda_list = nil
	self.mad_panda_state_list = nil
	self.mad_panda_evasion_list = nil

	self.projectile_virtual_obj_list = nil

	self.projectile_hitbox = nil
end

-----------------------------
-- 타이머 및 선물 UI 관련 함수
-----------------------------

-- UI 생성
function local_class:load_bakery_timer_ui()
	-- 리소스 홀더가 없는상태라면 할당
	if is_unity_null(self.ui_holder) then
		self.ui_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

				'ondemand/xmas/ui', 'XMasBreadMiniGame', stage.UIRoot.transform)

	end

-- UI 시간값 갱신
function local_class:update_bakery_timer(time)
	if self.ui_cache ~= nil then
		local label = self.ui_cache:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.XMasBreadMiniGame))

		local time_string = math.floor(time)

		-- TODO: string 스태틱 데이터 페치해서 받아와야함
		label:SetTimeLabel(game_string:GetString('xmas_comic_bakery_countdown_timer_label'), time_string)
	end

-- UI 완료된 선물 개수 갱신
function local_class:update_bakery_gift_count(num)

		end
	end

-- UI 빼앗긴 선물 개수 갱신

	if self.ui_cache ~= nil then
		local label = self.ui_cache:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.XMasBreadMiniGame))

		else

		end
	end

end

	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.ui_cache) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ui_cache.gameObject)
	end
	self.ui_cache = nil
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end

		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then

	end

	-- Constants Data 로드

	local constant_class = require('minigame/XMasComicBakery/XMasComicBakeryConstants')
	if constant_class == nil then
		-- 오류 뱉어냄
		return
	end

	self.constants = constant_class.default
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	party_util.align_party(vector(7, 0, 120.5), 'left', 0, 'linear')

	-- 벤치 및 벨트 테이블에 등록
	for i = 1, self.constants.workbench_count + 1 do
		self:generate_belt(i, vector(1, 0, 0), self.constants.convair_belt_lengths[i])
	end
	for i = 1, self.constants.workbench_count do
		self:generate_bench(i)
	end

	-- 플레이어 캐릭터 교체
	self:change_manual_character(self.shooter_name)

	-- 캐릭터 무적으로 설정
	character_util.set_immortal(user_party_leader, true)

	-- 매드 팬더 적으로 변경
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.mad_panda_list[i])
	end

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, vector(21.5, 0, 117))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'up')

	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	-- 불필요한 UI 끔
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)

	if CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 게임 진행
	self.is_playing_game = true

	yield_return_func(self.game_loop, self)

	self.is_playing_game = false

	-- Constants Data 제거
	self.constants = nil

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local is_success = self.fail_count < self.max_fail_count
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, is_success))

	for belt_id, _ in ipairs(self.belt_table) do
		self:belt_power_off(belt_id)
	end

-- 미니게임 진행
function local_class:game_loop()
	-- 매드 팬더 컨트롤
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.control_mad_panda, self))

	-- 플레이어 컨트롤
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.control_player, self))

	local timer = 0
	local gift_regen_timer = 0
	local gnome_sleep_timer = 10
	while timer < self.constants.time_limit do

		for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
			-- 작업대 위에 놓인 선물 진행
			self:gift_progress_on_bench(bench_id)
			-- 기계에 들어간 선물 대기 끝났는지 체크
			self:check_head_of_bench(bench_id)
		end

		for belt_id, _ in ipairs(self.belt_table) do
			-- 벨트 위에 놓인 선물 진행
			self:gift_progress_on_belt(belt_id)
			-- 벨트 끝에서 기계에 선물 들어가야 하는지 체크
			self:check_head_of_belt(belt_id)
		end

		-- 주기적으로 선물 아이템 생성
		if timer > gift_regen_timer then
			self:generate_gift()
			gift_regen_timer = gift_regen_timer + self.constants.regen_delay
		end

		-- 주기적으로 랜덤 작업대의 노움들이 잠듦
		if timer > gnome_sleep_timer then
			self:bench_power_off(random_util.get_random_int(1, self.constants.workbench_count))
			gnome_sleep_timer = gnome_sleep_timer + 10
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 미니게임 타임아웃시 처리

	for bench_id, _ in ipairs(self.bench_table) do
		self:bench_power_init(bench_id)
	end
end

-- 작업대 목록에 작업대 추가
function local_class:generate_bench(index)
	self.bench_table[index] = {
		gifts = {},
		gnomes = {},
		input = index,
		output = index + 1,
		duration = 3.5,
		power = true
	}

	-- 작업대에 할당된 노움들 목록에 추가
	for i = 1, 4 do
		table.insert(self.bench_table[index].gnomes,
				get_character(self.constants.workbench_name .. index .. '_' .. i))
	end

	self:bench_power_init(index)

	return self.bench_table[index]
end

-- 작업대에 배치된 선물들 순차적으로 진행
function local_class:gift_progress_on_bench(bench_id)
	local bench = self.bench_table[bench_id]
	if not bench.power then
		return
	end
	for _, gift_id in ipairs(bench.gifts) do

		self:gift_add_progress(gift_id, unity_class.time.deltaTime / bench.duration)

		local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

		-- 작업대에서 다같이 선물 포장하는 연출 (가운데에서 처리)
		if gift.progress > 0 and gift.level == bench_id then
			gift.level = bench_id + 0.1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gift_move_to, self,
					gift_id, gift.gift.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gnomes_delayed_animation, self,
					bench_id, 0.3, 'attack', 'idle'))
		elseif gift.progress > 0.5 and gift.level == bench_id + 0.1 then
			gift.level = bench_id + 0.2
			self:gift_level_up(gift_id)
		elseif gift.progress > 0.85 and gift.level == bench_id + 0.2 then
			gift.level = bench_id + 1
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gift_move_to, self,
					gift_id, self.belt_table[bench.output].start_pos, 0.5))
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gnomes_delayed_animation, self,
					bench_id, 0.1, 'idle', 'idle'))
		end

	end
end

-- 작업대에 선입한 선물이 벨트로 나갈 준비가 되었는지 체크
function local_class:check_head_of_bench(bench_id)
	local t = self.bench_table[bench_id].gifts
	if t == nil then
		return
	end
	if #t < 1 then
		return
	end

	local gift_id = t[1]
	local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

	-- 선물의 진행도가 완료상태인지 체크
	if gift.progress >= 1 then
		-- 선물을 현재 작업대에서 제거
		table.remove(t, 1)

		-- 선물을 작업대의 아웃풋 벨트로 옮김

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_convairbelt, self,
				gift_id, bench_id + 1))
		--self:enter_convairbelt(gift_id, self.bench_table[bench_id].ouput_belt)

	end
end

-- 작업대에 선물이 들어가는 연출
function local_class:enter_workbench(gift_id, bench_id)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_wait

	-- 벨트에서 작업대로 이동하는 짧은 이동 연출
	coroutine.yield(nil)


	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_bench
	self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, 0)
	table.insert(self.bench_table[bench_id].gifts, gift_id)

	-- 노움들 선물 작업하는 연출
	for _, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
		character_util.set_anim(gnome, {name = 'attack'})
	end
end

function local_class:gnomes_delayed_animation(bench_id, delay, anim, emo)
	wait_for_sec(delay)
	if self.is_playing_game and self.bench_table[bench_id].power then
		-- 노움들 선물 작업하는 연출
		for _, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = anim}, {name = emo})
		end
	end
end

-- 작업대의 노움들이 졸기 시작함
function local_class:bench_power_off(bench_id)
	-- 앉아서 졸기 시작하는 연출
	local center = vector(0, 0, 2)
	for i, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'right')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'left')
		end
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'sleep'})
		character_util.add_listener(gnome, self.cs_controller)
		center = center + gnome.Position
	end
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('workbench_' .. bench_id, 60045, false, center / #self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes)
	self.bench_table[bench_id].power = false
	self:belt_power_off(bench_id + 1)
end

-- 작업대의 노움들이 잠에서 깸
function local_class:bench_power_on(bench_id)
	-- 졸다가 깨는 연출
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('workbench_' .. bench_id)
	for _, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
		character_util.normal_jump(gnome)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'surprise'})
		character_util.remove_relate_event(gnome, self.cs_controller)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	for i, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
		if i <= 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'down')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'up')
		end
		if #self.bench_table[bench_id].gifts > 0 then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'attack'}, {name = 'idle'})
		else
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
		end
	end
	self.bench_table[bench_id].power = true
	self:belt_power_on(bench_id + 1)
end

function local_class:bench_power_init(bench_id)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('workbench_' .. bench_id)
	for i, gnome in ipairs(self.bench_table[bench_id].gnomes) do
		if i <= 2 then
			character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'down')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'up')
		end
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(gnome, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.remove_relate_event(gnome, self.cs_controller)
	end
	self.bench_table[bench_id].power = true
	self:belt_power_on(bench_id + 1)
end

-- 컨베이어 벨트 목록에 벨트 추가
-- TODO: 지금은 받는 인자가 오른쪽으로 고정인데, 벨트별로 방향 다른 경우가 있다면 유동적으로 바꿔야 함. 근데 그런 일이 없을 수도 있다.
function local_class:generate_belt(index, direction, length)
	self.belt_table[index] = {
		gifts = {},
		segments = {},
		start_pos = vector(0,0,0),
		direction = direction,
		duration = length / 2,
		power = true
	}
	-- 벨트 마디에 해당하는 핸들네임 찾아서 segments에 추가
	for i = 1, length do
		table.insert(self.belt_table[index].segments,
				get_field_object(self.constants.convair_belt_name .. index .. '_' .. i))
	end

	self.belt_table[index].start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(self.belt_table[index].segments[1].Position, 0.7)
	self:belt_power_on(index)
end

-- 벨트에 배치된 선물들 일괄적으로 진행
function local_class:gift_progress_on_belt(belt_id)
	local belt = self.belt_table[belt_id]
	if not belt.power then
		return
	end
	for index, gift_id in ipairs(belt.gifts) do
		local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]
		if belt_id <= self.constants.workbench_count then
			if not self.bench_table[belt_id].power or #self.bench_table[belt_id].gifts > 0 then
				if (1 - gift.progress) * belt.duration > index * 0.25 then
					self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, gift.progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime / belt.duration)
					self:gift_set_position(gift_id, belt.start_pos + self.constants.belt_speed * belt.direction * gift.progress * belt.duration)
				end
			else
				self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, gift.progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime / belt.duration)
				self:gift_set_position(gift_id, belt.start_pos + self.constants.belt_speed * belt.direction * gift.progress * belt.duration)
			end
		else
			self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, gift.progress + unity_class.time.deltaTime / belt.duration)
			self:gift_set_position(gift_id, belt.start_pos + self.constants.belt_speed * belt.direction * gift.progress * belt.duration)
		end
	end
end

-- 벨트에 선입한 선물이 작업대로 나갈 준비가 되었는지 체크
function local_class:check_head_of_belt(belt_id)
	local bt = self.belt_table[belt_id].gifts
	if bt == nil then
		return
	end
	if #bt < 1 then
		return
	end

	local gift_id = bt[1]

	-- 선물의 진행도가 완료상태인지 체크
	if self.gift_table[gift_id].progress >= 1 then
		-- 선물을 현재 벨트에서 제거
		table.remove(bt, 1)

		if belt_id > self.constants.workbench_count then
			-- 선물을 운송 카트로 옮김
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.gift_finished, self,
					gift_id))
		else
			-- 선물을 작업대로 옮김
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_workbench, self,
					gift_id, belt_id))
		end
		--self:enter_workbench(gift_id, self.belt_table[belt_id].ouput_belt)
	end
end

-- 운송 카트에 담겨지는 선물
function local_class:gift_finished(gift_id)
	table.insert(self.gift_done, gift_id)
	self:gift_set_position(gift_id,
			vector(38.75 + math.floor((#self.gift_done - 1) / 4) / 2, 1, 121.25 - ((#self.gift_done - 1) % 4) / 2))
end

-- 컨베이어 벨트에 선물 올라가는 연출
function local_class:enter_convairbelt(gift_id, belt_id)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_wait

	-- 벨트에서 작업대로 이동하는 짧은 이동 연출
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.gift_table[gift_id].state = self.gift_enum.on_belt
	-- 선물의 진행도 초기화
	self:gift_set_progress(gift_id, 0)


	table.insert(self.belt_table[belt_id].gifts, gift_id)
end

-- 벨트의 전원이 차단됨
function local_class:belt_power_off(belt_id)
	self.belt_table[belt_id].power = false
	for _, seg in ipairs(self.belt_table[belt_id].segments) do
		local animator = seg:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator.speed = 0
	end
end

-- 벨트의 전원이 켜짐
function local_class:belt_power_on(belt_id)
	self.belt_table[belt_id].power = true
	for _, seg in ipairs(self.belt_table[belt_id].segments) do
		local animator = seg:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
		animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling')
		animator.speed = 3
	end
end

-- 선물 아이템 템플릿 생성해서 목록에 추가
function local_class:generate_gift()
	local random = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	local item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = self.belt_table[1].start_pos,
											 itemid = self.constants.original_item_id[random],
											 skip_item_text = true, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})

	self.gift_table[self.gift_count] = {
		-- 보여지는 드롭아이템
		gift = item,
		-- 현재 아이템의 상태
		-- 벨트 위/ 작업대 위/ 이동 연출중/ 도난당하는 중/ 카트에 담김
		state = self.gift_enum.on_wait,
		-- 현재 아이템의 단계
		level = 1,
		-- 현재 아이템 스텝의 진행도
		progress = 0
	}

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_convairbelt, self,
			self.gift_count, 1))

	self.gift_count = self.gift_count + 1
end

function local_class:gift_move_to(gift_id, pos, duration)
	local timer = 0
	local init_pos = self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position
	while timer < duration and self.is_playing_game do
		local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(init_pos, pos, timer / duration)
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position = lerp_pos
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, 0.7)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 선물 아이템 위치 설정
function local_class:gift_set_position(gift_id, pos)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, 0.7)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.ShadowTransform.position = vector_util.get_x0z(pos, 0.6)
end

-- 선물 아이템 현재 진행도 설정 (0~1, 1이 되면 다음 위치로 이동할 준비가 끝남)
function local_class:gift_set_progress(gift_id, progress)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].progress = progress
end

function local_class:gift_add_progress(gift_id, addition)
	self.gift_table[gift_id].progress = self.gift_table[gift_id].progress + addition
end

-- 선물의 포장 단계를 한 단계 올리고 아이템을 변경한다.
function local_class:gift_level_up(gift_id)
	local gift = self.gift_table[gift_id]

	if gift.level < 4 then
		self:gift_item_change(gift_id, self.constants.gift_item_id[math.floor(gift.level)])
	else
		CS.Debug.LogError('Cannot Level up more! Something gone wrong!')
	end
end

-- 선물 아이템 변경
function local_class:gift_item_change(gift_id, item_id)
	local pos = vector(0,0,0)
	if self.gift_table[gift_id] ~= nil then
		if self.gift_table[gift_id].gift ~= nil then
			pos = self.gift_table[gift_id].gift.Position
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:ConsumeComplete()
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = nil
		end
		self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = pos, itemid = item_id,
																	skip_item_text = true, notforinven = true, lootstate = "dontfindlooter"})
	end
end

-- 선물 id로 목록에서 제거(도난당해 게임 내에서 제거될 때 호출)
function local_class:dispose_gift_by_index(gift_id)
	if self.gift_table[gift_id] ~= nil then
		if self.gift_table[gift_id].gift ~= nil then
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:ConsumeComplete()
			self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = nil
		end
		table.remove(self.gift_table, gift_id)
	end
end

-- 게임 종료시 선물 목록 일괄 초기화
function local_class:dispose_gift_table()
	for gift_id, _ in pairs(self.gift_table) do
		if self.gift_table[gift_id] ~= nil then
			if self.gift_table[gift_id].gift ~= nil then
				self.gift_table[gift_id].gift:ConsumeComplete()
				self.gift_table[gift_id].gift = nil
			end
		end
		self.gift_table[gift_id] = nil
	end
	self.gift_table = nil
end

-- 플레이어 캐릭터 변경 및 파티 전체 비활성화
function local_class:change_manual_character(new_manual_character_name)
	self.saved_party_leader = user_party_leader
	local manual_character = get_character(new_manual_character_name)

	-- 레벨 업
	local exp = user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.Exp
	manual_character.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:SetExp(exp)

	-- 파티 리더 변경
	party_util.switch_leader(manual_character)

	character_util.set_direction(manual_character, self.saved_party_leader.Direction)

	-- 기존 캐릭터 보이지 않는 곳으로 이동
	character_util.set_position(self.saved_party_leader, vector(999, 0, 999))

	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
end

-- 프로젝타일 체크를 위해 플레이어가 발사한 프로젝타일의 궤적을 따라가는 Virtual FieldObject 추가하고 충돌했는지 확인
function local_class:instantiate_virtual_obj()
	if self.is_projectile_shoot then
		return
	end

	self.is_projectile_shoot = true

	local virtual_obj = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
	virtual_obj.Position = user_party_leader.Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction).normalized * 0.5
	virtual_obj.Direction = user_party_leader.Direction
	virtual_obj.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.projectile_virtual_obj_list:Add(virtual_obj)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local move_duration = self.projectile_life_time

	local move_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(virtual_obj.Direction).normalized
	local is_collided = false

	while not is_collided and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < move_duration do
		local next_pos = virtual_obj.Position + move_dir * unity_class.time.deltaTime * self.projectile_speed

		if field:IsThereFloorAt(next_pos) then
			virtual_obj.Position = next_pos
		else
			is_collided = true
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_projectile_shoot = false

	virtual_obj:Dispose()
end

-- 매드 팬더 전체 행동 제어
function local_class:control_mad_panda()
	local panda_timer = 0
	local is_panda_upgrade_1 = false
	local panda_upgrade_duration_1 = 20
	local is_panda_upgrade_2 = false
	local panda_upgrade_duration_2 = 40

	local cur_mad_panda_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	local saved_mad_panda_state_list = create_generic_list(CS.System.Single)

	-- 매드 팬더 상태 설정
	for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
		self.mad_panda_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_state.out_of_camera

		saved_mad_panda_state_list:Add(self.mad_panda_state.none)

		if i == 1 then
			self.mad_panda_evasion_list:Add(self.constants.mad_panda_evade_num_1)
		elseif i == 2 then
			self.mad_panda_evasion_list:Add(self.constants.mad_panda_evade_num_2)
		else
			self.mad_panda_evasion_list:Add(self.constants.mad_panda_evade_num_3)
		end
	end

	cur_mad_panda_list:Add(self.mad_panda_list[0])

	-- 매드 팬더 활동까지 잠시 대기
	wait_for_sec(self.constants.mad_panda_active_duration)

	while self.is_playing_game do
		for i = 0, cur_mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
			-- 기존 스테이트와 현재 스테이트가 다른 경우 특정 행동을 실행한다
			if saved_mad_panda_state_list[i] ~= self.mad_panda_state_list[i] then
				-- 기존 스테이트 정보 업데이트
				local evade_saved = saved_mad_panda_state_list[i]
				saved_mad_panda_state_list[i] = self.mad_panda_state_list[i]

				if self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.out_of_camera then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_out_of_camera(i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.enter_field then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_enter_field(i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.walk_normal then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_walk_normal(i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.damaged then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_damaged(i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.air_spin then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_air_spin(i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.wait_for_respawn then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_wait_for_respawn(i))
				elseif self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.evasion then
					coroutine.yield(self:mad_panda_evasion(i, evade_saved))
				end
			end
		end

		panda_timer = panda_timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not is_panda_upgrade_1 and panda_timer >= panda_upgrade_duration_1 then
			is_panda_upgrade_1 = true

			cur_mad_panda_list:Add(self.mad_panda_list[1])
		elseif not is_panda_upgrade_2 and panda_timer >= panda_upgrade_duration_2 then
			is_panda_upgrade_2 = true

			cur_mad_panda_list:Add(self.mad_panda_list[2])
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 매드 팬더 카메라 밖에서 생성되어 대기하는 연출
function local_class:mad_panda_out_of_camera(index)
	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]

	local cam_half_height = stage_camera.Size
	local cam_half_width = stage_camera.HalfWidth
	local camera_pos = stage_camera.LookAtPosition

	local z_up = 123
	local z_down = 118

	local x_limit_left = 4 + cam_half_width
	local x_limit_right = 42 - cam_half_width

	local cur_pos
	local cur_pos_x
	local cur_pox_z

	if camera_pos.x < x_limit_left then
		-- 카메라가 너무 왼쪽에 있어서 오른쪽에서만 너구리 생성해야 하는 경우
		cur_pos_x = camera_pos.x + cam_half_width + 1
	end

	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, camera_pos + vector(cur_x, 10, cur_z), true)

	local fall_duration = 1

	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_duration, mad_panda.Position.y, 0)

	local start_pos = mad_panda.Position

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_duration do
		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(mad_panda, vector(start_pos.x, start_pos.y +  dist_y, start_pos.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, vector(mad_panda.Position.x, 0, mad_panda.Position.z))

-- 매드 팬더 화면 안으로 걸어오는 연출
function local_class:mad_panda_enter_field(index)
	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]

	coroutine.yield(nil)

-- 매드 팬더 평범하게 걸어다니는 연출
-- 그냥 랜덤 이동
-- TODO: 이동 로직 추가해야 함
function local_class:mad_panda_walk_normal(index)
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('walk_normal')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]

	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'walk' })

	local dir = {
		up = 0,
		right = 1,
		down = 2,
		left = 3,
	}

	local dir_move_vec = { vector(0, 0, 1), vector(1, 0, 0),
	                       vector(0, 0, -1), vector(-1, 0, 0) }

	local speed = self.constants.mad_panda_speed_1

	local timer = 0

	-- 매드 팬더 방향
	local cur_dir = 0

	-- 움직일 시간
	local move_duration = 0

	while self.is_playing_game and self.mad_panda_state_list[index] == self.mad_panda_state.walk_normal do
		local enter_evade = false

		-- 프로젝타일이 근접한 상황에서 일정 확률로 팬더는 Evasion State로 바뀜
		for i = 0, self.projectile_virtual_obj_list.Count - 1 do
			local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(self.projectile_virtual_obj_list[i].Position, self.projectile_hitbox)

			local list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(bounds,
					CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self.projectile_virtual_obj_list[i].Direction) * 0.5)

			for ii = 0, list.Count - 1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(list[ii], mad_panda) then
					-- 확률로 피함
					local rand_evade = unity_class.random.Range(0, 1)

					if rand_evade < self.constants.mad_panda_evade_per_3 then
						-- 횟수 계산
						if self.mad_panda_evasion_cooltime_list[index] > 0 then
							enter_evade = true

							self.mad_panda_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_state.evasion

							self.mad_panda_evasion_cooltime_list[index] = self.mad_panda_evasion_cooltime_list[index] - 1

							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			list:Dispose()

			if enter_evade then
				self.projectile_virtual_obj_list:RemoveAt(i)

				break
			end
		end

		if not enter_evade then
			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if timer >= move_duration then
				timer = 0

				cur_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 4))

				-- 방향 설정
				if cur_dir == dir.up then
					character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'up')
				elseif cur_dir == dir.down then
					character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'down')
				elseif cur_dir == dir.left then
					character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'left')
				elseif cur_dir == dir.right then
					character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, 'right')
				end

				-- 움직일 시간 랜덤 설정
				move_duration = unity_class.random.Range(0.5, 5.5)
			end

			local cur_pos = mad_panda.Position + dir_move_vec[cur_dir + 1] * unity_class.time.deltaTime * speed

			-- 이동 불가능 할 경우 경로 이동 중단
			if not field:IsThereFloorAt(cur_pos) then
				timer = 999
			else
				character_util.set_position(mad_panda, cur_pos)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 팬더 점프해서 projectile 피하는 이벤트
function local_class:mad_panda_evasion(index, past_state)
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('evasion')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]
	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.jump(mad_panda, 1.5, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.mad_panda_state_list[index] = past_state
end

-- 팬더 프로젝타일 맞고 데미지 입은 상태
function local_class:mad_panda_damaged(index)
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('damaged')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]
	mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_direction(mad_panda, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(mad_panda.Direction))
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'prostrate' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mad_panda, { name = 'damaged' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = self.constants.mad_panda_revive_duration

	local air_spin = false

	local is_shake = false
	local shake_duration = duration * 2 / 3

	while not air_spin and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - mad_panda.Position).magnitude

		if dist < self.constants.mad_panda_air_spin_dist then
			air_spin = true
		end

		if not is_shake and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shake_duration then
			character_util.shake(mad_panda, 0.04, duration - shake_duration)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if air_spin then
		self.mad_panda_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_state.air_spin
	else
		self.mad_panda_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_state.walk_normal
		mad_panda.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
		character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)
	end
end

-- 팬더 에어 스핀
function local_class:mad_panda_air_spin(index)
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('air_spin')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]

	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(mad_panda, 10000, unity_class.color.red, mad_panda.Position)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(mad_panda.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	local dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party_leader.Direction)

	character_util.air_spin(mad_panda, { offset = dir, speed = 1.5, stay_time = 0.3 })
	character_util.set_anim(mad_panda, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	wait_for_sec(2)

	self.mad_panda_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_state.wait_for_respawn
end

function local_class:mad_panda_wait_for_respawn(index)
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('wait_for_respawn')

	local mad_panda = self.mad_panda_list[index]

	character_util.set_position(mad_panda, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_active_state(mad_panda, 'enabled')
	character_util.spine_rotate(mad_panda, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_anim(mad_panda)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mad_panda)

	-- 내부 횟수 초기화
	self.mad_panda_evasion_cooltime_list[index] = index

	wait_for_sec(self.constants.mad_panda_respawn_duration)

	self.mad_panda_state_list[index] = self.mad_panda_state.out_of_camera
end

-- 플레이어 위치 계산해서 매드 팬더와 부딪힌 경우 데미지 입고 잠시 정지
function local_class:control_player()
	while self.is_playing_game do
		for i = 0, self.mad_panda_list.Count - 1 do
			local dist = (user_party_leader.Position - self.mad_panda_list[i].Position).magnitude

			if dist < self.constants.player_game_over_dist and
					self.mad_panda_state_list[i] == self.mad_panda_state.walk_normal then
				self.damage_count = self.damage_count + 1

				if self.damage_count >= self.damage_count_max then
					self.damage_count = 0

					coroutine.yield(self:player_respawn())
				else
					coroutine.yield(self:player_damaged(self.mad_panda_list[i]))
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 플레이어 데미지 입음
function local_class:player_damaged()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control(mad_panda)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.look_at(user_party_leader, mad_panda)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	local knockback_dir = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(
			CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetOpposite(user_party_leader.Direction))

	local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, knockback_dir,
			15000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

	command_util.publish_knock_back(user_party_leader.Owner, user_party_leader, knock_back_info, nil)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'prostrate' })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.04, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)
	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Direction)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 무적 시간 동안 깜박임
	for n = 0, 2 do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party_leader, 0, 0.25)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(user_party_leader, 1, 0.25)

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end
end

-- 플레이어 리스폰
function local_class:player_respawn()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(user_party_leader, 9999, unity_class.color.red, user_party_leader.Position)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'dead', loop = false })
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = 'damaged' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)

	self.mad_panda_state_list = nil
	self.mad_panda_evasion_list = nil

	self.projectile_virtual_obj_list = nil

	self.projectile_hitbox = nil
end

return {

--region brazier_data_list

	local i = 1

		local brazier = get_field_object('dbm_brazier_' .. i)

		if brazier == nil then
			break
		end

		self.brazier_data_list[brazier] = {
			position = brazier.Position,
			is_turning_on = false,

		i = i + 1

function local_class:create_range_list()
	self.range_list = {}

	local i = 1
	while true do
		local zone = field:GetZone('dbm_refrigerator_' .. i)

		if zone == nil then
			break
		end

		local attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
			vector(zone.Bounds.center.x, zone.Bounds.center.y + 0.1, zone.Bounds.center.z ),
			unity_class.vector2(zone.Bounds.size.x, zone.Bounds.size.z),
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76),
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)
		)

		attack_range:Show()

		table.insert(self.range_list, attack_range)

		i = i + 1
	end

	if self.range_list then
		for i = 1, #self.range_list do

		end

	end

				local index = tonumber(string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 27, string.len(e.Zone.Name)))

				print('index : ' .. index)

				if self.reset_position_index < index then
					self.reset_position_index = index
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		if string.find(e.Zone.Name, 'dbm_refrigerator') then
			if snowman_freeze_state:made(self.snowman_state_machine.current_state) then
				self.snowman_state_machine:change_state(snowman_melting_state(self.snowman, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:game_main_loop()
	self.is_game_clear = false
	self.reset_position_index = 1

	while not self.is_game_clear do
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/xmas/audio:bgm_xmas_present', state = 'event' })

		self:snowman_top_hp_bar_init()
		self:create_range_list()

		-- 바로 직전에 ResetController로 State변경이 일어나고 있는 중일 수도 있어서, 1프레임 기다림.
		coroutine.yield()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		self:hide_character_ui_button(true)

		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		self.snowman_state_machine:change_state(snowman_freeze_state(self.snowman, self))

		while not self:is_snowman_dead() and not self.is_game_clear do
			local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

			if self.snowman_state_machine.current_state then
				self.snowman_state_machine.current_state:update_frame(dt)
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		self:snowman_top_hp_bar_remove()
		self:clear_range_list()

		self:hide_character_ui_button(false)

		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

		-- 클리어 한게 아니라, 시간 초과로 눈사람이 녹아서 게임오버가 됐을 경우 재시작
		if not self.is_game_clear then
			field_ui_manager:Hide()
			party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
			character_util.shake(self.snowman, 0.05, 1)
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_explosion_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
			self.get_dead_effect_pool():Instantiate(self.snowman.Position)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.snowman, 0, 0)
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party.Leader, { name = 'surprise' })
			character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black ,'linear')

			-- 위치 초기화
			local reset_position = field:GetMarker('dbm_reset_position_' .. self.reset_position_index)
			party_util.position_party(reset_position.position, reset_position.direction, 'arc')

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
			character_util.set_direction(self.snowman, user_party.Leader.Direction)
			character_util.set_anim(self.snowman, { name = 'idle' })
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.snowman, 1, 0)
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black ,'linear')

			party_util.reset_controllers()
		end
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	self:game_end()
end

function local_class:hide_character_ui_button(is_hide)
	local field_ui_types = CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton
		| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton
		| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton

	if is_hide then
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, field_ui_types)
	else
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, field_ui_types)
	end
end

--region snowman_state
--region snowman_base_state
function snowman_base_state:init(fo)
	self.fo = fo
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function snowman_base_state:dispose()
	self.fo = nil
end

function snowman_base_state:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end
--endregion

--region snowman_melting_state
function snowman_melting_state:init(fo, controller)
	self.super:init(fo)

	-- 미니게임 컨트롤러
	self.controller = controller

	-- 화로에 닿았을 떄 입을 데미지
	self.damage = 30
	-- 화로의 범위
	self.brazier_distance = 2.25
end

function snowman_melting_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
end

function snowman_melting_state:enter(prev_state)
end

function snowman_melting_state:exit(next_state)
end

function snowman_melting_state:update_frame(dt)
	self.super:update_frame(dt)

	-- 눈사람의 방향이, 플레이어의 방향과 다르다면 맞춰주기
	if self.fo.Direction ~= user_party.Leader.Direction then
		character_util.set_direction(self.fo, user_party.Leader.Direction)
	end

	local is_in_brazier_area = false

	for brazier, brazier_data in pairs(self.controller.brazier_data_list) do
		if brazier_data.is_turning_on then
			local distance = (brazier_data.position - user_party.Leader.Position).sqrMagnitude

			if distance <= self.brazier_distance then
				is_in_brazier_area = true
				break
			end
		end
	end

	if is_in_brazier_area then
		self:damaged()
		self.controller.snowman_state_machine:change_state(snowman_invincible_state(self.fo, self.controller))
	end
end

function snowman_melting_state:damaged()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_snowball_throw_01', parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self.controller.snowman_hp = self.controller.snowman_hp - self.damage
	self.controller:snowman_top_hp_bar_update(self.controller.snowman_hp, self.controller.snowman_hp + self.damage)

	local progress = self.controller.snowman_hp / self.controller.snowman_max_hp

	if progress <= 0 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'melt3' })
	elseif progress <= 0.334 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'melt2' })
	elseif progress <= 0.667 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'melt1' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'idle' })
	end
end
--endregion

--region snowman_freeze_state
function snowman_freeze_state:init(fo, controller)
	self.super:init(fo)

	-- 미니게임 컨트롤러
	self.controller = controller

	-- 회복 하는 주기
	self.duration = 0.25
	-- 매 주기마다 회복할 수치
	self.heal = 10
end

function snowman_freeze_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
end

function snowman_freeze_state:enter(prev_state)
end

function snowman_freeze_state:exit(next_state)
end

function snowman_freeze_state:update_frame(dt)
	self.super:update_frame(dt)

	-- 눈사람의 방향이, 플레이어의 방향과 다르다면 맞춰주기
	if self.fo.Direction ~= user_party.Leader.Direction then
		character_util.set_direction(self.fo, user_party.Leader.Direction)
	end

	local tick_num = 0

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		tick_num = math.floor(self.time_passed / self.duration)
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed % self.duration
	end

	if tick_num > 0 then
		local total_heal = (self.heal * tick_num)

		self:healed(total_heal)
	end
end

function snowman_freeze_state:healed(value)
	local prev_hp = self.controller.snowman_hp

	self.controller.snowman_hp = math.min(self.controller.snowman_hp + value, self.controller.snowman_max_hp)
	self.controller:snowman_top_hp_bar_update(self.controller.snowman_hp, prev_hp)

	-- 회복 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_get_heal_01', parent = self.fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	self.controller.get_heal_effect_pool():Instantiate(self.fo.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.fo.Transform)
	damage_util.show_damage_number(self.fo, value, unity_class.color.green, self.fo.Position)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.fo, unity_class.color.green, 1, 0.4, 0.25)

	local progress = self.controller.snowman_hp / self.controller.snowman_max_hp

	if progress <= 0 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'melt3' })
	elseif progress <= 0.334 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'melt2' })
	elseif progress <= 0.667 then
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'melt1' })
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.fo, { name = 'idle' })
	end
end
--endregion

--region snowman_invincible_state
function snowman_invincible_state:init(fo, controller)
	self.super:init(fo)

	-- 미니게임 컨트롤러
	self.controller = controller

	-- 상태(무적) 지속 시간
	self.duration = 0.5
end

function snowman_invincible_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.controller = nil
end

function snowman_invincible_state:enter(prev_state)
end

function snowman_invincible_state:exit(next_state)
end

function snowman_invincible_state:update_frame(dt)
	self.super:update_frame(dt)

	-- 눈사람의 방향이, 플레이어의 방향과 다르다면 맞춰주기
	if self.fo.Direction ~= user_party.Leader.Direction then
		character_util.set_direction(self.fo, user_party.Leader.Direction)
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.duration then
		self.controller.snowman_state_machine:change_state(snowman_melting_state(self.fo, self.controller))
	end
end
--endregion
--endregion

	return self.snowman_hp <= 0
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent) then
		return self:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	if e.Name ~= 'xmas_gift' then return false end

	if self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.none then
		self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.loading
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_init, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
		if CS.UICamera.Raycast(e.TouchPos:GetXy0()) then
			local touch_pos = self.ui_camera:ScreenToWorldPoint(e.TouchPos:GetXy0())

			local touch_effect = self.get_fx_touch():Instantiate(touch_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0), nil)
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(touch_effect.transform, 'UI')
			touch_effect.transform:GetChild(0).transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.2
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:convert_screen_pos(pos)
	local screen_size = CS.ScreenUtil.GetMainGameViewSize()

	if CS.Oak.AspectRatio.Type == CS.Oak.AspectRatioType.Narrow then
		return pos / (screen_size.x / stage.UIRoot.manualWidth)
	else
		return pos / (screen_size.y / stage.UIRoot.manualHeight)
	end
end

function local_class:preload_game_resource()
	local constant_class = require('minigame/XMasGift/XMasGiftConstants')
	if constant_class == nil then
		-- 오류 뱉어냄
		return
	end

	self.constants = constant_class.default

	self.background_bottom_pos = self:table_to_vector(self.constants.background_bottom_pos)
	self.camera_center_pos = self:table_to_vector(self.constants.camera_center_pos)
	self.plane_start_pos = self:table_to_vector(self.constants.plane_start_pos)

	self.snow_effect_offset = self:table_to_vector(self.constants.snow_effect_offset)

	self.bomb_effect_info = {}
	for _, info in pairs(self.constants.bomb_effect_info) do
		local new_info = {
			offset = self:table_to_vector(info.offset),
			delay = info.delay
		}
		table.insert(self.bomb_effect_info, new_info)
	end

	-- 배경 로드
	self.background_res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	self.background_obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.background_res_holder,
			'ondemand/xmas/ui', 'xm_minigame2_back')
	self.background_obj.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0)
	self.background_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * self.background_ratio
	self.background_obj.transform.position = self.background_bottom_pos + self.camera_center_pos

	self.background_loop_obj = self.background_obj.transform:GetChild(0):GetChild(0).gameObject

	-- UI 로드
	self.ui_resource_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, self.ui_resource_holder, 'ondemand/xmas/ui', 'XMasGiftMiniGame', function(prefab)
		self.ui_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
		self.ui_controller = self.ui_obj.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.XMasGiftMiniGame))
		self.ui_obj:SetActive(false)
		self.ui_obj.transform:GetChild(1).gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end)

	local bottom_widget_path = 'Content/Main Widget/Bottom Widget/'
	local center_widget_path = 'Content/Main Widget/Bottom Widget/Center Widget/'

	self.bomb_button_collider = self.ui_obj.transform:Find(bottom_widget_path .. 'Bomb Box Button').gameObject
			:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider))
	self.gift_button_collider = self.ui_obj.transform:Find(bottom_widget_path .. 'Gift Button').gameObject
			:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider))

	local stamp_paper_obj = self.ui_obj.transform:Find(center_widget_path .. 'Stamp Paper').gameObject
	local condition_paper_obj = self.ui_obj.transform:Find(center_widget_path .. 'Current Condition Widget').gameObject
	local notice_paper_obj = self.ui_obj.transform:Find(center_widget_path .. 'Condition Notice Paper').gameObject
	self.spine_container_obj = self.ui_obj.transform:Find(center_widget_path .. 'Character Widget/Spine Container').gameObject

	-- 종이 들어갔다 나왔다 할 때 transform 정보 저장용
	self.stamp_paper_info = {
		obj = stamp_paper_obj,
		pos = stamp_paper_obj.transform.localPosition,
		z_rot = self:get_z_rotation(stamp_paper_obj)
	}
	self.condition_paper_info = {
		obj = condition_paper_obj,
		pos = condition_paper_obj.transform.localPosition,
		z_rot = self:get_z_rotation(condition_paper_obj)
	}
	self.notice_paper_info = {
		obj = notice_paper_obj,
		pos = notice_paper_obj.transform.localPosition,
		z_rot = self:get_z_rotation(notice_paper_obj)
	}

	-- 비행기가 배경보다 앞에 나오도록 설정
	-- 이모티콘(order : 1000)보단 뒤에 나와야됨
	self.get_plane().SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Top Effects', 900)
	self.get_plane().SpineController:Scale(unity_class.vector3.one * 0.8, 0)

	self.ui_camera = stage.UISceneManager.UICamera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))

	local ui_panel = self.ui_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UIPanel))
	ui_panel.renderQueue = CS.UIPanel.RenderQueue.StartAt
	ui_panel.startingRenderQueue = 2000
end

function local_class:get_z_rotation(obj)
	local z_rot = obj.transform.localEulerAngles.z

	if z_rot > 180 then
		z_rot = z_rot - 360
	end

	return z_rot
end

function local_class:get_current_children_info()
	return self.children_info_list[self.current_children_index]
end

function local_class:table_to_vector(table)
	return vector(table[1], table[2], table[3])
end

function local_class:game_init()
	if self.constants == nil then
		-- BUG : 데이터 로드 안됨
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/xmas/audio:bgm_xmas_present', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	self.children_info_list = {}

	local max_info_count = self.constants.max_gift_count + self.constants.time_limit // self.constants.penalty_time
	local copied_spine_list = {}
	local behave_index_list = {
		good = {},
		bad = {},
	}

	--good이나 bad가 연속해서 나온 개수. 양수면 good, 음수면 bad
	local continuous_count = 0

	-- 최대 타이머 만큼 실패 후 30개 성공할 경우 대비
	for i = 1, max_info_count do
		-- Pool이 동났을 경우 다시 채워줌
		if #copied_spine_list == 0 then
			copied_spine_list = self:copy_list(self.constants.spine_list)
		end
		if #behave_index_list.good == 0 then
			behave_index_list.good = self:generate_int_list(self.constants.behave_key_list.good.max_count)
		end
		if #behave_index_list.bad == 0 then
			behave_index_list.bad = self:generate_int_list(self.constants.behave_key_list.bad.max_count)
		end

		local children_info = {}

		children_info.spine = self:get_random_in_list(copied_spine_list)

		-- 이미 한 가지 종류가 3개 연속으로 나왔을 때 반대의 경우 채워줌
		if continuous_count == 3 then
			children_info.is_good = false
		elseif continuous_count == -3 then
			children_info.is_good = true
		else
			children_info.is_good = random_util.get_random_int(0, 1) == 0
		end

		if children_info.is_good then
			children_info.behave_key = self.constants.behave_key_list.good.key
					.. self:get_random_in_list(behave_index_list.good)

			if continuous_count < 0 then
				continuous_count = 0
			end

			continuous_count = continuous_count + 1
		else
			children_info.behave_key = self.constants.behave_key_list.bad.key
					.. self:get_random_in_list(behave_index_list.bad)

			if continuous_count > 0 then
				continuous_count = 0
			end

			continuous_count = continuous_count - 1
		end

		table.insert(self.children_info_list, children_info)
	end

	self.moving_effect_list = {}

	-- 배경 위치 설정
	self.background_loop_obj.transform.localPosition = self.background_loop_offset

	-- 비행기 위치 설정
	self.get_plane().Position = self.plane_start_pos + self.background_bottom_pos + self.camera_center_pos

	-- 변수 초기화
	self.current_children_index = 1

	self.gifts_left = self.constants.max_gift_count

	self.current_button_state = self.button_state.none
	self.current_paper_state = self.paper_state.hide

	-- ui 세팅
	self.ui_obj:SetActive(true)

	-- ui가 켜질 때 까지 기다림
	coroutine.yield()

	-- 종이들 미리 숨겨놓음
	self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = self.hide_stamp_info.pos
	self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, self.hide_stamp_info.z_rot)

	self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = self.hide_condition_info.pos
	self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, self.hide_condition_info.z_rot)

	self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = self.hide_notice_info.pos
	self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, self.hide_notice_info.z_rot)

	-- 버튼 클릭 콜백 지정
	self.ui_controller.BoomBoxAction = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		if self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.playing
				and self.current_game_state == self.game_state.moving
				and self.current_button_state == self.button_state.idle
				and self.current_paper_state == self.paper_state.show then
			self.ui_controller:SetButtons(false)
			self.current_button_state = self.button_state.bomb
		end
	end

	self.ui_controller.GiftBoxAction = function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		if self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.playing
				and self.current_game_state == self.game_state.moving
				and self.current_button_state == self.button_state.idle
				and self.current_paper_state == self.paper_state.show then
			self.ui_controller:SetButtons(false)
			self.current_button_state = self.button_state.gift
		end
	end

	self.snow_effect_list = {}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local snow_effect = self.get_fx_xmas_snow():Instantiate(self.background_bottom_pos + self.camera_center_pos
				+ self.snow_effect_offset + vector((i - 1) * self.constants.snow_effect_x_dif, 0, 0),
				unity_class.quaternion.Euler(45, 0, 0), nil)
		table.insert(self.snow_effect_list, snow_effect)
	end

	-- 타이머 / 남은 선물 개수 세팅
	self:set_timer(self.constants.time_limit)
	self.ui_controller:HideResultIcon()
	self.ui_controller:SetGiftCount(self.gifts_left)

	self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.loaded

	-- 게임 시작
	self:start_game()
end

-- 테이블 안에 테이블이 존재하지 않는 경우만 산정함
function local_class:copy_list(list)
	local copied_list = {}

	for k, v in pairs(list) do
		copied_list[k] = v
	end

	return copied_list
end

function local_class:generate_int_list(max_int)
	local list = {}
	for i = 1, max_int do
		list[i] = i
	end

	return list
end

function local_class:get_random_in_list(list)
	local r_num = random_util.get_random_int(1, #list)
	local value = list[r_num]
	table.remove(list, r_num)

	return value
end

function local_class:game_dispose()
	self.ui_controller:Dispose()
	self.ui_obj:SetActive(false)

	if self.snow_effect_list ~= nil then
		for _, effect in pairs(self.snow_effect_list) do
			effect:Dispose()
		end
		self.snow_effect_list = nil
	end

	self:renew_moving_effect()
	for _, effect in pairs(self.moving_effect_list) do
		effect:Dispose()
	end
end

function local_class:desc_scene()
	wait_for_sec(1)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')

	if not self.is_seen_desc_scene then
		self.is_seen_desc_scene = true
		local plane = self.get_plane()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(plane,
				{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_1', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(plane,
				{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_2', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(plane,
				{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_4', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb'})
	else
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.playing
end

function local_class:start_game()
	if self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.loaded then
		self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.starting

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:game_routine()
	local plane = self.get_plane()
	local time_passed = 0

	local delivering_time = 0
	local reacting_time = 0

	local gift_box = nil

	local prev_game_state = self.game_state.idle

	local gift_start_pos = nil
	local gift_target_pos = nil

	local result_icon_showing = false
	local choice_correct = false

	local traj_z_func = function(progress)
		return math.sin((progress * 5 + 1) * math.pi / 6) - 0.5
	end

	local bomb_effects_active = {}

	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	camera_util.move_async(self.camera_center_pos, 0, { ignorecameragrids = true})

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.floating

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--시작 연출
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.desc_scene, self))

	while self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.starting do
		self:move_plane(vector(self.constants.move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0, 0))
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.current_game_state = self.game_state.moving

	while self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.playing do
		-- 타이머 갱신
		local time_left = self.constants.time_limit - time_passed
		self:set_timer(time_left)

		if self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.delivering
				and self.current_game_state ~= self.game_state.reacting then
			if self.gifts_left == 0 then
				self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.win
				break
			elseif time_left <= 0 then
				self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.over
				break
			end
		end

		-- 천천히 움직임
		self:move_plane(vector(self.constants.move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0, 0))

		if self.current_game_state == self.game_state.moving then
			if self.current_button_state == self.button_state.idle
					or self.current_button_state == self.button_state.none then
				if self.current_paper_state == self.paper_state.hide then
					-- 종이 ui 위로 올라옴
					self:show_ui_paper()
					self:set_current_info_ui()
				end

			else
				gift_start_pos = plane.Position
				-- 타겟 위치가 너무 위에 있어서 조금 아래로 내림
				gift_target_pos = gift_start_pos
						+ vector(self.constants.move_speed * self.constants.delivering_time * -1, 0,
						traj_z_func(1) * (self.plane_start_pos.z - self.constants.floor_pos_z) * self.background_ratio * 1.5)
				gift_box = drop_item_util.create_item({
					itemid = self.gift_box_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
					pos = gift_start_pos, sprscale = 0.5
				})
				gift_box:SetSortingLayer(true)

				local is_gift = false
				if self.current_button_state == self.button_state.gift then
					is_gift = true
					self.ui_controller:SetChildAnimation('victory_extra', 'smile', true, true)

					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.spine_container_obj.transform,
							{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_7', type_speed = 0, bubble_direction = 'rt', scale = 0.25})

				elseif self.current_button_state == self.button_state.bomb then
					is_gift = false
					self.ui_controller:SetChildAnimation('embarrassed', 'damaged', true, true)

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')

					speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.spine_container_obj.transform,
							{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_8', type_speed = 0, bubble_direction = 'rt', scale = 0.25})
				end

				choice_correct = self:check_gift(is_gift)

				if choice_correct then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_o_02')
				else
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_quiz_x_01')
				end
				self.ui_controller:ShowResultIcon(not choice_correct)

				if choice_correct then
					self.gifts_left = self.gifts_left - 1
					self.ui_controller:SetGiftCount(self.gifts_left)
				else
					time_passed = time_passed + self.constants.penalty_time
				end

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_pop_box_01')
				self.current_game_state = self.game_state.delivering
			end

		elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.delivering then
			if delivering_time < self.constants.delivering_time then
				--선물 드롭
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(delivering_time / self.constants.delivering_time)

				gift_box.Position = gift_start_pos
						+ vector(-self.constants.move_speed * self.constants.delivering_time * progress, 0,
						traj_z_func(progress) * (self.plane_start_pos.z - self.constants.floor_pos_z) * self.background_ratio *  1.5)

				delivering_time = delivering_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			else
				if self.current_button_state == self.button_state.gift then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_enhance_light_01')
					local get_effect = self.get_fx_get():Instantiate(gift_target_pos)
					get_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one
					self:add_moving_effect(get_effect)

				elseif self.current_button_state == self.button_state.bomb then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
					bomb_effects_active = {}
					for index, info in pairs(self.bomb_effect_info) do
						if info.delay == 0 then
							local explosion_effect = self.get_fx_explosion_bomb()
														 :Instantiate(gift_target_pos + info.offset)
							explosion_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.3
							self:add_moving_effect(explosion_effect)
							bomb_effects_active[index] = true
						else
							bomb_effects_active[index] = false
						end
					end
				else	-- BUG : 스테이트 꼬였을 때
				end

				delivering_time = 0
				gift_box:ConsumeComplete()

				self.current_game_state = self.game_state.reacting
			end

		elseif self.current_game_state == self.game_state.reacting then
			if self.current_button_state == self.button_state.bomb then
				-- 도착 이후 타겟 위치도 계속 갱신 필요
				gift_target_pos = gift_target_pos + vector(-self.constants.move_speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime, 0, 0)

				for index, info in pairs(self.bomb_effect_info) do
					if reacting_time >= info.delay and not bomb_effects_active[index] then
						bomb_effects_active[index] = true
						local explosion_effect = self.get_fx_explosion_bomb()
													 :Instantiate(gift_target_pos + info.offset)
						explosion_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 0.3
						self:add_moving_effect(explosion_effect)
					end
				end
			end

			if reacting_time < self.constants.reaction_time then
				reacting_time = reacting_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			elseif reacting_time > self.constants.reaction_time then

				reacting_time = 0
				self.current_children_index = self.current_children_index + 1
				self.current_button_state = self.button_state.none
				self.current_game_state = self.game_state.moving

				self.ui_controller:HideResultIcon()
				result_icon_showing = false

				local spine_controller = self.spine_container_obj.transform:GetChild(0)
											 :GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
				spine_controller:SetAlphaFade(0, self.constants.spine_fade_out_time)
				CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Return(self.spine_container_obj.transform)
				self:hide_ui_paper()
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		prev_game_state = self.current_game_state

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	local is_win = false

	if self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.win then
		is_win = true
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(plane,
				{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_5', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb'})

	elseif self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.over then
		is_win = false
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(plane,
				{key = 'xmas_gift_minigame_6', skip = true, bubble_direction = 'rb'})
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')

	else	-- BUG : 스테이트가 꼬였을 때

	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.disposing

	self:game_dispose()

	self.current_inner_state = self.inner_state.none

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create('xmas_gift', is_win))
end

function local_class:set_current_info_ui()
	local children_info = self:get_current_children_info()

	self.ui_controller:SetDescLabel(game_string:GetString(children_info.behave_key))
	self.ui_controller:SetGiftCount(self.gifts_left)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			self.ui_controller:InitChildSpine(children_info.spine, 'UI', 10, function()
				local spine_controller = self.spine_container_obj.transform:GetChild(0)
						:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))
				spine_controller:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
				spine_controller:SetAlphaFade(1, self.constants.spine_fade_in_time)
			end))
end

function local_class:add_moving_effect(effect)
	table.insert(self.moving_effect_list, effect)
end

function local_class:renew_moving_effect()
	for key, effect in pairs(self.moving_effect_list) do
		if is_unity_null(effect) or effect.transform.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
			self.moving_effect_list[key] = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hide_ui_paper()
	if self.current_paper_state == self.paper_state.show then
		self.current_paper_state = self.paper_state.hiding
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hide_paper_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:show_ui_paper()
	if self.current_paper_state == self.paper_state.hide then
		self.current_paper_state = self.paper_state.showing
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_paper_routine, self))
	end
end

function local_class:hide_paper_routine()
	local data = {
		stamp_start_pos = self.stamp_paper_info.pos,
		stamp_target_pos = self.hide_stamp_info.pos,

		stamp_start_z_rot = self.stamp_paper_info.z_rot,
		stamp_target_z_rot = self.hide_stamp_info.z_rot,

		condition_start_pos = self.condition_paper_info.pos,
		condition_target_pos = self.hide_condition_info.pos,

		condition_start_z_rot = self.condition_paper_info.z_rot,
		condition_target_z_rot = self.hide_condition_info.z_rot,

		notice_start_pos = self.notice_paper_info.pos,
		notice_target_pos = self.hide_notice_info.pos,

		notice_start_z_rot = self.notice_paper_info.z_rot,
		notice_target_z_rot = self.hide_notice_info.z_rot
	}

	self:move_paper_routine(self.constants.paper_move_time_info.hide, data)

	self.current_paper_state = self.paper_state.hide
end

function local_class:show_paper_routine()
	local data = {
		stamp_start_pos = self.hide_stamp_info.pos,
		stamp_target_pos = self.stamp_paper_info.pos,

		stamp_start_z_rot = self.hide_stamp_info.z_rot,
		stamp_target_z_rot = self.stamp_paper_info.z_rot,

		condition_start_pos = self.hide_condition_info.pos,
		condition_target_pos = self.condition_paper_info.pos,

		condition_start_z_rot = self.hide_condition_info.z_rot,
		condition_target_z_rot = self.condition_paper_info.z_rot,

		notice_start_pos = self.hide_notice_info.pos,
		notice_target_pos = self.notice_paper_info.pos,

		notice_start_z_rot = self.hide_notice_info.z_rot,
		notice_target_z_rot = self.notice_paper_info.z_rot
	}

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')

	self:move_paper_routine(self.constants.paper_move_time_info.show, data)

	self.current_paper_state = self.paper_state.show

	if self.current_button_state == self.button_state.none then
		self.ui_controller:SetButtons(true)
		self.current_button_state = self.button_state.idle
	end
end

function local_class:move_paper_routine(move_time_info, data)
	local stamp_end_time = move_time_info.stamp.delay + move_time_info.stamp.duration
	local condition_end_time = move_time_info.condition.delay + move_time_info.stamp.duration
	local notice_end_time = move_time_info.notice.delay + move_time_info.notice.duration

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = math.max(stamp_end_time, condition_end_time, notice_end_time)

	local stamp_move_end = false
	local condition_move_end = false
	local notice_move_end = false

	while time_passed < duration and
			self.inner_state ~= nil and
			(self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.playing
					or self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.win
					or self.current_inner_state == self.inner_state.over) do
		if time_passed >= move_time_info.stamp.delay
				and time_passed < stamp_end_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
					(time_passed - move_time_info.stamp.delay) / move_time_info.stamp.duration)

			local z_rot = data.stamp_start_z_rot * (1 - progress) + data.stamp_target_z_rot * progress
			local pos = data.stamp_start_pos * (1 - progress) + data.stamp_target_pos * progress

			self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, z_rot)
			self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = pos
		elseif time_passed >= stamp_end_time then
			if not stamp_move_end then
				stamp_move_end = true

				self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, data.stamp_target_z_rot)
				self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = data.stamp_target_pos
			end
		end

		if time_passed >= move_time_info.notice.delay
				and time_passed < notice_end_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
					(time_passed - move_time_info.notice.delay) / move_time_info.notice.duration)

			local z_rot = data.notice_start_z_rot * (1 - progress) + data.notice_target_z_rot * progress
			local pos = data.notice_start_pos * (1 - progress) + data.notice_target_pos * progress

			self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, z_rot)
			self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = pos
		elseif time_passed >= notice_end_time then
			if not notice_move_end then
				notice_move_end = true

				self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, data.notice_target_z_rot)
				self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = data.notice_target_pos
			end
		end

		if time_passed >= move_time_info.condition.delay
				and time_passed < condition_end_time then
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(
					(time_passed - move_time_info.condition.delay) / move_time_info.condition.duration)

			local z_rot = data.condition_start_z_rot * (1 - progress) + data.condition_target_z_rot * progress
			local pos = data.condition_start_pos * (1 - progress) + data.condition_target_pos * progress

			self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, z_rot)
			self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = pos
		elseif time_passed >= condition_end_time then
			if not condition_move_end then
				condition_move_end = true

				self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, data.condition_target_z_rot)
				self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = data.condition_target_pos
			end
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, data.stamp_target_z_rot)
	self.stamp_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = data.stamp_target_pos

	self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, data.condition_target_z_rot)
	self.condition_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = data.condition_target_pos

	self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localEulerAngles = vector(0, 0, data.notice_target_z_rot)
	self.notice_paper_info.obj.transform.localPosition = data.notice_target_pos
end

-- 타이머 ui 세팅
function local_class:set_timer(time_left)
	if time_left < 0 then
		time_left = 0
	end

	local progress = time_left / self.constants.time_limit

	local int_time = math.ceil(time_left)

	local minute = int_time // 60
	local second = int_time % 60

	local minute_str = minute < 10 and '0' .. minute or minute
	local second_str = second < 10 and '0' .. second or second

	self.ui_controller:SetTimerBar(progress)
	self.ui_controller:SetTimerLabel(minute_str .. ':' .. second_str)
end

function local_class:move_plane(dif_vec)
	local x_dif = dif_vec.x
	local z_dif = dif_vec.z
	local plane = self.get_plane()

	plane.Position = plane.Position + vector(0, 0, z_dif)

	self:move_obj(self.background_loop_obj, vector(-x_dif, 0, 0))

	if (self.camera_center_pos + self.background_bottom_pos).x
			> self.background_loop_obj.transform.position.x + self.background_scale.x * 1.5 then
		self:move_obj(self.background_loop_obj, vector(self.background_scale.x, 0, 0))
	end

	for _, effect in pairs(self.snow_effect_list) do
		self:move_obj(effect, vector(-x_dif, 0, 0))

		if effect.transform.position.x < self.camera_center_pos.x - self.constants.snow_effect_x_dif then
			self:move_obj(effect, vector(self.constants.snow_effect_x_dif * #self.snow_effect_list, 0, 0))
		end
	end

	self:renew_moving_effect()
	for _, effect in pairs(self.moving_effect_list) do
		self:move_obj(effect, vector(-x_dif, 0, 0))
	end
end

function local_class:move_obj(object, dif_vec)
	object.transform.position = object.transform.position + dif_vec
end

-- 맞는 선물은 준 것인지 확인
function local_class:check_gift(is_gift)
	return is_gift == self:get_current_children_info().is_good
end

return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}
