function local_class:on_click_recipe(recipe_id)
	local recipe_sprite = nil
	local recipe_name = nil
	local recipe_count = 0
	local recipe_max = 0
	local comp1_sprite = nil
	local comp1_name = nil
	local comp1_req = -1
	local comp1_count = 0
	local comp2_sprite = nil
	local comp2_name = nil
	local comp2_req = -1
	local comp2_count = 0


	for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
		local recipe = self.constants.items[i]
		if recipe.id == recipe_id then
			recipe_name = game_string:GetString(recipe.name)
			recipe_sprite = recipe.sprite
			recipe_max = recipe.max

			if recipe.is_building then
				if not recipe.is_remove then
					if self.game_data.built_items[recipe_id] ~= nil then
						recipe_count = #self.game_data.built_items[recipe_id]
					end
				end
			else
				recipe_count = self:get_item_count(recipe_id)
			end

			if recipe.comp1_id ~= nil then
				local comp1 = self:get_item_spec(recipe.comp1_id)
				comp1_sprite = comp1.sprite
				comp1_name = game_string:GetString(comp1.name)
				comp1_req = recipe.comp1_req
				comp1_count = self:get_item_count(recipe.comp1_id)
			end

			if recipe.comp2_id ~= nil then
				local comp2 = self:get_item_spec(recipe.comp2_id)
				comp2_sprite = comp2.sprite
				comp2_name = game_string:GetString(comp2.name)
				comp2_req = recipe.comp2_req
				comp2_count = self:get_item_count(recipe.comp2_id)
			end

			break
		end
	end

	CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuild.Instance:SetSelectedRecipe(recipe_id, recipe_sprite, recipe_name, recipe_count, recipe_max, comp1_count, comp1_req, comp1_sprite, comp1_name, comp2_count, comp2_req, comp2_sprite, comp2_name)
end

function local_class:on_build_recipe(recipe_id, count)
	local recipe = self:get_item_spec(recipe_id)

	local xmas_main_quest_id = 60045
	local q = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(xmas_main_quest_id)
	if q ~= nil and not q.IsComplete and q.InnerProgress < 9 then
		if recipe.name ~= "xmas_recipe_campfire" and self.loaded_stage_index == 3 then
			CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuild.Instance:ShowNoticePopUp(game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_notice_title"), game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_button_campfire"), nil)
			return
		end
	end

	if recipe.is_remove then
		CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay();
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		self:remove_building()
		return
	end

	local current_count = self:get_item_count(recipe.id)
	if current_count + count > recipe.max or count > 1 then
		CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuild.Instance:ShowNoticePopUp(game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_notice_title"), game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_button_full"), nil)
		return
	end

	local satisfied = true

	if recipe.comp1_id ~= nil then
		local req = recipe.comp1_req * count
		if req > self:get_item_count(recipe.comp1_id) then
			satisified = false
		end
	end

	if recipe.comp2_id ~= nil then
		local req = recipe.comp2_req * count
		if req > self:get_item_count(recipe.comp2_id) then
			satisified = false
		end
	end

	if not satisfied then
		CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuild.Instance:ShowNoticePopUp(game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_notice_title"), game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_button_insufficient"), nil)
		return
	end

	CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PopOverlay();
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	if recipe.is_building then
		self:build_building(recipe)
	else
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.build_routine, self, recipe_id, count))
	end
end

function local_class:build_routine(recipe_id, count)
	user_party[0].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_build_building_01")
	character_util.set_anim(user_party[0], { name = "eat", loop = true })

	local workstation = get_field_object("workstation")

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 1.0

	local ui_dict = field_ui_manager:SetUI(workstation, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)
	local timer_bar = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar]
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetMinMax(0, 1.0)
	timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(0, 0)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		if progress >= 1 then
			break
		end

		timer_bar.BarSprite:SetValue(progress, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(workstation, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TimerBar)

	local current_count = self:get_item_count(recipe_id) + count
	self.game_data.inventory[recipe_id] = current_count

	local recipe = self:get_item_spec(recipe_id)

	if recipe.comp1_id ~= nil then
		local req = recipe.comp1_req * count
		self.game_data.inventory[recipe.comp1_id] = self:get_item_count(recipe.comp1_id) - req
	end

	if recipe.comp2_id ~= nil then
		local req = recipe.comp2_req * count
		self.game_data.inventory[recipe.comp2_id] = self:get_item_count(recipe.comp2_id) - req
	end

	ui_scene_manager:ShowWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject, true)
	local time_start = unity_class.time.time
	-- 저장한다
	coroutine.yield(self:save())

	local time_diff = unity_class.time.time - time_start
	if time_diff < 0.15 then
		wait_for_sec(0.15 - time_diff)
	end
	ui_scene_manager:HideWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject)


	if recipe.weapon_name ~= nil then
		local current_weapon_name = user_party[0].Weapon1.WeaponSpec.Name
		local current_weapon_power = 0
		for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
			if self.constants.items[i].weapon_name == current_weapon_name then
				current_weapon_power = self.constants.items[i].weapon_power
				break
			end
		end

		if recipe.weapon_power >= current_weapon_power then
			local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
			local spec = item_data:GetSpec(recipe.weapon_name)
			local gear  = CS.Oak.Item.Create(spec)

			user_party[0]:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1, gear)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			while user_party[0].IsChangingEquipment do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			local swordHolder = create_item_placeholder({ id = spec.Id, not_for_inventory = true })
			coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(swordHolder, recipe.weapon_title, recipe.weapon_desc))
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party[0], false)
		else
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			user_party[0].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
			character_util.set_anim(user_party[0], { name = "bomb_idle", loop = true })
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party[0], { name = "sad", loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(workstation, { key = "xmas_survival_no_need_equip", skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim(user_party[0], false)
			character_util.remove_emotion(user_party[0])
		end

		user_party:ResetControllers()
	else
		local build = nil
		if recipe.builds == nil or #recipe.builds < current_count then
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Can't find build pool")
		else
			build = get_field_object(recipe.builds[current_count])
			if recipe.is_destructible then
				message_system:SendSync(build, CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent.Create(build))
			end

			local build_pos = user_party[0].Position - vector(0.7, 0, 0)
			build.Position = build_pos
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01' })
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_dead"):Instantiate(build_pos)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.0)

		-- 종료 연출
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[0], false)
		user_party:ResetControllers()

		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if build ~= nil then
			-- 빌드 오브젝트 처리
			if recipe.put_object then
				local s = CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutState.Create(user_party[0], build);
				message_system:SendSync(user_party[0].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(s))
			else
				command_util.execute_holdup(user_party[0], build, user_party[0].Position)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:build_building(item_spec)
	user_party[0].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_build_building_01")

	local item_id = item_spec.id

	if self.game_data.built_items[item_id] == nil then
		self.game_data.built_items[item_id] = {}
	end

	local build = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(item_spec.pool):Instantiate(user_party[0].Position - vector(0.7, 0, 0))
	local hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(item_spec.pivot, item_spec.size)

	self.current_build_item = item_spec

	local s = CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutState.CreateForBuilding(user_party[0], build, hitbox)
	message_system:SendSync(user_party[0].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(s))

	self:open_build_bar(item_spec)

	-- 종료 연출
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:remove_building()
	user_party[0].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	user_party[0].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	user_party[0].SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon2', 'shovel')

	local s = CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutState.CreateForRemoval(user_party[0])
	message_system:SendSync(user_party[0].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.ActionStateChangeEvent.Create(s))
	self.build_removal_mode = true
	self:open_build_bar(nil)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_build_building_01")

	user_party:ResetControllers()
end


function local_class:place_buildable(target, build_target, holder)
	local size = vector(1, 1)
	local pivot = vector(0.5, 0,0.5)

	if build_target ~= nil and self.current_build_item ~= nil then
		size.x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.current_build_item.size.x)
		size.y = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.current_build_item.size.z)
		pivot = self.current_build_item.pivot
	end

	local place_pos = self:get_build_pos()
	if not self:can_place_at(place_pos, target, size, pivot) then
		user_party[0]:Shake(0.08, 0.15)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_rustle_01")
		return
	-- FIXME: 빌드 범위 읽어서 할 것
	elseif build_target ~= nil and (place_pos.x < self.build_anchor_pos.x or place_pos.x > self.build_anchor_pos.x + self.build_zone_size.x or place_pos.z < self.build_anchor_pos.z or place_pos.z > self.build_anchor_pos.z + self.build_zone_size.z) then
		user_party[0]:Shake(0.08, 0.15)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_rustle_01")
		local text_color = unity_color({0.7, 0.2, 0.2, 1})
		local bg_color = unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0})
		CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(user_party_leader):ActivateForText(game_string:GetString('xmas_survival_not_area'), 0, text_color, bg_color)
		return
	elseif build_target ~= nil then
		local count = self:get_allowed_count(self.current_build_item)
		if count <= 0 then
			user_party[0]:Shake(0.08, 0.15)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_rustle_01")
			local text_color = unity_color({0.7, 0.2, 0.2, 1})
			local bg_color = unity_color({0, 0, 0, 0})
			CS.Oak.FieldUIFloatingText.Get(user_party_leader):ActivateForText(self:get_allowed_count_text(self.current_build_item), 0, text_color, bg_color)
			return
		end
	end

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Common_Jump_small"):Instantiate(place_pos)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_land_02")

	if target ~= nil then
		target.Position = place_pos
	elseif build_target ~= nil then
		if self.current_build_item.comp1_id ~= nil then
			local req =  self.current_build_item.comp1_req
			self.game_data.inventory[self.current_build_item.comp1_id] = self:get_item_count(self.current_build_item.comp1_id) - req
		end

		if self.current_build_item.comp2_id ~= nil then
			local req = self.current_build_item.comp2_req
			self.game_data.inventory[self.current_build_item.comp2_id] = self:get_item_count(self.current_build_item.comp2_id) - req
		end

		self:place_building_object(self.current_build_item, place_pos, true)
		CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance:SetLowerText(self:get_allowed_count_text(self.current_build_item))
		CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance:SetIconText(self:get_icon_text(self.current_build_item))
	end
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEvent.Create(target, build_target, holder, CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.Success))
end

function local_class:place_building_object(build_item, place_pos, update_built_items)
	local posint = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(place_pos.x), unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(place_pos.z))
	local built = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(build_item.pool):Instantiate(place_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, nil)
	if build_item.over_item then
		self.built_over_instances:Add(built)
		self.built_over_positions:Add(posint)

		local tile = CS.Oak.VirtualFieldObject()
		tile.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		tile.Position = place_pos
		tile.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(build_item.pivot, build_item.size)
		if build_item.is_door then
			tile.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		else
			tile.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
		end
		tile.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.InField
		tile.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		message_system:Send(field, CS.Oak.AddFieldObjectEvent.Create(tile))
		self.built_over_fos:Add(tile)
		self.built_over_ids:Add(build_item.id)

		if build_item.is_door then
			self.doors:Add(built)
			self.door_animation_states:Add(0)
			self.door_angles:Add(0)
			self.door_original_pos:Add(posint)
			self.door_fos:Add(tile)
		end
	else
		self.built_under_instances:Add(built)
		self.built_under_positions:Add(posint)
		self.built_under_ids:Add(build_item.id)
	end

	if update_built_items then
		if self.game_data.built_items[build_item.id] == nil then
			self.game_data.built_items[build_item.id] = {}
		end

		local posintmod = posint - CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.build_anchor_pos.x), unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.build_anchor_pos.z))
		table.insert(self.game_data.built_items[build_item.id], posintmod)
	end
end

function local_class:remove_floor()
	local place_pos = self:get_build_pos()
	local posint = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(place_pos.x), unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(place_pos.z))
	local index = self.built_under_positions:IndexOf(posint)
	if index >= 0 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Common_Jump_small"):Instantiate(place_pos)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_land_02")

		self:remove_from_built_items(self.built_under_ids[index], posint)
		self:refund_build_item(self.built_under_ids[index], place_pos)

		self.built_under_instances[index]:Dispose()
		self.built_under_positions:RemoveAt(index)
		self.built_under_instances:RemoveAt(index)
		self.built_under_ids:RemoveAt(index)
	else
		user_party[0]:Shake(0.08, 0.15)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_rustle_01")
	end
end

function local_class:refund_build_item(item_id, pos)
	local item_spec = self:get_item_spec(item_id)
	local count = 0

	if item_spec.comp2_req ~= nil and item_spec.comp2_req > 0 then
		count = 2
	elseif 	item_spec.comp1_req ~= nil and item_spec.comp1_req > 0 then
		count = 1
	end

	local item1_pos = pos
	local item2_pos = pos

	if count == 0 then
		return
	elseif count == 2 then
		item1_pos = pos - vector(0.3, 0, 0)
		item2_pos = pos + vector(0.3, 0, 0)
	end

	local item_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ItemData')
	for i = 0, count -1 do
		local comp_id = -1
		local comp_amount = 0

		if i == 0 then
			local comp_spec = self:get_item_spec(item_spec.comp1_id)
			comp_id = item_data:GetSpec(comp_spec.name).Id
			comp_amount = item_spec.comp1_req
		elseif i == 1 then
			local comp_spec = self:get_item_spec(item_spec.comp2_id)
			comp_id = item_data:GetSpec(comp_spec.name).Id
			comp_amount = item_spec.comp2_req
		end

		if comp_id >= 0 and comp_amount > 0 then
			local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
			item_placeholder.ItemId = comp_id
			item_placeholder.Amount = comp_amount
			item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true

			if i == 0 then
				CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(pos, item1_pos, item_placeholder, false, true)
			else
				CS.Oak.DropItem.Create(pos, item2_pos, item_placeholder, false, true)
			end
		end


	end
end


function local_class:remove_from_built_items(id, posint)
	local posintmod = posint - CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.build_anchor_pos.x), unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.build_anchor_pos.z))
	local deleted = false

	if self.game_data.built_items[id] ~= nil then
		local poses = self.game_data.built_items[id]
		local delete_index = -1
		for i = 1, #poses do
			if poses[i].x == posintmod.x and poses[i].y == posintmod.y then
				delete_index = i
				break
			end
		end

		if delete_index > 0 then
			table.remove(poses, delete_index)
			deleted = true
		end
	end

	if not deleted then
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Delete Failed")
	end
end

function local_class:reset_buildable(buildable, use_teleport_effect)
	local workstation = get_field_object("workstation")
	local reset_pos = workstation.Position - vector(0, 0, 1)

	if use_teleport_effect then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_reset_object"):Instantiate(buildable.Position)
	end

	buildable.Position = reset_pos
end


function local_class:load_resource()
	self.loaded_stage_index = -1
	if stage.Name == "xm_1_3" then
		self.loaded_stage_index = 3
	elseif stage.Name == "xm_1_1" then
		self.loaded_stage_index = 1
	end
	return util.cs_generator(self.stage_load_resource, self)
end


--- Load data here
function local_class:stage_load_resource()
	-- 오브젝트 풀
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_Common_Jump_small")

	-- 빌딩 오브젝트 풀 로드
	for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
		if self.constants.items[i].pool ~= nil then
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.constants.items[i].pool)
		end
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadItemGetEvent()

	if self.loaded_stage_index == 3 then
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalDataBridge.LoadGameAtStage3(self))
	elseif self.loaded_stage_index == 1 then
		coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalDataBridge.LoadGameAtStage1(self))
	else
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Can't loaded minigame data. Unknown stage name.")
	end


	-- NGUI / FieldUI 어셋 로드
	if self.res_holder == nil then
		self.res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

		-- NGUI
		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/xmas/ui", "XMasSurvivalBuild"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))

		coroutine.yield(self.res_holder:LoadPrefabAsync(CS.Foundations.AssetName("ondemand/xmas/ui", "XMasSurvivalBuildMini"), function(p)
			local menuObj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, p)
			local overlay = menuObj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.IUIOverlay))
			overlay.UISceneManager = stage.UISceneManager
			menuObj:SetActive(false)
		end))
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent) then
		-- 3스테이지 일 때만 FieldUITopHPBarActivationEvent false
		if stage.Name == 'xm_1_3' then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarActivationEvent.Create(false))
		end

		self.game_ended = false
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_marker, self))
	--elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent) then
	--	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarActivationEvent.Create(true))
	--elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent) then
		--message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.FieldUITopHPBarActivationEvent.Create(false))
		--local hp_bar = field_ui_manager:GetSingleUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TopHpBar)
		--if hp_bar ~= nil then
		--	hp_bar.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			--hp_bar.Alpha = 1.0
		--end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEvent) then
		if e.Type == CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.Attempt then
			if e.Target ~= nil or e.BuildTarget ~= nil then
				self:place_buildable(e.Target, e.BuildTarget, e.Holder)
			else
				self:remove_floor()
			end
		elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.Forced then
			if e.Target ~= nil then
				self:reset_buildable(e.Target, true)
			end
			self:update_build_marker(false, e.Target)
			if e.BuildTarget ~= nil then
				-- FIXME: 빌드 아이템 내려놓을 때 이펙트?
				e.BuildTarget:Dispose()
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_rustle_01")

				if lua_helper.reference_equals(ui_scene_manager.CurrentOverlay, CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance) then
					ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
				end
			elseif self.build_removal_mode then
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(ui_scene_manager.CurrentOverlay, CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance) then
					ui_scene_manager:PopOverlay()
				end

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_rustle_01")
				user_party[0]:RefreshWeaponAttachments()
			end
			self.current_build_item = nil
			self.build_removal_mode = false
		elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.HoldStart then
			self:update_build_marker(true, e.Target)
		elseif e.Type == CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEventType.End then
			self:update_build_marker(false, e.Target)
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		if e.Item.NotForInventory then
			local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
			local spec = item_data:GetSpec(e.Item.ItemId)
			if spec ~= nil then
				local this_spec = self:get_item_spec_by_name(spec.Name)
				if this_spec ~= nil then
					self.game_data.inventory[this_spec.id] = self:get_item_count(this_spec.id) + e.Item.Amount
				end
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local workstation = get_field_object("workstation")
		local workstation2 = get_field_object("workstation_build")
		local is_building_site = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, workstation2)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, workstation) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, workstation2) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.open_workstation, self, e.Target, is_building_site))
		else
			-- 벽 파괴
			local index_to_remove = -1
			for i = 0, self.built_over_fos.Count - 1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.built_over_fos[i]) then
					index_to_remove = i
					break
				end
			end

			if index_to_remove >= 0 then
				local fo = self.built_over_fos[index_to_remove]

				if self.loaded_stage_index == 1 then
					if not self:is_workstation_ready() then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_destruction_not_ready_narration, self))
						return false
					end
				end

				music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_explosion_01' })
				local destroy_pos = fo.Bounds.center
				destroy_pos.y = 0
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("FX_dead"):Instantiate(destroy_pos)

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.RemoveFieldObjectEvent.Create(fo))

				local door_index = self.doors:IndexOf(self.built_over_instances[index_to_remove])
				if door_index >= 0 then
					self.doors:RemoveAt(door_index)
					self.door_animation_states:RemoveAt(door_index)
					self.door_angles:RemoveAt(door_index)
					self.door_original_pos:RemoveAt(door_index)
					self.door_fos:RemoveAt(door_index)
				end

				self.built_over_instances[index_to_remove]:Dispose()

				self:remove_from_built_items(self.built_over_ids[index_to_remove], self.built_over_positions[index_to_remove])
				self:refund_build_item(self.built_over_ids[index_to_remove], destroy_pos)

				self.built_over_fos:RemoveAt(index_to_remove)
				self.built_over_instances:RemoveAt(index_to_remove)
				self.built_over_positions:RemoveAt(index_to_remove)
				self.built_over_ids:RemoveAt(index_to_remove)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		if e:GetParamAt(0) == "xmas_survival_weapon_query" then
			local params = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
			local weapon_name = nil
			local current_weapon_power = -1

			for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
				if self.constants.items[i].weapon_name ~= nil then
					if self:get_item_count(self.constants.items[i].id) > 0 then
						if self.constants.items[i].weapon_power > current_weapon_power then
							current_weapon_power = self.constants.items[i].weapon_power
							weapon_name = self.constants.items[i].weapon_name
						end
					end
				end
			end

			params:Add("xmas_survival_weapon_response")
			params:Add(weapon_name)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party[0], params:ToArray()))
		elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == "xmas_survival_build_game_query" then
			local params = create_generic_list(CS.System.String)
			params:Add("xmas_survival_build_game_response")

			-- 휴게실 완성 조건
			local wall_count = 0
			local floor_count = 0
			local chair_count = 0
			local table_count = 0

			if self.game_data.built_items[17] ~= nil then
				floor_count = #self.game_data.built_items[17]
			end

			if self.game_data.built_items[1] ~= nil then

			end

			if self.game_data.built_items[4] ~= nil then
				wall_count = #self.game_data.built_items[4]
			end

			if self.game_data.built_items[2] ~= nil then
				table_count = #self.game_data.built_items[2]
			end

			if wall_count >= 24 and floor_count >= 32 and chair_count >= 4 and table_count >= 2 then
				params:Add("success")
			else
				params:Add("failure")
			end

			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(user_party[0], params:ToArray()))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		local index = self.destructible_names:IndexOf(e.FieldObject.Name)
		if index >= 0 then
			local id = self.destructible_ids[index]
			self.game_data.inventory[id] = self:get_item_count(id) - 1
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent) then
		local build_walker = 0

		if self.loaded_stage_index == 3 then
			local workstation = get_field_object("workstation").Position

			for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
				if self.constants.items[i].builds ~= nil then
					local count = self:get_item_count(self.constants.items[i].id)
					local builds = self.constants.items[i].builds
					if count > 0 then
						for j = 1, count do
							if j > #builds then

							end

							local offset = vector(0, 0, -math.floor(build_walker / 2))
							if build_walker % 2 == 0 then
								offset.x = -1.5
							else

							local fo = get_field_object(builds[j])
							fo.Position = workstation + offset

function local_class:open_workstation(workstation, is_for_building)
	if self.loaded_stage_index == 1 then
		if not self:is_workstation_ready() then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = "xmas_survival_workstation_not_ready" })
			user_party:ResetControllers()
			return
		end

		-- 스테이지 1 에서 처음 작업대를 열면 자동으로 나무 999 개를 넣는다
		if self:get_item_count(10) < 20 then
			self.game_data.inventory[10] = 200
		end
	end

	local target_pos = workstation.Bounds.center
	target_pos.y = 0

	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local target_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	if target_pos.z < user_party[0].Position.z then
		target_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	end

	coroutine.yield(user_party:AlignPartyNew(target_pos, target_dir, 0.5))

	ui_scene_manager:ShowWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject, true)
	local time_start = unity_class.time.time
	-- 저장한다
	coroutine.yield(self:save())

	local time_diff = unity_class.time.time - time_start
	if time_diff < 0.15 then
		wait_for_sec(0.15 - time_diff)
	end
	ui_scene_manager:HideWaitingIndicator(stage.StageGameObject)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_interact_cakeshop_01')
	local menu_state = CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildState()

	if not is_for_building then
		if self.recipe_sprites == nil then
			self.recipe_ids = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.Int32))
			self.recipe_names = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.String))
			self.recipe_sprites = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.String))
			self.recipe_counts = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.Int32))
			self.recipe_maxes = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.Int32))

			for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
				local recipe = self.constants.items[i]
				if recipe.is_recipe and not recipe.is_building then
					self.recipe_ids:Add(recipe.id)
					self.recipe_names:Add(game_string:GetString(recipe.name))
					self.recipe_sprites:Add(recipe.sprite)
					self.recipe_counts:Add(0)
					self.recipe_maxes:Add(recipe.max)
				end
			end
		end

		for i = 0, self.recipe_ids.Count -1 do
			self.recipe_counts[i] = self:get_item_count(self.recipe_ids[i])
		end

		menu_state.RecipeIds = self.recipe_ids
		menu_state.RecipeSprites = self.recipe_sprites
		menu_state.RecipeNames = self.recipe_names
		menu_state.RecipeCounts = self.recipe_counts
		menu_state.RecipeMaxes = self.recipe_maxes
	else
		if self.build_recipe_sprites == nil then
			self.build_recipe_ids = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.Int32))
			self.build_recipe_names = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.String))
			self.build_recipe_sprites = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.String))
			self.build_recipe_counts = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.Int32))
			self.build_recipe_maxes = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.System.Int32))

			for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
				local recipe = self.constants.items[i]
				if recipe.is_recipe and recipe.is_building then
					self.build_recipe_ids:Add(recipe.id)
					self.build_recipe_names:Add(game_string:GetString(recipe.name))
					self.build_recipe_sprites:Add(recipe.sprite)
					self.build_recipe_counts:Add(0)
					self.build_recipe_maxes:Add(recipe.max)
				end
			end
		end

		for i = 0, self.build_recipe_ids.Count -1 do
			local rid = self.build_recipe_ids[i]
			if self.game_data.built_items[rid] ~= nil then
				self.build_recipe_counts[i] = #self.game_data.built_items[rid]
			else
				self.build_recipe_counts[i] = 0
			end
		end

		menu_state.RecipeIds = self.build_recipe_ids
		menu_state.RecipeSprites = self.build_recipe_sprites
		menu_state.RecipeNames = self.build_recipe_names
		menu_state.RecipeCounts = self.build_recipe_counts
		menu_state.RecipeMaxes = self.build_recipe_maxes

	end

	local on_click_recipe = function (recipe_id)
		self:on_click_recipe(recipe_id)
	end

	local on_build_recipe = function (recipe_id)
		self:on_build_recipe(recipe_id, CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuild.Instance.CurrentBuildCount)
	end

	local on_close = function ()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		user_party:ResetControllers()
	end

	menu_state.OnClickRecipe = on_click_recipe
	menu_state.OnBuildRecipe = on_build_recipe
	menu_state.OnCloseAction = on_close

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuild.Instance, menu_state)
end


function local_class:open_build_bar(item_spec)
	local menu_state = CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMiniState()
	if (item_spec ~= nil) then
		menu_state.IconName = item_spec.sprite
		menu_state.UpperText = game_string:GetString(item_spec.name)
		menu_state.IconText = self:get_icon_text(item_spec)
		menu_state.LowerText = self:get_allowed_count_text(item_spec)
	else
		menu_state.IconName = "survival_floor_remove"
		menu_state.UpperText = game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_remove")
		menu_state.LowerText = game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_remove_desc")
		menu_state.IconText = ""
	end

	local height_mod = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 1, (stage.UIRoot.activeHeight - CS.Oak.FieldUIManager.UIHeight) / 240)
	menu_state.HeightOffset = - height_mod * 120

	local on_close = function ()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(ui_scene_manager.CurrentScene, CS.Oak.UI.Pause.Instance) then
			CS.Oak.UI.Pause.Instance:OnBackButtonClick()
			--TODO : 빈 팝업 띄워서 임의로 조치 취해줌 추후 C#에서 추가 수정이 필요
			local state = CS.Oak.UI.PopUpState()
			CS.Oak.UI.UISceneManager.Instance:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp.Instance, state, typeof(CS.Oak.UI.PopUp))
		else
			local action_state = user_party[0].FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
			if action_state ~= nil and action_state:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutState) then
				if action_state.IsHolding then
					action_state:ForceReturnTarget()
				end
			end
		end
	end

	menu_state.OnCloseAction = on_close

	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance, menu_state)
end

function local_class:on_build_mini_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.UiSceneChangeEvent) then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(ui_scene_manager.CurrentOverlay, CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance) then
			return true;
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(ui_scene_manager.CurrentScene, CS.Oak.UI.Pause.Instance) then
			CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		else
			CS.Oak.UI.XMasSurvivalBuildMini.Instance.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		end

		return true;
	end

	return false;

function local_class:get_icon_text(item_spec)
	local max = item_spec.max
	local current = 0
	if self.game_data.built_items[item_spec.id] ~= nil then
		current = #self.game_data.built_items[item_spec.id]
	end

	return CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("n_out_of_m", current, max)
end

function local_class:get_allowed_count_text(item_spec)
	local comp1_limit = 9999
	local comp2_limit = 9999

	local max = item_spec.max
	local current = 0
	if self.game_data.built_items[item_spec.id] ~= nil then
		current = #self.game_data.built_items[item_spec.id]
	end

	local max_limit = max - current

	if item_spec.comp1_req ~= nil and item_spec.comp1_req > 0 then
		local has = self:get_item_count(item_spec.comp1_id)
		comp1_limit = unity_class.mathf.FloorToInt(has / item_spec.comp1_req)
	end

	if item_spec.comp2_req ~= nil and item_spec.comp2_req > 0 then
		local has = self:get_item_count(item_spec.comp2_id)
		comp2_limit = unity_class.mathf.FloorToInt(has / item_spec.comp2_req)
	end

	local total_limit = math.min(comp1_limit, comp2_limit, max_limit)

	if total_limit <= 0 then
		if total_limit == max_limit then
			return game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_button_full")
		else
			return game_string:GetString("xmas_survival_build_button_insufficient")
		end
	else
		return CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("xmas_survival_build_allowed", total_limit)
	end
end

function local_class:get_allowed_count(item_spec)
	local comp1_limit = 9999
	local comp2_limit = 9999

	local max = item_spec.max
	local current = 0
	if self.game_data.built_items[item_spec.id] ~= nil then
		current = #self.game_data.built_items[item_spec.id]
	end

	local max_limit = max - current

	if item_spec.comp1_req ~= nil and item_spec.comp1_req > 0 then
		local has = self:get_item_count(item_spec.comp1_id)
		comp1_limit = unity_class.mathf.FloorToInt(has / item_spec.comp1_req)
	end

	if item_spec.comp2_req ~= nil and item_spec.comp2_req > 0 then
		local has = self:get_item_count(item_spec.comp2_id)
		comp2_limit = unity_class.mathf.FloorToInt(has / item_spec.comp2_req)
	end

	local total_limit = math.min(comp1_limit, comp2_limit, max_limit)
	return total_limit
end



function local_class:check_marker()
	while true do
		local action_state = user_party[0].FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState
		if action_state ~= nil and action_state:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutState) then
			if action_state.IsHolding then
				self:update_build_marker(true, action_state.Target)
			end
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		if self.game_ended then
			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_build_pos()
	if self.current_build_item == nil and not self.build_removal_mode then
		local pos = user_party[0].Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party[0].Direction) * 1.0 + vector(0, self.build_y_offset, 0)
		return pos
	else
		local pos = user_party[0].Position + CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(user_party[0].Direction) * 1.0 + vector(0, self.build_y_offset, 0)
		if user_party[0].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left and self.current_build_item ~= nil and self.current_build_item.place_left_offset ~= nil then
			pos = pos + self.current_build_item.place_left_offset
		elseif user_party[0].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up and self.current_build_item ~= nil and self.current_build_item.place_up_offset ~= nil then
			pos = pos + self.current_build_item.place_up_offset
		elseif user_party[0].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right and self.current_build_item ~= nil and self.current_build_item.place_right_offset ~= nil then
			pos = pos + self.current_build_item.place_right_offset
		elseif user_party[0].Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Down and self.current_build_item ~= nil and self.current_build_item.place_down_offset ~= nil then
			pos = pos + self.current_build_item.place_down_offset
		end


		return vector(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(pos.x), pos.y, unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(pos.z))
	end
end

function local_class:can_place_at(pos, target, size, pivot)
	local y = field:GetGroundPositionAt(pos).y
	if math.abs(pos.y - y) > 0.1 then
		return false
	end

	local is_under = false
	if self.current_build_item ~= nil and not  self.current_build_item.over_item then
		is_under = true
		local posint = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(pos.x), unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(pos.z))
		if self.built_under_positions:IndexOf(posint) >= 0 then
			return false
		end
	end


	local pivot_offset = vector((0.5 - pivot.x) * size.x, 0, (0.5 - pivot.z) * size.y)
	local bounds = CS.UnityEngine.Bounds(pos + pivot_offset, vector(pivot.x, 1, pivot.z))
	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(pos, bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo_list[i], user_party[0]) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(fo_list[i], target) then
			local is_it_party = false
			for j = 1, user_party.Count -1 do
				if lua_helper.reference_equals(fo_list[i], user_party[j]) then
					is_it_party = true
					break
				end
			end

			local is_under_wall = false
			if is_under then
				if self.built_over_fos:IndexOf(fo_list[i]) >= 0 then
					is_under_wall = true
				end
			end

			if not is_it_party and not is_under_wall then
				return false
			end
		end
	end

	fo_list:Dispose()
	return true
end

function local_class:update_build_marker(show, target)
	local pos = self:get_build_pos() + vector(0, 0.01, 0)
	local pos_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
	local size = vector(1,1)
	local pivot = vector(0.5, 0, 0.5)
	if self.current_build_item ~= nil then
		pivot = self.current_build_item.pivot
		local pivot_diff = vector(0.5, 0, 0.5) - self.current_build_item.pivot
		pos_offset = vector(pivot_diff.x * self.current_build_item.size.x, 0, pivot_diff.z * self.current_build_item.size.z)
		size.x = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.current_build_item.size.x)
		size.y = unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(self.current_build_item.size.z)
	end

	local can_place_at = false
	if not self.build_removal_mode then
		can_place_at = self:can_place_at(pos, target, size, pivot)
	else
		local posint = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(pos.x), unity_class.mathf.RoundToInt(pos.z))
		can_place_at = self.built_under_positions:IndexOf(posint) >= 0
	end

	if show then
		local size_index = 1
		if self.build_markers_success == nil then
			self.build_markers_success = {}
			self.build_markers_fail = {}
			self.build_markers_size = {}
		end

		local size_found = false
		for i = 1, #self.build_markers_size do
			if self.build_markers_size[i].x == size.x and self.build_markers_size[i].y == size.y then
				size_found = true
				size_index = i
				break
			end
		end

		if not size_found then
			local light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76)
			local dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153)
			local marker_success = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector(0, 0, 0), size, light_color, dark_color)
			marker_success:Hide()

			light_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 70, 53, 76)
			dark_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 70, 53, 153)
			local marker_fail = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector(0, 0, 0), size, light_color, dark_color)
			marker_fail:Hide()

			table.insert(self.build_markers_success, marker_success)
			table.insert(self.build_markers_fail, marker_fail)
			table.insert(self.build_markers_size, size)

			size_index = #self.build_markers_size

			self.build_marker_success_shown = false
			self.build_marker_fail_shown = false
		end

		if self.build_removal_mode then
			if self.build_remove_icon == nil then
				self.build_remove_icon = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate("stage_item"):Instantiate(pos)
				local stage_item = self.build_remove_icon:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageItem))
				stage_item:SetItem("shovel", 0.025)
				stage_item.Item.localPosition = vector(0, 0, 0)
				stage_item.ShadowActive = false
			end

			self.build_remove_icon.transform.position = pos + vector(0, 0.01, 0)
		end

		if can_place_at then
			if not self.build_marker_success_shown then
				self.build_markers_success[size_index]:Show(0)
				self.build_marker_success_shown = true
			end

			if self.build_marker_fail_shown then
				self.build_markers_fail[size_index]:Hide()
				self.build_marker_fail_shown = false
			end

			self.build_markers_success[size_index].CacheTransform.position = pos + pos_offset
		else
			if not self.build_marker_fail_shown then
				self.build_markers_fail[size_index]:Show(0)
				self.build_marker_fail_shown = true
			end

			if self.build_marker_success_shown then
				self.build_markers_success[size_index]:Hide()
				self.build_marker_success_shown = false
			end

			self.build_markers_fail[size_index].CacheTransform.position = pos + pos_offset
		end

	else
		if self.build_marker_success_shown then
			for i = 1, #self.build_markers_success do
				self.build_markers_success[i]:Hide()
			end
			self.build_marker_success_shown = false
		end

		if self.build_marker_fail_shown then
			for i = 1, #self.build_markers_fail do
				self.build_markers_fail[i]:Hide()
			end
			self.build_marker_fail_shown = false
		end

		if self.build_remove_icon ~= nil then
			self.build_remove_icon:Dispose()
			self.build_remove_icon = nil
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalPutEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MoveFieldObjectEvent), 'on_field_object_move')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	self.game_ended = true
	if self.game_data_loaded then
		self:generate_spawned_items()
		if self.loaded_stage_index == 3 then
			CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalDataBridge.SaveGameAtStage3(self.game_data)
		elseif self.loaded_stage_index == 1 then
			CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalDataBridge.SaveGameAtStage1(self.game_data)
		end
	end

	--구독 해재
	if self.subscribe_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.UiSceneChangeEvent), self.subscribe_func)
		self.subscribe_func = nil
	end
end

--- XMasSurvivalDataBridge 의 클래스 확인
function local_class:load(data)
	local data_class = require('minigame/XMasSurvival/XMasSurvivalData')
	self.game_data = data_class.create(data)
	self.game_data_loaded = true

	-- FIXME HACK. 크리스마스 메인 퀘스트 섹션 4 에 도달하기 전까진 그냥 처음 시작시 모든걸 리셋한다
	local xmas_main_quest_id = 60045
	local q = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(xmas_main_quest_id)
	if (q ~= nil and not q.IsComplete and q.InnerProgress < 3) or (self.loaded_stage_index == 3 and q ~= nil and not q.IsComplete and q.InnerProgress < 9) then
		self.game_data.inventory = {}
		self.game_data.unlocked_tools = {}
		self.game_data.put_items = {}
		self.game_data.built_items = {}
		CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Force resetting data")
	end
end

function local_class:save()
	self:generate_spawned_items()

	local save_success = true
	local on_error = function (ex)
		save_success = false
	end

	local fail_count = 0
	while true do
		save_success = true

		local r = nil
		if self.loaded_stage_index == 3 then
			r = CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalDataBridge.SaveGameAtStage3Async(self.game_data, nil, on_error)
		elseif self.loaded_stage_index == 1 then
			r = CS.Oak.XMasSurvivalDataBridge.SaveGameAtStage1Async(self.game_data, nil, on_error)
		else
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Unknown stage name - can't save minigame")
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(r)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		if not save_success then
			fail_count = fail_count + 1
			CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("XMasSurvival : Save Retry")
			wait_for_sec(5.0 + fail_count)
		else
			break
		end
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.25)
end

function local_class:generate_spawned_items()
	-- game_data.built_items 로부터 저장할 spawned_items 제작
	-- (255, item_index) 이후 그 해당 아이템의 위치를 저장하는 실제 포지션들을 저장하는 방식
	self.game_data.spawned_items = {}
	for item_index,positions in pairs(self.game_data.built_items) do
		local p = CS.UnityEngine.Vector2Int(255, item_index)
		table.insert(self.game_data.spawned_items, p)

		for i = 1, #positions do
			table.insert(self.game_data.spawned_items, positions[i])
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_item_count(id)
	for i = 1, #self.game_data.unlocked_tools do
		if self.game_data.unlocked_tools[i] == id then
			return 1
		end
	end

	if self.game_data.inventory[id] ~= nil then
		return self.game_data.inventory[id]
	end

	return 0
end

function local_class:get_item_spec(id)
	for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
		if self.constants.items[i].id == id then
			return self.constants.items[i]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:get_item_spec_by_name(name)
	for i = 1, #self.constants.items do
		if self.constants.items[i].name == name then
			return self.constants.items[i]
		end
	end

	return nil
end

function local_class:door_loop()
	local angle_speed = 540
	local open_max = 85

	--FIXME: 일단 도어는 1x1 이고 열리는 피봇은 무조건 오른쪽이라고 가정
	local pivot = vector(1.25, 0, 0)

	while true do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		for i = 0, self.doors.Count -1 do
			local update_angle = false
			if self.door_animation_states[i] == 1 then
				update_angle = true
				self.door_angles[i] = self.door_angles[i] + angle_speed * dt
				if self.door_angles[i] >= open_max then
					self.door_angles[i] = open_max
					self.door_animation_states[i] = 0
				end
			elseif self.door_animation_states[i] == -1 or self.door_animation_states[i] == 0 then
				local intersects = user_party[0].Bounds:Intersects(self.door_fos[i].Bounds)
				if intersects then
					if self.door_animation_states[i] == -1 then
						self.door_animation_states[i] = 1
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_door_push_01")
					elseif self.door_animation_states[i] == 0 and self.door_angles[i] == 0 then
						self.door_animation_states[i] = 1
						music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_door_push_01")
					end
				elseif self.door_animation_states[i] == -1 then
					update_angle = true
					self.door_angles[i] = self.door_angles[i] - angle_speed * dt
					if self.door_angles[i] <= 0 then
						self.door_angles[i] = 0
						self.door_animation_states[i] = 0
					end
				elseif not intersects and self.door_animation_states[i] == 0 and self.door_angles[i] > 0 then
					if (self.door_fos[i].Bounds.center - user_party[0].Bounds.center).magnitude >= 3 then
						self.door_animation_states[i] = -1
					end
				end
			end

			if update_angle then
				local rot = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(self.door_angles[i], unity_class.vector3.up)
				self.doors[i].transform.rotation = rot
				local rotated_pivot = rot * pivot
				self.doors[i].transform.position = vector(self.door_original_pos[i].x + pivot.x - rotated_pivot.x, 0, self.door_original_pos[i].y + pivot.z - rotated_pivot.z)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:is_workstation_ready()
	local xmas_main_quest_id = 60045
	local q = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(xmas_main_quest_id)
	return q ~= nil and (q.IsComplete or q.InnerProgress >= 3)
end

function local_class:show_destruction_not_ready_narration()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = "xmas_survival_destruction_not_ready" })
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end


return {
	create = function(cs_controller, scene)
		return local_class(cs_controller, scene)
	end
}

require('base/class')

local local_class = newclass('XMasSurvivalData')

-- cs_data 기반으로 내부 데이터를 생성 하는 클래스.
-- data 가 없을 때에는 초기화 (아마 모든 초반 생성을 start_new_data 를 통해 진행 하면 될듯)
function local_class:init(cs_data)
	-- construction
	self.unlocked_tools = {}
	self.inventory = {}
	self.put_items = {}
	self.built_items = {}

	if cs_data == nil then
		self:start_new_data()
		return
	end

	-- load routine
	for index = 0, cs_data.UnlockedTools.Count -1 do
		table.insert(self.unlocked_tools, cs_data.UnlockedTools[index])
	end

	for k,v in pairs(cs_data.Inventory) do
		self.inventory[k] = v
	end

	for k, v in pairs(cs_data.ItemLocations) do
		local pos_list = cs_data.ItemLocations[k]
		local lua_pos_list = {}
		for index = 0, pos_list.Count - 1 do
			table.insert(lua_pos_list, pos_list[index])
		end

		self.put_items[k] = lua_pos_list
	end

	-- 만들어진 아이템들 경로
	local current_item_index = -1
	for index = 0, cs_data.SpawnedItemLocations.Count - 1 do
		-- Vector2Int
		local pos = cs_data.SpawnedItemLocations[index]
		if pos.x == 255 then
			current_item_index = pos.y
		else
			if current_item_index == -1 then
				CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError("Incorrect built items format")
				break
			end

			if self.built_items[current_item_index] == nil then
				self.built_items[current_item_index] = {}
			end

			table.insert(self.built_items[current_item_index], pos)
		end
	end
end

-- 여기서 새로운 게임 데이터들을 생성 하면 됩니다.
function local_class:start_new_data()

end


return {
	create = function(init_data)
		return local_class(init_data)
	end
}

	self.is_special_move_tutorial = false
