function local_class:load_resource(key, load_end_callback)
	-- 데이터 세팅
	local before_data_key = self.constants_data_key
	self.constants_data_key = key
	if self.game_data == nil or before_data_key ~= self.constants_data_key then
		-- 게임 데이터 세팅
		xm_df_constants_manager.set_constants_data_key(self.constants_data_key)
		self.game_data = xm_df_constants_manager.get_constants_data()
	end

	-- 적 스폰 데이터 세팅
	self.enemy_spawn_data = self.game_data.enemy_spawn_data
	self.enemy_spawn_count = 1
	self.enemy_spawn_delay = 0

	-- 에너지 초기화
	self.cur_energy = xm_df_constants_manager.get_start_energy()
	self.max_energy = xm_df_constants_manager.get_max_energy()

	-- 필살기 상태 초기화
	self.cur_special_move_state = self.special_move_state.none
	self.active_special_move_hp_ratio = xm_df_constants_manager.get_active_special_move_hp_ratio()

	-- 이벤트 타입
	self.event_type = xm_df_constants_manager.get_event_type()
	self.is_show_event = self.event_type == nil

	-- 타겟 퀘스트에서 xm_defense_game_special_move 값이 0보다 작으면 튜토리얼은 보지 않은 것이므로 false
	local target_quest_id = xm_df_constants_manager.get_target_quest_id()
	if target_quest_id > 0 then
		local quest_progress = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(target_quest_id)
		local custom_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(quest_progress, 'xm_defense_game_special_move')
		self.is_show_special_move_tutorial = custom_state > 0
	else
		self.is_show_special_move_tutorial = true
	end

	-- 리더 캐릭터 세팅
	local leader_name = xm_df_constants_manager.get_leader_character()
	if self.leader_character == nil and leader_name ~= nil then
		self.leader_character = get_character(leader_name)
		self.leader_character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character)
		character_util.set_active_state(self.leader_character, 'enabled')
		field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.leader_character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	elseif self.leader_character ~= nil and leader_name ~= nil then
		self.leader_character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character)
	end

	-- 유닛 매니져 세팅
	if self.unit_manager == nil then
		self.unit_manager = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameUnitManager')
	end

	return util.cs_generator(self.on_load_resource, self, load_end_callback)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	-- 디펜스 게임용 카메라 세팅
	self:set_defense_camera(res_holder)

	-- 캐릭터 매니져 로드 리소스
	self.unit_manager:on_load_resource()

	-- 아군 진영 정보 세팅
	self.ally_data = {}
	self.ally_data.cur_population = 0

	local marker_name = xm_df_constants_manager.get_spawn_marker(true)
	self.ally_data.spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position

	marker_name = xm_df_constants_manager.get_tower_pos_marker(true)
	self.ally_data.tower = self.unit_manager:ally_tower_spawn(field:GetMarker(marker_name).position)

	-- 아군 타워 애니메이션 idle로 변경
	local ally_tower_fo = self.ally_data.tower:get_unit()
	ally_tower_fo.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	ally_tower_fo.SpineController.SpineOffset = ally_tower_fo.SpineController.SpineOffset - vector(0, 0, 0.25)
	character_util.set_anim(ally_tower_fo, { name = 'idle' })

	-- 적군 진영 정보 세팅
	self.enemy_data = {}
	self.enemy_data.cur_population = 0

	marker_name = xm_df_constants_manager.get_spawn_marker(false)
	self.enemy_data.spawn_pos = field:GetMarker(marker_name).position

	marker_name = xm_df_constants_manager.get_tower_pos_marker(false)
	self.enemy_data.tower = self.unit_manager:enemy_tower_spawn(field:GetMarker(marker_name).position)

	-- UI 컨트롤러 리소스 로드, 컨트롤러가 지정되있지 않을 때만 호출
	if self.ui_controller == nil then
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
				res_holder, 'ondemand/short_story_xm/ui', 'ShortStoryXMDefenseUI', function(prefab)
					self.ui_controller_prefab = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
					self.ui_controller = self.ui_controller_prefab:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.XMDefense)).GetControllerLuaTable
				end)

		-- 유닛 소환 버튼 콜백 등록
		self.ui_controller:set_summon_buttons(self, self.spawn_ally)
		self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_button(self, self.on_click_special_move)
	else
		-- 이미 생성된 상태면 리셋만
		self:reset_ui_controller()
	end

	-- UI들 비활성화
	self:set_top_ui_active_state(false)
	self:set_bottom_ui_active_state(false)
	res_holder:Dispose()

	-- 승리시 출력될 엑티비티 클리어 이팩트 프리로드
	self.get_fanfare()
	self.get_smoke_effect()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')

	-- 리더가 세팅되어 있다면 AlwaysUpdateSpine false
	if self.leader_character ~= nil then
		self.leader_character.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end

	if load_end_callback then
		load_end_callback()
	end
end

function local_class:reset_ui_controller()
	self.ui_controller:set_current_population(self.ally_data.cur_population)

	self.ui_controller:update_ally_tower_hp(self.ally_data.tower.hp, self.ally_data.tower.max_hp)
	self.ui_controller:update_enemy_tower_hp(self.enemy_data.tower.hp, self.enemy_data.tower.max_hp)
	self.ui_controller:update_energy(self.cur_energy)

	self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_button_active_state(true)
	self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_skill_active_state(false)
end

function local_class:set_defense_camera(res_holder)
	-- 게임 중에는 stage_camera에 있는 오디오 리스너는 disable 처리 한다.
	if self.stage_audio_listener == nil then
		self.stage_audio_listener = stage_camera:GetComponentInParent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.AudioListener))
	end
	self.stage_audio_listener.enabled = false

	-- 카메라가 이미 세팅 되어 있는 상태라면 return
	if self.camera_prefab ~= nil then
		self.camera.Transform.localPosition = vector(0, self.camera.Transform.localPosition.y
		, self.camera.Transform.localPosition.z)
		self.camera_prefab:SetActive(true)
		self.camera_audio_listener.enabled = true
		return
	end

	self.camera_prefab = load_util.load_prefab_async(res_holder, 'ondemand/short_story_xm/ui'
	, 'xm_defense_game')
	self.camera = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.camera_prefab.transform, 'Camera'):GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.Oak.MobileTouchCameraWrapper))
	self.camera_offset = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(self.camera_prefab.transform, 'offset')

	-- ViewportScaler
	local vps = stage_camera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ViewportScaler))
	vps.enabled = false
	local new_vps = self.camera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ViewportScaler))
	new_vps.enabled = true
	vps.enabled = true

	-- 카메라에 달린 오디오 리스너를 enabled 시켜준다.
	self.camera_audio_listener = self.camera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.AudioListener))
	self.camera_audio_listener.enabled = true

	local zoom_size = xm_df_constants_manager.get_camera_zoom_size()
	self.camera.CamZoomMin = zoom_size
	self.camera.CamZoomMax = zoom_size
	self.camera_prefab.transform.localPosition = xm_df_constants_manager.get_camera_pos()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.is_playing_game then
		self:unsubscribe_event()
	end

	self.is_playing_game = false

	-- 스폰 데이터 nil
	self.enemy_spawn_data = nil

	self:dispose_unit_manager()
	self:dispose_ui_controller()
	self:dispose_camera_prefab()

	self.game_data = nil

	self.cs_controller = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(_)
	return false
end

-- 미니게임 시작
function local_class:game_start()
	if self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	-- 필요한 field UI는 활성화 필요없는건 비활성화
	self:set_active_field_ui_part(false)
	self:set_active_field_ui(true)

	-- 컨트롤 블록 false
	self:set_control_block(false)

	-- 버튼 활성화
	self:set_top_ui_active_state(true)
	self:set_bottom_ui_active_state(true)

	-- 해당 미니게임의 event_type이 nil 아니면서 enemy_tower_hp_ratio이면 적군 타워 immortal 세팅
	if self.event_type ~= nil and #self.event_type >= 4 and self.event_type[4] then
		self.enemy_data.tower:set_immortal(true)
	else
		self.enemy_data.tower:set_immortal(false)
	end

	-- 패드 사용 중인지 체크해서 사용할 값 세팅
	self.is_using_pad = CS.Oak.Game.Instance.InputManager.GamepadEnabled
	if self.is_using_pad then
		self.pad_camera_move_speed = xm_df_constants_manager.get_pad_camera_move_speed()
		self.pad_camera_max_range = xm_df_constants_manager.get_pad_camera_max_range()

		-- 패드 방향 none으로 세팅
		self.cur_move_pad_dir = self.move_pad_dir.none
	end

	-- 미니게임 시작
	self.is_playing_game = true
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.game_routine, self))
end

function local_class:set_active_field_ui_part(is_active)
	if is_active then
		field_ui_manager:ShowTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	else
		field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton |
				CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState
				| CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	end
end

function local_class:set_active_field_ui(is_active)
	if is_active then
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	else
		field_ui_manager:Hide()
	end
end

-- 게임 로직
function local_class:game_routine()
	-- 타워의 hp를 확인해서 게임오버 체크
	local check_game_over = function()
		if self.enemy_data.tower.hp <= 0 then
			self.is_clear = true
			self.is_playing_game = false
		elseif self.ally_data.tower.hp <= 0 then
			self.is_clear = false
			self.is_playing_game = false
		end
	end

	-- 이벤트 체크
	local check_event_ending = function()
		-- 이벤트가 있으면서 이벤트를 본상태에서 무조건 승리라면 is_clear를 true로 변경
		if self.event_type ~= nil and self.event_type[3]
				and self.is_show_event then
			self.is_clear = true
		end
	end

	-- 이벤트 구독
	self:subscribe_event()

	self.is_clear = false
	self.is_control_block = false
	self.is_active_enemy_spawn = true

	-- 게임 시작 체크용
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

	while self.is_playing_game do
		dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.is_play_leader_anim then
			self.cur_leader_anim_time = self.cur_leader_anim_time + dt
			if self.cur_leader_anim_time > 1 then
				self.is_play_leader_anim = false
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character)
			end
		end

		-- 필살기 연출 때는 적군 생성 및 에너지는 업데이트 하지 않는다.
		if not self.is_special_move_tutorial then
			-- 에너지 업데이트
			self:update_energy(dt)

			-- 적군 생성 루틴
			self:enemy_spawn_routine(dt)
		end

		-- 패드 사용중 일 때 패드 조작키 상태 체크
		if self.is_using_pad then
			self:check_pad_move(dt)
		end

		-- 유닛 로직 업데이트
		self:update_unit_manager(dt)

		-- 게임오버 체크
		check_game_over()

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 터치 블록
	self:set_control_block(true)

	-- 게임 끝났으니 구독 해지
	self:unsubscribe_event()

	-- 화살 제거
	self.unit_manager:hide_arrow()

	-- 오디오 리스너 원복
	self:restore_audio_listener()

	-- 승리 모션 연출
	self:directing_game_end()

	-- 이벤트 체크해서 조건이 충족하면 무조건 승리로 바꿔줌
	check_event_ending()

	-- 성공 실패 여부 리턴
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent.Create(self.game_name, self.is_clear))
end

-- 필살기 활성화
function local_class:active_special_move()
	-- 필살기 버튼 활성화
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_02')
	self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_skill_active_state(true)

	if self.is_show_special_move_tutorial then
		-- 필살기 사용할 때 출력할 string 출력 null이면 출력하지 않음
		local string_key = xm_df_constants_manager.get_special_move_string_key()
		if string_key ~= nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			local param = speech_bubble.generate_param(user_party.Leader, game_string:GetString(string_key))
			param.Speaker = self.camera.Transform
			param.Offset = vector(-2, -0.5, 0.5)
			param.BubbleDirection = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.None
			param.Scale = 1.25
			param.EulerAngle = vector(90, 0, 0)
			param.BubbleType = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleNew.BubbleType.Shout
			coroutine.yield(speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(param))
		end
	else
		-- 튜토리얼 시작
		self.is_show_special_move_tutorial = true
		self.is_special_move_tutorial = true

		-- 타워 및 살아 있는 유닛들 무적으로 만들고 튜토리얼 알림 ui 출력
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
		self:set_active_field_ui(false)
		self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_tutorial_notice(true)
		self:set_tower_invincible(true)
		self:set_alive_unit_invincible(true)

		-- 튜토리얼 Darken
		field:Darken('tutorial', 0.5, 0.1)

		-- 이대로는 위험해! 내 힘을 써야겠어!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		local param = speech_bubble.generate_param(user_party.Leader, game_string:GetString('xm_defense_game_special_move_2'))
		param.Speaker = self.camera.Transform
		param.Offset = vector(-2, -0.5, 0.5)
		param.BubbleDirection = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.None
		param.Scale = 1.25
		param.EulerAngle = vector(90, 0, 0)
		param.BubbleType = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleNew.BubbleType.Shout
		coroutine.yield(speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(param))
	end
end

-- 필살기 버튼 눌렀을 때
function local_class:on_click_special_move()
	if self.cur_special_move_state ~= self.special_move_state.active then
		return
	end

	-- 필살기 사용하라고 나오는 말풍선 삭제
	CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleManager.Instance:Return(self.camera.Transform)

	-- 필살기 상태 사용한 것으로 변경
	self.cur_special_move_state = self.special_move_state.used

	-- 필살기 버튼 비활성화
	self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_button_active_state(false)

	-- 타워 무적 상태로 변경
	self:set_tower_invincible(true)

	-- 튜토리얼 중이면 필살기 타입을 튜토리얼로 변경
	local special_move_type = 'normal'
	if self.is_special_move_tutorial then
		-- 살아 있는 유닛 무적 해제
		self:set_alive_unit_invincible(false)

		special_move_type = 'tutorial'
		field:Undarken('tutorial', 0.1)
		self:set_active_field_ui(true)
		self.ui_controller:set_ultimate_tutorial_notice(false)
	end

	-- 해당 미니게임을 진행하는 섹션에서 필살기 연출 처리할 수 있도록 CustomStateEvent 발행
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'xm_defense_special_move', special_move_type }))
end

function local_class:directing_game_end()
	local ally_unit_list = self.unit_manager:get_is_using_ally()
	for _, unit_list in pairs(ally_unit_list) do
		for _, ally in pairs(unit_list) do
			if ally:is_battle() and ally.unit_data.class ~= 'tower' then
				ally:force_dispose()
				local unit = ally:get_unit()
				local ani = self.is_clear and ally.unit_data.win_anim or ally.unit_data.lose_anim
				local emo = self.is_clear and 'smile' or 'damaged'
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(unit, { name = ani, loop = self.is_clear }
				, { name = emo })
			end
		end
	end

	local enemy_unit_list = self.unit_manager:get_is_using_enemy()
	for _, unit_list in pairs(enemy_unit_list) do
		for _, enemy in pairs(unit_list) do
			if enemy:is_battle() and enemy.unit_data.class ~= 'tower' and enemy.unit_data.class ~= 'boss' then
				enemy:force_dispose()
				local unit = enemy:get_unit()
				local ani = self.is_clear and enemy.unit_data.lose_anim or enemy.unit_data.win_anim
				local emo = self.is_clear and 'damaged' or 'smile'
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(unit, { name = ani, loop = self.is_clear == false }
				, { name = emo })
			end
		end
	end

	-- UI들 비활성화
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	self:set_top_ui_active_state(false)
	self:set_bottom_ui_active_state(false)

	if self.is_clear then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		if self.leader_character ~= nil then
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character
			, { name = 'victory_extra' }, { name = 'doyagao' })
		end

		-- 포탈 사라지는 연출
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local current_time = 0
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_portal_11')
		while not self.enemy_data.tower.end_tower_break_event do
			dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
			current_time = current_time + dt
			self.enemy_data.tower:update_action_state(dt)
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		wait_for_sec(0.25)

		-- 0.1초 후 팡파레 이팩트 출력
		self.crowd_clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_clap_03'
		, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		local fanfare = self.get_fanfare():Instantiate(unity_class.vector3.zero)
		fanfare.transform.localScale = vector(0.00278, 0.00278, 0.00278)

		-- 0.1초 후 엑티비티 클리어 출력
		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()
	else
		if self.event_type == nil or (self.event_type[3] and not self.is_show_event) then
			if self.leader_character ~= nil then
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character
				, { name = 'dead', loop = false }, { name = 'damaged' })
			end

			-- 패배할 때 타워(트리) 애니메이션 dead로 변경
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_destroy_tree_02')
			character_util.set_anim(self.ally_data.tower:get_unit(), { name = 'dead', loop = false })
			wait_for_sec(1.55)
			local smoke_pos = self.ally_data.tower:get_unit().Position - vector(3, 0.1, 0.5)
			self.get_smoke_effect():Instantiate(smoke_pos)

			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 0 })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_02')
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString('xm_defense_game_2'), 1)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_unique_clear()
	return self.is_show_event and self.is_clear and self.event_type ~= nil and self.event_type[3]
end

--
function local_class:dispose_mini_game_while_playing()
	-- 스폰 데이터 nil
	self.enemy_spawn_data = nil

	self:dispose_unit_manager()
	self:dispose_ui_controller()
	self:dispose_camera_prefab()

	-- UI 원복
	self:set_active_field_ui_part(true)
end

--region Event

function local_class:on_pause_start_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	self:set_control_block(true)
	self.ui_controller:pause()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pause_end_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	self:set_control_block(false)
	self.ui_controller:resume()
	return true
end

function local_class:on_chat_mode_on_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	self:set_control_block(true)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_chat_mode_off_event(_)
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return false
	end

	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()
	self:set_control_block(false)
	return true
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'xm_defense_special_move_end'
			and self.cur_special_move_state == self.special_move_state.used then
		-- 타워 무적 상태 해지
		self:set_tower_invincible(false)

		-- 적군 전체에게 데미지
		self.unit_manager:active_skill()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_gamepad_event(e)
	if not self.is_using_pad or self.is_control_block then
		return false
	end

	if e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonDown then
		-- 오른쪽으로 가는 버튼 누르고 있을 때
		self.cur_move_pad_dir = self.move_pad_dir.right
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadRightButtonUp
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickRightButtonUp then
		-- 오른쪽으로 가는 버튼을 놓았을 때
		self.cur_move_pad_dir = self.move_pad_dir.none
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonDown
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonDown then
		-- 왼쪽으로 가는 버튼 누르고 있을 때
		self.cur_move_pad_dir = self.move_pad_dir.left
		return true
	elseif e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.DpadLeftButtonUp
			or e.GamepadEventType == CS.Oak.GamepadEventType.LeftStickLeftButtonUp then
		-- 왼쪽으로 가는 버튼을 놓았을 때
		self.cur_move_pad_dir = self.move_pad_dir.none
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--endregion

-- 패드 움직임 체크 함수
function local_class:check_pad_move(dt)
	-- 패드 방향이 none이면 return
	if self.cur_move_pad_dir == self.move_pad_dir.none then
		return
	end

	-- 컨트롤 블록 걸렸을 경우에는 none으로 바꾸고 return
	if self.is_control_block then
		self.cur_move_pad_dir = self.move_pad_dir.none
		return
	end

	-- 방향에 맞는 위치로 이동시켜준다.
	local start_pos = self.camera.Transform.localPosition
	local cur_x = start_pos.x
	local is_right = self.cur_move_pad_dir == self.move_pad_dir.right
	local add_pos_x = self.pad_camera_move_speed * (is_right and dt or -dt)
	cur_x = cur_x + add_pos_x
	if cur_x > -self.pad_camera_max_range and cur_x < self.pad_camera_max_range then
		self.camera.Transform.localPosition = vector(cur_x, start_pos.y, start_pos.z)
	end
end

-- 유닛 업데이트
function local_class:update_unit_manager(dt)
	-- 유닛 매니저 로직
	self.unit_manager:update_frame(dt)

	-- 아군 데미지 관련 로직 true를 리턴한다면 타워에 데미지를 받은 것이니 아군 타워 Hp 갱신
	local is_apply = self.unit_manager:ally_apply_damage()
	if is_apply then
		self:update_ally_tower_hp()
	end

	-- 적군 데미지 관련 로직 true를 리턴한다면 타워에 데미지를 받은 것이니 적군 타워 Hp 갱신
	is_apply = self.unit_manager:enemy_apply_damage()
	if is_apply then
		self:update_enemy_tower_hp()
	end
end

-- 아군 타워 hp 갱신
function local_class:update_ally_tower_hp()
	-- 타워 hp 갱신 중 아군 타워의 hp가 active_special_move_hp_ratio 보다 낮아졌을 때 필살기 활성화
	if self.cur_special_move_state == self.special_move_state.none then
		local ally_tower = self.ally_data.tower
		local ratio = ally_tower.hp / ally_tower.max_hp
		if ratio <= self.active_special_move_hp_ratio then
			self.cur_special_move_state = self.special_move_state.active
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.active_special_move, self))
		end
	end

	-- 리더가 있으면 애니메이션 실행
	if self.leader_character ~= nil then
		self.cur_leader_anim_time = 0
		if not self.is_play_leader_anim then
			self.is_play_leader_anim = true
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character, { name = 'cast' }
			, { name = 'tired' })
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_flower_hit_01', parent = self.ally_data.tower:get_unit() })
	self.ui_controller:update_ally_tower_hp(self.ally_data.tower.hp, self.ally_data.tower.max_hp)
end

-- 적군 타워 hp 갱신
function local_class:update_enemy_tower_hp()
	--TODO: 다른 타입의 이벤트가 들어갈 때면 다른 곳에서 확인하거나 이벤트 조건에 맞는 곳에서도 확인이 필요함
	self:check_event()

	self.ui_controller:update_enemy_tower_hp(self.enemy_data.tower.hp, self.enemy_data.tower.max_hp)
end

function local_class:check_event()
	-- 이미 이벤트를 본 상태거나 event_type이 nil이면 return
	if self.is_show_event or self.event_type == nil then
		return
	end

	-- enemy_tower_hp_ratio 이벤트 확인
	if self.event_type[1] == 'enemy_tower_hp_ratio' then
		local enemy_tower = self.enemy_data.tower
		local ratio = enemy_tower.hp / enemy_tower.max_hp

		-- hp 비율이 2번 인덱스의 값보다 낮아졌을 때 CustomStageEvent 발행
		if ratio <= self.event_type[2] then
			self.is_show_event = true
			message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'xm_defense_event' }))
		end
	end
end

-- 에너지 Update
function local_class:update_energy(dt)
	-- 현재 에너지가 맥스 에너지보다 낮을 때만
	if self.cur_energy < self.max_energy then

		-- 에너지 증가
		self.cur_energy = self.cur_energy + self.game_data.energy_per_second * dt

		-- 만약 에너지가 맥스치보다 크거나 같아지면 맥스치랑 동일하게 보정
		if self.cur_energy >= self.max_energy then
			self.cur_energy = self.max_energy
		end

		self.ui_controller:update_energy(self.cur_energy)
	end
end

--region Enemy Patten

-- 일정 시간마다 적군을 스폰하는 루틴
function local_class:enemy_spawn_routine(dt)
	if not self.is_active_enemy_spawn then
		return
	end

	self.enemy_spawn_delay = self.enemy_spawn_delay + dt

	-- 적군의 인구수가 다 차지 않았으며 스폰 딜레이가 다되었을 때 스폰
	if self.enemy_spawn_delay >= self.enemy_spawn_data[self.enemy_spawn_count].delay then
		local spawn_id = self.enemy_spawn_data[self.enemy_spawn_count].spawn_id
		local population = self.enemy_data.cur_population + 1
		local is_spawn = spawn_id > 0

		-- 스폰 하지 않을 때나 스폰했을 때 인구수가 가득 차지 않을 때만
		if not is_spawn or population <= xm_df_constants_manager.get_max_population() then
			-- 딜레이 초기화 및 카운팅 ++
			self.enemy_spawn_delay = 0
			self.enemy_spawn_count = self.enemy_spawn_count + 1

			-- 스폰 테이블 다 돌았으면 다시 1부터 시작
			if self.enemy_spawn_count > #self.enemy_spawn_data then
				self.enemy_spawn_count = 1
			end

			-- 스폰아이디가 1이상 일 때만 스폰
			if is_spawn then
				self:enemy_spawn(spawn_id)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enemy_spawn(id)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_object_warp_01', play_pos = self.enemy_data.spawn_pos
	, type_priority = 'gimmick', player_priority = 'object' })

	local enemy_data = self.unit_manager:enemy_spawn(id, self.enemy_data.spawn_pos, self, self.update_population)
	self.enemy_data.cur_population = self.enemy_data.cur_population + 1
	return enemy_data
end

function local_class:spawn_ally(unit_id)
	-- 게임 플레이 중이 아니라면
	if not self.is_playing_game then
		return
	end

	-- 필살기 연출 때라면 return
	if self.is_special_move_tutorial then
		return
	end

	-- 에너지가 부족하면 그냥 리턴
	local unit_data = xm_df_constants_manager.get_unit_data(unit_id)
	if self.cur_energy < unit_data.cost then
		return
	end

	-- 인구수가 max population보다 많을 경우에는 리턴
	local population = self.ally_data.cur_population + 1
	if population > xm_df_constants_manager.get_max_population() then
		self.ui_controller:set_system_msg('xm_defense_game_1')
		return
	end

	-- 리더가 있으면 애니메이션 실행
	if self.leader_character ~= nil and not self.is_play_leader_anim then
		self.cur_leader_anim_time = 0
		self.is_play_leader_anim = true
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.leader_character
		, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' }, { name = 'attack' })
	end

	-- 유닛 스폰
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	self.cur_energy = self.cur_energy - unit_data.cost
	self.unit_manager:ally_spawn(unit_id, self.ally_data.spawn_pos, self, self.update_population)

	-- 인구수 업데이트
	self.ally_data.cur_population = population
	self.ui_controller:set_current_population(self.ally_data.cur_population)
end

function local_class:update_population(camp)
	if camp == 'ally' then
		self.ally_data.cur_population = self.ally_data.cur_population - 1
		if self.ally_data.cur_population < 0 then
			self.ally_data.cur_population = 0
		end
		self.ui_controller:set_current_population(self.ally_data.cur_population)
	elseif camp == 'enemy' then
		self.enemy_data.cur_population = self.enemy_data.cur_population - 1
		if self.enemy_data.cur_population < 0 then
			self.enemy_data.cur_population = 0
		end
	end
end

--endregion

--region directing

-- 타워 무적 상태로 바꾸는 함수
function local_class:set_tower_invincible(is_invincible)
	if self.ally_data ~= nil and self.ally_data.tower ~= nil then
		self.ally_data.tower:set_invincible(is_invincible)
	end

	if self.enemy_data ~= nil and self.enemy_data.tower ~= nil then
		self.enemy_data.tower:set_invincible(is_invincible)
	end
end

-- 각 진영 살아있는 유닛들 무적으로 만드는 함수
function local_class:set_alive_unit_invincible(is_invincible)
	local ally_unit_list = self.unit_manager:get_is_using_ally()
	for _, unit_list in pairs(ally_unit_list) do
		for _, ally in pairs(unit_list) do
			if ally:is_battle() and ally.unit_data.class ~= 'tower' then
				ally:set_invincible(is_invincible)
			end
		end
	end

	local enemy_unit_list = self.unit_manager:get_is_using_enemy()
	for _, unit_list in pairs(enemy_unit_list) do
		for _, enemy in pairs(unit_list) do
			if enemy:is_battle() and enemy.unit_data.class ~= 'tower' then
				enemy:set_invincible(is_invincible)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 상단 ui 활성화
function local_class:set_top_ui_active_state(is_active)
	self.ui_controller:set_top_ui_active_state(is_active)
end

-- 하단 버튼 활성화
function local_class:set_bottom_ui_active_state(is_active)
	self.ui_controller:set_bottom_ui_active_state(is_active)
end

-- 카메라 이동, x축으로만 이동한다.
function local_class:move_camera_x_axis(target_pos_x, duration)
	local target_pos = self.camera.Transform.localPosition + vector(target_pos_x, 0, 0)
	if duration <= 0 then
		self.camera.Transform.localPosition = target_pos
		camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(target_pos_x, 0, 0), duration)
		return
	end

	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = self.camera.Transform.localPosition
	camera_util.move(stage_camera.LookAtPosition + vector(target_pos_x, 0, 0), duration)
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		self.camera.Transform.localPosition = pos
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.camera.Transform.localPosition = target_pos
	coroutine.yield(nil)
end

-- 카메라 쉐이크
function local_class:camera_shake(magnitude, duration)
	if self.camera == nil then
		return
	end

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local position = self.camera_offset.localPosition
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if shake_calculator.IsActive then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			self.camera_offset.localPosition = position + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.camera_offset.localPosition = position
end

-- 화면 터치 블록
function local_class:set_control_block(is_block)
	if self.is_control_block == is_block then
		return
	end

	self.is_control_block = is_block

	-- 패드 쓰지않을 때만 카메라의 터치를 제어한다.
	if self.is_using_pad then
		return
	end
	self.camera.Block = is_block
end

--region Subscribe Event

function local_class:subscribe_event()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOffEvent), 'on_chat_mode_off_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOnEvent), 'on_chat_mode_on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent), 'on_pause_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent), 'on_pause_end_event')

	if self.is_using_pad then
		message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent), 'on_gamepad_event')
	end
end

function local_class:unsubscribe_event()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOffEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ChatModeOnEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseStartEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PauseEndEvent))

	if self.is_using_pad ~= nil and self.is_using_pad then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GamepadEvent))
	end
end

--endregion

--region dispose

-- 유닛 매니져 dispose
function local_class:dispose_unit_manager()
	if self.unit_manager then
		self.unit_manager:dispose()
		self.unit_manager = nil
	end
end

-- ui 컨트롤러 dispose
function local_class:dispose_ui_controller()
	if self.ui_controller and self.ui_controller_prefab then
		self.ui_controller:dispose()
		self.ui_controller = nil

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.ui_controller_prefab)
		self.ui_controller_prefab = nil
	end
end

-- 디펜스용 카메라 dispose
function local_class:dispose_camera_prefab()
	if self.camera_prefab then
		local vps = stage_camera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ViewportScaler))
		local new_vps = self.camera.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.ViewportScaler))
		new_vps.enabled = false
		vps.enabled = false
		vps.enabled = true

		self.camera = nil
		self.camera_offset = nil

		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.camera_prefab)
		self.camera_prefab = nil
	end

	self.camera = nil
end

function local_class:restore_audio_listener()
	if self.camera_audio_listener.enabled ~= nil then
		self.camera_audio_listener.enabled = false
	end

	if self.stage_audio_listener ~= nil then
		self.stage_audio_listener.enabled = true
	end
end

function local_class:dispose_crowd_clap_sfx()
	if self.crowd_clap_sfx ~= nil then
		self.crowd_clap_sfx:FadeOut()
		self.crowd_clap_sfx = nil
	end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(cs_controller)
		return local_class(cs_controller)
	end
}

local constants_data = require('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameConstants')

local constants_data_key

local function set_constants_data_key(key)
	constants_data_key = key
end

local function get_constants_data()
	return constants_data[constants_data_key]
end

-- 스폰 위치 마커 이름 받아오는 함수
--- @param is_ally any 받아올 마커가 아군 스폰 위치 인지
local function get_spawn_marker(is_ally)
	return is_ally and constants_data.ally_spawn_marker or constants_data.enemy_spawn_marker
end

-- 타워 위치 마커 이름 받아오는 함수
--- @param is_ally any 받아올 마커가 아군 타워 위치 인지
local function get_tower_pos_marker(is_ally)
	return is_ally and constants_data.ally_tower_pos_marker or constants_data.enemy_tower_pos_marker
end

-- 최대 에너지 값
local function get_max_energy()
	return constants_data.max_energy
end

-- 시작 에너지 값
local function get_start_energy()
	return constants_data.start_energy
end

-- 캐릭터 데이터 받아오는 함수
--- @param id any 데이터 가져올 유닛 id
local function get_unit_data(id)
	for _, unit_data in ipairs(constants_data.unit_data) do
		if unit_data.id == id then
			return unit_data
		end
	end

	return nil
end

-- 진형별 유닛 id 가져기
--- @param is_ally any 아군 유닛 id를 가져올 것인가?
local function get_unit_id(is_ally)
	return is_ally and constants_data.ally_unit_id or constants_data.enemy_unit_id
end

-- 각 진영
--- @param is_ally boolean 아군의 리더 정모를 가져올지?
local function get_leader_info(is_ally)
	local current_constants_data = get_constants_data()
	local leader_info = current_constants_data.leader_info

	return is_ally and leader_info.ally or leader_info.enemy
end

-- 타워 id 가져오기
--- @param is_ally boolean 아군의 타워 데이터를 가져올지?
local function get_tower_data(is_ally)
	local current_constants_data = get_constants_data()
	local tower_id = is_ally and current_constants_data.ally_tower_id or current_constants_data.enemy_tower_id
	return get_unit_data(tower_id)
end

-- init 할 때 풀링할 갯수
local function get_init_pooled_count()
	return constants_data.init_pooled_count
end

-- 진형별 유닛 최대 인구수 가져오기
local function get_max_population()
	return get_constants_data().max_population
end

-- 카메라 시작 포인트 가져오기
local function get_default_pos_marker()
	return get_constants_data().default_pos_marker
end

-- 필살기 사용할 때 출력될 string key
local function get_special_move_string_key()
	return get_constants_data().special_move_string_key
end

-- 필살기가 활성화 될 hp 비율
local function get_active_special_move_hp_ratio()
	return get_constants_data().active_special_move_hp_ratio
end

-- 필살기 초상화 가져오기
local function get_ultimate_portrait()
	return constants_data.ultimate_portrait
end

-- 필살기 연출 후 데미지 딜레이
local function get_special_move_damage_delay()
	return get_constants_data().special_move_damage_delay
end

local function get_target_quest_id()
	return get_constants_data().target_quest_id
end

local function get_event_type()
	return get_constants_data().event_type
end

local function get_camera_zoom_size()
	return CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize > 4
			and constants_data.camera_zoom_size_pad or constants_data.camera_zoom_size
end

local function get_pad_camera_move_speed()
	return constants_data.pad_camera_move_speed
end

local function get_pad_camera_max_range()
	return constants_data.pad_camera_max_range
end

local function get_camera_pos()
	local default_marker_pos = field:GetMarker(get_default_pos_marker()).position
	return default_marker_pos + vector(0, -35, 35)
end

local function get_leader_character()
	return get_constants_data().leader_character
end

return {
	set_constants_data_key = set_constants_data_key,
	get_constants_data = get_constants_data,
	get_spawn_marker = get_spawn_marker,
	get_tower_pos_marker = get_tower_pos_marker,
	get_max_energy = get_max_energy,
	get_start_energy = get_start_energy,
	get_unit_data = get_unit_data,
	get_unit_id = get_unit_id,
	get_leader_info = get_leader_info,
	get_tower_data = get_tower_data,
	get_init_pooled_count = get_init_pooled_count,
	get_max_population = get_max_population,
	get_default_pos_marker = get_default_pos_marker,
	get_special_move_string_key = get_special_move_string_key,
	get_active_special_move_hp_ratio = get_active_special_move_hp_ratio,
	get_ultimate_portrait = get_ultimate_portrait,
	get_special_move_damage_delay = get_special_move_damage_delay,
	get_target_quest_id = get_target_quest_id,
	get_event_type = get_event_type,
	get_camera_zoom_size = get_camera_zoom_size,
	get_pad_camera_move_speed = get_pad_camera_move_speed,
	get_pad_camera_max_range = get_pad_camera_max_range,
	get_camera_pos = get_camera_pos,
	get_leader_character = get_leader_character,
}

		magician_attack = {
			enter = self.enter_magician_attack_state,
			exit = self.exit_magician_attack_state,
			update = self.update_magician_attack_state,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_apply_damage = false
		},
		dead = nil,
		stand = {
			enter = self.enter_stand_state,
			exit = self.exit_stand_state,
			update = self.update_stand_state,
			time_passed = 0
		}
	}

	self.current_state = self.unit_state.none

	self.spawn_pos = nil
	self.move_direction = nil

	self.max_hp = 0
	self.hp = 0
	self.attack_range = 0
	self.move_speed = 0
	self.attack_cool_time = 0
	self.attack_damage = 0
	self.priority = 0

	self.is_tower_class = false
	self.is_boss_class = false

	-- 유닛 무적 여부
	self.is_invincible = false

	-- 유닛 불사 여부
	self.is_immortal = false

	-- 타워 파괴 연출이 끝났는지
	self.end_tower_break_event = false

	-- 현재 공격 쿨타임
	self.current_attack_cool_time = 0

	-- 가장 앞에 있는 타겟 리스트
	self.front_target_list = nil

	-- 가장 앞에 있는 타겟 x 좌표
	self.front_target_pos_x = nil

	-- 사용 중인 타겟 리스트
	self.is_using_target_list = nil

	-- 화살 풀
	self.pooled_arrows = nil

	-- HP UI
	self.hp_ui = nil

	-- 직업별 애니메이션
	self.animation = {
		idle = nil,
		move = nil,
		attack = nil
	}

	-- 타워 이펙트 파괴 연출 상태
	self.tower_break_progress_enum = {
		none = 0,
		size_up = 1,
		size_down = 2
	}

	self.current_tower_break_progress = self.tower_break_progress_enum.none

	-- 받은 대미지 리스트
	self.receive_damage_list = {}
end

--- 캐릭터 데이터 세팅
function local_class:set_data(unit_id, unit, pooled_arrows, hp_ui)
	self.unit_id = unit_id
	self.unit = unit
	self.pooled_arrows = pooled_arrows
	self.hp_ui = hp_ui
	self.unit_data = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_data(unit_id)

	self.unit_state.attack = self.class_attack_state[self.unit_data.class]

	if self.unit_data.class == 'tower' then
		self.unit_state.dead = self.dead_state.tower
		self.is_tower_class = true
	else
		self.unit_state.dead = self.dead_state.unit
	end

	if self.unit_data.class == 'boss' then
		self.is_boss_class = true
	else
		self.is_boss_class = false
	end

	self.move_direction = self.unit_data.camp == 'ally' and vector(1, 0, 0) or vector(-1, 0, 0)

	self.animation.idle = self.unit_data.idle_anim
	self.animation.walk = self.unit_data.walk_anim
	self.animation.attack = self.unit_data.attack_anim

	self.max_hp = self.unit_data.hp
	self.hp = self.unit_data.hp
	self.attack_range = self.unit_data.attack_range
	self.move_speed = self.unit_data.move_speed
	self.attack_cool_time = self.unit_data.attack_cool_time
	self.attack_damage = self.unit_data.attack_damage
	self.priority = self.unit_data.priority

	if self.unit_data.is_effect then
		self.shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
		self.shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
		self.shake_info.name = 'tower_shake'
		self.shake_info.magnitude = 0.2
		self.shake_info.duration = 0.2
		self.shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true
	end
end

--- state 변경
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	self.current_state = new_state

	self.current_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- update
function local_class:update_action_state(dt)
	if not self:is_using() then return end

	self.current_state.time_passed = self.current_state.time_passed + dt
	self.current_attack_cool_time = self.current_attack_cool_time - dt

	self.current_state.update(self, self.current_state.time_passed, dt)
end

--region tower break state
function local_class:enter_tower_break_state(_)
	if self.unit_data.is_effect then
		self.current_tower_break_progress = self.tower_break_progress_enum.size_up

		self.start_scale = self.portal_effect.transform.localScale

		local portal_end = self.get_fx_tower_portal_end():Instantiate(self.unit.Position)
		portal_end.transform.localScale = 2 * unity_class.vector3.one

		local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
		shake_info.name = 'tower_shake'
		shake_info.magnitude = 0.1
		shake_info.duration = 0.2
		shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

		self.shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)
	end
end

function local_class:update_tower_break_state(time_passed, dt)
	if self.unit_data.is_effect and self.portal_effect then

		local cur_scale

		if self.current_tower_break_progress == self.tower_break_progress_enum.size_up then
			-- 0.1초 동안 1.2배 커짐
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / 0.1)
			cur_scale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_scale, 1.2 * self.start_scale, progress)

			if time_passed > 0.1 then
				self.start_scale = cur_scale
				self.current_tower_break_progress = self.current_tower_break_progress + 1
			end
		elseif self.current_tower_break_progress == self.tower_break_progress_enum.size_down then
			-- 0.35초 동안 0으로 작아짐
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01((time_passed - 0.1) / 0.35)
			cur_scale = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_scale, unity_class.vector3.zero, progress)
		end

		if cur_scale then
			self.portal_effect.transform.localScale = cur_scale
		end

		if self.shake_calculator.IsActive then
			self.shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			self.portal_effect.transform.localPosition = self.portal_position + self.shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
	end

	if time_passed > 0.45 then
		self:change_state(self.unit_state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:exit_tower_break_state(_)
	self.current_tower_break_progress = self.tower_break_progress_enum.none
	self.current_state.is_show_event = false
	self.end_tower_break_event = true
end

--- 자신의 위치에서 가장 가까운 상대를 찾음 (x축은 이미 비교한 결과라 z축만 비교)
function local_class:find_near_target(position)
	if not self.front_target_list then return end

	local pos = position == nil and self.unit.Position or position

	local near_target
	local near_dist

	for _, npc in pairs(self.front_target_list) do
		local current_dist = math.abs(npc:get_position().z - pos.z)

		if not near_dist then
			-- 처음
			near_target = npc
			near_dist = current_dist
		elseif near_target:get_priority() < npc:get_priority() or current_dist < near_dist then
			-- 우선순위가 더 높거나 더 가까울 때
			near_target = npc
			near_dist = current_dist
		end
	end

	return near_target
end

--- 마법사 범위 공격
function local_class:magician_splash_attack()
	if not self.is_using_target_list or not self.front_target_list then return end

	music_player_util.play_sfx(
		{ sfx_name = '02_stomp_fire_01', parent = self.front_target_list[1]:get_unit(), volume = 0.5 })
	self:show_hit_effect(self.front_target_list[1], self.get_fx_flame_strike())
	self:attack_near_front_target(self.unit_data.splash_attack_range)
end

--- 보스 범위 공격
function local_class:boss_splash_attack()
	if not self.is_using_target_list or not self.front_target_list then return end

	local target_list = self:attack_near_front_target(self.unit_data.splash_attack_range)

	for _, target in pairs(target_list) do
		self:show_hit_effect(target, self.get_fx_hit())
	end
end

--- 가장 앞에 있는 타겟의 특정 범위 안에 있는 타겟을 공격
function local_class:attack_near_front_target(range)
	local target_list = {}

	for _, id_list in pairs(self.is_using_target_list) do
		for _, npc in pairs(id_list) do
			if npc:is_battle() and math.abs(npc:get_position().x - self.front_target_pos_x) <= range then
				self:send_damage(npc, self.attack_damage)
				table.insert(target_list, npc)
			end
		end
	end

	return target_list
end

--- 타겟이 공격 범위 안에 있는지
function local_class:target_in_attack_range()
	return self.front_target_list and
			math.abs(self.front_target_pos_x - self.unit.Position.x) <= self.attack_range
end

--- 대미지 보냄
function local_class:send_damage(target, damage)
	target:receive_damage(damage)
end

--- 대미지 받음
function local_class:receive_damage(damage)
	if self.is_invincible then return end

	table.insert(self.receive_damage_list, damage)
end

--- 대미지 적용
function local_class:apply_damage()
	if not self.receive_damage_list or #self.receive_damage_list == 0 then return false end

	-- 피격 연출
	if self.unit_data.is_effect then
		self.shake_calculator:Shake(self.shake_info)
	elseif not self.unit_data.is_effect and self.is_tower_class then
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.unit, 1.1, 0.9, 1, 0.3)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.unit)
	else
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.unit)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.unit)
	end

	local total_damage = 0
	for _, damage in pairs(self.receive_damage_list) do
		total_damage = total_damage + damage
	end

	self.receive_damage_list = {}
	if self.is_immortal then
		self.hp = math.max(self.hp - total_damage, 1)
	else
		self.hp = math.max(self.hp - total_damage, 0)
	end

	self.hp_ui:Damage(self.hp)

	-- 죽었을 때
	if self.hp == 0 then
		if self.dead_call_back ~= nil then
			self:dead_call_back()
			self.dead_call_back = nil
		end

		self:change_state(self.unit_state.dead)
	end

	return true
end

--- 유닛 생성
function local_class:spawn(spawn_pos, caller, dead_call_back)
	self.spawn_pos = spawn_pos
	self:change_state(self.unit_state.summon)
	self.dead_call_back = function()
		dead_call_back(caller, self.unit_data.camp)
	end
end

--- 타워 생성
function local_class:tower_spawn(spawn_pos)
	self:set_position(spawn_pos)

	self.end_tower_break_event = false
	self.hp = self.max_hp

	if self.unit_data.is_effect then
		self.portal_effect = self.get_fx_tower_portal():Instantiate(spawn_pos + unity_class.vector3.forward * 0.5)
		self.portal_effect.transform.localScale = 2 * unity_class.vector3.one
		self.unit.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(999, 0, 999)
		self.unit.SpineController.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.unit.SpineController.ShadowScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
		self.portal_position = self.portal_effect.transform.localPosition
	end

	self:change_state(self.unit_state.stand)
end

--- 화살 발사
function local_class:shoot_arrow()
	for _, arrow_data in pairs(self.pooled_arrows) do
		if not arrow_data.is_using then
			arrow_data.is_using = true
			arrow_data.dir_vector = self.move_direction
			arrow_data.shooter = self
			arrow_data.shooter_pos = self.unit.Position

			local offset_z = 0.3
			if self.unit_data.arrow_offset then
				offset_z = self.unit_data.arrow_offset
			end

			local offset = vector(0.3 * self.move_direction.x, 0, offset_z)
			arrow_data.arrow.transform.localPosition = self.unit.Position + offset

			-- 좌우 방향 변경
			local scale_y
			local cur_scale = arrow_data.arrow.transform.localScale

			if self.unit_data.camp == 'ally' then
				scale_y = 1 * math.abs(cur_scale.y)
				arrow_data.camp = 'ally'
			else
				scale_y = -1 * math.abs(cur_scale.y)
				arrow_data.camp = 'enemy'
			end

			arrow_data.arrow.transform.localScale = vector(cur_scale.x, scale_y, cur_scale.z)

			return
		end
	end
end

--- 화살 맞았을 때
function local_class:hit_arrow(shooter_pos)
	local near_target = self:find_near_target(shooter_pos)
	self:show_hit_effect(near_target, self.get_fx_hit_projectile())
	self:send_damage(near_target, self.attack_damage)
end

function local_class:show_hit_effect(target, fx)
	local offset = vector(0, 0.2, 0.3) + (-0.4 * self.move_direction)
	fx:Instantiate(target:get_position() + offset)
end

function local_class:set_position(position)

xm_defense_constants_manager = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameConstantsManager')

local local_class = newclass('XMDefenseGameUnitManager')

function local_class:init()
	self.ally = {}
	self.enemy = {}

	self.ally_tower = nil
	self.enemy_tower = nil

	self.unit_data = {}

	self.ally_current_count = {}
	self.enemy_current_count = {}

	-- 현재 사용 중인 유닛 리스트
	self.is_using_ally_list = {}
	self.is_using_enemy_list = {}

	-- 아군 유닛 타입별 리스트 생성
	for _, unit_id in pairs(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(true)) do
		self.ally[unit_id] = {}
		self.ally_current_count[unit_id] = 0
		self.is_using_ally_list[unit_id] = {}
	end

	-- 적군 유닛 타입별 리스트 생성
	for _, unit_id in pairs(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(false)) do
		self.enemy[unit_id] = {}
		self.enemy_current_count[unit_id] = 0
		self.is_using_enemy_list[unit_id] = {}
	end

	-- 동적 생성한 npc 전체
	self.optimized_npc_list = {}

	-- 가장 앞에 있는 유닛 리스트
	self.front_ally_list = {}
	self.front_enemy_list = {}

	self.pooled_arrows = {}

	self.already_load_resource = false
end

function local_class:on_load_resource(load_end_callback)
	if self.already_load_resource then return end
	self.already_load_resource = true

	quest_util.load_pool_resource(
		'custom_sprite',
		'FX_hit',
		'FX_hit_projectile',
		'FX_FlameStrike',
		'xm_defense_unit_hp',
		'MagicCircle_AppearIdle',
		'fx_xm_devil_portal_start',
		'fx_xm_devil_portal_end'
	)

	local init_pooled_count = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_init_pooled_count()
	self.check_unit_pool_count = init_pooled_count / 2

	-- 아군 npc 동적 생성
	for _, unit_id in pairs(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(true)) do
		self.unit_data[unit_id] = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_data(unit_id)

		if self.unit_data[unit_id].class == 'tower' or self.unit_data[unit_id].class == 'boss' then
			self:create_optimized_npc_func(self.unit_data[unit_id], 1)
		else
			self:create_optimized_npc_func(self.unit_data[unit_id], init_pooled_count)
		end
	end

	-- 적군 npc 동적 생성
	for _, unit_id in pairs(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(false)) do
		self.unit_data[unit_id] = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_data(unit_id)

		if self.unit_data[unit_id].class == 'tower' or self.unit_data[unit_id].class == 'boss' then
			self:create_optimized_npc_func(self.unit_data[unit_id], 1)
		else
			self:create_optimized_npc_func(self.unit_data[unit_id], init_pooled_count)
		end
	end
end

--- Update
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self:find_front_unit()

	self:unit_action(dt)

	self:update_arrows(dt)
end

--- 아군 스폰
function local_class:ally_spawn(unit_id, spawn_pos, caller, dead_call_back)
	local created_unit

	for _, ally in pairs(self.ally[unit_id]) do
		if not ally:is_using() then
			local random_z = random_util.get_random_int(-35, 35) * vector(0, 0, 0.01)
			ally:spawn(spawn_pos + random_z, caller, dead_call_back)

			table.insert(self.is_using_ally_list[unit_id], ally)

			created_unit = ally
			break
		end
	end

	if created_unit:is_boss() then
		return created_unit
	end

	-- 추가 풀링
	if self.ally_current_count[unit_id] < xm_defense_constants_manager.get_max_population() and
		#self.is_using_ally_list[unit_id] > self.ally_current_count[unit_id] - self.check_unit_pool_count then

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.create_optimized_npc_func, self, self.unit_data[unit_id], self.check_unit_pool_count))
	end

	return created_unit
end

--- 적군 스폰
function local_class:enemy_spawn(unit_id, spawn_pos, caller, dead_call_back)
	local created_unit

	for _, enemy in pairs(self.enemy[unit_id]) do
		if not enemy:is_using() then
			local random_z = random_util.get_random_int(-35, 35) * vector(0, 0, 0.01)
			enemy:spawn(spawn_pos + random_z, caller, dead_call_back)

			table.insert(self.is_using_enemy_list[unit_id], enemy)

			created_unit = enemy
			break
		end
	end

	if created_unit:is_boss() then
		return created_unit
	end

	-- 추가 풀링
	if self.enemy_current_count[unit_id] < xm_defense_constants_manager.get_max_population() and
		#self.is_using_enemy_list[unit_id] > self.enemy_current_count[unit_id] - self.check_unit_pool_count then

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.create_optimized_npc_func, self, self.unit_data[unit_id], self.check_unit_pool_count))
	end

	return created_unit
end

--- 아군 타워 스폰
function local_class:ally_tower_spawn(spawn_pos)
	if self.ally_tower:is_using() then return end

	self.ally_tower:tower_spawn(spawn_pos)
	table.insert(self.is_using_ally_list[self.ally_tower:get_unit_id()], self.ally_tower)
	return self.ally_tower
end

--- 적군 타워 스폰
function local_class:enemy_tower_spawn(spawn_pos)
	if self.enemy_tower:is_using() then return end

	self.enemy_tower:tower_spawn(spawn_pos)
	table.insert(self.is_using_enemy_list[self.enemy_tower:get_unit_id()], self.enemy_tower)
	return self.enemy_tower
end

--- 유닛 행동
function local_class:unit_action(dt)
	for _, unit_list in pairs(self.is_using_ally_list) do
		for _, ally in pairs(unit_list) do
			ally:set_front_target_list(self.front_enemy_list, self.front_enemy_pos_x)
			ally:set_using_target_list(self.is_using_enemy_list)
			ally:update_action_state(dt)
		end
	end

	for _, enemy_unit_id_list in pairs(self.is_using_enemy_list) do
		for _, enemy in pairs(enemy_unit_id_list) do
			enemy:set_front_target_list(self.front_ally_list, self.front_ally_pos_x)
			enemy:set_using_target_list(self.is_using_ally_list)
			enemy:update_action_state(dt)
		end
	end
end

--- 아군 유닛 대미지 적용
function local_class:ally_apply_damage()
	local tower_hp_update = false

	for _, unit_list in pairs(self.is_using_ally_list) do
		for _, ally in pairs(unit_list) do
			local is_damage = ally:apply_damage()
			if is_damage and ally:is_tower() then
				tower_hp_update = true
			end
		end
	end

	return tower_hp_update
end

--- 적군 유닛 대미지 적용
function local_class:enemy_apply_damage()
	local tower_hp_update = false

	for _, unit_list in pairs(self.is_using_enemy_list) do
		for _, enemy in pairs(unit_list) do
			local is_damage = enemy:apply_damage()
			if is_damage and enemy:is_tower() then
				tower_hp_update = true
			end
		end
	end

	return tower_hp_update
end

--- 가장 앞에 있는 유닛 찾기
function local_class:find_front_unit()
	self.front_ally_list = {}
	self.front_ally_pos_x = nil

	-- 가장 앞에 있는 아군 찾기
	for id, unit_list in pairs(self.is_using_ally_list) do
		local remove_index

		for index, ally in pairs(unit_list) do
			if ally:is_battle() then
				if not self.front_ally_pos_x then
					-- 처음일 경우
					table.insert(self.front_ally_list, ally)
					self.front_ally_pos_x = ally:get_position().x
				elseif math.abs(self.front_ally_pos_x - ally:get_position().x) <= 0.05 then
					-- 같을 경우
					table.insert(self.front_ally_list, ally)
				elseif self.front_ally_pos_x < ally:get_position().x then
					-- 더 가까울 경우
					self.front_ally_list = {}
					table.insert(self.front_ally_list, ally)
					self.front_ally_pos_x = ally:get_position().x
				end
			elseif not ally:is_using() then
				remove_index = index
			end
		end

		if remove_index then
			table.remove(self.is_using_ally_list[id], remove_index)
		end
	end

	self.front_enemy_list = {}
	self.front_enemy_pos_x = nil

	-- 가장 앞에 있는 적군 찾기
	for id, enemy_unit_id_list in pairs(self.is_using_enemy_list) do
		local remove_index

		for index, enemy in pairs(enemy_unit_id_list) do
			if enemy:is_battle() then
				if not self.front_enemy_pos_x then
					-- 처음일 경우
					table.insert(self.front_enemy_list, enemy)
					self.front_enemy_pos_x = enemy:get_position().x
				elseif math.abs(self.front_enemy_pos_x - enemy:get_position().x) <= 0.05 then
					-- 같을 경우
					table.insert(self.front_enemy_list, enemy)
				elseif self.front_enemy_pos_x > enemy:get_position().x then
					-- 더 가까울 경우
					self.front_enemy_list = {}
					table.insert(self.front_enemy_list, enemy)
					self.front_enemy_pos_x = enemy:get_position().x
				end
			elseif not enemy:is_using() then
				remove_index = index
			end
		end

		if remove_index then
			table.remove(self.is_using_enemy_list[id], remove_index)
		end
	end
end

--- npc 동적 생성 함수
function local_class:create_optimized_npc_func(unit_data, index)
	local optimized_npc
	local unit_id = unit_data.id

	local hp_offset
	if unit_data.hp_offset then
		hp_offset = vector(unit_data.hp_offset.x, unit_data.hp_offset.y, unit_data.hp_offset.z)
	end

	if unit_data.class == 'archer' then
		self:load_arrows(index)
	end

	if unit_data.camp == 'ally' then
		-- 아군 npc 동적 생성
		local optimized_ally_npc_list = {}

		for _ = 1, index do
			local current_count = self.ally_current_count[unit_id]
			optimized_ally_npc_list[unit_data.spec_name .. current_count] = unit_data.spec_name
			self.ally_current_count[unit_id] = self.ally_current_count[unit_id] + 1
		end

		optimized_npc = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(optimized_ally_npc_list)

		for _, npc in pairs(optimized_npc) do
			-- 커스텀 체력바 설정
			local hp_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('xm_defense_unit_hp')
			local hp_ui = hp_pool:Instantiate(npc.Position, CS.Quaternion.identity,
					npc.transform, CS.Oak.ParentFollowFlag.Position):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.Components.XMUnitHp));
			hp_ui:Init(unit_data.hp, CS.Oak.UI.Components.XMUnitHp.UnitType.Ally, hp_offset)

			local game_unit = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameUnit')
			game_unit:set_data(unit_id, npc, self.pooled_arrows, hp_ui)
			self.ally[unit_id][npc] = game_unit

			-- 레벨만 제거
			local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(npc)
			if ui_dict:ContainsKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats) then
				local stats_ui = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
				stats_ui.Level.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end

			if unit_data.class == 'tower' then
				--TODO: 임시코드, 타워는 방향 없을테니 필요 없을 듯?
				character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
				npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', -1)

				self.ally_tower = game_unit
			else
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
			end

			if unit_data.spr_scale then
				character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, unit_data.spr_scale)
			end

			local weapon = unit_data.weapon
			if weapon then
				npc.SpineController:SetAttachment(unit_data.weapon_slot, weapon)
			end
		end
	else
		-- 적군 npc 동적 생성
		local optimized_enemy_npc_list = {}

		for _ = 1, index do
			local current_count = self.enemy_current_count[unit_id]
			optimized_enemy_npc_list[unit_data.spec_name .. current_count] = unit_data.spec_name
			self.enemy_current_count[unit_id] = self.enemy_current_count[unit_id] + 1
		end

		optimized_npc = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async(optimized_enemy_npc_list)

		for _, npc in pairs(optimized_npc) do
			local hp_pool = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('xm_defense_unit_hp')
			local hp_ui = hp_pool:Instantiate(npc.Position, CS.Quaternion.identity,
					npc.transform, CS.Oak.ParentFollowFlag.Position):GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.Components.XMUnitHp))
			hp_ui:Init(unit_data.hp, CS.Oak.UI.Components.XMUnitHp.UnitType.Enemy, hp_offset)

			local game_unit = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.Create('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameUnit')
			game_unit:set_data(unit_id, npc, self.pooled_arrows, hp_ui)
			self.enemy[unit_id][npc] = game_unit

			-- 레벨만 제거
			local ui_dict = stage.FieldUIManager:GetUI(npc)
			if ui_dict:ContainsKey(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats) then
				local stats_ui = ui_dict[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats]
				stats_ui.Level.gameObject:SetActive(false)
			end

			if unit_data.class == 'tower' then
				--TODO: 임시코드, 타워는 방향 없을테니 필요 없을 듯?
				character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
				npc.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', -1)

				self.enemy_tower = game_unit
			else
				character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'disabled')
			end

			if unit_data.spr_scale then
				character_util.set_scale_factor(npc, nil, unit_data.spr_scale)
			end

			local weapon = unit_data.weapon
			if weapon then
				npc.SpineController:SetAttachment(unit_data.weapon_slot, weapon)
			end
		end
	end

	table.insert(self.optimized_npc_list, optimized_npc)
end

--- 액티브 스킬 사용 했을 때
function local_class:active_skill()
	for _, enemy_unit_id_list in pairs(self.is_using_enemy_list) do
		for _, enemy in pairs(enemy_unit_id_list) do
			if enemy:is_using() and enemy:is_battle() and not enemy:is_tower() then
				enemy:receive_damage(9999)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 화살 로드
function local_class:load_arrows(index)
	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	for _ = 1, index do
		local custom_atlas
		yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'spritesheets/projectiles', 'projectiles_custom', function(prefab)
				custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

		local arrow = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite'):Instantiate(vector(999, 0, 999))
		local arrow_sprite = arrow.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
		arrow_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 90, 0)
		arrow_sprite.transform.localScale = 1.3 * unity_class.vector3.one
		arrow_sprite.Atlas = custom_atlas
		arrow_sprite.SpriteName = 'arrow_snowsoldier'
		arrow_sprite:Rebuild()

		-- 화살 정보
		local arrow_data = {
			arrow = arrow,
			is_using = false,
			camp = nil,
			dir_vector = nil,
			shooter = nil,
			shooter_pos = nil,
			speed = 5
		}

		table.insert(self.pooled_arrows, arrow_data)
	end
end

--- 화살 업데이트
function local_class:update_arrows(dt)
	-- 화살에 맞았을 때
	local on_hit = function(arrow_data)
		arrow_data.shooter:hit_arrow(arrow_data.shooter_pos)

		self:reset_arrow(arrow_data)
	end

	local hit_offset = 0.5

	-- 화살 이동
	for _, arrow_data in pairs(self.pooled_arrows) do
		if arrow_data.is_using then
			local move_dist = arrow_data.speed * dt * arrow_data.dir_vector
			local next_pos = arrow_data.arrow.transform.localPosition + move_dist
			arrow_data.arrow.transform.localPosition = next_pos

			-- 피격 판정 (가장 앞의 적과 x축 비교)
			if arrow_data.camp == 'ally' and #self.front_enemy_list and
				next_pos.x >= self.front_enemy_list[1]:get_position().x - hit_offset then

				on_hit(arrow_data)
			elseif arrow_data.camp == 'enemy' and #self.front_ally_list and
				next_pos.x <= self.front_ally_list[1]:get_position().x + hit_offset then

				on_hit(arrow_data)
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 화살 초기화
function local_class:reset_arrow(arrow_data)
	arrow_data.is_using = false
	arrow_data.camp = nil
	arrow_data.dir_vector = nil
	arrow_data.shooter = nil
	arrow_data.shooter_pos = nil
	arrow_data.arrow.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
end

--- 화면에 보이는 화살을 안 보이도록 함
function local_class:hide_arrow()
	for _, arrow_data in pairs(self.pooled_arrows) do
		if arrow_data.is_using then
			self:reset_arrow(arrow_data)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:get_is_using_ally()
	return self.is_using_ally_list
end

function local_class:get_is_using_enemy()
	return self.is_using_enemy_list
end

function local_class:dispose()
	for _, unit_id in pairs(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(true)) do
		for _, ally in pairs(self.ally[unit_id]) do
			ally:dispose()
		end
	end

	for _, unit_id in pairs(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(false)) do
		for _, enemy in pairs(self.enemy[unit_id]) do
			enemy:dispose()
		end
	end

	if self.optimized_npc_list then
		for _, v in pairs(self.optimized_npc_list) do
			load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(v)
		end
	end
	self.optimized_npc_list = nil

	if self.pooled_arrows then
		for _, v in pairs(self.pooled_arrows) do
			v.arrow:Dispose()
			v.arrow = nil
		end
	end
	self.pooled_arrows = nil

	self.already_load_resource = false
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

	--TODO: 유닛 매니져에서 가져와야 할 듯
	self.current_ally_health = 0
	self.current_enemy_health = 0

	-- 최대 체력
	self.ally_max_hp = 1
	self.enemy_max_hp = 1
end

function local_class:late_init(ally_hp, enemy_hp, item)
	self.ally_hp = ally_hp
	self.enemy_hp = enemy_hp

	local ally_tower_info = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_tower_data(true)
	local enemy_tower_info = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_tower_data(false)

	-- 좌측 체력 UI (아군이 세팅 되어야함)
	local left_ui = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(game_string.IsRTL, enemy_hp, ally_hp)
	self:init_ui(left_ui, ally_tower_info.name, ally_tower_info.portrait, ally_tower_info.hp)

	-- 우측 체력 UI (적군이 세팅 되어야함)
	local right_ui = lua_helper.get_conditional_value(game_string.IsRTL, ally_hp, enemy_hp)
	self:init_ui(right_ui, enemy_tower_info.name, enemy_tower_info.portrait, enemy_tower_info.hp)

	-- 체력 UI 컬러 설정 (RTL 일 경우에만)
	if (game_string.IsRTL) then
		-- 체력바 BG 스왑
		local left_progress_bar_bg = left_ui.hpProgress.transform:GetChild(0):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))
		local right_progress_bar_bg = right_ui.hpProgress.transform:GetChild(0):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))
		self:swap_color(left_progress_bar_bg, right_progress_bar_bg)

		-- 체력바 FG 스왑
		local left_progress_bar_fg = left_ui.hpProgress.transform:GetChild(1):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))
		local right_progress_bar_fg = right_ui.hpProgress.transform:GetChild(1):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UISprite))
		self:swap_color(left_progress_bar_fg, right_progress_bar_fg)

		-- 체력바 label 색상 스왑
		self:swap_color(ally_hp.nameLabel, enemy_hp.nameLabel)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 게임 데이터
	self.game_data = nil

	-- 아군 체력
	self.ally_hp = nil

	-- 적군 체력 UI 처리
	self.enemy_hp = nil

	-- 대결 UI
	self.versus_ui = nil

	-- 아군 인구수 표시 UI
	self.ally_population = nil
end

function local_class:init_ui(hp_ui, name, sprite, max_hp)
	hp_ui.hpLabel.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("n_out_of_m", max_hp, max_hp)
	hp_ui.nameLabel.text = game_string:GetString(name)
	hp_ui.portrait.spriteName = sprite
	hp_ui.hpProgress.value = 1
end

function local_class:swap_color(lhs, rhs)
	local temp = lhs.color
	lhs.color = rhs.color
	rhs.color = temp
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

xm_defense_constants_manager = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameConstantsManager')
xm_defense_unit_manager = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/XMDefenseGame/XMDefenseGameUnitManager')

-- 크리스타스 단편집 타워디팬스 (XMDefenseGame)의 소환 에너지, 버튼 UI
local local_class = newclass('XMUnitSpawnUI')

function local_class:init()
	self.game_data = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_constants_data()

	self.max_energy = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_max_energy()

	self.charged_energy = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_start_energy()

	self.ui_controller = nil

	self.summon_buttons = nil

	self.energy_bars = nil
	self.charged_energy_label = nil

	self.cost_label_effect = nil

	self.energy_bar_effect = nil

	-- 이전 프레임에 충전되어있던 에너지 량
	self.pre_charged_energy = 0

	-- 에너지 바 채워지는 연출에 사용되는 right 앵커 최대 수치
	self.min_anchor_right = 27
	self.gap_anchor_right = 47

	-- 아군 인구수
	self.ally_population = nil
	self.ally_max_population = nil

	-- 소환이 불가능할 or 인구 수 가득 찾을 시 출력할 메시지

	-- 각 버튼 별로 상호 작용이 가능한 상태인지 저장한 테이블
	self.is_button_available = {}

	-- 각 버튼들의 코스트가 몇 인지 저장한 테이블
	self.each_button_cost = {}

	self.disabled_color = CS.UnityEngine.Color(70 / 255, 70 / 255, 70 / 255, 1)
end

function local_class:late_init(summon_buttons, energy_bars, energy_label, population, cost_label_effect,
                               energy_bar_effect, ultimate_skill, item)
	self.summon_buttons = summon_buttons

	self.energy_bars = energy_bars

	self.charged_energy_label = energy_label

	self.cost_label_effect = cost_label_effect

	self.energy_bar_effect = energy_bar_effect

	self.ultimate_skill = ultimate_skill

	self.item = item

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.load_typing_text, self))

	-- 초기 에너지량 설정
	self.charged_energy_label.text = '0'

	-- 이펙트 비 활성화
	self.cost_label_effect:SetActive(false)
	self.energy_bar_effect:SetActive(false)

	-- 에너지 라벨 초기화
	for i = 0, energy_bars.Length - 1 do
		local charging_energy_bar = self.energy_bars[i]
		charging_energy_bar.rightAnchor.absolute = 0
		charging_energy_bar:UpdateAnchors()
	end
	item:UpdateEnergy(xm_defense_constants_manager.get_start_energy())

	-- 아군 인구수
	self.ally_population = population
	local max_population = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_max_population()
	self.ally_max_population = lua_helper.get_or_default(max_population, 0)
	self:set_current_population(0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.summon_buttons = nil
	self.energy_bars = nil
	self.charged_energy_label = nil
	self.system_msg = nil
	self.cost_label_effect = nil
	self.energy_bar_effect = nil
	self.item = nil
end

function local_class:set_summon_buttons(caller, summon_callback)
	local ally_unit_ids = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_id(true)

	for i = 0, self.summon_buttons.Length - 1 do
		local unit_id = ally_unit_ids[i + 1]
		local summon_button = self.summon_buttons[i]

		if (unit_id ~= nil) then
			local unit_data = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_unit_data(unit_id)
			summon_button.unitPortrait.spriteName = unit_data.portrait
			summon_button.costLabel.text = tostring(unit_data.cost)
			summon_button.cost = unit_data.cost

			summon_button.button.onClick:Clear()
			CS.EventDelegate.Set(summon_button.button.onClick, function()
				summon_callback(caller, unit_id)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_09')
			end)

			self.item:SetUnitSummonBtnActiveState(summon_button, false)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:set_ultimate(caller, ultimate_callback)
	self.ultimate_skill.portrait.spriteName = xm_defense_constants_manager.get_ultimate_portrait()
	self.ultimate_skill.button.onClick:Clear()

	if caller ~= nil and ultimate_callback ~= nil then
		CS.EventDelegate.Set(self.ultimate_skill.button.onClick, function()
			ultimate_callback(caller)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_matched_01')
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_button_06')
		end)
	end
end

function local_class:set_ultimate_button_active_state(active_state)
	self.ultimate_skill.button.gameObject:SetActive(active_state)
	self.ultimate_skill.chargedEffect:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:clear_all_button_callback()
	for i = 0, self.summon_buttons.Length - 1 do
		local summon_button = self.summon_buttons[i]
		summon_button.button.onClick:Clear()
	end
end

function local_class:set_system_msg(msg_key)
	if (self.system_msg.InUse == true) then
		self.system_msg:ForceFinish()
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			self.system_msg:SetTypedText(game_string:GetString(msg_key), 1000, 0))
end

function local_class:set_current_population(population)
	self.ally_population.text = CS.GameStrings.Instance:Format("xm_def_population", population, self.ally_max_population)
end

function local_class:load_typing_text()
	local typing_text_asset_bundle_name = 'ui/prologue'
	local typing_text_asset_name = 'typing_text'
	local text_resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			text_resholder, typing_text_asset_bundle_name, typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
				self.system_msg = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(
						stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

				self.system_msg.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 100, 1, 350);
				self.system_msg.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0;
				self.system_msg.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
				self.system_msg.Label.fontSize = 25
				self.system_msg.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
				self.system_msg.Label.color = unity_class.color.red
			end)
end

function local_class:reset_state()
	self.cost_label_effect:SetActive(false)
	self.energy_bar_effect:SetActive(false)

	self.pre_charged_energy = 0
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

---@class BattleBallGameSceneBase
local local_class = newclass('BattleBallGameSceneBase')

---@type BattleBallGameEnum
local enum = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/BattleBallGame/Enum')

do
	--변수 선언
	function local_class:init()
		self.const = nil

		---@type BattleBallGameTeam
		---플레이어 팀. team:get(index) 로 fo 가져올 수 있음
		self.player_team = nil

		---@type BattleBallGameTeam
		---상대 팀. team:get(index) 로 fo 가져올 수 있음
		self.opposite_team = nil

		---@type BattleBallGameTeam
		---현재 수비팀
		self.defense_team = nil

		---@type BattleBallGameTeam
		---현재 공격팀
		self.offense_team = nil

		self.scene_version = scene_util.default_version

		self.character = setmetatable({
			spec = {
				princess = 'princess',
				purple_sox_manager = 'purple_sox_manager',
				sucker_puncher_manager = 'sucker_puncher_manager',
				demon_inspector = 'demon_inspector',
				mad_scientist = 'mad_scientist',
				purple_sox_manager = 'purple_sox_manager',
				knight = user_util.has_knight_male() and 'knight_male' or 'knight_female',
				teatan_hero = 'teatan_hero',
				innuit = 'innuit',
				desert_slave = 'desert_slave',
				tanker = 'tanker',
				ghost_buster = 'ghost_buster',
				battleball_girl = 'battleball_girl',
				battleball_girl_myth = 'battleball_girl_myth',
				battleball_pitcher_myth = 'battleball_pitcher_myth',
			}
		}, {
			__index = function(this, key)
				return get_character(this.spec[key])
			end
		})

		self.marker = {
			--투-타 중간 위치
			default_pos = function()
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_default')
			end,
			---타석 왼쪽: 1, 오른쪽: 2
			batter_pos = function(idx)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_batter_' .. idx)
			end,
			---수비시 1~7 위치(번호는 상황별 연출->수비 세팅의 번호에 따름)
			defender_pos = function(idx)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_defender_' .. idx)
			end,
			---수비시 a~i 위치(번호는 상황별 연출->수비 세팅의 번호에 따름)[1~9], 홈런시 이동 위치[10~13]
			field_point = function(idx)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_field_' .. idx)
			end,
			---hit_result-type에 해당하는 이벤트 시 공이 멈추는 위치
			hit_ball_end_pos = function(hit_result, type)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_' .. hit_result .. '_' .. type)
			end,
			---1. 우리팀 감독, 2. 상대팀 감독
			manager_pos = function(idx)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_manager_' .. idx)
			end,
			base_pos = function(idx)
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_base_' .. idx)
			end,
			batter_start_pos = function()
				return field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_batter_start')
			end
		}

		self.fx = {
			get = function()
				return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_get')
			end,
		}

		---@type BattleBallGameDynamicNPCs
		self.dynamic_npcs = nil

		self.out_type = {
			defense = {
				--땅볼
				enum.hit_result.ground_ball,
				--뜬볼
				enum.hit_result.fly_ball,
				--삼진
				enum.hit_result.strikeout,
				--병살
				enum.hit_result.double_play
			},

			---@param hit_result BattleBallGameHitResult 타격 결과
			---@return boolean 실점이 아닌 아웃(땅볼, 뜬볼, 삼진, 병살)일 경우 인지 반환
			is_defensive_out = function(this, hit_result)
				local is_defensive_out = false

				for i = 1, #this.defense do
					if hit_result == this.defense[i] then
						is_defensive_out = true
					end
				end

				return is_defensive_out
			end
		}

		self.runner_position = {
			---@param base_data number[] 미니게임에서 넘겨주는 base 데이터 ex : { 1, -1, 2, 3 }
			---@return boolean 베이스가 전부 비어 있는지
			is_base_empty = function(this, base_data)
				local is_base_empty = true

				for i = 2, #base_data do
					local base = base_data[i]

					if base ~= -1 then
						is_base_empty = false
					end
				end

				return is_base_empty
			end,

			---@param base_data number[] 미니게임에서 넘겨주는 base 데이터 ex : { 1, -1, 2, 3 }
			---@return boolean 만루 상태 인지
			is_bases_loaded = function(this, base_data)
				local is_bases_loaded = true

				for i = 2, #base_data do
					local base = base_data[i]

					if base == -1 then
						is_bases_loaded = false
					end
				end

				return is_bases_loaded
			end,

			---@param runner_position_speech_key_data table 섹션별 진루 상황에 따른 스피치 키 데이터
			---@param base_data number[] 미니게임에서 넘겨주는 base 데이터 ex : { 1, -1, 2, 3 }
			---@return string base 데이터를 디코딩 하여 진루 상황에 맞는 스피치 키를 반환
			get_speech_key = function(this, runner_position_speech_key_data, base_data)
				local key = 'base_'

				-- 1번 데이터는 타자 데이터라 2번 부터
				for i = 2, #base_data do
					local base = base_data[i]

					if base ~= -1 then

						key = key .. i - 1
					end
				end

				return runner_position_speech_key_data[key]
			end
		}

		-- 연출마다 페이드 인아웃이 상이 하여 블로킹이 없도록 페이드 인아웃의 순서쌍을 맞춰주기 위해 사용
		self.fade = {
			--out 할때 is_circular 값 지정
			is_circular = false,

			default_fade_time = 0.5,

			--종료시 기본값
			dispose = function(this)
				this.is_circular = false
			end,

			---@param fade_time number fade_in 시간
			---@param base_data boolean async 로 적용할지
			out_screen = function(this, fade_time, is_async)
				fade_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_time, this.default_fade_time)
				local async = is_async and '_async' or ''

				if this.is_circular then
					screen_util['fade_out_circular' .. async](fade_time, 'linear')
				else
					screen_util['fade_out' .. async](fade_time, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				end
			end,

			---@param fade_time number fade_in 시간
			---@param base_data boolean async 로 적용할지
			in_screen = function(this, fade_time, is_async)
				fade_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_time, this.default_fade_time)
				async = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_time, true)
				local async = is_async and '_async' or ''

				if this.is_circular then
					screen_util['fade_in_circular' .. async](fade_time, 'linear')
				else
					screen_util['fade_in' .. async](fade_time, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				end
			end
		}
	end
end

--region 공통 사용 함수
do
	---기본 위치 배치 함수
	---@param base number[] 루에 배치할 주자 번호(없으면 -1)
	function local_class:place_default_pos(base)
		--카메라 위치는 플레이어와 타자 중간
		camera_util.set_position(self.marker.default_pos())

		--심판 초기 배치
		local judge = self.dynamic_npcs:judge()

		judge.Position = field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_judge')
		judge.Direction = direction_constants.up
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(judge)

		--일단 전부 초기화
		--NOTE: 플레이어 팀은 수비에 안 들어가는 타자도 있기 때문에, 공수 전환 시 수비에 참여하는 애들만 초기화하면 안 됨
		for i = 1, #self.defense_team.fos do
			local fo = self.defense_team:get(i)

			--일단 전부 초기화
			field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)
			character_util.stop(fo)
		end

		--일반 수비수 fo 배치
		do
			local pitcher_hand = self.defense_team.pitcher_hand

			for defense_idx = 1, #self.defense_team.defense_order do
				local fo = self.defense_team:get_by_def_idx(defense_idx)

				--포수일 때 UP, 나머지 DOWN
				if defense_idx == enum.def.catcher then
					fo.Direction = direction_constants.up
				else
					fo.Direction = direction_constants.down
				end

				fo.Position = self.marker.defender_pos(defense_idx)

				--왼손 투수일 때만 글러브 위치, 대기 애니메이션이 혼자 다름
				local glove_spec = self.defense_team.glove_specs[self.defense_team.defense_order[defense_idx]]

				do
					if defense_idx == enum.def.pitcher then
						local idle_anim = self.const.common.pitcher.idle_anim[pitcher_hand]
						local glove_slot = self.const.common.pitcher.glove_slot[pitcher_hand]

						character_util.spine_remove_attachment(fo, glove_slot)
						character_util.spine_set_attachment(fo, glove_slot, glove_spec)
						scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, idle_anim)
					else
						local idle_anim = self.const.common.default_idle_anim
						local glove_slot = self.const.common.default_glove_slot

						character_util.spine_set_attachment(fo, glove_slot, glove_spec)
						scene_util.set_anim(fo, self, idle_anim)
					end
				end

				field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.enabled)
			end
		end

		--공격 주자들 fo 배치
		do
			--일단 전부 비활성화
			for i = 1, #self.offense_team.fos do
				local fo = self.offense_team:get(i)
				--NOTE: 다이나믹 NPC의 이슈 상 최초 호출 시에 disabled가 안 되나, 999로 가 있는 상태라 문제 없을 듯
				field_object_util.set_active_state(fo, active_state_type.disabled)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(fo)

				--모든 슬롯에서 낀 아이템 제거
				do
					local glove_slot_left = self.const.common.pitcher.glove_slot.left
					local glove_slot_right = self.const.common.pitcher.glove_slot.right
					local bat_slot = self.const.common.default_bat_slot

					character_util.spine_remove_attachment(fo, glove_slot_left)
					character_util.spine_remove_attachment(fo, glove_slot_right)
					character_util.spine_remove_attachment(fo, bat_slot)
				end

				character_util.stop(fo)
			end
