								true, {
									portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
									viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8),
									default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
								})
					elseif out_count == 2 then
						--2아웃 달성 시
						--오딜 말풍선(x0.4, y:0.7): 퍼플 삭스의 결승에 필요한 아웃 카운트는 하나!!!
						music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
						scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(catcher, 'ss_battleball_main_s10_out_6_2',
								true, {
									portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
									viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8),
									default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
								})
					elseif out_count == 3 then

						self:win_the_game()

						--FIXME : 공격 이닝으로 전환 될 때 페이드 인 아웃이 어떻게 진행 되는지 기획 판단 후 수정
						self.fade.is_circular = false

						return
					end
				end
			else
				--실점 시
				--랜디 (right, idle, dead) 출력
				scene_util.set_direction(battleball_girl, direction_constants.right, false)
				scene_util.set_anim_async(battleball_girl, self, { name = 'dead', keep_anim = true })

				--미니 게임 시작 연출 부터 진행
				self.fade.is_circular = true

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
				return
			end
		end

		if cur_highlight_index == 2 or cur_highlight_index == 4 or cur_highlight_index == 6 then
			local is_base_empty = self.runner_position:is_base_empty(base)

			-- 주자가 한명이라도 진루해 있을때만
			if not is_base_empty then
				local runner_position_speech_key = self.runner_position:get_speech_key(self.runner_position_speech_key_data, base)

				-- 주자 만루일 경우
				local is_bases_loaded = self.runner_position:is_bases_loaded(base)

				if is_bases_loaded then
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
				end

				scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(catcher, runner_position_speech_key,
						true, {
							portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
							viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8),
							default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
						})
			end
		end

		self.fade.is_circular = true
	end

	---@param cur_highlight_index number 몇번째 하이라이트인지
	---인트로 연출 종료 후 세팅 함수
	function local_class:exit_battle_outro(cur_highlight_index)
		local demon_inspector = self.character.demon_inspector

		--1초에 걸쳐 서큘러 페이드 아웃 (async)
		self.fade:out_screen(1, true)

		--0.5초 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

				viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8),
				default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
			})

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--완료되면 대사 출력
	wait_all_lua(
			function()
				--다, 다시 왼손으로 좋은 모습을 보여주는랜디 선수 인데요?
				scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(mad_scientist, self, 'left',

						{

							skip = true,

					camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.const.common.default_cam_size, camera_dur)

					local camera_pos = self.marker.default_pos()
					camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, camera_dur)
				end

	--이번 이닝 무사히 마무리할 수 있을지 지켜보겠습니다.

	local battleball_pitcher = self.player_team:get(8)
	local battleball_girl = self.player_team:get(4)
	local thrower_pos = self.marker.field_point(1)
	local manager_pos = self.marker.manager_pos(1)

	--이닝 종료 시
	--화면 shake 0.08세기로 0.5초 출력
	camera_util.shake(0.08, 0.5)

	--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4, y:0.6): 쓰리 아웃으로 이닝 종료!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	scene_util.show_shout_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'ss_battleball_main_s10_outro_6_1',
			true, {
				portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8),

			})

	scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_pitcher, self, 'smile')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(4, 0.5)

	start_coroutine(function()

			skip = false

		wait_for_sec(1)

		--관중 (x:0.8, y: 0.7)[shout 1.2배]: 퍼플 삭스가 이겼다!!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(battleball_pitcher, {

			viewport_pos = vector(0.8, 0.7),
			default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size,
			skip = false
		})
	end)

	local wp_list = {
		{
			--1번 (right, smile, cast2)
			npc = self.player_team:get(1),
			end_pos = thrower_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			direction = 'right',
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'cast2',
		},
		{
			--2번 (left, smile, idle)
			npc = self.player_team:get(2),
			end_pos = thrower_pos + vector(1, 0, 1),
			direction = 'left',
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'idle',
		},
		{
			--3번 (left, smile, victory_get)
			npc = self.player_team:get(3),
			end_pos = thrower_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			direction = 'left',
			emotion = 'smile',
			anim = 'victory_get',
		},
		{

function local_class:play_custom_speech_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args, speech_args)
	self:start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)
	-- 스트링 키로 넣은 경우면 skippable로 간주하고 기본 args 구성
	if type_util.is_string(speech_args) then
		speech_args = {
			key = speech_args,
			skip = true,
		}
	end

	if speech_args.portraitname == nil then
		speech_args.portraitname = self.portrait[character]
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(character, speech_args)

	self:end_action(character, anim_args, emotion_args)
end

function local_class:start_action(character, version_holder, dir_args, anim_args, emotion_args)
	if dir_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_direction_by_args(character, dir_args)
	end

	if anim_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_anim(character, version_holder, anim_args)
	end

	if emotion_args ~= nil then
		scene_util.set_emotion(character, version_holder, emotion_args)
	end
end

function local_class:end_action(character, anim_args, emotion_args)
	local keep_anim = lua_helper.get_value(anim_args, 'keep', false)
	local upper_anim = lua_helper.get_value(anim_args, 'upper', false)

	local keep_emotion = lua_helper.get_value(emotion_args, 'keep', false)

	if anim_args ~= nil and not keep_anim then
		character_util.remove_anim(character, upper_anim)
	end

	if emotion_args ~= nil and not keep_emotion then
		character_util.remove_emotion(character)
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return local_class()
	end
}

--기사 타석 인트로 세팅
function local_class:knight_batter_intro_setting()
	local knight = self.player_team:get(1)
	local princess = self.character.princess

	local player_manager = self.character.purple_sox_manager
	local sucker_puncher_manager = self.character.sucker_puncher_manager

	local base_2_pos = self.marker.base_pos(2)

	local batter_start_pos = self.marker.batter_start_pos()
	local princess_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos('battleball_game_s15_princess')

	--시작전 배치
	do
		--퍼플 삭스 감독(shortstory_ bb_purple_sox_manager) (right, idle, cross_arm)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(player_manager, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_direction(player_manager, direction_constants.right)
		character_util.set_position(player_manager, self.marker.manager_pos(1))
		scene_util.set_anim(player_manager, self, { name = 'cross_arm', one_shot_sfx = false })

		--써커 펀처 감독 (shortstory_bb_sucker_puncher_manager) (left, idle, seat)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(sucker_puncher_manager, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_direction(sucker_puncher_manager, direction_constants.left)
		character_util.set_position(sucker_puncher_manager, self.marker.manager_pos(2))
		scene_util.set_anim(sucker_puncher_manager, self, 'seat')

		--기사(shortstory_bb_knight_male / shortstory_bb_knight_female)(right, idle twohand_idle)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(knight, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(knight, batter_start_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(knight, direction_constants.right)
		scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'twohand_idle')

		--bb_battleball_black_bat 착용한 상태 (임시: nail_bat)
		local bat_slot = self.const.common.default_bat_slot
		local bat_spec = self.const.common.black_bat
		character_util.spine_set_attachment(knight, bat_slot, bat_spec)

		--(shortstory_bb_princess)(right, idle, idle)(x: -7, y: 1, z:70)
		field_object_util.set_active_state(princess, active_state_type.enabled)
		character_util.set_position(princess, princess_pos)
		character_util.set_direction(princess, direction_constants.right)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		local is_create, place_controller = global_table_util.try_create('Quest/Etc/CharacterPlaceController/CharacterPlaceController')
		local dynamic_princess = place_controller:get_group('minigame_audience_group_3'):get_dynamic_member('princess')
		field_object_util.set_active_state(dynamic_princess, active_state_type.disabled)

		camera_util.set_position(base_2_pos)
	end
end

--기사 타석 인트로 연출(1번째 하이라이트)
function local_class:knight_batter_intro()
	local knight = self.player_team:get(1)
	local demon_inspector = self.character.demon_inspector
	local home_pos = self.marker.base_pos(4)

	local sp_data = function(key, viewport_pos, fo)
		return {
			key = key,
			viewport_pos = viewport_pos,
			skip = true,
			portraitname = self.portrait[fo],
			default_orthographic_size = CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize
		}
	end

	--동시 연출
	do
		--카메라 크기 4
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio_async(4, 0)

		--스피치버블 크기 조절 위해 대기
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(knight)

		wait_all_lua(
				function()
					--화면 0.5초에 걸쳐 fade in
					screen_util.fade_in(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

					--보라색 1번 ‘나’ 타석으로 이동
					--2의 속도로 이동
					--(right, idle, sword_walk)
					scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'sword_walk')
					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(knight, self.marker.batter_pos(2), 2,
							nil, self, nil, {
								last_direction = 'left',
								end_callback = function()
									--도착하면 (left, idle, twohand_idle)
									scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, 'twohand_idle')
								end
							})

					--카메라 2초에 걸쳐 2루 포커스에서 스트라이크 존 포커스로 이동
					camera_util.move_async(home_pos, 4)
				end,
				function()
					--2번 그룹
					--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4 y:0.7): 7회 초, 스코어는 7 대 4으로 앞서가고 있는 상황.
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self,
							nil, nil, nil,
							sp_data('ss_battleball_game_s15_1', vector(0.3, 0.8), demon_inspector))

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

					--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4 y:0.7): 써커 펀처의 승리까지 아웃 카운트는 하나 남았습니다.
					scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self,
							nil, nil, nil,
							sp_data('ss_battleball_game_s15_2', vector(0.3, 0.8), demon_inspector))
				end
		)
	end

	--위 연출 끝나면 다음으로 진행
	wp_util.wait_move_end(self)

	--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4 y:0.7): 타석에서는 1번 타자 $name 선수입니다.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			nil, nil, sp_data('ss_battleball_game_s15_3', vector(0.3, 0.8), demon_inspector))

	--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4 y:0.7): 분위기는 써커 펀처에게 넘어간 상태인데요.
	scene_util.play_normal_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
			nil, nil, sp_data('ss_battleball_game_s15_4', vector(0.3, 0.8), demon_inspector))

	--0.5초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--기사 (up, handgun_idle) 출력
	scene_util.set_anim(knight, self, { name = 'handgun_idle' })
	character_util.set_direction(knight, direction_constants.up)

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	--동시 연출
	do
		--0.5초에 걸쳐 카메라 기본값으로 전환
		camera_util.resize_by_ratio(self.const.common.default_cam_size, 0.5)

		--0.5초에 걸쳐 마운드와 스트라이크 존 중간을 포커스로 이동
		camera_util.move_async(self.marker.default_pos(), 0.5)

		--위 연출 완료되면 다음으로 진행
	end

	--0.3초 대기
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
end

function local_class:knight_batter_outro()
	local knight = self.player_team:get(1)
	local demon_inspector = self.character.demon_inspector
	local mad_scientist = self.character.mad_scientist

	--안타 연출 완료되면 기사 (left, smile, victory_extra) 출력
	scene_util.set_direction(knight, 'left', false)

function local_class:batttleball_girl_batter_outro(hit_result)
	local demon_inspector = self.character.demon_inspector

	local speech_key = 'ss_battleball_main_s15_first_out_'
	--고정 연출
	--플레이어가 good 이상을 쳤을 경우 좌측 홈런 연출 출력
	if hit_result == enum.hit_result.fly_ball then
		--뜬볼일 경우
		--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4, y:0.6): 리에 선수가 뜬볼으로 아웃되면서 써커 펀처가 우승합니다!
		speech_key = speech_key .. hit_result
	elseif hit_result == enum.hit_result.ground_ball then
		--땅볼일 경우
		--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4, y:0.6): 리에 선수가 땅볼으로 아웃되면서 써커 펀처가 우승합니다!
		speech_key = speech_key .. hit_result
	elseif hit_result == enum.hit_result.strikeout then
		--삼진일 경우
		--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4, y:0.6): 리에 선수, 삼진으로 아웃되면서 써커 펀처가 우승합니다!
		speech_key = speech_key .. hit_result
	else
		speech_key = nil
	end

			  default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size,
			  scale = 0.8, portraitname = self.portrait[battleball_pitcher] })

	--아래 대사 연출 항목 동시에 실행.
	local is_odil_end = false

	local remove_speech = function(npc)
		local bubble = speech_bubble.instance:Get(npc)

		if bubble ~= nil then
			bubble:ResetBubble()
		end
	end

	start_coroutine(function()
		--랜디 파트
		--아래의 대사를을 2초에 한 번씩 실행.
		scene_util.set_emotion(battleball_pitcher, self, 'damaged')

		--랜디 (down, damaged, idle) : 실수하지 마. 실수하지 마. 실수하지 마. 실수하지 마. 실수하지 마. 실수하지 마.
		while is_odil_end == false do

					{ key = 'ss_battleball_main_s15_awaken_11_8', skip = false,
					  type_speed = 0.03, default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size,
					  scale = 0.8, portraitname = self.portrait[battleball_pitcher], bubble_direction = 'rb' })

			wait_for_sec(2)

			remove_speech(battleball_pitcher)
		end
	end)

	--오딜, 그레모리 파트
	--오딜 말풍선(x0.4, y:0.7) : 이전 타자가 볼넷이었기 때문이었을까요…?
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'ss_battleball_main_s15_awaken_11_5',
			true, {
				portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.4, 0.7),
				default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
			})

	--그레모리 말풍선(x:0.6, y:0.7) : 조, 좀 더 집중할 필요가 있습니다…!
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'ss_battleball_main_s15_awaken_11_6',
			true, {
				portraitname = 'mad_scientist',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.6, 0.7),
				default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
			})

	--오딜 말풍선(x0.4, y:0.7) : 랜디 선수… 이대로면…
	scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'ss_battleball_main_s15_awaken_11_7',
			true, {
				portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
				viewport_pos = vector(0.4, 0.7),
				default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
			})

	is_odil_end = true

	remove_speech(battleball_pitcher)

	--이때 오딜 마지막 말풍선이 실행된 0.5초 뒤 아래의 대사 실행
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--리에 말풍선(x0.5, y:0.2) : [shout] 랜디!!!!!
	--화면 0.3 / 0.3 shake 실행.

				viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.2),
				default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
			})

						emotion = 'smile',

						direction = 'right',
						emotion = 'smile',
						anim = 'cast2',
					},
					{
						--6번 (down, smile, cast)
						npc = self.player_team:get(6),

						emotion = 'smile',

						emotion = 'smile',
						anim = 'clap',
					},

						field_object_util.set_active_state(npc, active_state_type.enabled)
						npc.Position = info.start_pos
					end

					local wp = wp_util.get_turn_once_wp(npc, info.end_pos, true)

					--(진행 방향, smile, run)

					scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, 'smile')
					wp_util.move_with_end_callback(npc, wp, 7, nil, self, move_key, {
						run = true,
						end_callback = function()
							scene_util.set_direction(npc, info.direction, false)
							scene_util.set_emotion(npc, self, info.emotion)
							scene_util.set_anim(npc, self, info.anim)

				--오딜 말풍선(x:0.5, y:0.7)[1.3배]: 퍼플 삭스는 위기에 강한 팀이었습니다!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,
						nil, nil,
						{
							key = 'ss_battleball_main_s15_6_outro_4',
							skip = true,
							viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.7),
							scale = 1.3,
							default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size

				--오딜 말풍선(x:0.5, y:0.7)[1.3배]: 리빙 레전드 리에 선수와 돌아온 신인왕 랜디!

							skip = true,
							viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.7),
							scale = 1.3,
							default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size
						})
				--오딜 말풍선(x:0.5, y:0.7)[1.3배]: 그들이 현존하는 최강의 배틀볼 팀이라는 것을 증명해냅니다!
				scene_util.play_shout_speech_action(demon_inspector, self, nil,

						{
							key = 'ss_battleball_main_s15_6_outro_6',

							viewport_pos = vector(0.5, 0.7),
							scale = 1.3,
							default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size

				music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

				--카메라 1초에 걸쳐 fade out
				self.fade.is_circular = false
				self.fade:out_screen(1, true)
			end
		end
	end

	if not is_3_out then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

		--오딜 말풍선(x:0.4, y:0.7):여전히 주자는 만루입니다.
		scene_util.show_normal_speech_async(demon_inspector, 'ss_battleball_game_s15_base_1',

					portraitname = 'demon_inspector',
					viewport_pos = vector(0.3, 0.8),
					default_orthographic_size = self.default_speech_size

return {

	end

local enemy_state = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/JumpingOnTrainGame/Enemy/JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyState')

local enemy_registry = {}

local enemy_class = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemy')

local enemy_load_cnt = 0

function enemy_class:init(enemy_controller, player_controller, enemy_data)
  self.enemy_controller = enemy_controller
  self.player_controller = player_controller
  self.enemy_data = enemy_data
  self.character = nil
  enemy_load_cnt = enemy_load_cnt + 1
  self.train = nil

  self.reset_pos_val = unity_class.vector3.one * 999
  self.current_ani = nil
  self.current_dir = nil
  self.is_alive = true

  self.effect_name_list = player_controller.effect_name_list

  self.class_name = 'default'

  --자식에 있는 변수 추가 nil로 선언시 할당이 안되어 실제로는 부모에서 접근이 불가능하다.
  self.shoot_helper = ''

  self.collision_state = {
    none = 0,
    collision = 1, --충돌
    stamping = 2, -- 밟은거
  }

  self.attacked_cutscene_kind = {
    normal = 1,
    become_star = 2
  }

  self.has_star_piece = false

  local config = self.player_controller.constants_data['item_config']
  self.star_piece_name = config.star_piece_name
  if enemy_data.has_star_piece and not star_piece_util.has_star_piece(self.star_piece_name) then
    self.has_star_piece = true
  end
end

function enemy_class:load_async()
  self.enemy_name = 'mini_game_enemy_'..enemy_load_cnt..'_'.. self.enemy_data.npc_name
  self.dynamic_npc = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({ [ self.enemy_name] = self.enemy_data.npc_name })
  self.character =  self.dynamic_npc[self.enemy_name]
  self.character.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy0
  self.character.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterCrashBehaviour.Instance
  self.character.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.MonsterAssassinateDamagedBehaviour.Create()
  self.character.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled
  self.character.Position = self.reset_pos_val
  character_util.spine_set_attachment(self.character, '[base]weapon1', self.enemy_data.weapon)
  self:set_dir('left')
  self:set_ani(self.enemy_data.ani.idle)

  self.character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 50)
  self.character.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

  --레벨 표시 제거
  field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(self.character, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

  if self.has_star_piece then
    self.star_piece_effect =  self.effect_name_list['fx_starpiece_in_character']():Instantiate(self.character.Position,
        unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.character.Transform)
  end
end

function enemy_class:check_collision_bounds(bounds1, bounds2)
  local x_overlap = bounds2.min.x <= bounds1.max.x and bounds2.max.x >= bounds1.min.x
  local z_overlap = bounds2.min.z <= bounds1.max.z and bounds2.max.z >= bounds1.min.z

  return x_overlap and z_overlap
end

function enemy_class:remove_star_piece()
  self.has_star_piece = false

  if self.star_piece_effect then
    self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
    self.star_piece_effect = nil
  end
end

function enemy_class:set_ani(ani_name)
  if self.current_ani ~= ani_name then
    self.current_ani = ani_name
    character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = ani_name })
  end
end

function enemy_class:set_dir(dir)
  if self.current_dir ~= dir then
    self.current_dir = dir
    character_util.set_direction(self.character, dir)
  end
end

function enemy_class:dispose()
  self.enemy_data = nil
  self.character = nil
  if self.dynamic_npc ~= nil then
    load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npc)
    self.dynamic_npc = nil
  end
  self.dynamic_npc = nil

  if self.star_piece_effect then
    self.star_piece_effect:Dispose()
    self.star_piece_effect = nil
  end
end

function enemy_class:reset()
  self.character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 50)
  self.character.Position = self.reset_pos_val
  character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'left')

  self:change_state('idle')

  wait_for_sec(0.1)

  character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })
  character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })

  wait_for_sec(0.1)

  self.effect_name_list['hit']():Instantiate(self.character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
  self.effect_name_list['last_hit']():Instantiate(self.character.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

  character_util.spine_pulse_color(self.character, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
  character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.character, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.6)
  character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.character, vector(0, 0, 0.1), 0.3, 0.2)

  music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_03', max_distance = 6, parent = self.character, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

  local character_pos = self.character.Position

  wait_all_lua(
      function()
        if not self.has_star_piece then return end
        self.player_controller:set_pause(true)
        stage.ProjectileManager:ClearProjectiles()

        local star_piece = self.player_controller.star_piece
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_quest_complete_a_01')
        star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, character_pos, character_pos)

        coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(0.2, star_piece.Position,  character_pos + vector(0,0,3), function(progress, cur_value)
          star_piece.Position = cur_value
        end)
        wait_for_sec(0.2)
        coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(0.5, star_piece.Position,  character_pos + vector(0,0,1), function(progress, cur_value)
          star_piece.Position = cur_value
        end)

        self.player_controller:set_pause(false)

      end,
      function()
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_die_goblin_01')
        if kind == self.attacked_cutscene_kind.become_star then
          self.character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 30)
          character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'up')
          character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })
          character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'cliff',  one_shot_sfx = false, })

          character_util.spine_scale(self.character, vector(0,0,0), 1)

          local dir_vec = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self.player_controller.character.Direction)

          character_util.move_to_async(self.character, self.character.Position + dir_vec * 2 + vector(0,0, 2), 1)
          wait_for_sec(0.2)

          local twinkle_effect = self.effect_name_list['twinkle']():Instantiate(self.character.Position)

          wait_for_sec(0.5)
          twinkle_effect:Dispose()

          self:reset()
        else
          self.character.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 60)
          character_util.set_direction(self.character, 'down')
          character_util.set_emotion(self.character, { name = 'damaged' })
          character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'cliff',  one_shot_sfx = false, })
          music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_big_01', max_distance = 10
          , parent = self.character, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

          character_util.move_to(self.character, self.character.Position + vector(0,1, 0), 0.3)

          character_util.spine_scale(self.character, vector(2,2,2), 0.3)
          wait_for_sec(0.3)

          character_util.move_to(self.character, self.character.Position + vector(0,0.5, 0), 0.1)
          wait_for_sec(0.1)

          character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'embarrassed',  one_shot_sfx = false, })

          character_util.move_to_async(self.character, self.character.Position + vector(0,0, -5), 1)
        end

        self:reset()
      end

  )
end

local enemy_class = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/JumpingOnTrainGame/Enemy/JumpingOnTrainGameEnemy')

local enemy_controller = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyController')

function enemy_controller:init(controller)
  self.controller = controller
  self.is_cutscene = false
end

function enemy_controller:setting_enemy(player_controller)
  self.player_controller = player_controller

  self.enemy_kind = self.player_controller.constants_data['enemy_kind']
  self.enemy_spec = self.player_controller.constants_data['enemy_spec']

  self.unused_enemy_queue = {}
  self.current_enemy_pool = {}

  self.enemy_has_star = {}

  -- 몬스터 동적 생성
  for i = 1, #self.enemy_kind do

    local enemy_data = self.enemy_spec[self.enemy_kind[i]]
    self.unused_enemy_queue[self.enemy_kind[i]] = queue_util.new()
    for j = 1, enemy_data.max_cnt do
      local enemy = enemy_class[self.enemy_kind[i]]:new(self, self.player_controller, enemy_data)
      enemy:load_async()
      self.unused_enemy_queue[self.enemy_kind[i]]:push(enemy)
      if enemy_data.has_star_piece then
        table.insert(self.enemy_has_star, enemy)
      end
    end
  end
end

function enemy_controller:dispose()
  if self.current_enemy_pool ~= nil then
    for i = 1, #self.current_enemy_pool do

      self.current_enemy_pool[i]:dispose()
    end
  end

  if self.unused_enemy_queue ~= nil then
    for i = 1, #self.unused_enemy_queue do
      while self.unused_enemy_queue[i] ~= nil and self.unused_enemy_queue[i]:size() > 0 do
        local item = self.unused_enemy_queue[i]:pop()
        item:dispose()
      end
    end
  end
  self.enemy_with_star = nil
end

function enemy_controller:set_enemy(train, enemy_sequence_info)

  for i = 1, #enemy_sequence_info do

    local enemy = self.unused_enemy_queue[enemy_sequence_info[i].enemy_kind]:pop()

    if enemy == nil then
      return
    end

    if enemy.enemy_data.kind ~= 'airborne' then
      enemy:set_train(train)
      enemy.character.Position =  vector(train:get_position().x + enemy_sequence_info[i].x, 0.1, self.player_controller.ground_z_val)
      enemy:change_state('roaming')
    else
      -- 공중형 적은 기차와 상관 없이 동작하도록 한다.
    end

    table.insert(self.current_enemy_pool, enemy)
  end
end

function enemy_controller:sync_train()
  for i = 1, #self.current_enemy_pool do

    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]
    enemy:sync_train()

  end
end

function enemy_controller:update_frame(dt)

  if self.is_cutscene then
    return
  end

  for i = 1, #self.current_enemy_pool do

    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]
    enemy:update_frame(dt)

  end
end

function enemy_controller:remove_enemy_out_of_screen()

  for i = #self.current_enemy_pool, 1, -1 do

    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]

    if enemy.enemy_data.kind ~= 'airborne' then
      --이 경우 아래 기차가 없어진 건지 체크
      if enemy.train == nil or not enemy.train.is_using then
        enemy:reset()
        enemy:change_state('idle')
        table.remove(self.current_enemy_pool, i)
        self.unused_enemy_queue[enemy:get_enemy_kind()]:push(enemy)
      end
    end

  end

end

function enemy_controller:remove_all_enemies()
  for i = #self.current_enemy_pool, 1, -1 do
    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]
    enemy:reset()
    enemy:change_state('idle')
    table.remove(self.current_enemy_pool, i)
    self.unused_enemy_queue[enemy:get_enemy_kind()]:push(enemy)
  end
end

function enemy_controller:remove_enemies(enemies, is_reset)
  for i, e in ipairs(enemies) do
    self:remove_enemy(e, is_reset)
  end
end

function enemy_controller:remove_enemy(enemy, is_reset)
  for i, e in ipairs(self.current_enemy_pool) do
    if e == enemy then
      table.remove(self.current_enemy_pool, i)
      self.unused_enemy_queue[enemy:get_enemy_kind()]:push(enemy)
      break
    end
  end

  if is_reset then
    enemy:reset()
    enemy:change_state('idle')
  end
end

function enemy_controller:get_attackable_enemies(player, attack_range)

  local return_enemies = {}

  for i = 1, #self.current_enemy_pool do
    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]
    local enemy_pos = enemy.character.Position
    local player_pos = player.Position

    if vector_util.distance(enemy_pos, player_pos) <= attack_range then
      if player.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
        if enemy_pos.x <= player_pos.x then
          table.insert(return_enemies, enemy)
        end
      else
        if enemy_pos.x >= player_pos.x then
          table.insert(return_enemies, enemy)
        end
      end
    end
  end

  return return_enemies
end

function enemy_controller:check_collision(player)
  local is_set_event = false

  for i = 1, #self.current_enemy_pool do
    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]

    if enemy ~= nil then
      local collision_sate = enemy:get_collision(player.Bounds)

      if enemy.collision_state.collision == collision_sate then
        if not is_set_event then
          self.player_controller:collision_damaged_event(enemy)
        end
      elseif enemy.collision_state.stamping == collision_sate then
        if not is_set_event then
          --self.player_controller:collision_stamping_event(enemy)
          self.player_controller:collision_damaged_event(enemy)
        end
        --enemy:change_state('stun')
      end
    end
  end
end


function enemy_controller:get_blocking_enemy(character, move)

  local return_enemies = {}

  local magnitude = move.magnitude
  local normalizedMove = move.normalized

  for i = 1, #self.current_enemy_pool do
    local enemy = self.current_enemy_pool[i]

    if character ~= enemy.character then

      if CS.BoundsExtensions.IntersectLineSegmentOnXz(enemy.character.Bounds, character.Bounds.center, character.Bounds.center + move) then

        --if CS.BoundsExtensions.GetDistanceOnRay(enemy.character.Bounds, bounds, normalizedMove) <= magnitude then
        table.insert(return_enemies, enemy)
      end
    end
  end

  return return_enemies
end

function enemy_controller:set_attacked_cutscene(enemies)
  self.is_cutscene = true
  start_coroutine(self.set_attacked_cutscene_async, self, enemies)
end

function enemy_controller:set_attacked_cutscene_async(enemies)
  local cutscene_cnt = #enemies

  self:remove_enemies(enemies, false)

  for i = 1, #enemies do
    start_coroutine(function()
      enemies[i]:view_attacked_cutscene_async()

    end, self)

  while cutscene_cnt > 0 do
    coroutine.yield(nil)
  end

  self:remove_enemies(enemies, true)

  self.is_cutscene = false

function enemy_controller:set_remove_stars(star_piece_name)
  --일단 단일이므로

  for i = 1, #self.enemy_has_star do
    self.enemy_has_star[i]:remove_star_piece()
  end
end

return {
  create = function()
    return enemy_controller()
  end

---- 돌아다니는 패턴
local roaming_state = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyRoamingState', base_state)

state_registry['roaming'] = roaming_state

function roaming_state:init(enemy)
  self.super:init(enemy)

  self.state = {
    none = 1,
    search = 2,
    moving = 3,
  }

  self.cur_state = self.state.none

  self.time_passed = 0
  self.ani_time_delay = 1
  self.direction_val = 1
  self.next_direction = 0
  self.move_duration = 0.3

  self.none_ani = {'cross_arm', 'release', 'clap', self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle}
end

function roaming_state:late_init()
end

function roaming_state:update_frame(dt)
  local enemy = self.enemy.character
  --동일 차량일 경우나 공격 볌위 안일 경우 추적 상태로 돌입
  if vector_util.distance(self.player_controller.character.Position,  enemy.Position) <= self.enemy.enemy_data.attack_range then
    self.enemy:change_state('chasing')
    return
  end
  if self.enemy.train ~= nil then
    if self.enemy.train:is_on_train(self.player_controller.character.Position) then
      self.enemy:change_state('chasing')
      return
    end
  else
    return
  end

  local train_min_x = self.enemy.train:get_min_x() + 0.2
  local train_max_x = self.enemy.train:get_max_x() - 0.2

  if self.cur_state == self.state.none then

    if self.time_passed == 0 then
      if enemy.Position.x >= train_max_x - 0.3 or enemy.Position.x <= train_min_x + 0.3 then
        self.enemy:set_ani('cliff')
        self.ani_time_delay = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, 2)
      else
        local index = math.random(1, #self.none_ani)
        self.enemy:set_ani(self.none_ani[index])
        self.ani_time_delay = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, 4)
      end
    end

    if self.time_passed >= self.ani_time_delay then
      self.time_passed = 0
      self.cur_state = self.state.search
      return
    end
  elseif self.cur_state == self.state.search then
    if self.time_passed == 0 then
      if self.next_direction == 0 then
        local x_offset = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0,train_max_x - train_min_x - 1)
        if enemy.Position.x < train_min_x + x_offset then
          self.direction_val = 1
          self.enemy:set_dir('right')
        else
          self.direction_val = -1
          self.enemy:set_dir('left')
        end
      else
        self.direction_val = self.next_direction
        if self.next_direction < 0 then
          self.enemy:set_dir('left')
        else
          self.enemy:set_dir('right')
        end
        self.next_direction = 0
      end
    end
    if self.time_passed >= self.ani_time_delay then
      self.cur_state = self.state.moving
      self.time_passed = 0
      return
    end
  elseif self.cur_state == self.state.moving then
    if self.time_passed == 0 then
      self.move_duration = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.3, 0.6)
    end

    local movement = self.enemy.enemy_data.move_speed * dt * self.direction_val
    local check_x_pos = enemy.Position.x + movement

    if #self.enemy.enemy_controller:get_blocking_enemy(enemy, vector(movement + 0.2 * self.direction_val,0,0)) > 0 then
      self.cur_state = self.state.none
      self.time_passed = 0
      self.next_direction = -self.direction_val
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
      return
    end

    if check_x_pos < train_min_x then
      check_x_pos = train_min_x
      self.time_passed = self.move_duration
    end

    if check_x_pos > train_max_x then
      check_x_pos = train_max_x
      self.time_passed = self.move_duration
    end

    if movement > 0 then
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.run)
    end

    enemy.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(enemy.Position, check_x_pos)

    if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
      self.cur_state = self.state.none
      self.time_passed = 0
      return
    end
  end

  self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function roaming_state:is_acting_complete()
  return true
end

function roaming_state:is_moving()
  return self.cur_state == self.state.moving
end

function roaming_state:dispose()
  self.super:dispose()

  self.is_complete_acting = true
end

function roaming_state:get_type()
  return 'roaming'
end

---- 추적하는 패턴
local chasing_state = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyChasingState', base_state)

state_registry['chasing'] = chasing_state

function chasing_state:init(enemy)
  self.super:init(enemy)

  self.state = {
    none = 1,
    moving = 2,
  }

  self.cur_state = self.state.none

  self.time_passed = 0
  self.ani_time_delay = 0.5
  self.direction_val = 1
  self.move_duration = 0.3
end

function chasing_state:late_init()
end

function chasing_state:update_frame(dt)
  local enemy = self.enemy.character
  local player = self.player_controller.character

  local distance = vector_util.distance(player.Position,  enemy.Position) - self.enemy.enemy_data.attack_range
  --동일 차량이 아닐 경우 로밍 상태로 돌입
  if self.enemy.train ~= nil then
    if not self.enemy.train:is_on_train(player.Position) and distance > 0 then
      self.enemy:change_state('roaming')
      return
    end
  else
    return
  end

  local train_min_x = self.enemy.train:get_min_x() + 0.2
  local train_max_x = self.enemy.train:get_max_x() - 0.2

  if self.cur_state == self.state.none then
    if self.time_passed == 0 then
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
      if enemy.Position.x < player.Position.x then
        self.direction_val = 1
        self.enemy:set_dir('right')
      else
        self.direction_val = -1
        self.enemy:set_dir('left')
      end
    end

    if self.time_passed >= self.ani_time_delay then
      self.cur_state = self.state.moving
      self.time_passed = 0
      return
    end
  elseif self.cur_state == self.state.moving then


    if distance <= 0  then
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
      --attack state로 변경
      self.enemy:change_state('attack')
      return
    end

    if self.time_passed == 0 then
      self.move_duration = distance / self.enemy.enemy_data.move_speed
    end

    local movement = self.enemy.enemy_data.move_speed * dt * self.direction_val
    local check_x_pos = enemy.Position.x + movement

    if #self.enemy.enemy_controller:get_blocking_enemy(enemy, vector(movement + 0.2 * self.direction_val,0,0)) > 0 then
      self.cur_state = self.state.none
      self.time_passed = 0
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
      return
    end

    if check_x_pos < train_min_x then
      check_x_pos = train_min_x
      movement = 0
      self.time_passed = self.move_duration
    end

    if check_x_pos > train_max_x then
      check_x_pos = train_max_x
      movement = 0
      self.time_passed = self.move_duration
    end

    if movement > 0 then
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.run)
    else
      self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
    end
    enemy.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(enemy.Position, check_x_pos)

    if self.time_passed >= self.move_duration then
      self.cur_state = self.state.none
      self.time_passed = 0
      return
    end
  end

  self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function chasing_state:is_acting_complete()
  return true
end

function chasing_state:is_moving()
  return self.cur_state == self.state.moving
end

function chasing_state:dispose()
  self.super:dispose()

  self.is_complete_acting = true
end

function chasing_state:get_type()
  return 'chasing'
end


---- 공격하는 패턴
local attack_state = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyAttackState', base_state)

state_registry['attack'] = attack_state

function attack_state:init(enemy)
  self.super:init(enemy)

  self.state = {
    none = 1,
    start_attack = 2,
  }

  self.cur_state = self.state.none

  self.time_passed = 0

end

function attack_state:late_init()
end

function attack_state:update_frame(dt)

  if self.cur_state == self.state.none then
    local enemy = self.enemy.character
    local player = self.player_controller.character

    self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
    if enemy.Position.x < player.Position.x then
      self.direction_val = 1
      self.enemy:set_dir('right')
    else
      self.direction_val = -1
      self.enemy:set_dir('left')
    end

    self.cur_state = self.state.start_attack
    return
  elseif self.cur_state == self.state.start_attack then

    if self.time_passed == 0 then
      self.enemy:view_attack_motion()
    end
  end

  self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function attack_state:is_acting_complete()
  return true
end

function attack_state:is_moving()
  return self.cur_state == self.state.moving
end

function attack_state:dispose()
  self.super:dispose()

  self.is_complete_acting = true
end

function attack_state:get_type()
  return 'attack'
end


--region StunState

-- 플레이어에게 밟혀 스턴 상태
local stun_state = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyStunState', base_state)

state_registry['stun'] = stun_state

function stun_state:init(controller)
  self.super:init(controller)
  self.time_passed = 0
  self.stun_time = 0.6
end

function stun_state:late_init()
  self.enemy:set_ani('damaged')
  character_util.spine_damage_squish(self.enemy.character, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.6)
end

function stun_state:update_frame(dt)
  if self.is_complete_acting then
    return
  end

  self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

  if self.time_passed > self.stun_time then
    self.enemy:set_ani(self.enemy.enemy_data.ani.idle)
    self.enemy:change_state('roaming')
  end
end

function stun_state:is_next_state()
  return self.is_complete_acting
end

function stun_state:dispose()
  self.super:dispose()

  self.monster = nil
  self.start_pos = nil
  self.end_pos = nil
end

function stun_state:is_chase()
  return false
end

function stun_state:get_type()
  return 'stun'
end

--endregion StunState

local enemy_state = newclass('JumpingOnTrainGameEnemyState')

function enemy_state:init()

end

function enemy_state:get_state(next_state_name, enemy)
  local state_class = state_registry[next_state_name]
  if not state_class then
    error("알 수 없는 상태입니다: " .. next_state_name)
    return nil
  end

  local next_state = state_class:new(enemy)
  next_state:late_init()
  return next_state
end

return {
  create = function()
    return enemy_state()
  end
}

function monster_controller:init()

	self.zaco_battle_data = {}
	self.boss_battle_data = {}

	--boss
	self.boss = nil

	self.dissolver = nil

	self.is_dispose = false

	if self.is_dispose then

	self.is_dispose = true

	self.boss = nil

function monster_controller:load_async(constants_data)
	self.constants_data = constants_data
	self.zaco_battle_data = constants_data.zaco_battle_data
	self.boss_battle_data = constants_data.boss_battle_data

	--디졸브 세팅
	self.dissolver = get_or_create_global_table('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async('ondemand/v2_75_civilwar/theatres/dissolve', 'dissolve_material_container')

	for _, data in pairs(self.zaco_battle_data) do
		for i = 1, data.monster_count do
			local monster = get_character(data.monster_name .. i)
			character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'attack_rush_end', scale = 0 })
			monster.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
		end
	end

	--보스 세팅
	self.boss = get_character(self.boss_battle_data.monster_name)
	character_util.set_immortal(self.boss, true)
	self.boss.ActiveState = active_state('infield')

function monster_controller:game_start()
end

function monster_controller:update(dt)
end

--일반 몬스터 죽는 연출
function monster_controller:monster_dead_routine(npc)
	npc.ActiveState = active_state('visible')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_21')

	--damaged2, loop = false
	character_util.set_anim(npc, { name = 'damaged2', loop = false })

	--0.5초간 캐릭터 검게 틴트 처리
	character_util.add_color(npc, npc.Name, unity_class.color.black, 1, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.dissolver:set_dissolve_material(npc)
	self.dissolver:set_wave_data(npc, { amplitude = 0 })

	local dissolver_dur = 1
	coroutine_util.while_each_frame(dissolver_dur, function(progress)
		self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(npc, progress)
	end)

	--캐릭터 제거
	npc.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(npc)
end

function monster_controller:boss_heal()

	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = self.boss.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.sender = self.boss
	heal_info.target = self.boss
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function monster_controller:boss_damage(damage)
	--보스에게 데미지
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = self.boss
	damage_info.target = self.boss
	damage_info.damage = damage

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function monster_controller:boss_pause()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.boss)
end

function monster_controller:boss_reset()
	self:boss_heal()

	self.boss.Position = self.constants_data.boss_restart_pos
end

return {
	create = function()
		return monster_controller()
	end
}

local player_controller = newclass('RobotFightPlayerController')

function player_controller:init()
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.is_dispose = false

	self.cashed_leader = nil

	self.battle_actions = {}
	self.combo_actions = {}

	self.front_speed = 3
	self.back_speed = 1.5

	self.is_pressed = false
	self.move_direction = nil

	self.move_state = {
		idle = 1,
		front_move = 2,
		back_move = 3,
		wait = 4,
	}
	self.current_move_state = self.move_state.idle

	self.skill_state = {
		idle = 0,
		rush = 1,
		range = 2,
		guard = 3,
		normal = 4,
		parry = 5,
	}
	self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.idle

	self.screen_controller = nil
	self.ui_controller = nil

	self.control_active = true

	self.lw_explosion = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_lw_minigame_explosion')
	end
end

function player_controller:dispose()
	if self.is_dispose then
		return
	end

	self.is_dispose = true

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent))

	self.screen_controller = nil
	self.ui_controller = nil

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당 해제
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('-', self.on_spine_event_func)
end

function player_controller:load_async(constants_data)
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.JoypadEvent), 'on_joypad_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BuffAddEvent), 'on_buff_add_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BuffExpiredEvent), 'on_buff_expired_event')

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent), 'on_battleaction_finished_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent), 'on_battleaction_cancelled_event')

	--pre load
	self:lw_explosion()

	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 처리 함수
	self.on_spine_event_func = function(entry, event)
		self:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	end

	self.constants_data = constants_data

	self.robot = get_character(constants_data.player_name)

	local actions = self.robot.CharacterBehaviour.BattleActions
	for i = 0, actions.Count - 1 do
		local ba = actions[i]

		table.insert(self.battle_actions, ba)
	end

	self.robot.Position = constants_data.player_start_pos

	self.front_speed = constants_data.front_speed
	self.back_speed = constants_data.back_speed

	character_util.remove_anim(self.robot)
	character_util.set_locked_dir(self.robot, 'right')
	character_util.set_immortal(self.robot, true)

	self:convert_to_robot()

	self:disable_controls(get_party_leader())
	self.current_pos = self.robot.Position
	self.current_time_passed = 0
	self.old_time = 0
end

function player_controller:on_touch_event(e)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 여부
	if not self.control_active or
			lua_helper.type_compare(self.robot.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState,
					typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterStunState)) then
		return false
	end

	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction1TouchDown then
		self:range_action()
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction2TouchDown then
		self:rush_action()
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction3TouchDown then
		self:guard_action()
		return true
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SpecialFunction4TouchDown then
		self:normal_action()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function player_controller:on_joypad_event(e)
	--플레이어 컨트롤 여부
	if not self.control_active then
		return false
	end

	self.move_direction = e.Stick4WayDirection

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.JoypadEventType, CS.Oak.JoypadEventType.StickDirection) and
			e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
			e.Stick4WayDirection == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		self.is_pressed = true
		return true
	else
		self.is_pressed = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function player_controller:on_buff_add_event(e)
	local buff_name = 'money_shot_parry_success_buff'

	if not self.robot.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:IsActiveBuff(buff_name) then
		return false
	end

	--- 추가된 버프
	local buff = e.Buff

	--- 버프 이름 체크
	if buff.BuffSpec.Name ~= buff_name then
		return false
	end

	--- 버프를 보낸 객체 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.robot, buff.Target) then
		return false
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_treasure_appear_01')

	--버튼 활성화
	self.ui_controller:set_button_active('normal', true)

	--지속 이펙트 생성
	self.ui_controller:hide_button_effect('normal')
	self.ui_controller:set_button_effect('normal')
	self.ui_controller:show_button_effect('normal')

	return false
end

function player_controller:on_buff_expired_event(e)
	--- 만료된 대상
	local expired_target = e.Target

	--- 만료된 대상 체크
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.robot, expired_target) then
		return false
	end

	--- 캐릭터에게 버프가 여전히 잔존하는지 체크
	if self.robot.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:IsActiveBuff('money_shot_parry_success_buff') then
		return false
	end

	--버튼 비활성화
	if self.current_skill_state == self.skill_state.guard then
		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('normal', false)
	end

	--이펙트 종료
	self.ui_controller:hide_button_effect('normal')

	return false
end

function player_controller:on_battleaction_finished_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Character, self.robot) == false then
		return
	end
	--- 현재 액션이 콤보가 아니면 생략
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BattleAction, self.combo_actions[self.current_combo_count]) == false then
		return
	end

	if self.robot.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:IsActiveBuff('money_shot_combo_buff') then
		local next_combo_count = (self.current_combo_count) % #self.combo_actions + 1

		if unity_class.time.realtimeSinceStartup - self.last_normal_action_down_time < 0.3 then
			self.delay_trigger_action = true
		end

		self.current_combo_count = next_combo_count
	else
		self:reset_combo()
		return
	end

	self.time_since_last_combo_action = 0
	self.waiting_next_combo_action = true
end

function player_controller:on_battleaction_cancelled_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Character, self.robot) == false then
		return
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.BattleAction, self.combo_actions[self.current_combo_count]) == true then
		self:reset_combo()
	end
end

--원거리 스킬 시전
function player_controller:range_action()
	local action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.robot, 'RangeHeavenholdRobot')

	--쿨타임 여부
	if self.ui_controller:is_cool_down('range') then
		return
	end

	if self.current_skill_state == self.skill_state.idle and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(self.robot) == false then
		self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.range
		self.ui_controller:set_skill_cool_down('range')
		self.robot.CharacterBehaviour:TriggerBattleAction(action)
	end
end

--러쉬 스킬 시전
function player_controller:rush_action()
	local action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.robot, 'RushHeavenholdRobot')

	--쿨타임 여부
	if self.ui_controller:is_cool_down('rush') then
		return
	end

	if self.current_skill_state == self.skill_state.idle and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(self.robot) == false then
		self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.rush
		self.robot.CharacterBehaviour:TriggerBattleAction(action)
	end
end

--가드 스킬 시전
function player_controller:guard_action()
	local action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.robot, 'GuardHeavenholdRobot')

	if self.current_skill_state == self.skill_state.idle and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(self.robot) == false then
		self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.guard
		self.ui_controller:set_skill_cool_down('guard')
		self.robot.CharacterBehaviour:TriggerBattleAction(action)

		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('normal', false)
		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('range', false)
		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('rush', false)
	end
end

--평타 스킬 시전
function player_controller:normal_action()
	--페링
	if self.current_skill_state ~= self.skill_state.parry and
			self.robot.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour:IsActiveBuff('money_shot_parry_success_buff') then
		local action = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.robot, 'ParryHeavenholdRobot')
		local triggered = self.robot.CharacterBehaviour:TriggerBattleAction(action)

		self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.parry

		--패링 어택시 버튼 실행
		self.ui_controller:hide_button_effect('normal')
		self.ui_controller:set_button_end_effect('normal')
		self.ui_controller:show_button_effect('normal')

		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('normal', true)
		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('range', true)
		self.ui_controller:set_button_active('rush', true)
	else
		if self.current_skill_state ~= self.skill_state.idle or
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(self.robot) == true then
			return
		end

		self.ui_controller:set_skill_cool_down('normal')
		self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.normal

		local action = self.combo_actions[self.current_combo_count]
		local triggered = self.robot.CharacterBehaviour:TriggerBattleAction(action)

		if triggered then
			self.waiting_next_combo_action = false
		end
	end
end

function player_controller:game_start()
	local combo_action_names = self.robot.CharacterBehaviour.BattleStyleSpec.ClassBattleActions
	for _, action_name in pairs(combo_action_names) do
		local ba = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetBattleActionByName(self.robot, action_name)
		table.insert(self.combo_actions, ba)
	end

	--- 스켈레톤 애니메이션 할당
	self.skeleton_animation = self.robot.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	--- 스파인 이벤트 콜백 할당
	self.skeleton_animation.state:Event('+', self.on_spine_event_func)

	--late init
	self.screen_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RobotFight/Controller/ScreenController')
	self.ui_controller = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RobotFight/Controller/UIController')
end

function player_controller:update(dt)
	self.old_time = self.current_time_passed
	self.current_time_passed = self.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.waiting_next_combo_action then
		self.time_since_last_combo_action = self.time_since_last_combo_action + dt
		if self.time_since_last_combo_action > 0.5 then
			self:reset_combo()
		end
	end

	--로봇 이동 스테이트 처리
	if self.control_active then
		if not self.is_pressed or
				lua_helper.type_compare(self.robot.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState,
						typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterStunState)) or
				CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(self.robot) == true then
			self.current_move_state = self.move_state.idle
			character_util.remove_anim(self.robot)
		else
			if self.move_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
				character_util.set_anim(self.robot, { name = 'walk' })
				self.current_move_state = self.move_state.front_move
			elseif self.move_direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
				character_util.set_anim(self.robot, { name = 'walk_back' })
				self.current_move_state = self.move_state.back_move
			end
		end

		--로봇 움직임
		if self.current_move_state == self.move_state.front_move then
			local diff = self.front_speed * dt * vector(1, 0, 0)
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.robot, diff)
		elseif self.current_move_state == self.move_state.back_move then
			local diff = self.back_speed * dt * vector(-1, 0, 0)
			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.robot, diff)
		end
	end

	--스킬 시전 완료 시
	if self.current_skill_state ~= self.skill_state.idle and
			CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.IsAnyBattleActionActive(self.robot) == false then
		--스킬 쿨다운 설정
		if self.current_skill_state == self.skill_state.rush then
			self.ui_controller:set_skill_cool_down('rush')
		elseif self.current_skill_state == self.skill_state.guard then
			self.ui_controller:set_button_active('normal', true)
			self.ui_controller:set_button_active('range', true)
			self.ui_controller:set_button_active('rush', true)
		end

		self.current_skill_state = self.skill_state.idle
	end
end

--로봇으로 리더 변경
function player_controller:convert_to_robot()
	self.cashed_leader = get_party_leader()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.robot)

	self.current_combo_count = 1
	self.last_normal_action_down_time = unity_class.time.realtimeSinceStartup
	self.time_since_last_combo_action = 0
	self.waiting_next_combo_action = false
	self.robot.DamagedBehaviour.SuppressDamageReaction = true
end

--기존 리더로 복구
function player_controller:convert_to_leader()
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.cashed_leader)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.cashed_leader, 'enabled')
end

function player_controller:disable_controls(leader)
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(leader, false)
	local disabled_control = CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All)

	player_state:DisableControls(disabled_control)
	message_system:SendSync(leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))
end

function player_controller:set_control_active(active)
	self.control_active = active
end

--async 죽는 연출
function player_controller:dead_routine()
	--몬스터 피격 종료 대기
	while lua_helper.type_compare(self.robot.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterStunState)) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	--dead 애니메이션 실행
	character_util.cancel_all_battle_actions(self.robot, true)

	character_util.remove_anim(self.robot)

	local dead_sfx_callback = function(_, sfx)
		local sfx_key = sfx.Data.Name

		if sfx_key == 'sfx1' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_ready_03')
		elseif sfx_key == 'sfx2' then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_heavenhold_stomp_03')
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.robot, { name = 'dead', loop = false, sfx_name = dead_sfx_callback })

	--애니메이션 실행 시작 후 4초 대기
	--대기하는 처음의 2.5초간 0.5초 간격으로 몸 주위 2칸 내 랜덤한 지점에 fx_lw_minigame_explosion 이펙트 생성
	do
		local wait_duration = 4
		local fx_delay = 0.5
		local result_duration = 0

		local fx_offset = {
			vector(-3.5, 8, 0),
			vector(1.5, 14, 0),
			vector(-0.5, 11, 0),
			vector(-2, 15.5, 0),
			vector(2.5, 10, 0),
		}

		--fx_offset과 순서를 공유
		local sfx_data = {
			'02_lina_b_explosion_01',
			'02_orca_mine_explosion_01',
			'02_lina_ds_explosion_01',
			'02_lina_b_explosion_01',
			'02_inspector_explosion_01',
		}

		for num = 1, #fx_offset do
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_data[num])
			self:lw_explosion():Instantiate(self.robot.Position + fx_offset[num])

			wait_for_sec(fx_delay)
			result_duration = result_duration + fx_delay
		end

		wait_for_sec(wait_duration - result_duration)
	end
end

--모든 스킬 쿨타임 초기화
function player_controller:init_skill_cool_down_all()
	self.ui_controller:init_cool_down('normal')
	self.ui_controller:init_cool_down('range')
	self.ui_controller:init_cool_down('guard')
	self.ui_controller:init_cool_down('rush')
end

function player_controller:heal()
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.heal = self.robot.CharacterStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
	heal_info.sender = self.robot
	heal_info.target = self.robot
	heal_info.skipEffect = true

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function player_controller:damage()
	--보스에게 데미지
	local damage_rate = 0.2

	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
	damage_info.sender = self.robot
	damage_info.target = self.robot
	damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.robot.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * damage_rate)

	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end

function player_controller:reset()
	self:heal()

	character_util.set_immortal(self.robot, true)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.robot)

	self.robot.Position = self.constants_data.player_restart_pos
end

function player_controller:reset_combo()
	self.current_combo_count = 1
	self.time_since_last_combo_action = 0
	self.waiting_next_combo_action = false
	self.delay_trigger_action = false
end

function player_controller:check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, target_passed)
	return target_passed == 0 and old_time_passed == 0 or
			old_time_passed < target_passed and target_passed <= time_passed
end

function player_controller:on_spine_event(entry, event)
	--- 이벤트 키 검증
	if event.Data.Name == 'walk1' or event.Data.Name == 'walk2' then
		self:play_random_walk_sfx()
		self.screen_controller:shake(0.2, 0.15)
		return
	end
end

function player_controller:play_random_walk_sfx()
	local sfx_name = '02_heavenhold_stomp_0'
	local rand = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_name .. rand)
end

--- 어떤 애니메이션을 스파인 몇 번 트랙에 할당할지
spine_animation_track = {
	--- 베이스 애니메이션 트랙 번호
	base = CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Base,
	--- 상체 애니메이션 트랙 번호
	upper = CS.Oak.Character.SpineAnimationTrack.Upper
}

return {
	create = function()
		return player_controller()
	end

local screen_controller = newclass('RobotFightBackScreenController')

function screen_controller:init()
	--배경 + 카메라 프리팹
	self.w18_bg_obj = nil

	self.constants_data = {}

	self.is_dispose = false

	--region BackGround

	--시작 지점 벽
	self.virtual_obj = nil

	--scrolling background pool
	self.scrolling_background_pool = {}

	--카메라를 따라다니는 background
	self.following_background_pool = {}

	--배경화면 기준점
	self.cashed_player_pos = vector(0, 0, 0)

	--background tint
	self.tint_pivot = unity_class.color.white
	self.renderer_data = {}
	self.fx_data = {}

	--tint calcurator
	self.tint_calculator = {
		is_active = false,
		is_calculate = false,
		time_passed = 0,
		tint_info = {
			target_color = nil,
			start_color = nil,
			duration = 0,
		},
		add_tint = function(this, start_color, target_color, duration)
			this.is_active = true
			this.time_passed = 0
			this.tint_info.start_color = start_color
			this.tint_info.target_color = target_color
			this.tint_info.duration = duration
			this.is_calculate = true
		end,
		remove_tint = function(this, duration)
			this.is_active = true
			this.time_passed = 0
			this.tint_info.start_color = self.tint_pivot
			this.tint_info.target_color = unity_class.color.white
			this.tint_info.duration = duration
			this.is_calculate = true
		end,
		update = function(this, dt)
			this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt

			if this.time_passed > this.tint_info.duration then
				this.is_calculate = false
				return this.tint_info.target_color
			else
				local progress = this.time_passed / this.tint_info.duration
				local result_color = unity_class.color.Lerp(
						this.tint_info.start_color, this.tint_info.target_color, progress)
				return result_color
			end
		end,
	}

	--endregion

	--region Camera
	--camera resize calcurator
	self.resize_camera_calculator = {
		is_active = false,
		is_calculate = false,
		time_passed = 0,
		resize_info = {
			target_size = nil,
			start_size = nil,
			duration = 0,
		},
		reset_size = function(this, start_size, target_size, duration)
			this.is_active = true
			this.is_calculate = true
			this.time_passed = 0
			this.resize_info.start_size = start_size
			this.resize_info.target_size = target_size
			this.resize_info.duration = duration
		end,
		update = function(this, dt)
			local result_size = this.resize_info.start_size

			if this.time_passed > this.resize_info.duration then
				this.is_calculate = false
				result_size = this.resize_info.target_size
			else
				local progress = this.time_passed / this.resize_info.duration
				result_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(
						this.resize_info.start_size, this.resize_info.target_size, progress)
			end

			this.time_passed = this.time_passed + dt

			return result_size
		end,
	}

	self.camera_state = {
		normal = 1,
		target = 2,
		boss_battle = 3,
		change = 4,
		player = 5,
	}
	self.current_camera_state = self.camera_state.player
	self.change_camera_info = {
		before_state = self.camera_state.normal,
		after_state = self.camera_state.normal,
		lerp_duration = 0,
		time_passed = 0,
	}

	--카메라
	self.camera_obj = nil
	self.camera = nil

	--카메라 중심
	self.camera_pivot = vector(0, 0, 0)
	self.camera_normal_pivot = vector(0, 0, 0)

	--카메라 타게팅 대상
	self.target = nil
	self.robot = nil
	self.boss = nil
	self.is_screenplay = false

	self.bottom_fixed = true

	self.camera_min_size = 0
	self.camera_max_size = 0

	--카메라 거리
	self.target_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)

	--좌우 이동 한계 값
	self.camera_grid = {

	}

	-- ex = {
	--	active = false,

	--	duration = 0,

	--}
	self.change_grid_info = {}

	--endregion
end

function screen_controller:dispose()
	if self.is_dispose then
		return
	end

	self.is_dispose = true

	self.constants_data = {}

	--프리팹 제거
	if not is_unity_null(self.w18_bg_obj) then

function screen_controller:camera_update(dt)
	--카메라 크기 계산
	self:resize_camera_update(dt)

	--카메라 pivot 계산
	self:camera_pivot_update(dt)

	--카메라 위치 입력
	self.camera_obj.position = self.camera_pivot

	--카메라 쉐이크
	self:shake_update(dt)
end

function screen_controller:resize_camera_update(dt)
	--사이즈 계산
	if self.resize_camera_calculator.is_active then
		local camera_size = self.resize_camera_calculator:update(dt)
		self.camera.orthographicSize = camera_size

		if not self.resize_camera_calculator.is_calculate then
			self.resize_camera_calculator.is_active = false
		end
	end

	if self.current_camera_state == self.camera_state.boss_battle then
		local boss_x = self.boss.Position.x + 4.5
		local robot_x = self.robot.Position.x - 4.5
		local distance = boss_x - robot_x
		local camera_size = distance / 2 / self.camera.aspect

		if camera_size >= self.camera_min_size and camera_size <= self.camera_max_size then
			self.camera.orthographicSize = camera_size
		end
	end
end

function screen_controller:camera_pivot_update(dt)
	local pos_by_state = {}
	pos_by_state[self.camera_state.player] = self.robot.Position + self.target_offset
	pos_by_state[self.camera_state.boss_battle] = (self.robot.Position + self.boss.Position) / 2 + vector_util.get_0yz(self.target_offset)
	pos_by_state[self.camera_state.normal] = self.camera_normal_pivot

	if self.target ~= nil then
		pos_by_state[self.camera_state.target] = self.target.Position + vector_util.get_0yz(self.target_offset)
	end

	--state 별 카메라 처리
	if self.current_camera_state == self.camera_state.change then
		self.change_camera_info.time_passed = self.change_camera_info.time_passed + dt

		--스테이트 전환용 연출
		local current_pivot = pos_by_state[self.change_camera_info.before_state]
		local next_pivot = pos_by_state[self.change_camera_info.after_state]

		--progress by result
		if self.change_camera_info.time_passed >= self.change_camera_info.lerp_duration then
			self.current_camera_state = self.change_camera_info.after_state
			self.camera_pivot = next_pivot
		else
			local progress = self.change_camera_info.time_passed / self.change_camera_info.lerp_duration

			self.camera_pivot = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_pivot, next_pivot, progress)
		end
	elseif self.current_camera_state ~= self.camera_state.normal then
		self.camera_pivot = pos_by_state[self.current_camera_state]
	end

	--그리드 구역 전환
	for name, data in pairs(self.change_grid_info) do
		if data.active then
			self.change_grid_info[name].time_passed = data.time_passed + dt

			if self.change_grid_info[name].time_passed > data.duration then
				self.change_grid_info[name].active = false
				self.camera_grid[name] = data.change_after
			else
				local progress = self.change_grid_info[name].time_passed / data.duration
				self.camera_grid[name] = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(
						self.camera_grid[name], data.target_pos, progress)
			end
		end
	end

	--스크린플레이 제외 min max 보정
	if not self.is_screenplay then
		local offset = self:camera_half_width()
		local camera_min_grid = self.camera_grid.min + offset
		local camera_max_grid = self.camera_grid.max - offset

		if camera_min_grid > self.camera_pivot.x then
			self.camera_pivot = vector_util.get_0yz(self.camera_pivot, camera_min_grid)
		elseif camera_max_grid < self.camera_pivot.x then
			self.camera_pivot = vector_util.get_0yz(self.camera_pivot, camera_max_grid)
		end
	end

	--카메라 사이즈에 따른 y 값 보정
	if self.camera_pivot.y < self:camera_half_height() or self.bottom_fixed then
		self.camera_pivot = vector_util.get_x0z(self.camera_pivot, self:camera_half_height())
	end
end

function screen_controller:shake_update(dt)
	if self.shake_calculator.IsActive then
		self.shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		local shake_offset = vector_util.get_xy0(self.shake_calculator.ShakeOffset, 0)
		self.camera_obj.position = self.camera_obj.position + shake_offset
	end
end

function screen_controller:scrolling_update(dt)
	local half_width = self:camera_half_width()
	local camera_front_pos_x = self.camera_pivot.x + half_width
	local camera_back_pos_x = self.camera_pivot.x - half_width


	local dir = vector(self.cashed_player_pos.x - self.robot.Position.x, 0, 0)

	for _, data in pairs(self.scrolling_background_pool) do
		--배경 이동
		local cur_move = dt * data.speed * dir
		data.first.position = data.first.position + cur_move
		data.second.position = data.second.position + cur_move

		--스크롤링
		if camera_front_pos_x > data.second.position.x + (data.width / 2) then
			data.first.position = data.second.position + vector(data.width, 0, 0)

			local temp = data.first
			data.first = data.second
			data.second = temp
		elseif camera_back_pos_x < data.first.position.x - data.width / 2 then
			data.second.position = data.first.position + vector(-data.width, 0, 0)

			local temp = data.first
			data.first = data.second
			data.second = temp
		end
	end
end

function screen_controller:background_update(dt)
	for _, data in pairs(self.following_background_pool) do
		local background = data.background
		background.position = vector(self.camera_pivot.x, 11, 0) + data.offset
	end

	self.cashed_player_pos = self.robot.Position
end

function screen_controller:tint_update(dt)
	if self.tint_calculator.is_active then
		self.tint_pivot = self.tint_calculator:update(dt)
		for _, renderer in pairs(self.renderer_data) do
			renderer.color = self.tint_pivot
		end

		if not self.tint_calculator.is_calculate then
			self.tint_calculator.is_active = false
		end
	end
end

function screen_controller:shake(magnitude, duration, unscaled_time, shake_name)
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = unscaled_time or true
	shake_info.name = shake_name
	self.shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)
end

function screen_controller:cancel_shake()
	self.shake_calculator:Cancel()
end

--카메라 그리드 구역 설정
function screen_controller:set_min_area(min_pos, duration, distance)
	local grid_key = 'min'

	distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(distance, 25)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0)

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.camera_grid.min = min_pos
		return
	end

	self.camera_grid[grid_key] = min_pos - distance

	self.change_grid_info[grid_key] = {
		active = true,
		target_pos = min_pos,
		duration = duration,
		time_passed = 0,
		change_after = min_pos,
	}
end

--카메라 그리드 구역 설정
function screen_controller:set_max_area(max_pos, duration, distance)
	local grid_key = 'max'

	distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(distance, 25)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0)

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.camera_grid.max = max_pos
		return
	end

	self.camera_grid[grid_key] = max_pos + distance

	self.change_grid_info[grid_key] = {
		active = true,
		target_pos = max_pos,
		duration = duration,
		time_passed = 0,
		change_after = max_pos,
	}
end

--카메라 그리드 구역 점진적 해제
function screen_controller:remove_min_area(duration, distance)
	local grid_key = 'min'

	distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(distance, 25)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 2)

	self.change_grid_info[grid_key] = {
		active = true,
		target_pos = self.camera_grid[grid_key] - distance,
		duration = duration,
		time_passed = 0,
		change_after = 0,
	}
end

--카메라 그리드 구역 점진적 해제
function screen_controller:remove_max_area(duration, distance)
	distance = lua_helper.get_or_default(distance, 25)
	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 2)

	self.change_grid_info['max'] = {
		active = true,
		target_pos = self.camera_grid['max'] + distance,
		duration = duration,
		time_passed = 0,
		change_after = 1000,
	}
end

function screen_controller:camera_half_width()
	local half_width = self.camera.orthographicSize * self.camera.aspect
	return half_width
end

function screen_controller:camera_half_height()
	return self.camera.orthographicSize
end

--백그라운드 틴트 명령
function screen_controller:tint(target_color, tint_duration)
	self.tint_calculator:add_tint(self.tint_pivot, target_color, tint_duration)
end

--- 암전 처리
function screen_controller:set_darken(cs_action, target_darken, duration)
	if not CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsManualLocal(cs_action.Character) then
		return
	end

	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.2)
	local darken = (1 - target_darken)
	local target_color = unity_class.color(darken, darken, darken, 1)
	self:tint(target_color, duration)
end
--- 암전 제거
function screen_controller:unset_darken(cs_action, duration)
	if not CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.IsManualLocal(cs_action.Character) then
		return
	end

	duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, 0.2)
	self:remove_tint(duration)
end

--- 틴트 제거
function screen_controller:remove_tint(tint_duration)
	self.tint_calculator:remove_tint(tint_duration)
end

function screen_controller:add_renderer_data(fo)
	local renderer = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	table.insert(self.renderer_data, renderer)
end

function screen_controller:set_scrolling_background(prefab, data, fx_key)
	--첫번째 배경
	local first_transform = prefab.transform
	local width = data.width

	--두번째 배경 생성 후 배치
	local second_background = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab.gameObject)
	local second_transform = second_background.transform
	second_transform.parent = prefab.parent
	second_transform.localPosition = prefab.localPosition + vector(width, 0, 0)

	--변경 기준점
	local scrolling_background_data = {
		first = first_transform,
		second = second_transform,
		width = width,
		speed = data.speed,
	}

	table.insert(self.scrolling_background_pool, scrolling_background_data)

	--tint 변경 적용 받도록 등록
	self:add_renderer_data(second_background)

	--fx 리스트 추가
	if fx_key == 'top' then
		local fx = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(second_transform, 'fx_w18_bg_top_smoke')
		table.insert(self.fx_data, fx)
	elseif fx_key == 'mid' then
		local fx = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(second_transform, 'fx_w18_bg_middle_smoke')
		table.insert(self.fx_data, fx)
	elseif fx_key == 'bot' then
		local fx = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(second_transform, 'fx_w18_bg_smoke')
		table.insert(self.fx_data, fx)
	end
end

function screen_controller:set_following_background(prefab)
	local background_transform = prefab.transform

	local following_data = {
		background = background_transform,
		offset = background_transform.localPosition,
	}

	table.insert(self.following_background_pool, following_data)
end

--카메라 스테이트 간 전환
function screen_controller:change_camera_state(state_key, change_duration, data)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(change_duration, 0)
	local target = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'and_target')

	if target ~= nil then
		self:set_camera_target(target)
	end

	if self.current_camera_state == self.camera_state[state_key] then
		return
	end

	if state_key == 'normal' or self.current_camera_state then
		self.camera_normal_pivot = self.camera_pivot
	end

	if duration <= 0 then
		self.current_camera_state = self.camera_state[state_key]
		return
	end

	self.change_camera_info = {
		before_state = self.current_camera_state,
		after_state = self.camera_state[state_key],
		lerp_duration = duration,
		time_passed = 0,
	}

	self.current_camera_state = self.camera_state.change
end

--카메라 스테이트 간 전환
function screen_controller:camera_move_to_distance_async(distance, duration)
	local current_pos = self.camera_pivot
	local target_pos = current_pos + distance

	if duration > 0 then
		coroutine_util.while_from_to_each_frame(duration, current_pos, target_pos,
				function(_, cur_value)
					self.camera_pivot = cur_value
				end)
	end

	self.camera_pivot = target_pos
end

function screen_controller:resize_camera(target_size, duration, is_ratio)
	is_ratio = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_ratio, true)
	local result_size = target_size

	if is_ratio then
		result_size = target_size * self.camera_min_size / 11
	end

	self.resize_camera_calculator:reset_size(self.camera.orthographicSize, result_size, duration)
end

function screen_controller:set_bottom_fixed(bool)
	self.bottom_fixed = bool
end

function screen_controller:set_screenplay(is_screenplay)
	self.is_screenplay = is_screenplay
end

function screen_controller:set_fx_active(key)
	for num, data in pairs(self.fx_data) do
		self.fx_data[num].gameObject:SetActive(key)
	end
end


--화면비에 따른 카메라 최소 사이즈 계산
--4:3는 15 사이즈 시작
--16:9 부터 11 사이즈
function screen_controller:min_size_to_aspect(aspect)
	local aspect_16 = 16 / 9
	local aspect_4 = 4 / 3
	local progress = (aspect - aspect_4) / (aspect_16 - aspect_4)

	return unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.constants_data.camera_min_size.aspect_4,
			self.constants_data.camera_min_size.aspect_16, progress)
end

--화면비에 따른 카메라 최대 사이즈 계산
--4:3는 21 사이즈 시작
--21:9 부터 11 사이즈
function screen_controller:max_size_to_aspect(aspect)
	local aspect_21 = 21 / 9
	local aspect_4 = 4 / 3
	local progress = (aspect - aspect_4) / (aspect_21 - aspect_4)

	return unity_class.mathf.Lerp(self.constants_data.camera_max_size.aspect_4,
			self.constants_data.camera_max_size.aspect_21, progress)
end

--카메라 타겟 모드에서 사용 될 타겟 지정
function screen_controller:set_camera_target(fo)
	self.target = fo
end

return {
	create = function()
		return screen_controller()
	end
}
