local ui_controller = newclass('RobotFightUIController')

function ui_controller:init()
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.is_dispose = false

	--보스전 hp bar
	self.hp_bar_obj = nil
	self.hp_bar_ui = nil

	--미니게임 전용 설정 버튼
	self.navigation_obj = nil
	self.navigation_ui = nil

	self.custom_atlas = nil

	--비네트 효과
	self.vignette = nil

	self.ui_state = {
		normal = 1,
		boss = 2,
	}
	self.current_ui_state = self.ui_state.normal

	--보스 전 용 캐싱
	self.player = nil
	self.boss = nil

	--일반 몬스터 ui offset
	self.ui_offset = vector(0, 0, 0)

	--일반 몬스터 hp bar
	self.lw_hpbar_pool = function()
		return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('LwHpBar')
	end

	--러쉬 버튼 캐싱
	self.skill_button_data = {}
end

function ui_controller:dispose()
	if self.is_dispose then
		return
	end

	if self.vignette ~= nil then
		self.vignette.gameObject:SetActive(true)
		self.vignette = nil
	end

	self.is_dispose = true

	if not is_unity_null(self.navigation_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.navigation_obj)
		self.navigation_obj = nil
		self.navigation_ui = nil
	end

	if not is_unity_null(self.hp_bar_obj) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.hp_bar_obj)
		self.hp_bar_obj = nil
		self.hp_bar_ui = nil
	end

	self.player = nil
	self.boss = nil

	self.skill_button_data = {}
end

function ui_controller:load_async(constants_data, res_holder)
	self.constants_data = constants_data

	self.vignette = stage.FieldUIVignette
	self.vignette.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	--pre load
	self:lw_hpbar_pool()

	self.ui_offset = constants_data.monster_ui_offset

	--기존 환경 제거
	field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.PartyState)
	CS.Oak.UI.NavigationBar.Instance:Hide()
	stage.FieldUIMiniMap:Hide()

	--hp bar
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/ui', 'LaboseworldMoneyShotHpUI', function(prefab)
				self.hp_bar_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.hp_bar_ui = self.hp_bar_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.LaboseworldMoneyShotHpUI))
				self.hp_bar_ui:InitUI()
				self.hp_bar_ui:HideUI()
			end)

	--navigation
	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ui/stage/minigame', 'MiniGameNavigationBar', function(prefab)
				self.navigation_obj = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(CS.Oak.Stage.Instance.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab)
				self.navigation_ui = self.navigation_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.UI.MiniGameNavigationBar)).GetControllerLuaTable
			end)

	--일시 정지 클릭 버튼 기능
	self.navigation_ui:set_pause_on_click_call_back(function()
		--사운드 전체 일시 정지
		music_player:PauseAllAudioExceptBgmAndNGUI()

		self:hide_all_ui()
	end)

	--일시 정지 클릭 이어하기 기능
	--사운드 일괄 일시 정지 해제는 Pause 버튼 기본 기능으로 적용 된 상태
	self.navigation_ui:set_pause_continue_call_back(function()
		self:show_all_ui()
	end)

	--캐릭터 ui 설정
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ActionButton)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(get_party_leader(), CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton)

	--스킬 별 스페셜 버튼 세팅
	for name, info in pairs(constants_data.button_info) do
		field_ui_manager:SetUI(get_party_leader(), info.ui_type)

		local button = field_ui_manager:GetUI(get_party_leader())[info.ui_type]

		--버튼 이미지, 크기 설정
		button:SetButtonSprite(info.sprite_name, info.scale)

		--전투 중에 사용 할 수 있는 버튼
		button:SetIgnoreBattle(false)

		--버튼 쿨타임 설정
		button:SetButtonCoolTime(0)

		self.skill_button_data[name] = {
			button = button,
			cool_down = info.cool_time,
			time_passed = 0,
			is_active = false,
		}

		--키 바인딩
		button:BindingKeyCode(info.bind_key)
		button:SetKeyboardStringKey(info.keyboard_string_key)

		--버튼 위치 설정
		local positioner = button.transform:Find('Touch').transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScreenLayoutPositioner))
		positioner.Position = info.offset
		positioner:Rebuild()
	end

	--Dpad
	local dpad_ui = field_ui_manager:GetUI(get_party_leader())[CS.Oak.FieldUiType.DPad]
	local up_tr = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(dpad_ui.transform, 'up')
	up_tr.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local down_tr = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(dpad_ui.transform, 'down')
	down_tr.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			res_holder, 'ondemand/v2_86_laboseworld/ui', 'laboseworld_custom_top', function(prefab)
				self.custom_atlas = prefab.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomAtlas))
				self.custom_atlas:Initialize()
			end)

	dpad_ui:SetDpadButtonSprite('ch18_dpad_off.png', 'ch18_dpad_on.png', self.custom_atlas)

	--보스전 캐싱
	self.player = get_character(constants_data.player_name)
	self.boss = get_character(constants_data.boss_battle_data.monster_name)

	--effect
	self:set_button_effect('normal')
	self:set_button_end_effect('normal')
end

function ui_controller:update(dt)
	--버튼 쿨타임 업데이트
	for name, info in pairs(self.skill_button_data) do
		if info.is_active then
			--기존 쿨타임 초기화
			if self.skill_button_data[name].time_passed <= 0 then
				self.skill_button_data[name].is_active = false
				self.skill_button_data[name].button:SetButtonCoolDown(dt)
				self.skill_button_data[name].button:SetButtonCoolTime(unity_class.mathf.Epsilon)
			end

			self.skill_button_data[name].time_passed = info.time_passed - dt
		end
	end
end

local base_state = newclass('RunningGameMonsterBaseState')

function base_state:init(monster_controller)
	self.monster_controller = monster_controller
	self.controller = monster_controller.controller
	self.is_complete_acting = false
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function base_state:late_init()
end

function base_state:update_frame(dt)
end

function base_state:is_acting_complete()
	return true
end

function base_state:is_next_state()
	return true
end

function base_state:dispose()
	self.is_complete_acting = true
	self.monster_controller = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function base_state:get_type()
	return 'base'
end

-- 몬스터가 추적하는 패턴
local chase_state = newclass('RunningGameMonsterChaseState', base_state)

function chase_state:init(monster_controller)
	self.super:init(monster_controller)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		search = 2,
		moving = 3,
	}

	self.cur_state = self.state.none

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.line_move_delay = self.monster_controller.line_move_delay

	self.target_line = self.monster_controller.cur_line
end

function chase_state:late_init()
end

function chase_state:update_frame(dt)
	local x = self.monster_controller.cur_x
	local target_pos = self.monster_controller.monster.Position

	if self.cur_state == self.state.none then
		local player_line = self.controller:cur_player_line()
		local monster_line = self.monster_controller.cur_line

		-- 플레이어와 라인이 다를 경우 search 상태로 돌입
		if player_line ~= monster_line then
			self.cur_state = self.state.search
			self.time_passed = 0
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.state.search then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		if self.time_passed >= self.line_move_delay then
			self.time_passed = 0

			-- 같은 라인일 경우에는 none 상태로 변경
			if self:is_equal_line() then
				self.cur_state = self.state.none
			end
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.state.moving then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		local move_duration = 0.3
		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / move_duration)
		target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)

		if self.time_passed >= move_duration then
			self.cur_state = self.state.none
			self.monster_controller.cur_line = self.target_line
		end
	end

	self.monster_controller.monster.Position = vector_util.get_0yz(target_pos, x)
end

function chase_state:is_equal_line()
	local player_line = self.controller:cur_player_line()
	local monster_line = self.monster_controller.cur_line

	-- 같은 라인일 경우 return true
	if player_line == monster_line then
		return true
	end

	-- 다른 라인일 경우 라인 이동 상태로 변경
	self.cur_state = self.state.moving
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.target_line = player_line

	self.start_pos = self.monster_controller.monster.Position
	self.end_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(vector(0, 0, self.controller.line_pos_z_list[player_line])
	, self.monster_controller.cur_x)

	return false
end

function chase_state:is_acting_complete()
	return true
end

function chase_state:is_moving()
	return self.cur_state == self.state.moving
end

function chase_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	self.is_complete_acting = true
	self.monster_controller = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function chase_state:get_type()
	return 'chase'
end

--region WaitState

-- 라보스 괴물이 추격 준비 하는 상태
local wait_state = newclass('RunningGameMonsterRunningState', base_state)

function wait_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)

	-- 뛰는 애니메이션으로 변경
	character_util.set_anim(self.monster_controller.monster, { name = self.monster_controller.chase_anim })
end

function wait_state:late_init()
end

function wait_state:update_frame(dt)
	if self.time_passed >= self.monster_controller.attack_delay then
		self.is_complete_acting = true
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
end

function wait_state:is_next_state()
	if self.is_complete_acting == false then
		return false
	end

	if self.monster_controller.chase_state:is_moving() then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

function wait_state:get_type()
	return 'wait'
end

function wait_state:is_chase()

--region ChargeState

-- 어택레인지로 공격 딜레이 표기하는 상태
local charge_state = newclass('RunningGameMonsterChargeState', base_state)

function charge_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
	self.charge_time = self.monster_controller.charge_time
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.is_ready_to_attack = false

	self.ready_to_attack_duration = self.charge_time * self.monster_controller.ready_to_attack_ratio
end

function charge_state:late_init()
	self.attack_range = self.monster_controller:get_attack_range()

	local attack_range_size = math.abs(self.monster_controller.monster.Position.x - self.controller.center_pos.x) * 1.35
	self.attack_range:Resize(attack_range_size, 1.5)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.charge_time)

	self.attack_range_state = { charge = 1, hide = 2 }
	self.cur_attack_range_state = self.attack_range_state.charge
end

function charge_state:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_complete_acting then
		return
	end

	if not self.is_ready_to_attack and self.time_passed >= self.ready_to_attack_duration then
		self.is_ready_to_attack = true
	end

	if self.time_passed < self.charge_time then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
		self:update_pos_attack_range()
	else
		if not self.is_ready_to_attack and
				self.monster_controller.chase_state:is_moving() then
			if self.cur_attack_range_state == self.attack_range_state.charge then
				self.cur_attack_range_state = self.attack_range_state.hide
				self.attack_range:Hide()
			end
		else
			if self.cur_attack_range_state == self.attack_range_state.hide then
				self.time_passed = 0

				self:update_pos_attack_range()
				self.attack_range:Show(self.charge_time)
				self.cur_attack_range_state = self.attack_range_state.charge
			else
				self.is_complete_acting = true
			end
		end
	end
end

function charge_state:update_pos_attack_range()
	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.monster_controller.monster.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.5)
end

function charge_state:is_next_state()
	return self.is_complete_acting and (self.monster_controller.chase_state:is_moving() == false)
end

function charge_state:dispose()
	self.super:dispose()

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

	self.attack_range_state = nil
end

function charge_state:is_chase()
	return self.is_ready_to_attack == false or self.monster_controller.chase_state:is_moving()
end

function charge_state:get_type()
	return 'charge'
end

--endregion ChargeState

function range_attack_state:init(controller)
	self.super:init(controller)
	self.time_passed = 0

	local speed = self.monster_controller.attack_speed
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.monster = self.monster_controller.monster

	self.start_pos = self.monster.Position
	self.end_pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.controller.center_pos + vector(1, 0, 0),
			self.monster.Position.z)
	self.attack_duration = math.abs(self.end_pos.x - self.start_pos.x) / speed
	self.is_damaged = false

	self.is_charge_complete = false
end

function range_attack_state:late_init()
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_wolf_boss_jump_01', volume = 0.7, loop = false })
	character_util.set_anim(self.monster, { name = self.monster_controller.attack_anim, loop = false })

	if self.is_complete_acting then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local move_duration = self.attack_duration
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / move_duration)
	local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
	local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * 1.5 + lerp_pos.y
	character_util.set_position(self.monster, vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y), true)

	if self.is_damaged == false and self.controller:check_player_damage(self.monster_controller.cur_line, lerp_pos,
					self.controller.config.game_over_interval * 1.25, false, false) then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_slash_01', loop = false })
		self.monster_controller:add_target_x()
		self.is_damaged = true
	end

	if self.time_passed > move_duration then
		self.is_complete_acting = true
	end
end

function range_attack_state:is_next_state()
	return self.is_complete_acting
end

	self.super:dispose()

	self.end_pos = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.monster = nil
end

	return false
end

	return 'range_attack'

local monster_controller = newclass('RunningGameMonsterController')

function monster_controller:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.attack_range = nil
end

function monster_controller:setting_monster(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	local monster_spec = self.controller.constants_data['monster_spec']

	self.start_interval = monster_spec.start_interval
	self.charge_time = monster_spec.charge_time
	self.attack_speed = monster_spec.attack_speed
	self.attack_success_dist = monster_spec.attack_success_dist
	self.attack_delay = monster_spec.attack_delay
	self.chase_speed = monster_spec.move_speed
	self.accel_speed = monster_spec.accel_speed
	self.accel_time = monster_spec.accel_time
	self.melee_attack_interval = monster_spec.melee_attack_interval
	self.line_move_delay = monster_spec.line_move_delay
	self.obstacle_hit_pushed_out_dist = monster_spec.obstacle_hit_pushed_out_dist
	self.ready_to_attack_ratio = monster_spec.ready_to_attack_ratio
	self.melee_attack_duration = monster_spec.melee_attack_duration
	self.melee_attack_anim = monster_spec.melee_attack_anim
	self.max_pos_x = self.controller.center_pos.x + monster_spec.max_interval

	self.attack_anim = monster_spec.attack_anim
	self.chase_anim = monster_spec.chase_anim
	self.damaged_anim = monster_spec.damaged_anim

	-- 몬스터 동적 생성
	local chaser_key = 'running_game_chaser'
	self.dynamic_npc = load_util.create_dynamic_npcs_async({ [chaser_key] = monster_spec.npc_name })
	self.monster = self.dynamic_npc[chaser_key]

	-- 어택레인지 세팅
	self:set_attack_range(self.monster)

	self:reset_monster()
end

function monster_controller:reset_monster()
	-- 몬스터 좌표 세팅
	local start_pos = self.controller.center_pos + vector(self.start_interval, 0, 0)
	self.cur_x = start_pos.x

	character_util.set_direction(self.monster, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(self.monster, start_pos)
	character_util.set_anim(self.monster, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.set_active_state(self.monster, 'enabled')

	self.is_accel = false
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.accel_time_passed = 0
	self.cur_line = 2

	self.chase_state = chase_state(self)

	-- 몬스터 waitState로 변경
	self:change_state(wait_state(self))
end

function monster_controller:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_accel then
		self.accel_time_passed = self.accel_time_passed + dt
		if self.accel_time_passed >= self.accel_time then
			self.is_accel = false
		end
	end

	self:update_state()

	if self.current_state:is_chase() then
		self:chase_monster(dt)
		self.chase_state:update_frame(dt)
	end

	self.current_state:update_frame(dt)
end

function monster_controller:update_state()
	if self.current_state:get_type() == 'wait' and self.current_state:is_next_state() then
		self:change_state(charge_state(self))
	elseif self.current_state:get_type() == 'charge' and self.current_state:is_next_state() then
		if self.controller:get_distance_from_monster() >= self.melee_attack_interval then
			self:change_state(range_attack_state(self))
		else
			self:change_state(melee_attack_state(self))
		end
	elseif (self.current_state:get_type() == 'range_attack' or self.current_state:get_type() == 'melee_attack') and
			self.current_state:is_next_state() then
		self:change_state(back_state(self))
	elseif (self.current_state:get_type() == 'back' or self.current_state:get_type() == 'stun') and
			self.current_state:is_next_state() then
		self:change_state(wait_state(self))
	end
end

function monster_controller:dispose()
	if self.dynamic_npc ~= nil then
		load_util.dispose_dynamic_npcs(self.dynamic_npc)
		self.dynamic_npc = nil
	end

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
		self.attack_range = nil
	end
end

function monster_controller:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	next_state:late_init()
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function monster_controller:set_idle_state()
	self:change_state(idle_state(self))

	self.chase_state:dispose()
	self.chase_state = nil
end

function monster_controller:set_attack_range(target_character)
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero
	, unity_class.vector2(8, 1.5), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, target_character.Position + vector(1, 0, -0.5),
			vector(-1, 0, 0), 0.5)

	attack_range_util.show(self.attack_range, 0)
	attack_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
end

function monster_controller:get_attack_range()
	return self.attack_range
end

function monster_controller:chase_monster(dt)
	local speed = self.is_accel and self.accel_speed or self.chase_speed
	if self.cur_x >= self.controller.game_over_pos.x then
		self.cur_x = self.cur_x - (speed * dt)
	end
end

function monster_controller:set_accel()
	self.is_accel = true
	self.accel_time_passed = 0
end

function monster_controller:add_target_x()
	self.cur_x = math.max(self.cur_x - self.attack_success_dist
	, self.controller.center_pos.x + self.controller.config.game_over_interval)
end

function monster_controller:get_cur_line()
	return self.cur_line
end

function monster_controller:is_idle_state()
	return self.current_state:get_type() == 'running'
end

function monster_controller:damaged_event()
	local cur_chase_state = self.current_state.chase_state
	if cur_chase_state ~= nil and cur_chase_state.cur_state == 3 then
		return false
	end

	self:change_state(stun_state(self))
	return true
end

return {
	create = function()
		return monster_controller()
	end
}

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		explosion = 2,
	}
	self.cur_state = self.state.none

	self.character = self.controller:get_player_controller().character
	self.monster = self.controller:get_monster_controller().monster

	self.fo = fo
	self.start_pos = data.start_pos
	self.end_pos = data.end_pos
	self.move_duration = data.move_duration

	self.line = data.line
	self.damage_magnitude = self.ob_controller.size * 0.5

function attack_state:update_frame(dt)
	if self.complete_flag then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local move_duration = self.move_duration
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / move_duration)
	local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
	self.fo.transform.localPosition = lerp_pos

	if self.controller:check_player_damage(self.line, lerp_pos, self.damage_magnitude, true, true)
			or self.controller:check_monster_damage(self.line, lerp_pos, self.damage_magnitude) then

		return
	end

	if self.time_passed > move_duration then
		self.complete_flag = true
	end
end

function attack_state:is_state_complete()

end

function attack_state:is_explosion()

function obstacle:init(ob_controller, fo, data)
	-- 사용중이지 않은 장애물 가져와서
	self.fo = fo

	self.ob_controller = ob_controller

	local controller = ob_controller.controller

	self.line = data.line

	self.start_pos = vector(self.ob_controller.start_pos_x, 0, controller.line_pos_z_list[self.line])
	self.end_pos = vector(self.ob_controller.end_pos_x, 0, controller.line_pos_z_list[self.line])
	self.move_duration = math.abs(self.end_pos.x - self.start_pos.x) / self.ob_controller.speed
	self.fo.transform.localPosition = self.start_pos

	self.current_state = warning_state(self.ob_controller, self.start_pos, data)
	self.complete_flag = false
end

function obstacle:update_frame(dt)
	if self.complete_flag then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state:get_type() == 'warning' and self.current_state:is_state_complete() then
		self:change_state(attack_state(self.ob_controller, self.fo, {
			start_pos = self.start_pos,
			end_pos = self.end_pos,
			line = self.line,
			move_duration = self.move_duration
		}))
	elseif self.current_state:get_type() == 'attack' and self.current_state:is_state_complete() then
		if self.current_state:is_explosion() then
			self:change_state(explosion_state(self.ob_controller, self.fo, {
				explosion_effect_name = self.ob_controller.effect_name_list['explosion_effect_name']
			}))
		else
			self.complete_flag = true
			self:dispose_current_state(true)
			return
		end
	elseif self.current_state:get_type() == 'explosion' and self.current_state:is_state_complete() then
		self.complete_flag = true
		self:dispose_current_state(true)
		return
	end

	self.current_state:update_frame(dt)
end

function obstacle:change_state(next_state)
	self:dispose_current_state()

	next_state:late_init()
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function obstacle:is_attack_complete()
	return self.complete_flag
end

function obstacle:dispose()
	self:dispose_current_state(true)

	self.fo.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
	self.fo.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	self.fo = nil
	self.ob_controller = nil
end

function obstacle:dispose_current_state(is_nil)
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
	end

	is_nil = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_nil, false)
	if is_nil then
		self.current_state = nil
	end
end

	self.speed = obstacle_spec.speed

		end

-- 장애물 배치

	for i = 1, #self.obstacle_obj_list do

	end

return {

local road_block = newclass('RunningGameRoadBlock')

function road_block:init(road_controller, data)
	self.road_controller = road_controller
	self.controller = road_controller.controller

	self.state = {
		warning = 1,
		active = 2, -- 활성화 상태 (중간에 도착하면 멈춤)
		looping = 3, -- 오브젝트 스크롤링 시작
		close = 4,
		unlock_line_move = 5,
		end_road_block = 6,
	}
	self.cur_state = self.state.warning

	self.obj_list = data.active_obj_list
	self.cur_line = data.line
	self.size = data.size
	self.speed = data.speed
	self.damage_magnitude = self.size * 0.5
	self.warning_time = data.warning_time

	local pos = vector_util.get_xy0(self.controller.center_pos, self.controller.line_pos_z_list[self.cur_line])

	self.center_pos = self.controller.center_pos
	self.spawn_pos = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('left', pos, -self.size)
	self.reset_pos_x = screen_util.get_left_right_outside_pos('right', self.controller.center_pos, self.size).x

	self.dir_vec = unity_class.vector3.right

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.is_check_damage = false

	for i = 1, #self.obj_list do
		local obj = self.obj_list[i]
		obj.transform.localPosition = self.spawn_pos - vector(self.size * i, 0, 0)
	end

	local effect_name = self.road_controller.effect_name_list['notice_effect_name']
	local effect_offset = self.road_controller.effect_offset
	local effect_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(self.spawn_pos, self.controller.center_pos.x - effect_offset)
			+ vector(0, 2, -1.25)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_targeted_04')
	self.effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(effect_pos)
end

function road_block:update_frame(dt)
	if self.cur_state == self.state.end_road_block then
		return
	end

	if self.cur_state == self.state.warning then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
		if self.time_passed < self.warning_time then
			return
		end

		self.time_passed = 0
		self:dispose_effect()
		self.cur_state = self.state.active
	end

	local velocity = self.dir_vec * self.speed * dt
	local obj_count = #self.obj_list

	for i = 1, obj_count do
		local bg = self.obj_list[i]
		bg.transform.position = bg.transform.position + velocity
	end

	if self.cur_state == self.state.active then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

		local reset_target = self.obj_list[1]
		local reset_target_pos = reset_target.transform.position

		if self.is_check_damage == false then
			if self.controller:check_special_game_over(self.cur_line, reset_target_pos, self.size * 0.9) then
				self.is_check_damage = true
				self.cur_state = self.state.wait
			end

			if reset_target_pos.x >= self.controller.center_pos.x then
				self.is_check_damage = true
				self.controller:set_active_line_move(false)
			end
		else
			if self.controller:is_equal_line_and_not_line_move(self.cur_line) then
				self.controller.is_special_game_over = true
				self.cur_state = self.state.wait
			end
		end

		if reset_target_pos.x > self.reset_pos_x then
			local dest_pos = self.obj_list[obj_count].transform.position + (self.dir_vec * self.size * -1)

			for i = 2, obj_count do
				self.obj_list[i - 1] = self.obj_list[i]
			end

			self.obj_list[obj_count] = reset_target
			reset_target.transform.localPosition = dest_pos
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.state.close then
		local last_obj = self.obj_list[obj_count]
		local diff = last_obj.transform.localPosition.x - self.center_pos.x
		if diff >= 2 then
			self.cur_state = self.state.unlock_line_move
			self.controller:set_active_line_move(true)
		end
	elseif self.cur_state == self.state.unlock_line_move then
		local is_complete = true
		for i = 1, obj_count do
			local bg = self.obj_list[i]
			if bg.transform.localPosition.x < self.reset_pos_x then
				is_complete = false
				break
			end
		end

		if is_complete then
			self.cur_state = self.state.end_road_block
		end
	end
end

function road_block:dispose()
	self.controller:set_active_line_move(true)

	self:dispose_effect()

	for i = 1, #self.obj_list do
		local obj = self.obj_list[i]
		obj.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
		obj.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	end

	self.obj_list = nil
	self.road_controller = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

function road_block:dispose_effect()
	if self.effect == nil then
		return
	end

	self.effect:Dispose()
	self.effect = nil
end

function road_block:end_road_block()
	self.cur_state = self.state.close
end

function road_block:is_end_road_block()
	return self.cur_state == self.state.end_road_block
end

local road_block_controller = newclass('RunningGameRoadBlockController')

function road_block_controller:init(_)

end

	self.controller = controller

	for i = 1, road_block_spec.pulling_size do

		, road_block_spec.asset_name)

		obs.name = 'running_game_road_block_' .. i
		obs.transform.localPosition = vector(999, 0, 999)
		obs.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		table.insert(self.obj_list, obs)
	end

	self.effect_name_list = {}
	for key, effect_name in pairs(road_block_spec.effect_list) do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name)
		self.effect_name_list[key] = effect_name
	end

	self.active_road_block_list = {}
end

function road_block_controller:update_frame(dt)
	for i = #self.active_road_block_list, 1, -1 do
		local active_obstacle = self.active_road_block_list[i]
		active_obstacle:update_frame(dt)

		if active_obstacle:is_end_road_block() then
			active_obstacle:dispose()
			table.remove(self.active_road_block_list, i)
		end
	end
end

function road_block_controller:dispose()
	self:dispose_obj_list()
end

function road_block_controller:dispose_obj_list()
	if self.obj_list == nil then
		return
	end

	for i = 1, #self.obj_list do
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.obj_list[i])
	end

	self.obj_list = nil
end

function road_block_controller:active_road_block(data)
	local new_road_block = road_block(self, {
		line = data.line,
		active_obj_list = self:get_de_active_obj_list(),
		start_interval = self.start_interval,
		move_distance = self.move_distance,
		warning_time = self.warning_time,
		speed = self.speed,
		size = self.size
	})

	table.insert(self.active_road_block_list, new_road_block)
end

function road_block_controller:end_road_block()
	if #self.active_road_block_list <= 0 then
		return
	end

	self.active_road_block_list[1]:end_road_block()
end

function road_block_controller:get_de_active_obj_list()
	local de_active_obj_list = {}
	for i = 1, #self.obj_list do
		local obj = self.obj_list[i]

		if obj.gameObject.activeSelf == false then
			obj.gameObject:SetActive(true)
			table.insert(de_active_obj_list, obj)
		end

		if #de_active_obj_list >= self.line_obj_count then
			return de_active_obj_list
		end
	end

	return de_active_obj_list
end

function road_block_controller:all_stop_road_block()
	for i = 1, #self.active_road_block_list do
		self.active_road_block_list[i]:dispose()
	end

	self.active_road_block_list = {}
end

return {
	create = function()
		return road_block_controller()
	end
}

local bt_node_status = {
	failed = 0,
	succeed = 1,
	running = 2
}

--region 베이스 노드
local bt_node = newclass('RunningGameBaseBTNode')

function bt_node:init()
	self.is_finished = false
end

function bt_node:enter(_)

end

function bt_node:update_frame(dt)

end

function bt_node:evaluate(dt)
	return bt_node_status.succeed
end

function bt_node:dispose()
end

--endregion 베이스 노드

local attack_sequence = newclass('RunningGameSequenceNode', bt_node)

function attack_sequence:init(bt_creator, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.sub_nodes = {}

	self.cur_index = 1

	for _, node in pairs(data.sub_nodes) do
		local instance = bt_creator:create_node(node.node_type, bt_creator, node.data)
		table.insert(self.sub_nodes, instance)
	end
end

function attack_sequence:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.sub_nodes[self.cur_index]:enter(controller)
end

function attack_sequence:evaluate(dt)
	if self.cur_index > #self.sub_nodes then
		return bt_node_status.succeed
	end

	for i = 1, #self.sub_nodes do
		if self.cur_index > #self.sub_nodes then
			return true
		end

		local cur_node = self.sub_nodes[self.cur_index]
		local evaluate = cur_node:evaluate(dt)
		if evaluate == 2 then
			return bt_node_status.running
		end

		self.sub_nodes[self.cur_index]:dispose()
		self.cur_index = self.cur_index + 1
		if self.cur_index > #self.sub_nodes then
			return bt_node_status.succeed
		end

		self.sub_nodes[self.cur_index]:enter(self.controller)
	end

	return bt_node_status.succeed
end

function attack_sequence:dispose()
end

local charge_action_node = newclass('RunningGameChargeActionNode', bt_node)

function charge_action_node:init(bt_creator, data)

	self.charge_time = data.charge_time * 1.1
	self.line = data.line
	self.time_passed = 0

	self.attack_range = monster_controller:get_attack_range_list(self.line)
	self.attack_range:Show(self.charge_time)
end

function charge_action_node:evaluate(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.time_passed < self.charge_time then
		return bt_node_status.running
	end

	return bt_node_status.succeed
end

function charge_action_node:dispose()

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.attack_range = nil
	end

local attack_action_node = newclass('RunningGameAttackActionNode', bt_node)

function attack_action_node:init(bt_creator, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.data = data
	self.move_duration = data.move_duration
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function attack_action_node:enter(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	local monster_controller = controller:get_monster_controller()
	self.character = monster_controller:get_line_monster(self.data.line)

	self.start_pos = self.character.Position
	self.end_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(self.start_pos, self.data.target_x)

	character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = self.data.anim, loop = false })
end

function attack_action_node:evaluate(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local move_duration = self.data.move_duration
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / move_duration)
	local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
	local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * self.data.jump_height + lerp_pos.y
	character_util.set_position(self.character, vector_util.get_x0z(lerp_pos, cur_y), true)

	if self.time_passed > move_duration then
		return bt_node_status.succeed
	else
		return bt_node_status.running
	end
end

function attack_action_node:dispose()
	self.controller:check_damage(self.data.line)

	self.data = nil
	self.controller = nil
	self.time_passed = nil
	self.end_pos = nil
	self.start_pos = nil
	self.character = nil
end

local back_action_node = newclass('RunningGameBackActionNode', bt_node)

function back_action_node:init(bt_creator, data)
	self.super:init()

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.data = data

function back_action_node:enter(controller)
	local monster_controller = controller:get_monster_controller()
	self.character = monster_controller:get_line_monster(self.data.line)

	self.start_pos = self.character.Position
	self.end_pos = vector_util.get_0yz(self.start_pos, self.data.target_x)
	character_util.set_anim(self.character, { name = 'run' })
end

function back_action_node:evaluate(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	local move_duration = self.data.move_duration
	local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(self.time_passed / move_duration)
	local lerp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.start_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
	character_util.set_position(self.character, lerp_pos, true)

	if self.time_passed > move_duration then
		return bt_node_status.succeed
	else
		return bt_node_status.running
	end

function back_action_node:dispose()
	self.time_passed = nil

local sequence_controller = newclass('RunningGameSequenceController')
local bt_creator = get_or_create_global_table('minigame/RunningGame/Sequence/RunningGameSequenceCreator')

function sequence_controller:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
end

function sequence_controller:setting(controller)
	self.controller = controller

	local sequence_data = self.controller.constants_data['game_sequence']
	self.game_sequence = {}

	for _, sequence in pairs(sequence_data) do
		local node = bt_creator:create_node(sequence.node_type, bt_creator, sequence.data)
		table.insert(self.game_sequence, node)
	end

	self.cur_index = 1
	self.game_sequence[self.cur_index]:enter(self.controller)
end

function sequence_controller:sequence_update(dt)
	if self.cur_index > #self.game_sequence then
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, #self.game_sequence do
		local cur_node = self.game_sequence[self.cur_index]
		local evaluate = cur_node:evaluate(dt)
		if evaluate == 2 then
			return false
		end

		self.cur_index = self.cur_index + 1
		if self.cur_index > #self.game_sequence then
			return true
		end

		self.game_sequence[self.cur_index]:enter(self.controller)
	end

	return true
end

function sequence_controller:reset_sequence()
	self.cur_index = 1
	self.game_sequence[self.cur_index]:enter(self.controller)
end

function sequence_controller:dispose()
	self.game_sequence = nil
	self.controller = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return sequence_controller()
	end
}

local camera_controller = newclass('TunnelRunCameraController')

function camera_controller:init()
	self.camera_info = nil
	self.camera_pivot = nil
	self.rotate_angle = 0
end

function camera_controller:dispose()
	self.camera_pivot = nil
	self.camera_info = nil
	self.constants_data = nil
end

function camera_controller:game_init(constants_data, camera)
	self.constants_data = constants_data
	self.camera_info = constants_data.camera_info
	self.camera_pivot = camera
	self.current_angle_z = 0
	self.camera_shake_req_id = 1
end

function camera_controller:pressed(axis)
	self:rotate_camera(axis)
end

function camera_controller:rotate_camera(axis)
	--서화 / 도화 카메라 회전 추가.
	--좌, 우로 회전을 진행할 때 마다 카메라에 아래의 회전값을 실행한다.
	--좌측으로 회전을 실행할 시(45도 회전)
	--카메라 Z 로테이션 -15 이동.
	--우측으로 회전을 실행할 시(45도 회전)
	--카메라 Z 로테이션 15 이동.
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = self.constants_data.rotate_duration
	local angle = 15 * axis
	local max_angle = 45 * axis

	if self.current_angle_z ~= max_angle then
		self.current_angle_z = self.current_angle_z + angle

		local current_rotation = self.camera_pivot.transform.rotation
		local target_rotation = current_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, angle))

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			self.camera_pivot.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(current_rotation, target_rotation, progress)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

function camera_controller:reset_rotate_camera()
	self.camera_pivot.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(6, 0, 0))
end

function camera_controller:in_game_setting(duration)
	local cam_pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(self.camera_info.marker_name)

	local current_pos = self.camera_pivot.transform.position
	local current_rotation = self.camera_pivot.transform.rotation
	local cam_target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(6, 0, 0)

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.camera_pivot.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_pos, cam_pos, progress)
		self.camera_pivot.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(current_rotation, cam_target_rotation, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.camera_pivot.transform.position = cam_pos
	self.camera_pivot.transform.rotation = cam_target_rotation
end

function camera_controller:conversion_qte_scene(dir, dt, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local camera_transform = self.camera_pivot.transform
	local qte_info = self.camera_info.qte_scene

	local pos = field_util.get_marker_pos(qte_info.marker[dir])

	local set_pos = vector(qte_info.rotate[dir][1], qte_info.rotate[dir][2], qte_info.rotate[dir][3])

	local current_pos = camera_transform.position

	local current_rotation = camera_transform.localRotation

	local target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(set_pos)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + dt

		local progress = time_passed / duration

		camera_transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_pos, pos, progress)

		camera_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(current_rotation, target_rotation, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function camera_controller:stop_camera_shake()
	self.camera_shake_req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id + 1
end

function camera_controller:shake_camera_async(camera, magnitude, duration)
	self:stop_camera_shake()
	local req_id = self.camera_shake_req_id

	local shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()

	shake_info.magnitude = magnitude
	shake_info.duration = duration
	shake_info.useUnscaledTime = true

	shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)

	local cam_original_pos = camera.transform.localPosition
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	while req_id == self.camera_shake_req_id and unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		if shake_calculator.IsActive then
			shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			camera.transform.localPosition = cam_original_pos + shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera.transform.localPosition = cam_original_pos
end

function camera_controller:resize_fov_camera(camera, fov_value, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local current_fov = camera.fieldOfView
	local target_fov = fov_value

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(current_fov, target_fov, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function camera_controller:resize_fov_default_camera(camera, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local current_fov = camera.fieldOfView
	local target_fov = 45

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		camera.fieldOfView = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(current_fov, target_fov, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

return {
	create = function()
		return camera_controller()
	end
}

	end

	self:player_anim_run()

		for index = 1, #self.player_data do

		end
	end

	self:reset_companion_boy()

	self.is_player_jumping = true

	wait_all_lua(

				self:rotate_boy(rotate_axis, ignore_touch_delay)
			end,
			function()
				for index = 1, #self.player_data do
					character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player_data[index], false)
					character_util.normal_jump(self.player_data[index], '01_jump_01')
				end

			end

	end

	self.is_player_jumping = false
end

	self:update_boy_routine()
end

	if self.play_time_passed > self.enemy_info.play_duration and not self.is_boy_playing and self.is_game_play then
		self.is_boy_playing = true

		start_coroutine(function()
			self:hovering_move_async()

			self.play_time_passed = 0
			self.is_boy_playing = false
		end)
	end

	self.play_time_passed = self.play_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
end

function player_controller:rotate_boy(rotate_axis, ignore_touch_delay)
	--카메라 회전의 반대로 움직임

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = ignore_touch_delay
	local angle = 15 * rotate_axis
	local max_angle = 45 * rotate_axis

	if self.current_angle_z ~= max_angle then
		self.current_angle_z = self.current_angle_z + angle

		local current_rotation = self.companion_boy.transform.rotation
		local target_rotation = current_rotation * unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(0, 0, angle))

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			self.companion_boy.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(current_rotation, target_rotation, progress)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end
end

	local duration = 3
	local wait_duration = 1
	local time_passed = 0

	local patten_index = random_util.get_random_int(1, 4)
	local patten_name = 'patten_' .. patten_index
	local current_patten = self.enemy_info.data.patten[patten_name]

	local pos_table = {}
	local z_offset_data = {}

	for index = 1, #self.enemy_info.data.z_offset_data.value do
		local z_offset = self.enemy_info.data.z_offset_data.value[index]

		table.insert(z_offset_data, z_offset)
	end

	local pos_z_offset_table = random_util.get_values_in_array(z_offset_data, { count = 2 })
	local between_z = math.abs(pos_z_offset_table[1] - pos_z_offset_table[2])

	local data = current_patten[1]
	local set_pos = vector(
			self.enemy_info.data.pos[data][1],
			self.enemy_info.data.pos[data][2],
			self.enemy_info.data.pos[data][3] + pos_z_offset_table[1]
	)
	local fx_offset = vector(0, -0.25, 0)

	--플레이 파트 3초에서부터 8초에 한 번씩 아래에 정리된 랜덤한 시온 움직임이 실행되어 보여진다.

	--카메라 기준 Z (12.5) 의 방향에 있는 시온.
	--원통 중심에서부터 호버링 상태로 1초에 걸쳐 화면 바깥으로 이동.
	--sin 함수를 그리며 호버링
	--unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * time_passed * speed) * height + 현재 높이
	--speed = 0.4

function player_controller:player_dead()
	local older_move_offset = vector(-0.5, -8, 0)
	local younger_move_offset = vector(0.5, -8, 0)
	local duration = 0.5

	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player_data[1], false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player_data[2], false)

	--플레이어가 사라진 타일에 인접할 시, 각 캐릭터 설정된 사항을 진행.
	--도화
	--(right, surprise, embarrassed)
	--right 방향으로 1타일을 0.5초간 이동.
	--down(Y축) 방향으로 3타일을 0.5초간 이동.
	--서화 (left, surprise, embarrassed)
	--left 방향으로 1타일을 0.5초간 이동.
	--down(Y축) 방향으로 3타일을 0.5초간 이동.
	--이후 게임 오버 텍스트가 출력.
	--카메라 1초간 페이드 아웃.
	--머니샷 시작 지점으로 복귀 세팅.
	--카메라 1초간 페이드 인을 실행하여 머니샷 재진입.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	scene_util.set_direction(self.player_data[2], 'left', false)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player_data[2], { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.player_data[2], { name = 'embarrassed' })

	scene_util.set_direction(self.player_data[1], 'right', false)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player_data[1], { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.player_data[1], { name = 'embarrassed' })

	local time_passed = 0

	local current_older_pos = self.player_data[1].Position
	local current_younger_pos = self.player_data[2].Position

	local target_younger_pos = current_younger_pos + younger_move_offset
	local target_older_pos = current_older_pos + older_move_offset

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local move_progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInOutSine(progress, 0, 1, 1)

		self.player_data[1].Position = current_older_pos * (1 - move_progress) + target_older_pos * move_progress

		self.player_data[2].Position = current_younger_pos * (1 - move_progress) + target_younger_pos * move_progress

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for index = 1, #self.player_data do
		local character = self.player_data[index]

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(character)
	end

	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player_data[1], true)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.player_data[2], true)
end

function player_controller:qte_fail_scene(dir_arg, height_pos_arg, end_pos_arg, duration)
	--해당 과정에서 서화, 도화가 사슬에 피격될 시 아래에 사항 동시에 실행.
	--서화
	--(right, damaged, damaged)
	--일반 피격 연출 실행.
	--x -0.5 / y 1.5 의 공중으로 0.4초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--이후 x -1.5 / y-3 의 바닥으로 0.8초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--그대로 화면 이탈
	--도화
	--(left, damaged, damaged)
	--일반 피격 연출 실행.
	--x 0.5 / y 1.5 의 공중으로 0.4초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--이후 x 1.5 / y-3 의 바닥으로 0.8초에 걸쳐 이동.
	--그대로 화면 이탈

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	scene_util.set_direction(self.player_data[1], dir_arg[1], false)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player_data[1], { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.player_data[1], { name = 'damaged' })

	scene_util.set_direction(self.player_data[2], dir_arg[2], false)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.player_data[2], { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(self.player_data[2], { name = 'damaged' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_critical_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fall_down_01')

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player_data[1])
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.player_data[2])

	do
		local time_passed = 0

		local current_pos_player_data = {
			self.player_data[1].Position,
			self.player_data[2].Position,
		}

		while time_passed < duration do
			local progress = time_passed / duration

			for index = 1, #self.player_data do
				local pos = current_pos_player_data[index]
				local pos_2 = pos + height_pos_arg[index]
				local pos_end = pos + end_pos_arg[index]

				local vec_1 = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
						pos, pos_2, progress)

				local vec_2 = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(
						pos_2, pos_end, progress)

				self.player_data[index].Position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(vec_1, vec_2, progress)
			end

			coroutine.yield()

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end
	end
end

	character_util.set_emotion(self.player_data[1], { name = 'damaged' })

	wait_for_sec(duration)

function player_controller:start_boy_hovering(speed, height)
	--sin 함수를 그리며 호버링
	--unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * 2 * time_passed * speed) * height + 현재 높이
	--speed = 0.4
	--height = 0.1

	start_coroutine(function()
		local currnet_boy_y = self.companion_boy.Position.y
		local time_passed = 0

		while self.is_hovering_boy do

end

	self.is_game_play = boolean
end

return {
	create = function()
		return player_controller()
	end

local scroller_controller = newclass('TunnelRunScrollerController')

function scroller_controller:init()
	self.constants_data = nil

	self.scroller_speed = nil

	self.current_direction_index = nil

	self.is_changed_stage = false

	self.is_check_tile = true

	self.is_scrolling = true

	self.y_axis_value = 2.25

	self.break_start_index = 20

	self.move_dir = unity_class.vector3.back

	self.is_reset_update_wave = true

	self.current_game_number = nil

	self.tile_animation_between_time = 0.1

	self.reset_object_pos = nil

	self.lock_speed = nil

	self.wave_data_pool = {}
	self.qte_data = {}

	self.ring_object_queue = metatable_helper.inherit({
		head = 1,
		tail = 1,

		to_break_pointer = 1,

		container = {},
	}, {
		---@param this self
		init = function(this, pool)
			this.pool = pool
		end,

		dispose = function(this)
			this:clear()

			this.pool = nil
		end,

		---@param this self
		clear = function(this)
			for i = this.head, this.tail - 1 do
				this.pool:return_object(this.container[i])

				this.container[i] = nil
			end

			this.head = 1
			this.tail = 1
			this.to_break_pointer = 1
		end,

		---@param this self
		create_on_back = function(this, pattern_info)
			local ring_object = this.pool:get_object(pattern_info)

			this.container[this.tail] = ring_object
			this.tail = this.tail + 1

			return ring_object
		end,

		---@param this self
		dispose_front = function(this)
			if this:count() == 0 then
				return
			end

			local object = this.container[this.head]

			this.pool:return_object(object)

			this.head = this.head + 1
		end,

		---@param this self
		get_front_object = function(this)
			if this:count() == 0 then
				return nil
			end

			return this.container[this.head]
		end,

		get_back_object = function(this)
			if this:count() == 0 then
				return nil
			end

			return this.container[this.tail - 1]
		end,

		---@param this self
		count = function(this)
			return this.tail - this.head
		end,

		---@param this self
		get_next_break_object = function(this)
			if this.to_break_pointer == this.tail then
				return
			end

			return this.container[this.to_break_pointer]
		end,

		---@param this self
		proceed_break_object = function(this)
			if this.to_break_pointer == this.tail then
				return
			end

			this.to_break_pointer = this.to_break_pointer + 1
		end,

		---@param this self
		move = function(this, diff)
			for i = this.head, this.tail - 1 do
				local object = this.container[i]

				object:move(diff)
			end
		end,

		rotate = function(this, rotation)
			for i = this.head, this.tail - 1 do
				local object = this.container[i]

				object:rotate(rotation)
			end
		end,

		search_by_z_pos = function(this, target_z)
			for i = this.head, this.tail - 1 do
				local object = this.container[i]

				if object:get_z_pos() > target_z then
					return object
				end
			end

			return nil
		end,

		cut_all_on_back = function(this, target_z)
			for i = this.tail - 1, this.head, -1 do
				local object = this.container[i]

				if object:get_z_pos() > target_z then
					this.tail = this.tail - 1

					this.pool:return_object(object)

					this.container[this.tail] = nil
				else
					break
				end
			end
		end,

		set_front_position = function(this, position)
			if this:count() == 0 then
				return
			end

			local front = this:get_front_object()
			local origin_pos = front:get_pos()
			local diff = position - origin_pos

			for i = this.head, this.tail - 1 do
				local object = this.container[i]
				local prev_pos = object:get_pos()

				object:set_position(prev_pos + diff)
			end
		end,
	})

	self.get_reset_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('minigame_wave_reset_pos')
	end

	self.get_wave_init_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('minigame_wave_start')
	end

	self.get_minigame_init_pos = function()
		return field_util.get_marker_pos('minigame_start')
	end
end

function scroller_controller:dispose()
	self.ring_object_queue:dispose()
end

function scroller_controller:game_init(game_number, constants_data, ring_object_creator, event_object_pool)
	if self.is_preload_init then
		self.is_preload_init = false
		return
	end

	if constants_data ~= nil then
		self.constants_data = constants_data
	end

	if ring_object_creator ~= nil then
		self.ring_object_queue:init(ring_object_creator)
	end

	if event_object_pool ~= nil then
		self.qte_data = event_object_pool.qte_data
	end

	self.is_check_tile = true
	self.is_changed_stage = false
	self.scroller_speed = self.constants_data.init_speed
	self.max_speed = self.constants_data.max_speed
	self.current_direction_index = 1
	self.tile_animation_between_time = 0.1

	self.current_pattern_index = 1
	self.current_get_data_pattern_index = 1

	self.reset_object_pos = self.get_reset_pos()

	self.is_complete_wave = false

	self.ring_object_queue:clear()

	self:clear_qte_pool()

	self.current_game_number = game_number

	-- 프리로드 카운트만큼 생성
	for i = 1, self.constants_data.preload_count do
		self:append_new_ring_object()
	end

	self:set_scrolling(true)

	self:set_lock_speed(false)
end

function scroller_controller:clear_data()
	self.ring_object_queue:clear()
end

function scroller_controller:pressed(axis)
	self.is_check_tile = false

	self:rotate_object(nil, axis)

	self.is_check_tile = true
end

function scroller_controller:update()
	local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
	local check_tile_update = false

	check_tile_update = self:update_move_wave(dt, self.move_dir)

	return check_tile_update
end

function scroller_controller:update_move_wave(dt, dir_vec)
	if self.ring_object_queue:count() == 0 or not self.is_scrolling then
		return false
	end

	local velocity

	if self.lock_speed == nil then
		velocity = dir_vec * self.scroller_speed * dt

		if self.scroller_speed < self.max_speed then
			self.scroller_speed = self.scroller_speed + self.constants_data.speed_magnification
		end
	else
		velocity = dir_vec * self.lock_speed * dt
	end

	-- 위치 업데이트
	self.ring_object_queue:move(velocity)

	do
		-- 얘는 매번 계산할 필요는 없을듯
		local start_z = self.reset_object_pos.z + self.constants_data.interval_tile_size * self.break_start_index

		while true do
			local object = self.ring_object_queue:get_next_break_object()

			if object == nil then
				break
			end

			if object:get_z_pos() < start_z then
				object:play_break()

				self.ring_object_queue:proceed_break_object()
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end

	do
		local boundary_z = self.reset_object_pos.z + (self.constants_data.interval_tile_size * -1)

		while true do
			local object = self.ring_object_queue:get_front_object()

			if object == nil then
				break
			end

			if object:get_z_pos() < boundary_z then
				self.ring_object_queue:dispose_front()

				self:append_new_ring_object()
			else
				break
			end
		end
	end

	return true
end

function scroller_controller:rotate_object(set_angle, axis, dur)
	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(dur, self.constants_data.rotate_duration)
	local angle = lua_helper.get_or_default(set_angle, self.constants_data.rotate_angles)
	local front_object = self.ring_object_queue:get_front_object()

	if front_object == nil then
		return
	end

	local target = front_object.object
	local current_rotation_vector3 = target.transform.localRotation.eulerAngles

	local offset_vector = vector(0, 0, angle * axis)

	local current_rotation = target.transform.rotation
	local target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(current_rotation_vector3 + offset_vector)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local new_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Slerp(current_rotation, target_rotation, progress)

		self.ring_object_queue:rotate(new_rotation)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.current_direction_index = self.current_direction_index + axis

	if self.current_direction_index > #self.constants_data.coures_info.direction_spec then
		self.current_direction_index = 1
	elseif self.current_direction_index < 1 then
		self.current_direction_index = #self.constants_data.coures_info.direction_spec
	end
end

function scroller_controller:append_new_ring_object()
	local wave_name = 'wave_' .. self.current_game_number
	local pattern_num = self.constants_data.coures_info.data[wave_name][self.current_pattern_index]
	local is_looping_object = false

	-- 더이상 없으면 1번으로 싹 채움
	if pattern_num == nil then
		self.is_complete_wave = true
		pattern_num = 1

		is_looping_object = true
	else
		self.current_pattern_index = self.current_pattern_index + 1
	end

	local position = nil
	local rotation = nil

	if self.ring_object_queue:count() == 0 then
		position = self.get_wave_init_pos() + vector(0, self.y_axis_value, -11.5)
		rotation = unity_class.quaternion.identity
	else
		local prev_object = self.ring_object_queue:get_back_object()

		position = prev_object:get_pos() + self.move_dir * self.constants_data.interval_tile_size * -1
		rotation = prev_object:get_rotation()
	end

	local pattern_name = 'patten_' .. pattern_num
	local pattern_info = self.constants_data.coures_info.tile_patten[pattern_name]
	local ring_object = self.ring_object_queue:create_on_back(pattern_info)

	ring_object.is_looping_object = is_looping_object

	ring_object:set_position(position)
	ring_object:rotate(rotation)
end

function scroller_controller:get_is_current_tile_active()
	if not self.is_check_tile then
		return true
	end

	local target_z = self.get_minigame_init_pos().z - 1.5

	local object = self.ring_object_queue:search_by_z_pos(target_z)

	if object == nil then
		return true
	end

	local direction_name = self.constants_data.coures_info.direction_spec[self.current_direction_index]

	return object:is_tile_enabled(direction_name)
end

function scroller_controller:clear_qte_pool()
	local kusarigama_number = 70

	local qte_object = self.qte_data.object

	local animator = qte_object.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	animator:Rebind();

	for index = 1, qte_object.transform:GetChild(kusarigama_number).childCount do
		local child_index = index - 1
		local kusarigama = qte_object.transform:GetChild(kusarigama_number):GetChild(child_index).gameObject

		kusarigama:SetActive(false)
	end

	qte_object:SetActive(false)
end

function scroller_controller:next_wave_intro(duration)
	local action_object = self.qte_data.object

	self:set_scrolling(false)

	local rotate_object = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject()

	rotate_object.transform.position = vector(39.25, 0, 284)
	action_object.transform.parent = rotate_object.transform

	local current_object_pos = rotate_object.transform.position
	local end_object_pos = self.get_minigame_init_pos()

	do
		local target_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0)
		local current_rotation = rotate_object.transform.rotation

		local time_passed = 0

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = time_passed / duration

			rotate_object.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_object_pos, end_object_pos, progress)

			rotate_object.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(current_rotation, target_rotation, progress)

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	action_object.transform.parent = nil
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(rotate_object)
end

function scroller_controller:setting_next_wave()
	self:append_new_ring_object()

	local front_object = self.ring_object_queue:get_front_object()

	front_object:set_position(self.get_minigame_init_pos() + vector(0, self.y_axis_value, -10))

	for i = 2, self.constants_data.preload_count do
		self:append_new_ring_object()
	end
end

function scroller_controller:qte_clear_erase_tile(is_active)
	local action_object = self.qte_data.object
	local erase_tile_numbers = { 37, 38, 39 }
	local erase_direction_tile_numbers = { 1, 2, 3 }

	for index = 1, #erase_tile_numbers do
		local tile = action_object.transform:GetChild(erase_tile_numbers[index])

		for direction_index = 1, #erase_direction_tile_numbers do
			local direction_tile = tile:GetChild(erase_direction_tile_numbers[direction_index]).gameObject

			direction_tile:SetActive(is_active)
		end
	end

end

function scroller_controller:set_definite_current_object_pos(target_pos, duration)
	local current_object = self.qte_data.object

	local current_pos = current_object.transform.position
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		current_object.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function scroller_controller:move_next_game_wave(duration)

	local action_object = self.qte_data.object
	local front_object = self.ring_object_queue:get_front_object().object

	local time_passed = 0
	local move_offset_z = -21

	local action_object_current_pos = action_object.transform.position
	local action_object_target_pos = action_object.transform.position + vector(0, 0, move_offset_z)

	local front_object_current_pos = front_object.transform.position
	local front_object_target_pos = front_object.transform.position + vector(0, 0, move_offset_z)

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		local pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(front_object_current_pos, front_object_target_pos, progress)

		self.ring_object_queue:set_front_position(pos)

		action_object.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(action_object_current_pos, action_object_target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self:qte_clear_erase_tile(true)
	action_object:SetActive(false)
end

function scroller_controller:set_qte_intro(pos)
	self.ring_object_queue:cut_all_on_back(pos)

	self.ring_object_queue:rotate(unity_class.quaternion.identity)
end

function scroller_controller:play_qte_intro()
	local close_patten_tile_data = { 'down', 'left_down', 'right_down' }

	self.ring_object_queue:rotate(unity_class.quaternion.identity)

	for i = self.ring_object_queue.tail - 1, self.ring_object_queue.head, -1 do
		local object = self.ring_object_queue.container[i]

		for tile_name_index = 1, #close_patten_tile_data do
			object:break_tile(close_patten_tile_data[tile_name_index])
		end

		wait_for_sec(self.tile_animation_between_time)
	end
end

function scroller_controller:start_qte_tab_setting(duration)
	local object = self.qte_data.object
	local pos_z = 218
	local time_passed = 0

	local current_pos = object.transform.position
	local target_pos = vector(current_pos.x, current_pos.y, pos_z)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		object.transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(current_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	object.transform.position = target_pos
end

function scroller_controller:changed_scene_wave_data()
	self.is_changed_stage = true

	local looping_count = 0
	local set_position_count = 5

	start_coroutine(function()

		while looping_count < set_position_count and self.is_changed_stage do
			if self.ring_object_queue:get_front_object().is_looping_object then
				looping_count = looping_count + 1
			end

			if looping_count == 1 then
				self:set_is_check_tile(false)
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		if self.is_changed_stage then
			self.is_changed_stage = false
		end
	end)
end

function scroller_controller:changed_qte_object()
	local qte_object = self.qte_data.object
	local vector_offset = vector(0, 0, -6)

	qte_object.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(unity_class.vector3.zero)

	qte_object.transform.position = self.ring_object_queue:get_front_object().object.transform.position + vector_offset

	qte_object:SetActive(true)

	self.ring_object_queue:clear()

	self.update_wave_table = self.qte_data
end

function scroller_controller:play_qte_animation(animation_name)
	local animator = self.qte_data.object.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	animator:Play(animation_name)
end

function scroller_controller:get_is_change_stage()
	return self.is_changed_stage
end

function scroller_controller:scene_rotate_object(set_angle, axis, dur)
	self:rotate_object(set_angle, axis, dur)
end

function scroller_controller:cancel_changed()
	self.is_changed_stage = false
end

function scroller_controller:set_is_check_tile(bool)
	self.is_check_tile = bool
end

function scroller_controller:changed_game_wave_data(data_number)
	self:game_init(data_number)
end

function scroller_controller:get_complete_wave()
	return self.is_complete_wave
end

function scroller_controller:get_current_update_wave_table()
	return self.update_wave_table
end

function scroller_controller:set_update_wave_reset(is_reset)
	self.is_reset_update_wave = is_reset
end

function scroller_controller:set_scrolling(bool)
	self.is_scrolling = bool
end

function scroller_controller:set_tile_between_time(valve)
	self.tile_animation_between_time = valve
end

function scroller_controller:set_lock_speed(boolean, speed)
	if boolean then
		self.lock_speed = speed
	else
		self.lock_speed = nil
	end
end

function scroller_controller:proceed_qte_break(min_z, from, tile_names)
	from = from or self.ring_object_queue.tail - 1

	for i = from, self.ring_object_queue.head, -1 do
		local object = self.ring_object_queue.container[i]

		-- 대충 0.5정도 오프셋이 필요함
		if object:get_z_pos() - 5 < min_z then
			return i
		end

		for _, tile_name in pairs(tile_names) do
			object:break_tile(tile_name)
		end
	end

	return -1
end

return {
	create = function()
		return scroller_controller()
	end
}

local tile_controller = newclass('TunnelRunTileController')

function tile_controller:game_init(constants_data, game_number)
	self.constants_data = constants_data

	self.current_game_number = game_number

	self.is_start_turn_off_tile = true

	self.before_patten = nil
end

function tile_controller:turn_off_tile(pool, pos, current_game_number)
	if pool == nil or not self.is_start_turn_off_tile then
		return
	end

	local current_patten = self:get_current_object_on_pos(pool, pos)

	if self.before_patten == current_patten then
		return
	end

	self.before_patten = current_patten

	local coures_info = self.constants_data.coures_info

	local wave_name = 'wave_' .. current_game_number
	local coures_name = current_patten.transform.parent.parent.name
	local patten_name = current_patten.transform.parent.name

	local coures_data = coures_info.data[wave_name][coures_name]

	local patten_data = coures_info.tile_patten[patten_name]

	for index = 1, #coures_info.direction_spec do
		local count = index - 1
		local direction_tile = current_patten:GetChild(count)
		local direction_spec = coures_info.direction_spec[index]

		if patten_data[direction_spec].active == false then
			self:tile_animation(direction_tile)
		end
	end end

function tile_controller:tile_animation(tile)
	local name = tile.name

	self.animator_table[name].data:Play('break')
	self.animator_table[name].active = true
end

function tile_controller:reset_tile_animation()
	for _, data in pairs(self.animator_table) do
		if  data.active then
			data.data:Play('empty')
			data.active = false
		end
	end
end

function tile_controller:set_tile_animation_speed(tile, valve)
	local animator = tile.transform.parent:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	animator.speed = valve
end

function tile_controller:set_turn_off_tile(boolean)
	self.is_start_turn_off_tile = boolean
end

function tile_controller:is_event_object(object)
	return object.name == 'curve' or object.name == 'qte_action'
end

function tile_controller:is_qte_object(object)
	return object.name == 'qte_action'
end

function tile_controller:is_curve_object(object)
	return object.name == 'curve'
end

function tile_controller:set_animator_in_tile(tile)
	if self.animator_table == nil then
		self.animator_table = {}
		self.animator_index =  1
	end

	local data_table = {
		data = nil,
		active = false
	}


	local tile_name = 'tile_' ..self.animator_index
	local animator = tile.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))

	tile.name = tile_name

	data_table.data = animator
	data_table.active = false

	self.animator_table[tile_name] = data_table

	self.animator_index = self.animator_index + 1
end

function tile_controller:get_animator()
	return self.animator_table
end

return {
	create = function()
		return tile_controller()
	end
}

-- @desc    카메라 줌인 액션 리퀘스트 데이터 구조
-- @param    target_fov    변경전 카메라의 Field of View 값, 내부에서 자동으로 값 설정하니 별도 설정 필요 없음. 
-- @param    target_fov    변경할 카메라의 최종 Field of View 값
-- @param    time_passed   리퀘스트 처리를 시작하고 현재까지 경과된 시간
-- @param    duration      리퀘스트 처리까지 걸리는데 총 걸릴 시간

--[[
	{
		start_fov
		target_fov
		time_passed
		duration
	}
]]

-- @desc    카메라 이동 액션 리퀘스트 데이터 구조
-- @param    start_pos     변경전 카메라의 위치, 내부에서 자동으로 값 설정하니 별도 설정 필요 없음. 
-- @param    target_pos    카메라가 이동할 최종 위치
-- @param    time_passed   리퀘스트 처리를 시작하고 현재까지 경과된 시간
-- @param    duration      리퀘스트 처리까지 걸리는데 총 걸릴 시간
--[[
	{
		start_pos
		target_pos
		time_passed
		duration
	}
]]

-- @desc    카메라 회전 액션 리퀘스트 데이터 구조
-- @param    start_rotation     변경전 카메라의 회전 값, 내부에서 자동으로 값 설정하니 별도 설정 필요 없음. 
-- @param    target_rotation    카메라가 회전할 최종 각도
-- @param    time_passed        리퀘스트 처리를 시작하고 현재까지 경과된 시간
-- @param    duration           리퀘스트 처리까지 걸리는데 총 걸릴 시간

	}
]]

-- @desc    카메라 액션 리퀘스트 관리 데이터 구조
--          각 리퀘스트에 관련 세부 데이터 항목은 위에 나열된 데이터 구조를 참고. 
-- @param    zoom    카메라 줌인 리퀘스트 관련 데이터
-- @param    move    카메라 이동 리퀘스트 관련 데이터

	{

		rotation
	}
]]

local camera_action_request_status = {
	waiting = 1,
	requested = 2,
	progressing = 3,
	finished = 4
}

local camera_action_type = {
	move = 1, -- 직선 이동
	zoom = 2,
	rotate = 3,
	bezier_move = 4, -- 베지어 곡선 이동
	shake = 5
}

-- 17챕터 버추얼 캅 미니 게임에 사용될 리퀘스트를 기반으로 동작하는 카메라 컨트롤러
-- 가지고 있는 이동, 줌, 회전 관련 리퀘스트 데이터를 기반으로 한 프레임씩 계산하여서 적용시킨다.
-- 해당 미니 게임에서 카메라의 각 이동, 줌, 회전 행동은 단 하나씩만 존재해야하므로, 수행중인 리퀘스트 데이터가 오버라이드
-- 될 경우, 현재까지 진행된 수치에서 새로 들어온 목표 수치만큼 행동을 수행하도록 제작되어있다.
local camera_controller = newclass('VirtualCopCameraController')

function camera_controller:init()
--#region Dependencies
	-- C# 모노비헤이비어 카메라 컴포넌트
	self.camera_comp = nil
	self.default_fov = nil
	self.default_pos = nil
	self.default_rotation = nil

	self.hit_effect = nil
	self.hit_effect_original_local_position = nil

	self.screen_red_vignette = nil
--#endregion
	-- 베지어 이동 시 좌표 담고 있을 벡터
	self.bezier_point_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	-- 재시작시 활용할 값
	self.restart_position = nil
	self.restart_rotation = nil
	self.restart_fov = nil

	-- 현재 카메라 줌 리퀘스트 상태
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status = nil

	-- 현재 들어온 카메라 액션 관련 리퀘스트 데이터들
	-- 상세 값들은 위의 데이터 구조 주석 참고
	self.cur_cam_action_request = nil

	-- 다음 프레임에 등록될 리퀘스트 데이터들
	self.requests_in_queue = nil

	self.interpolations = interpolations_constants['ease_in_sine']

	self.shake_calculator = CS.Oak.ShakeCalculator()
	
	self.camera_shake_original_local_pos = nil

	self.virtual_cop_ui = nil
end

function camera_controller:late_init()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VirtualCop.CameraMoveRequestedEvent), 'on_move_requested')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VirtualCop.CameraZoomRequestedEvent), 'on_zoom_requested')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VirtualCop.CameraRotateRequestedEvent), 'on_rotate_requested')

	self:reset_requests()
end

function camera_controller:update_default_transfrom_value()
	self.default_pos = self.camera_comp.transform.position
	self.default_rotation = self.camera_comp.transform.localRotation
	self.default_fov = self.camera_comp.fieldOfView
end

function camera_controller:resolve_dependencies(camera_comp, camera_red_vignette, camera_hit_effect, virtual_cop_ui)
	self.camera_comp = camera_comp
	self.virtual_cop_ui = virtual_cop_ui

	if camera_hit_effect ~= nil then
		camera_hit_effect.transform.parent = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera.transform

		self.hit_effect = camera_hit_effect
		self.hit_effect_original_local_position = self.hit_effect.transform.localPosition
	end

	if camera_red_vignette ~= nil then
		camera_red_vignette.transform.parent = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera.transform

		self.screen_red_vignette = camera_red_vignette
	end

	self.default_fov = camera_comp.fieldOfView
	self:update_default_transfrom_value()
end

function camera_controller:set_restart_transform_value(position, rotation, fov)
	self.restart_position = position
	self.restart_rotation = rotation
	self.restart_fov = fov
end

function camera_controller:reset_requests()
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status = {
		[camera_action_type.move] = camera_action_request_status.waiting,
		[camera_action_type.zoom] = camera_action_request_status.waiting,
		[camera_action_type.rotate] = camera_action_request_status.waiting,
		[camera_action_type.bezier_move] = camera_action_request_status.waiting,
		[camera_action_type.shake] = camera_action_request_status.waiting,
	}

	self.cur_cam_action_request = {
		[camera_action_type.move] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.zoom] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.rotate] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.bezier_move] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.shake] = nil,
	}

	self.requests_in_queue = {
		[camera_action_type.move] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.zoom] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.rotate] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.bezier_move] = nil,
		[camera_action_type.shake] = nil,
	}

	self.damage_sfx = {
		'02_gun_ricochet_01',
		'02_gun_ricochet_02'
	}
end

function camera_controller:restart()
	self:reset_requests()

	self.camera_comp.transform.position = self.restart_position
	self.camera_comp.transform.localRotation = self.restart_rotation
	self.camera_comp.fieldOfView = self.restart_fov
end

function camera_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	self.camera_comp = nil
	self.virtual_cop_ui = nil
end

function camera_controller:is_camera_moving()
	local is_linear_moving = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.move] == camera_action_request_status.progressing
	local is_bezier_moving = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.bezier_move] == camera_action_request_status.progressing
	return is_linear_moving or is_bezier_moving 
end

function camera_controller:is_camera_zooming()
	return self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.zoom] == camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

function camera_controller:is_camera_rotating()
	return self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.rotate] == camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

function camera_controller:get_transform()
	return self.camera_comp.transform
end

function camera_controller:get_position()

end

function camera_controller:active_hit_effect()
	self:active_window_break_effect()
	self:active_red_screen_effect()
end

function camera_controller:active_window_break_effect()
	if self.hit_effect ~= nil then
		local axis_x_range = 1
		local axis_y_range = 0.45
		local random_x_adj_pos = unity_class.random.Range(-axis_x_range, axis_x_range)
		local random_y_adj_pos = unity_class.random.Range(-axis_y_range, axis_y_range)
		local random_local_adj_pos = vector(random_x_adj_pos, random_y_adj_pos, 0)
	
		self.hit_effect.transform.localPosition = self.hit_effect_original_local_position + random_local_adj_pos

		self.hit_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.hit_effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

		self:play_random_damaged_effect()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_glass_03')
	end
end

function camera_controller:play_random_damaged_effect()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(random_sfx)
end


function camera_controller:active_red_screen_effect()

		self.screen_red_vignette.gameObject:SetActive(false)
		self.screen_red_vignette.gameObject:SetActive(true)

function camera_controller:active_heal_effect()
