-- NOTE: 일단 카메라에 리퀘스트 날라오는거는 이벤트 기반으로 잡기는 했는데, 변경될 수 있음.
function camera_controller:on_move_requested(e)
	local new_request = {
		target_pos = e.TargetPos,
		duration = e.Duration
	}
	self:request_to_move(new_request)
end

-- NOTE: 일단 카메라에 리퀘스트 날라오는거는 이벤트 기반으로 잡기는 했는데, 변경될 수 있음.
function camera_controller:on_zoom_requested(e)
	local new_request = {
		target_fov = e.TargetFOV,
		duration = e.Duration
	}
	self:request_to_zoom(new_request)
end

-- NOTE: 일단 카메라에 리퀘스트 날라오는거는 이벤트 기반으로 잡기는 했는데, 변경될 수 있음.
function camera_controller:on_rotate_requested(e)
	local new_request = {
		target_rotation = e.TargetRotation,
		duration = e.Duration
	}
	self:request_to_rotate(new_request)
end

-- 이동 리퀘스트 데이터 설정
function camera_controller:request_to_move(request)
	if request == nil then
		return
	end

	request.time_passed = 0
	request.start_pos = self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition
	self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.move] = request
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.move] = camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

-- 줌 리퀘스트 데이터 설정
function camera_controller:request_to_zoom(request)
	if request == nil then
		return
	end

	request.time_passed = 0
	request.start_fov = self.camera_comp.fieldOfView
	self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.zoom] = request
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.zoom] = camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

-- 회전 리퀘스트 데이터 설정
function camera_controller:request_to_rotate(request)
	if request == nil then
		return
	end

	request.time_passed = 0
	request.start_rotation = self.camera_comp.transform.localRotation
	self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.rotate] = request
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.rotate] = camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

function camera_controller:request_to_bezier_move(request)
	if request == nil then
		return
	end

	request.time_passed = 0
	request.calculator = CS.Oak.BezierCurveCalculator()
	
	local num_waypoints = #request.waypoints
	local curve_type = nil
	
	self.bezier_point_list:Clear()

	for i = 1, #request.waypoints do
		local waypoint = request.waypoints[i]

		if num_waypoints == 3 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Quadratic
		elseif num_waypoints == 4 then
			curve_type = CS.Oak.BezierCurveType.Cubic
		end

		self.bezier_point_list:Add(vector(waypoint[1], waypoint[2], waypoint[3]))
	end
	
	request.calculator:Add(self.bezier_point_list, request.duration, curve_type)
	
	request.start_pos = self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition
	self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.bezier_move] = request
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.bezier_move] = camera_action_request_status.progressing
end


-- 쉐이크 리퀘스트 데이터 설정
function camera_controller:request_to_shake(request)
	if request == nil then
		return
	end

	request.time_passed = 0
	self.camera_shake_original_local_pos = self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition

	local shake_info = CS.Oak.ShakeInfo()
	shake_info.magnitude = request.magnitude
	shake_info.duration = request.duration
	

	self.shake_calculator:Shake(shake_info)
	self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.shake] = request
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.shake] = camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

function camera_controller:update(dt)
	-- 이동 관련 리퀘스트 처리
	local move_request_result = self:process_move_request(dt)
	
	-- 줌 관련 리퀘스트 처리
	local zoom_request_result = self:process_zoom_request(dt)
	
	-- 회전 관련 리퀘스트 처리
	local rotate_request_result = self:process_rotation_request(dt)

	-- 베지어 곡선 이동 관련 리퀘스트 처리
	local bezier_move_request_result = self:process_bezier_move_request(dt)

	-- 쉐이크 관련 리퀘스트 처리
	local shake_request_result = self:process_shake_request(dt)

	-- 결과 후 리퀘스트들 상태 처리
	self:compute_request_result(camera_action_type.move, move_request_result)
	self:compute_request_result(camera_action_type.zoom, zoom_request_result)
	self:compute_request_result(camera_action_type.rotate, rotate_request_result)
	self:compute_request_result(camera_action_type.bezier_move, bezier_move_request_result)
	self:compute_request_result(camera_action_type.shake, shake_request_result)
end

-- 카메라 회전 처리 함수
function camera_controller:process_rotation_request(dt)
	local request_status = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.rotate]
	local request = self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.rotate]

	if request_status == camera_action_request_status.waiting or request == nil then
		return camera_action_request_status.waiting
	end

	request.time_passed = request.time_passed + dt

	local progress = self:compute_progress(request.time_passed, request.duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		self.camera_comp.transform.localRotation = request.target_rotation

		return camera_action_request_status.finished
	end

	local next_rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Lerp(request.start_rotation, request.target_rotation, progress)
	self.camera_comp.transform.localRotation = next_rotation

	return camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

-- 카메라 이동 리퀘스트 처리 함수
function camera_controller:process_move_request(dt)
	local request_status = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.move]
	local request = self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.move]

	if request_status == camera_action_request_status.waiting or request == nil then
		return camera_action_request_status.waiting
	end

	request.time_passed = request.time_passed + dt

	local progress = self:compute_progress(request.time_passed, request.duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition = request.target_pos
		return camera_action_request_status.finished
	end

	local start_pos = request.start_pos
	local target_pos = request.target_pos
	local duration = request.duration

	-- 선형 보간 적용
	local cur_x = self.interpolations(request.time_passed, start_pos.x, target_pos.x - start_pos.x, duration)
	local cur_y = self.interpolations(request.time_passed, start_pos.y, target_pos.y - start_pos.y, duration)
	local cur_z = self.interpolations(request.time_passed, start_pos.z, target_pos.z - start_pos.z, duration)

	--local current_pos = vector_util.lerp(request.start_pos, request.target_pos, progress)
	self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition = vector(cur_x, cur_y, cur_z)

	return camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

-- 카메라 줌 크기 변경 리퀘스트 처리 함수
function camera_controller:process_zoom_request(dt)
	local request_status = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.zoom]
	local request = self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.zoom]
	
	if request_status == camera_action_request_status.waiting or request == nil then
		return camera_action_request_status.waiting
	end
	
	request.time_passed = request.time_passed + dt

	local progress = self:compute_progress(request.time_passed, request.duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		self.camera_comp.fieldOfView = request.target_fov
		return camera_action_request_status.finished
	end

	local current_fov = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(request.start_fov, request.target_fov, progress)
	self.camera_comp.fieldOfView = current_fov
	return camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

-- 카메라 베지어 곡선 이동 처리 함수
function camera_controller:process_bezier_move_request(dt)
	local request_status = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.bezier_move]
	local request = self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.bezier_move]
	
	if request_status == camera_action_request_status.waiting or request == nil then
		return camera_action_request_status.waiting
	end
	
	request.time_passed = request.time_passed + dt

	local progress = self:compute_progress(request.time_passed, request.duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		return camera_action_request_status.finished
	end

	request.calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition = request.calculator.CurrentPosition

	return camera_action_request_status.progressing
end

-- 쉐이크 리퀘스트 처리 함수
function camera_controller:process_shake_request(dt)
	local request_status = self.cur_cam_action_request_status[camera_action_type.shake]
	local request = self.cur_cam_action_request[camera_action_type.shake]

	if request_status == camera_action_request_status.waiting or request == nil then
		return camera_action_request_status.waiting
	end
	
	request.time_passed = request.time_passed + dt

	local progress = self:compute_progress(request.time_passed, request.duration)

	if (progress >= 1) then
		self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition = self.camera_shake_original_local_pos
		return camera_action_request_status.finished
	end

	self.shake_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition = self.camera_shake_original_local_pos + self.shake_calculator.ShakeOffset
end

function camera_controller:stop_shake()
	--self.camera_comp.transform.localPosition = self.camera_shake_original_local_pos
end

-- 카메라 리퀘스트 결과 처리 함수
function camera_controller:compute_request_result(request_type, result)
	self.cur_cam_action_request_status[request_type] = result
	if result == camera_action_request_status.progressing then
		return
	end

	if result == camera_action_request_status.finished then
		self.cur_cam_action_request[request_type] = nil
	end
end

-- 진행도 계산용 편의함수
function camera_controller:compute_progress(cur, total)
	return unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(cur / total)
end

function camera_controller:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VirtualCop.CameraMoveRequestedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VirtualCop.CameraZoomRequestedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.VirtualCop.CameraRotateRequestedEvent))

	self.bezier_point_list = nil
end

return {
    create = function()
        return camera_controller()
    end
}

---@class VirtualCopEffectController
local effect_controller = newclass('VirtualCopEffectController')

function effect_controller:init()
	self.minigame_controller = nil

	self.effect_names = nil
	self.effect_map = {}
end

function effect_controller:late_init()
end

function effect_controller:resolve_dependencies(minigame_controller, config)
	self.effect_names = config.effects
	self.minigame_controller = minigame_controller
end

function effect_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	self.minigame_controller = nil
	self.effect_names = nil
end

function effect_controller:pre_load_async()
	for i = 1, #self.effect_names do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.effect_names[i])
	end

	yield_return(unity_object_pool, 'WaitAll')
end

function effect_controller:create(effect_type, position, rotation, parent_transform, layer, is_manual_control)
	is_manual_control = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_manual_control, false)

	local effect_name = self.effect_names[effect_type]

	local effect = nil

	if parent_transform == nil then
		effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(position)
	else
		if rotation == nil then
			effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, parent_transform)
		else
			effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(position, rotation, parent_transform)
		end
	end

	if effect ~= nil then
		if is_manual_control then
			-- 한번에 한개의 이펙트만 허용.
			if self.effect_map[effect_name] ~= nil then
				self.effect_map[effect_name]:Dispose()
				self.effect_map[effect_name] = nil
			end 
			
			self.effect_map[effect_name] = effect
		end
		
		if layer ~= nil then
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(effect.transform, layer)
		end

	end
	
	return effect
end

function effect_controller:dispose_effect(effect_type)
	local effect_name = self.effect_names[effect_type]
	local effect = self.effect_map[effect_name] 

	if effect ~= nil then
		effect:Dispose()
		effect = nil
		self.effect_map[effect_name] = nil
	end
end

function effect_controller:reset()
	if self.effect_map ~= nil then
		for _, effect in pairs(self.effect_map) do
			effect:Dispose()
			effect = nil
		end
		
		self.effect_map = {}
	end
end

function effect_controller:dispose()
	self:reset()
	self.effect_map = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return effect_controller()
	end
}

---@class Entity
local entity = newclass('Entity')
local core = get_or_create_global_variable('minigame/VirtualCop/Nodes/BTNode')
local node_status = core.node_status

function entity:init(instance, hp, invincible, damage)
	self.instance = instance
	self.max_hp = hp
	self.hp = hp
	self.is_invincible = lua_helper.get_or_default(invincible, false)
	self.damage = lua_helper.get_or_default(damage, 1)
	self.parent_pool = nil
	self.collider = nil
	self.child_effect = nil

	self:cache_collider()
end

function entity:cache_collider()
	local collider = self.instance.gameObject:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
	
	if (not is_unity_null(collider)) then
		self.collider= collider
	end
end

function entity:get_name()
	return self.instance.gameObject.name
end

function entity:set_hit_point(point)
	self.hit_point = point
end

function entity:decrement_hp()
	if self.is_invincible then
		return
	end

	self.hp = self.hp - 1
end

function entity:is_alive()
	return self.hp > 0
end

function entity:reset()
	self.hp = self.max_hp
end

function entity:enable_collider()
	if self.collider == nil then
		return
	end

	self.collider.enabled = true
end

function entity:disable_collider()
	if self.collider == nil then
		return
	end

	self.collider.enabled = false
end


function entity:return_to_pool()
	if self.parent_pool.is_static then
		if self.parent_pool.is_item then
			self.instance.transform.position = vector(-999, 0, -999)
		end
		
		self.instance.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	else
		if self.instance.transform ~= nil then
			self.instance.transform.position = vector(-999, 0, -999)
		end
	end

	self:enable_collider()
	self.parent_pool:return_entity(self)
end

---@class EntityPool
local entity_pool = newclass('EntityPool')

function entity_pool:init(tag, entities, is_static, is_item)
	self.tag = tag
	self.entities = entities
	self.is_static = is_static
	self.is_item = lua_helper.get_or_default(is_item, false)

	for i = 1, #entities do
		entities[i].parent_pool = self
	end

	self.availables = create_lua_queue()
	self.in_used = {}

	for _, entity in pairs(entities) do
		self.availables:enqueue(entity)
	end
end

function entity_pool:get_available()
	local result, available = self.availables:try_dequeue()

	if result then
		available:reset()
		table.insert(self.in_used, available)
		return available
	end

	return nil
end

function entity_pool:return_entity(entity)
	local idx = array_util.index_of(self.in_used, entity)
	table.remove(self.in_used, idx)

	self.availables:enqueue(entity)
end

function entity_pool:restart()
	local total_entities = {}

	local result, item = self.availables:try_dequeue()
	
	while result do
		table.insert(total_entities, item)
		result, item = self.availables:try_dequeue()
	end
	
	self.availables:clear()

	for i = 1, #self.in_used do
		table.insert(total_entities, self.in_used[i])
	end

	self.in_used = {}

	-- 머리가 안돌아간다....
	for i = 1, #total_entities do
		total_entities[i]:return_to_pool()
	end
end

function entity_pool:reset()
	for _, in_used in ipairs(self.in_used) do
		in_used:return_to_pool()
	end

	self.in_used = {}
end

function entity_pool:dispose_child_effect()
	local result, item = self.availables:try_dequeue()
	
	while result do
		if item.child_effect ~= nil then
			item.child_effect:Dispose()
			item.child_effect = nil
		end

		result, item = self.availables:try_dequeue()
	end

	for i = 1, #self.in_used do
		local child_effect = self.in_used[i].child_effect
		if child_effect ~= nil then
			child_effect:Dispose()
			child_effect = nil
		end
	end
end

function entity_pool:dispose()
	self:dispose_child_effect()
	
	self.availables = nil
	self.in_used = nil
end

	for _, character in pairs(characters) do

			characters[entity_name] = spawn_data.spine
		elseif type_util.is_array(spawn_data.spine) then
			local random_spine = random_util.get_values_in_array(spawn_data.spine, { overlap = true, count = 1 })
			characters[entity_name] = random_spine[1]
		end

function prefab_spawner:init()
end

function prefab_spawner:spawn(type_name, spawn_data, layer, resource)
	local prefab = resource.prefabs[type_name]
	local clones = self:create_clones(type_name, spawn_data, prefab)
	
	for _, clone in pairs(clones) do
		self:change_layer(clone.instance.transform, layer)
		self:deactive_clone(clone.instance)
	end

	local entity_pool = prefab_pool(type_name, clones, true)

	if table_util.get_size(clones) == 1 then
		return singleton_pool(entity_pool)
	end

	return entity_pool
end

function prefab_spawner:create_clones(type_name, spawn_data, prefab)
	local quantity = spawn_data.quantity
	local clones = {}

	local active_shadow = lua_helper.get_or_default(spawn_data.active_shadow, true)

	for idx = 1, quantity do
		local clone = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab)
		clone.gameObject.name = type_name .. '_' .. idx 
		local tile_comp = clone.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Tilemaps.Tile))
		if not is_unity_null(tile_comp) then
			tile_comp.enabled = false
		end
		
		if spawn_data.scale ~= nil then
			clone.transform.localScale = vector(spawn_data.scale, spawn_data.scale, spawn_data.scale)
		end

		local collider = clone.transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Collider))
		if not is_unity_null(collider) then
			collider.enabled = true
		end

		local shadow_transform = clone.transform:Find('shadow')
		if not is_unity_null(shadow_transform) and not active_shadow then
			shadow_transform.gameObject:SetActive(active_shadow)
		end 

		clone.gameObject:SetActive(false)

		table.insert(clones, entity(clone, spawn_data.max_hp, spawn_data.invincible, spawn_data.damage))
	end

	return clones
end

function prefab_spawner:deactive_clone(clone)
	clone.transform.position = vector(-999, 0, -999)
end

end

function gimmick_spawner:spawn(type_name, spawn_data, layer, resource)
	local entities = {}
	local handle_name_prefix = spawn_data.handle_name_prefix
	local collider_data = spawn_data.collider
	
	for i = 1, spawn_data.quantity do
		local field_object = get_field_object(handle_name_prefix .. i )
		
		if field_object ~= nil then
			if collider_data ~= nil then
				local collider = field_object.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.BoxCollider))
				local collider_size = vector(collider_data.size[1], collider_data.size[2], collider_data.size[3])
				local collider_center = vector(collider_data.center[1], collider_data.center[2], collider_data.center[3])
				collider.center = collider_center
				collider.size = collider_size
			end

			local instance = entity(field_object, spawn_data.max_hp, spawn_data.invincible, spawn_data.damage)

			if type_name == 'supply' then
				local spawn_pos = field_object.Transform.position + vector(0, 1.25, 0)
				instance.child_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('ch11_move_icon')
						:Instantiate(spawn_pos, unity_class.quaternion.identity, field_object.Transform)
				instance.child_effect.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
				instance.child_effect:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state:SetAnimation(0, 'in', true)
				self:change_layer(instance.child_effect.transform, layer)
			end
			
			self:change_layer(field_object.Transform, layer)
			table.insert(entities, instance)
		end
	end

	local entity_pool = entity_pool(type_name, entities, true)
	
	if #entities == 1 then
		return singleton_pool(entity_pool)
	end

	return entity_pool
end

---@class EntityController
local entity_manager = newclass('EntityManager')

function entity_manager:init()
	self.entities = {}
	self.resource_loader = nil
	self.entity_layer = nil
	self.bt_builder = nil

	self.entity_loaders = {
		['character'] = character_spawner,
		['prefab'] = prefab_spawner,
		['gimmick'] = gimmick_spawner,
		['drop_item'] = drop_item_spawner
	}

	--
	self.activated_entities = {}
	self.activated_entity_behaviors = {}
	
	self.deactivated_entities = {}
	self.deactivated_entity_behaviors = {}
	
	-- 스테이지에 미리 배치되어있는 정적 엔티티
	self.static_entities = {}
	self.static_entity_behaviors = {}

	self.is_behaviour_updating = false
end

function entity_manager:resolve_dependencies(game_controller, resource_loader, bt_builder)
	self.entity_layer = game_controller.game_config.game_layer
	self.resource_loader = resource_loader
	self.bt_builder = bt_builder
end 

function entity_manager:dissolve_dependencies()
	self.resource_loader = nil
	self.bt_builder = nil
end

function entity_manager:load_entities()
	local resource = self.resource_loader:get_resources()
	local entity_data = resource.entity_data

	for type, data in pairs(entity_data) do
		local loader_type = self.entity_loaders[data.asset_load_type]

		if loader_type ~= nil then
			local entities = loader_type():spawn(type, data, self.entity_layer, resource)
			self.entities[type] = entities
		end
	end
end

function entity_manager:create_entity(type)
	return self.entities[type]:get_available()
end

function entity_manager:create_entities(entity_info_list)
	local entities = {}

	for i = 1, #entity_info_list do
		table.insert(entities, self:create_entity(entity_info_list[i].type))
	end

	return entities
end

function entity_manager:activate_entity(entity, entity_info)
	local entity_name = entity:get_name()
	local data = entity_info.behavior_data
	local behavior_type = entity_info.behavior_type
	local behavior = self.bt_builder:create_entity_behavior(entity, behavior_type, data)
	local is_static = lua_helper.get_or_default(entity_info.is_static, false)

	if is_static then
		self.static_entities[entity_name] = entity
		self.static_entity_behaviors[entity_name] = behavior
	else
		self.activated_entities[entity_name] = entity
		self.activated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] = behavior
	end

	self.is_behaviour_updating = true
end

function entity_manager:deactive_entity(entity_name)
	if not type_util.is_string(entity_name) then
		return
	end
	
	local entity = self.activated_entities[entity_name]
	local behavior = self.activated_entity_behaviors[entity_name]

	if entity ~= nil then
		self.activated_entities[entity_name] = nil
		self.activated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] = nil

		self.deactivated_entities[entity_name] = entity
		self.deactivated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] = behavior
	end
end

function entity_manager:remove_entity(entity)
	local entity_name = entity:get_name()
	
	self.activated_entities[entity_name] = nil
	self.activated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] = nil

	self.deactivated_entities[entity_name] = nil
	self.deactivated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] = nil

	entity:return_to_pool()
end

function entity_manager:update_damaged_entity(hit_info)
	if hit_info == nil then
		return
	end

	local entity = self.activated_entities[hit_info.name]

	if entity ~= nil then
		entity:decrement_hp()
		entity:set_hit_point(hit_info.point)

		if not entity:is_alive() then
			self:deactive_entity(hit_info.name)
		end

		return
	end


	entity = self.static_entities[hit_info.name]

	if entity ~= nil then
		entity:decrement_hp()
		entity:set_hit_point(hit_info.point)
	end
end

function entity_manager:update_entity_behaviors(dt)
	
	self.is_behaviour_updating = false

	for _, behavior in pairs(self.activated_entity_behaviors) do
		local result = behavior:update(dt)

		if result == node_status.running then
			self.is_behaviour_updating = true
		end
	end

	for _, behavior in pairs(self.deactivated_entity_behaviors) do
		behavior:update(dt)
	end

	for _, behavior in pairs(self.static_entity_behaviors) do
		behavior:update(dt)
	end
end

function entity_manager:update_entity_behavior(entity_name, dt)
	if self.activated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] ~= nil then
		return self.activated_entity_behaviors[entity_name]:update(dt)
	end
	
	if self.deactivated_entity_behaviors[entity_name] ~= nil then
		return self.deactivated_entity_behaviors[entity_name]:update(dt)
	end
end

function entity_manager:get_activated_entities()
	return table_util.get_values(self.activated_entities)
end

function entity_manager:get_deactivated_entities()
	return self.deactivated_entities
end

function entity_manager:is_any_behaviour_updating()
	return self.is_behaviour_updating
end

function entity_manager:is_any_entity_alive()
	for _, entity in pairs(self.activated_entities) do
		if entity:is_alive() then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function entity_manager:reset()
	for _, pool in pairs(self.entities) do
		if not pool.is_static then 
			pool:reset()
		end
	end

	for _, behaviour in pairs(self.activated_entity_behaviors) do
		behaviour:dispose()
	end

	for _, behaviour in pairs(self.deactivated_entity_behaviors) do
		behaviour:dispose()
	end

	self.activated_entities = {}
	self.activated_entity_behaviors = {}
	self.deactivated_entity_behaviors = {}
	self.deactivated_entities = {}
end

function entity_manager:dispose_child_effect()
	for _, pool in pairs(self.entities) do
		pool:dispose_child_effect()
	end
end

function entity_manager:reset_static_entities()
	for _, pool in pairs(self.entities) do
		if pool.is_static then 
			pool:reset()
		end
	end

	for _, behaviour in pairs(self.static_entity_behaviors) do
		behaviour:dispose()
	end

	self.static_entities = {}
	self.static_entity_behaviors = {}
end

function entity_manager:restart()
	for _, pool in pairs(self.entities) do
		pool:restart()
	end

	for _, behaviour in pairs(self.activated_entity_behaviors) do
		behaviour:dispose()
	end

	for _, behaviour in pairs(self.deactivated_entity_behaviors) do
		behaviour:dispose()
	end

	for _, behaviour in pairs(self.static_entity_behaviors) do
		behaviour:dispose()
	end

	self.static_entities = {}
	self.activated_entities = {}
	self.deactivated_entities = {}

	self.static_entity_behaviors = {}
	self.activated_entity_behaviors = {}
	self.deactivated_entity_behaviors = {}
end

function entity_manager:dispose()

	if self.entities ~= nil then
		for _, pool in pairs(self.entities) do
			pool:dispose()
		end
		self.entities = nil
	end

	if self.activated_entity_behaviors ~= nil then
		for _, behaviour in pairs(self.activated_entity_behaviors) do
			behaviour:dispose()
		end

		self.activated_entity_behaviors = nil
	end

	if self.deactivated_entity_behaviors ~= nil then
		for _, behaviour in pairs(self.deactivated_entity_behaviors) do
			behaviour:dispose()
		end

		self.deactivated_entity_behaviors = nil
	end

	if self.static_entity_behaviors ~= nil then
		for _, behaviour in pairs(self.static_entity_behaviors) do
			behaviour:dispose()
		end

		self.static_entity_behaviors = nil
	end


	self.activated_entity = nil
	self.deactivated_entities = nil
	self.static_entities = nil

	self.entity_layer = nil
	self.player = nil
	self.enemies = nil
	self.obstacles = nil
end

return {
	create = function()
		return entity_manager()
	end
}

function loop_sound_controller:init()
	self.sfx_map = {}
end

function loop_sound_controller:add_loop_sound(name, vol, fade_in)
	vol = lua_helper.get_or_default(vol, 1)
	fade_in = lua_helper.get_or_default(fade_in, 0)

	if self.sfx_map[name] ~= nil then
		self.sfx_map[name]:Stop()
	end

	self.sfx_map[name] =
		music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{
				sfx_name = name,
				loop = true,
				volume = vol,
				fade_in_time = fade_in
			})
end

function loop_sound_controller:change_volume(name, target_vol, mix)
	if self.sfx_map[name] ~= nil then
		start_coroutine(function() 
			local sfx = self.sfx_map[name]
			local time_passed = 0
			local init_vol = sfx.Volume

			while time_passed < mix do
				time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / mix)
				local cur_vol = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(init_vol, target_vol, progress)
				sfx.Volume = cur_vol

				coroutine.yield()
			end

			sfx.Volume = target_vol
		end)
	end
end

function loop_sound_controller:fade_out_loop_sound(name, fade_out)
	if self.sfx_map[name] ~= nil then
		self.sfx_map[name]:FadeOut(fade_out)
	end
end

function loop_sound_controller:stop_sfx(name)
	if self.sfx_map[name] ~= nil then
		self.sfx_map[name]:Stop()
	end
end

function loop_sound_controller:reset()
	if self.sfx_map ~= nil then
		for _, sfx in pairs(self.sfx_map) do
			sfx:Stop()
			sfx = nil
		end
		
		self.sfx_map = {}
	end
end

function loop_sound_controller:dispose()

	self.sfx_map = nil
end

	create = function()
		return loop_sound_controller()
	end

	progressing = 1,

--#region ********** Shooting State Interface **********
local shooting_state_base = newclass('IShootingState')
function shooting_state_base:init(controller) end

--#region ********** Reloading State **********
local reloading_state = newclass('ReloadingState', shooting_state_base)

function reloading_state:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.duration = controller.reload_duration

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_reload_06')
	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:reload_start()

	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:play_fps_hand_anim('reload', false)
end

function reloading_state:update(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if (self.time_passed >= self.duration) then
		self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:reload_complete()
		self.controller.available_bullet_rounds = self.controller.max_bullet_count
		return state_progress_status.finished
	end

	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:reloading(self.time_passed, self.duration)

	return state_progress_status.progressing
end

function reloading_state:late_update()
end

end

--#region ********** Fireable State **********
local fireable_state = newclass('FireableState', shooting_state_base)

function fireable_state:init(controller)
	self.controller = controller
	self.fire_interval = controller.fire_interval

	self.time_passed_since_last_input = 0

	self.raycasting_filter_layers = ~CS.UnityEngine.LayerMask.NameToLayer(self.controller.game_layer)

	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:set_current_bullet_num(self.controller.available_bullet_rounds)
	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:play_fps_hand_anim('idle', true)

	self.is_current_state_computable = true
	self.is_fired = false
end

function fireable_state:update(dt)
	if self.controller.available_bullet_rounds == 0 then
		return state_progress_status.finished
	end

	self:update_fire_interval(dt)
	
	return state_progress_status.progressing
end

function fireable_state:late_update()
	if not self.is_fired then
		return
	end
	
	self.controller.available_bullet_rounds = math.max(0, self.controller.available_bullet_rounds - 1)
	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:set_current_bullet_num(self.controller.available_bullet_rounds)
	self.is_fired = false
end

function fireable_state:update_fire_interval(dt)
	if self.is_current_state_computable then
		return
	end
	
	self.time_passed_since_last_input = self.time_passed_since_last_input + dt

	if self.time_passed_since_last_input > self.fire_interval then
		self.time_passed_since_last_input = 0
		self.is_current_state_computable = true
	end
end

function fireable_state:evaluate_raycast_hit(touch_pos)
	if (not self.is_current_state_computable) or (self.controller.camera_comp == nil) then
		return nil
	end

	local touch_pos_ui_layer = vector(touch_pos.x, touch_pos.y, 0)
	local ray = self.controller.camera_comp:ScreenPointToRay(touch_pos_ui_layer)
	local ray_max_distance = 10000
	local count = CS.UnityEngine.Physics.RaycastNonAlloc(ray, self.controller.raycast_hit_array, ray_max_distance, self.raycasting_filter_layers)
	
	local is_clicked_on_ui_layer = self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:set_cross_hair(ray.origin)
	
	if is_clicked_on_ui_layer then
		return nil
	end

	-- 다음 사격까지 딜레이 처리.
	self.is_current_state_computable = false
	self.is_fired = true
	
	local hit_objects = {}

	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		local raycast_hit = self.controller.raycast_hit_array[i]

		local hit_object = {
			name = raycast_hit.transform.gameObject.name,
			point = raycast_hit.point,
			distance = raycast_hit.distance
		}

		table.insert(hit_objects, hit_object)
	end

	table.sort(hit_objects, function(a, b)
		return a.distance < b.distance
	end)
	
	-- 단 하나만 가져온다.
	if #hit_objects > 0 then
		return hit_objects[1]
	end
	
	return nil
end

function fireable_state:active_gunfire_effect(touch_pos)
	local screen_size = screen_util.get_world_screen_size()
	local center = screen_size / 2
	local diff = touch_pos - center
	local field_ui_cam_pos = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera.transform.position
	local test = vector(field_ui_cam_pos.x + diff.x, field_ui_cam_pos.y + diff.y, 1)
	local effect_pos = field_ui_manager.FieldUICamera:WorldToScreenPoint(test)

	self.controller.gunfire.transform.position = vector(effect_pos.x, effect_pos.y, 0) 
	self.controller.gunfire.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	self.controller.gunfire.gameObject:SetActive(true)
end

function fireable_state:bullet_supplied()
	self.is_fired = false
	self.controller.available_bullet_rounds = self.controller.max_bullet_count
	self.controller.virtual_cop_ui:set_current_bullet_num(self.controller.max_bullet_count)
end

--#endregion


--#region ********** Shooting Controller **********  
local shooting_controller = newclass('VirtualCopShootingController')

function shooting_controller:init()
	self.game_layer = nil
	self.camera_comp = nil
	self.virtual_cop_ui = nil

	self.available_bullet_rounds = nil
	self.max_bullet_count = nil

	-- 각 사격간 텀. 기본 값 0.1
	self.fire_interval = 0.1
	
	-- 재장전 시간. 기본 값 0.5
	self.reload_duration = 0.5

	self.raycast_hit_array = CS.PhysicsExtensions.GetRaycastHitArray(5)

	self.hit_object = nil

	self.next_states = {
		[fireable_state:name()] = reloading_state,
		[reloading_state:name()] = fireable_state,
	}

	self.current_state = nil

	self.is_bullet_suppied = false
end

function shooting_controller:late_init()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	self.current_state = fireable_state(self)
end

function shooting_controller:resolve_dependencies(game_config, camera_comp, virtual_cop_ui)
	self.game_layer = game_config.game_layer
	self.available_bullet_rounds = game_config.max_bullet 
	self.max_bullet_count = game_config.max_bullet
	self.camera_comp = camera_comp
	self.virtual_cop_ui = virtual_cop_ui

	self.fire_interval = lua_helper.get_or_default(game_config.fire_interval, self.fire_interval)
	self.reload_duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(game_config.reload_duration, self.reload_duration)

	self.virtual_cop_ui:set_reload_call_back(function() 
		self:reload() 
	end)
end

function shooting_controller:dissolve_dependencies()
	self.virtual_cop_ui = nil
	self.camera_comp = nil
end

function shooting_controller:update(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil then
		return
	end

	local state_status = self.current_state:update(dt)

	if state_status == state_progress_status.finished then
		local next_state = self.next_states[self.current_state:class():name()]
		if next_state ~= nil then
			self:change_state(next_state)
		end
	end
end

function shooting_controller:late_update()
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:late_update()
	end
end

function shooting_controller:change_state(next_state)
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
		self.current_state = next_state(self)
	end
end

function shooting_controller:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 터치 다운만 인풋 진행
	local touch_type = e.TouchEventType
	local is_touch_downed = touch_type == touch_event_type.touch_down

	if is_touch_downed then
		self.hit_object = self.current_state:evaluate_raycast_hit(e.TouchPos)
	end
end

function shooting_controller:reload()
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
		self.current_state = reloading_state(self)
	end 
end

function shooting_controller:restore()
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:dispose()
		self.current_state = fireable_state(self)
	end 

	self:bullet_supplied()

	self.virtual_cop_ui:reload_complete()
end

function shooting_controller:bullet_supplied()
	if self.current_state ~= nil then
		self.current_state:bullet_supplied()
	end
end

function shooting_controller:reset()
	self.hit_object = nil
	self.is_fired = false
end

function shooting_controller:get_hit_object()
	return self.hit_object
end

function shooting_controller:disable()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

function shooting_controller:dispose()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
end

--#endregion

return {
	create = function()
		return shooting_controller()
	end
}
